data.title: Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Company: EVOCS

Location: Mumbai/ Noida, Hybrid

Experience: 3-4 years

Employment Type: Full-time

About The Role

Velloe - an EVOCS Company is looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team and work across our headless, multi-platform product architecture. Our stack pairs a Drupal 10 headless CMS with a Next. js 14 web portal and React Native mobile apps for iOS and Android, all sharing synchronized state, unified data contracts, and end-to-end AES-256-CBC payload encryption. You'll work across mobile, web, and backend layers, contributing to features that span our entire platform rather than sitting in a single silo. 

This role suits someone with 3-4 years of hands-on development experience who is comfortable moving between a React Native codebase, a Next. js frontend, and a PHP/Drupal backend, and who wants to keep building breadth across a modern, security-conscious stack. 

What You'll Work With

Our architecture is headless and decoupled: Drupal 10 serves content and business logic through REST and GraphQL APIs, consumed by a Next. js 14 web portal and React Native 0. 78 mobile apps. All three layers share unified data contracts and encrypt API payloads end-to-end with AES-256-CBC. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain features across our React Native (iOS & Android), Next. js web, and Drupal backend codebases, depending on sprint needs. 
 - Implement UI screens and components using React Native Paper, Reanimated, and React Navigation on mobile, and React with Tailwind CSS on web. 
 - Integrate with REST and GraphQL APIs exposed by our Drupal 10 backend, including handling CSRF token injection, authenticated requests, and AES-256-CBC encrypted payloads. 
 - Manage application state using Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, including offline persistence via redux-persist and AsyncStorage on mobile. 
 - Build and validate forms using React Hook Form and Yup on the web portal. 
 - Implement and troubleshoot push notifications, deep linking, and local/remote notification handling using Firebase Cloud Messaging and Notifee. 
 - Contribute to backend features in Drupal 10 (PHP 8. 2), including custom REST endpoints, GraphQL schema/resolvers, and content model changes. 
 - Work with MySQL 8. 0 for data modeling, queries, and performance tuning as needed. 
 - Integrate third-party services such as Razorpay (payments), FingerprintJS (device fraud prevention), Google Analytics 4, Firebase Crashlytics, and Vimeo/YouTube video embeds. 
 - Support release processes: generate Android `. aab`/`. apk` builds via Gradle and iOS `. ipa` builds via Xcode Archive, and assist with manual submissions to Google Play Console and TestFlight/App Store. 
 - Write clean, typed code in TypeScript across mobile and web, following our ESLint/Prettier standards and Conventional Commits via Husky and Commitizen. 
 - Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and cross-functional discussions with design, QA, and product. 
 - Debug and resolve issues across the stack, using tools like Firebase Crashlytics and network/API debugging to trace problems from client to backend. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 3-4 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated work across both frontend and backend, or frontend and mobile. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience writing typed, interface-driven code. 
 - Hands-on experience with React (web) and ideally React Native for mobile app development. 
 - Working knowledge of Redux or Redux Toolkit for state management, including async data fetching patterns (RTK Query or similar). 
 - Experience consuming REST APIs; exposure to GraphQL is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with a server-side language such as PHP, and comfort working with a CMS or backend framework (Drupal experience is a strong plus, but not required if you're comfortable picking it up). 
 - Basic to intermediate SQL and relational database experience (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar). 
 - Understanding of Git workflows, including feature branching, pull requests, and code review practices. 
 - Familiarity with authentication/security concepts such as token-based auth, CSRF protection, or payload encryption (AES-256 or similar) is a plus. 
 - Ability to work across the mobile, web, and backend layers of a project, and willingness to learn unfamiliar parts of the stack. 
 - Good communication skills and comfort collaborating in a cross-functional agile team. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Next. js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS. 
 - Experience with Drupal or another headless/decoupled CMS. 
 - Exposure to Firebase services (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics). 
 - Experience integrating payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with mobile release processes (Gradle builds, Xcode Archive, Play Console/App Store submissions). 
 - Experience with mapping libraries (Leaflet, Google Maps) or media/video integrations (React Player, PDF. js, Vimeo/YouTube APIs). 
 - Exposure to AWS S3 or other cloud object storage for media/asset handling. 

Tools & Practices You'll Use

Bitbucket for version control, Husky pre-commit hooks with Commitizen for Conventional Commits, ESLint and Prettier for code quality, and Composer for backend dependency management. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Portfolio or prior project experience demonstrating full-stack or cross-platform development work.

Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. Job Details
 - Location: Hyderabad, India (100% Work from Office)
 - Experience Required: 12-15 Years
 - Job Type: Full-Time / Permanent
 - Client Context: US-Based Fortune 200 Energy & Utilities Enterprise
 - Travel Requirement: Active US Business Visa (B1/B2) required for potential immediate travel deploymentAbout Us: The Prodigy DNA

At Prodigy Systems and Services, we are an AI-Native, extensive-engineering-focused enterprise that believes software engineering is an elite craft. For over 14 years, we have maintained a deeply trusted, bulletproof foothold with our primary US Fortune 200 client. Today, we have a powerhouse family of 70 elite engineers actively scaling and supporting their infrastructure. 

We are a tight-knit family of professionals built on a core pillar of deep mutual respect. Our strengths are anchored in Customer First, Integrity, Transparency, and Innovation. We are working hungry, driven to make a true difference in society and the world through hyper-velocity technological progress. 

When you join Prodigy, you will experience: 

- Warm, brilliant colleagues who push you to be your best engineering self. 
 - A humble management team that is fiercely committed to doing the right thing. 
 - An environment of radical documentation: We live by a strict operational doctrine: "Over-communication is a mandatory requirement. " We heavily utilize Microsoft Teams, Emails, and written technical specs. If it is not in writing, it never happened. Role Description & Intent

We are looking for a powerhouse, battle-tested Senior Consultant / Principal Engineer (IC) who can single-handedly pull the engineering weight of an entire team. This is a high-throttle street-the work is highly demanding, intensely fast-paced, yet deeply rewarding. 

This is strictly a production-code-producing role. You will not be limited to high-level whiteboard architecture; you must actively write, optimize, compile, and ship the code you design. You will be responsible for tearing down a legacy enterprise stack and rebuilding it from scratch using state-of-the-art Generative AI acceleration. 

Core Responsibilities & Technical Expectations
 - Production Code Execution: Massively produce clean, scalable, production-grade code leveraging Microsoft . NET Core (C#) and advanced SQL Server engineering. 
 - AI-Autonomous Engineering: Operate as an AI-augmented developer. You must natively orchestrate autonomous AI software agents (like Devin) and advanced tools (ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf) within sandboxed environments to multiply development speed. 
 - Spec-Driven Development (SDD): Write software exclusively against rigorous, unambiguous technical specifications. Code is only written once the spec is perfect. 
 - Architectural Rigor: Strictly apply SOLID principles and decoupled design patterns to ensure the new stack is easily maintainable. 
 - High-Scale Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain systems built to handle 0. 5 Million+ active customers and scale smoothly through 5 Million+ transactions daily with bulletproof stability. 
 - Hybrid Infrastructure Management: Engineer code optimized to run seamlessly within a primary On-Premises Data Center while managing low-latency replication and automated failover pipelines to AWS Disaster Recovery (DR). 
 - Observability & Instrumentation: Build world-class distributed log instrumentation and tracing setups to ensure zero blind spots across the On-Prem/AWS boundary. 
 - Cost-Sensitive Engineering: Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction. Core Skills & Competencies
 - Primary Stack: Microsoft . NET C#, . NET Core, Advanced SQL Server (Query optimization, locking, indexing structures). 
 - AI Engineering: Cognition Devin orchestration, ChatGPT prompt engineering, Cursor, Windsurf. 
 - Methodologies: Spec-Driven Development (SDD), SOLID Principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Infrastructure: Hybrid Data Centers, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, DR automation). 
 - Observability: Advanced Distributed Logging, Telemetry, and APM Instrumentation. 
 - Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the Texas Energy & Utilities sector (ERCOT, smart grids, or deregulated market clearing) is a massive plus. Rigorous 4-Round Interview Evaluation Process
 - Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive
 - Focus: Severe testing of . NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals. 
 - Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge
 - Focus: A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code. 
 - Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design
 - Focus: Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency. 
 - Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit
 - Focus: Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

Company Description Neologic Automation Systems is a specialized engineering company focused on test automation, validation systems, industrial automation, and advanced manufacturing solutions. The organization helps manufacturers improve product quality, traceability, and production efficiency through customized testing and validation solutions. Its expertise includes automated test equipment, end-of-line testing, PCB functional testing, NI TestStand and LabVIEW development, PLC and HMI integration, vision inspection systems, data acquisition and reporting, and robot-based automation. With extensive experience in automotive, electrical, electronics, and manufacturing industries, Neologic Automation Systems delivers reliable and scalable solutions that ensure product quality and process excellence. The company is committed to validating performance, ensuring quality, and building confidence in every product. 

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site LabVIEW Developer role based in Bengaluru South. The LabVIEW Developer will design, develop, and maintain test and validation applications using LabVIEW and NI TestStand for automated test equipment and industrial automation projects. Responsibilities include gathering requirements from engineering and production teams, implementing data acquisition, control, and reporting modules, and integrating test systems with PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, and robot-based automation where applicable. The role involves debugging and optimizing existing LabVIEW code, ensuring robust performance, traceability, and compliance with industry standards, and preparing technical documentation, test procedures, and user manuals. The LabVIEW Developer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of test and validation systems at customer sites. 

Qualifications

- Strong proficiency in LabVIEW development, including modular application design and hardware interfacing. 
 - Experience with NI TestStand for test sequence development, automation workflows, and result management. 
 - Knowledge of data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and measurement techniques for automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with PLC and HMI integration, industrial communication protocols, and control system concepts. 
 - Understanding of vision inspection systems, robot-based automation, and Industry 4. 0 connectivity and traceability is an advantage. 
 - Ability to analyze requirements, design test architectures, and validate solutions for automotive, electrical, electronics, or manufacturing applications. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to debug complex software and hardware interactions. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on-site. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering field. 
 - Prior experience in automated test equipment development, end-of-line testing, or PCB functional testing is preferred.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer) to design, build, and maintain scalable web applications across the front end, back end, and cloud infrastructure. This role requires a strong foundation in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, Python and Node. js backend development, containerized microservices, and hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features end-to-end - from UI implementation to API design to cloud deployment - and collaborates effectively within an Agile team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain full stack web applications spanning front-end, back-end, and cloud environments
 - Develop and integrate REST/SOAP APIs and microservices to support business applications and AI-driven workflows
 - Enhance, troubleshoot, and support existing production applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability
 - Deploy and manage applications on AWS using containerized (Docker/ECS Fargate) and serverless (Lambda/API Gateway) architectures
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers within an Agile development process
 - Participate in code reviews and apply static code analysis and security scanning tools to maintain code quality
 - Collaborate with IT partners, business teams, and the broader IT matrix organization to understand requirements and use cases, support solution design and delivery of new digital capabilities, and contribute to the enablement and simplification of existing ones - translating requirements into user stories, epics, and sprint-ready tasks using Agile/Scrum methodologies
 - Gather requirements, propose solution options, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Desired Experience

Front End

- Strong hands-on experience building production applications with ReactJS (with TypeScript); working knowledge of Next. js
 - Experience with React Native for mobile development
 - Exposure to an additional front-end framework such as Vue. js is a plus
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
 - Experience with modern CSS frameworks/libraries such as Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and component libraries like shadcn/ui

Back End

- Solid experience with Python and Node. js for building server-side applications and services
 - Experience designing and building REST APIs; familiarity with SOAP APIs
 - Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and Docker containerization
 - Experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, and Express. js
 - Understanding of ORM concepts and implementation

Database

- Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB (or similar relational and NoSQL databases)
 - Familiarity with SQLite for lightweight/local data storage use cases
 - Practical experience with data modeling for both relational and NoSQL systems

Cloud (AWS)

- Hands-on experience with core AWS services API Gateway, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, EC2, ECR, ECS Fargate, ALB, NLB, and IAM
 - Understanding of serverless and containerized deployment patterns on AWS
 - Working knowledge of AWS security and access management (IAM roles/policies)

DevOps

- Proficient with Git for version control and collaborative development workflows
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy
 - Familiarity with static code analysis and linting tools such as PyLint and ESLint

Tools & Collaboration

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot within VS Code
 - Experience working with JIRA and Confluence in an Agile development environment
 - Strong track record of participating in code reviews and applying static code analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk Code

Good to Have

- Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts and application development
 - Experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph for building AI-driven workflows and agents
 - Familiarity with Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock
 - Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its use in AI tool integrations

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 - 4-7 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated full stack project delivery
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a cross-functional Agile team
 - Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, including version control, code review, testing, and secure coding standards
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Demonstrated experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

How We Work

Where you work matters - because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https //careers. bms. com/ways-of-working. 

Supporting People With Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms. com. Join our ambitious team and help us continue to raise the standard in responsible gameplay and sustainability!

 - For QA Teams: Build agents that parse acceptance criteria to generate comprehensive test cases, automate synthetic test data generation, generate submission documents, and categorize bug reports. 

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 5+ years in software engineering, with at least 1. 5+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade AI/LLM applications.

 - Programming: Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node. js. 
 - AI Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks, and Vector Databases. 
 - Integrations: Proven track record of working with REST APIs, webhooks, and SDKs for various platforms like GitHub, Jira, Figma, Adobe, Slack, and Teams. 

Soft Skills & Approach

Qualification

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Description

About Salesforce

Department Overview

The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows. 

Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation-not experimentation without operational accountability. 

Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator

We are seeking a Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node. js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software. 

Core Responsibilities

- Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule. 
 - Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications. 
 - App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node. js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS). 
 - Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs. 
 - Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance. 
 - Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces. 

Technical Profile

- Core Data Engineering Foundations: 
 - Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting). 
 - Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts. 
 - Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge: 
 - Practical experience with Node. js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO). 
 - AI & Agentic Engineering: 
 - Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain. 
 - Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms. 
 - Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e. g. , Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure: 
 - Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 

Qualifications

- Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth). 
 - Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation. 
 - Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node. js/APIs). 
 - Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

data.title: Senior Principal Verification Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Principal ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer to join our dynamic and fast‐paced engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the functional correctness, robustness, and overall quality of our cutting‐edge semiconductor and SoC designs. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, this opportunity is an excellent fit. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Verification Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute comprehensive SoC/IP‐level verification plans aligned with design specifications and project goals. 
 - Drive verification closure through functional, code, and assertion coverage, ensuring high‐quality deliverables. 
 - Apply industry‐standard ASIC/SoC verification techniques including test planning, testbench creation, constrained‐random and directed stimulus, assertions, and coverage‐driven verification. 
 - Perform SoC integration verification, validating interactions across subsystems, interfaces, and power/performance domains. 
 - Testbench & Environment Development
 - Architect, develop, and enhance SystemVerilog UVM/OVM‐based testbenches for IP and SoC‐level verification. 
 - Build and integrate reusable Verification IP (VIP) and scalable verification components. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams and third‐party VIP providers to ensure seamless integration and compliance. 
 - Develop checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and coverage models to support robust verification. 
 - Methodology, Flows & Best Practices
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of ASIC/SoC design and verification methodologies, including constraint‐random verification and object‐oriented programming principles. 
 - Contribute to verification methodology improvements, automation, and flow optimization. 
 - Ensure adherence to best practices in UVM architecture, reuse, and maintainability
 - Advanced Verification Skills
 - Perform Gate‐Level Simulation (GLS) including SDF annotation, timing verification, and debug of post‐synthesis/post‐layout issues. 
 - Execute power‐aware verification using UPF/CPF, validating power modes, isolation, retention, and sequencing. 
 - Debug complex SoC‐level issues involving multiple clock domains, resets, and power states. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques where appropriate to complement simulation‐based verification. 
 - Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog (UVM/OVM) and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, C/C++, and Verilog PLI. 
 - Familiarity with standard protocols and interfaces (e. g. , I2C, SPI, UART, AXI/AHB/APB). 
 - Experience with simulation, debug, and coverage tools from major EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens). 
 - Knowledge of CI/regression automation, version control, and workflow tools is a plus
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Work effectively with design, architecture, DV, validation, and firmware teams to drive verification to completion. 
 - Communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, reviews, and cross‐functional discussions. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, strong analytical problem‐solving skills, and adaptability in a diverse team environment. 

Qualifications

data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Who You'll Work With

You will work with software development engineers, hardware engineers, field support engineers, product managers, and software test engineers to analyse customer requirements and use cases, gather technical details, create software test plans, and validate that the product meets our customer's requirements. You will also work with our customer support and engineering teams to help address escalated customer issues by reproducing, and debugging those in the lab. 

The role will provide opportunities to create real impact in the rapidly growing Cloud IT services, and virtualization technologies. 

What You'll Do

Arista Networks is looking for world-class Software Test Engineers (aka System Test engineers) to help us in building the highest quality networking products. If you love networking. If working on complex & scaled out network topologies makes you excited. 

If you like to challenge yourself to find the hard-to-find bugs and if troubleshooting & debugging network and system problems gives you a thrill, this role is tailor made for you. 

At Arista, you'll bring your intelligence, creativity, and drive every day & work with our products exactly how they are going to be used by our end customers and while doing so, make sure that the products are going to work every time. 

Your job is to find the hard bugs, the ones not easily exposed by the developers' automated unit and product level tests. You will NOT spend your time running manual regressions of mind numbing, 1000 page test plans, because Arista's developers automate all the basic functional and integration tests. 

Courtesy our super collaborative work environment, you'll spend your time embedded deeply with multiple engineering teams, working side by side with the developers, POC engineers, account teams, working together as one team and do all of it to help us to explore, find and fix software problems before they can reach the customers. We take quality seriously and we invite you to be a champion of software quality!!

Qualifications

- Experience & Education: BE/ B. Tech/ME/ M. Tech with networking industry experience. 
 - Proven expertise in creating test methodologies and writing test plans. 
 - Strong knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, IGMP, PIM SM/SSM, QoS, L2-L3 protocols, Platform validation, HA, QOS, network management. 
 - Experience with IXIA and/or Spirent test tools desired. 
 - Work with the developers on your team in creating their plans for automated tests to complement the exploratory testing that you perform. 
 - Participate in functional specification and software design reviews held by your team and provide customer centric input. 
 - Work in a highly productive environment along with best of the engineers on Linux platform that cuts a typical development cycle by order of magnitude with a laser focus towards quality. 
 - Use every means possible to find the bugs in the software and/or hardware being developed by your team. 
 - Write test plans to validate Arista features and products. 
 - Design test network topologies to validate functionality, performance, stability and scalability of features and products. 
 - Execute test plans to verify all aspects of the product. Identify defects and validate resolution. 
 - Work as an agile member of a combined development and test team, running in short cycles to develop functional software in quick iterations.

data.title: Staff Physical Design Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24, 000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's PossibleTM. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X). 

Role Overview

The Staff Physical Design Engineer is role which combines deep hands-on implementation expertise with technical leadership. This role owns complex block- and/or top-level physical design for advanced-node SoCs and leads a small group of engineers to achieve high-quality, on-time delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership

Own end-to-end physical implementation (floorplanning, power planning, placement, CTS, routing, ECO) for complex blocks or subsystems across advanced technology nodes (e. g. , 22nm, 16nm, 7nm, 5nm, 4nm). 

Drive timing closure, congestion resolution, IR/EM, signal integrity, and physical verification (DRC/LVS/antenna) to meet PPA and quality targets. 

Define and refine hierarchical PNR strategies, IO ring/PG structures, and integration guidelines for large SoCs. 

Perform in-depth analysis and debug of tool issues, timing failures, and physical design anomalies; propose robust, scalable solutions. 

Methodology and Automation

Develop, maintain, and enhance physical design methodologies, scripts, and flows (e. g. , for PDN, PG, clock structure, exception handling, signoff automation). 

Proactively identify opportunities for flow improvements and standardization to reduce turnaround time and error rates. 

Evaluate EDA tool features and drive best practices in collaboration with CAD/enablement teams. 

Technical Leadership & Team Enablement

Provide technical direction to a small group of physical design engineers, including task breakdown, priority setting, and quality expectations. 

Mentor junior engineers and NCGs in PNR, STA and debug practices to build a strong second tier of technical capability. 

Review floorplans, constraints, and implementation choices from team members, giving clear, actionable feedback. 

Act as a go-to technical reference within the PD team. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with RTL design, STA, DFT, CAD, and packaging teams to converge on implementation-friendly architectures and constraints. 

Communicate risks, options, and trade-offs clearly to project leads and managers, and help shape mitigation plans. 

Participate in design reviews and signoff reviews, representing physical design status, risks, and recommendations. 

Required Qualifications

Strong experience in physical design implementation for complex digital SoCs, typically 8-12+ years in physical design or equivalent level of mastery. 

Proven hands-on expertise with industry-standard PNR and signoff tools (e. g. , Cadence Innovus, Synopsys ICC2, Tempus/PrimeTime, RedHawk, Voltus, etc. ). 

Demonstrated success in closing challenging blocks/subsystems on advanced nodes (timing-, IR-, and congestion-critical designs). 

Solid understanding of: 

Floorplanning and partitioning strategies

Power grid and PDN methodology (including IR/EM mitigation)

Advanced clock tree/clock mesh design and constraints

STA constraints (modes/corners, exceptions, derates)

Physical verification and reliability checks

Leadership Expectations

Strong problem-solving and debugging mindset, with a bias toward scalable, automated solutions. 

Clear, concise communication skills-able to explain complex technical issues and options to different audiences. 

Demonstrated commitment to mentoring, knowledge sharing, and raising the capability of the broader team. 

Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities while maintaining quality and accountability. 

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process. 

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

data.title: Integration Engineer
data.description:
As an Integration and Automation Engineer in the Technology Architecture team at Basware IT, you'll build and run the integration fabric that connects our enterprise systems - directly impacting how reliably data and processes flow across finance, operations, and customer-facing platforms. You'll design, build, and support integrations on Azure Integration Services, standing up the APIs, event-driven interfaces, and automations other teams depend on, while helping shape this into a dedicated Integration and Automation practice as it grows. You're hands-on by nature: comfortable owning a build end-to-end - writing the code, securing it, load-testing it, and troubleshooting it in production - and picking up new tools fast, including AI-assisted development, without needing everything taught. 

- Integration development - design and build integrations on Azure Integration Services - Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Event Grid/Event Hubs - that are reliable, maintainable, and reusable. 
 - API management - build and manage APIs end-to-end through Azure API Management, including policies, versioning, throttling, and lifecycle, exposing them securely to internal and external consumers. 
 - Security & authentication - implement OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, JWT validation, and Managed Identities across integrations and APIs, and manage secrets and certificates through Azure Key Vault. 
 - Event-driven & asynchronous processing - design pub/sub and queue-based patterns using Service Bus topics/subscriptions and Event Grid/Event Hubs for decoupled, scalable system-to-system communication. 
 - Data handling & transformation - map and transform data between JSON, XML, and flat-file formats, handle schema evolution, and build validation and quality checks into pipelines rather than bolting them on afterward. 
 - Resilient API & integration design - build in retry policies, circuit breakers, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and graceful degradation so integrations fail safely and recover on their own wherever possible. 
 - Reliability & observability - monitor integrations in production using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics; troubleshoot failures and drive fixes that improve stability over time. 
 - CI/CD & source control - build and maintain deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (ARM/Bicep) and work disciplined Git workflows so releases are repeatable and low-risk. 
 - AI-assisted development - use tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude as part of your everyday workflow - for design, coding, testing, and documentation - while owning the quality of everything you ship. 
 - Collaboration - work closely with Enterprise Data, Solution Architecture, and AI Enablement so integrations are built with the wider platform in mind, not in isolation. 

, 

Must-have Skills & Experience

- Hands-on, production-grade experience building integrations on Azure Integration Services - Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and API Management. 
 - Practical experience building and securing APIs end to end, including OAuth2/OpenID Connect, JWT, API keys, and Managed Identities. 
 - Working knowledge of event-driven architecture - Event Grid and/or Event Hubs, pub/sub and queue-based messaging patterns. 
 - Strong grasp of data handling and transformation - JSON, XML, schema mapping, and building validation and error handling into the pipeline itself. 
 - Experience designing resilient, error-resistant APIs and integrations - retry logic, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter/exception handling - not just the happy path. 
 - Solid programming fundamentals (C#/. NET, Python, or JavaScript) applied to Azure Functions and custom integration logic. 
 - A demonstrated ability to learn new tools quickly, particularly AI-assisted development tools - our toolchain evolves fast, and curiosity matters as much as current skills. Hands-on experience with Claude and/or Azure AI tooling in a real development workflow is a strong plus. 
 - Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multicultural, globally distributed teams. 
 - Comfort operating independently in a small, growing team, with the flexibility to take on ambiguous problems. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Power Automate. 
 - SQL Server / T-SQL for data debugging, stored procedures, and integration troubleshooting. 
 - Exposure to Azure Data Factory or Databricks for data ingestion pipelines. 
 - Microsoft certification such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate) or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with Finance Technology and SaaS business
 - Prior experience in an enterprise environment with multiple integrated systems. 

How We Think About AI

We value curiosity and a proactive willingness to explore AI-driven technologies, and we provide room to experiment and learn - AI capability is something we build, not just buy.

data.title: Quant Developer - Low Latency C++
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub-working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You'll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the CEO
 - Direct ownership and end-to-end visibility on production systems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment where performance speaks louder than hierarchy
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - 5-week structured training program: 

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

- Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

- Architect and implement: 
 - Execution algorithms across global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Smart Order Routing systems across lit and dark venues
 - Models for market impact, price prediction, and volume forecasting
 - High-performance trading systems optimized for throughput and latency
 - Core infrastructure to support new asset classes and global markets
 - Collaborate closely with global quants, traders, and senior engineers
 - Analyze system performance across app, OS, and hardware layers

Requirements

You Should Have

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS, Math, or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - 2+ years hands-on C++ experience (C++14/17/20) in performance-sensitive applications
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, OS, networks, and concurrency
 - Python fluency for data analysis and prototyping (preferred but not required)
 - Experience with large-scale, real-time systems (trading experience is a plus but not mandatory)
 - Passion for learning-markets, systems, and modeling

Bonus Points For

- Deep experience with TCP/IP, multi-threading, and latency optimization
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - SQL optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools

Benefits

Why This Role Is Rare

- Exposure to real-time trading systems live in global markets
 - Direct mentorship from senior algorithmic trading and software engineering veterans
 - Blend of research, systems design, and algorithm development
 - Equity and cash compensation
 - Zero red tape, no outsourcing mentality

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio. 

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

 - Optimize data workloads at a software level by improving processing efficiency. 
 - Work with senior engineers to identify areas for process improvement and help implement solutions. 
 - Use monitoring and observability best practices to ensure optimal pipeline performance. 
 - Assist with ML Operations to ensure optimal model efficiency. 
 - Leverage CI/CD best practices to effectively develop and release source code. 
 - Participate in code reviews and collaborate with team members to improve engineering practices.

- Programming and technology knowledge in cloud data processing. 
 - Spark experience is needed, existing Databricks knowledge is a plus. 
 - Ability to learn fast and strong desire to develop 
 - Interest in cybersecurity; interest in identity security is preferred. 
 - Understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and distributed data processing concepts. 
 - Experience working with distributed systems and data processing on object stores. 
 - Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively. 

Technologies You Should Know

- Required: Data warehousing for analytics use cases 
 - Required: Proficient in Python (or another object orientated language) 
 - Required: Distributed processing framework experience 
 - Highly Preferred: Spark

 - Ideal: Some experience with graph data stores

Better Together

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20, 000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

data.title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
data.description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform. 

Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands. 

Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities

- Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand. 
 - Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput. 
 - Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity. 
 - Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff. 
 - Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness. 
 - Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients. 
 - Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens. 
 - Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks. 
 - Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review. 
 - Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams. 
 - Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
 - 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
 - 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
 - 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
 - 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
 - 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
 - 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
 - Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
 - 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications

- CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
 - CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
 - CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

- Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules. 
 - Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record. 
 - Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance. 
 - Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms. 
 - Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones. 
 - Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established. 
 - Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data. 

Working Arrangements

- Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements. 
 - Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely. 
 - Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams. 

Travel

- Up to 10% travel may be required. 

Benefits

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.

Lead Software Engineer

Who is Mastercard?

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team - one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results. 

Technology at Mastercard

What we create today will define tomorrow. Revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before. Safer, faster, more sustainable. 

And we need the best people to do it. Technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network. With the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day. 

Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture. Inclusive and diverse, a rich collaboration of ideas and perspectives. A place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers you the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents. And the opportunity to work alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business, improving what exists, and inventing what's next. 

About The Role

Software Engineers at Mastercard design and code a variety of applications covering transaction processing, analytics, user interfaces, and APIs using a blend of cutting-edge technologies across big data, distributed systems, machine learning, and more. As a Software Engineer, you will deliver these products and solutions with speed and agility as part of a small team. This will involve developing high-performing, highly scalable software solutions and products for some of the world's top brands. Specific tasks vary depending on the project and the business unit that you join in. 

All Staff At Mastercard Are Expected To Demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' Cultural Values Every Day - Own It, Simplify It, Sense Of Urgency, Thoughtful Risk-taking, Unlock Potential, And Be Inclusive - With a Relentless Focus On Our Customers. As a Lead Software Engineer At Mastercard, You Are Expected To Perform The Following General Responsibilities:

 - Drive prioritization decisions and trade-offs in working with product partners 
 - Automate and simplify all aspects of software delivery and development 
 - Introduce new technologies and architecture by following enterprise guidelines

 - Drive blameless postmortems culture to identify root causes of incidents and implement learnings
 - Introduce new technologies and architecture by following enterprise guidelines
 - Advocate for engineering principles outside of current organization/platform

 - Build relationships and effective partnerships across organizations

- Able to write secure code and hands-on experience on Java, spring.

 - Has skills to elaborate and estimate non-functional requirements, including security (e. g. , data protection, authentication, authorization), regulatory, and performance (SLAs, throughput, transactions per second)

 - Drives operational excellence by suggesting improvements to product modules/features using test data, performance data, and production metrics. Leverage testing to verify both functional and non-functional application requirements. Drives efforts to build and maintain lower environments that accurately reflect production.

 - Approaches discussions and problem solving, across organization and team boundaries with differing motivations/priorities, with empathy and a goal of building consensus. Finds way pitches in and lends support where needed. Valuable partner with organization and business partners in all roles and geographies. 
 - Key technical voice in anticipating, articulating, and evangelizing solutions to technical challenges, spanning org/team boundaries, based on broader industry trends, prioritized based on business needs

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Network Engineering and Operations (NEO) team is a core part of Cisco, delivering development and infrastructure support for a wide range of critical applications. This includes Cisco's internal Platform Engineering, Observability, and Automation services. We are "Customer Zero, " running Cisco networking applications and gear in our own environment. 

Your Impact

As an SRE on our team, you will bring DevOps technology, SRE practices, and Network automation to the deployment, management, and continuous improvement of our Network Services systems. You will play a key role in developing and maintaining internally developed applications that provide critical services for Cisco's internal network, ensuring our platforms are reliable, available, scalable, and high-performing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and improve automation solutions using Python and/or Shell in Linux environments. 
 - Support and enhance production platform services with a focus on reliability, availability, and performance. 
 - Develop and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and disaster recovery processes. 
 - Work with containers and orchestration platforms like Podman, and Kubernetes in Linux-based environments. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Git and Jenkins. 
 - Build and support API-based integrations across internal tools and services. 
 - Partner with platform, software, network, and operations teams to identify failure points and drive improvements. 
 - Use modern engineering productivity tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to boost efficiency. 
 - Improve observability through monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational insights. 
 - Help define and improve SLIs, SLOs, and operational metrics. 
 - Lead incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, postmortems, and service restoration. 
 - Participate in on-call support for critical services and contribute to operational readiness. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in either of the following areas Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or Operations. 
 - Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, and supporting automation solutions using Python and/or Shell scripting. 
 - Strong experience with Linux administration, preferably in RHEL environments. 
 - Working knowledge of infrastructure fundamentals (compute, storage, networking, DNS, load balancing, security). 
 - Experience supporting containerized and/or orchestrated environments ( Docker / Podman, Kubernetes). 
 - Understanding of modern software delivery (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, and microservices). 
 - Experience creating and consuming API-based services. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability practices. 
 - Familiarity with incident response, root cause analysis, and production support. 
 - Familiarity with Agile delivery processes. 
 - Willingness to provide on-call support. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a STEM-related field. 
 - Experience in large enterprise or mission-critical production environments. 
 - Exposure to public cloud platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Cisco platforms (Catalyst Center, Spaces, EPNM, NSO, or Infoblox). 
 - Experience with disaster recovery, operational readiness, and incident simulations. 
 - Foundational knowledge of enterprise networking (TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, load balancing). 
 - Exposure to ServiceNow (CMDB, Incident, Request, and Change Management) and Jira. 
 - Awareness of OpenTelemetry, AIOps, or data-driven operations. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like GitHub Copilot. 
 - CCNA, Kubernetes (Administrator/Developer), or RHEL Administrator certifications. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

- Build what powers the world. 

At Arm, the technology you build doesn't sit in isolation-it ends up in billions of devices. From smartphones and AI workloads to automotive and cloud, Arm-based systems are everywhere. 

In our Bangalore team, you'll work on real system-level problems , helping validate next-generation Arm CPU and System IP used by leading global companies. 

What You'll Work On

You'll be part of a team that builds complete reference systems around Arm IPs and use it for and Arm IP stress verification, giving you exposure far beyond traditional DV roles. 

- Integrate Arm CPU and system IPs into full reference platforms 
 - Bring up systems across simulation and emulation 
 - Debug real system issues spanning hardware + low-level software 
 - Develop system-level tests (C/C++/Assembly driven) 
 - Work closely with design, architecture, and global teams 
 - Contribute to improving verification flows, tools, and efficiency

Why This Role Stands Out

- Early System-level exposure - go beyond UVM/testbench work 
 - Strong learning curve - CPU architecture, AMBA, memory systems 
 - High ownership - own IP integration, features, debug, and bring-up 
 - Global collaboration - work with teams across UK, US, and Europe 
 - Real impact - your work directly influences quality of Arm IPs. 

What We're Looking For Must-Have

- 4-8 years of experience in SoC/IP development or verification 
 - Solid understanding of verification fundamentals & debug 
 - Experience with C/C++ or Assembly-based testing 
 - Exposure to pre-silicon environments (simulation/emulation) 
 - Basic understanding of CPU or SoC architecture

Good to Have

- Knowledge of Arm architecture / AMBA protocols 
 - Experience in embedded software or firmware bring-up 
 - Exposure to SoC integration or system-level validation

Who You'll Fit In Best As

- You enjoy debugging and figuring out system integration problems 
 - You want to work close to real hardware and full systems 
 - You're looking to move beyond pure DV into system understanding 
 - You take ownership and can drive tasks end-to-end

Education

- BE/BTech/MS in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or related fields

Why Join Arm Bangalore

data.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
 - 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
 - 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
 - Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
 - Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
 - Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.
