data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 77773

About Skyworks

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Skyworks offers the industry's broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance. 

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 3 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
 - Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, . NET preferred, or similar)
 - Experience with test frameworks and data analysis tools (JMP, MATLAB, or equivalent)
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams

Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Description

As the Resident Engineer - Automatic Transmission Launch & Localization, you will represent Product Development onsite at a new manufacturing facility producing automatic transmissions. 

You will provide technical leadership throughout equipment commissioning, pre-production builds, production validation, launch, ramp-up, and ongoing production. You will also lead regional Product Development activities associated with localization of components and assemblies. 

The Position Combines Two Closely Related Areas Of Accountability

- Resident engineering leadership for the transmission manufacturing operation. 
 - Regional Product Development leadership for component localization and implementation. 

You will work closely with regional and global transmission engineering teams to ensure localized products, manufacturing changes, supplier proposals, validation activities, and production approvals meet applicable engineering, functional, durability, quality, and manufacturing requirements. 

The role reports to the Product Development General Manager for Underbody Systems in Chennai, with a matrix reporting relationship to the Global Rear-Wheel-Drive Transmission Manager. 

Responsibilities

Serve as the onsite Product Development technical representative

- Act as the primary Product Development interface between the transmission plant and regional and global engineering organizations. 
 - Represent Product Development in decisions related to product engineering, manufacturing feasibility, quality, production readiness, and launch. 
 - Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, design requirements, validation results, and product acceptance criteria. 
 - Connect plant concerns with the appropriate Product Development, Design and Release, systems engineering, manufacturing, quality, supplier, and vehicle engineering owners. 
 - Establish productive working relationships with plant leadership, engineers, manufacturing personnel, suppliers, and regional and global Product Development teams. 

Support plant launch and production readiness

- Provide onsite engineering support during installation, commissioning, pre-production builds, production validation, launch, ramp-up, and ongoing production. 
 - Support applicable prototype, development, validation, tooling-trial, pre-production, and production builds. 
 - Coordinate engineering disposition of build concerns and ensure unresolved risks have defined owners, containment actions, and closure plans. 
 - Support transmission and component approval for regional vehicle builds and vehicle assembly plants. 
 - Lead or support Product Development reviews for Production Validation, part approval, production sign-off, and Ok-to-Ship decisions. 
 - Identify emerging product and manufacturing concerns early and escalate issues requiring regional or global engineering support. 
 - Capture launch lessons learned and support the transition to stable production. 

Lead technical problem solving

- Lead Product Development response to transmission and component concerns identified at the plant. 
 - Determine whether concerns originate from product design, supplier quality, manufacturing processes, assembly execution, specifications, or interactions among these areas. 
 - Lead structured root-cause analysis using appropriate problem-solving methods and coordinate interim and permanent corrective actions. 
 - Review end-of-line test results, process audit data, component measurements, transmission build history, teardown findings, and other engineering evidence when assessing product acceptability. 
 - Support investigation of plant concerns, vehicle assembly plant concerns, field/warranty returns, and transmission teardowns. 
 - Ensure significant technical issues are documented, tracked, escalated, and driven to verified closure. 

Manage engineering changes and plant concerns

- Initiate, review, approve or reject, track, and close engineering concerns within delegated authority. 
 - Coordinate implementation of engineering changes at the transmission plant and affected regional vehicle assembly plants. 
 - Ensure manufacturing teams understand each change's technical rationale, affected components, implementation timing, validation requirements, and production risks. 
 - Review supplier requests for engineering approval and coordinate Design and Release and systems engineering input. 
 - Review Manufacturing Risk Assessments within established engineering governance and delegated authority. 
 - Coordinate temporary engineering deviations with appropriate regional and global engineering owners. 
 - Monitor component availability, supplier readiness, implementation timing, production run-out plans, and trial results. 
 - Maintain a current record of open engineering concerns, changes, decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and closure evidence. 

Lead regional product localization

- Serve as the regional Product Development focal point for localization and manufacturing implementation. 
 - Coordinate localization with global transmission systems, component engineering, Design and Release, validation, manufacturing, purchasing, supplier, and program teams. 
 - Ensure localized components maintain approved design intent and satisfy applicable functional, durability, quality, engineering, and manufacturing requirements. 
 - Develop and execute localization-specific component and transmission validation plans, obtaining global engineering approval where required. 
 - Coordinate pre-production and Production Validation testing, analyze results, identify gaps, and drive closure. 
 - Lead regional execution of Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Part Submission Warrant (PSW), Production Validation, and Ok-to-Ship activities as applicable. 
 - Support supplier technical reviews, site assessments, readiness reviews, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), control-plan reviews, and production trials. 
 - Coordinate local vehicle-integration support, prototype requirements, transmission sign-off, and regional vehicle-program interfaces. 
 - Ensure sourcing, supplier, tooling, timing, cost, and local-content decisions do not compromise product requirements. 
 - Maintain alignment with global Design and Release ownership, engineering specifications, engineering changes, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), and Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R) requirements. 

Drive regional and global engineering alignment

- Provide clear, concise status updates to regional Product Development and global transmission leadership. 
 - Communicate significant product risks, launch concerns, quality trends, approval gaps, decisions required, and support needs. 
 - Participate in relevant regional and global product, design, manufacturing, supplier, launch, and quality reviews. 
 - Collaborate across regions and time zones to obtain timely technical decisions. 
 - Ensure locally made decisions are properly documented and comply with applicable global engineering governance. 
 - Share lessons learned and effective practices with other resident engineers and Product Development teams. 
 - Escalate unresolved safety, regulatory, durability, quality, supplier, production, or customer risks through established leadership channels. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. 
 - 10+ years of relevant engineering experience in one or more areas such as Product Development, Design and Release, systems engineering, powertrain engineering, transmission engineering, manufacturing engineering, vehicle plant engineering, launch, or product quality. 
 - Demonstrated experience resolving complex technical problems in manufacturing, product launch, or product-development environments. 
 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, product requirements, validation results, test data, and manufacturing data. 
 - Experience with engineering change control, product concern management, production approvals, or supplier deviation processes. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to engineering specialists and senior leaders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority technical issues while maintaining disciplined ownership and action tracking. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with manufacturing employees, engineering specialists, suppliers, cross-functional teams, and leadership. 
 - Ability to work onsite at the transmission manufacturing facility and support launch or production activities outside normal business hours when necessary. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with regional and global teams across time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with or comparable longitudinal automatic transmissions, including transmission systems, mechanical components, controls, calibration, manufacturing, or validation. 
 - Experience launching a new powertrain manufacturing operation, automatic transmission line, or major localized automotive product. 
 - Experience with APQP, PPAP/PSW, DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, production validation, and engineering change management. 
 - Experience working directly with automotive component suppliers during product localization or manufacturing launch. 
 - Experience using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why analysis, Ishikawa/fishbone analysis, or equivalent methods.

data.title: Principal Engineer/Sr. Principal Engineer - CQV
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

Design Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 15+ year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development and experience in technical support
 - 5+ years of operations management experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
 - Experience in facilities management, or experience in project management

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience
 - 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
 - Knowledge of six Sigma/Lean processes
 - Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
 - 2+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Principal Engineer will lead the design and technical development of BMS, GRMS, HAS and SCADA systems within a consultancy setup. The role focuses on producing high-quality designs, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with project standards. This position requires strong design depth, solid communication skills, and the ability to guide teams across multiple project stages. 

Responsibilities

- Lead concept, schematic, and detailed design for BMS, GRMS, HAS and SCADA systems. 
 - Prepare design reports, control philosophies, layouts, schematics, points lists, and equipment schedules. 
 - Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, and client representatives to ensure smooth design integration.

data.description:
We are hiring!

Aerospace (FMS) System Testing Engineer

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

Experience: 3-5 Years

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance. 

What You Will Do: 

- Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures. 
 - Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts. 
 - Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration. 
 - Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification. 

The Standards You Will Drive: 

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle: 

- ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations. 
 - ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing. 
 - DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests. 
 - DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels. 
 - DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains. 
 - DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Bachelor's or Master's in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program. 
 - Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion). 
 - Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B). 
 - A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits. 

How to Apply: 

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to communications@qubistsolutions. com with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform
data.description:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer - your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers - updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform to help build and evolve the data platform that powers critical business decisions and customer-facing experiences. You will own significant parts of our data architecture that is main powerhouse of DevRev Computer's memory for accurate and efficient Answers. As a part of data team, you will design and operate scalable data systems, and work closely with Software Engineering, AI Agent teams, Data Science, and Product teams to turn complex data requirements into reliable, high-quality data products. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving challenging problems involving large-scale data, distributed systems, database architecture, and performance optimization. You will have significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the direction of our agentic data platform while helping raise the engineering bar across the team. 

What You'll Do

- Own data architecture for large-scale, high-impact projects, making thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational cost. 
 - Design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and data systems that reliably ingest, transform, store, and serve large volumes of data. 
 - Partner closely with Software Engineering, Data Science, Product Management, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. 
 - Define and own data quality, reliability, and SLA/SLO requirements for datasets and systems within your area of ownership. 
 - Design and optimize data models, databases, and complex SQL workloads, with a strong focus on query performance, storage efficiency, and scalability. 
 - Build frameworks, tooling, and reusable infrastructure that make it easier for engineers and data consumers to develop and maintain data products. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage data to improve products, customer experiences, and business outcomes, and influence cross-functional teams toward high-impact solutions. 
 - Establish and promote engineering best practices around testing, observability, deployment, and operational excellence for data systems. 
 - Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and actionable feedback, while contributing to a strong engineering culture. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of software or data engineering experience building production systems. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more general-purpose languages such as Go, Java, C++, Python, or JavaScript, along with strong SQL skills. 
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Experience designing and operating production-grade data pipelines or distributed data systems. 
 - Experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases and understanding their underlying performance and scalability characteristics. 
 - Strong ability to independently drive projects from technical design through implementation, deployment, and operation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing large-scale data platforms, data warehouses, or distributed data systems. 
 - Deep understanding of database architecture, data modeling, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and storage systems. 
 - Experience with cloud data infrastructure and databases, including understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and cost tradeoffs. 
 - Experience building and operating high-throughput or large-scale data pipelines. 
 - Experience working with large datasets and optimizing complex SQL queries and data processing workloads. 
 - Experience with distributed data technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Trino/Presto, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar systems. 
 - Strong experience with data quality, observability, monitoring, and production reliability. 
 - Experience developing robust testing strategies, including unit, integration, and data quality testing. 
 - Experience providing technical mentorship and driving engineering best practices across teams. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other. 

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn't necessarily fit neatly into your job description. 

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn't working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don't let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem. 

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn't. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it. 

That's DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

data.title: Technical Director, Infrastructure SoC Software
data.description:
Job Overview

Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power the next generation of infrastructure - combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production-ready solutions. 

We have a requirement for a Technical Director in the infrastructure solutions software team in our CE-SW group to join in a technical leadership role for a globally distributed software engineering team delivering highly complex software for our cloud and data center products

This is an opportunity to make an impact at scale!

Responsibilities

You will: 

- Provide technical direction and expertise to the team and ensure strong technical progress across SoC, firmware and system validation from pre-silicon through silicon bring-up and production readiness. 
 - Partner with senior leaders across hardware, software, architecture and product teams to align with technology and delivery strategy and drive key decisions at the organisation level. 
 - Actively analyse product requirements, architecture specs and industry standards to drive software design. Lead development practices for best-in-class software efficiency, quality, and predictability

Required Skills and Experience : 

- Extensive experience delivering complex system software and technical leadership of large, globally distributed engineering organizations within embedded or infrastructure SoC space. 
 - Strong technical background in System-on-Chip (SoC), firmware, platform software and system-level validation across pre-silicon and silicon environments. 
 - Deep expertise low-level systems, including bootloaders, device drivers, OS fundamentals (preferably Linux), and a good understanding of computer architecture. 
 - Excellent technical judgement, leadership and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence senior collaborators and drive decisions across engineering organizations. 

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Knowledge of server-class SoCs, including RAS, power management, PCI Express (PCIe), Compute Express Link (CXL), memory and virtualization. 
 - Familiarity with the Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM). 
 - An ideal candidate would have acted in technical lead capacity for teams of 100+ engineers within SoC space. 

In Return: 

If you want to shape how the next generation of Arm infrastructure technology reaches production, you will have the opportunity to lead a critical engineering function, influence technology and product decisions, and build an internationally spread organization responsible for the quality and readiness of some of our most sophisticated infrastructure platforms. 

Join us and help define what world-class system validation looks like at Arm!

Additional Information

Please note that a relocation package (including visa sponsorship support) is available for this role, for candidates who require it. 

Salary Range

Cambridge: £168, 300 - £227, 700

Sophia Antipolis: €136, 800 - €185, 000

Bangalore: ₹11, 025, 000 - ₹18, 375, 000

We value people as individuals and our dedication is to reward people competitively and equitably for the work they do and the skills and experience they bring to Arm. Salary is only one component of Arm's offering. The total reward package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment and selection process. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Role: Senior Technical Engineer - LabVantage Master Data

The Senior Technical Engineer will be leading designing, building, and automating analytical test methods and associated data and specifications within LabVantage LIMS, and for developing or coordinating the development of instrument drivers and integrations that enable direct data capture into LIMS from laboratory instruments. 

This role combines domain expertise in laboratory processes and analytical methods with technical leadership in LIMS MD configuration & Custom development. The incumbent will play a key role in advancing the organization's digital laboratory ecosystem, driving data integrity, automation, and compliance in GxP systems. 

Key Responsibilities

What you'll be doing: 

LabVantage MD Development & Build

- Develop the configuration, creation, and lifecycle management of analytical test methods in LabVantage LIMS (i. e. All interconnected MDs to support entire workflow for test method to work as per expectations). 
 - Implement test templates, specifications, and parameter lists ensuring standardization and scalability across products and sites. 
 - Define and maintain Test method metadata structures for automation (units, limits, calculations, result entry templates). 
 - Custom Script development for data transfer or verifications
 - Implement Test method versioning, review, and approval workflows in accordance with organisational data governance and validation policies. 
 - Partner with functional SMEs to ensure test methods adhering with GxP, ALCOA+, and analytical method validation principles. 
 - Build test scenarios/ documents and Test method templates

Technical Maintenance and Master Data Support

- Triage, analyze and resolve issues through root cause analysis, harnessing both business and technical knowledge to minimize downtime. 
 - Driver L3 Engineering with global data team, site team and ensuring timely completion
 - Develop and maintain scripts, business rules, and LabVantage SDK components to automate data processing and workflow activities. 
 - Enable service improvement through fixes of incidences
 - Support and analyze instrument integrations (e. g. , Lab Application - Empower, Chromeleon, SmartLab, Darwin, Complex instruments) and maintain data exchange with ERP, ELN, QMS, EM and analytics systems. 

Automation & Digital Integration

- Develop automation frameworks to reduce manual effort in test method setup and instrument data handling. 
 - Support initiatives for automated test method build from structured templates or upstream systems (ERP/PLM). 
 - Collaborate with analytics teams to make instrument and method data analytics-ready for dashboards and trending. 

Governance, Validation & Documentation

- Support for versioned MD, and auditable as part of GxP compliance and following regulatory and Lilly IT quality standards (CSV-Computer System Validation). 
 - Create design documents, configuration specifications and technical SOPs for test method. 
 - Support QA in CSV, change control, and periodic review activities. 
 - Active participation in audits and ensure all automation components meet 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 requirements. 
 - Prepare and maintain design specifications, configuration documentation, and validation test scripts for IQ/OQ/PQ activities along with installation procedures
 - Support change control, release management, ensuring compliance and stability in a multi-environment setup. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Strong technical SME for LabVantage test method management
 - Collaboration with site-level LabVantage data stewards to lead test methods management
 - Partner with global digital, quality, and IT SMEs to define and implement standards for method and instrument onboarding. 
 - Enable process improvement through automation, template standardization, and adoption of new technologies

How You Will Succeed

- Reduced manual effort and faster development of new test methods. 
 - Improved data flow between LabVantage and analytical instruments in secured environment
 - Compliance with global lab data governance and validation standards. 
 - Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data. 

What You Should Bring

- Strong analytical and critical thinking. 
 - Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables
 - Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments. 
 - Excellent documentation and verbal communication
 - Ability to work across global teams (IT, Quality, Lab Operations). 
 - Strategic outlook to connect lab automation initiatives with enterprise digital goals. 

Basic Qualifications And Experience Requirement

- Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Computer Science/ Instrumentation /Chemical Engineering / Analytical Chemistry, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in laboratory informatics, preferably in the pharma, biotech, or chemicals industry. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience configuring and deploying LabVantage LIMS Master Data (i. e. test methods, specifications, calculations, and workflows). 
 - Experience integrating LabVantage with chromatography and analytical instrument systems (Empower, Chromeleon, Microplate readers, etc. ). 
 - Strong knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity principles (ALCOA+). 
 - Familiarity with ETL/middleware tools and system validation (CSV/SDLC) practices. 
 - Exposure to data analytics or digital lab transformation projects is a plus. 
 - Hands-on experience with JIRA, ALM, Git and ServiceNow (SNOW) for requirement tracking, defect management, and change control activities in regulated environments.

We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. Job Description - Quality Manager

Ingenious Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and results-driven **Quality Manager** to lead quality assurance and quality control operations across its steel fabrication and OEM manufacturing processes. The role involves establishing and implementing quality standards, managing inspection teams, ensuring compliance with customer specifications, and driving continuous improvement to deliver high-quality fabricated steel components and assemblies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage all quality assurance and quality control activities across incoming materials, in-process manufacturing, and final product inspection. 
 - Develop, implement, and monitor quality procedures, inspection plans, and control processes to ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 
 - Supervise, train, and guide the quality inspection team to maintain consistent inspection practices and performance. 
 - Review and interpret **mechanical drawings, technical specifications, tolerances, and quality requirements** to ensure product conformity. 
 - Oversee dimensional inspections, weld quality inspections, material verification, and final acceptance of fabricated components and assemblies. 
 - Ensure proper maintenance of inspection reports, test certificates, material traceability records, non-conformance reports, and quality documentation. 
 - Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence. 
 - Coordinate with design, production, planning, procurement, and dispatch teams to resolve quality concerns and ensure timely delivery of conforming products. 
 - Manage customer quality complaints, coordinate inspections and audits, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions. 
 - Establish and monitor quality performance indicators, identify recurring defects, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Ensure proper calibration, maintenance, and utilization of inspection instruments and measuring equipment. 
 - ·Support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable quality management systems and customer requirements. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 8 - 12 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control, preferably in steel fabrication, OEM manufacturing, or the engineering industry. 
 - Proven experience in managing quality operations and leading an inspection or quality control team. 
 - Strong understanding of **fabrication processes, welding inspection, dimensional inspection, material specifications, and mechanical drawings**. 
 - Hands-on experience with inspection instruments, measurement techniques, inspection plans, and quality documentation. 
 - Knowledge of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
 -   Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management systems and relevant industry standards. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to coordinate effectively across departments and manage multiple quality requirements. 
 - A proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven approach, with a strong commitment to product quality and customer satisfaction.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to own the hardest technical problems in our product and see them through from first sketch to stable production. You will set technical direction, design systems that scale, and raise the engineering bar through your own work and the people around you. This is a hands-on leadership role: you write code, review designs, and ship. 

What will you do?

You will own outcomes, not just tasks. Expect to spend your time on the following. 

- Own projects end to end. Take an ambiguous problem, shape the requirements, design the solution, break down the work, deliver it to production, and stay accountable for how it runs afterwards. 
 - Lead system design. Author and review architecture for services, data pipelines and integrations, with clear trade-offs on scale, latency, cost, consistency and reliability. 
 - Write and review critical code. Build the hardest components yourself, and set standards for code quality, testing and maintainability through code and design reviews. 
 - Own deployment and operations. Design CI/CD, infrastructure and release strategies. Drive observability, on-call readiness, incident response and post-incident learning. 
 - Solve hard problems. Debug production issues across the stack, and find root causes in performance, concurrency, data and scaling problems. 
 - Mentor and multiply. Coach senior and junior engineers, grow future tech leads, and make the whole team faster and more confident. 
 - Partner across functions. Work with product, design, data and business teams to turn goals into technical plans, and to say no or reshape scope when needed. 
 - Shape technical strategy. Guide build-versus-buy decisions, manage tech debt, evaluate new technologies, and contribute to the engineering roadmap. 
 - Raise the bar. Help define engineering practices, hiring standards and culture, and take part in interviewing. 

What are we looking for?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Core engineering

- 10+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping and running production systems. 
 - Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and complexity, operating systems, networking, databases and concurrency. 
 - Fluency in at least one major backend language (for example Python, Go, Java, or Node. js/ TypeScript) and the ability to pick up others quickly. 
 - Deep knowledge of relational and NoSQL data stores: schema design, indexing, transactions, query tuning and replication. 

System design and problem solving

- Proven ability to design distributed systems that are scalable, fault tolerant and cost aware, and to explain the trade-offs clearly. 
 - Experience with APIs, event-driven and asynchronous architectures, queues, caching and service-to-service communication. 
 - A structured approach to ambiguous problems: break them down, test assumptions, decide with incomplete data, and measure results. 
 - Strong debugging instincts, including performance profiling and production troubleshooting. 

Delivery and operations

- Have led at least two significant projects from inception to production, including planning, milestones, risk management and launch. 
 - Hands-on experience with deployment: CI/CD pipelines, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), a major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), and infrastructure as code. 
 - Practical experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs and incident management. 
 - Habit of writing tests and automation, and of leaving systems more reliable than you found them. 

Leadership and communication

- Experience leading engineers without formal authority, through influence, mentoring and clear technical writing. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication: design docs, RFCs and concise updates to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ownership mindset, sound judgment on priorities, and comfort working in a fast-moving environment. 

Nice to have

- Experience in fintech, lending or another regulated, data-heavy domain. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production: model serving, evaluation, retrieval, and cost and latency management. 
 - Deep experience with data engineering: streaming, batch pipelines, warehouses or search systems. 
 - Security and compliance awareness: authentication, encryption, audit trails, secure SDLC. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, high-throughput systems or zero downtime migrations. 
 - Open-source contributions, conference talks, or technical writing. 
 - Experience scaling an engineering team or helping set up hiring and onboarding practices. 

Skills: - Python, Java, NodeJS (Node. js), TypeScript, Systems design, Architecture, Distributed Systems, Scalability, Fault tolerance, Performance optimisation, Data Structures, Algorithms, Complexity Analysis, Concurrency, Operating systems, Networking, Databases, SQL, NOSQL Databases, Schema Design, Indexing, Transactions, Query optimization, Replication, Microservices, API design, RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture, Asynchronous processing, Message queues, Caching, Cloud, DevOps, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Reliability, Production Operations, Monitoring, Logging, Alerting, SLOs, Incident management, Root cause analysis, Code quality, Automated testing, technical strategy, Deployment, Production support, Profiling, Latency Optimization, throughput and cost optimization

data.title: Staff/ Sr Staff - Analog Mixed-Signal Verification
data.description:
Role Overview

The role involves end-to-end mixed-signal verification of high-current IVR designs, including developing behavioral models, performing analog-digital co-simulation, and verifying digital control loops and key power-performance metrics. The candidate will be responsible for creating testbenches, running PVT and Monte Carlo regressions, debugging transistor- and behavioral-level issues, and developing automation to improve verification efficiency. The role also requires close collaboration with analog, digital, and system teams and support for post-silicon validation. 

What You'll Do

- Develop and execute mixed-signal verification plans for high-current IVR designs. 
 - Build and maintain analog behavioral models (Verilog-A / SystemVerilog real-number modeling) for power stages, integrated inductors, PDN, and analog blocks. 
 - Perform analog-digital co-simulation using industry-standard tools (Cadence Xcelium + Spectre, Synopsys VCS + FineSim / CustomSim, or AMS Designer). 
 - Verify digital control loops
 - Create testbenches for key performance metrics: transient response (load steps), loop stability, efficiency, ripple, over-current / over-voltage protection, and startup/shutdown sequences. 
 - Run regressions across PVT corners, Monte-Carlo analysis, and corner-case scenarios. 
 - Debug mixed-signal issues at both transistor-level and behavioral level. 
 - Collaborate closely with analog designers, digital designers, and system engineers to close verification coverage. 
 - Develop automated verification scripts and improve verification methodology for faster turnaround. 
 - Support post-silicon validation by correlating simulation results with lab measurements. What We're Looking For

- 8 to 15 years of hands-on experience in mixed-signal verification of power management ICs OR analog/mixed-signal SoCs. 
 - Strong proficiency in mixed-signal simulation flows: 
 - Real Number Modeling (RNM) and Verilog-A behavioral modeling
 - Analog-digital co-simulation (AMS, VCS + Spectre, Xcelium)
 - Solid understanding of power converter topologies (buck, multi-phase, 3-level buck, switched-capacitor converters). 
 - Good knowledge of digital control concepts for power converters (PID controllers, DPWM, digital feedback loops). 
 - Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for system-level modeling and testbench reference generation. 
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM for digital/mixed-signal testbenches. 
 - Familiarity with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, or Synopsys CustomSim for analog simulation. 
 - Understanding of analog non-idealities (quantization effects, loop delay, sensor offsets, PDN resonances, inductor non-linearities). 
 - BSEE / MSEE with 8+ years relevant experience. Nice to Have

- Experience verifying high-frequency IVRs, PoL regulators, or high-current power delivery systems. 
 - Experience with SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Simulink for system-level power electronics validation. 
 - Familiarity with digital PID controller verification and fixed-point arithmetic effects. 
 - Exposure to advanced packaging and on-die inductor modeling. 
 - Scripting skills in Python, Perl, or Tcl for automation. About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in BangaloreMove Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

You will also apply SRE, automation and responsible AI/AIOps practices to improve issue detection, diagnosis and recovery while maintaining appropriate human validation, access controls, traceability and rollback safeguards. 

The role supports service governance and stakeholder coordination but does not own application development, deployment execution or L3 defect delivery. 

Who you are

- You have 6-8 years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise application-operations experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on production support involving Oracle WebLogic and Order Management or OSM platforms 
 - You have practical expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server administration and production support, including domains, clusters, managed servers, Node Manager, JVM, JDBC, JMS, threads and heap analysis 
 - You understand Telecom Order Management or Oracle OSM operations, including COM/SOM/TOM concepts, order orchestration, order states, fallout and recovery 
 - You understand order capture, decomposition, fulfilment, provisioning and service activation 
 - You have experience troubleshooting WebLogic and application logs, performance issues and production incidents

 - You have contributed to automation, observability or continual-improvement initiatives 
 - You can communicate clearly when coordinating technical activities, service restoration and operational governance 
 - Practical exposure to AIOps, anomaly detection, intelligent alert correlation, AI-assisted RCA or incident summarisation is beneficial 
 - ITIL Foundation certification and exposure to Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, Oracle OSM, UIM, ASAP and SRE practices are preferred

Not a Perfect Fit?

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

What Skills You Will Learn

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

data.title: BDR Manager
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Most BDR manager jobs are a dead end if you care about marketing. You book meetings, you hit a number, you repeat. 

This one is not that. This team sits inside Demand Generation, not Sales. You own the humans and the plays that turn demand into pipeline, and you work shoulder to shoulder with performance marketing, SEO, and lifecycle on the same funnel. If your goal is to grow into demand gen or growth marketing, this is the fastest seat in the building to do it from. We are specifically hiring someone who wants that path, not someone who wants to manage a dialer forever. 

You run Sprinto's BDR function end to end: the entire inbound engine, and the net-new intent plays we are building from scratch. You own the number across SMB and mid-market, the team that hits it, and the systems (sequences, routing, reporting, AI) that make it repeatable. 

This is a growth role by design. The intent funnel, the AI automation, the campaign-level conversion work, and the reporting are all demand gen muscles. As you prove them, the path opens toward owning a channel (lifecycle, paid, or intent/ABM) or a broader demand gen mandate. 

We will invest in that deliberately: exposure to campaign planning, budget thinking, and the full funnel, not just the BDR slice. If you show up curious about why a campaign converts and not only how many dials it took, you will move fast here. 

Where you'll leave your mark

- Hitting the number. Carry and hit the demo and pipeline number across both the SMB and the mid-market motion. 
 - Make the inbound engine efficient. Move the engine from volume to conversion. Lift conversion rates campaign by campaign and hold the gains, not just for a spike month. 
 - Build a net-new demos engine. Stand up an intent-based funnel that produces demos predictably, turn at least one intent signal into a repeatable documented playbook, and diversify pipeline beyond the top-priority campaigns so growth isn't riding on a couple of plays. 
 - Raise outreach quality. Improve response rates and the quality of the pitch on live calls, not just activity volume. 
 - Put AI to work inside the team. Automate the manual ops (lead assignment, reporting) end to end, build real-time reporting leadership can trust, and extend coverage with AI so inbound doesn't go dark on weekends. 
 - Build the talent engine. Turn the BDR team into a farm system for Associate AEs. The goal: a repeatable pipeline that brings BDRs in and graduates them into AAEs inside 12 months

What You'll Own Day To Day

- Build and lead the team. Recruit, ramp, and train BDRs across inbound and outbound. Run recurring 1: 1s, live call reviews, and feedback that changes what happens on the next call
 - Run the operating rhythm. Weekly reviews against pipeline, activity, qualification, and conversion targets. Scorecards over vibes
 - Forecast honestly. Own pipeline predictability on both volume and value, so leadership can actually plan on your number
 - Own the playbook. SOPs, sequences, scripts, email pitches, and qualification criteria. Build them, keep them sharp, kill what stops working
 - Watch ramp and productivity. Time to productivity for new hires, activity levels, meeting quality, and opportunity conversion. Know where every rep is and why
 - Build the culture. Accountability, recognition, honest feedback, and a career path people can actually see. This is also what feeds the AAE bench
 - Work across functions. With content marketing on webinars, messaging, campaign follow-up, and events. With AEs and Sales on target accounts, outbound execution, and handoff quality. With RevOps on the tooling and the tech stack

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- 3-5+ years in BDR/SDR, with at least 1-2 years managing or leading a team (or a strong senior IC ready to step up) 
 - You have carried and hit a pipeline number, and you can explain exactly how you did it 
 - You think in funnels and conversion rates, not just activity counts 
 - You are genuinely curious about marketing: campaigns, positioning, channels, the whole funnel 
 - You are AI-forward: you have already used AI to make outreach or ops faster, or you are itching to 
 - You write well. Punchy, plain, no fluff. We care about this a lot 
 - Comfortable in HubSpot and modern outbound/sequencing tooling

Nice to have

- Experience selling compliance, security, or developer/infra tooling 
 - Built an outbound motion or intent play from scratch before 
 - Comfort with data: light SQL, spreadsheets, or a BI tool

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
