data.description:
Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer - Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role

Overview

We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs. 

In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices. 
 - Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability. 
 - Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks. 
 - Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa_supplicant, and iw sub-systems. 
 - Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms. 
 - SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs. 
 - Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication. 
 - Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding. 
 - Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369). 
 - Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management). 
 - Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git. 

Must-Have Requirements

- Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries. 
 - Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems. 
 - Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems. 
 - Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369). 
 - Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM. 
 - Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers. 
 - Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts. 
 - Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind. 
 - Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git. 

Good-to-Have Requirements

- Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7. 
 - Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution. 
 - Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e. g. , CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context. 
 - IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP. 
 - Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs.

performance, and driving incident reduction strategies across hybrid cloud environments.

Job Title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, AI

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with the Information Technology team. 

Help us build world class infrastructure in public cloud, mainly GCP and AWS. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with a strong focus on AI-enabled platforms and automation to design, build, and operate highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure. 

As a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure, while maintaining and improving the reliability and performance of our company's technology stack. 

You will work closely with development teams to design scalable and highly reliable software systems, play a critical role in optimizing CI/CD pipelines using AI insights, and leverage automation to improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across cloud environments. 

Your role will involve identifying and resolving complex issues before they impact customers, implementing automation to streamline our operations, and advocating for best practices in reliability, scalability, and maintainability. As a senior member of the team, you will mentor junior engineers, drive technical initiatives, and collaborate across departments to achieve our reliability goals. 

What You Will Do As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Build infrastructure/systems that balance operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization. 
 - Improve the observability of our systems to anticipate and address issues before they become critical, leveraging strategies like infrastructure as code, system operational and health metrics, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Contribute to DevOps roadmaps, helping balance priorities like modernizing past infrastructure, supporting new projects and deployments, and improving/hardening systems where it is needed most. 
 - Integrate AI-powered tools into DevOps workflows for predictive monitoring, anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, and auto-remediation. 
 - Leverage AI/ML insights to optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and infrastructure performance and cost. 
 - Build and maintain self-healing systems using AI-based observability platforms. 
 - Support our initiatives for modernizing/centralizing our cloud footprint in partnership with business, analytics, software, InfoSec, and data science teams. 
 - Design and enforce SDLC, InfoSec, and compliance requirements. 
 - Assist with root cause analysis/remediation for system incidents. 
 - Provide support to the engineering team in basic database operations (SQL Server, MySQL) in running SQL scripts, creating database objects, and troubleshooting performance and connection issues. 
 - Manage, patch, and monitor MySQL and SQL Server databases running in AWS and GCP. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for build, test, and deployment workflows. 
 - Manage repository structure, branch protection, and access controls across the GitHub Organization. 
 - Automate release processes and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Configure and manage Cloudflare services: DNS, CDN caching rules, Page Rules/Rulesets, Load Balancing, Workers, WAF, and Zero Trust (Access/Tunnel). 
 - Provide 24x7x365 monitoring, incident response, and on-call support as part of the DevOps team. 
 - Perform other IT related duties or projects, as assigned. 

What You Will Bring As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Systems Engineering preferred, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Expertise with cloud-based systems and containerized infrastructure (Linux/OS fundamentals, Kubernetes, database systems, cloud networking). 
 - Deep expertise with GCP required, with significant expertise across two or more (GCP and AWS) preferred. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms and integrating AI-powered DevOps tools. 
 - Experience working with and supporting database infrastructure, mainly MySQL and SQL Server databases, in AWS and GCP. 
 - Familiarity with LLM-based systems, vector databases, or AI APIs. 
 - Expertise building common web/internet platform components (e. g. proxies, caches, load balancers, firewalls, app/web server tiers, DB systems). 
 - Unix scripting experience required, and a willingness to learn/support technologies you may not presently know. 
 - Conceptual and practical knowledge of modern DevOps techniques, such as CI/CD, IaC, configuration management, and secrets/vault management. 
 - Expertise in troubleshooting that spans systems, network, and applications in a distributed/microservice environment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Cloudflare. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. 
 - Experience managing GitHub Organizations, repo permissions, and branch protection policies. 
 - Candidates that have worked in IT for a United States based publicly owned company preferred. 
 - Excellent written and communication skills in the English language. 
 - Proven experience working with US based business teams. 
 - Ability to work within core US business hours / time zone expectations - Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap. 
 - Working Hours: 8 Hours (Excluding breaks) 4 Core US Hours Overlap (7: 30pm- 11: 30pm IST) 4 flexible hours (IST) 
 - Workspace: A quiet, dedicated space to work, and a reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps. 

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: ₹24, 75, 000 - ₹34, 65, 000 INR Annually

- Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location. 

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. 

- Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits
 - Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity leaves, and weekly wellness events. 

What's next?

Submit your application below and our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. 

Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

data.title: System Engineer – Protection & Automation (Control Relay Panels & Substation Automation)
data.description:
Organization: Smart Infrastructure

Business Unit: Energy Automation

Job Family: Engineering

Sub Job Family: System Engineering

Job Type: Full-time Hybrid

Location: Gurugram

Experience: 2-8 years

Job Overview

The System Engineer will be responsible for the engineering and design of secondary protection systems, including numerical relays, Control and Relay Panels (CRP), Substation Automation Systems (SAS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC) and Load Shedding schemes across various voltage levels. 

The role involves working on projects for Central, State and Private Utilities, renewable energy customers and Process Bus substations. Responsibilities span the complete project lifecycle, from understanding customer requirements and preparing detailed engineering documentation to obtaining design approvals, initiating material procurement and supporting project execution, factory testing and commissioning. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare Protection Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), trip matrices, interlocking logic, General Arrangement (GA) drawings and Bills of Material (BOM) as per customer and project specifications. 
 - Design Control and Protection Panels for different voltage levels and bus arrangements. 
 - Prepare control and protection schematics for generators, transmission lines, transformers, reactors, busbars and other power system equipment. 
 - Configure and work with numerical protection relays from Siemens, Hitachi, GE and other relevant manufacturers. 
 - Prepare FAT, SAT, GTP, TTR, FDS and heat-load calculation documents. 
 - Develop SAS and Process Bus system architectures using Star, RSTP, PRP and Ring topologies. 
 - Work with Ethernet switches, next-generation firewalls, RedBox devices and associated networking components. 
 - Apply knowledge of substation communication protocols, including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, Modbus Serial/TCP-IP, SNTP and PTP. 
 - Understand Master-Slave and Client-Server architectures, IEC 61850 communication and computer networking principles. 
 - Work with SAS platforms and configuration tools such as SICAM SCC, SIMATIC WinCC, RTC A8000, S8000 and MicroSCADA. 
 - Develop suitable Substation Automation System solutions based on customer and project requirements. 
 - Coordinate with customers for drawing approvals and resolution of technical queries. 
 - Initiate material loading documents for factory procurement, fabrication and panel wiring. 
 - Provide engineering support to Sales, Factory, Testing, Project Management and Commissioning teams during project execution. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical or Electronics Engineering. 
 - 2-8 years of relevant experience in Protection & Control engineering, Control Relay Panels and/or Substation Automation Systems. 
 - Strong understanding of secondary engineering, protection schemes, control schematics and numerical relays. 
 - Knowledge of SAS architectures, communication protocols and industrial networking. 
 - Good interpersonal, communication and critical-thinking skills. 
 - Ability to work independently, learn quickly and deliver with minimal supervision. 
 - Proficiency in Windows, server environments and MS Office. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with DIGSI 5, DIGSI 4, Reyrolle and Siemens protection relay configuration tools. 
 - Experience with Ethernet switches and Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs). 
 - Familiarity with SIMATIC WinCC/SCC, Toolbox, Device Manager and DIGSI. 
 - Knowledge of EPLAN E-CAD or E-Base and AutoCAD. 
 - Experience in substation projects involving utilities, renewable energy, Process Bus or multiple voltage levels. #SL

Our Benefits

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

What happens when AI agents can rewrite millions of lines of code orders of magnitude faster than humans can review them? That question drives the Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in Microsoft's CoreAI division. We build AI agents that transform some of the world's largest codebases, including Windows and Azure. Generating code is becoming the easy part; knowing whether to trust it is the real challenge. 

We combine AI agents with static analysis, testing, and formal verification to make large-scale software transformation practical and trustworthy, and we design tools that spend scarce human attention where it matters most. The team began in Microsoft Research and moved to CoreAI in 2025, and we continue to collaborate closely with Microsoft Research, so research depth meets production stakes every day. 

Here are the main problems we are currently working on: 

Migration at scale: We work on migrating hundreds of millions of lines of code, across Windows, Azure, Office, and other products, to work with new versions of dependent packages, new compilers and new platforms. Examples include increasing language-standards conformance of code, remediating CodeQL and other static analysis findings, and retargeting services from x86 to ARM. 

Language modernization: We move legacy C/C++ (and C#) codebases to Rust, with validation gates at every step. Differential testing against the original, held-out tests, and specification extraction with formal verification (such as Verus proofs) mean each migration is backed by evidence, not optimism. 

Specification-driven development: We help brownfield codebases adopt specification-driven development by inferring formal specifications for existing code. The specifications are grounded using execution traces and then used to generate concurrency and fault-tolerance tests, find subtle bugs, and ultimately create a validation guardrail for future AI-driven code changes. We are working with formal tools such as TLA+, F*, Lean and Verus in this work. 

You will be onsite at least three days a week and learn and grow through working with talented colleagues. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of agentic tools and infrastructure for one or more of our problem areas (such as migration at scale, language modernization, or specification-driven development). 
 - Set technical direction for a problem area end to end, from architecture to production adoption. 
 - Architect systems that let a small expert team drive transformations across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Define the validation strategies and quality bars that make agent-produced changes trustworthy at scale. 
 - Lead cross-organizational efforts with partner teams, such as Windows, Azure, compiler, and security teams, and with the research community. 
 - Turn ambiguous, fast-moving problems into roadmaps while staying flexible as models improve. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the engineering bar across the team. 
 - Represent the team externally through talks, papers, and our blog. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related areas and 10+ years of experience. Or a Master's degree with 8+ years of experience. Or a PhD in computer science or related areas with 5+ years of experience. 
 - Experience coding in languages such as C, C++, C#, or Rust. 
 - Experience building developer tools using LLM-based agents. 
 - Experience with compilers and program analysis. 
 - Excellent technical design, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, customer obsession, and a passion for shipping high-quality products. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Rust and C/C++ interop and memory safety. 
 - Experience testing at scale, such as differential testing, property-based testing, or fuzzing. 
 - Experience with formal methods such as TLA+, model checking, F*, Lean, Verus, Dafny, or similar. 
 - Experience working with very large codebases and build systems. 
 - Interest or experience in human-AI interaction and developer experience design. 
 - Experience leading research-to-production transitions. 
 - Track record of leading technical efforts across teams or organizations. 
 - Publications or open-source contributions are a plus. 

Why join us

- Work on the hardest problems in agentic software engineering, at real scale. 
 - Join a small team with outsized leverage, where a handful of experts steer changes across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Blend research and engineering: ideas here ship to tools used by Windows, Azure, and other large teams. 
 - Build on, and contribute back to, the research community around TLA+, F*, Lean, Verus, etc.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we're dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.

The initial approach will combine existing AI capabilities with original product engineering. You will help determine where custom development creates meaningful value. 

What we need to seeEvidence of shipping

You have built and deployed AI-enabled software beyond tutorials and isolated demonstrations. You can explain your personal contribution, the architecture, the failures encountered and what changed after real usage. 

Strong software engineering

You can build reliable asynchronous services, APIs, data models and stateful applications. You understand debugging, testing, deployment and operational responsibility. 

Applied AI depth

You have practical experience with model APIs, structured outputs, tool use, context management and evaluation. You understand the limitations of probabilistic systems and build appropriate controls around them. 

Multimodal and real-time capability

You can demonstrate relevant work involving visual understanding, voice, streaming or interactive media-and explain how you would combine these into a responsive product. 

End-to-end product ownership

You can work across backend and frontend boundaries and deliver a coherent experience. You care about what the user sees, hears and can successfully accomplish. 

Sound technical judgment

You can make scope decisions, choose sensible dependencies, measure trade-offs and communicate when an assumption needs validation. 

Independent execution

You are comfortable beginning without an established engineering team or a fully specified implementation plan. You can turn ambiguity into experiments, decisions and working software. 

Particularly relevant experience
 - Real-time voice, audio/video applications, WebRTC, WebSockets or similar streaming systems. 
 - Vision-language models and image/video processing pipelines. 
 - Dynamic interfaces, scene composition, graphics or multimedia synchronization. 
 - Mobile applications or responsive browser-based products. 
 - Personalization, retrieval and permission-based memory. 
 - Taking an early product from an initial prototype to sustained real-world use. 
 - Building effectively with AI coding tools while retaining ownership of correctness and maintainability. 

We are open to different technology stacks. Explain why your choices fit the problem. 

Experience and qualificationsWe expect most suitable candidates to have approximately 4-10 years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on AI product work. 

Demonstrated capability matters more than an exact experience bracket, college name or degree. Candidates outside this range with exceptional relevant work are welcome. 

What the first six months should establishThe objective is a focused, usable product suitable for early-user testing and investor demonstrations, supported by evidence about technical feasibility, experience quality, reliability and operating cost. 

You will help define the scope and milestones with the founders. The broader product roadmap will evolve from what we learn. 

What this role offers
 - Ownership of the initial architecture and implementation. 
 - Direct access to the founders and influence over product decisions. 
 - The opportunity to establish the engineering foundations of a new AI business. 
 - Substantial technical responsibility from the beginning. 

Compensation: Open for discussion based on demonstrated capability, relevant experience and the scope of ownership. 

How to applyApply with your résumé and links to your strongest relevant work. 

For one or two projects, briefly explain: 

- What the system does and where we can see it. 
 - What you personally designed and implemented. 
 - One difficult engineering problem you solved. 
 - Any measured results involving users, quality, latency, reliability or cost. 

GitHub, deployed applications, technical write-ups, open-source contributions and recorded demonstrations are all welcome. 

If your strongest work is confidential, describe your contribution without sharing proprietary information. We can discuss an appropriate private walkthrough. 

Selection process
 - Application and project review. 
 - Initial conversation and technical project deep dive. 
 - A time-boxed engineering assessment for shortlisted candidates. 
 - An in-office technical and founder discussion in Gurugram. 
 - Reference checks and offer discussion. 

Further product details will be shared progressively during the process. 

We are looking for someone who can make thoughtful technical decisions and turn them into a product that works.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).

Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Your Technical Arsenal

- Cloud & Orchestration: Expert-level AWS (VPC, Networking, ECR) and deep production experience with Kubernetes (EKS, K8s Ingress, mTLS) and ArgoCD. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Advanced proficiency in terraform and Ansible for maintaining immutable infrastructure. 
 - Automation & CI/CD: Strong command of Python and Bash; experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS serverless automation (Lambda, Step Functions). 
 - AI & Observability: Building proactive AIOps frameworks via Grafana and utilizing AI coding tools like Cursor to accelerate delivery. 
 - Data & Middleware: Hands-on experience with RDS (Postgres), Kafka, and big data tools like Druid or Athena. 
 - Security & Quality: Integration of SonarQube and CodeArtifact into the SDLC, with a focus on network security and identity management. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 8-10+ years in DevOps/SRE roles, with a proven track record of managing highly agile, large-scale environments. 
 - Modern Mindset: Familiarity with GitOps principles and a passion for applying AI/ML to operations to reduce noise and MTTR. 
 - Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to remove technical roadblocks, provide architectural guidance to peers, and foster a culture of innovation.

Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave.

data.description:
Description

At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions. 

The Role

As a Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). 

LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification. 

What You Will Do

Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems

- Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions. 
 - Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities. 
 - Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements. 
 - Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues. 
 - Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally. 

Partner with the Business

- Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions. 
 - Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change. 

Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation

- Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies. 
 - Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance. 
 - Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes. 
 - Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization. 

Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations

- Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management. 
 - Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain. 
 - Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities. 

Lead Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes. 
 - Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions. 
 - Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities. 
 - Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains. 

Requirements

Education

Experience

- Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles. 
 - Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 

Preferred Technical Expertise -

Laboratory & Quality Systems

 - Change management
 - Technical project delivery
 - Analytical problem solving
 - Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working. 

You Will Be Successful If You Can

- Balance technology expertise with business understanding. 
 - Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility. 
 - Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions. 
 - Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation. 
 - Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. 

Benefits

Competitive Compensation

Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded. 

Comprehensive Benefits

Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care. 

Work-Life Balance & Flexibility

Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule. 

Training & Development Opportunities

At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring. 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it's only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential. 

APPLY NOW!

Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future. 

Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu. Tripathi@envalior. com

Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent. Acquisition@Envalior. com. 

OUR HERITAGE

With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung. Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird. Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen. 
 - Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen. Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind. Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann. Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

General Summary

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. Qualcomm has been at the forefront of driving the revolution in the mobile gaming space by providing state of the art powerful GPUs as part of the Snapdragon program. Our AdrenoTM GPU is designed to quickly render complex geometries for next-level visuals in games and apps-with super-fast responsiveness and superior mobile connectivity for truly immersive experiences. As part of GPU performance and architecture team, the candidate will be working on the latest and greatest in GPU architecture and Computer Graphics. The role revolves around working on analyzing the most popular games and benchmarks which use highly advanced rendering techniques, evaluating their performance on Qualcomm GPUs, define new optimizations/algorithms/configurations for the Adreno GPUs and modeling them to define next generation of AdrenoTM GPU

 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption.

Job Description

Role: Tech Lead Data Engineer

What you'll do

We're MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of

everything we do, and as a Tech Lead - Data Engineering, you'll be right at the center of it. This role

combines technical excellence, hands-on problem-solving, and engineering leadership to help us build

optimized, scalable, and cost-efficient data products and pipelines across our platforms. 

You will lead by example, guiding a team of data engineers to build and maintain robust data systems while

collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact business outcomes. This role goes beyond

writing code-you'll be setting standards, making architectural decisions, mentoring team members, and

driving technical innovation across the organization.

What you'll bring

- 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with 2+ years in a technical or team

leadership role

data platforms

- Proficiency with big data ecosystems like Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Presto, and Delta

Lake

- Strong coding skills in Python, Scala or Java, and a solid understanding of software

engineering principles

- Expertise in SQL/NoSQL, data & delta lakes, and cloud-native services (preferably AWS

or GCP)

- Proven track record in building production-grade ETL pipelines and event-driven systems

teams

- Familiarity with DataOps, DevOps and CI/CD, including tools for monitoring, alerting, 

and observability

- A passion for mentoring and developing engineers, and a love for collaborative problem-

solving

We've highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don't

worry if you don't meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They

might see something in your background that's a fit for this role, or another opportunity at

MiQ. If you have a passion for the role, please still apply. 

What impact will you create?

As a Tech Lead, your mission is to set direction, not just velocity. You will: 

- Drive the architectural vision for scalable, cost-optimized, and performant data systems
 - Design, review, and guide the implementation of complex pipelines and data products
 - Introduce and champion engineering best practices, design patterns, and quality standards

What's in it for you?

At MiQ, you'll be empowered to influence technical strategy at a global scale. You'll be joining a diverse and

dynamic team in our Center of Excellence, where innovation and experimentation are encouraged and

celebrated. Your work will not only power our platform but shape the future of data-driven programmatic

advertising. 

You'll be part of a culture that champions curiosity, autonomy, and continuous learning-while having a lot

of fun doing it. 

Values

Our values are so much more than statements. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape

the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for

better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just

like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do - no matter how big or small. 

- We do what we love - Passion
 - We figure it out - Determination
 - We anticipate the unexpected - Agility
 - We always unite - Unite
 - We dare to be unconventional - Courage

Benefits

Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can

Expect

- A hybrid work environment
 - New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
 - Internal and global mobility opportunities
 - Competitive healthcare benefits
 - Bonus and performance incentives
 - Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to

acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives. 

- Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, 

drive action, and support our communities. 

Apply today!

Equal Opportunity Employer

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CPU/SoC Validation Engineer with strong knowledge of ARM Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC) architecture and hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, system-level debugging. The engineer will own validation of interrupt-controller functionality across CPU, firmware, power-management, and OS interactions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for ARM GICv3/GICv4 and CPU interrupt subsystems. 
 - Validate GIC components including: Distributor (GICD)Redistributor (GICR)CPU interface and system registersInterrupt Translation Service (ITS)SGI, PPI, SPI and LPI interrupt flows
 - Validate interrupt routing, prioritization, masking, preemption, affinity, acknowledgement and EOI behavior. 
 - Develop stress scenarios covering: Concurrent interrupt generationHigh interrupt ratesMulti-core interrupt routingSGI broadcast and targeted SGIsInterrupt migration and CPU hotplugInterrupt handling during CPU idle and low-power transitions
 - Validate GIC behavior across CPU power collapse, suspend/resume, reset and DVFS transitions. 
 - Debug complex issues involving lost interrupts, unexpected routing, interrupt latency, stuck interrupts and incorrect GIC state. 
 - Analyze key GIC registers such as GICD, GICR, ICC system registers, ICH virtualization registers and ITS state. 
 - Validate interactions between the GIC and OS/kernel, firmware, hypervisor and power-management software. 
 - Work closely with CPU architecture, firmware, kernel, power-management, design and verification teams to root-cause silicon issues. 
 - Use hardware/software debugging techniques including register dumps, trace, kernel logs, crash dumps and waveform/trace correlation. 
 - Develop automation and stress workloads for interrupt validation and regression testing. 
 - Track validation coverage, defects, risks and closure status through engineering tracking systems. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of ARMv8/ARMv9 architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM GICv3/GICv4 architecture. 
 - Good knowledge of: SGI / PPI / SPI / LPIInterrupt affinity and routingPriority masking and preemptionGroup 0 / Group 1 interruptsSecure and Non-secure interrupt handlingGIC Distributor and RedistributorCPU interface registersITS and MSI-based interruptsVirtual interrupts / vGIC concepts
 - Understanding of CPU power states, clock/power collapse, reset sequences and low-power entry/exit. 
 - Programming/scripting experience with C/C++, Python and shell scripting. 
 - Experience with JTAG/debuggers and SoC debug methodologies is desirable. 

Preferred Experience

- 7 to 16 years of experience in CPU/SoC post-silicon validation or silicon bring-up experience. 
 - Validation of ARM-based multicore SoCs. 
 - Knowledge of virtualization, hypervisors and virtual interrupt handling. 
 - Experience debugging interactions among GIC, CPU low-power states, DVFS and firmware. 
 - Ability to convert architectural requirements into validation scenarios, stress tests and measurable coverage.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

● AI/ML Domain Experience: 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML, OCR, and Generative AI solutions in production.

strategies, vector databases, and document intelligence workflows.

Azure Document Intelligence) and Multi-Modal/Vision LLMs.

○ Frontend: Working proficiency in React (TypeScript/JavaScript) for building interactive web UI

components. 

○ Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure / AWS), Docker, 

Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

As an Engineering Manager within Tesco Media, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for building and scaling technology solutions that enable advertisers and retailers to measure and optimise campaign performance. 

This role combines technical leadership, people management and delivery excellence. You will work closely with Product, Design and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality software while creating an environment where engineers can grow, collaborate and perform at their best. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead, coach and support a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, translate business needs into technical solutions and ensure successful delivery.

 - Support architectural decisions that promote scalability, reliability, security and maintainability across products and platforms.

- Experience leading software engineering teams in an Agile environment from an Adtech, Retail Media OR Saas background

 - Ability to balance technical decision-making with business priorities and customer outcomes. 
 - Proven capability to develop talent through coaching, mentoring and performance support.

- Enjoy enabling engineers to do their best work and grow their careers.

data.title: Director, Engineering
data.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life's other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235, 000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6, 500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera. com. 

The Role

Director Engineering | Reports To: Vice President, Engineering | Location: Bangalore

What You'll Bring

- Masters/ Bachelors degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent
 - Experience in Software Delivery, Managing Stakeholders and Managing Managers. 
 - Experience with C#, Web API server, SQL Server, React and Angular. 
 - Good to have - PHP, Python and Public or Private Cloud, Sql and NoSql databases like Mongo or similar and caching technologies like redis or similar. CI/CD Pipelines, Jenkins, git, bitbucket etc. 
 - Minimum Overall experience would be 15 years. 
 - Minimum 8 Years of Hands-on Development Experience, out of which minimum 5 years of experience in Microsoft based Tech Stack (C#, . net, webapi, IIS and related skills). 
 - Minimum 5 years of Hands-on Development experience in web services like restful services and microservices. 
 - Minimum 5 Years of Management experience and minimum 2 years in managing managers. 
 - An attitude to take technical and delivery problems head-on and leading from the front. 
 - You should be ready to roll up your sleeves and make your hands dirty whenever needed. 
 - Need to be hands on in coding. 
 - Hands On Experience in Agentic AI and Generative AI including - LLM training, Agentic Workflows, Prompt Engineerin, MCP, RAG. 

What You'll Do

Technical Guidance: 

You will provide technical leadership to a team of excellent software engineers; this requires that you have the technical depth to make complex design decisions and the hands-on ability to lead by example. 

Execution and Delivery: 

You will be expected to instill and follow good software development practices and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products. You should be familiar with agile practices as well as be able to adapt these to the needs of the business, with a constant focus on product quality. 

Team management: 

You will be responsible for hiring and mentoring your team; helping individuals grow in their careers, having constant dialogue about their aspirations and sharing prompt, clear and actionable feedback about performance. 

Technical depth: 

You have the strong technical competence required to gain credibility. Ability to architect, design and code yourself. Technical experience in building and operating cloud native applications and microservices. Deep understanding of all layers of the web-stack work (from the client interface to the database. ) Knowledge of multiple technology stacks/languages/tools and their pros/cons. 

Execution ability: 

Focus on delivering products in a timely manner with high quality. Familiarity with multiple software development practices and tools, and the proven ability to adapt, champion and institute good practices and tools. 

Create Plans and Systems: 

Create and implement best practice engineering vision, strategy, policies, processes and procedures to aid and improve business performance. Ensure that engineering strategies and processes are in place to meet business objectives and operational needs in terms of price, quality and delivery targets and which enables the company to function and compete effectively in the market. Contribute to overall business strategy and annual budget process. Take ownership of the engineering policy, guidelines and any associated documents

General and Task Management: 

Providing technical support to the business development, estimating and onsite engineering teams. Responsible for overseeing all aspects of build design, from contract award to handover. Develop planning and prioritize processes to ensure that multi-disciplinary resource is well aligned to maximize delivery of projects. 

Oversee Developmental Processes

The Director of Engineering is charged with the task of evaluating schedules, quality assurance procedures and new releases in order to assess their value. Since the end goal of the Director of Engineering is to ensure that the engineering process runs smoothly, these developmental processes must be examined systematically and carefully so that the positive and negative aspects of each one can be properly weighed. 

Continuous Improvement

Demonstrated thought leadership and a passion for identifying and pursuing new ideas and leveraging continuous improvement processes. Championed continuous improvement strategies to improve software bug rates and overall product quality. Work with production facilities to provide designs and processes for continuous improvement. Established and drove a clear and consistent culture of transparency, predictability, agility, continuous improvement, and accountability

Relationship Management

Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance. Work with the rest of the leadership team to decide which engineering projects are the highest priority against the business targets and which can be executed with the available resource. Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the engineering strategy.

data.title: Principal, Tech (Middleware)
data.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
data.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for a senior technologist to join our Messaging Middleware team based in the firm's offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurugram. The team is responsible for building and evolving a framework for real-time data streaming web applications used across the firm. This framework enables partner teams to focus on business logic while relying on a robust shared platform to handle the complexity of real-time messaging, data delivery, scalability, resiliency, observability, and developer ergonomics. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will help shape the technical direction of a core platform, make key architectural and implementation decisions, contribute directly to high-impact systems, and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, mentorship, and example. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

In this role, you will design, build, and enhance a framework that powers real-time data streaming web applications across the firm. You will work on capabilities that improve platform efficiency, robustness, scalability, observability, and ease of use for application teams. You will partner closely with framework users to understand their requirements and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that support low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant application behavior. You will drive performance tuning across the stack, including messaging, serialization, transport, concurrency, backpressure handling, and client/server interactions. You will help design resilient systems that handle failures gracefully, including network interruptions, traffic spikes, and partial service degradation. You will also contribute directly to the implementation of critical components, review architecture and code, troubleshoot production issues, and drive improvements in testing, operability, and long-term design health. As a senior technical leader on the team, you will mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration. You will influence engineering culture by setting a high bar in technical rigor, ownership, and execution, and periodically providing clear updates to senior stakeholders on technical direction, system health, key deliverables, and important risks or trade-offs. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and object-oriented programming
 - The candidate should have 7+ years of software engineering experience building high-performance, real-time distributed systems
 - The candidate should have strong experience with messaging middleware, event-driven systems, and low-latency data streaming architectures
 - Proven experience designing and building production-grade frameworks, platforms, or shared infrastructure
 - The candidate should have strong understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed systems
 - The candidate should have hands-on experience with technologies such as Kafka, Solace, NATS, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, WebSockets, SSE, or gRPC streaming
 - The candidate should have strong software design, debugging, testing, and code quality fundamentals
 - The candidate should have experience with production observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support
 - The candidate should have demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience as a senior individual contributor
 - The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication skills
 - The candidate should be comfortable working in a language-agnostic environment
 - Candidates with experience in browser-facing real-time applications, serialization and wire protocols, resilience patterns, or large-scale performance testing will have an added advantage

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https: //www. deshawindia. com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplMiddlewareApr26

We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
data.description:
Job Description

At Loyalty Partner Solutions GmbH we are pioneers and technology leaders in high-performance loyalty management software for the airline, retail, travel, and transportation sectors. Headquartered in Munich, with teams around the world, we develop comprehensive software solutions for the operation of complex customer loyalty programs, which we implement for our clients worldwide. 

We develop long-term partnerships with our clients, advise them on their digitalization journey, work on innovative ideas together, and put them into practice. 

Among the companies that count on our know-how are Lufthansa, for its frequent flyer program Miles & More, Deutsche Bahn AG for its BahnCard and BahnBonus programs, PAYBACK, and international air carriers such as China Southern Airlines and United Airlines. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborates with Software Engineering teams to support the development, and implementation of features that enhance system resilience, scalability, and performance, ensuring systems can handle varying loads and recover effectively from unexpected disruptions. 
 - Collaborates in the development and implementation of automation tools and frameworks, including infrastructure as code (IaC) practices, to reduce manual intervention and improve system efficiency, with guidance from peers and leaders. 
 - Collaborates with senior engineers to contribute to the architectural design of systems, ensuring that reliability, scalability, and performance considerations are integrated into design discussions with direct guidance from senior colleagues. 
 - Collaborates in the design and execution of chaos engineering experiments and other resiliency testing methods to help identify potential failure points and ensure systems can recover from disruptions, with guidance from peers and leaders. 
 - Supports the development and implementation of disaster recovery plans and business continuity strategies, ensuring systems can recover quickly and effectively from unexpected disruptions. 
 - Collaborates with seniors to promote and implement best practices such as error budgeting, service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level indicators (SLIs), contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and reliability. 
 - Serves as a key point of contact for customer-facing incident management, helping drive timely resolution and coordinating stakeholders through to recovery. 
 - Works within an ITIL-aligned support organization, applying structured incident, problem, and change management processes to support consistent, repeatable service delivery. 
 - Builds and maintains automation tools and frameworks, including infrastructure as code (IaC), to reduce manual toil, accelerate recovery, and improve operational efficiency across cloud environments. 
 - Helps deploy and operate cloud-native infrastructure on public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), contributing to containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling. 
 - Creates and maintains clear, structured process documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles, ensuring operational knowledge is captured, standardized, and accessible across the team. 
 - Collaborates with Software Engineering teams to enhance system resilience, scalability, and performance, ensuring services handle varying loads and recover effectively from disruptions. 
 - Contributes to the definition and monitoring of service-level KPIs, supporting a culture of continuous improvement and reliability. 
 - Supports the development and execution of disaster recovery and business continuity plans, including resiliency testing methods such as chaos engineering experiments. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred. 
 - Experience in customer-facing incident management or technical operations. 
 - Working knowledge of ITIL service management practices (incident, problem, and change management), ITIL certification preferred. 
 - Hands-on DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub). 
 - Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-based SRE practices. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with a modern observability stack (e. g. , Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana), including logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance analysis. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix systems, infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform), and scripting languages (e. g. , Python, Bash), familiarity with object-oriented languages such as Java a plus. 
 - Good written communication skills. 
 - AWS (DevOps) certification preferred. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

 - Career development and training opportunities

 - Provide full technical leadership for projects by coordinating architecture, engineering execution, dependency management, risk mitigation, and cross-team alignment

AI‐Assisted Engineering & Developer Productivity

Mentorship & Team Elevation

- Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and design discussions
 - Help senior engineers grow into broader technical leadership roles
 - Coach less-experienced developers on modern engineering and AI-aware practices
 - Foster a culture of continuous learning, ownership, and technical excellence
 - Lead by example with clear communication, humility, and accountability

Technical Execution & Operations

- Build and maintain SaaS applications using modern frameworks and cloud platforms
 - Design and implement RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations
 - Work with relational and NoSQL databases, optimizing for performance and reliability
 - Build containerized applications using Docker and deploy via Kubernetes
 - Partner with DevOps/SRE to ensure strong CI/CD pipelines, observability, and safe deployments
 - Participate fully in the SDLC: design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support

Experience

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of professional software development experience
 - Proven experience owning and delivering large, complex systems
 - Demonstrated success modernizing legacy systems and tech stacks
 - Hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping AI-driven and agentic AI systems in production or production-like environments
 - History of hands-on technical leadership across teams or domains
 - Strong track record of mentoring and developing engineers
 - Proven ability to lead a complete project independently, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, manage technical risks, and drive execution through delivery

Technical Skills

- Expert-level proficiency in C# and . NET (ASP. NET Core, modern . NET)
 - Deep understanding of RESTful API design and distributed systems
 - Strong experience with microservices architectures
 - Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI processing systems, including:

 - Experience integrating AI systems with datastores, APIs, and event-driven workflows

Must Have Skills:
