data.title: Senior HR Technology Analyst — Automation & AI (m/f/d)
data.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

You will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology - deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions. You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation - using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI. 

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions. 

This role is based in Gurugram or Bangalore (India), with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required. 

About The Role

- Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle - conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions. 
 - Help build, deploy and maintain Claude-based applications and AI-powered internal tools, working with our cloud and technology teams to ensure appropriate authentication (RBAC/ABAC), governance and HRIS-aligned access controls including MCPs, APIs and custom connectors that securely connect AI applications with the wider HR Tech landscape. 
 - Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance. 
 - Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration. 
 - Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology - turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value. 

About You

- 6+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR & Workday domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is a must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred. 
 - Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus. 
 - Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems. 
 - Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to build service desks, portals, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services. 
 - Fluency in English. Mandatory Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e. g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus. 
 - Comfort working across European, APAC and US time zones, with a primary collaboration focus on a Berlin-based team. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

- Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
 - Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
 - Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
 - Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1: 1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
 - Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
 - Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. 

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. 

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress, make the right financial decisions, and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. 

Job Title: Principal Software Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team: The Technology Team is responsible for the world-leading application of technology and operations across every aspect of CommBank, from innovative product platforms for our customers to essential tools within our business. We also use technology to drive efficient and timely processing, an essential component of great customer service. CommBank is recognised as leading the industry in IT and operations with its world-class platforms and processes, agile IT infrastructure, and innovation in everything from payments to internet banking and mobile apps. 

The Group Security (GS) team protects the Bank and our customers from cyber compromise, through proactive management of cyber security, privacy, and operational risk. Our team includes: 

- Cyber Strategy & Performance
 - Cyber Security Centre
 - Cyber Protection & Design
 - Cyber Delivery
 - Cyber Data Engineering
 - Cyber Data Security
 - Identity & Access Technology
 - Fraud Management

Impact & Contribution: 

As a Principal Software Engineer within Group Security, you will be responsible for implementing designs that align with the Group Security Architecture. You will develop solutions and guide design to drive outcomes across Core Product Systems within Group Security To ensure the Group achieves a sustainable competitive advantage. Your role will encompass various aspects such as Engineering, Automation, DevSecOps, and Engineering Quality and Productivity. You will utilize advanced technical expertise to achieve business outcomes and support the technical strategy of the team. You will be responsible for design analysis and the estimation process from Business Case, ideation, discovery, and inception phases. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead the design and architecture of secure, scalable, and supportable API and platform solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise security and architectural standards. 
 - Drive technical strategy, engineering standards, cloud-native adoption, DevSecOps practices, and continuous improvement across security platforms and services. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, architecture, product, and security stakeholders to deliver integrated end-to-end solutions, while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineers. 
 - Lead evaluation of emerging technologies and conduct Proof of Concepts (PoCs), including AI/LLM capabilities where relevant, to accelerate innovation and improve engineering outcomes. 

Technical Skills & Experience

- 14+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in designing and building enterprise-scale REST APIs and microservices. 
 - Deep expertise in enterprise backend engineering (Java/Spring Boot or . NET Core/C#) and Python(must have) and modern API development patterns, with experience building secure, scalable cloud-native services. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, secure coding practices, API security (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), and object-oriented design principles. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure-by-design solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong experience in building and operating cloud-native services using infrastructure as a code such as terraform, Cloud formation templates etc. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS services such as API Gateway, Lambda, EKS/ECS, IAM, VPC, Security Groups, Load Balancers, and CloudWatch. 
 - Experience building scalable, resilient, and secure platforms in cloud environments. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, security automation, observability, and troubleshooting across cloud-native platforms. 
 - Ability to drive architecture decisions, engineering standards, and platform strategy across teams. 
 - Proven track record of delivering high-impact engineering outcomes and influencing stakeholders across the organisation. 
 - Experience working in security, risk, compliance, fraud, identity, or other enterprise platform domains is desirable (Nice to Have). 
 - Exposure to AI/LLM-enabled engineering solutions and security automation (Nice to Have). 

Soft Skills

- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams. 
 - Strong analytical and reasoning skills, combined with the ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovative thinking. 

Education Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified Developer is desirable. 
 - Security-related certifications are desirable. 

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We're keen to support you with the next step in your career.

data.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today. 

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today's volatility and disruption. With more than 40, 000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers. 

Location

Chennai, India

About The Team

The Site Reliability Engineering team is responsible for the delivery, management, and monitoring of Kinaxis products and cloud infrastructure in our production offerings. We are responsible for ensuring service availability and performance to our customers globally, 7x24x365. 

About The Role

The Staff Cloud Engineer, as a seasoned professional with extensive experience, is responsible for the design, implementation, operations, monitoring, automation, testing, and delivery of complex cloud infrastructure projects. 

The incumbent will provide technical guidance and expertise as they support the cloud infrastructure solutions delivered in production environments and will act as a lead on interactions with Global Customer Care teams in management of critical escalations. 

This role will be 50% SRE & 50% Data Analytics

What you will do

- Transition legacy systems to a cloud-native, modern data stack leveraging tools such as Informatica, Airflow, Postgres and modern technologies like Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, CI/CD, Git, Databricks, PowerBI, Datadog and Grafana. 
 - Deploy, upgrade and support numerous applications, services and operating systems. 
 - Apply software engineering principles to operational challenges with a focus on automation, self-healing and monitoring solutions. 
 - Deliver customer excellence, making sure we meet all SLAs. 
 - Translate architectural, technical and feature changes into operational plans. 
 - Advise and maintain a feedback loop with development and operations teams to ensure deliveries are in accordance with needs and expectations. 
 - Deliver cloud reference architectures to be used by teams across the enterprise as they work to modernize existing technologies and build new capabilities to deliver to Customers. 
 - Develop and manage cloud automation using cloud orchestration capabilities, scripting languages and APIs to design, code, test, implement and support production services. 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation to investigate incidents and provide root causes relating to production infrastructure, services and applications. 
 - Troubleshoot issues within the cloud platform, documenting resolutions and providing coaching and feedback to more junior employees on those resolutions 
 - Responsible for designing, implementing, and managing reporting solutions that support the cloud infrastructure; Optimize cloud resources to ensure cost effectiveness, and identify opportunities for cost savings in customer-facing infrastructure. 
 - Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and trends, evaluating and recommending new tools and services to enhance our cloud infrastructure. 
 - Support scalable and secure cloud environments using best practices and industry standards. 

What we are looking for

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering with specialization in Computer Science or related discipline or demonstrated equivalent experience. 
 - Prior experience in a site reliability engineering role. 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Informatica, dbt, BigQuery, Looker and/or Power BI. 
 - 10+ years of experience with deployment and monitoring of distributed systems , infrastructure and deployment of Cloud Services, public cloud platforms (both console and API) like GCP, Azure or AWS. 
 - Working with VMware ESXi is considered an asset. 
 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and supportive Observability tooling (Logstash, Datadog, Grafana). 
 - Strong knowledge of system design to manage operational and reliability trade-offs. 
 - Extensive experience developing in a scription language (Ansible, PowerShell, Bash and Python). 
 - Proven practical experience in building and managing: 
 - Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) 
 - Configuration management tools (Ansible) 
 - CI/CD solutions (Git, GitOps, Argo CD) 
 - Containers and orchestrators (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) 
 - System monitoring and centralized logging platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, ELK) 
 - In-depth and proactive communication and documentation skills. 

#Senior #Fulltime

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world's supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more. 

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more. 

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we're committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. 

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee: 

- Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
 - Flexible work options
 - Physical and mental well-being programs
 - Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
 - Mentorship programs, training, and career development
 - Recognition programs and referral rewards
 - Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www. kinaxis. com or the company's blog at http: //blog. kinaxis. com . 

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis. com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. 

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Role: Senior Software Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) Location: Bengaluru/Chennai - Hybrid (3 days in Office per week)

About Pearson

Pearson is the world's leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through education. We deliver high-quality content, assessments, and digital services to learners, educators, and institutions globally. Our mission is to empower every learner to achieve their potential. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) who combines strong software engineering expertise with a customer-centric mindset to solve complex business problems and deliver production-ready solutions. 

The FDE works closely with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and engineers to understand customer needs, validate ideas, build proof-of-concepts, and deliver scalable capabilities using modern engineering practices. 

This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. 

Success is measured by delivering customer value, accelerating solution delivery, and enabling successful adoption of the capabilities delivered. 

Key Responsibilities

Customer-Centric Solution Delivery

- Work directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand requirements and desired outcomes. 

- Analyse customer journeys, business workflows, and user pain points. 

- Translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 

- Ensure customer value remains at the centre of the delivery lifecycle. 

- Gather feedback and continuously improve delivered solutions. 

Solution Discovery & Proof of Concepts

- Lead technical discovery sessions and solution design workshops. 

- Develop proof-of-concepts (POCs), prototypes, and minimum viable solutions to validate assumptions, demonstrate value, and reduce implementation risk. 

- Evaluate technology options and recommend suitable approaches. 

- Present technical recommendations and trade-offs to stakeholders. 

- Support solution shaping and implementation planning activities. 

Software Engineering

- Design, develop, test, and deploy production-grade software solutions. 

- Build APIs, integrations, microservices, automations, and cloud-native applications. 

- Participate in architecture and design discussions. 

- Apply software engineering best practices, coding standards, and testing approaches. 

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems. 

Cloud Engineering

- Design, build, and support solutions on AWS and/or Azure. 

- Apply Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud automation, and deployment pipelines. 

- Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and operational controls. 

- Design and contribute to scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions. 

- Follow cloud engineering and operational excellence practices. 

Secure-by-Design Engineering

- Apply secure-by-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle. 

- Implement secure coding practices and security controls. 

- Participate in threat modelling, vulnerability remediation, and security reviews. 

- Apply DevSecOps practices, including automated security validation and compliance checks. 

- Ensure solutions meet enterprise security and governance standards. 

AI-Assisted Engineering

- Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity and software quality. 

- Apply AI-supported approaches for coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation. 

- Contribute to agentic and automation initiatives where appropriate. 

- Follow responsible AI and data governance practices. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership within project teams. 

- Mentor engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing. 

- Lead code reviews, design reviews, and engineering discussions. 

- Collaborate with architects, security teams, product teams, and cloud engineers. 

- Influence technical decisions through technical expertise, collaboration, and data-driven recommendations. 

Required Qualifications

Customer Focus & Business Acumen

- Strong customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business value. 

- Experience engaging directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand problems, validate assumptions, and shape technical solutions. 

- Ability to balance customer experience, business priorities, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational considerations. 

Software Engineering

- Strong software development experience using Python, Java, TypeScript, or similar technologies. 

- Experience building APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications. 

- Understanding of microservices architecture and modern software engineering principles. 

- Experience delivering production-grade solutions. 

Cloud Engineering

- Experience with AWS and/or Azure. 

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud automation, and deployment pipelines. 

- Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence practices. 

- Understanding of cloud security, scalability, resilience, and cost optimisation. 

Security

- Experience applying secure software development practices. 

- Understanding of authentication, authorisation, data protection, encryption, and application security. 

- Familiarity with DevSecOps principles and security automation. 

AI-Assisted Engineering

- Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools within development workflows. 

- Understanding of automation, agentic engineering concepts, and modern AI-assisted delivery practices. 

- Knowledge of responsible AI practices and governance considerations. 

Leadership & Communication

- Demonstrated technical leadership within engineering teams. 

- Experience leading proof-of-concepts, pilots, or complex technical initiatives. 

- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. 

- Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. 

- Passion for continuous learning and innovation. 

Success Measures

Success in this role is demonstrated through: 

- Successful delivery of secure, scalable, production-ready solutions. 

- Effective execution of proof-of-concepts and technology validations. 

- Positive customer, stakeholder, and business outcomes. 

- High-quality engineering practices and code quality. 

- Adoption of cloud engineering, automation, security, and AI-assisted development practices. 

- Strong technical leadership and collaboration within teams. 

- Contribution to reusable engineering patterns and continuous improvement. 

What This Role Is Not

- Not a pure Enterprise Architect. 

- Not a traditional Software Engineer working only from a predefined backlog. 

- Not a Consultant providing recommendations without accountability. 

- Not a Project Manager. 

- Not an AI Tool Specialist. 

- Not an Individual Hero. 

Who we are: 

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson. 

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. 

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp. pearson. com.

data.description:
TITLE

Software Engineer I

Who We Are

Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences. 

Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you'll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration. 

About Vista

Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you'll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers. 

Position Overview

The Software Engineer I is responsible to design, code, and/or configure solutions for moderate complexity Agile stories, as well as writing automated unit and integration-level tests. 

WHAT YOU'LL Do

- Designs, codes, and/or configures solutions for moderate complexity Agile stories with some guidance from a senior software engineer, using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation while critically validating all AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability. 
 - Debugs and resolves moderate complexity software bugs or issues, working independently to find the real root cause and provide a fix without collateral damage - applying systematic debugging practices rather than trial-and-error, including when using AI tooling to assist investigation. 
 - Writes automated unit and integration-level tests under own direction, including end-to-end test coverage using modern test automation frameworks. 
 - Contributes to Infrastructure-as-Code (e. g. , Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline definitions for cloud-based (Azure) deployments as part of feature delivery. 
 - May create or support the creation of a conceptual design/architecture for small-scale software solutions with guidance from an architect or more senior developer. 
 - May provide guidance and mentoring to more junior software engineers, including on the effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools. 
 - Follows development standards and effectively demonstrates technical solutions to other software engineers in code reviews - including reviewing AI-assisted contributions with the same rigor as hand-written code. 
 - Assists in making source code management decisions for one or more teams. 
 - Performs source code management tasks (Git-based workflows, branching, PR hygiene) without specific guidance required from other team members. 
 - Performs other related duties and activities as required. 

What You've Done

Education and Work Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree, or higher education level, or its foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Information Sciences, and/or related field
 - Total Work Experience: 6+ years (software development), 4 years minimum, 
 - Product Experience: 2 years minimum, 4+ years preferred
 - Domain Experience: 2 years minimum, 4+ years preferred

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors

- Expert in object-oriented design, Java or . NET development, relational OLTP queries, and relational database design. 
 - Capable of XML/XSLT document design, JavaScript/TypeScript development, HTML5 & CSS. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure fundamentals (Azure preferred) and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling such as Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes) as used in modern deployment pipelines. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or equivalent) and automated testing frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Pester, or similar). 
 - Expert in Duck Creek Policy, Billing, Claims, Engagement (AP), or Data Insights. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) as part of the daily development workflow, paired with sound judgment on when to trust, verify, or override AI suggestions. 
 - Ability to manage deadlines, communicate in a team, and operate independently with guidance. 
 - Understands how to estimate, analyze, and execute the Software Product Development Lifecycle with Agile methodology. 
 - Understands Insurance domain knowledge. 

CORE COMPETENCIES

Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing-treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds. 

LEARN MORE

- Company Website - Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
 - Life at Duck Creek - Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
 - Benefits & Rewards - Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING

Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. 

This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities. 

At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs. 

The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations. 

What We Stand For

Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems. 

Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements-without regard to any protected status. 

We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead. 

To learn more: https: //www. duckcreek. com/life-at-duck-creek/

AI STATEMENT

To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted. 

PRIVACY NOTICE

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data - Refer Privacy Notice

NOTICE

Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

data.title: Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Principal HW DFT Engineer who will architect, implement, and validate in-vehicle networking devices as part of NXP's Automotive grade products. You will be responsible for advanced test strategies and implementation, verification and validation of pre/post tapeout of DFT features, overall test coverage improvements, and work closely with RTL and physical team on DFT timing constraints and closures. 

Main Job Tasks And Responsibilities

- Architecture & Strategy: Define and implement advanced DFT strategies, including Scan Architecture, JTAG, Memory BIST (MBIST), and Logic BIST (LBIST)
 - Implementation & Verification: Lead the integration of digital subsystems, perform scan insertion, and generate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns while ensuring high fault coverage. 
 - Silicon Support: Drive post-silicon validation and debug activities to root cause failures and improve manufacturing test efficiency. 
 - Collaboration: Coordinate with physical design and test engineering teams to ensure timing closure and that test patterns are operational immediately upon silicon arrival. 

Minimum Required Qualifications

- Education: B. S. /M. S. Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degrees)
 - Experience: Typically requires 10+ years of industry experience in SoC DFT implementation, verification, static timing closure, test coverage analysis and improvement, and silicon bring-up on ATE
 - Tool Expertise: Proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools from Mentor Graphics/Siemens (Tessent), Cadence, or Synopsys
 - Technical Skills: 
 - DFT - Scan insertion and architecture, ATPG: Proficiency in generating test vectors to detect manufacturing faults like stuck-at, transition, and advanced faults, Built-In Self-Test (BIST): Integration of Memory BIST (MBIST) for embedded SRAM/ROM and Logic BIST (LBIST) for autonomous logic testing, Boundary Scan & JTAG, Test Compression: Implementing techniques to reduce test data volume and application time, which is critical for large System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. 
 - Hardware Design & Implementation - HDL Proficiency: Strong command of Verilog or SystemVerilog for modifying RTL to insert test logic and writing test wrappers. Timing & Constraints: Knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) and creating DFT-specific timing constraints (SDC files) to ensure test logic does not degrade functional performance. 
 - Verification & Debug - Simulation: Conducting gate-level simulations (GLS) and verifying DFT logic for correctness before fabrication. Post-Silicon Debug: Analyzing silicon data from Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to diagnose failures and improve manufacturing yield. 
 - Software & Tool Proficiency - EDA Tool Suites: Mastery of industry-standard tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Mentor Graphics Tessent, and Cadence Modus. Scripting & Automation: Expertise in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate test insertion flows, run simulations, and parse coverage reports.

We are a fast-growing financial technology innovator building high-performance, secure, and scalable payment infrastructure. We process high-volume financial transactions and power seamless payment experiences for modern enterprises.

data.title: Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

The Test Automation Engineer will build and maintain shared automated testing frameworks and suites covering UI, API, end-to-end (E2E), and regression testing. The role involves using AI tools to generate and improve tests, validating AI-generated code, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and testing AI-powered features against reliable source data. 

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on automation experience and at least 1 year of AI-assisted delivery experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain reusable UI, API, E2E, and regression automation suites. 
 - Develop automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, or Python. 
 - Use AI tools to generate test scripts and assertions, then review and correct the output. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 
 - Manage test data, environment dependencies, and test execution. 
 - Investigate failures, flaky tests, incorrect locators, synchronization issues, and assertion problems. 
 - Test AI features by checking output accuracy, grounding, and consistency against source information. 
 - Maintain readable, reusable, reliable, and maintainable automation code. 
 - Track test coverage, regression execution time, failures, and automation effectiveness. 

Mandatory Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of hands-on test automation experience. 
 - Strong experience building and maintaining automated test suites. 
 - Practical UI, API, E2E, and regression testing experience. 
 - Experience with Playwright or Selenium. 
 - Programming skills in TypeScript or Python. 
 - Experience with API testing tools such as Postman/Newman or equivalent. 
 - At least 1 year of hands-on AI-assisted delivery for test generation, automation development, or test maintenance. 
 - Ability to review AI-generated tests for correct locators, assertions, waits, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to investigate test failures and distinguish genuine product defects from automation issues. 
 - Understanding that a passing automated test does not, by itself, prove product quality. 

Preferred Skills

- Playwright with TypeScript. 
 - Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions. 
 - Codex, Augment Code, Claude, or GitHub Copilot.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
data.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to take ownership of reliability, performance, and operational excellence across our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms. You'll lead the response to complex, high-severity incidents, raise the bar on automation and observability, and mentor other engineers as the team scales. 

This is a Rotational Shift role and an onsite position located at Bangalore, India. You will be required to work from the office on a full-time basis. We are only considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. 

Position Details

About The Role

- Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex, high-severity incidents across AWS/GCP infrastructure and EKS/GKE clusters, often serving as incident commander for major incidents. 
 - Design and build Python-based automation frameworks and tooling that eliminate manual toil and improve reliability at scale, not just one-off scripts. 
 - Architect and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, establishing reusable, secure, and scalable patterns across AWS/GCP environments. 
 - Drive observability strategy - design Grafana dashboards and alert frameworks that surface the right signals to the right teams at the right time. 
 - Use SQL and CloudWatch Logs Insights to perform deep root-cause analysis on complex, cross-service incidents. 
 - Own end-to-end ITSM processes - Incident Management and Problem Management - including root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and long-term remediation plans. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level SREs, reviewing their troubleshooting approach, automation, and incident handling. 
 - Partner with engineering, product, and leadership teams to communicate incident impact, risk, and remediation plans clearly and confidently. 
 - Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones. 
 - Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks. 
 - Participate in and provide senior-level escalation support for on-call rotations. 

About You

- You should have 5-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with a proven track record of owning the reliability and performance of production-critical systems. 
 - You should possess deep hands-on expertise across AWS services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, networking, and related cloud infrastructure technologies. 
 - You should have demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex EKS and GKE environments, including cluster failures, networking issues, autoscaling challenges, performance bottlenecks, and platform upgrades. 
 - You should be highly proficient in Python for developing automation frameworks, operational tooling, and scalable engineering solutions, as well as Terraform for designing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code patterns at scale. 
 - You should have strong experience with ITSM practices, including hands-on ownership of Incident and Problem Management processes, complemented by advanced skills in SQL and AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights for root-cause analysis and operational investigations. 
 - You should be experienced in designing Grafana dashboards and alerting strategies that provide meaningful observability across multiple teams, services, and environments. 
 - You should communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor other engineers, contribute to reliability strategy, and demonstrate ownership, accountability, and composure during high-severity incidents. 
 - You should hold an AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) and a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent Kubernetes certification, along with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Operational Excellence

Required Experience

Preferred Experience

Skills And Attributes

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. data.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

Harvee Technologies is seeking skilled Quality Assurance (QA) Automation Engineers to partner directly with our enterprise clients. This is not a back-office, ticket-driven position. You will take end-to-end ownership of product quality for client accounts: designing robust automation frameworks, using intelligent tools to identify and resolve issues efficiently, and communicating your findings clearly to English-speaking stakeholders. 

As a client-embedded engineer, you will work closely with client engineering teams as a trusted member of their organization. You will be the person they rely on to identify what is broken, explain why, and recommend how to fix it. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile applications. 

• Integrate automated test suites into client CI/CD pipelines to ensure every build is validated before release. 

• Define and own the test strategy for each client account, determining what to automate, what to test manually, and what residual risks remain. 

• Investigate test failures to their root cause, distinguishing genuine product defects from flaky tests and environment-related issues. 

Intelligent Problem Solving

• Use intelligent tools, including coding assistants, coding agents, and automated test generation, as part of your daily workflow to write tests, analyse logs, and accelerate debugging. 

• Build smart workflows that reduce manual effort, such as generating test cases from requirements or automatically triaging test failures. 

• Test intelligent product features by evaluating generated outputs for accuracy, consistency, and safety, and by designing comprehensive evaluation datasets. 

• Critically review and validate all tool-generated output before it reaches the client. 

Client Engagement

• Work as an embedded member of enterprise client teams, participating in their stand-ups and working within their tools and codebases. 

• Translate ambiguous client requirements into clear, actionable technical plans and deliver against them. 

• Serve as the quality lead on the account by reporting status, flagging risks early, and recommending corrective actions. 

• Bring insights gained from client engagements back into Harvee's internal tools and best practices. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Experience: 2+ years in test automation or software engineering. Client-facing or consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Programming: Strong proficiency in at least one of Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with the ability to write automation code to production-quality standards. 

• Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI testing, and REST Assured, Postman, or similar tools for API testing. Experience with Appium for mobile testing is a plus. 

• CI/CD and Cloud: Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; proficiency with Docker; and working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

• AI Tool Proficiency: Regular, practical use of modern coding and testing assistants, with the ability to write effective prompts and validate generated output. 

• Problem Solving: A proven track record of resolving ambiguous, high-pressure problems independently. 

• English Communication: Fluent spoken and written English, with the confidence to lead calls with clients in the US, UK, or Australia. 

• Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Communication and Client-Facing Expectations

In this role, communication skills carry as much weight as technical expertise. You will often be the sole representative of Harvee Technologies that the client interacts with. You will be expected to: 

• Lead client calls with confidence, including running demos, presenting test results, and responding to questions in real time. 

• Explain complex technical issues in clear, plain English to non-technical stakeholders such as product owners and managers. 

• Produce clear, self-explanatory status reports, defect reports, and test plans that require no further clarification. 

• Push back professionally when timelines or quality are at risk, while proposing practical alternatives. 

• Earn the trust of senior client engineers by working at their level and consistently delivering on your commitments. 

• Maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with client time zones (US, UK, or Australia) as required by the account. 

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience testing products with AI-driven or generated-content features, including prompt evaluation and output quality scoring. 

• Experience building internal tools or agents using LLM APIs to automate parts of the QA process. 

• Performance and load testing experience with JMeter, k6, or Gatling. 

• Exposure to security or accessibility testing. 

• Prior on-site or embedded experience with Fortune 500 or large enterprise clients. 

• ISTQB or an equivalent certification. 

What We Offer

• Direct exposure to enterprise clients and modern engineering practices. 

• Access to industry-leading developer tools, along with dedicated time to explore and experiment with them. 

• Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus. 

• A clear and accelerated growth path into Solution Architect, QA Lead, or Automation Engineering roles. 

Harvee Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Leads the architecture and design of interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance including leveraging distributed state management tools.

-Designs interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down).

-Architects comprehensive fault-tolerant interdependent systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing advanced redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Leads the design of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance). 

-Optimizes and design advanced techniques for handling network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Designs systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Defines key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to proactively identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running systems.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

-Formally verifies complex features (e. g. , via TLA+) to ensure system design correctness. 

-Develops strategies for data replication and synchronization to maintain data integrity and availability.

-Mentors others to ensures that cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date. 

Automation & Change Management:

Builds and maintains partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Problem Solving:

Acts as a role model for continuous learning by identifying new areas to grow skills. data.title: Director AI – Enterprise AI, Generative AI & Agentic Platforms
data.description:
Role Overview

Our company is seeking an accomplished Head of AI Division to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. This is a senior leadership position responsible for defining the AI vision, building and scaling AI capabilities, establishing enterprise AI platforms, and driving measurable business transformation across the organization's engineering, product, and operational ecosystems. 

The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. 

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions. 

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Business Transformation

- Define and execute Solartis' enterprise AI strategy, vision, and multi-year transformation roadmap. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered decision systems across products and business functions. 
 - Translate business objectives into scalable AI initiatives with clearly defined outcomes, investment priorities, and measurable ROI. 
 - Establish enterprise AI reference architectures, technology standards, implementation frameworks, and reusable accelerators. 
 - Advise executive leadership on AI adoption, emerging technologies, investment priorities, opportunities, and associated risks. 
 - Drive an AI-first engineering and product development culture across the organization. 2. AI Division Leadership & Organizational Development

- Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AI division comprising AI architects, AI/ML engineers, Generative AI specialists, platform engineers, and research or innovation teams. 
 - Define the organizational structure, operating model, hiring strategy, capability development plans, and performance expectations for the AI division. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability across AI strategy, architecture, engineering, platform development, and production operations. 
 - Mentor senior technical leaders and develop a strong leadership pipeline within the AI organization. 
 - Foster collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business stakeholders. 
 - Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, technology investments, and AI program budgets. 3. Enterprise Generative AI & Foundation Model Strategy

- Lead the evaluation, selection, architecture, and enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source foundation models. 
 - Establish model selection, routing, orchestration, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and deployment strategies aligned with business requirements. 
 - Drive the adoption of platforms and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other relevant foundation models. 
 - Define strategies for balancing model performance, security, latency, scalability, licensing, and inference costs. 
 - Oversee the development of enterprise AI services, reusable frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and shared platform capabilities. 4. Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Intelligence Platforms

- Lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms and knowledge intelligence systems. 
 - Establish scalable architectures integrating structured and unstructured enterprise data, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge graphs. 
 - Drive improvements in retrieval accuracy, contextual relevance, response quality, grounding, and hallucination mitigation. 
 - Oversee enterprise knowledge assistants, AI copilots, intelligent search solutions, and domain-specific AI applications. 
 - Establish standards for data access, source attribution, information security, and evaluation of knowledge-grounded AI systems. 5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

- Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration. 
 - Lead the design and deployment of AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, task execution, and controlled decision support. 
 - Drive Agentic AI adoption across software engineering, testing, customer support, business operations, and relevant domain-specific workflows. 
 - Establish frameworks for agent orchestration, memory management, human-in-the-loop controls, exception handling, and safe execution. 
 - Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability. 
 - Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries. 6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

data.title: Android Developer
data.description:
Join Data Eminence as a remote Android Developer and contribute to building modern, reliable, and user-friendly mobile applications for Android devices. You will work on application development, user interface implementation, API integration, data management, testing, debugging, and deployment. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in Android development and enjoys creating intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences. This role provides hands-on experience with Android application architecture, modern development frameworks, backend integrations, performance optimization, and application releases. 

Full Description

At Data Eminence, we build practical digital solutions that deliver seamless experiences across devices. As an Android Developer, you will work closely with product managers, designers, backend developers, and other team members to design, develop, test, and maintain Android applications. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Develop and maintain Android applications using Kotlin or Java. 
 - Build responsive and user-friendly mobile interfaces. 
 - Implement application features based on product requirements and design specifications. 
 - Work with Android SDK and Android Studio. 
 - Develop modern interfaces using Jetpack Compose or XML layouts. 
 - Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services. 
 - Work with local and cloud databases to manage application data. 
 - Implement authentication, authorization, and secure data handling. 
 - Follow Android application architecture and development best practices. 
 - Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code. 
 - Debug application crashes, UI issues, API errors, and performance problems. 
 - Write and execute unit and UI tests. 
 - Optimize application performance, memory usage, and responsiveness. 
 - Ensure compatibility across different Android devices and screen sizes. 
 - Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. 
 - Collaborate with backend developers to integrate application services. 
 - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. 
 - Assist with application packaging, release management, and Google Play Store deployment. 
 - Maintain technical documentation for application features and workflows. 
 - Stay updated with modern Android technologies and AI-assisted development tools. We believe in learning by doing. You will gain practical experience with Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Android Studio, Jetpack Compose, XML, REST APIs, Firebase, Room, SQLite, Git/GitHub, Gradle, authentication, mobile testing, and Google Play Store deployment. 

This is a hands-on mobile development role where you will build real application features, integrate backend services, troubleshoot technical issues, improve application performance, and gain practical experience throughout the Android development lifecycle. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 0-2 years of experience in Android development or relevant academic/personal projects. 
 - Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming. 
 - Familiarity with Kotlin or Java. 
 - Basic knowledge of Android SDK and Android Studio. 
 - Understanding of Android application components and lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with Jetpack Compose or XML-based UI development. 
 - Understanding of REST APIs and JSON. 
 - Basic knowledge of Firebase, Room, SQLite, or similar technologies. 
 - Familiarity with Git and GitHub. 
 - Understanding of debugging and application testing. 
 - Basic knowledge of authentication and secure data handling. 
 - Familiarity with Gradle and Android build processes is a plus. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Good communication and teamwork abilities. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment. Benefits

- Competitive salary based on skills and experience. 
 - Fully remote work flexibility. 
 - Paid time off and holidays. 
 - Professional development and learning opportunities. 
 - Company-provided equipment where applicable. 
 - Exposure to modern Android technologies and AI-powered development tools. 
 - Opportunities to work on real-world mobile applications. 
 - Supportive and collaborative remote work environment.

data.title: Director, Software Engineer
data.description:
Level: Director

Location: Gurgaon, India

Reports to: VP of Engineering (or designated Japan Technology leader)

About The Role

We are building a new AI-native, product-led engineering organization at Prudential Japan and are looking for Engineering Directors who want to help shape the future of both technology and the insurance business. 

This role is responsible for building and leading high-performing engineering teams that deliver modern digital products, platforms, and business capabilities aligned to Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation initiative. Engineering Directors will lead teams of Full-Stack Engineers, Front-End Engineers, AI Engineers, and other engineering specialists to modernize legacy systems, redesign business workflows, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business growth. 

This is not a traditional delivery management role. We are looking for hands-on technology leaders who combine engineering excellence, product thinking, AI adoption, and people leadership to help transform Prudential into a more product-driven, data-driven, and insurtech-style organization. 

Key Responsibilities

Japan Technology Transformation & Business Growth

- Lead engineering teams that help accelerate Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation initiative
 - Partner with business, product, design, and technology leaders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy complexity, and improve how the business operates
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled products and workflows that improve customer experiences, employee productivity, distribution effectiveness, and operational efficiency
 - Contribute directly to business growth by delivering technology capabilities that enable new products, improve customer engagement, accelerate distribution, and reduce operational friction
 - Help establish a modern product engineering culture that moves Prudential toward a more insurtech-style operating model

Product & Engineering Delivery

- Lead one or more product-aligned engineering teams delivering business-critical capabilities, platforms, and customer journeys
 - Provide technical leadership across the product domain, helping teams make sound architecture, design, and engineering decisions. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Design, Architecture, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions
 - Drive delivery of high-quality products and services using modern engineering practices
 - Ensure teams focus on business outcomes, customer value, and operational excellence rather than project milestones alone
 - Support the transition from siloed applications to modern product and workflow-based platforms
 - Foster adoption of reusable services, APIs, shared capabilities, and platform thinking across engineering teams

AI-First Engineering

- Build teams that leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations
 - Help engineers identify opportunities to embed AI into products, customer journeys, and business workflows
 - Drive practical adoption of AI technologies that improve delivery speed, product quality, productivity, and business outcomes
 - Foster an AI-native mindset where teams challenge existing processes and rethink how technology and work get done
 - Encourage experimentation and continuous learning around AI technologies while maintaining appropriate controls and governance

People Leadership & Talent Development

- Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams of Full-Stack Engineers, Front-End Engineers, AI Engineers, and other engineering specialists
 - Create an environment where engineers can grow their technical expertise, product mindset, and business understanding
 - Develop future technical leaders and engineering managers
 - Foster a culture aligned to Product Engineering's tenets: 
 - AI-First, Human-Led
 - Outcomes Over Projects
 - Standardize Before Customize
 - Builders Own the Outcome
 - Secure by Design
 - Raise the Bar Every Day
 - Promote continuous learning, experimentation, coaching, and engineering excellence

Engineering Excellence

- Establish and reinforce modern software engineering practices
 - Drive adoption of reusable components, APIs, shared platforms, and engineering standards
 - Promote secure-by-design and compliance-by-design development practices
 - Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, maintainable, and supportable in production
 - Balance speed, quality, risk, and long-term sustainability

Delivery & Vendor Leadership

- Lead hybrid engineering teams consisting of internal engineers and strategic vendor partners
 - Ensure vendors operate as integrated members of the product team and deliver against shared outcomes
 - Improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery predictability
 - Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, vendor effectiveness, and engineering practices

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Build strong partnerships across Product Engineering, Product Management, Design, Architecture, Security, Data & AI, and Platform Engineering teams
 - Communicate effectively with business and technology stakeholders across Japan and global teams
 - Manage competing priorities and drive informed trade-off decisions
 - Help bridge business strategy and technology execution

Examples of Key Success Metrics

- Delivery of business outcomes and product roadmap commitments
 - Improvement in customer experience, operational efficiency, and business workflow outcomes
 - Adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices
 - Engineering productivity and delivery lead time
 - Product quality, reliability, and system performance
 - Reduction in technical debt and operational risk
 - Reuse of shared services, APIs, and engineering standards
 - Team engagement, retention, and capability growth
 - Vendor productivity, quality, and effectiveness

Experience

Qualifications and Experience

- Experience leading software engineering teams in an enterprise technology environment
 - Proven track record delivering modern digital products, platforms, or customer-facing solutions
 - Experience working within Agile product delivery models
 - Experience managing distributed teams and collaborating across global organizations
 - Experience working with third-party vendors and hybrid delivery models preferred
 - Experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated industries preferred but not required

Technical Background

- Strong software engineering foundation with experience in one or more modern technology stacks
 - Experience with cloud-native technologies, APIs, microservices, and modern application architectures
 - Experience making architecture, platform, and technical design decisions for complex enterprise systems
 - Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and software engineering best practices
 - Understanding of AI-assisted software development and emerging AI technologies
 - Experience building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise systems
 - Ability to balance immediate business needs with long-term technology strategy and sustainability. 

Capabilities

- Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills
 - Product and outcome-oriented mindset
 - Ability to connect engineering decisions to business outcomes and customer value
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
 - Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-changing, and transformation-oriented environments
 - Passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and engineering excellence

Culture and Leadership Expectations

- Act as One Prudential by collaborating across teams, geographies, and domains
 - Drive Change by challenging legacy ways of working and embracing modern engineering and AI-enabled practices
 - Be Highly Accountable for team outcomes, engineering quality, and customer impact
 - Engage with Candor through open communication and transparent decision-making
 - Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity

Mission

This role builds the teams, products, and culture that help drive Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation and business growth. Engineering Directors are expected to challenge legacy thinking, embrace AI-native ways of working, and deliver innovative solutions that transform customer experiences, accelerate business growth, and shape the future of technology at Prudential Japan. 

You'll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters; where every day, your work transforms our experiences to make lives better. As you put your skills to use, we'll help you make an even bigger impact with learning experiences that can grow your technical and leadership capabilities. You'll be surprised by what this rock-solid organization has in store for you.

data.title: Product Lifecycle Manager
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This position reports to: 

Global BL Quality & Lifecycle Manager

__

Your Role And Responsibilities

As new industries turn to electrification, it is more vital than ever that we can support ABB's customers with their new challenges and ensure that our Low Voltage System Drives products meet emerging requirements. That is why we are establishing a new role of Product Lifecycle Manager in our Quality & Lifecycle organization. 

In this role, you will ensure that learnings from field performance and reliability testing reach all needed stakeholders for example in product management, R&D and sales. You will also analyze the effects of planned changes or new products on the existing technical offering and customer installed base. The target is to fully leverage accumulated product performance data to support business growth. 

This role is contributing to ABB's Low Voltage System Drives business line in Motion High Power division. You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from division's Product Management, Product Engineering, R&D and Service. 

This is a global role but location is set to be one of these: Finland (Helsinki), China (Beijing), Germany (Mannheim), USA (New Berlin, WI) or India (Bangalore). The work model for the role is: hybrid, 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Initial phase: Developing a new process, related documentation (reports, dashboards) and meeting practices to support efficient product lifecycle decision making and a learning organization
 - Overseeing the process and ensuring execution of related tasks with stakeholders
 - Coordinating and conducting change impact analysis of additions, enhancements or simplifications of the existing product portfolio
 - Facilitating continuous improvements along with the execution of lifecycle changes
 - Managing global projects, involving stakeholders from various functions and local units

Qualifications For The Role

- 10+ years of experience on product engineering, product management, portfolio management, R&D or similar area. 
 - 5+ years experience in leading people with or without line manager authority
 - M. Sc. or B. Sc. degree in electrical /electronics engineering, mechanical engineering or equivalent
 - Experience on process development is a benefit
 - Experience on frequency converters is an asset
 - You enjoy taking on new challenges and working with people across different functions, perspectives, and backgrounds to move ideas forward. 
 - Readiness for international travel, estimated 15% of work time

More About Us
ABB High Power division is the market leader in high-power, high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial process and large infrastructure applications, and a leading supplier of power conversion equipment for renewable energy and other applications. The division offers global support to help customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications. 

If you have questions, please contact Global Business Line Quality & Lifecycle Manager, Johanna Honkanen, at one of these times (according to Finland's time): Oct 29 between 1-3pm, or Nov 2 between 8. 30-9. 30am. 

Interested in joining the crew? Please apply for the position by Nov 8, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application. #ABBCareers #Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https: //www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
