data.title: Senior Software Test Engineer (SDET)
data.description:
About the Company

Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security. Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3, 000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security. This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day. 

Location: Bangalore (Electronic City)

Work Model: 4 Days Work from Office

Interview Process: Face-to-Face Interviews at our Bangalore Office

Note: Apply only if you match the requirement. 

About the Role

Job Purpose: 

The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 

As per company policy, this role requires presence in the office 4 days per week. 

Responsibilities: 

Duties: 

- Test Case Development & Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test cases that align with project requirements, ensuring thorough testing of software functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Automation Support: Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts and frameworks. Assist in enhancing test automation coverage for both system-level and front-end applications. 
 - Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify, track, and document software defects, functionality issues, and performance problems, working closely with developers to reproduce, debug, and resolve issues. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and senior testers, to ensure alignment on testing goals and priorities. Communicate findings and progress effectively. 
 - Test Reporting & Metrics: Contribute to the preparation of test reports and track key testing metrics to assess test coverage, defect resolution, and overall testing progress. 
 - Support in Test Planning: Participate in test planning activities, contributing to discussions about scope, approach, and strategy for different types of testing, such as functional, regression, and integration testing. 
 - Version Control & Configuration Management: Utilize version control systems (e. g. , Git, Subversion) for maintaining test scripts, test cases, and related artifacts. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Assist in integrating test scripts into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure that automated tests are executed as part of the development process. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 

Required Skills

- 4-7 years of hands‐on experience testing distributed, microservices‐based applications, including test strategy definition, design, execution, and maintenance. 
 - Strong expertise in automated testing frameworks such as Robot Framework and Python for service‐level and end‐to‐end testing across backend and consumer‐facing applications. 
 - Proficiency in API testing (RESTful services), including contract validation, payload verification, error handling, and service dependency checks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with containerisation technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes), including deployment validation and scalability testing. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms and their deployment models. 
 - Experience supporting applications deployed via CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Bitbucket) with understanding of microservices promotion across environments. 
 - Proficiency with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), test management tools (TestRail), and version control systems (Git). 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, microservices concepts, and test methodologies with ability to collaborate across development, DevOps, and testing teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to write clear test cases, maintain accurate documentation, and track quality metrics in fast‐moving environments. 

Preferred Skills

- Broader exposure to advanced automation strategies or scripting for test environments. 
 - Certifications in testing frameworks, cloud technologies, or DevOps practices. 
 - Familiarity with security testing or compliance validation in microservices architectures. 
 - Self-starter with excellent time management, attention to detail, and initiative. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

Company Description AKP. HYMX Ready-Mix Concrete is a leading ready-mix concrete manufacturer in Odisha, focused on delivering products that maintain strength and durability over time. The company uses advanced batching technology, strong logistics networks, and strict quality controls to support consistent performance across a wide range of projects. AKP. HYMX serves infrastructure and real estate developers with concrete solutions designed for modern construction needs. With a commitment to strength, speed, reliability, and sustainability, HYMX positions itself as a solid choice for organizations building for the future. 
Role Description The Senior Quality Assurance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Cuttack, responsible for overseeing end-to-end quality control and quality assurance across all ready-mix concrete production activities. This role includes designing and implementing QA/QC processes, monitoring batching operations, supervising laboratory testing, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations. The person in this role will lead a quality team, conduct regular inspections at plants and project sites, and collaborate closely with production, logistics, and sales teams to resolve quality issues and optimize product performance. Daily responsibilities also include reviewing test reports, authorizing mix designs, maintaining documentation for audits, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and training staff on quality standards and safety practices. 
Qualifications

- Demonstrated expertise in quality management, including development and implementation of QA/QC procedures, internal audits, and corrective action programs. 
 - Strong knowledge of concrete technology, mix design, materials testing, and relevant construction and industry standards (e. g. , IS codes or equivalent). 
 - Experience leading and mentoring quality teams, with proven ability to coordinate with production, logistics, and project stakeholders in a manufacturing or construction environment. 
 - Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret test data, identify root causes, and implement practical, data-driven improvements. 
 - Proficiency in technical documentation, report writing, and use of digital tools or software for quality tracking, data analysis, and performance monitoring. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Civil Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field; professional certifications in quality management are an advantage. 
 - Prior experience in ready-mix concrete or building materials quality management at a senior or supervisory level. 
 - Solid understanding of safety standards and environmental compliance, with commitment to sustainable and responsible operations. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work on-site in Cuttack and travel to plants or project sites as required.

data.title: Engineering Manager - AI Native Software
data.description:
Job Description

Provana is looking for a rare engineering leader. Someone who doesn't just manage software teams, but actively reshapes how software is built. 

As our AI Native Software Engineering Manager, you will be the company's foremost practitioner of agentic AI software development practices compressing entire development cycles and turning ideas into production in days rather than months owning the full engineering lifecycle from idea to production across both internal enterprise transformation and externally-facing product lines. 

You will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers embedded across Provana's business units and product divisions. You will be equally at home architecting a multi-agent workflow that automates legal document processing and pairing with an engineer on a complex PostgreSQL schema migration. Hands-on coding is not optional it is core to how you lead. 

This role sits at the intersection of organizational transformation and product innovation. You will compress the distance between what AI can do and what Provana ships at speed and at scale. 

What You Will Own

INTERNAL ENTERPRISE TRANSFORMATION (Org-Wide) : 

- Lead engineering for AI-driven transformation across Finance, Legal, HR, IT, and Accounts replacing manual workflows with rule bases and/or intelligent, agentic systems that deliver measurable efficiency and productivity gains. 
 - Define and enforce a spec-driven development culture internally ensuring every project begins with a precise, versioned specification before a single line of code is written. 
 - Establish BMAD-based multi-agent workflows that mirror real team structures (Analyst PM Architect Dev QA), enabling fast, high-quality delivery by small teams. 
 - Build context engineering standards: like CLAUDE. md files, organizational skill libraries, MCP server integrations, and agentic toolchains that become institutional assets in the pod based FDE model. 

External-facing Products & Services

- Architect and deliver agentic capabilities within Provana's legal tech products including foreclosure legal support, dispute resolution, compliance management, and automated e-filing systems. 
 - Drive the next generation of Healthcare RCM products, embedding generative AI and agentic workflows into billing, coding, credentialing, denial management, and patient access pipelines. 
 - Lead development within Provana's Agentic BPM platform building compound agent systems for process orchestration, workflow automation, and operational intelligence at enterprise scale. 
 - Extend Provana's Speech AI and Conversational AI capabilities designing and shipping production-grade voice and language products for contact center, compliance monitoring, and customer interaction domains. 
 - Collaborate with product and domain teams to ship AI features that directly improve client outcomes: reduced denial rates, faster cycle times, improved compliance coverage, and lower cost-to-serve. 

Team Leadership & Engineering Excellence

- Manage, mentor, and grow a team of forward-deployed engineers across product and internal domains defining career paths, conducting code reviews, and setting quality standards. 
 - Act as the primary technical thought leader on AI-native development practices: agentic software development, swarm architectures, context engineering, and spec-driven workflows. 
 - Partner with executive and product leadership to translate business priorities into engineered solutions with clear ROI, defined success metrics, and delivery timelines. 
 - Build and maintain Provana's internal AI engineering playbook a living system of standards, tools, agent skills, and practices that every engineer can leverage. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging AI coding tools, models, and frameworks; maintain hands-on proficiency with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and next-generation agentic platforms. 

Required Qualifications

- 8 - 12 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead or engineering management role. 
 - Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent agentic coding tools as core development workflow. 
 - Deep hands-on coding ability you write, review, and architect production code daily, not just in theory. 
 - Solid data engineering skills: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, vector databases, RAG pipeline design, and data modeling for AI applications. 
 - Demonstrated experience with agentic software development: building, orchestrating, and deploying multi-agent systems in production environments. 
 - Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool use, eval harnesses, and production observability. 
 - Fluency in spec-driven development structured PRDs, versioned specs as source of truth, and context engineering discipline. 
 - Generative AI integration experience: RAG systems, structured generation, agent memory, multi-step reasoning, and output validation. 
 - Proficiency with the BMAD method or equivalent multi-agent orchestration frameworks for structured software delivery. 
 - Strong communication skills ability to write clear technical specifications, architectural decision records, and executive-level summaries. 
 - Strong Azure platform skills including Azure OpenAI, AKS, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL / Cosmos DB. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive engineering culture across cross-functional teams. 

Technical Stack

AI & Agentic : 

- Claude Code - OpenAI Codex - Cursor - BMAD Method - Spec-Driven Dev - Agentic Swarms - RAG - MCP Servers - Context Engineering. 

Cloud (Azure)

- Azure OpenAI - Azure AKS - Azure Functions - Azure DevOps - Azure AI Studio - CI/CD Pipelines - Docker / Kubernetes. 

Data & Backend

- PostgreSQL - MongoDB - Vector DBs - Python - Node. js / TypeScript - REST / GraphQL APIs - Event-Driven Architecture. 

Domains

- Legal Tech - Healthcare RCM - Agentic BPM - Speech AI - Conversational AI - Finance Ops - HR Automation - Compliance Tech.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
About Altura

Altura is an AI technology partner for companies that want technology to work inside their operation, not alongside it. We start by understanding the business. Before proposing anything, we map how the company actually runs: its processes, its systems, its data, and where the operational load sits. The goal is to find where technology has real leverage, and where it doesn't. We build the roadmap. Opportunities are prioritized by return, effort and dependencies, each one with defined scope, estimated investment, and the indicator it is meant to move. The company ends up knowing what to do first, what it costs, and how success will be measured. We implement. Custom software when existing tools don't cover what the operation needs. Automations that connect systems and remove manual work. AI agents that analyze information, decide and execute tasks within a process. And the infrastructure that makes all of it run reliably. We are not tied to a predefined solution - we choose the technology each business priority calls for. We stay after go-live. Solutions reach production and keep being improved. As the operation evolves, we identify what comes next. One team, from strategy through implementation and beyond. That is the whole point: technology projects usually break at the handoff, so we don't hand off. 

Responsibilities

We need a senior QA engineer for our system with 5+ years of experience who will be able to do: 

- Unit Testing
 - Validate individual functions and calculations. 
 - Test business logic and validation rules. 
 - Test edge cases, null values, and invalid inputs. 
 - Verify error handling and expected outputs. 

- Integration Testing
 - Test frontend and backend integration. 
 - Verify API and database interactions. 
 - Test third-party integrations. 
 - Validate data consistency and error handling between services. 

- Functional Testing
 - Test all features against acceptance criteria. 
 - Verify forms, validations, and user actions. 
 - Test authentication and user permissions. 
 - Verify successful and unsuccessful workflows. 

- End-to-End (E2E) Testing
 - Test all critical user workflows. 
 - Verify data flows correctly across the application. 
 - Test successful and failed transactions. 
 - Confirm expected results and notifications. 

- Regression Testing
 - Retest existing features after code changes. 
 - Run regression tests after bug fixes. 
 - Verify critical workflows after updates. 
 - Document any newly introduced defects. 

- Security Testing
 - Test authentication and authorization. 
 - Verify role-based access and permissions. 
 - Test input validation and common vulnerabilities. 
 - Verify sensitive data protection and secure API access. 
 - Check session management and access restrictions. 

- Performance Testing
 - Measure page load times and API response times. 
 - Perform load testing with expected user traffic. 
 - Test application behavior under peak loads. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and resource usage. 
 - Verify recovery after performance failures. 

- Usability and Accessibility Testing
 - Review navigation and user experience. 
 - Verify responsive layouts and readable content. 
 - Test keyboard navigation and screen-reader support. 
 - Check accessibility against agreed WCAG criteria. 
 - Validate error messages and user feedback. 

- Compatibility Testing
 - Test supported browsers and browser versions. 
 - Test desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 
 - Verify supported operating systems. 
 - Check responsive layouts and screen resolutions. 

- User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
 - Validate features against business requirements. 
 - Execute agreed user acceptance scenarios. 
 - Document client feedback and requested corrections. 
 - Retest resolved acceptance issues. 
 - Obtain formal client approval. 

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in QA engineering (required)
 - Comprehensive expertise across Unit, Integration, Functional, E2E, Regression, Security, Performance, Usability, Compatibility, and UAT testing (required)
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (typically expected)
 - Experience working in agile environments and cross-functional teams (typically expected)

Benefits

- Competitive compensation package (to be discussed during the hiring process)
 - Remote work flexibility (to be discussed during the hiring process)
 - Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning (to be discussed during the hiring process)

data.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Embedded & Edge AI
data.description:
Description

Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world's most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics AstraTM AI-Native embedded compute, VerosTM wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We're making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play. 

Overview

Synaptics is looking for talented Sr. Staff Software Engineer to join our dynamic and growing organization. You will be responsible for the software development for Synaptics Astra® SL Series of Embedded processors. The Astra® SL Series is a family of highly integrated AI-native Linux SoCs optimized for multi-modal Consumer and Industrial IoT workloads with high-performance hardware accelerators for edge-based inferencing, security, graphics, vision and audio. These processors incorporate multiple high-performance compute engines including a quad-core Arm64 CPU subsystem, multi-TOPS NPU, GPU for AI-acceleration and 3D Graphics, along with multimedia accelerators for Image Signal Processing, 4K video encode and decode, backed by industry-grade security certifications. This position reports to the Director, Software Engineering. 

Responsibilities & Competencies

Job Duties

- Develop device drivers for GPU/Display/Camera as well as the Media/Camera/Graphics framework for our Astra processor series 
 - Development of bare metal drivers for pre and post silicon bring up 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship on various Software lifecycle components including requirements analysis, design, implementation, qualification, and production release 
 - Participate in design reviews, documentation, and process improvements to ensure quality and efficiency 
 - This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a large team around the world working to create revolutionary products

Competencies

- Solid understanding of software system architecture 
 - Excellent skills in C/C++ programming 
 - Excellent knowledge of Linux system programming and kernel drivers
 - Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment to complete projects on time with minimal guidance
 - Well organized with strong attention to detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
 - Positive attitude and work ethic; unafraid to ask questions and explore new ideas 
 - Resourceful and able to solve complex problems through adaptation of existing technology and investigation of new technology with a solid understanding of product architecture
 - Analytical and able to make informed decisions based on experience 
 - Sets clear expectations and objectives, and brings parties together to drive key initiatives
 - Ability to work within a diverse team and mentor developing team members 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 - Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across engineering teams

Qualifications (Requirements)

- Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in CSE/ECE or related field or equivalent 
 - 12+ years of relevant industry experience 
 - 8+ years of experience working with embedded firmware/hardware 
 - Expertise with systems analysis, profiling, and low-level debugging with ability to interpret and isolate root causes 
 - Experience in trusted software development in Secure OS/TEE 
 - Strong development experience with device drivers, including Display, GPU, Audio, and Camera drivers 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of display, graphics, multimedia, including Display, GPU, MIPI, Audio, and Camera ISP subsystems 
 - Experience with Linux Display, Graphics, Video, and Audio subsystems, including OpenGL, Framebuffer driver, DRM/KMS, V4L2, and ALSA 
 - Proven proficiency with Linux graphics stack (Wayland, EGL, X11, Qt5 / Qt6 and QML) 
 - Experience developing and integrating Media framework (Gstreamer/OpenMax) 
 - No travel required

Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.

data.title: Propulsion Systems Engineer, Engine Test & Acceptance
data.description:
About Astrobase Space Technologies

Astrobase Space Technologies is an early-stage Bengaluru company building a two-stage orbital launch vehicle. Our engine is a LOX-methane full-flow staged-combustion engine. The Astrobase Propulsion team is looking for experienced and passionate professionals who can own the vehicle's stage fluid and propulsion systems from design to flight. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write engine and component test plans and procedures: proof and leak checks, functional and valve-timing checks, water and LN2 flow tests, and hot-fire runs. 
 - Set test objectives, test matrices, redlines and abort criteria with the cycle and controls engineers; chair test readiness reviews. 
 - Define the test-article configuration, stand interfaces and instrumentation list (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, high-speed channels); verify calibration and channel checkout before each run. 
 - Interface with system specialists and bring engine to test stand; conduct and own test process. 
 - Review data against pre-test predictions after every run; issue quick-look and final test reports. 
 - Lead anomaly investigations to root cause and verified corrective action; disposition test-related nonconformances at MRB. 
 - Assess every engineering change for its effect on completed test and acceptance evidence, and decide what must be repeated. 
 - Write the engine acceptance test specification; maintain as-tested against as-built records and compile the acceptance data package and certificate of conformity for each flight engine. 

DESIRED QUALIFICATION

- B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. 
 - Min. 5+ years in liquid rocket engine or propulsion component testing. 
 - Has written and run test procedures on a cryogenic stand (LOX, LN2, LCH4 or LH2). 
 - Has led an anomaly investigation through to a closed corrective action. 
 - Instrumentation and DAQ: transducer selection, calibration traceability, sample rates and filtering. 
 - Python or MATLAB for test-data reduction. 

Preferred Qualification

- Has accepted and delivered flight propulsion hardware under AS9100D, including AS9102 first-article inspection. 
 - Oxygen-service cleaning and compatibility (ASTM G93, IEST-STD-CC1246, NASA-STD-6001). 
 - Pressure-system safety on test stands (ASME B31. 3, NASA-STD-8719. 17). 
 - Liquid rocket engine qualification and acceptance practice (SMC-S-016; Aerospace TR-RS-2023-00026). 
 - Turbopump-fed or staged-combustion engine test experience. 
 - Stand sequencing and automated redline logic. 

What We Offer

- Salary: ₹24-36 LPA fixed CTC, variable pay based on experience and role fitment. 
 - Attractive early-stage stock options (ESOPs). 
 - Group health insurance: employee, spouse, children and parents. 
 - Insurance: term-life and personal-accident cover. 
 - Work environment: Challenging, stimulating, research-driven work solving rocket problems every day with a great team. We have a good time, and unlimited coffee. 

WHY WORK WITH US?

At Astrobase, We Believe In The Power Of Human Ingenuity And Collaboration To Push The Boundaries Of Space Exploration. As a Team Member, You'll Be

- Creating History: Join us in developing cutting-edge launch vehicles, playing a pivotal role in transforming space access and shaping the future of space exploration. 
 - Collaborating with Experts: Work alongside ISRO scientists and industry veterans with decades of experience in designing India's iconic space missions like Chandrayaan 3
 - Growth Opportunities: As Astrobase scales, you'll have the chance to take on leadership roles and be part of an expanding organization driving change in the Indian space sector. 
 - Pioneering Space Technology: Your contributions will not only impact Astrobase but also influence the global space ecosystem. Be part of something larger than yourself. 

Astrobase is an equal-opportunity employer; we hire on skills, merit and experience. Apply with your CV and a short note on combustion hardware you have designed, built or tested.

Title: Engineering Team Leader - Mechanical-Husky (India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 21203

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Engineering Team Leader, Platform Mechanical

Lead and develop a mechanical engineering team made up of junior, senior, and specialist level designers in the development of new Husky products and solutions with a focus on innovation, quality, risk mitigation and customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability

- Lead, manage and develop the team, which includes but is not limited to coaching, mentoring and cross-training. 
 - Oversee the design, development, and release of engineering for new Husky machine platforms as well as critical service and customer support requests. 
 - Ensure the team is effective in delivering new products that meet the requirements defined by the businesses as essential for success - aligned with product definition and the Husky Operating model. 
 - Planning and scheduling design activities to ensure committed completion dates are met as per business needs. 
 - Enforcement of Product Development Process, Design Documents and Risk Mitigation as well as applicable directives and standards our machines must comply with. 
 - Participate in, and lead as needed, technical discussions, design reviews, and executive updates to ensure the implementation of high-quality solutions with stakeholder transparency. 
 - Influence and establish engineering standards through solid design decisions, processes and tools. 
 - Participate in process creation, product architecture decisions, technology roadmap creation and continuous improvement initiatives
 - Encourage team members to think, organize and lead while providing them with developmental and career growth opportunities. 
 - Lead effective cross-disciplinary collaboration between various stakeholders and teams. 
 - Facilitating collaboration between other departments (Supply chain, Service, Operations)
 - Interviewing and hiring new team members. 

Critcal Capabilities And Qualifications

- Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal and presentation)
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team. 
 - Strong decision-making and judgment. 
 - System level thinking at both a product and enterprise level. 
 - Excellent knowledge of the mechanical design discipline
 - Demonstrates high degree of flexibility and embraces changing priorities. 
 - Knowledge of Husky products, tools, standards, processes and technology is an asset. 

Education

- Bachelor or Master's of engineering degree from accredited university

Experience

- 10+ years relevant engineering experience. 
 - Proven leadership experience. 
 - Previous engineering experience in heavy machinery or injection molding industry is an asset. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Python and Data - Vice President
data.description:
Citi's Markets Technology group is seeking an experienced Senior Python and Data Engineer in Pune to join the engineering organization in developing high-throughput Regulatory & Market Manipulation Controls. In this hands-on technical role, you will code, architect, and optimize scalable Python backend services and data pipelines that process massive volumes of financial market data - including trade lifecycles, orders, executions, and risk analytics. Bridging software engineering with capital markets domain expertise, you will serve as a strategic partner to risk managers, trading desks heads and compliance teams, delivering automated control frameworks and leveraging modern innovations - including Generative AI - to enhance operational resilience and ensure regulatory compliance across Citi's global markets footprint. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the hands-on design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency Python backend services and SQL pipelines to ingest and process massive volumes of financial market data. 
 - Translate complex regulatory mandates and market surveillance policies into robust, deterministic control algorithms and automated surveillance engines. 
 - Partner directly with trading desks, risk managers, and compliance stakeholders to model end-to-end trade lifecycles, order workflows, and multi-asset risk analytics. 
 - Conduct application profiling, database tuning, and SQL query optimization to eliminate bottlenecks, minimize latency, and maximize throughput. 
 - Implement Generative AI-assisted solutions and modern automation patterns to eliminate manual operational activities and streamline control testing workflows. 
 - Act as the technical authority for the engineering team, guiding architectural decisions, system design reviews, and modern CI/CD practices using GitHub and Jira. 
 - Champion engineering best practices, conduct rigorous peer code reviews, enforce testing standards, and mentor engineers across the team. 
 - Ensure technical deliverables strictly adhere to Citi engineering policies, enterprise security standards, and global regulatory compliance requirements. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep hands-on expertise building backend applications and data-intensive pipelines in Python. 
 - Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational database design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and database performance profiling. 
 - Strong domain knowledge in Investment Banking and Capital Markets, including comprehensive understanding of trade and transaction lifecycles, order management, execution workflows, and market risk analytics. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership capabilities, including conducting architectural reviews, mentoring engineers, and setting engineering standards. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the skill to resolve complex, ambiguous technical issues and translate business requirements into robust technical specifications. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills, with the ability to partner effectively with both technical teams and non-technical business leaders. 

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

- Prior experience building regulatory reporting or market surveillance platforms (e. g. , MiFID II, CAT, Dodd-Frank, MAR, Best Execution). 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). 
 - Exposure to distributed computing or data streaming technologies (e. g. , Apache Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Solace, MQ). 
 - Experience applying Generative AI APIs, prompt engineering, or LLM-driven tooling to automate workflows and extract structured insights from unstructured datasets. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent professional experience; Master's degree preferred. 

What We Offer

- Direct technical ownership of critical, high-impact systems that safeguard market integrity and ensure regulatory compliance across a global financial leader. 
 - A hybrid working model combining focused remote productivity with in-office collaboration in Pune. 
 - Access to comprehensive technical training and leadership growth programs across Citi's global engineering community.

data.description:
Job Description

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible. 

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Consumer and community banking technology - Business Banking team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
 - Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
 - Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e. g. , AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 
 - Lead technical design and delivery of complex full-stack capabilities (Java/Spring Boot + React/Angular). 
 - Drive event-driven patterns using Kafka (idempotency, retries, ordering, error handling). 
 - Establish strong engineering practices (test strategy, automation, CI/CD quality gates, observability). 
 - Own production excellence: incident reduction, RCA prevention, performance tuning, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers and influence technical direction across squads and partner teams. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience 
 - Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e. g. , for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
 - Deep expertise in Java 8+ / Spring Boot, microservices, and React/Angular. 
 - Strong Kafka/event-driven architecture experience (retries, idempotency, DLQ patterns, schema/versioning). 
 - Experience with SQL databases with data modelling, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong NoSQL experience: Cassandra / DynamoDB / Elastic Search (data modeling, reliability, scale). 
 - Strong experience with Cloud Foundry/AWS and CI/CD strategy and execution. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in design reviews, mentoring, and cross-team technical alignment. 
 - Ability to work with tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana for observability and monitoring 
 - Experience building applications with resilient, highly available architectures, including consideration for failure modes, recovery, and operational readiness. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Working knowledge of secure engineering practices and designing to meet Cyber Security and Technology Control requirements (e. g. , authentication/authorization, secure APIs, data protection, dependency hygiene).

data.description:
About Us

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. 

As a Senior Engineer, you serve as a specialist in the engineering team that supports the product. You help develop and gain insight in the application architecture. You can distill an abstract architecture into concrete design and influence the implementation. You show expertize in applying the appropriate software engineering patterns to build robust and scalable systems. You are an expert in programming and apply your skills in developing the product. You have the skills to design and implement the architecture on your own, but choose to influence your fellow engineers by proposing software designs, providing feedback on software designs and/or implementation. You show good problem solving skills and can help the team in triaging operational issues. You leverage your expertise in eliminating repeat occurrences. 

Use your skills, experience and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals. As a Sr. Engineer, you'll take the lead as you. . . 

Use your technology acumen to apply and maintain knowledge of current and emerging technologies within specialized area(s) of the technology domain. Evaluate new technologies and participate in decision-making, accounting for several factors such as viability within Target's technical environment, maintainability, and cost of ownership. Initiate and execute research and proof-of-concept activities for new technologies. Manage total product, financials and forecasting. Lead the design, lifecycle management, and total cost of ownership of services. Lead and conduct code review, design review, testing, and debugging activities at the application level. Lead functional design and architecture discussions with understanding of process flows and system diagrams to enable design decisions. Participate in routine and non-routine construction, automation, and implementation activities, ensuring successful implementation with architectural and operational requirements and best practices met.  - Mentorship: Provide guidance and best practices to junior team members. 
 - Continuous Learning: Keep up-to-date with the latest trends in distributed systems and backend technologies. 

About You

- 5+ years in software design & development; at least 4 years building scalable backend apps in Java or Kotlin. 
 - Microservices & Distributed Systems: Proven track record designing and implementing microservices, working with event-driven systems. 
 - Databases: Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non relational databases.

 - Containerization & Orchestration: Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

- Engage in the full software development lifecycle, with a solid focus on coding, testing, and debugging
 - Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices
 - Collaborate closely with team members to design, develop, and deploy new features

 - Communicate effectively and regularly with management and technical support teams
 - Participate in Scrum meeting, design reviews, test case reviews, and production support readiness reviews for new releases
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

- B. Tech. /MCA (16+ years of formal education)

 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Docker, Kubernetes/NoMad, and Jenkins 
 - Proficient in GenAI, Python, Angular, Java, Spring/Spring Boot, Hibernate, Git, RESTful APIs, Splunk, and MySQL

 - Demonstrate solid analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

data.title: Quality Automation Engineer, API Testing, AVP
data.description:
Join us as a Quality Automation Specialist, API Testing

- In this key role, you'll be undertaking and enabling automated testing activities in all delivery models
 - We'll look to you to support teams to develop quality solutions and enable continuous integration and assurance of defect free deployment of customer value
 - You'll be working closely with feature teams and a variety of stakeholders, giving you great exposure to professional development opportunities
 - We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you'll do

Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you'll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You'll be making sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market. 

It's a chance to work with colleagues at multiple levels, and with cross-domain, domain, platform and feature teams, to build in quality as an integral part of all activities. 

Additionally, You'll Be

- Supporting the design of automation test strategies, aligned to business or programme goals
 - Evolving more predictive and intelligent testing approaches, based on automation and innovative testing products and solutions
 - Collaborating with stakeholders and feature teams and making sure that automated testing is performed and monitored as an essential part of the planning and product delivery
 - Designing and creating a low maintenance suite of stable, re-usable automated tests, which are usable both within the product or domain and across domains and systems in an end-to-end capacity

data.title: Head of PBU - Vantage AI
data.description:
About Us

Head of Product Business Unit, Anchanto Vantage AI

Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 10 to 30 people, growing with each bet

About Anchanto

Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company. 

THE UNIT

Anchanto Vantage AI is the data, intelligence and economics business of Anchanto, and the Product Business Unit that builds our new products. Every customer runs their operation on our software, so we hold the most complete operational and financial data they have: orders, inventory, fulfilment events, carrier performance, marketplace performance, settlements and cost to serve, correlated in one place. Vantage AI is built on that asset. It owns the central data layer across every Anchanto product and the products that monetize it: data access for enterprise data and AI teams through MCP, connectors and streaming; operational, business and market insights; Anchanto Settle and Anchanto E-commerce Economics, the financial operations and economics products for e-commerce, starting with marketplace settlement reconciliation and extending to cost to serve, channel contribution and the financial health of the operation; and agentic decisioning for e-commerce and supply chain, where the system sees the stock out, the SLA breach or the margin leak before the customer does and acts or recommends the action. 

A Product Business Unit (PBU) at Anchanto is Product Management and Engineering for one business, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. This unit is different from the other PBUs in one respect: it takes bets. It builds more than one new product, runs each through stage gates, and either spins it out as its own PBU or closes it on evidence. The first bet in build is Anchanto Settle and E-commerce Economics; the data foundation and the agentic products follow. 

THE ROLE

You build a product business from the data Anchanto already holds. You set where each product goes, build it with your own product and engineering team, take it to the first paying customers with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns. This is not a pure product management role and it is not a data platform role: you lead the engineers who build the data layer and the products on it, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is also not a role that protects its bets. You propose them, you fund them against a gate, and you close the ones that fail. 

WHAT YOU OWN: STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, BETS AND RESULTS

- Product strategy. For each product in the unit you know the market, the buyer and the competitors better than anyone in the company, set the strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, and give the CROs your input on pricing, packaging and the entitlement model (included, paid module, download and page level) before anything is built. 
 - The portfolio of bets. You propose which products the unit builds, in what order, with what envelope and against what gate. Each bet moves through the same gates: problem validated with named design partners; first paying customer; ten paying customers; gross margin at scale; then spin out as its own PBU or close. You take the close decision yourself and put it in writing with the evidence. 
 - The data foundation. The central data lake and pipelines from every Anchanto product, the warehouse model, shard discipline, access and entitlement, and the MCP, connector and streaming layer that gives enterprise customers their data back. Nothing above it works without it, so it is built first and kept to an internal SLA for every other unit that consumes it. 
 - Roadmap, decisions and execution. One backlog per bet; what gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security guardrails; release decisions; and whether a product can meet a scope and a date. Customer priorities and asks on live products come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer. 
 - The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering from the first line of code. Two pizza teams per bet, forward deployed engineers with design partners, built on Anchanto Grid and the Vantage data layer rather than on new plumbing. A bet does not get its own infrastructure. 
 - Results and people. The unit's P&L and the spend envelope of each bet; reliability and customer satisfaction for live products; unit structure, hiring, promotions and the final interview of every person joining the unit. Your people are not a bench for other units; a transfer out of the unit is your decision. 

CUSTOMERS, DESIGN PARTNERS AND THE REVENUE TEAMS

This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how each product is sold; the revenue teams own the customer connect and close every deal. A 0 to 1 unit needs discovery, so the rule here is wider than in the other units: you run design partner and discovery conversations with enterprise data teams, finance teams and operations leaders, with the account owner in the room and informed before and after, and you bring the revenue teams the product story, the demos and the answers. You never price, negotiate or close alone, and you never go around the account owner to reach a customer. 

How You Manage Your People

- Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining. Everyone in the unit is full time on the unit; nobody works on Vantage on the side of another job. 
 - Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters. 
 - You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it. 
 - Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. People are confirmed and promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation. 
 - The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review. 
 - You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly, and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep. 

OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS

An escalation on a live product of the unit is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. For the data layer, an outage or a data quality failure felt by another unit's customer is your escalation too. 

How You Are Measured

You own outcomes, not activities. Products without customers cannot be judged on retention and margin yet, so the outputs below are built for a unit that takes bets. You run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance. 

- Gate progress

Each bet against the gate committed in the quarterly plan: design partners signed, first paying customer, ten paying customers, gross margin at scale; bets closed on evidence count as progress, bets kept alive without evidence do not. 

- Time to revenue and ARR per bet

Months from start to first paying customer; ARR, net revenue retention and churn per product once live; deals unblocked or lost on product capability. 

- Data foundation

Products connected to the central data layer, data freshness and quality, enterprise customers on MCP, connector or streaming access, internal SLA met for the other units. 

- Time to market

Weeks from bet approved to a product early adopters can use; weeks from first build to first paying customer; early adopters signed and live with the revenue and account management teams each quarter; planned versus actual on the quarterly plan with variances explained in writing. 

- Reliability and customer satisfaction

Availability, incidents and time to resolve, data quality incidents, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT on live products. 

- AI leverage and AI first approach

Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, and whether every product is designed AI first and agentic rather than as a dashboard. 

- Team EPS and health

Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room. 

PLANNING AND CADENCE

You write the product plan for the unit as a portfolio: which bets, the thesis and the buyer of each, the envelope, the gate and the date it is reviewed. The annual plan each October is a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios. Four weeks before each quarter you write a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly gate review per bet, and a review of the two or three CEO goals for the unit. 

Skills And Prior Experience

Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted. 

- At least fifteen years of industry experience, and at least one product taken personally from zero to paying customers in B2B SaaS, fintech or commerce technology, with accountability for its results. 
 - Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify. 
 - Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school. 
 - Data and AI products. Has built or run a product whose value is data, analytics or AI driven decisions, and can sit with an enterprise data team and a finance team in the same week and be credible with both. 
 - Domain. E-commerce, marketplaces, logistics or supply chain, or the finance and operations functions they serve. 
 - Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome; has closed a product or a project of their own on evidence; has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. 

Career paths we are open to. Nobody arrives with product, technology, data and business skills at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each. 

- Technology or data leader with product skills. CTO, Director of Engineering, Head of Data or equivalent who has built, released and commercialized data or AI systems, and has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs. 
 - Product leader with technology depth. Head of Product for a data, analytics, fintech or commerce product in B2B SaaS, who has led or closely directed engineering and has shipped and commercialized what they defined. 
 - Operations or finance practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer, brand or marketplace. Has run e-commerce finance, settlements, supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale and has specified, bought or built the data and systems behind it well enough to direct a product team. 
 - Consultant or transformation leader. Head of a data, analytics, supply chain or commerce practice who has delivered data platforms, decisioning systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side. 

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a data platform lead with a product manager reporting in, a BI or reporting manager, an innovation lab head who demonstrates but does not sell, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates. 

Benefits Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 
 - Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 
 - International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 
 - Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 
 - Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 
 - Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 
 - Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

data.description:

This role focuses on designing and maintaining enterprise Java services within distributed architectures. You'll work across the full development lifecycle-from API design and Spring Boot development to deployment automation and production support-while collaborating with cross-functional teams in AWS and Linux environments. 

What You'll Do

- Build, develop, and maintain Java-based services/APIs (REST/SOAP) and SOA/web services in a distributed, multi-tier architecture, managing XML and JSON data exchanges. 
 - Develop and maintain Spring Boot applications with containerized deployments on Docker, Tomcat, and OpenShift using strong Unix/Linux operational skills. 
 - Support and implement integrations using Kafka and various queuing or messaging approaches. 
 - Work with relational databases (Postgres, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases, including XML data handling, schema design, and query optimization. 
 - Participate in or lead Java migration/upgrade efforts (JDK 8/11 → JDK 17), ensuring compatibility, performance, and security. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation (Maven builds, GitHub workflows, Jenkins jobs, artifact publishing to Nexus). 
 - Integrate with communication platforms including SMS providers (Syniverse/Twilio), email delivery platforms (SparkPost), and security integrations (Proofpoint/DMARC). 
 - Collaborate with multi-functional teams to develop clear user documentation and communicate status, risks, and build decisions. 
 - Fix and support applications across multiple runtime environments and deployment platforms. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and architecture standards. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of extensive hands-on Java development experience, including JDK 11 and/or JDK 17 (beyond Java 8), with strong object-oriented design and coding skills. 
 - Experience building and integrating APIs and services using REST, SOAP/Web Services, SOA, XML, and JSON data formats. 
 - Advanced XML transformation experience with XSLT programming skills. 
 - 4+ years of experience in Node. js development experience with working knowledge of JavaScript and related technologies. 
 - Knowledge of distributed systems concepts including multi-tier architecture, algorithms, and messaging/queuing patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (Maven, GitHub, Jenkins, Nexus or equivalent) along with applied Unix/Linux command knowledge for production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with application servers (Apache Tomcat) and containerization platforms (Docker and OpenShift). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work across multiple databases including relational (Postgres, SQL Server) and NoSQL solutions. 
 - Experience integrating with SMS and email communication platforms, including delivery callbacks, templates, compliance, and security protocols. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with ability to document technical decisions and manage cross-functional projects. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience on JDK migration projects (JDK 8/11 → JDK 17) including compatibility, dependency upgrades, testing, and performance tuning. 
 - Production-level expertise with Kafka (streams, consumer groups, retries/DLQ patterns, schema evolution) and hands-on experience with SMS/email platform integrations (Syniverse, Twilio, SparkPost, Proofpoint/DMARC). 
 - Cloud depth in AWS (networking, IAM, monitoring/logging, scaling, cost awareness) and production OpenShift operations, plus HTML email template design and SMTP workflow expertise. 

Location

Bangalore, India

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to age, sex, gender (and characteristics related to sex and gender), pregnancy (and related medical conditions), race, color, citizenship, religion, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by law. 

Click Here for Additional Disclosures in Accordance with the LA County Fair Chance Ordinance.

For details regarding how we protect your data, please consult the Amex GBT Recruitment Privacy Statement.

data.title: Sr. QA Engineer 1 - MyWP Core SIT
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

This role is responsible for supporting the quality assurance of the MyWorldPanel platform through automation, functional validation, and collaboration with cross-functional delivery teams. 

The position is suited to a candidate with strong testing fundamentals, practical automation experience, and the ability to work effectively in an Agile delivery environment. 

Role Overview

The SIT Automation Engineer will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of the MyWorldPanel platform during ongoing delivery and migration activities. The role is responsible for designing, maintaining, and executing automated tests, while also supporting manual and exploratory testing where required. Working closely with developers, analysts, and quality assurance colleagues, the successful candidate will help deliver high-quality releases in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

The role also requires a basic level of AI literacy, including the ability to use tools such as Microsoft Copilot or similar solutions to support productivity in testing activities. 

Candidates should be comfortable using clear prompts, interpreting AI-generated outputs, and validating results to ensure accuracy and relevance to business requirements. 

Core Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for UI, functional, and regression testing. 
 - Support manual and exploratory testing activities to validate new or changing functionality. 
 - Ensure appropriate automation coverage for critical business workflows and regression scenarios. 
 - Integrate and maintain automated tests within Azure DevOps pipelines to support continuous validation. 
 - Log, track, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence, working closely with development teams to drive timely resolution. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, documentation standards, and Agile quality assurance practices. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders including developers, analysts, and other quality assurance team members. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Skills

- Proven experience in automation testing and functional validation within complex application environments. 
 - Strong understanding of UI testing, regression testing, and test execution best practice. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps and familiarity with defect and test management tools such as Jira. 
 - Working knowledge of scripting or programming languages such as Java, Python, or similar. 
 - Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and experience working within sprint-based teams. 
 - Good analytical skills with the ability to investigate issues, validate outcomes, and communicate defects clearly. 
 - Basic AI literacy, including the ability to use tools such as Microsoft Copilot, write effective prompts, and review AI-generated outputs critically. 

Desirable Skills

- Experience with Selenium and Java-based automation frameworks. 
 - Exposure to API testing, database validation, and data quality checks. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Previous experience supporting migration, transformation, or platform modernization initiatives. 
 - Awareness of emerging AI use cases in software testing, including test design support, automation acceleration, and analysis of test results. 
 - Ability to use AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot effectively through clear prompting, structured requests, and critical validation of generated outputs. 
 - Willingness to adopt new AI-enabled ways of working as SIT Proof of Concept activities mature and approved tooling becomes part of delivery processe

AI-related expectations for this role may evolve over time. If recruitment takes place when specific AI tools are already adopted within SIT testing activities, those tools and associated capabilities should be explicitly reflected in the job description. 

- Key Performance Expectations
 - Deliver and maintain reliable automated test coverage for agreed business-critical workflows. 
 - Support timely test execution and high-quality defect reporting across sprint cycles. 
 - Contribute to stable releases through effective collaboration with development and QA teams. 
 - Demonstrate ownership of automation assets, test evidence, and ongoing test improvement opportunities. 
 - Engage effectively in Agile ceremonies, quality discussions, and continuous improvement activities.

data.title: Quality Manager | Aerospace & Precision Manufacturing
data.description:
- Should have prior experience leading a Quality team in aerospace manufacturing. 
 - 10+ yrs of Strong in process quality and customer quality management. 

About Our Client

Our client is an established manufacturing company serving demanding industrial and aerospace applications. With a growing order book, a diverse product portfolio and expanding manufacturing operations, the organization is strengthening its Quality function to support business growth and increasingly complex customer requirements. 

Job Description

- Lead end-to-end Quality operations across incoming inspection, in-process quality and final inspection for aerospace and precision-machined components. 
 - Drive process quality, dimensional accuracy and drawing compliance through effective inspection methods, process controls and measurement systems. 
 - Lead technical investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective actions for internal defects, customer complaints and recurring manufacturing issues. 
 - Manage customer quality interactions, technical clarifications, non-conformance resolution and corrective action commitments. 
 - Strengthen supplier quality through incoming quality controls, supplier issue resolution and coordination with procurement and manufacturing teams. 
 - Lead and develop a large Quality team, including managers, assistant managers, engineers and inspection personnel, while improving technical capability and accountability. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace quality standards, customer-specific requirements, traceability and documentation controls. 

The Successful Applicant

The ideal candidate will hold a BE/B. Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, with 10-15+ years of Quality experience in aerospace, precision machining or other high-precision manufacturing environments. Prior experience in aerospace manufacturing is preferred, with candidates from automotive manufacturing also considered, particularly those familiar with IATF 16949. Knowledge of applicable quality management standards such as AS9100, AS9102, IATF 16949 and ISO 9001, along with the ability to implement customer-specific requirements and resolve complex shop-floor quality issues, is expected. 

What's On Offer

- Senior Quality leadership responsibility within a growing precision manufacturing business.

The Data Foundation Quality Engineer owns quality engineering activities for assigned data pipelines, data services, APIs

 - Monitor project execution, identify risks, and resolve technical dependencies.

 - Communicate technical dependencies, challenges, and project progress proactively.

 - Strong ownership of customer commitments and technical delivery.

Growth Opportunities

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Skyworks offers the industry's broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance. 

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 6 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
 - Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, . NET preferred, or similar)
 - Experience with test frameworks and data analysis tools (JMP, MATLAB, or equivalent)
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams
