data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Member Records
data.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to shape the systems that give Hinge Health care-team members a clear, actionable view of the people they support. Member Records is the care-team-facing context layer within CareHub: it brings together member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indications, device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions so care teams can spend less time navigating fragmented systems and more time delivering personalized care. 

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and adjacent engineering teams. You will turn complex healthcare workflows into reliable, intuitive experiences and lead work from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support. 

This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area end to end, influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team, and raise the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of the systems and engineers around you. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-service Member Records initiatives-from discovery through production-bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Set and advance a multi-quarter technical direction for Member Records in partnership with engineering and product leadership. 
 - Establish durable technical patterns for APIs, domain models, integrations, testing, observability, and secure handling of member data. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through high-quality design and code reviews, pairing, mentoring, hiring participation, and coaching other engineers toward greater technical ownership. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership by defining meaningful health metrics, improving incident response, and addressing root causes rather than symptoms. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree
 - 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software. 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development. 
 - 3+years backend experience with Node. js, service development, API design, and integration patterns. 
 - 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

Preferred Qualifications

- Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS
 - Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization, 
 - Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices. 
 - Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners. 
 - A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2, 900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth. com. 

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth. com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth. com.

data.title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for SonicOS, the core operating system powering SonicWall's next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust. 

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle - from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Release Ownership

- Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
 - Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
 - Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
 - Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpointFirewall Domain & Technical Leadership

- Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as: 
 - Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
 - Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering
 - Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
 - Define comprehensive test strategies covering: 
 - Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
 - Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
 - HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability
 - Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenariosAutomation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure

- Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
 - Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
 - Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
 - Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
 - Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environmentsExecution Excellence & Metrics

- Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
 - Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
 - Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
 - Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvementsPeople Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

- Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
 - Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
 - Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
 - Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviewsRequired Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
 - Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
 - Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
 - Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
 - Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
 - Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholdersGood to Have

- Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
 - Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
 - Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
 - Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCAWhat Success Looks Like

- Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
 - Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
 - Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
 - Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
 - Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries. 

Applicant Privacy Notice

data.title: Principal AI/ML Architect
data.description:
About Egen: 

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. 

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team. 

About the opportunity: 

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same. 

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance. 

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program. 

What you will do: 

- Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements. 
 - Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI. 
 - Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved. 
 - Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls. 
 - Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh. 
 - Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning. 
 - Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence. 
 - Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution. 

Your technical toolkit: 

Languages and software engineering

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership. 

Models and AI ecosystem

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation. 

Agentic AI engineering

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design. 

Retrieval and search

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. 

Cloud infrastructure and AI systems

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management. 

Frameworks

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate. 

MLOps and LLMOps

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response. 

Data and ML foundations

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes. 

Basic qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 
 - 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale. 
 - Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios. 
 - A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems. 
 - Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions. 
 - Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products. 
 - Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models. 
 - Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector. 
 - Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification. 
 - Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams. 
 - Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations. 
 - Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: DevOps Engineer IV (Infrastructure)
data.description:
Lead DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

What this Job Entails

This is a hands-on lead role owning the cloud infrastructure and DevOps function for Astreya's product portfolio. The person in this seat is accountable for how our products get built, deployed, secured and run - in our own environments and inside customer environments. 

Google Cloud is the primary platform; Azure is secondary. This is not a role that sets direction and hands the work to someone else: the expectation is that this person writes the Terraform, debugs the cluster, runs the deployment, and then mentors the engineers who will do it next time. They act as the subject matter expert for infrastructure across product, engineering and delivery teams, and as the technical owner in customer conversations about deployment, security and hosting models. 

Scope

- Owns the infrastructure and deployment layer end to end, from CI pipeline to production runtime, across multiple products on independent release cadences
 - Resolves complex problems where the diagnosis requires in-depth evaluation of many interacting variables - networking, identity, cluster behaviour, managed service limits, cost
 - Exercises independent judgment in selecting platform services, patterns and tooling, and is expected to defend those choices technically and commercially
 - Operates as a player-coach: a small team reports to this role, and the role remains individually productive

Your Roles and Responsibilities

Cloud infrastructure (primary)

- Design, build and operate our GCP footprint: GKE, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL (Postgres), Cloud Storage, Memorystore (Redis), Vertex AI, Cloud Monitoring/Logging, Cloud DNS
 - Own network and perimeter design: VPC architecture, Private Service Connect, Cloud NAT, Cloud Armor, private connectivity to customer systems
 - Own secrets, keys and identity: Secret Manager, Workload Identity, IAM design and least-privilege service accounts, KMS, certificate lifecycle
 - Run R&D on platform services we haven't used yet - evaluate the GCP service, identify the Azure and AWS equivalents, and produce a recommendation with a working proof of concept, not a slide
 - Manage cloud cost: attribution by product and environment, budget alerts, rightsizing, commitment planning

Deployment into environments (a core reason this role exists)

- Make deploying our products into a new environment a repeatable, documented, low-drama exercise - both customer-VPC and Astreya-hosted models
 - Own the deployment artefacts: Helm charts, namespace and pod topology, environment configuration, migration and rollback paths
 - Work directly with customer infrastructure and security teams during onboarding - answer their architecture and security questions, adapt to their constraints, and get us to production
 - Produce and maintain the evidence infrastructure security reviews and audits ask for: architecture diagrams, data flow, access controls, encryption posture, audit logging, retention

DevOps and platform engineering

- Own CI/CD across products: build pipelines, artefact promotion, environment strategy, source control branching strategies across multiple release cadences
 - Write automation and internal tooling for provisioning and operating infrastructure - infrastructure as code (Terraform) as the default, scripts and services where it isn't
 - Build the observability layer: metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards and SLOs that let us find problems before customers do
 - Improve scalability, reliability, capacity and performance of the platform, including the infrastructure serving AI/LLM workloads
 - Harden the platform: image scanning, dependency and vulnerability management, network policy, secrets hygiene, patching

Leadership and process

- Lead and mentor DevOps and infrastructure engineers; set standards and review their work
 - Work with product owners and engineering leads to understand requirements, surface infrastructure bottlenecks early, and propose resolutions
 - Own incident response for platform issues and produce root cause analyses for outages that are honest about cause and specific about prevention
 - Design and implement improvements to existing support processes and tooling; introduce innovations and follow through on execution, not just proposal
 - Document decisions, runbooks and resolution history so the next person doesn't rediscover them
 - Other duties as required. This list is not a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities assigned to this position

Required Qualifications/Skills

- Bachelor's degree (B. S/B. A) from a four-year college or university and 8+ years' related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 - Deep, hands-on Google Cloud experience - has designed and run production workloads on GCP, not just passed a certification
 - Strong Kubernetes experience in production: GKE preferred, including networking, ingress, autoscaling, resource management and debugging failures under load
 - Infrastructure as code at a professional standard - Terraform, module design, state management, review discipline
 - Strong scripting and coding ability (Python, Go, Bash or equivalent) and enough software development experience to work inside application repositories, not just around them
 - Practical cloud networking and security depth: VPC design, private connectivity, IAM, secrets management, TLS
 - CI/CD ownership across multiple products and release trains, with source control branching strategies
 - Monitoring, alerting and incident management experience, including writing the RCA afterwards
 - Experience with open-source tooling in large distributed systems
 - Good communication skills - can hold a technical conversation with a customer's security team and a working conversation with a developer on the same day
 - Ability to pick up unfamiliar technology quickly and carry several threads at once

Preferred Qualifications

- Working Azure knowledge (AKS, Key Vault, Entra ID, VNet) and the ability to translate a GCP design onto it; AWS exposure a bonus
 - Experience deploying a product into customer-controlled cloud environments as a vendor
 - Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production - Vertex AI, model endpoints, GPU scheduling, inference cost control
 - Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001 or comparable audits from the infrastructure side
 - Experience integrating with enterprise ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) and the connectivity that requires
 - Prior experience as a first or early infrastructure hire on a product team
 - Relevant certification (Google Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA)

Physical Demand & Work Environment

- Must have the ability to perform office-related tasks which may include prolonged sitting or standing
 - Must have the ability to move from place to place within an office environment
 - Must be able to use a computer
 - Must have the ability to communicate effectively
 - Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

data.title: Manager - Project Quality
data.description:
Job Description

Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. 

We are currently seeking a Manager -Project Quality, to join ourQuality team based in Dahej, Gujarat. 

About us: 

Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. 

Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17, 000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. 

About the opportunity we offer: 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage all day-to-day Quality Control (QC) inspection activities on the shop floor for assigned projects. This role ensures execution of Inspection and Test Plans (ITP) and Quality Control Plans (QCP), manages coordination with Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies and Authorized Inspectors (AI), tracks daily inspection workloads, and guarantees that high-quality inspections and on-time documentation are consistently achieved

Job Responsibilities: 

Shop Floor Inspection & Quality of Inspection: 

- Look after and supervise all daily inspection activities on the shop floor across fabrication, welding, assembly, Surface treatment and testing for assigned projects. 
 - Ensure the highest quality of inspection is maintained by QC Engineers, preventing any defective or non-compliant products from passing to the next manufacturing stage. 
 - Conduct random surveillance checks on the shop floor to ensure strict compliance with approved drawings, welding procedures, and quality standards. 

Traveller, ITP & QCP Management: 

- Ensure precise physical execution of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) and Quality Control Plan (QCP) for all assigned project modules. 
 - Routinely update, sign off, and manage manufacturing Travellers (routing cards) in real-time as physical inspection stages are cleared to ensure seamless production flow. 

TPI & AI Coordination (Customer & Third-Party Management): 

- Plan, coordinate, and manage customer visits and client audits, ensuring readiness of facilities, documentation, inspection activities, and relevant departments, while facilitating timely closure of observations and audit findings. 
 - Act as the primary shop-floor point of contact and coordinator for Client Representatives, Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies, and ASME Authorized Inspectors (AI). 
 - Schedule and coordinate witness, hold, and review points efficiently to ensure external inspectors are present without causing production bottlenecks or unnecessary downtime. 

NCR Management & RCA Participation: 

- Identify process or product deviations, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and halt non-compliant processes immediately. 
 - Manage the shop-floor NCR log, track the physical execution of approved rework/repair instructions, and ensure dimensional/welding corrections are verified. 
 - Actively participate in cross-functional Root Cause Analysis (RCA) meetings with Production, Engineering, and Head QC to investigate recurring defects and implement preventive measures. 

Inspection Load Tracking & Transaction: 

- Monitor, track, and manage the daily inspection load and inspection call transactions requested by the production department. 
 - Dynamically allocate QC Engineers and inspectors to various workstations or modules to balance workloads, eliminate inspection delays, and meet tight dispatch schedules. 

On-Time Documentation & Record Keeping: 

- Ensure all stage-wise inspection reports, dimension check sheets, NDE clearance reports, painting inspection reports and visual weld reports are accurately generated and signed concurrently with the physical inspection. 
 - Maintain strict discipline regarding on-time documentation to ensure there are no delays during the final Manufacturing Data Record (MDR) compilation and product dispatch. 

Starting Date: October 2026

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Qualification: -

Diploma / bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Production, or Metallurgy preferred)

Experience: -

- Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in shop-floor quality control, inspection, and testing within heavy engineering, fabrication, or process equipment manufacturing environments. 
 - Minimum 3+ years in a lead, supervisory, or Project Quality Management (PQM) role. 
 - Relevant certifications such as ASNT NDE Level II, AWS-CWI, or CSWIP 3. 1 are highly preferred

Skills require: - (IT, Communication etc)

- Expertise in reading and executing ITPs, QCPs, and manufacturing Travellers. 
 - Strong coordination and negotiation skills for TPI (Third-Party Inspection) and AI (Authorized Inspector) management. 
 - NCR lifecycle management and participation in RCA (Root Cause Analysis). 
 - Manpower planning and inspection load tracking/transaction management. 
 - Excellent time-management skills for ensuring on-time documentation. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and online systems for tracking shop-floor data. 
 - Assertive communication and shop-floor conflict resolution. 

Your career with us: 

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development

What's next?

Once receiving your application, our Talent Acquisition professionals will screen and match your profile against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. 

We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube for company updates.

Job Description

Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. 

We are currently seeking a Manager -Project Quality, to join ourQuality team based in Dahej, Gujarat. 

About us: 

Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. 

Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17, 000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. 

About the opportunity we offer: 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage all day-to-day Quality Control (QC) inspection activities on the shop floor for assigned projects. This role ensures execution of Inspection and Test Plans (ITP) and Quality Control Plans (QCP), manages coordination with Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies and Authorized Inspectors (AI), tracks daily inspection workloads, and guarantees that high-quality inspections and on-time documentation are consistently achieved

Job Responsibilities: 

Shop Floor Inspection & Quality of Inspection: 

- Look after and supervise all daily inspection activities on the shop floor across fabrication, welding, assembly, Surface treatment and testing for assigned projects. 
 - Ensure the highest quality of inspection is maintained by QC Engineers, preventing any defective or non-compliant products from passing to the next manufacturing stage. 
 - Conduct random surveillance checks on the shop floor to ensure strict compliance with approved drawings, welding procedures, and quality standards. 

Traveller, ITP & QCP Management: 

- Ensure precise physical execution of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) and Quality Control Plan (QCP) for all assigned project modules. 
 - Routinely update, sign off, and manage manufacturing Travellers (routing cards) in real-time as physical inspection stages are cleared to ensure seamless production flow. 

TPI & AI Coordination (Customer & Third-Party Management): 

- Plan, coordinate, and manage customer visits and client audits, ensuring readiness of facilities, documentation, inspection activities, and relevant departments, while facilitating timely closure of observations and audit findings. 
 - Act as the primary shop-floor point of contact and coordinator for Client Representatives, Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies, and ASME Authorized Inspectors (AI). 
 - Schedule and coordinate witness, hold, and review points efficiently to ensure external inspectors are present without causing production bottlenecks or unnecessary downtime. 

NCR Management & RCA Participation: 

- Identify process or product deviations, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and halt non-compliant processes immediately. 
 - Manage the shop-floor NCR log, track the physical execution of approved rework/repair instructions, and ensure dimensional/welding corrections are verified. 
 - Actively participate in cross-functional Root Cause Analysis (RCA) meetings with Production, Engineering, and Head QC to investigate recurring defects and implement preventive measures. 

Inspection Load Tracking & Transaction: 

- Monitor, track, and manage the daily inspection load and inspection call transactions requested by the production department. 
 - Dynamically allocate QC Engineers and inspectors to various workstations or modules to balance workloads, eliminate inspection delays, and meet tight dispatch schedules. 

On-Time Documentation & Record Keeping: 

- Ensure all stage-wise inspection reports, dimension check sheets, NDE clearance reports, painting inspection reports and visual weld reports are accurately generated and signed concurrently with the physical inspection. 
 - Maintain strict discipline regarding on-time documentation to ensure there are no delays during the final Manufacturing Data Record (MDR) compilation and product dispatch. 

Starting Date: October 2026

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Qualification: -

Diploma / bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Production, or Metallurgy preferred)

Experience: -

- Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in shop-floor quality control, inspection, and testing within heavy engineering, fabrication, or process equipment manufacturing environments. 
 - Minimum 3+ years in a lead, supervisory, or Project Quality Management (PQM) role. 
 - Relevant certifications such as ASNT NDE Level II, AWS-CWI, or CSWIP 3. 1 are highly preferred

Skills require: - (IT, Communication etc)

- Expertise in reading and executing ITPs, QCPs, and manufacturing Travellers. 
 - Strong coordination and negotiation skills for TPI (Third-Party Inspection) and AI (Authorized Inspector) management. 
 - NCR lifecycle management and participation in RCA (Root Cause Analysis). 
 - Manpower planning and inspection load tracking/transaction management. 
 - Excellent time-management skills for ensuring on-time documentation. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and online systems for tracking shop-floor data. 
 - Assertive communication and shop-floor conflict resolution. 

Your career with us: 

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development

What's next?

Once receiving your application, our Talent Acquisition professionals will screen and match your profile against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. 

We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube for company updates.

With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. 

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. 

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. 

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space - from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. 

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Our customers use the Meraki web dashboard, mobile app, and programmable APIs to configure, monitor, and automate critical IT infrastructure that serves tens of millions of people every single day. Cisco collects massive amounts of data from devices all over the world. We write millions of data points each second globally every day. With this data, we power our dashboard and a rich set of programmable APIs that allow our customers to gain insight into the state of their networks. 

Your Impact

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings. 

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance-helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care. 

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc's next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you'll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests. 

You'll also own how we test AI itself. You'll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc's AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You'll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release. 
 - Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records. 
 - Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge. 
 - Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production. 
 - Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows. 
 - Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value. 
 - Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness. 
 - Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time. 
 - Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts. 

AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING

AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will: 

- AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement. 
 - Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright's MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code. 
 - Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner. 
 - Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators. 
 - Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes. 
 - AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what "good enough for the ED" means in measurable terms. 
 - Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams. 

THE STACK YOU'LL SHAPE

This is our starting point, not a mandate. You'll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them. 

- UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core). 
 - API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces. 
 - Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing. 
 - Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features. 
 - AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc's clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You've proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records. 
 - By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results. 
 - By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today's. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features. 

Requirements

- Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment. 
 - QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles. 
 - Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code. 
 - Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions. 
 - AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow. 
 - Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds. 
 - Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results. 
 - API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines. 
 - Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude. 
 - Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Nice to have

- Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments. 
 - AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams. 
 - Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation. 
 - Global Team Collaboration-work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world. 
 - Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge. 
 - Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization. 
 - Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind. 
 - Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

PeopleSoft Developer

About The Role

#JLLTechAmbitions

JLL, an international real estate management company, is looking for PeopleSoft Developers to join our JLL Technology Engineering organization. You will work on mission-critical financial systems, combining hands-on PeopleSoft development with analysis of business needs, root-cause work on production issues, and delivery of enhancements through the full change lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, changing environment, enjoys solving business problems through creative thinking, and brings a "Get it done" attitude with a "Think ahead" mentality. You should be comfortable working independently and with a distributed team, and able to lead by example. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and enhance: design, code, and unit test customizations and enhancements to JLL's PeopleSoft Financials modules using PeopleCode, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, SQR, and SQL. 
 - Resolve production issues: analyze incidents and batch failures, determine root cause, deliver fixes, and move solutions through the change lifecycle. Document recurring failures as SOPs and known-error articles. 
 - Translate requirements: work with finance users and functional analysts to turn business needs into functional and technical specifications, and articulate requirements in enough detail for thorough testing. 
 - Build and support integrations: develop and maintain interfaces with upstream and downstream systems using Integration Broker, file layouts, and Component Interfaces, and monitor interface and batch process flows. 
 - Reporting: build and maintain BI Publisher reports, PS Queries, and SQRs for finance, audit, and operational needs. 
 - Upgrades and infrastructure: take part in PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) and PeopleTools upgrades, including keep/drop analysis, compare-report review, and retrofit of customizations, and support PeopleSoft environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - Testing and quality: prepare test cases, run unit and system integration testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and track defects to closure. 
 - Improve and optimize: identify performance improvements and automation opportunities, evaluate user interface enhancements, and drive change that reduces manual effort. 
 - Document and enable: maintain technical documentation, training material, and job aids, and consult with the business on correct use and interpretation of PeopleSoft functionality. 
 - Collaborate and mentor: participate in global and regional enhancement and implementation projects, and share knowledge with and guide junior team members. 

Experience & Education

- At least 5 years of IT experience, with 8+ years of hands-on PeopleSoft development preferred. A computer science or related engineering degree is preferred. 
 - Proven experience supporting and enhancing PeopleSoft Financials (FSCM 9. 2) in a production environment. 
 - Experience with PeopleSoft upgrades (PUM image and PeopleTools), including object compare and retrofit. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to resolve issues under SLA pressure. 
 - Experience with API testing and familiarity with HTTP, REST, and JSON protocols. 
 - Reliable, self-motivated, and self-disciplined, able to plan and run multiple tasks at once. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication, and strong analytical and organizational skills. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

- PeopleSoft development (required): PeopleCode, Application Designer, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, File Layouts, Data Mover, Approval Workflow Engine (AWE), and PS Query, on PeopleTools 8. 5x and later. 
 - Reporting (required): BI/XML Publisher and SQR. 
 - Integrations (required): PeopleSoft Integration Broker, plus experience with file-based and web-service interfaces. 
 - Database (required): Strong Oracle SQL; ability to write, tune, and troubleshoot SQL scripts. 
 - Financial modules: hands-on experience in several of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Billing, Contracts, Purchasing/Requisitions, Asset Management, Project Costing, and Travel & Expenses. Exposure to a multi-currency, multi-book instance is a plus, including document sequencing, VAT, sales and use tax processing, payment predictor, and bank interfaces. 
 - SDLC and tooling: full software development lifecycle (analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment), Agile delivery, and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow and Jira. 
 - Basic knowledge of financial accounting. 

Preferred (Nice To Have)

- PeopleSoft Fluid user interface development. 
 - Experience with PeopleSoft on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or a cloud migration. 
 - PeopleSoft Test Framework or other test automation tools. 
 - UNIX shell scripting and job scheduling tools (for example Autosys). 
 - PeopleSoft security administration (user profiles, roles, workflow setup). 
 - Integration experience with external platforms such as Workday or ServiceNow. 
 - Oracle PeopleSoft or Oracle Cloud certifications.

data.title: Tech Lead /Sr. Principal Engineer (L6)
data.description:
See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio's next Tech Lead/Sr. Principal Engineer (L6) in Emerging Technologies. 

About The Job

This position is needed to contribute hands-on technical expertise, collaborate on rapid prototyping, and develop innovative solutions as part of Twilio's incubation team. 

As a Tech Lead, you'll work closely with cross-functional partners to design and build new product ideas, leveraging modern technologies and your problem-solving abilities. This is a high-impact opportunity for growth and learning, helping Twilio experiment and stay ahead in the evolving tech landscape. You will be accountable for enabling rapid experimentation in partnership with the ETI tech lead. 

Welcome to Twilio Forward, the incubation lab where we push boundaries, unlock next-era growth, and turn the once-unimagined into reality. 

As part of our Emerging Tech team, you will pioneer Horizon-3 initiatives that fundamentally redefine how humanity interacts with artificial intelligence. 

From launching Ola, the world's first agent-native communication channel, to engineering the ground-breaking Agent-to-Human (A2H) protocol, we are actively building the control room for the autonomous future. If you are a builder driven to disrupt the status quo, reimagine what's possible, and engineer what comes next, your journey starts here. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you'll: 

- Architect & Deliver: Design, develop, and own the end-to-end implementation of high-stakes prototypes and robust, production-ready solutions. 
 - Spearhead AI R&D: Drive the technical direction and collaborate with cross-functional teams to experiment with, validate, and integrate AI, machine learning, and frontier technologies. 
 - Champion Engineering Excellence: Establish governance for code reviews and pioneer continuous improvements to engineering standards, mentoring peers to elevate overall code quality. 
 - Influence & Evangelize: Articulate complex technical concepts, architectural decisions, and project velocity clearly to executive stakeholders and engineering peers alike. 
 - Drive Agility: Navigate ambiguity and rapidly pivot technical strategies in response to shifting requirements, user feedback, and fast-paced market dynamics. 

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

- Required: 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 12+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - Proficiency across modern programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java or Go with the ability to select the right tool for the job. 
 - Experience building applications using front-end (React, Angular) and/or back-end (Node. js, Springboot) frameworks. 
 - Data Architecture: Solid understanding of database technologies, including both SQL and NoSQL paradigms and when to select them. 
 - Next-Gen Workflow: Mastery of an agentic coding operating model; highly effective at leveraging advanced dev tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLMs to drastically accelerate AI-assisted development. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset with effective communication skills for technical discussions. 
 - Extreme Autonomy: Exceptional ability to navigate intense ambiguity, self-unblock execution, and ruthlessly solve ambiguous problems without requiring constant structural support. 
 - Leadership & Collaboration: Strong communication and mentorship skills, with a collaborative mindset suited for high-bandwidth technical discussions. 

Desired

Who you are:

- Design, build, and maintain automation and tooling that reduces operational toil. 
 - Contribute to maturing reliability practices in partnership with Product & Engineering leaders.

Incident Management and Operational Excellence:

 - Use alert, incident, support, and SLO trends to move the organization from reactive response toward proactive risk reduction. 
 - Build measurable feedback loops that connect incident learning to engineering standards, service maturity, product priorities, and vendor actions.

Reliability Strategy and Service Maturity:
