Meet The Team

The Cisco Crosswork Network Controller quality engineering team helps ensure that a highly scalable, microservices-based SDN controller delivers reliable automation for IP transport networks. Crosswork Network Controller brings service and device lifecycle management, telemetry-driven insights, workflow automation, and intent-based closed-loop operations into one integrated solution for multivendor environments. Our team owns service provision and monitoring testing, validating customer-relevant workflows, solution integration, scale, resiliency, upgrades, and release readiness across the platform and its applications. We partner with development, product management, customer-facing, and operations teams to identify risk early, automate repeatable validation, and deliver dependable releases. 

Your Impact

- Plan and execute service provision and monitoring test strategies for Crosswork Network Controller releases, translating customer and solution use cases into comprehensive end-to-end validation. 
 - Build and maintain Python-based automation for GUI, REST API, platform, network-device, and service workflows to improve coverage and execution efficiency. 
 - Validate integrated solution behavior across installation and upgrades, device onboarding, service provisioning, topology, telemetry, high availability, scale, and failure recovery. 
 - Reproduce complex defects, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent regressions. 
 - Communicate quality status and release risk through clear test plans, execution results, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of CI/CD quality gates. 

Minimum Requirements: (Must Have)

- Strong Python automation skills with experience designing and maintaining scalable test frameworks, libraries, and scripts for system and end-to-end validation. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and JSON-based integrations. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including routing protocols, MPLS, Segment Routing, TCP/IP, and L2/L3 VPN services, with the ability to configure network devices, validate control- and data-plane behavior, and troubleshoot multivendor environments. 
 - Hands-on quality engineering experience designing and executing functional, integration, regression, upgrade, resiliency, scale, and end-to-end tests for distributed network-management or automation products. 
 - Strong Linux/Unix, API, and platform troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, service-health validation, defect isolation, and release verification across clustered or containerized environments. 
 - Ability to work in an cross-functional environment, collaborating with developers, product managers, customer-facing teams, and quality engineers to define acceptance criteria, automate workflows, improve coverage, and communicate release risk. 

Optional Skills: (Good to have)

- Experience with Cisco Crosswork, Cisco NSO, SR-PCE, model-driven telemetry, NETCONF/YANG, gNMI, SNMP, or related network-automation technologies is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes or other container platforms, virtualization, CI/CD systems, and test approaches for high availability, performance, scale, and upgrade or migration scenarios. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Business Acceptance Analyst
data.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2, 800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. 

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. 

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. 

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. 

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. 

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. 

Role Details

📍 Job location: Bangalore (On-site)

🕒 Contract type: Permanent

🗓 Target start date: January 2027

⏰ Working hours: Full-time (40h/week), aligned with the GMT timezone (starting at 1: 00 PM IST)

💵 Compensation: INR 10, 00, 000 - 22, 00, 000 per year

📋 What You'll Architect

As a Business Acceptance Analyst / Digital Solution Validation, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making. 

This role is both analytical and consultative, ideal for someone who can bridge business requirements and delivered digital solutions while ensuring production readiness. We are looking for professionals who can connect business needs with technology delivery, ensuring that solutions meet expectations before moving into production. Professionals who think like architects and act like builders. 

You will support a global team responsible for the processes, tools, and data governance associated with customer installed-base management, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and digital delivery teams. 

Responsibilities

- Review business and functional requirements to understand expected outcomes and acceptance conditions. 
 - Translate requirements and specifications into structured validation scenarios and acceptance criteria. 
 - Validate delivered functionality against agreed business requirements and solution specifications. 
 - Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and deviations between requirements and delivered solutions. 
 - Work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and digital delivery teams to resolve issues. 
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, acceptance criteria, validation outcomes, and production readiness. 
 - Support business acceptance and pre-production validation activities. 
 - Provide clear evidence-based reporting of validation results and outstanding issues. 
 - Challenge unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria before solutions progress toward production. 
 - Apply AI-enabled techniques to improve validation efficiency, requirements analysis, documentation quality, scenario generation, and solution analysis. 
 - Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI-assisted tools. 
 - Collaborate effectively with international colleagues while maintaining a strong on-site presence in Bangalore. 

👤 Who You Are

- You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges. 
 - You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action. 
 - You balance technical thinking with business understanding. 
 - You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments. 
 - You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. 
 - You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth. 
 - You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders. 
 - You have strong attention to detail and enjoy validating whether solutions truly meet business expectations. 
 - You embrace innovation and are interested in leveraging AI to improve quality and efficiency. 

🛠️ What You Bring

Qualifications & Experience

- 4+ years of experience in business acceptance, solution validation, functional testing, QA analysis, UAT, or a similar role within digital or technology delivery environments. 
 - Experience working with business stakeholders and software delivery teams. 
 - Experience operating within agile or iterative delivery environments. 
 - Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams. 
 - Professional proficiency in English. 
 - Availability to work on-site in Bangalore. 

Technical & Professional Skills

- Strong understanding of business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Ability to transform functional requirements into effective validation scenarios and acceptance approaches. 
 - Experience validating delivered functionality against agreed business requirements. 
 - Proven ability to identify discrepancies between specifications and delivered solutions. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail. 
 - Excellent documentation and communication skills. 
 - Experience with requirements traceability and acceptance management processes. 
 - Experience supporting production-readiness assessments and go-live decisions. 
 - AI-aware mindset with the ability to apply AI-assisted techniques to validation and analysis activities. 

Nice to Have

- Experience validating data-driven applications, platforms, or digital products. 
 - Knowledge of data quality, data governance, or master data management concepts. 
 - Familiarity with validation management, defect tracking, or requirements management tools. 
 - Familiarity with CRM, enterprise applications, or Salesforce ecosystems and the business processes they support. 
 - Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot or other Generative AI tools to support business analysis, validation, documentation, or testing activities. 
 - Exposure to industrial, manufacturing, energy or service environments
 - Experience in consulting or client-facing projects. 
 - Exposure to large-scale international transformation or digitalisation programmes. 
 - Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Testing, Quality Assurance, Agile, Scrum, or related disciplines. 

⭐ What Makes You Successful

- You focus on outcomes rather than activity. 
 - You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism. 
 - You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way. 
 - You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions. 
 - You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others. 
 - You combine autonomy with collaboration. 
 - You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results. 

🎁 What We Offer at Keyrus India

- Hybrid work model (3 days/week in office)
 - 18 paid leaves + 9 public holidays
 - ₹5L medical insurance + ₹10L accident insurance
 - Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
 - International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
 - Discretionary Bonus Scheme 
 - Referral Bonus Scheme
 - Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

💰 How Our Salary Ranges Work

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role - not different job titles. 

- Bottom of the range You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support. 
 - Middle of the range You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently. 
 - Top of the range You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team. 

Final offers are based on experience, autonomy, scope, and market context, and are discussed transparently during the process. 

🔒 Responsible AI & Recruitment

At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers. 

To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for note-taking purposes during interviews. AI is never used to make decisions. 

To ensure fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is strictly prohibited. 

Our commitment to responsible AI practices ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate's own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise. 

⚠️ Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process. 

♿ Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. . 

At Keyrus, we help organisations move from experimental AI to industrialised AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. 

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated ModelTM (HOM), we architect reliable: 

- Intelligence Foundations, 
 - Human in Command governance, 
 - and Performance Steering, 

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time. 

With 30+ years of expertise and 2, 800 employees across 28 countries, we help organisations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organisations. 

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

data.title: Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Are you. . . 

- Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
 - Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
 - Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc. ). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software. 

Role Overview - Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer - Bangalore (India)

As an Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, cybersecurity, and performance of X-Rite's embedded software solutions. You will work closely with software, firmware, systems, and product teams throughout the development lifecycle to validate new features, improve test automation, and ensure robust product releases. This role combines hands-on testing, test automation development, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in a global engineering organization spanning India, Europe, and the United States. You will contribute directly to the quality of our market-leading spectrophotometers, color measurement systems, and spectral imaging products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for embedded software products. 
 - Develop and enhance automated test frameworks, regression test suites, and validation tools to improve quality and efficiency. 
 - Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing of embedded devices and associated software components. 
 - Analyze test results, investigate defects, and work closely with software and firmware engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Support cybersecurity validation activities, including security testing and verification of security requirements. 
 - Assist in improving test coverage, automation capabilities, release readiness criteria, and quality metrics. 
 - Participate actively in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Acquire a strong understanding of customer use cases and product functionality to help ensure high-quality product releases. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through automation, AI-assisted testing, process optimization, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor or Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3-7 years of experience in software quality assurance, embedded systems testing, or test automation. 

Experience and training in most of the following areas are required: 

- Experience testing embedded Linux-based systems and software-driven hardware products. 
 - Experience developing automated tests using Python, PyTest, GoogleTest, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with software debugging, defect tracking, and test management processes. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated build pipelines. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile development environments (Scrum and/or Kanban). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto-based systems. 
 - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, and Bash. 
 - Experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with optical measurement systems, instrumentation products, or related industrial devices. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership mindset with a passion for product quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Curious, hands-on, and eager to learn new technologies and domains. 
 - Structured and detail-oriented approach to testing and problem solving. 
 - Collaborative team player with strong communication and influencing skills. 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart. 

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc. ). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software.

data.title: Advanced Specialist - Process Quality
data.description:
About The Role

The Advanced Specialist - Process Quality is a subject‐matter expert and hands‐on leader responsible for ensuring manufacturing process robustness, product safety and regulatory compliance across assigned projects. This role provides technical leadership for process quality activities during new product introductions, process changes and production support, working closely with cross‐functional teams and suppliers to deliver safe, high quality and cost‐effective solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Process Quality Leadership
 - Lead process quality input to design reviews, DFMEA/PFMEA sessions, control plan development and process flow definitions. 
 - Define and maintain process requirements, work instructions and inspection criteria ensuring traceability between design, validation and production documentation. 
 - Provide technical guidance to manufacturing, engineering and supplier teams on process controls, error‐proofing and poka‐yoke solutions. 
 - Validation & Qualification
 - Develop and oversee process validation protocols, capability studies and production qualification activities to demonstrate sustained compliance and performance. 
 - Plan and manage pilot builds, pre‐production runs and production part approval (PPAP) activities to secure customer and regulatory approvals. 
 - Risk Management & Problem Solving
 - Drive risk assessment activities (PFMEA) and facilitate cross‐functional mitigation actions; ensure effectiveness of controls through verification activities. 
 - Lead structured root cause analysis for process or quality deviations, implement corrective and preventive actions and track closure to ensure sustained resolution. 
 - Supplier Quality & Collaboration
 - Support supplier selection, capability assessments and technical reviews; resolve supplier process issues and ensure alignment to control plans and quality requirements. 
 - Collaborate with Purchasing, Engineering and Manufacturing to ensure supplier deliverables meet safety, regulatory and customer expectations. 
 - Performance Monitoring & Reporting
 - Monitor process quality metrics and capability indicators; prepare clear reports and escalate technical or process risks to project leadership when required. 
 - Maintain documentation and evidence of process performance for internal and customer audits. 
 - Continuous Improvement
 - Identify and drive improvement initiatives to enhance process stability, manufacturability and cost effectiveness. 
 - Coach and engage colleagues to adopt best practices and lessons learned from launches and production experience. 
Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong background in process quality, manufacturing engineering or similar disciplines within automotive or safety‐critical industries. 
 - Practical experience with PFMEA/DFMEA, control plans, SPC, capability studies and process validation techniques. 
 - Demonstrated problem‐solving skills with experience in structured root cause analysis and effective corrective action deployment. 
 - Ability to manage complex trade‐offs between risk, cost and schedule and to make sound technical decisions under uncertainty. 
 - Proven ability to influence cross‐functional teams and suppliers through clear communication and technical credibility. 
 - Proficiency with MS Office; experience with PLM/ERP, quality systems or manufacturing tools is desirable. 

Behavioural Competencies & Traits

- Accountability and ownership for delivery of process quality outcomes. 
 - Attention to detail and disciplined execution to meet safety and quality objectives. 
 - Adaptability to changing priorities and evolving project needs. 
 - Collaborative mindset with ability to build trust across functions and suppliers. 
 - Drive for continuous improvement and measurable impact. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Science or a related discipline; relevant professional certifications (e. g. , Six Sigma, CQE) are an advantage. 

Experience

- Typically 7+ years' relevant experience in process quality, manufacturing or quality engineering roles; experience in automotive or other safety‐critical product environments is preferred. 

Language

- English (required). 

We are committed to inclusive recruitment and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. In our international work environment you will find opportunities for career development, technical training and leadership growth. 

More lives saved - more life lived!

data.title: Full-Stack Tech Lead – AI Best Practices - Remote
data.description:
Company Description

McFadyen Digital is the leading advisor and implementer of eCommerce Marketplace solutions. During 15 years of implementing marketplaces, we've built dozens of platforms that cumulatively generate billions of dollars of gross merchandise value (GMV). We're honored to have supported 10% of the Fortune 500 with their digital marketplace initiatives. Over 250 global brands like ABB, AB InBev, ACCO, Albertsons, American Red Cross, American Eagle Outfitters, US Army, US Agriculture Dept, (and many more) have entrusted their digital transformations to McFadyen. We operate global offices across the US, Brazil, and India. McFadyen Digital has been a trusted employer for 35 years and believes that people are the most important part of our company. We're proud of our Great Place to Work certification. 

Learn more about us at our website: www. mcfadyen. com

About AI Best Practices (AIBP)

AI Best Practices (ai-best-practices. com) is a knowledge platform and toolset that helps enterprises benchmark and improve how they apply AI across their value chains. It pairs a content-rich Wiki - covering use cases, AI tools, ROI frameworks, and industry categorization - with Librarian, an AI-driven backend that curates, scores, and surfaces that content. The platform serves C-suite and VP-level decision-makers evaluating AI maturity, tooling, and vendor fit across industries. 

AIBP is a product line built and operated by McFadyen Digital. This role owns the full-stack engineering of the AIBP web application portfolio (Wiki, Librarian, and the surrounding product surface) end-to-end - including how work is planned, ticketed, sequenced, and released. 

Job Description

Do you want to own architecture, delivery, and release for a fast-moving AI-native product line - not just write code for one? Can you turn a rough roadmap into a sequence of self-contained, agent-ready Linear tickets without anyone needing to ask a follow-up question? Have you made Claude Code and Claude. ai your daily driver for coding, planning, and ticket-writing, and built your own skills, hooks, or MCP integrations on top of them? Can you judge in seconds when AI-generated code needs a second look - especially around auth, access control, or anything destructive? Do you thrive in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery rather than traditional phased client work? If you answered yes, then we want to talk to you!

We need a full-stack tech lead to own fast-moving AI-native products end-to-end - and to be the person who turns roadmap into shipped software through well-run Linear tickets, realistic timelines, and clean releases. We build with AI as a first-class part of the workflow: Claude (Claude Code and Claude. ai) is our daily driver for coding, ticket drafting, planning, and status reporting, alongside agentic coding tools, custom skills/hooks/MCP servers, and spec-driven plan/execute/verify loops. You'll work the same way - full-time, hands-on daily, owning architecture, planning, and delivery, and mentoring/reviewing other engineers. 

Responsibilities

Top 5 responsibilities

- Own architecture and technical direction across the AIBP web application portfolio - data model, auth/access control, API design, and deployment. 
 - Ship full-stack features end-to-end - UI, backend logic, schema/migrations, and cloud deploy. 
 - Plan and run the team's work in Linear as the single source of truth - break initiatives into tickets, sequence them against timelines, and keep status, priority, and dependencies accurate at all times. 
 - Build and own delivery timelines and project plans, setting realistic estimates for a fast pace and flagging delays and blockers early with a clear cause and recovery plan. 
 - Own the release process end-to-end - decide what ships, verify migration/deploy readiness, write release notes, and hold the rollback plan. 

Additional Responsibilities

- Write and review tickets so they're self-contained and agent-ready - clear scope, acceptance criteria, and file/test pointers - whether executed by a person or an agentic coding tool. 
 - Use Claude (Claude Code and Claude. ai) as the default way of writing code, drafting/refining tickets, planning work, and producing status reports. 
 - Review PRs, mentor other engineers, and set technical and ticket-quality standards. 
 - Judge when AI output needs verification - especially auth, access control, and destructive data operations. 
 - Keep tests (unit/integration/E2E) and CI/CD gating healthy as things move fast. 
 - Report status concisely to stakeholders - what shipped, what's at risk, and what's needed to unblock it. 
 - Linear & ticket quality: keep Linear accurate as the single source of truth (not a wiki or chat thread); maintain ticket hygiene - status, labels, priority, linked dependencies, sub-issue structure - continuously, not just before a status meeting. 
 - Timeline & project planning: keep milestones, dependencies, and sequencing visibly current as scope shifts; surface risk and slippage the moment they're known, with a cause and recovery plan attached. 
 - Release ownership: gate every release through CI/CD and required checks, confirm migration safety, and ensure release notes and a rollback plan exist for every release; run post-release monitoring and any hotfix path. 

Qualifications

Top 5 qualifications

- 8-12 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a lead/ownership capacity. 
 - Strong TypeScript/React expertise with a modern full-stack framework such as Next. js (deep App Router experience a plus). 
 - 2+ years of daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools, with Claude (Claude Code and/or Claude. ai) as a true daily driver - not occasional autocomplete. 
 - Relational database design and ORM experience (Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, or similar), with sound judgment on migration safety and cascade behavior. 
 - Fluency with Linear (or an equivalent issue tracker) as a planning and delivery tool, not just a task list. 

Additional Qualifications

- REST API design experience: auth boundaries, rate limiting, CSRF protection. 
 - Solid experience on at least one major cloud/edge platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare) and the judgment to apply it elsewhere. 
 - CI/CD literacy: gating, required checks, migration safety. 
 - Session-based auth, RBAC, JWT experience; awareness of CSRF/XSS/injection and secure-by-design habits. 
 - Testing across the pyramid: mocked unit, real-DB integration, browser E2E (Playwright or equivalent). 
 - Release management: versioning, changelogs, rollback strategy, deployment gating. 
 - Has built/customized skills, hooks, subagents, or MCP integrations - extends the tooling, doesn't just consume it. 
 - Comfortable with spec-driven plan execute verify workflows, including using Claude to draft and refine Linear tickets themselves. 
 - Uses AI for UI/UX generation and can carry it to production quality. 
 - Thrives in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery - not traditional estimated client work. 

Nice to Have

- Experience running Linear as the source of truth across multiple concurrent workstreams or teams. 
 - CMS-style platforms (admin + public rendering split). 
 - SEO/AEO/GEO awareness (structured data, sitemaps, AI-crawler design). 
 - Experience running a smaller companion service alongside a larger app.

data.title: AI Principle Architect
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

AI Principle Architect

Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. 

We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. 
 - Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). 
 - Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e. g. , LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. 
 - Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. 
 - Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e. g. , Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. 
 - Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e. g. , Neo4j, AWS Neptune). 
 - Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. 
 - Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. 
 - Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. 
 - Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. 
 - Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. 
 - Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. 

All About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. 
 - Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. 
 - Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. 
 - A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. 
 - The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. 
 - Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. 
 - Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. 
 - Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Director, Product Engineering
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

The Role

We are seeking a strategic, people-first Director of Product & Engineering to lead and grow a portfolio of product and engineering teams in India. Reporting to the VP of Engineering and India Site Lead, you will lead Engineering Managers, senior technical leaders and Product Owners across multiple teams, with accountability for strategy, delivery, organisation design and team performance. Working closely with Product Managers in the US and UK and global Engineering, Design, Quality and business leaders, you will turn customer and business needs into clear strategic direction and predictable outcomes. You will build a high-performing, AI-first product and engineering organisation that delivers meaningful value for customers

What You Will Own

- Engineering leadership and high-performing teams: Lead, coach and grow Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders across multiple teams. Build strong succession, capability and career-development practices, and create an accountable, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture. 
 - Technical direction and architecture: Set the technical direction for your teams in partnership with global Engineering and Architecture. Drive sound decisions on architecture, scalability, security and platform investment, and balance feature delivery with technical debt and long-term system health. 
 - Delivery excellence: Partner with Product Managers and the Director of Product to turn the product roadmap into realistic engineering plans, capacity and milestones. Own predictable, high-quality delivery, and surface risks, dependencies and trade-offs early. 
 - AI-first engineering: Lead the practical adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle, including coding, testing, code review and delivery. Measure its impact on productivity and quality, and share what works across the global organisation. 
 - Quality, reliability and operational excellence: Own engineering standards, CI/CD, test automation, observability and incident management for your teams. Use metrics such as DORA, defect rates and uptime to drive continuous improvement, and ensure strong handling of production issues and customer escalations. 
 - Security and compliance: Ensure your teams build and operate software that meets StarRez security and data privacy standards, including obligations such as SOC 2, GDPR and FERPA for student data. 
 - Organisation design and scale Define team structures, ownership boundaries and operating rhythms as the India Product & Technology organisation grows. Own headcount planning for your teams, manage vendor relationships, and partner with Talent Acquisition and global leadership to hire and retain exceptional talent. 
 - Global partnership and stakeholder visibility: Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Design and Quality leaders in the US, UK and Australia. Keep teams aligned with customer needs and business priorities, and give stakeholders clear visibility of plans, progress, risks and outcomes

Required Qualifications

- 15+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading Engineering Managers or multiple engineering teams. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - Proven experience leading product engineering teams in a SaaS product environment, managing multiple teams. 
 - Track record of improving delivery, quality and reliability using agile, DevOps and engineering metrics. 
 - Hands-on experience driving practical use of AI tools in engineering teams. 
 - Strong people leadership, including coaching leaders, building high-performing teams and shaping organisation design. 
 - Experience partnering with globally distributed Product, Engineering and business stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Strong customer, commercial and stakeholder orientation, with the ability to connect strategy to measurable outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or scaling product and engineering teams in India for a global product company. 
 - Experience leading AI-enabled change in product development or engineering operations. 
 - Experience in property management technology, student housing or higher education is a plus. 

Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

Reasons to join our Team: 

StarRez is not just a workplace - it is a place to belong, build, and grow. 

- A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20+ years - a testament to our people-first philosophy. 
 - Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry-leading solutions while building the India centre for Product & Technology. 
 - Long-Term Vision: We are not here for short-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive. 
 - Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long-term industry leadership. 
 - Z-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives. If you are excited about shaping product strategy, growing exceptional leaders and building game-changing products in a high-impact, collaborative environment - StarRez India is the place for you

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

As a Software Development Engineer II on our Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team, you will build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate the complex processes that keep AWS infrastructure growing ahead of customer demand. The team is expanding quickly with a strong pipeline of projects ready for you on day one, and we are actively investing in new features and AI adoption. If you enjoy building systems from the ground up and solving problems that require creative, unconventional thinking, this is the role for you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate infrastructure supply chain processes for AWS. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams such to understand scaling requirements, translating them into technical designs that account for performance, security, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Write high-quality, well-documented code across the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and operations, ensuring solutions can be maintained by engineers new to the codebase. 
 - Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design discussions, actively training new team members on system architecture and operational practices. 
 - Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, improving system reliability through proactive monitoring and automation. 

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics and triaging any operational alerts. By mid-morning, you are whiteboarding a new automation workflow with teammates, weighing tradeoffs around data structures, algorithms, and service dependencies. After lunch, you pair with a junior engineer on a code change, coaching them through the review process. Later, you pick up one of the projects waiting in the team's backlog, scoping the technical approach and drafting a design document for peer review. 

About The Team

The Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services and directly contributes to the scaling capability of core AWS services. We work alongside software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers across AWS. Together we help deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. With a growing project pipeline and active investment in AI-driven capabilities, this is a compelling time to join. You will experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon values inclusive experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

data.description:
Job Description

About the Function: 

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. 

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. 

It's fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers' hands, you'll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love. 

Qualifications & Experience

- B. Sc/M. Sc. (Chemistry/Microbiology/Food Technology/Biotechnology) or BE/BTech- Food Tech/Chemical Engineering. 
 - 6-10 years of experience in distillery, brewery or beverage manufacturing quality. 
 - Knowledge of SAP/LIMS, laboratory systems, HACCP, ISO/FSSC 22000 and statistical quality tools. 

About The Role

Quality Governance & Compliance

Lead and sustain the Unit Quality & Food Safety Management System in line with organizational, regulatory and statutory requirements. 

- Ensure effective quality controls for RM/PM, liquid, in-process and finished goods, including end-of-line inspection and product release. 
 - Lead internal audits, MRM and ensure readiness for external, certification and regulatory audits. 
 - Govern QC holds, deviations, rework and disposition of non-conforming materials/products. 
 - Ensure timely investigation and closure of consumer/customer complaints and escalation of significant quality risks.

People, Capability & Quality Culture

Continuous Improvement

- Lead structured RCPS/RCA for quality incidents, complaints, deviations and recurring defects. 
 - Ensure robust CAPAs are implemented with process owners and verified for effectiveness. 
 - Analyse Quality KPIs and trends to identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities. 
 - Drive reduction in defects, complaints, rejection, rework and Cost of Poor Quality. 
 - Drive Right-First-Time and process capability improvements jointly with Operations and Engineering. 
 - Ensure Quality risk assessment and validation for new products, packs, materials, equipment and process changes

Working with us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you're supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

data.title: Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Are you. . . 

- Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
 - Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
 - Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc. ). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software. 

Role Overview - Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer - Bangalore (India)

As an Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, cybersecurity, and performance of X-Rite's embedded software solutions. You will work closely with software, firmware, systems, and product teams throughout the development lifecycle to validate new features, improve test automation, and ensure robust product releases. This role combines hands-on testing, test automation development, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in a global engineering organization spanning India, Europe, and the United States. You will contribute directly to the quality of our market-leading spectrophotometers, color measurement systems, and spectral imaging products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for embedded software products. 
 - Develop and enhance automated test frameworks, regression test suites, and validation tools to improve quality and efficiency. 
 - Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing of embedded devices and associated software components. 
 - Analyze test results, investigate defects, and work closely with software and firmware engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Support cybersecurity validation activities, including security testing and verification of security requirements. 
 - Assist in improving test coverage, automation capabilities, release readiness criteria, and quality metrics. 
 - Participate actively in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Acquire a strong understanding of customer use cases and product functionality to help ensure high-quality product releases. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through automation, AI-assisted testing, process optimization, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor or Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3-7 years of experience in software quality assurance, embedded systems testing, or test automation. 

Experience and training in most of the following areas are required: 

- Experience testing embedded Linux-based systems and software-driven hardware products. 
 - Experience developing automated tests using Python, PyTest, GoogleTest, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with software debugging, defect tracking, and test management processes. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated build pipelines. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile development environments (Scrum and/or Kanban). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto-based systems. 
 - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, and Bash. 
 - Experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with optical measurement systems, instrumentation products, or related industrial devices. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership mindset with a passion for product quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Curious, hands-on, and eager to learn new technologies and domains. 
 - Structured and detail-oriented approach to testing and problem solving. 
 - Collaborative team player with strong communication and influencing skills. 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart.

When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 16, 000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Minimum required knowledge, skills and abilities:

 - Knowledge of AWS, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Docker
 - Familiarity with network security, authentication and authorization as a nice-to-have

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS as a good-to-have

data.title: Embedded QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Are you. . . 

- Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
 - Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
 - Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc. ). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software. 

As an Embedded QA Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in advancing the quality, reliability, and efficiency of X-Rite's embedded software development process through automation. You will design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and validation tools that support continuous testing across our embedded product portfolio. 

Working closely with quality assurance, software, firmware, DevOps, and systems engineering teams, you will help ensure high product quality by integrating automated testing into the development lifecycle and enabling rapid feedback in a CI/CD environment. 

This role combines software development skills with quality engineering expertise and offers the opportunity to contribute directly to market-leading spectrophotometers, color measurement instruments, and spectral imaging systems used by customers worldwide. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for embedded software products. 
 - Implement automated functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end test suites. 
 - Develop tools and infrastructure to improve test efficiency, automation coverage, and product quality. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and release readiness. 
 - Collaborate with software, firmware, systems, and QA engineers to identify automation opportunities and improve test strategies. 
 - Analyze automated test results, investigate failures, and support root cause analysis activities. 
 - Develop and maintain test environments, hardware setups, and automation infrastructure required for reliable execution of test suites. 
 - Support hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), system-level, and device communication testing activities. 
 - Promote continuous improvement through automation, AI-assisted testing approaches, process optimization, and technical innovation. 
 - Acquire a strong understanding of product functionality and customer workflows to ensure effective validation of business-critical features.

Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Job Description

Who we are

About Bp/team

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp's businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves. 

Role Purpose

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements. 

Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement. 

Scope & Scale

Platform focus

Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities. 

Testing coverage

Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing. 

Non-functional quality

Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation. 

Delivery lifecycle

Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement. 

Quality engineering

Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis

- Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives. 
 - Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage. 
 - Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements. 
 - Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks. 
 - Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions. 

Manual & Exploratory Testing

- Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services. 
 - Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios. 
 - Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards. 
 - Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes. 
 - Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases. 

Test Automation & Continuous Testing

- Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback. 
 - Select appropriate candidates for automation, balancing business value, stability, maintenance effort and execution speed. 
 - Monitor automation reliability, investigate failures and continuously improve coverage, execution time and maintainability. 

Defect Management & Quality Insight

- Log clear, reproducible defects with evidence, business impact, severity and appropriate diagnostic information. 
 - Work with engineers and suppliers to triage defects, investigate root causes, validate fixes and prevent recurrence. 
 - Maintain transparent defect status, highlight release risks and escalate unresolved quality concerns with options. 
 - Analyse defect patterns, escaped defects, automation results and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Contribute to retrospectives and root-cause reviews, turning lessons into stronger requirements, engineering and test practices. 

Collaboration & Quality Culture

- Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery. 
 - Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions. 
 - Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing. 
 - Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets. 
 - Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams. 

Skills & Experience

- Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches. 
 - Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent. 
 - Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms. 
 - Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing. 
 - Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers. 
 - Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations. 

Success Measures

- Clear test coverage and traceability across requirements, business journeys, risks and acceptance criteria. 
 - Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues. 
 - Reliable and maintainable automated regression coverage integrated into delivery pipelines. 
 - Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions. 
 - Improved platform quality across functionality, accessibility, usability, performance, security and operability. 
 - Effective defect resolution and measurable reduction in repeated or escaped defects. 

Strong collaboration and shared quality ownership across business, product, engineering and supplier

data.description:
About Us

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy - and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there. 

We have a great team and culture - picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly. 

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Risk Management team and help build first-party risk management features that help our customers identify, assess, and mitigate organizational risk. 

Who You Are

You are a full-stack engineer with 3-5 years of experience who cares about building software that is correct, reliable, and genuinely useful. You thrive working across the stack - comfortable designing APIs in the morning and refining React components in the afternoon. You take pride in writing code that is well-tested and maintainable, and you understand that in a compliance domain, data integrity is not optional. 

You are excited by the challenge of translating complex domain logic - risk scoring, control testing, framework alignment - into clean, intuitive product experiences. You are comfortable asking questions, engaging in design discussions, and owning features end-to-end. You work well in a collaborative, async-first environment. 

What You Will Do

As a Software Engineer on the Risk Management team, your responsibilities will include: 

- Design, build, and ship first-party risk management features including risk register, inherent and residual risk scoring, and risk lifecycle workflows. 
 - Develop and extend control testing and monitoring capabilities - automated evidence checks, test cadence scheduling, and pass/fail logic tied to compliance outcomes. 
 - Build integrations with compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and others - enabling customers to map their controls and risks to the standards that matter to them. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate compliance domain requirements into reliable, intuitive product experiences. 
 - Write backend services and APIs in C# (. NET), Node. js, and/or Python that are performant, well-documented, and testable. 
 - Build and maintain React/TypeScript front-end components that surface complex risk data in clean, actionable dashboards. 
 - Participate in design reviews and code reviews, contributing to engineering quality across the team. 
 - Work closely with QA to ensure correctness - you understand that in a compliance product, data integrity issues have real consequences for our customers. What You Will Bring

Required: 

- 3-5 years of software engineering experience in a product-focused company. 
 - Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript for front-end development. 
 - Experience with at least one of Java Springboot, Node. js, or Python for back-end API development. 
 - Comfort working across the full stack - you can own a feature from data model to UI. 
 - Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and writing efficient, well-structured queries. 
 - Solid understanding of REST API design principles and asynchronous patterns. 
 - A track record of writing well-tested code; you care about test coverage and the long-term cost of technical debt. 
 - Excellent communication skills; you can engage effectively in async and cross-functional team environments. 
 - A positive attitude and willingness to learn, adapt, and grow in a dynamic environment. Preferred: 

- Exposure to GRC, compliance, audit, or risk management domains - even as an end user. 
 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or FedRAMP. 
 - Experience building workflow-heavy or state-machine-driven features. 
 - Familiarity with risk registers, control frameworks, or evidence management concepts. 
 - Prior experience in a B2B SaaS environment. Location

We are a fully remote company! This role is open to candidates based in India. Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live. 

Where You'll Go

- Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us. Compensation

- ₹2, 137, 000 - ₹3, 000, 000 WHERE YOU'LL GO

- Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us. WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES

Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ

- Annual compensation reviews + equity
 - Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
 - Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
 - 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match

 - Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects

 - $100 quarterly  paid wellness stipend
 - Pet insurance discount
 - Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
 - Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)  It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof - we recently  raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space. 

At Hyperproof's core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.   

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) do the right things so the wrong things don't happen. 

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started. 

A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

data.title: Quality Control Engineer
data.description:
Company Description Shambho Techsteel Private Limited is a recognized leader in the stainless steel industry, serving industrial clients across global markets. Based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India, the company specializes in manufacturing and exporting high-quality stainless steel pipes, tubes, and fittings. Its strong focus on product reliability and precision engineering has earned a reputation for excellence and long-term partnerships. Team members benefit from working in a quality-driven environment that supports continuous improvement in manufacturing and quality practices. 
Role Description The Quality Control Engineer is a full-time, on-site role located in Vadodara. This role is responsible for inspecting stainless steel pipes, tubes, and fittings at various stages of production to ensure they meet defined quality standards and customer specifications. Daily activities include performing dimensional and visual inspections, reviewing test reports, monitoring process controls, and documenting non-conformities. The engineer collaborates with production teams to identify root causes of issues, implement corrective and preventive actions, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The role also includes maintaining quality records, assisting in internal audits, and communicating quality findings and recommendations to stakeholders. 
Qualifications

- Strong Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills, with experience in inspection methods, testing procedures, and documentation. 
 - Analytical Skills and Quality Management capabilities, including root cause analysis, use of quality tools, and participation in continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Effective Communication skills for coordinating with production, engineering, and management teams, and for preparing clear quality reports. 
 - Knowledge of standards and specifications relevant to stainless steel products or metal fabrication (e. g. , ISO, ASTM) is an advantage. 
 - Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgy, Production Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments, preferably in metals or stainless steel processing. 
 - Attention to detail, ability to follow established procedures, and commitment to workplace safety and compliance.
