data.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer (C#/APL)
data.description:
Senior Principal Software Engineer (C#/APL) - Portfolio Analysisa

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As our new Principal Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product. In your daily work you will - together with your team - understand and challenge customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, APL and an Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend and APIs. 

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping our product for the cloud. 

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team, and individual. Your daily work life will thus also include topics such as "how can we reduce our build time", "how can we rearchitect this component to perform significantly faster", and "how can we work together in a more fun and effective way". 

We encourage your personal development, and you will be able to spend 20% of your time experimenting with new technologies and implementing your ideas. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join an agile team in Portfolio Analytics Product Area. 

We use a multitude of tools and technologies such as Visual Studio, C#, Dyalog APL, Azure DevOps within the areas of development and software configuration management. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

In your daily work, you will - together with your team

- Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing. 
 - Help explore how AI can improve user experiences, workflows, and engineering productivity. 
 - Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level. 
 - Balance active coding (C#, APL) with guiding automation initiatives
 - Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team. 
 - Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals. 
 - Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions
 - Advocate for and implementing improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes. 
 - Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange. 

We expect you to be good at several of the following and are interested in learning the rest. 

- Advanced C# skills and insight into the . NET framework
 - Be able to learn additional technologies (like APL)
 - Experience with developing and integrating middle and backend services and APIs
 - You are interested and able to work within the architecture of an enterprise solution
 - Actively work with improvements relating to tool stack and engineering practices (CI/CD pipelines, test-driven development, telemetry, etc)
 - You have good English skills and thrive in an international work environment
 - You have an M. Sc. in Computer Science or a similar field, or an equivalent level of experience
 - Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is of course an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest. 

- Taking ownership and achieving results
 - Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
 - Working with others to leverage the strengths of everyone in the team
 - Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
 - Continually looking for ways to improve what we do and how we do it

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and Innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, deploy, and manage scalable back-end services, APIs, and database integrations that meet business needs and leverage best practices in full-stack development and cloud technologies. We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial and non-financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. 

EY Risk and Compliance Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Engineering (RCE) practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY's RCE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Front-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript and Java-based technologies. 
 - API Integration: Work with REST APIs and GraphQL services for data integration. 
 - Back-End Development: Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. 
 - CI/CD Management: Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps. 
 - Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions. 
 - Technology Updates: Stay updated with emerging web technologies and apply best practices in performance and security. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Required Skills: 

- 4+ years of experience in full-stack application development with strong expertise in React and Java technologies. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with React. js, TypeScript, and modern front-end development practices. 
 - Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design, and browser compatibility. 
 - Experience with state management libraries, component-driven architecture, reusable UI development, and front-end performance optimization. 
 - Strong proficiency in Core Java (Java 8+) and object-oriented programming principles. 
 - Hands-on experience with Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections Framework, Java Streams, and Functional Programming concepts. 
 - Strong understanding of asynchronous programming using CompletableFuture, Executor Framework, and Thread Pools. 
 - Good knowledge of JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection, and performance tuning. 
 - Extensive experience in developing enterprise applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Data JPA. 
 - Experience in designing and developing Microservices-based architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of RESTful Web Services, API design standards, and integration patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing application security using OAuth2, JWT, and role-based access controls. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Strong proficiency with Git and modern source control practices. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Domain: Prior experience in the Financial Services / FS Risk domain. 
 - Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
 - Familiarity with AI/GenAI concepts, such as LLM fundamentals and prompt engineering. Ability to work with AI APIs or AI-powered components in application development. 

Education: 

Degree: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As our new Principal Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product. In your daily work you will - together with your team - understand and challenge customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, APL and an Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend and APIs. 

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping our product for the cloud. 

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team, and individual. Your daily work life will thus also include topics such as "how can we reduce our build time", "how can we rearchitect this component to perform significantly faster", and "how can we work together in a more fun and effective way". 

We encourage your personal development, and you will be able to spend 20% of your time experimenting with new technologies and implementing your ideas. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join an agile team in Portfolio Analytics Product Area. 

We use a multitude of tools and technologies such as Visual Studio, C#, Dyalog APL, Azure DevOps within the areas of development and software configuration management. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

In your daily work, you will - together with your team

- Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing. 
 - Help explore how AI can improve user experiences, workflows, and engineering productivity. 
 - Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level. 
 - Balance active coding (C#, APL) with guiding automation initiatives
 - Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team. 
 - Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals. 
 - Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions
 - Advocate for and implementing improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes. 
 - Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange. 

We expect you to be good at several of the following and are interested in learning the rest. 

- Advanced C# skills and insight into the . NET framework
 - Be able to learn additional technologies (like APL)
 - Experience with developing and integrating middle and backend services and APIs
 - You are interested and able to work within the architecture of an enterprise solution
 - Actively work with improvements relating to tool stack and engineering practices (CI/CD pipelines, test-driven development, telemetry, etc)
 - You have good English skills and thrive in an international work environment
 - You have an M. Sc. in Computer Science or a similar field, or an equivalent level of experience
 - Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is of course an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest. 

- Taking ownership and achieving results
 - Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
 - Working with others to leverage the strengths of everyone in the team
 - Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
 - Continually looking for ways to improve what we do and how we do it

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.

data.title: Chief Technological Officer
data.description:
Experience: 10. 00 + years

Salary: Confidential (based on experience)

Expected Notice Period: 7 Days

Shift: (GMT+05: 30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Office ()

Placement Type: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: AI-powered platform automating clinic operations and healthcare workflows. )

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - AI-powered platform automating clinic operations and healthcare workflows. )

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

Healthtech Experience, AWS/GCP, LLM, RAG or agentic system

AI-powered platform automating clinic operations and healthcare workflows. is Looking for: 

Key Responsibilities

- Technology strategy and architecture
 - Own the technical roadmap: agent loops, event bus, workflow/BPMN orchestration and data schemas. 
 - Hands on experience with Scalable architecture
 - Define integration with eCW and other EMRs (APIs, HL7/FHIR) and with clearinghouses (X12 837/835, 270/271). 
 - Ensure HIPAA, NCQA, payer compliance are baked into design. 
 - AI and agent platform
 - Ship LLM, RAG and agentic workflows to production for documentation, coding, claims and front-desk operations. 
 - Set up evaluation, monitoring and feedback loops so model output is reliable enough for clinical and billing use. 
 - Make build-vs-buy and model/vendor decisions, and own infrastructure cost. 
 - Team building and leadership
 - Hire and mentor integration engineers, a rules-engine developer, NLP/ML engineers, and data and security staff. 
 - Build India-based engineering team
 - Run agile delivery with high accountability and regular clinical input. 
 - Clinical and business alignment
 - Work with the informaticist, physician champion, and billing and quality advisors. 
 - Turn clinical workflows into technical requirements, respecting billing, compliance and quality-incentive logic. 
 - Keep the product tied to business goals: fewer denials, faster documentation, more HEDIS gaps closed. 
 - Execution, governance and security
 - Deliver the success metrics: time saved, denial reduction, quality-gap closure. 
 - Manage vendor relationships, including eCW contacts for interface specs and compliance. 
 - Implement robust auditability, provenance tracking, and secure PHI handling. 
 - Own risk management across technical and compliance domains. 

Must-have Qualifications

- 10+ years building software products, with hands-on experience working as a CTO, Co-founder (Tech) or Head/Director of Engineering at a startup. Two or more founder/CTO stints is a strong plus. 
 - 0 → 1 → scale track record: built a product from scratch and took it to real users, revenue or enterprise customers (e. g. hundreds of thousands of DAU, millions of users, or TB-PB-scale data). 
 - Venture-backed or product-company background: YC, Sequoia/Peak XV or similar-backed startups, and/or scale-ups and big tech (e. g. Google, Intuit, Rippling, ShareChat, Delhivery). 
 - Team building: hired and led engineering teams of 15-25+ people across backend, frontend, data and AI. 
 - Hands-on GenAI in production: has shipped LLM, RAG or agentic systems, including evaluation and regression testing, not just prototypes. 
 - Strong architecture: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven design, data pipelines, cloud (AWS/GCP), security, observability and cost optimization. 
 - Still writes code: comfortable owning architecture and building core components personally. 
 - Education: B. Tech/M. Tech in CS or related field from a Tier-1 institute (IIT preferred, top NIT considered). 
 - Communication: can explain technical trade-offs to physicians, billing teams, investors and engineers. 

Good to have

- Healthcare or healthtech experience, especially U. S. healthcare: EMR/EHR integrations (eClinicalWorks, Epic, Athena), HL7/FHIR, claims and billing workflows, payer quality metrics (HEDIS). 
 - Familiarity with rules engines and clinical ontologies (SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10, CPT). 
 - Experience in regulated domains (healthcare, fintech, banking) with HIPAA- or SOC 2-grade security, including on-prem enterprise deployments. 
 - Experience managing onshore/offshore teams across U. S. and India time zones. 

Personal traits

- Pragmatic builder: prefers working prototypes and fast iteration over theory. 
 - Comfortable with trade-offs: speed vs compliance, MVP vs scale. 
 - Culturally fluent: can lead distributed teams of U. S. physicians, India engineers and U. S. payers. 
 - Founder mindset: takes full ownership of outcomes, not only of engineering. 

How to apply for this opportunity?

- Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal. 
 - Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
 - Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

About Uplers: 

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement. 

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well). 

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

THE ROLE: 

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead System Validation for BIOS, Firmware and Driver validation activities across our embedded product portfolio. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership, drive validation coverage, strengthen test planning and execution discipline, and ensure timely visibility to critical issues, risks and customer-impacting defects. The leader will work closely with development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer-facing teams to ensure validation readiness, reduce test escapes and improve engineering effectiveness through scale and AI-driven initiatives. 

THE PERSON

- A strong technical validation leader with deep understanding of system-level validation across BIOS, firmware, drivers and platform software stacks. 
 - Demonstrates ownership in defining validation coverage, test strategy, execution governance and defect triage for complex silicon and platform programs. 
 - Builds trusted networks across client and server ecosystems, development teams, silicon IP enablement teams and validation organizations to improve end-to-end product readiness. 
 - Balances technical depth with people leadership, helping the team grow in capability, execution maturity, collaboration and customer orientation. 
 - Brings a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive scale, automation, traceability and AI-enabled productivity across validation workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership for system validation activities covering BIOS, firmware and driver validation across assigned embedded programs. 
 - Define and drive the right validation coverage by partnering with architecture, development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer enablement teams. 
 - Own test management discipline including validation planning, test readiness, execution tracking, completion governance and timely reporting of progress, gaps and risks. 
 - Drive first-level triage for critical issues by ensuring structured debug data collection, clear ownership alignment, prioritization and timely handoff to the appropriate development teams. 
 - Establish strong collaboration forums with BIOS, firmware, driver, silicon IP, silicon validation and platform teams to close coverage gaps and improve defect discovery earlier in the lifecycle. 
 - Build and maintain technical connects in the client and server spaces from which the group leverages devices, ecosystems, validation methodologies and learnings. 
 - Reduce validation escapes through improved test strategy, coverage analysis, defect trend reviews, regression rigor and disciplined exit criteria. 
 - Support customer escalations and critical field issue triage as required, ensuring responsiveness, technical clarity and coordinated execution across engineering owners. 
 - Lead team development by coaching engineers and leads, improving technical depth, strengthening ownership behaviors and building succession for key validation areas. 
 - Drive scale initiatives across validation execution, including automation, reusable test assets, consistent dashboards, traceability from requirements to tests, and execution efficiency improvements. 
 - Champion AI initiatives that improve test planning, coverage mapping, traceability, execution tracking, defect analytics, reporting quality and validation productivity. 
 - Partner with program management and engineering leadership to provide accurate status, risk visibility, decision points and recovery plans for validation milestones. 

Preferred Experience

- 20+ years of industry experience with 8+ years of exposure with people management roles
 - Experience leading system validation, post-silicon validation, platform validation, BIOS validation, firmware validation or driver validation teams for complex silicon or platform products. 
 - Strong understanding of validation lifecycle, test plan development, coverage definition, test execution governance, defect management, regression strategy and exit criteria. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with BIOS, UEFI, firmware, drivers, platform initialization, silicon bring-up, debug flows and system-level validation environments. 
 - Experience collaborating with silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, platform, architecture and customer-facing teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead issue triage, drive technical discussions, identify ownership, escalate risks and close critical defects with urgency. 
 - Experience with customer escalations, field issue debug, escape analysis and corrective action planning. 
 - Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices. 
 - Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights. 
 - Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership. 

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline. 
 - Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.

You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. 

We are looking for software engineers to join the Arm Fast Models team responsible for building high-performance software models of Arm-based systems. These models enable early software development, architecture exploration, and system validation before silicon is available. Members of the modelling team transform hardware designs and specifications into high-performance software representations of hardware systems and components. 

In this role, you will develop functional models of CPUs, system IP, and complete Arm's reference platforms using C++ and SystemC, working closely with hardware and software teams across Arm. 

If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities Include

- Develop, test, and maintain high-performance functional models of Arm system-level IP using C++ and SystemC. 
 - Build virtual platforms representing complete Arm's reference platforms to enable early firmware, OS, and application development before silicon availability. 
 - Collaborate with hardware architects and RTL designers to understand IP specifications and ensure accurate behavioral modelling. 
 - Work with open-source and software engineering teams to enable software bring-up on virtual platforms and diagnose system-level issues. 
 - Integrate multiple IP models to create scalable system-level simulations. 
 - Participate in planning and execution of development roadmaps, working with project managers and global engineering teams. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Minimum 15-20 years of proven experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ programming skills with experience in developing large-scale software systems. 
 - Experience in SoC or IP modelling using C++, SystemC, or TLM. 
 - Good understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and SoC design concepts. 
 - Experience with software development practices including debugging, testing, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience using version control systems such as Git/Gerrit. 
 - Understanding of RISC-based architectures and familiarity with CPU instruction sets. 
 - Ability to work effectively independently and within distributed global teams. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Programmer's View (PV) modelling and SystemC TLM-2. 0 methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of Arm architecture or Arm system IP (CPU, interconnects, GIC, SMMU, etc. ). 
 - Experience building SoC virtual platforms or full-system simulators. 
 - Background in low-level software, firmware, bare-metal programming, or device drivers. 
 - Experience in supporting to large-scale multi-site software projects. 

Why Join Us

- Work on modern virtual platforms used across the Arm ecosystem. 
 - Experience with hardware validation labs and test farms. 
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers across global Arm teams. 
 - A clear path for career progression, with scope to evolve into technical leadership or management roles. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

Job Description

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our software engineering team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role. You'll spend roughly half your time writing and shipping production code - React, modern JavaScript- alongside the team. The other half is people, process, and direction: growing engineers, making architectural calls, and keeping delivery on track. 

You'll lead a team of Staff ReactJS/NodeJS Frontend Engineers, Senior Backend Engineers, and Senior Quality Engineers. We also expect you to be an active AI engineer - someone who uses tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot in daily work, not just someone who knows they exist. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Development: 
 - Lead, mentor, and coach a team of software engineers (Frontend, and Backend) to foster their professional growth, career development, and technical capabilities. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback to team members. 
 - Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-trust team environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Participate in the recruitment and hiring process to attract top engineering talent. 
 - Technical & Architectural Guidance: 
 - Make architectural decisions for both frontend (ReactJS, Node. js) and backend (Java, Node. js, distributed systems) components - and be the person the team comes to when those decisions get hard. 
 - Work closely with Staff Engineers to define technical roadmaps and resolve complex technical challenges. 
 - Guide the team on AI engineering practices: how to use agentic tools effectively, where they help and where they don't, and how to build systems that incorporate AI thoughtfully rather than just bolting it on. 
 - Build alongside the team, not above it. When the team is using Claude Code, Cursor, or other agentic tools to ship features, you're in there with them - pairing, reviewing AI-generated code critically, and raising the bar on what good looks like in an AI-assisted workflow. 
 - Hold the team to coding standards, quality metrics, and security practices across all deliverables. 
 - Stay current with the team's stack: ReactJS, Node. js, Java/Spring Boot, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Contribute directly to production features. About half your time is coding. 
 - Project Delivery & Execution: 
 - Oversee the end-to-end delivery of features and projects, from planning and estimation to execution, testing, and deployment. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate product requirements into actionable engineering plans. 
 - Ensure efficient execution of Agile/Scrum processes, managing project risks and dependencies effectively. 
 - Champion a strong quality mindset within the team, working closely with the Senior Quality Engineer to establish robust testing strategies and automation. 
 - Strategic Planning & Vision: 
 - Contribute to the broader engineering strategy and technical vision for the organization. 
 - Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in web development, distributed systems, and quality assurance. 
 - Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and innovation within the team's operations. 
 - Communication & Collaboration: 
 - Serve as a key liaison between the engineering team and other departments, effectively communicating progress, challenges, and technical insights. 
 - Drive cross-team collaboration and knowledge sharing to ensure alignment and leverage expertise across the organization. 
Required Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, including at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role. 
 - Technical Acumen: Strong foundational knowledge and practical experience in modern web development technologies, including: 
 - Frontend: Deep understanding of ReactJS, modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and related state management libraries. 
 - Backend: Expertise in building scalable distributed systems using Java/J2EE (Spring Boot preferred) and/or Node. js. 
 - Databases: Experience with relational (e. g. , Oracle) and NoSQL databases (e. g. , MongoDB, Cassandra). 
 - APIs: Proficiency with RESTful and/or GraphQL API design and consumption. 
 - Quality Assurance Mindset: A strong understanding of software quality principles, test automation strategies (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress), and CI/CD pipelines, with a commitment to delivering high-quality software. 
 - System Design: Experience in designing and architecting highly scalable, performant, and resilient web applications and services. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Agile Methodologies: Demonstrated experience leading teams in an Agile/Scrum environment. 
 - Leadership & Mentorship: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow engineering teams. Strong communication skills, written and verbal. 
 - Problem Solving: Strong analytical and decision-making ability in complex technical and organizational situations. 
 - AI Engineering: Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in real production work. You should have opinions on how these tools change the way code gets written and reviewed - not just awareness that they exist. 
 - Hands-on React and JavaScript: You must be comfortable shipping React and modern JavaScript to production. This is not a role where frontend experience is optional. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a high-growth or startup environment. 
 - Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures. 
 - Knowledge of performance optimization for large-scale web applications. 
 - Experience with spec-driven development frameworks such as GitHub SpecKit, SuperPower, GSD, or similar. We use these workflows to keep AI-assisted development structured and reviewable. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

The Senior Control & Protection System Engineering Manager leads engineering teams responsible for the design, integration, analysis, and testing of HVDC Control & Protection systems. The role spans the full engineering lifecycle-from conceptual design and modelling through simulation, validation, implementation, and commissioning-ensuring the delivery of high-quality technical solutions across multiple projects. 

This position requires deep expertise in HVDC Control & Protection systems, proven leadership, and the ability to drive engineering strategy, process improvement, and consistent technical quality across multi-disciplinary, international teams. A key focus is building organisational capability, strengthening engineering processes, and unifying engineering centres worldwide around common standards and best practices. Success depends on proactive communication, strong collaboration, and fostering a global "one-team" culture. 

Key responsibilities include leadership development, engineering governance, technical oversight, lessons-learned implementation, and adherence to Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles. 

Job Description

 - Manage engineering resources, workloads, schedules, and project milestones. 
 - Define project work breakdown structures (WBS), required resources, and skill sets to ensure timely delivery. 
 - Uphold and promote Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles across teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC Control &Protection System Engineering.

data.title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
data.description:
What do we do?

Introducing Thinkproject Platform

Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies. 

By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem. 

What your day will look like

About The Role

We are looking for two Cloud Application Modernisation & Agentic Architects (f/m/d) to own the end-to-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio - 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6-8 months. 

This is not a design-and-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP & Network Agentic Architect - and turn them into modernised, cloud-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run. 

Time allocation (approximate): 

~50% hands-on application refactoring & migration | ~25% project management, planning & stakeholder coordination | ~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance & SRE | ~10% observability, testing & validation

Key Responsibilities

Application Refactoring & Modernisation

- Own the end-to-end refactoring of your assigned applications - from assessment and design through implementation and validation
 - Apply 12-factor app principles, event-driven architecture patterns, and cloud-native design to legacy codebases
 - Migrate workloads from on-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
 - Design for scalability and on-demand resource consumption - cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
 - Use LLM-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation

Project Management & Delivery

- Own the migration plan for your applications: timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
 - Track and report progress with precision - this is a time-boxed programme (6-8 months); delays must be surfaced early
 - Split application ownership with your paired architect: clear DRI per application, shared standards

Resilience & Rollback

- Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins - you have crisis experience and you use it
 - Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
 - Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover

Collaboration

- Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
 - Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
 - Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post-migration
 - Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog - you are one of its primary consumers

What you need to fulfill the role

Required Skills & Qualifications

You have migrated complex, production applications from on-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically: 

- Proven on-prem to cloud migration experience - at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
 - Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform - networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
 - Deep hands-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
 - Strong 12-factor app knowledge - you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
 - Strong event-driven architecture experience - Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
 - Crisis and rollback experience - you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post-mortems
 - Proven focus on scalability and on-demand resource design - your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
 - Proven hands-on agentic experience: must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity - 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)

- Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
 - FinOps awareness - cost attribution and rightsizing post-migration
 - Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
 - Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme

Soft Skills

- Extreme ownership - you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
 - Strong project management discipline: you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
 - Collaborative by default - you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
 - Crisis-calm: you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
 - Intense technical curiosity - you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
 - Fact-driven communicator: you report progress with data, not narrative

What Success Looks Like

- Month 2: Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
 - Month 4: First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major + 2 add-on) - observable, scalable, cost-attributed
 - Month 6: 7-8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
 - Month 8: All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application

Success is defined as: more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost - across all 10 applications. 

You're probably NOT a fit if

- You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
 - You need a stable architecture foundation before you start - legacy migration means working with what exists
 - You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
 - You treat project management as someone else's job
 - You have not handled a production rollback under pressure

What we offer

- Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
 - Hybrid-first working
 - Continuous learning & certification budget 
 - Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
 - Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership - not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia. data.title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
data.description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends. 

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used. 

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones. 

About Sarvam

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people. 

What this role promises you

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack. 

What you'll do

- Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail. 
 - Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents. 
 - Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from. 
 - Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily. 
 - Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time. 
 - Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves. 
 - Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer. 
 - Write design docs and keep decisions documented. 

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres. 

Who you are

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience. 

- You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke. 
 - You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day. 
 - You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL. 
 - You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover. 
 - You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back. 
 - You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't. 
 - You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it. 

Bonus points

- Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction. 
 - Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications. 
 - Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction. 
 - Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems. 
 - Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production. 
 - On-prem or air-gapped deployments. 
 - Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

Location: India

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer Specialist to help build and evolve the cloud foundation services that power Esko's SaaS products. 

This is a hands-on technical role focused on turning architectural direction into robust, production-ready platform capabilities. You will partner closely with Architects, bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions while owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, and operational readiness of complex cloud services. 

You will work on shared platform capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational services used across multiple Esko products. You will remain deeply hands-on while mentoring engineers, solving complex technical problems, and raising engineering standards across the team. 

What You Will Do

 - Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code quality, design practices, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, reviews, and technical guidance.

 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks.

 - Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify implementation trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive technical feedback during design discussions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization

# Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer

 - Work Mode: ** Work From Office (WFO)(890)

 - Notice Period: ** Immediate to 45 Days

## Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability. 

This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality. 

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration

- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies. 
 - Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic. 
 - Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle

 - Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles. 
 - Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs. 

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing

- Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications. 
 - Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.

 - Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers. 

### 4. Azure AI Stack

- Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads. 
 - Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations

 - Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control

 - Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks. 
 - Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues. 

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability

- Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms. 
 - Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements. 
 - Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency. 

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security

- Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads.

 - Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls. 

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.

 - Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams.

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software, and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Validation leadership team, the Principal Execution and Quality Validation Engineer will be responsible for driving validation execution, automation, product quality, and release readiness across Graphcore silicon and platform technologies. 

The role combines deep expertise in hardware validation, test automation, and quality engineering with a strong focus on execution excellence. Working closely with architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, systems engineering, and validation teams, the successful candidate will develop scalable validation methodologies, improve test coverage and execution efficiency, and ensure products meet the highest standards of functionality, reliability, and performance before customer deployment. 

As a recognized technical leader within the validation organisation, this role will influence validation strategies, automation roadmaps, and quality practices across multiple projects and engineering disciplines.

The Validation Execution and Quality team sits within the Validation organisation and is responsible for improving validation effectiveness, test execution efficiency, product quality, and release readiness across Graphcore silicon and platform products. 

The team develops validation methodologies, automation frameworks, test execution infrastructure, and quality processes that enable engineering teams to execute validation activities at scale. Working closely with validation, architecture, firmware, software, systems, and design teams, the group helps ensure products are thoroughly validated before release.

 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve validation quality, execution efficiency, and engineering productivity

Candidate Profile

 - Clear written and verbal communication
 - Degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have~ automation exposure, multi-state US payroll tax, open enrollment, HRIS or HCM platforms. The schedule~ 8~00 AM - 5~00 PM EST (Eastern Time), Monday to Friday. First four hours from our Noida office, the rest from home. Mornings and afternoons are yours. Competitive compensation, health coverage, learning support. Apply now.

Job Description

About the team: 

We have Scripting Team in India, based in Gurgaon. This hub is part of our global Operations team, reporting into Operations Director based in the UK office. By integrating complex logic, customized routing, and validation checks, the team will ensure high-quality, error-free data. Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.

The role will involve help with setting up the scripting function, working with Research and Project Management stakeholders to define the best practice and establish processes for scripting and data processing within the business, as well as managing actual scripting. - Initial set up of the scripting and data processing function, working with a variety of senior stakeholders to understand requirements and suggest improvements. 
 - Implementation of new processes and policies, including preparing "the best practice" manuals and guides for Research and Project Management staff globally. 
 - Supporting a transition from an outsourced model to a blended in-house approach. 
 - Line management of Scripting Executives, including training, mentoring and involvement in recruitment and selection. 
 - Scripting and programming medium complexity online surveys using the Confirmit platform, incorporating logic, custom routing, and question validation to ensure seamless user experience and data accuracy
 - Conducting rigorous testing of surveys before launch, identifying and resolving any programming or logic errors to ensure data integrity and smooth respondent experience
 - Cleansing and validating data in the relevant software (SPSS or similar) and process survey data for tabulation
 - Managing workloads of the team and delivery across projects
 - Liaising with internal clients, advising on best practice, and assisting with problem solving

About You. . . 

Your skills and experience: 

- More than 6 years of experience in a scripting role within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)

 - Solid understanding of scripting languages such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for customizing survey functionality and layout
 - Experience working with survey data formats (e. g. , XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management. 
 - Understanding of quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices. 
 - Demonstrable experience of working with senior and junior team members
 - Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
 - Excellent analytical and numerical skills
 - Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment

Ideal profile: 

- You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a 'can do' attitude and approach
 - You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
 - You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
 - You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion

data.title: Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Experience: 5-10 years

Location: Gurugram, Haryana

Position Type: Full time

Team: Platform Engineering

5 Days work from office mandate. 

About SCIKIQ

SCIKIQ is an AI-native data operating platform that turns scattered enterprise data into a clean, governed, AI-ready foundation. Built on a Connect-Curate-Control-Consume methodology, our Data Hub connects data across systems, applies governance and quality by default, and activates it through capabilities like Natural Language Query (NLQ), AI agents, and reusable data products - deployed inside the customer's own AWS, Azure, or on-prem environment. 

We work with enterprises across BFSI, aviation, retail, telecom, and healthcare, and we're scaling across India, the UK, the UAE, and the US. You'll be joining a small, high-ownership engineering team building the core of how enterprises become AI-ready. 

Role Overview

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer to own features end to end across our platform - from database and API design through to the interfaces our enterprise users rely on. You'll build and integrate frontend and backend components, extend our microservices architecture, and increasingly work alongside agentic AI workflows that power automated insight generation across the product. This is a builder's role. You'll ship features that touch real customer data at scale, make architectural calls, and see your work run in production quickly. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and ship features across the full stack - data models, backend services, APIs, and frontend UI. 
 - Develop and maintain microservices that are reliable, observable, and independently deployable. 
 - Design and consume RESTful APIs, and integrate third-party and internal services cleanly. 
 - Build responsive, intuitive frontends using HTML, Javascript & JQUery. 
 - Integrate LLM and AI/ML services into production workflows, and help build agentic pipelines that automate insight generation. 
 - Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines; containerize and deploy services on AWS/Azure. 
 - Own the reliability of what you ship - monitoring, debugging, performance tuning, and production support. 
 - Collaborate with product, data, and AI teams to translate requirements into well architected solutions. 

Required Skills

Backend

- Strong backend development with Python and Django and/or FastAPI. 
 - Hands-on with Pandas, NumPy, and Polars for data processing. 
 - Designing and consuming RESTful APIs. 
 - Solid SQL and relational database design skills. 

Frontend

- Strong hands-on experience Javascript, HTML, JQuery. 

Platform & DevOps

- Containerization with Docker and deployment on AWS or Azure. 
 - Building and operating microservices. 
 - Setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. 

Preferred / Bonus Skills

- Hands-on exposure to agentic AI frameworks - LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI. 
 - Experience integrating LLM and AI/ML services into production applications. 
 - Familiarity with data platforms, data governance, or metadata/knowledge-graph concepts. 
 - Experience with async processing, message queues, or event-driven architecture. 

What We're Looking For

- 5-7 years building and shipping production software across the stack. 
 - Strong ownership - you can take a feature from ambiguity to a deployed, monitored, well-tested result. 
 - Comfortable making pragmatic architectural trade-offs in a fast-moving environment. 
 - Clear communicator who works well across product, data, and AI teams. 
 - Genuine curiosity about AI-native development and how agentic workflows change how software is built. 

Why Join SCIKIQ

- Work at the intersection of enterprise data and applied AI, on a platform used by global enterprises. 
 - High autonomy and real ownership - your decisions ship and your impact is visible. 
 - Build with a modern stack and hands-on exposure to production agentic AI. 
 - Join early enough to shape architecture, practices, and culture as we scale internationally.

data.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager - Quality (ADLEC) will play a pivotal role in controlling and supervising quality assurance processes, working closely with process owners to enhance efficiency and product quality. This role is integral to the company's commitment to delivering high-quality electrical and digital systems, and the successful candidate will have a direct impact on the company's reputation and customer satisfaction. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build effective quality processes within the organization and work with all process owners to remove bottlenecks. 
 - Understand test methods and the operation of testing equipment. 
 - Conduct product and process audits and plan daily inspection activities to thoroughly inspect final products and components. 
 - Ensure effective quality-checking activities to prevent errors in subsequent processes. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for product quality issues and present findings to senior management. 
 - Conduct stage-wise verification to check compliance with stated requirements and analyze stage-wise rejection to control CONQ and first-hand rejections. 
 - Provide quick and effective solutions to quality issues. 
 - Manage field returns and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Ensure timely analysis and resolution of customer complaints. 
 - Carry out calibration activities and ensure all instruments are calibrated on time. 
 - Track quality measures and achieve targets for first-hand rejections, cost of non-quality, customer returns index, instrument calibration, and other relevant measures. 
 - Conduct monthly SGIA audits and work toward achieving productivity targets. 
 - Support Production and other teams on a daily basis to ensure product quality. 
 - Train, develop, and coach team members, keeping them updated on the latest developments in the QA field. 
 - Handle customers during product inspections, compliance follow-ups, and factory assessments/evaluations. 
 - Prepare Manufacturing Control Plans. 
 - Demonstrate good communication skills and coordinate/collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Maintain good knowledge of electrical switchgear/switchboards and applicable IS/IEC standards.

Understanding of product standards

Knowledge of manufacturing processes

Awareness of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, TQM, etc. 

Planning and organizing skills

Product qualification, PPAP, and PFMEA tools

Qualifications, Role-specific Knowledge And Experience

Diploma/BE/B. Tech, preferably in Electrical Engineering. 

7+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry. 

At least 2-3 years of experience in process, product, and quality system audits. 

Quality certifications such as ISO, TQM, Six Sigma, etc.

Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), ERP systems, and technical tools such as SPC, SOC, and other quality tools. 

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
