data.description:
About Chubb

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40, 000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www. chubb. com. 

About Chubb India

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow. 

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. 

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning. 

Position Details

Job Title: Engineering Manager - Digital Enablement & Lifecycle Services

Function / Department: Technology

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore

Reports To: Head of Engineering NA - CECI

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who leads the Digital Enablement pillar - the engineering foundation that powers automation, process transformation, integration services, and lifecycle management across Chubb's technology estate. You will build and lead teams that make digital transformation real: replacing manual processes with intelligent, automated workflows; enabling seamless service integration across complex systems; and ensuring the engineering delivery lifecycle is fast, reliable, and AI-augmented. Candidates from hi-tech product companies, BFSI, or enterprise software backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a team of engineers building digital enablement platforms, automation services, and lifecycle management capabilities. 
 - Own the engineering roadmap for process automation, workflow orchestration, and digital transformation programmes within the NA CI estate. 
 - Drive AI-native engineering across the full SDLC - from requirements parsing and intelligent code generation to automated testing, deployment observability, and agentic automation. 
 - Deliver scalable integration and automation services connecting core insurance systems, third-party platforms, and digital channels. 
 - Partner with architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate transformation objectives into engineering outcomes with measurable business impact. 
 - Embed DevSecOps standards as default practice: CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, infrastructure-as-code, and automated release management. 
 - Own sprint quality, release cadence, and technical debt trade-offs across the digital enablement portfolio. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging AI engineering tools - coding assistants, intelligent test generation, agentic workflow frameworks - and embed them into team practice. 
 - Build and sustain a high-performance engineering team culture: psychological safety, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Hire, onboard, and develop engineering talent; contribute to the Chubb India Digital engineering brand. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong engineering background in Java, . NET, or equivalent enterprise stacks; comfortable reading and reviewing code across the stack. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering digital transformation, process automation, or workflow orchestration platforms in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Hands-on AI tool adoption: GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow tools embedded into team practice - not experimented with. 
 - Cloud-native development expertise (Azure or AWS): microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, and containerization. 
 - Experience from hi-tech product companies, BFSI, or enterprise software environments with delivery at meaningful scale. 
 - 3+ years of engineering leadership experience in agile, high-velocity delivery environments. 
 - Exposure to integration platforms (MuleSoft, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent) and enterprise automation frameworks is a strong advantage. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - 18+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years leading engineering teams. 
 - Strong AI-native SDLC practice and digital transformation delivery track record. 

Why Join Us?

- Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry. 
 - Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes. 
 - Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment. 

Why Chubb?

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results. 

- Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
 - A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
 - Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
 - Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
 - Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

Employee Benefits

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include: 

- Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
 - Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs. 
 - Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees' well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits. 

Application Process

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive. 

- Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal. 
 - Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion. 
 - Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable). 
 - Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership. 

Join Us

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India's journey. 

Apply Now: Search Jobs - Chubb Careers

data.description:
Apollo. io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500, 000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1. 6 billion. Apollo. io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo. io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. 

Your Role & Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast-growing company, working on a cross-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an AI-native role. We're not looking for someone who also uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks with it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone. 

You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas. 

Daily Adventures & Responsibilities

- Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
 - Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
 - Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
 - Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
 - Scope and reshape under-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
 - Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
 - Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up-level the team
 - Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
 - Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
 - Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team. 

What We're Looking For

- AI-native engineers. You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast-moving toolset. 
 - Comfort in unfamiliar code. You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de-risk changes rather than hoping they work. 
 - Architectural ownership & operational readiness. You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start. 
 - Ownership start to finish. Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
 - Collaboration you can trust. You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with. 
 - Product judgment. You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec. 
 - Growth & learning. You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work. 
 - Proactivity. You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You can operate without a fully-specified problem and bring structure to it. 
 - Organization & planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver. 
 - Strong communication. Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

- Minimum 8+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3-4 years in senior positions, building large-scale applications with right observability. 
 - Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
 - Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
 - Experience developing distributed web applications
 - Write code that is comprehensible, well-structured, and highly performant
 - Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
 - Experience using and designing RESTful services

Must have: Curiosity, AI-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving. 

Nice to have: BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning

Apollo. io Tech Blog: deep dives into engineering, product design, and company-culture stories from the Apollo team - behind-the-scenes insight into how Apollo builds and scales its B2B sales platform. 

We are AI Native

Apollo. io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We're on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers-and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here. 

Why You'll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we're driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That's why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead. 

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core-we're all for one, meaning you'll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins. 

If you're looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive-Apollo is the place for you. 

Learn more here!

Job Description

Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. 

We are currently seeking a Lead Engineer - Quality Control, to join ourQuality team based in Dahej, Gujarat. 

About us: 

Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. 

Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17, 000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. 

About the opportunity we offer: 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage all day-to-day Quality Control (QC) inspection activities on the shop floor for assigned projects. This role ensures execution of Inspection and Test Plans (ITP) and Quality Control Plans (QCP), manages coordination with Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies and Authorized Inspectors (AI), tracks daily inspection workloads, and guarantees that high-quality inspections and on-time documentation are consistently achieved. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Shop Floor Inspection & Quality of Inspection

- Look after and supervise all daily inspection activities on the shop floor across fabrication, welding, assembly, Surface treatment and testing for assigned projects. 
 - Ensure the highest quality of inspection is maintained by QC Engineers, preventing any defective or non-compliant products from passing to the next manufacturing stage. 
 - Conduct random surveillance checks on the shop floor to ensure strict compliance with approved drawings, welding procedures, and quality standards

Traveller, ITP & QCP Management

- Ensure precise physical execution of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) and Quality Control Plan (QCP) for all assigned project modules. 
 - Routinely update, sign off, and manage manufacturing Travellers (routing cards) in real-time as physical inspection stages are cleared to ensure seamless production flow. 

TPI & AI Coordination (Customer & Third-Party Management)

- Plan, coordinate, and manage customer visits and client audits, ensuring readiness of facilities, documentation, inspection activities, and relevant departments, while facilitating timely closure of observations and audit findings. 
 - Act as the primary shop-floor point of contact and coordinator for Client Representatives, Third-Party Inspection (TPI) agencies, and ASME Authorized Inspectors (AI). 
 - Schedule and coordinate witness, hold, and review points efficiently to ensure external inspectors are present without causing production bottlenecks or unnecessary downtime. 

NCR Management & RCA Participation

- Identify process or product deviations, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and halt non-compliant processes immediately. 
 - Manage the shop-floor NCR log, track the physical execution of approved rework/repair instructions, and ensure dimensional/welding corrections are verified. 
 - Actively participate in cross-functional Root Cause Analysis (RCA) meetings with Production, Engineering, and Head QC to investigate recurring defects and implement preventive measures. 

Inspection Load Tracking & Transaction

- Monitor, track, and manage the daily inspection load and inspection call transactions requested by the production department. 
 - Dynamically allocate QC Engineers and inspectors to various workstations or modules to balance workloads, eliminate inspection delays, and meet tight dispatch schedules. 

On-Time Documentation & Record Keeping

- Ensure all stage-wise inspection reports, dimension check sheets, NDE clearance reports, painting inspection reports and visual weld reports are accurately generated and signed concurrently with the physical inspection. 
 - Maintain strict discipline regarding on-time documentation to ensure there are no delays during the final Manufacturing Data Record (MDR) compilation and product dispatch. 

Starting Date: October 2026

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Qualification: -

Diploma / bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Production, or Metallurgy preferred). 

Experience: -

- Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in shop-floor quality control, inspection, and testing within heavy engineering, fabrication, or process equipment manufacturing environments. 
 - Minimum 3+ years in a lead, supervisory, or Project Quality Management (PQM) role. 
 - Relevant certifications such as ASNT NDE Level II, AWS-CWI, or CSWIP 3. 1 are highly preferred. 

Skills require: - (IT, Communication etc)

- Expertise in reading and executing ITPs, QCPs, and manufacturing Travellers. 
 - Strong coordination and negotiation skills for TPI (Third-Party Inspection) and AI (Authorized Inspector) management. 
 - NCR lifecycle management and participation in RCA (Root Cause Analysis). 
 - Manpower planning and inspection load tracking/transaction management. 
 - Excellent time-management skills for ensuring on-time documentation. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and online systems for tracking shop-floor data. 
 - Assertive communication and shop-floor conflict resolution. 

Your career with us: 

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development

What's next?

Once receiving your application, our Talent Acquisition professionals will screen and match your profile against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. 

We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube for company updates.

data.title: Senior DDR & Execution Validation Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the Memory Validation leadership team, the Senior Silicon DDR/HBM Validation Engineer will be responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of advanced memory subsystems used in next-generation AI compute platforms. 

The role will focus on DDR and HBM technologies, working closely with silicon design, firmware, characterization, platform and systems teams to ensure robust memory subsystem functionality, performance and reliability. The successful candidate will take ownership of significant validation activities, contribute to debug and root-cause analysis efforts, and help improve validation methodologies, automation and infrastructure. 

The Team

The Memory Validation team sits within the Validation organisation and is responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of memory subsystems across Graphcore silicon and platform products. 

The team supports DDR and HBM validation activities throughout the product lifecycle, from first silicon through production readiness. Engineers work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, characterization, systems and platform teams to ensure memory technologies meet functionality, performance, reliability and performance objectives. 

Responsibilities And Duties

- Execute validation and bring-up activities for DDR and HBM memory subsystems 
 - Verify memory bring-up software, firmware and scripts against defined project requirements 
 - Debug firmware, hardware and system-level issues and contribute to root-cause analysis activities 
 - Analyse system logs, validation data and characterization results to identify failures and performance issues 
 - Perform PHY characterization and analog-level analysis during stress testing and validation activities 
 - Develop and execute functional, stress, performance and corner-case validation tests 
 - Perform signal integrity, voltage, frequency and timing measurements using laboratory instrumentation 
 - Characterize memory bandwidth, latency, training behaviour and subsystem stability across operating conditions 
 - Develop Python-based automation, test infrastructure and reporting tools to improve validation efficiency 
 - Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware and platform teams to investigate and resolve technical issues 
 - Contribute to memory subsystem debug activities spanning silicon, firmware, board and system domains 
 - Support development of validation methodologies, debug procedures and reporting frameworks 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of validation infrastructure and engineering processes 
 - Support silicon characterization, production readiness and qualification activities 
 - Document validation results and communicate findings to the wider engineering team

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience validating DDR, LPDDR, HBM or related DRAM technologies 
 - Deep understanding of DRAM architecture, memory subsystem operation and memory controller functionality 
 - Experience with firmware, BIOS and Embedded C development 
 - Strong programming skills in C and Python 
 - Hands-on experience using laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes and related measurement instrumentation 
 - Experience interfacing with low-speed peripherals including GPIO, SPI, I2C and UART/serial interfaces 
 - Experience performing functional testing and signal measurements including voltage, frequency and timing analysis 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems and microcontroller-based platforms 
 - Hands-on experience with board bring-up and hardware validation activities 
 - Experience debugging complex hardware, firmware and system-level issues 
 - Experience performing silicon characterization and analysing validation results 
 - Strong analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams

Desirable

- Experience with memory IP bring-up environments, firmware or validation software 
 - Experience with DDR or HBM PHY behaviour, memory controller architectures, training algorithms and calibration flows 
 - Knowledge of memory subsystem performance analysis and workload characterization 
 - Experience with memory margining, stress testing and reliability validation 
 - Familiarity with JTAG, trace infrastructure and low-level debug tools 
 - Experience with high-performance compute, AI accelerator or data center systems 
 - Understanding of signal integrity and power integrity considerations in high-speed memory systems 
 - Experience developing validation automation frameworks and regression environments 
 - Experience supporting first-silicon bring-up and production readiness activities

data.title: Quality Analyst – US Healthcare Credentialing & Provider Enrollment
data.description:
We're Hiring: Quality Analyst - Credentialing & Provider Enrollment

Company: Healthcare

Job Type: Full-Time

Work Mode: Remote / Work From Home

Experience Required: Minimum 5 Years

Working Hours: 9: 00 AM - 6: 00 PM EST, Monday-Friday

A US Healthcare company provides healthcare credentialing, provider enrollment, revenue cycle management, and related operational support services to healthcare providers and medical practices across the United States. 

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Quality Analyst - Credentialing & Provider Enrollment to ensure accuracy, compliance, consistency, and operational excellence across our credentialing and enrollment processes. 

The ideal candidate will have at least five years of hands-on experience in US healthcare credentialing and provider enrollment, with a strong understanding of payer requirements, application submission workflows, quality audits, and error prevention. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Audits & Process Reviews

- Conduct quality audits of provider credentialing and enrollment applications before submission and at relevant stages of processing. 
 - Review applications for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with payer-specific requirements. 
 - Audit provider demographics, licenses, certifications, NPI details, taxonomy codes, practice locations, ownership information, and supporting documentation. 
 - Identify errors, omissions, discrepancies, and potential compliance risks before they affect submissions or client accounts. 
 - Ensure applications and supporting documents meet internal quality standards and applicable payer requirements. 

2. Credentialing & Provider Enrollment Quality Control

- Review applications and enrollment activities related to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers. 
 - Validate information entered into CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and applicable payer portals. 
 - Verify the accuracy of provider and group enrollment information, re-credentialing submissions, demographic updates, and other enrollment-related transactions. 
 - Review payer follow-ups, application status updates, approval documentation, and effective-date information for accuracy. 
 - Ensure quality standards are consistently followed throughout the onboarding and application filing processes. 

3. Error Identification & Corrective Action

- Document audit findings and communicate errors to the responsible onboarding specialists and application filers. 
 - Provide clear, actionable feedback and coordinate corrective actions to prevent recurring errors. 
 - Identify root causes of quality issues and recommend improvements to workflows, checklists, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
 - Escalate critical errors, recurring quality concerns, and potential compliance issues to management. 

4. Quality Reporting & Performance Monitoring

- Maintain accurate audit records, quality scorecards, error logs, and corrective-action trackers. 
 - Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports for management. 
 - Track quality metrics, including audit scores, error rates, application accuracy, rework, and recurring deficiencies. 
 - Analyze trends and recommend practical measures to improve team performance and reduce avoidable rework. 

5. Training & Continuous Improvement

- Work with operations leadership to improve credentialing and provider enrollment processes. 
 - Provide coaching and process feedback to team members based on audit results. 
 - Assist in updating quality checklists, SOPs, and internal training materials. 
 - Support the implementation of standardized quality controls across onboarding and application filing teams. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in US healthcare credentialing and provider enrollment. 
 - Strong knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer enrollment processes. 
 - Practical experience with CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and payer-specific portals. 
 - Proven experience conducting quality audits, reviewing applications, identifying errors, and documenting findings. 
 - Strong understanding of provider demographics, NPI Type 1 and Type 2, taxonomy codes, licensing, certifications, practice locations, and enrollment documentation. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies before application submission. 
 - Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and other standard reporting tools. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage audit workloads, and meet deadlines in a remote work environment. 

Work-From-Home Requirements

Candidates must meet the following technical and work-environment requirements: 

- Must have their own Windows 11 laptop or computer suitable for professional work. 
 - Must have a reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps. 
 - Must have a stable work-from-home setup with minimal background noise and interruptions. 
 - Must be comfortable working with online portals, cloud-based systems, spreadsheets, and remote communication tools. 
 - Must maintain the confidentiality and security of provider information and company data. 
 - Must be available to work 9: 00 AM to 6: 00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST), Monday through Friday. 

Please note: The working hours follow US Eastern Time and may shift by one hour during daylight saving time, depending on the company's scheduling policy. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on: 

- Accuracy and consistency of quality audits. 
 - Timely completion of assigned audits. 
 - Identification and prevention of application errors. 
 - Reduction in repeat errors and avoidable rework. 
 - Quality of audit documentation and reporting. 
 - Effectiveness of corrective feedback and process improvement recommendations. 
 - Adherence to internal SOPs, confidentiality standards, and quality requirements. 

What We Offer

- A full-time remote working opportunity. 
 - The opportunity to contribute to the quality and efficiency of US healthcare operations. 
 - A professional environment focused on accountability, process improvement, and operational excellence. 
 - The opportunity to work closely with credentialing, provider enrollment, and operations leadership. 

How to Apply

If you have strong experience in US healthcare credentialing and provider enrollment, along with a passion for accuracy and process excellence, we invite you to apply. 

Please submit your updated resume through LinkedIn, highlighting your relevant experience in credentialing, provider enrollment, quality auditing, and payer portal workflows.

data.title: Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. 

Job Description

Job Summary

The Acceptance Solutions Product Development team are the engineers responsible for a portfolio of products that drive diversification of Visa revenue, differentiate our network, and deliver value-added solutions across other rails. This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility. 

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world's most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale. 

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale. 

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments. 

Essential Functions

- Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of secure, reliable, robust, and interoperable payment acceptance products. 
 - Provide engineering leadership to ensure solutions align with platform principles, architecture standards, and Visa-grade availability, resiliency, and operational excellence expectations. 
 - Remain actively hands-on with architecture, design reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concepts, performance analysis, debugging, technical troubleshooting, production-readiness, and critical delivery decisions on a day-to-day basis. 
 - Apply AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent engineering practices to improve software delivery, search relevance, analytics capabilities, operational insight, developer productivity, and business outcomes. 
 - Define and execute the technical strategy for payment processing and acceptance platforms in alignment with product vision, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Drive delivery of fit-for-purpose products and platform capabilities that improve time-to-market while maintaining security, quality, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases. 
 - Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users. 
 - Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives. 
 - Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement. 
 - Establish and continuously improve engineering best practices for application development, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness, strengthening reliability, performance, maintainability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Search and Analytics capabilities. 
 - Partner with application, data, platform, product, regional, business, client-facing, security, privacy, risk, governance, compliance, and operations teams to translate requirements into high-quality solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements (security, latency, availability, compliance, maintainability) and applicable policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments. 
 - Communicate and present technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, delivery progress, and recommendations clearly, adapting to audiences that include executive leaders, business partners, product partners, architecture forums, and engineering teams. 
 - Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, senior engineers, technical leads, and engineering leaders through regular feedback, design reviews, architecture discussions, hands-on problem solving, technical deep dives, brown bag sessions, tech talks, production troubleshooting, and career development conversations. 
 - Build and lead high-performing teams by promoting collaboration, constructive debate, accountability, inclusion, and execution excellence consistent with Visa Leadership Principles. 
 - Bring forward new ideas, engineering improvements, and technology recommendations that increase team effectiveness, improve developer productivity, and advance platform capabilities. 
 - Influence technical strategy across teams without relying on formal reporting authority, using strong engineering judgment, collaboration, credibility, and hands-on technical depth. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e. g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD. 
 - Demonstrated success leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and geographically distributed software engineering teams, including people management, coaching, performance development, delivery accountability, and hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent. 
 - Deep experience designing, building, and operating globally distributed, mission-critical systems that require high availability, scalability, resiliency, and security, and that support very high transaction volumes with strict availability, latency, security, and compliance requirements. 
 - Proven ability to solve complex technical and organizational problems across multiple domains, systems, and teams. 
 - Experience setting technical direction, influencing architecture and delivery strategy, and aligning engineering execution with product and business objectives. 
 - Strong proficiency in modern software engineering practices, programming languages, API design, system design, testing, deployment, and operational excellence, with a strong hands-on background in API-first software product development using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Vert. x, REST, Kafka, Hazelcast, Git, Maven, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation. 
 - Recent hands-on experience with architecture, design, coding practices, code reviews, debugging, production support, and technical decision-making in complex software systems. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, containerized deployment models, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture, streaming platforms such as Kafka, and high-throughput transaction or data processing systems, including resilient patterns such as event correlation, transaction matching, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, and exactly-once processing considerations. 
 - Experience delivering secure software platforms, including familiarity with authentication, authorization, encryption, identity, and secure engineering practices.

 - Experience applying AI-enabled engineering practices, automation, or developer productivity improvements across software delivery teams, and implementing, deploying, or governing AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI capabilities in production environments or engineering workflows. 
 - Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, or high-scale transaction processing environments, including payment processing, transaction lifecycle concepts, payment network protocols, and acceptance workflows. 
 - Experience partnering with executive leadership, product leaders, technical product managers, regional teams, and business stakeholders to define strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and delivery plans. 
 - Experience with financial services compliance, risk, and control requirements such as PCI-DSS, SOX, security standards, audit readiness, and operational controls.

 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to form, advocate, and communicate an independent technical viewpoint grounded in hands-on engineering experience.

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer – Block Storage
data.description:
Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer - Block Storage

About Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and the Block Storage Team

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers cloud services designed to help organizations run demanding enterprise and cloud-native workloads securely, reliably, and at scale. 

The OCI Block Storage team builds and operates highly available, durable, scalable storage services that support mission-critical workloads. The team works on complex engineering challenges across distributed systems, virtualized infrastructure, storage, networking, reliability, performance, security, and automation. 

As part of this team, you will work with experienced engineers to design and evolve core components of the Block Storage Service. You will operate across the technology stack-from low-level systems and data paths to large-scale distributed system architecture-while maintaining a strong focus on simplicity, scalability, operational excellence, and customer experience. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about solving complex engineering problems in distributed systems, virtualized infrastructure, and highly available storage services. 

In this hands-on technical role, you will lead the design and development of major components and features within the OCI Block Storage Service. You will architect scalable and elastic distributed systems, optimize critical code and data paths, and design systems that maintain correctness, durability, availability, and performance at hyperscale. 

You will also play an important role in operational excellence by improving observability, diagnosing complex production issues, strengthening security and compliance, driving automation, and mentoring other engineers. 

Success in this role requires strong programming fundamentals, deep distributed systems expertise, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to work effectively across both detailed implementation and broad system-level design. 

Key Responsibilities

Design and architect scalable distributed systems: Lead the design and implementation of major Block Storage components that support horizontal and vertical scaling, elasticity, distributed state management, and large-scale data processing. 

Drive performance and efficiency at scale: Optimize software, data paths, and system interactions for high-throughput, hyperscale workloads; establish scalability requirements and develop appropriate performance and load-testing strategies. 

Engineer highly reliable and durable services: Design fault-tolerant systems using redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automated failover while enabling in-service upgrades and minimizing customer-visible disruption. 

Design for distributed-systems failure modes: Develop systems that behave predictably during network partitions, infrastructure failures, and traffic spikes by applying appropriate consistency and availability models, load shedding, throttling, and rate limiting. 

Ensure correctness, availability, and observability: Define functional and correctness requirements, establish KPIs and telemetry, build dashboards and alerts, and create sophisticated validation strategies such as fault injection and brownout testing. 

Own operational excellence: Proactively diagnose, debug, and resolve complex production issues; participate in operational support rotations; conduct or guide root-cause investigations; and ensure systems meet operational-readiness standards. 

Strengthen security and compliance: Implement security controls for multi-tenant cloud environments, including encryption and access controls; remediate identified vulnerabilities and maintain infrastructure and supporting documentation in accordance with applicable requirements. 

Advance automation and engineering practices: Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC), tooling, and automated workflows for provisioning, patching, updating, deployment, and rollback while mentoring engineers and contributing to strong engineering practices across the team. 

Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory

10+ years of software engineering experience, including experience designing and delivering large-scale, highly available distributed systems or backend services. 

Strong hands-on programming experience developing production-quality software in Java, C++, or comparable systems/backend programming languages. 

Experience with scripting or automation languages such as Python. 

Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreading, and distributed systems fundamentals. 

Demonstrated experience designing systems for scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, durability, and performance. 

Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols, including TCP/IP, HTTP, and common network architectures. 

Strong production troubleshooting, debugging, performance analysis, and performance-tuning capabilities. 

Ability to independently own complex technical components while collaborating effectively in an agile engineering environment. 

Good-to-Have

Experience building or operating multi-tenant cloud infrastructure. 

Experience with virtualized storage infrastructure, block storage, storage systems, or data-management platforms. 

Experience designing replication, synchronization, consistency, and failover mechanisms in distributed systems. 

Experience with cloud service observability, including telemetry, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and SLO-based operations. 

Experience designing and executing fault-injection, brownout, resilience, performance, or large-scale load tests. 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated cloud infrastructure provisioning, deployment, patching, and rollback. 

Knowledge of cloud security practices, including encryption, access controls, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements. 

Experience participating in production support rotations, incident response, and root-cause analysis for large-scale services. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, influence technical direction, and contribute to architectural decisions across teams. 

Self-Assessment Questions

Before applying, consider the following: 

Have I spent significant time designing and delivering large-scale, highly available distributed systems or backend services in production environments?

Can I independently design a distributed-system component while reasoning about scalability, concurrency, fault tolerance, consistency, durability, availability, and performance trade-offs?

Do I have strong hands-on coding experience in Java, C++, or a comparable language, along with solid knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and multithreaded programming?

Can I diagnose complex production issues across software, networking, infrastructure, and distributed-system interactions and drive them through root-cause analysis and resolution?

Am I comfortable owning the full lifecycle of a critical service component-from architecture and implementation through testing, observability, security, deployment, and production operations?

data.description:

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we'll give you the opportunity to harness all that's within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we'll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you'll be supported in progressing - whatever your ambitions. 

About The Role

The Principal Cybersecurity Quality Engineer is a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert responsible for providing independent Quality oversight and technical leadership for product cybersecurity activities across the medical-device product lifecycle. This position partners with Quality, R&D, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Global Product Cybersecurity, Regulatory Affairs, Design Assurance, Post-Market Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity risks and deliverables are appropriately identified, assessed, controlled, verified, documented, and maintained. 

The role supports new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, third-party software and component assessments, vulnerability management, and post-market cybersecurity activities. The individual will also strengthen organizational cybersecurity capability by developing consistent approaches, reusable knowledge assets, and technical expertise within the Quality organization. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

- Serve as the Quality subject matter expert for product cybersecurity activities across new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, remediation, and integration programs. 
 - Provide independent Quality review and approval of cybersecurity plans, assessments, reports, and other lifecycle deliverables in accordance with applicable Quality System requirements. 
 - Review cybersecurity risk analyses, threat models, security architectures, attack-surface assessments, and risk-control strategies for completeness, consistency, technical adequacy, and traceability. 
 - Ensure cybersecurity risks, requirements, controls, and verification evidence are appropriately connected across design controls, software lifecycle documentation, system requirements, and product risk-management files. 
 - Review Software Bills of Materials, MDS2 documentation, cybersecurity reports, penetration-test results, static and dynamic analysis results, vulnerability assessments, and security verification evidence. 
 - Assess the cybersecurity quality impact of design changes, software changes, third-party software updates, operating-system changes, supplier changes, and other product lifecycle changes. 
 - Provide Quality oversight for cybersecurity verification and validation strategies, including acceptance criteria, test coverage, traceability, anomaly handling, and objective evidence. 
 - Support product vulnerability assessments and Post-Market Vulnerability Reviews, including evaluation of potential safety, quality, compliance, and product-security impacts. 
 - Support post-market cybersecurity investigations, remediation plans, corrective actions, and escalation activities, as applicable. 
 - Partner with Global Product Cybersecurity and project teams to interpret and consistently apply internal cybersecurity procedures, work instructions, standards, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Support cybersecurity content needed for regulatory submissions, notified-body reviews, internal audits, external inspections, and responses to regulatory questions. 
 - Identify Quality and compliance gaps, communicate risks clearly, and influence appropriate mitigation and escalation decisions. 
 - Lead complex cybersecurity quality initiatives that may span multiple projects, product families, divisions, or geographic locations. 
 - Develop and improve cybersecurity quality review methods, templates, checklists, playbooks, metrics, and reusable knowledge assets. 
 - Monitor cybersecurity quality trends and recommend process, training, governance, or capability improvements. 
 - Mentor engineers and cross-functional team members in cybersecurity risk management, design controls, documentation quality, and lifecycle expectations. 
 - Support development of independent cybersecurity subject matter experts and help establish a sustainable cybersecurity Quality capability. 
 - Represent Cybersecurity Quality in technical reviews, governance forums, communities of practice, and cross-functional decision-making bodies. 
 - Maintain current knowledge of evolving medical-device cybersecurity regulations, standards, guidance, technologies, threats, and industry practices. 
 - Perform other related duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Significant professional experience in cybersecurity, software quality, design assurance, product security, systems engineering, software engineering, or another relevant technical field. 
 - Experience working with software-enabled products in a regulated product-development environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity risk assessment, threat modelling, vulnerability evaluation, security requirements, or secure product-development practices. 
 - Working knowledge of software development lifecycle and design-control principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex technical documentation and determining whether evidence is complete, traceable, technically sound, and compliant. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical work independently and make risk-based recommendations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence decisions across functions and organizational levels without direct reporting authority. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex cybersecurity risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively within a global, cross-functional, and matrixed organization. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience in the medical-device, healthcare technology, pharmaceutical, aerospace, automotive, or another safety-critical regulated industry. 
 - Experience with medical-device cybersecurity, software quality assurance, design assurance, or product-security quality oversight. 
 - Knowledge of medical-device design controls, software lifecycle processes, and product risk management. 
 - Experience with threat modelling, security architecture review, vulnerability assessment, penetration-testing review, static application security testing, or dynamic application security testing.

Leadership And Expectations

Data Systems & Database Automation

Tooling, Applications & Workflow Integration

Additional Consideration

- Candidates with strong software, data, or automation backgrounds from non-semiconductor domains will be considered if they demonstrate the ability to learn complex engineering workflows quickly. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, yield, or product engineering environments. 
 - Experience working with engineering datasets such as test data, DFT outputs, manufacturing data, diagnostic data, or high-volume silicon or system telemetry. 
 - Familiarity with semiconductor data formats such as STDF, KLARF, wafer maps, lot history, test results, binning, dispositions, or assembly data.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Engineering Manager – Platform Engineering
data.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks. 

Position Summary

The Engineering Manager will lead the India engineering team building PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform. This is a hands-on role: you will balance day-to-day delivery and people management with real technical involvement - reviewing designs and code, and unblocking engineers - while working closely with the Lead Architect / Product Owner to turn technical designs and JIRA backlogs into shipped, quality-tested increments. You will also grow a high-performing engineering team. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead and grow a team of engineers delivering PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform
 - Own day-to-day engineering delivery: sprint planning, work breakdown, estimation, and tracking progress against roadmap commitments in partnership with the Product Owner and architecture team
 - Stay hands-on - review designs, participate in architecture discussions, read and review code, and unblock engineers on FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, and RKE2/OpenShift deployment issues
 - Translate technical design documents and JIRA stories into clear, sequenced execution plans for the India engineering team
 - Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers; run performance conversations, set growth plans, and build a strong engineering culture within the team
 - Coordinate closely with the external development vendor and internal architecture leadership to align delivery timelines, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain quality standards
 - Drive engineering best practices: code review discipline, CI/CD hygiene, test coverage, and consistent frontend routing and coding standards across the team
 - Partner with QA to plan release readiness, support UAT cycles, and ensure milestone sign-off criteria are met before delivery
 - Manage risk and dependency tracking across concurrent workstreams (Model Deployment, Observability & Metrics, Secrets Management, GPU Quota/Billing) and escalate blockers early
 - Contribute to technical decision-making on multi-tenant isolation, GPU resource quota enforcement, and identity/SSO federation as the platform evolves
 - Report on team velocity, delivery risk, and capacity to the Lead Architect / Product Owner and other stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

- Education: B. E / B. Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline
 - Experience: 10-15 years in software engineering, with at least 2-3 years in a engineering manager/ tech-lead capacity leading a team of 5-10 engineers
 - Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in at least one backend stack (Python/FastAPI or equivalent) and one frontend stack (React or equivalent), with the ability to review code and unblock engineers directly
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes-native application development and deployment (RKE2, OpenShift, or vanilla K8s)
 - Experience managing delivery for complex, multi-service platforms (preferably virtualisation and control planes)
 - Well versed with Agile methodology including sprint planning, estimation, prioritisation, governance and reporting
 - Proven experience hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, including performance management
 - Comfort working across India/US team structures and coordinating with external delivery vendors or partners
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical design detail and delivery status for architecture and product stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU-based infrastructure management and control platform, AI/ML inference platforms, or LLM serving stacks will be an solid added advantage
 - Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, RBAC models, and quota/billing systems will be an added advantage
 - Experience with PostgreSQL schema-per-service architectures and event-driven or workflow automation tools (e. g. , n8n) will be an added advantage
 - Exposure to Prometheus/Grafana-based observability stacks will be an added advantage
 - Prior experience managing or coordinating with offshore/nearshore development vendors will be an added advantage
 - Certifications such as CKA/CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes credentials are a plus

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you're passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

About our Team
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

Under consultative direction, you will be entrusted to determine and pursue courses of action essential to achieving our predetermined long-range targets. This is a hands-on, full-stack software engineering leadership role, not a DevOps or IT infrastructure position. We are seeking a master-level engineer who will personally research, architect, design, and write production-grade code for our most complex and real-time cloud solutions. You will also maintain the critical software for our products and systems, acting as a technical leader who builds and delivers enterprise-grade platforms from the ground up. A key aspect of your work will involve performing complex system integration of software and hardware to ensure program consistency and maintain system throughput. Beyond coding, you will develop, validate, and test system structures and user documentation to ensure we deliver robust, high-quality, and well-documented solutions. 

Candidates whose experience is primarily in DevOps, SRE, or cloud administration will not be considered for this position.

- Architects, designs, and oversees the development of cloud software solutions for highly complex technical projects, ensuring alignment with business and technical strategies and highly decoupled microservices optimized for distributed cloud environments. 
 - Creates detailed software specifications and leads the technology roadmap process, recommending project approaches and long-term goals
 - Champions innovation and cultivates creativity among team members, fostering an environment that attracts and retains top talent
 - Leads and advises on all aspects of the software development lifecycle, prioritizing quality and continuous improvement
 - Monitors competitor products and development strategies, ensuring the organization's designs exceed industry standards

Job Requirements

- Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
 - 10+ years of relevant full stack development experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
 - Expert hands-on experience in architecture, design, full-stack development, and coding is essential. Experience limited to DevOps will not qualify for this position. 

Key Skills And Competencies

- Expertise in software architecture, system design, and scalable software solutions for enterprise-level applications
 - In-depth knowledge of multiple programming languages, advanced software development methodologies, and adopting GenAI in the Software Development Lifecycle
 - Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive complex, high impact projects to completion
 - Strong strategic thinking skills, with a focus on long-term technical and business goals
 - Exceptional innovation and creativity in solving complex challenges and developing novel solutions
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop technical talent, fostering a culture of learning and growth
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience engaging with senior leadership and external customers
 - Familiarity with intellectual property protection, competitor analysis, and industry trends
 - Proven hands-on experience of 10+ years as a Cloud Solutions Engineer with multiple enterprise-grade solutions architected, designed, developed, and delivered. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in architecting and developing highly scalable, multi-tenanted, and real-time solutions. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with microservice architecture, design, and development. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with real-time push notifications for mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and others. 
 - Expertise in designing and managing highly scalable databases such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and MongoDB. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment. 
 - Strong programming skills in languages such as JavaScript and Java. 
 - Solid understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud architecture patterns. 
 - GCP Platform Deployment: Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. 
 - Real-Time Systems: Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Data & Database Systems: Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. 
 - Data Analytics Integration: Seamlessly integrate analytics and telemetry pipelines into cloud platforms to extract actionable system insights. 
 - AI Integration in SDLC Adaptation: Drive the secure adoption of AI technologies (such as Claude and other LLMs) within the software development life cycle (SDL), ensuring code quality, security compliance, and prompt engineering best practices. 
 - Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specs, and mentor junior engineers to drive continuous improvement.

Position Specific Information

- Travel Requirements: Up to 15%
 - Able to Telework?: Hybrid

Physical Demands

- Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
