data.title: EV Technical Lead
data.description:
Company Description

Aryan Pumps & Enviro Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a Pune-headquartered engineering and speciality vehicle manufacturing company with in-house product development, design, manufacturing and field-service capabilities. The company has built a strong engineering base in India and serves customers in domestic and international markets. 

  

The Next Technology Platform

Aryan is building capability for a modular Electric Vehicle Platform. The objective is to develop a scalable architecture that can support future vehicle programs across different configurations and duty cycles, with ownership of the core vehicle-level engineering and integration. 

For more information about the company, please visit our website: www. aryanpumps. com

Role Description

Own complete electric vehicle system architecture and platform definition. 

Define voltage class, power and energy requirements, vehicle-level electrical architecture and safety concept. 

Lead selection, sizing and integration of battery packs, BMS, traction motors, inverters, VCU, DC-DC converters, onboard charging and high-voltage distribution. 

Lead CAN / J1939 communication architecture, diagnostics, controls and vehicle software integration. 

Define regenerative braking strategy and integration with chassis braking systems. 

Own battery, motor, inverter and overall vehicle thermal-management strategy. 

Lead integration with chassis, axles, steering, braking and other vehicle subsystems. 

Establish functional safety, electrical safety, EMC/EMI, diagnostics and validation requirements. 

Lead prototype build, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, design iterations and production release. 

Drive homologation and regulatory compliance with relevant Indian and export-market standards. 

Develop and manage the technical supplier ecosystem for key EV components and systems. 

Build, mentor and lead a multidisciplinary EV engineering team. 

Establish DFMEA, DVP&R, design reviews, engineering change control, documentation and release processes. 

Drive cost, weight, efficiency, reliability, serviceability and localisation targets. 

Experience

Approximately 12-20 years of overall automotive engineering experience. 

Preferably 5-8+ years of direct electric-vehicle development experience. 

Strong preference for commercial vehicles, electric buses, electric trucks, off-highway vehicles or scalable EV platforms. 

Demonstrated involvement in a program from concept / architecture through prototype, validation, homologation and production. 

Technical Competencies

High-voltage EV architecture, ideally including 400-800 V systems. 

Battery pack engineering, BMS, traction motors, inverters and power electronics. 

VCU, CAN, J1939, diagnostics and controls integration. 

Charging architecture, DC-DC conversion and HV/LV power distribution. 

Thermal management, energy management, functional safety and EMC/EMI. 

Vehicle integration, validation, homologation and productionisation. 

Leadership Expectations

Act as the technical owner of the EV platform rather than only a component specialist. 

Build and lead Aryan's EV engineering/R&D; team and coordinate mechanical, electrical, electronics, software, testing, sourcing and manufacturing. 

Evaluate technology partners and suppliers and make sound make-vs-buy decisions.

data.title: Consultant - OT Data Operations, GIC Engineering
data.description:
Company Overview

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best - bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what's next. 

Overview

The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. This role requires you to operate in 1. 30 pm to 10. 30 pm. 

Key Accountabilities

- Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles. 
 - Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms. 
 - Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions. 
 - Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases. 
 - Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms. 
 - Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms. 
 - Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites. 
 - Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns. 
 - Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition. 
 - Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation. 
 - Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting. 
 - Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture. 
 - System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization. 
 - Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
 - GCP certification
 - Background in Mathematics or Statistics

ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www. envestnet. com. 

The Team You'll Join

On the Tamarac development team, we build one of the industry's most advanced portfolio management and trading platforms for RIAs. We tackle complex engineering challenges every day from large scale data ingestion and analytics to deep system integrations, high performance trading algorithms, and a robust full stack web experience used by thousands of advisors. 

As we continue to scale the platform-supporting 50+ million trades annually-we're modernizing our architecture to meet growing demand while delivering innovative, advisor focused features. Our engineers collaborate across disciplines to build AI powered insights, enhance cross platform capabilities, and design resilient, cloud native systems. 

This is a rare opportunity to join us in shaping the technical roadmap of a leading trading platform-driving how we scale, evolve, and deliver capabilities that elevate both the advisor and client experience, with real world impact from day one. 

How You'll Contribute

Responsible for building scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements. 

- Designs, develops, and maintains complex features or system components. 
 - Leads technical design for small-to-medium features or services. 
 - Identifies root causes of issues and implement robust, scalable fixes. 
 - Optimizes code for performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Mentors junior engineers (P1-P2) and provide technical guidance. 
 - Drives improvements in coding standards, testing practices, and CI/CD processes. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to refine requirements and clarify technical constraints. 
 - Troubleshoots production issues and lead resolution efforts. 
 - Balances multiple priorities across projects with minimal supervision. 
 - Implements and improves basic observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) for owned services. 
 - Supports production troubleshooting in collaboration with DevOps/SRE teams. 
 - Partners with DevOps/SRE to improve system reliability, deployment automation, and observability. 
 - Designs and maintains CI/CD pipelines for owned services, improving deployment speed and safety. 
 - Implements infrastructure-aware design decisions (scalability, failover, resiliency, cost). 
 - Leverages agentic coding tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to increase personal productivity across development, testing, and code review phases of the SDLC. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- Candidates should demonstrate the relevant experience, skills, and capabilities needed to successfully perform in the role. Relevant experience may be gained through current responsibilities, prior roles, project work, leadership opportunities, or other comparable experiences. 
 - Strong proficiency in . NET, C#, RESTful APIs, and relational/NoSQL database design. 
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and Redis. 
 - Experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudWatch. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, observability practices, agile/Scrum delivery, test-driven development, and code quality standards. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot and resolve production issues independently and lead resolution efforts within owned services. 
 - Experience mentoring P1-P2 engineers and contributing to team technical standards. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML systems, LLM-based applications, or data pipeline work preferred. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field required; master's degree preferred. 
 - Software engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of complex features or system components in production environments. 

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future. 

The opportunity is now!

Our Investment in You

At Envestnet, our total rewards philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and grow exceptional talent. We offer competitive, market-aligned compensation complemented with performance-linked incentives and rewards programs that recognize and reward impact. 

In addition, we provide a comprehensive suite of benefits - subject to Envestnet's plan eligibility rules - that support your overall well-being, including medical insurance for you and your family, annual health check-ups, free online doctor consultations and telemedicine services, subsidized health club memberships, and an employee assistance program. Our investment in you means supporting you professionally, financially, and personally at every stage of your journey with us. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

Envestnet is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of religion, race, color, caste, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, medical condition, nationality, ethnic origin, marital status, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. This commitment is in accordance with the Constitution of India and applicable labor and employment laws. All employment decisions are made solely based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. 

We strive to provide an inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at [email protected]. Please include your full name, the title of the role you are applying for, and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

Recruitment Fraud

At Envestnet, safeguarding the trust and safety of job seekers is a top priority. We are aware that scammers may impersonate Envestnet recruiters or create fake job opportunities to deceive candidates. Review the information on our recruitment fraud awareness page to help you recognize and avoid recruitment fraud.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Java & Kafka
data.description:
Job Description: Senior Backend Java Developer

Job Title: Senior Backend Java Developer

Experience: 5+ Years

Location: Mohali, India

Work Mode: Work from Office (Full-time, On-site)

Shift time is -7: 30 am to 3: 30 pm. 

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Java Developer with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Apache Kafka, MySQL, Docker, and Kubernetes. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing backend services, designing scalable REST APIs, and managing integrations with internal and external systems. The role also involves taking ownership of existing microservices, troubleshooting production issues, maintaining Kubernetes deployments, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Take ownership of 2-3 assigned microservices, including application controllers, BSS controllers, notification services, schedulers, and exporters. 
 - Understand, document, maintain, and improve existing business logic across microservices. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance REST APIs. 
 - Implement Kafka producers and consumers for push and email notification pipelines. 
 - Integrate applications with external systems, including BSS, ASM, ATG, FCM/Firebase, email systems, and Vault. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established coding standards. 
 - Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback. 
 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests. 
 - Maintain Helm charts and Kubernetes deployment configurations. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and support L3/L4 escalations for owned services. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation, test strategies, deployment procedures, and architecture reviews. 
 - Mentor junior developers and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies. Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of professional backend software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot for microservices development. 
 - Strong experience with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, and consumer groups. 
 - Solid knowledge of MySQL, complex queries, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including pods, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and resource management. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, including OpenAPI and Swagger documentation. 
 - Understanding of JWT, OAuth2, and token-based authentication and authorization. 
 - Experience integrating Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications. 
 - Proficiency in Git and feature-branch workflows. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD. 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm charts. 
 - Good understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies. Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, or Spring Scheduler. 
 - Familiarity with HashiCorp Vault for secrets and certificate management. 
 - Knowledge of Strimzi Operator and Kafka on Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Micrometer, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Familiarity with distributed tracing tools such as Jaeger or Zipkin. 
 - Knowledge of the Telecom domain, particularly BSS/OSS provisioning workflows and account management. 
 - Experience with ELK Stack, Loki, or APM tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, or Datadog. 
 - Familiarity with Istio or Envoy service mesh technologies. 
 - Experience with JUnit 5, Mockito, and Testcontainers. 
 - CKAD certification is an added advantage. Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership, accountability, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. 
 - Comfortable working with geographically distributed teams across different cultures and time zones. 
 - Delivery-oriented mindset with the ability to meet strict deadlines. 
 - Willingness to learn, document, and take ownership of existing systems. Work Location and Reporting

This position is based in Mohali, India, and requires full-time, on-site presence on all working days. This is not a work-from-home position.

Job Description

Join a High-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence

At Vertiv, we don't just hire talent-we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what's possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next-gen technology-and we need bold, high-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level. 

Position Summary

The P3 Digital Automation and AI Specialist is a senior-level subject matter expert within the Optimization Team, responsible for developing and delivering AI solutions, scaling automation initiatives, and uplifting team capabilities across the organization. This role combines hands-on AI development experience (including tools like Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other LLM platforms) with software development skills and practical RPA expertise in business contexts such as finance, procurement, and sales. 

As a people-oriented leader and experienced subject matter expert, the Specialist drives AI adoption by building and deploying solutions, training colleagues on AI tools and methodologies, and coaching team members to develop their own expertise. The role also involves product and project management, ensuring initiatives move from concept to delivery with clear ownership and accountability. 

The role demands a results-driven mindset, strong training skills, and the ability to bring personal expertise to uplift others. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives on getting things done, enjoys teaching and mentoring, and can bridge the gap between technical AI capabilities and real-world business outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Development & Delivery

- Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions leveraging platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other LLM/generative AI tools 
 - Apply software development skills to build custom integrations, APIs, and AI-powered applications that solve business challenges 
 - Leverage RPA experience to automate processes in business-critical areas such as finance, procurement, and sales 
 - Own the full lifecycle of AI projects, from requirements gathering and prototyping through deployment and iteration

Training & Knowledge Sharing

- Develop and deliver training programs on AI tools for teams across the organization 
 - Conduct hands-on workshops, lunch-and-learns, and structured training sessions to build AI literacy and practical skills 
 - Create reusable training materials, guides, and documentation to support ongoing learning and adoption 
 - Promote AI capabilities and use cases to drive awareness and enthusiasm for AI adoption across business functions

Team Coaching & Mentorship

- Coach and mentor team members at all levels, sharing personal expertise to accelerate their growth and technical capabilities 
 - Foster a people-oriented team culture focused on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support 
 - Help scale AI and automation solutions by enabling others to build, maintain, and extend solutions independently 
 - Lead guild sessions and community-of-practice meetings to share best practices, emerging AI trends, and lessons learned across teams

Scaling & Continuous Improvement

- Scale successful AI and automation solutions across business units, ensuring broad adoption and measurable impact 
 - Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and pilot programs to validate new AI technologies and identify high-value use cases 
 - Drive a results-oriented culture focused on getting things done, continuous improvement, and delivering tangible business value through AI and automation

Qualifications & Requirements

Education & Experience

- 5-8+ years of experience in AI solution development, automation, and digital transformation, with hands-on experience using AI/LLM platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT). Demonstrated software development skills and practical RPA experience in business contexts such as finance, procurement, or sales. Product or project management experience preferred. 
 - Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred in IT, Computer Science, Data Science, or related discipline. 

Technical Skills

- Proficiency in AI/LLM tools (Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar), software development (Python, JavaScript, or comparable languages), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI), RPA development, API design, and project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or SAFe). 

Core Competencies & Soft Skills

- People-oriented mindset, strong training and facilitation skills, results-driven attitude, coaching and mentoring ability, cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and a passion for teaching others and driving AI adoption. 

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv's Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

Innovation

Financial Strength

data.title: Sr. SDET
data.description:
About Us

Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry's first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end-to-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics-all delivered with enterprise-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential. 

Senior SDET - AI-Driven Quality Engineering

Full-Time

- Engineering
 - Quality
 - AI & Automation

Location : Bangalore / Hyderabad

We are looking for a Senior SDET who brings together deep automation expertise and a forward-looking AI-first mindset to redefine how quality is built into our products. You will lead the charge in adopting AI-powered testing tools, intelligent defect analysis, and autonomous test generation - while remaining the quality champion your team relies on. 

- Job Roles and Responsibilities
 - Champion an AI-first testing culture - proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML-powered tools into test design, execution, maintenance, and defect analysis. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test authoring, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort in test script maintenance. 
 - Apply AI-driven visual testing and self-healing automation techniques to reduce flakiness and keep test suites resilient across rapid UI changes. 
 - Leverage large language models (LLMs) and AI assistants to generate test cases from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria - then validate, refine, and own the output. 
 - Implement AI-augmented log and anomaly analysis to proactively identify patterns that precede failures in production or staging environments. 
 - Quickly gain a deep understanding of the solution domain; analyze customer-reported defects and implement automation strategies - powered by AI where applicable - to prevent recurrence. 
 - Be the first customer to the product and its documentation; provide feedback from the customer's perspective and act as the quality champion for the team. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, developers, UX/UI designers, developers and SDETs to understand functionality, identify test scenarios, and ensure comprehensive coverage. 
 - Review all backend and engineering stories assigned, assess impact, and define test coverage with an AI-assisted risk-based approach. 
 - Perform functional, integration, end-to-end, performance and regression testing across all release phases, augmented by AI-driven test selection and prioritization. 
 - Set up, maintain, and evolve test automation frameworks across Web, Desktop, and Mobile - incorporating AI capabilities for smarter execution and maintenance. 
 - Write and maintain automation code for front-end & back-end testing; apply AI tools to assist in debugging, refactoring, and coverage gap analysis. 
 - Build automation for customer use-case scenarios and customer reported defects; use AI-generated scenario suggestions to expand coverage beyond manual thinking. 
 - Contribute actively to API/integration testing, UI automation, TDD, ATDD, and code quality tooling - using AI to boost throughput at every layer. 
 - Diagnose and resolve CI/CD pipeline issues; apply AI-based observability tools to detect and predict build instability. 
 - Perform database querying and log analysis for root cause investigation; use AI-assisted analysis where available to speed up triage. 
 - Share knowledge with the team through workshops and learning sessions focused on AI tools, testing innovation, and SDET skill development. 
 - Continuously evaluate and introduce new AI-powered testing tools and methodologies; advocate for adoption across the team. 
 - Contribute to initiatives that improve team processes, tooling, and product quality - with a bias toward intelligent automation over manual toil. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of test strategies, automation processes, and AI tooling decisions to ensure knowledge is accessible and transferable. 
 - Candidates who bring hands-on experience with RAG-based conversational AI and have tested conversational bots with automated frameworks that validate multi-turn flows across intent recognition, context retention, response accuracy, and end-to-end workflow validations will be a compelling fit for this role. 
 - Job Requirements
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5-7 years of experience in SDET or quality engineering roles, with demonstrable exposure to AI-assisted testing or tooling. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and modern software testing methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in Java, Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; ability to write, review, and debug automation code at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with Playwright/Selenium for UI and API testing. 
 - Practical experience with one or more AI-powered testing tools - such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, similar. 
 - Familiarity with using LLMs or AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc. ) to accelerate test authoring, code review, or defect analysis. 
 - Experience with self-healing test frameworks or AI-driven test maintenance strategies is a strong plus. 
 - Understanding TDD, BDD, and ATDD techniques & integrating it into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of database querying and log/anomaly analysis, including AI-assisted observability platforms. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and the ability to triage, stabilize, and improve build and deployment workflows. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated test output - validating, refining, and taking ownership rather than accepting it at face value. 
 - Knows when to ask for help, communicates clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders, and documents AI tool decisions transparently. 
 - Problem-solving mindset with the ability to debug complex issues in both handwritten and AI-generated automation code. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Collaborative team player who leads by example in driving a culture of quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

All unsolicited resumes submitted to any @automationanywhere. com email address, whether submitted by an individual or by an agency, will not be eligible for an agency fee.

data.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun - where everyone can succeed. 

Join us to transform the way the world works. 

Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 

Hiring Team Description: 

LinkedIn Learning Solutions Engineering India is a ground-up, AI-first org building scalable systems and consumer-grade experiences that connect skills, learning, career growth, and internal mobility across LinkedIn Learning and the enterprise Career Hub. Engineers own end-to-end delivery across web, mobile, backend, data, and AI - designing architectures for skills intelligence, skill-gap detection, personalized recommendations, workforce transformation, and internal mobility-while shaping engineering standards, culture, and hiring in a greenfield environment with LinkedIn's scale. 

LinkedIn Learning is entering a significant new phase of growth and innovation. What started as a learning platform has evolved into a much broader vision: helping organizations understand, develop, and transform workforce capabilities at scale. Our new Learning Solutions Engineering charter is going to be built ground-up from India exclusively and is building AI-powered experiences that connect skills, learning, career growth, and internal mobility. 

The Learning Solutions Engineering team is being built to drive this next chapter. This is a rare opportunity to join a business that already serves millions of professionals globally while helping shape the future of AI-powered workforce transformation. 

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the design and delivery of AI-native systems that solve real product and business problems. You'll set technical direction for how we apply LLMs and agentic systems at scale , from prototyping to production-grade, evaluated, and observable systems. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build agentic workflows that orchestrate multi-step reasoning, tool use, and decision-making across complex tasks
 - Architect and scale Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines - including chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval strategy - for accuracy and latency at production scale
 - Own prompt engineering practices: design, iterate, and systematize prompts across use cases, balancing reliability, cost, and latency
 - Build robust evaluation frameworks (offline and online) to measure model/agent quality, catch regressions, and guide iteration
 - Partner closely with product, data science, and infra teams to translate ambiguous problems into scoped AI-powered solutions
 - Drive technical decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, and build-vs-buy for AI infrastructure
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers; raise the technical bar for applied AI practices org-wide
 - Stay current with the fast-moving LLM/agent ecosystem and pragmatically bring relevant advances into the roadmap

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

- BS Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline or related practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years hands-on building applied AI/LLM-based systems in production

Nice to Have

- Experience with fine-tuning or custom model training
 - Familiarity with LLM observability/tracing tools . 
 - Experience in a high-scale consumer or enterprise product environment
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping agentic workflows (multi-step tool-calling, planning, orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, custom agent loops, etc. )
 - Strong grasp of RAG system design - retrieval quality, embedding strategies, vector DBs, hybrid search
 - Deep experience with prompt engineering methodologies and prompt/version management at scale
 - Proven track record building evaluation systems for LLM outputs (automated evals, human-in-the-loop review, regression suites, LLM-as-judge techniques)
 - Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, APIs, and production-grade software engineering
 - Excellent communication skills; able to explain AI system trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- LLM

 - Distributed Systems

Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer

- In this key role, you'll improve, drive, and embed non-functional and operational characteristics such as availability, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, security, incident response, and capacity planning of our products and services
 - You'll enjoy significant stakeholder interaction, working in collaboration with engineers to ensure a principled approach to deliver change in a safe and secure way
 - This is a chance to join an inclusive team with a collaborative ethos and a commitment to innovation and professional development
 - We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

As our Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work closely with our feature team and other colleagues to meet defined service level objectives and continually improve systems and environments. You'll define error budgets that support finding the right balance between risk and reliability. 

You'll also provide structure and help to our release process, suggesting and making improvements where possible. You'll scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, evolving them by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity. We'll also look to you to coach and provide guidance to colleagues and the wider team, leading where required. 

In Addition To This, You'll

- Proactively contribute new ideas and innovations to meet short term and longer-term goals
 - Continually balance and manage any potential risks
 - Be accountable for the day-to-day health of both production and non-production environments and respond to any incidents as required
 - Provide technical expertise and input to establish the risk tolerance of products and services
 - Communicate incident status updates clearly and frequently to other teams, customers and stakeholders

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with strong knowledge of reliability systems thinking and experience of software engineering. You'll need experience of using a data driven and scientific approach to fact finding. We'll also look for financial services knowledge, and the ability to identify wider business impact, risk and opportunity, and make connections across key outputs and processes

We're Also Looking For

- Strong SRE and production support expertise, including SLI/SLOs, incident/problem management, ITIL, resilience and operational reliability with 12+ years of experience
 - Strong technical experience across AWS, Java/Spring Boot, Microservices, React, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, automation and AIOps. 
 - Proven technical leadership and mentoring, with strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III
Senior Backend Engineer - Golang (Product Engineering)
data.description:
ABOUT OOLIO: 

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22, 000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights - all within one connected ecosystem. 

We are building the operating system for modern hospitality - simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafés and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software - we become long-term partners in growth. 

As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we're shaping the future of hospitality technology. 

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale. 

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Oolio, Senior Backend Engineers - Golang are hands-on engineers who design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend systems. You will take ownership across the backend engineering lifecycle - from technical design and development through testing, deployment, observability, and production support. 

The role requires strong expertise in Golang, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies, and system performance. As AI continues to transform software engineering, you will also be encouraged to leverage AI-powered development tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance code quality, and solve real-world engineering problems. 

The primary focus of this role is hands-on backend engineering, with opportunities to contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices. You will work closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams to build customer-facing products and backend capabilities that support Oolio's growing global platform. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable and scalable backend services using Golang. 
 - Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable microservices with strong emphasis on performance, concurrency, maintainability, and reliability. 
 - Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, including HLD/LLD, service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns. 
 - Design and implement event-driven systems using asynchronous messaging, queues, pub/sub, and streaming patterns where appropriate. 
 - Build and maintain RESTful and/or gRPC APIs that power web, mobile, and third-party integrations. 
 - Work collaboratively across the stack when required, including integration with React and Node. js services to deliver end-to-end product features. 
 - Develop and operate cloud-native services deployed on AWS, leveraging Kubernetes and Docker for containerized environments. 
 - Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks as product usage and customer scale increase. 
 - Implement effective testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and performance testing. 
 - Contribute to observability best practices including structured logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards, coding practices, and overall code quality. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines. 
 - Mentor and support junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Leverage AI-powered development tools and automation to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery. 
 - Explore and adopt relevant AI capabilities and engineering tools that can solve practical software development and operational challenges. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) - final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials, and interview outcomes

Experience: 5 - 9 Years

Education: Preferred - B. Tech/B. E/M. Tech/M. E/MCA/M. S

Technology Stack: 

(A) Core Engineering: 

Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI-Powered Development Tooling

(B) Good/Nice to Have: 

ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL

OTHER REQUIREMENTS: 

- Strong hands-on experience building production-grade backend systems in SaaS or product-based organisations. 
 - Strong expertise in Golang, including concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, memory management, profiling, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven experience developing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and system reliability principles. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or similar databases, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development and delivery practices. 
 - Good understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, fault tolerance, and production reliability. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing long-term improvements. 
 - Experience working in high-scale or high-transaction environments is highly desirable. 
 - Practical experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Exposure to AI-powered workflows across development, testing, documentation, deployment, or operational processes is a plus. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and engineering teams while taking ownership of assigned services and features. 
 - Strong focus on writing clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.

data.title: Technical Test Analyst - Professional
data.description:
Who We Are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution. 

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Engineer to join our team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing solutions to ensure the highest quality of our software products. Your primary focus will be on web automation using Selenium with Java, while simultaneously driving the strategic adoption and implementation of UiPath for broader process automation. 

Day-to-day Responsibilities

Test Automation & Technical Development

- Design and Maintenance: Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium (Java) and Maven, following the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern. 
 - Process Automation: Lead the technical evaluation and introduction of UiPath within our organization to automate repetitive business processes. 
 - Script Development: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code to support both automated functional testing and robotic process automation (RPA). 
 - Continuous Improvement: Optimize existing scripts and frameworks to reduce technical debt and increase execution speed and reliability. 

Collaboration & Strategy

- Tool Integration: Manage the integration of automation tools into our existing CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless deployment cycles. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Collaborate closely with development teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to identify high-value automation opportunities. 
 - Best Practices: Define and enforce coding standards and best practices for automation across the engineering department. 
 - Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation for automated test suites, RPA workflows, and technical procedures. 

Who Are We Looking For

Qualifications & Requirements

- Technical Proficiency: Solid experience in test automation using Selenium WebDriver with Java. 
 - Framework Knowledge: Proven track record in building frameworks from scratch using Maven and the Page Object Model (POM). 
 - RPA Experience: Practical experience or strong willingness to lead the implementation of UiPath. 
 - General Skills: Familiarity with version control systems (e. g. , Git), build tools, and CI/CD concepts. 
 - Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to automation strategy. 

Language: Fluent in English (German language skills are a plus). 

Perks & Benefits

- The opportunity to shape our automation strategy from the ground up. 
 - Work with a modern tech stack and influence the future of our RPA deployment. 
 - A collaborative environment that values continuous learning and professional development. 

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18, 000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs. worldline. com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

What You'll Do

We are seeking an experienced Delivery Manager - Engineering to lead engineering teams within the Benefits & Protection - Business Owner Solutions IT Platform organization. This role is responsible for driving delivery execution, engineering excellence, technology modernization, people leadership, and stakeholder engagement across business-critical platforms. 

The successful candidate will provide leadership across engineering delivery, operational stability, talent development, performance management, and strategic technology initiatives while partnering closely with Product Management, Architecture, Operations, and Business stakeholders. 

Responsibilities

Delivery & Execution Leadership

- Lead multiple cross-functional engineering teams delivering business-critical technology solutions. 
 - Drive execution of strategic initiatives, product roadmaps, modernization programs, and operational excellence objectives. 
 - Establish delivery governance, planning, prioritization, dependency management, release management, and risk mitigation practices. 
 - Ensure predictable delivery outcomes aligned with business commitments and organizational goals. 
 - Manage production support, operational health, service reliability, and continuous improvement programs. 

Engineering & Technology Leadership

- Provide engineering leadership and technology oversight for assigned product and platform teams. 
 - Partner with architects and engineering leads to define and execute technology strategy and modernization initiatives. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through adoption of best practices, automation, quality engineering, DevOps, security, and operational resiliency. 
 - Support technical decision-making, architectural alignment, technical debt reduction, and platform simplification efforts. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, quality, and accountability. 

AI & Innovation Leadership

- Lead adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices to improve development productivity, delivery velocity, quality, and operational efficiency. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and implement AI-driven solutions that create measurable business impact. 
 - Promote responsible use of AI technologies, ensuring compliance, security, governance, and risk management standards. 
 - Drive innovation culture through experimentation, proof-of-concepts, hackathons, and emerging technology adoption. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities to improve software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes including requirements analysis, development, testing, documentation, knowledge management, and operational support. 
 - Champion engineering productivity initiatives by integrating AI-powered tools into daily delivery workflows. 
 - Enable teams to measure and demonstrate business value generated through AI and automation investments. 

Engineering Productivity, Metrics & Outcomes

- Establish and drive engineering productivity and operational excellence metrics across teams. 
 - Utilize Developer Experience (DX) and Engineering Excellence frameworks to improve developer effectiveness, system reliability, quality, and delivery predictability. 
 - Leverage engineering insights and platform metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve value stream flow, and increase team efficiency. 
 - Drive adoption of data-driven decision making using engineering, delivery, quality, and operational KPIs. 
 - Continuously evaluate and improve team performance through actionable metrics and measurable outcomes. 
 - Promote automation-first approaches to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and accelerate time-to-market. 
 - Establish outcome-based goals focused on customer value, business impact, delivery effectiveness, and engineering excellence. 

People Leadership

- Lead, coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent across multiple teams. 
 - Drive employee engagement, retention, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives. 
 - Build high-performing, inclusive teams focused on collaboration, innovation, and customer outcomes. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, and talent acquisition activities. 

Performance & Talent Management

- Own performance management processes including goal setting, development planning, talent assessments, and appraisal cycles. 
 - Conduct regular coaching and career development discussions with team members. 
 - Identify growth opportunities and create development plans aligned with organizational needs. 
 - Recognize and reward performance while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 

Stakeholder & Business Partnership

- Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Business Leaders, Operations, and Enterprise stakeholders. 
 - Provide regular updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and strategic priorities. 
 - Influence decisions through data-driven insights, technical expertise, and business acumen. 
 - Align engineering initiatives with business objectives and customer outcomes. 

Additional Responsibilities

- Serve as a key BOS leadership representative within the Hyderabad location. 
 - Support Hyderabad location strategy, workforce growth, employee engagement, leadership visibility, and organizational development. 
 - Partner with local and global leaders to strengthen BOS presence and leadership effectiveness within the Hyderabad engineering organization. 
 - Drive local leadership forums, employee connect initiatives, and organizational health activities. 

Who You Are

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10-14 years of technology industry experience with progressive responsibilities in software engineering, technology delivery, or engineering management. 
 - 3+ years of people leadership experience leading engineering teams. 
 - Experience leading multiple Agile delivery teams in a complex enterprise environment. 
 - Proven experience managing performance reviews, talent development, goal setting, and employee mentoring. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple locations. 
 - Experience assisting with location strategy, workforce planning, and organizational growth initiatives. 
 - Experience presenting to senior leadership teams and portfolio governance forums. 
 - Experience managing large-scale transformation or organizational change programs. 
 - Solid grasp of Agile, Lean, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Developer Experience (DX) principles. 

Additional Information

What Makes You a Standout Candidate

- Thinks like an Engineering Leader and Technology Strategist, not a traditional project manager. 
 - Uses AI, automation, and engineering insights to accelerate delivery and improve outcomes. 
 - Drives measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, reliability, and business value. 
 - Makes data-driven decisions using engineering metrics, delivery benchmarks, and business outcomes. 
 - Balances technology strategy, engineering excellence, people leadership, and business priorities. 
 - Builds a culture of innovation, continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence. 
 - Successfully translates technology investments into measurable customer and business impact.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you.

This key role involves building and leading a team of talented, passionate backend Java software engineers responsible for developing mission-critical and innovative identity and security products, specifically focusing on platform features for authentication and authorisation. We are looking for a passionate, entrepreneurial engineering leader to join the Bangalore engineering team. In this role, you will be part of LinkedIn's India initiatives team responsible for leading a team of engineers to develop new products and services and scale existing LinkedIn's products for the fast-growing Indian market. You will also partner with other teams across the company to ensure a consistently awesome experience across platforms and products. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team

data.description:
ABOUT OOLIO: 

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22, 000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights - all within one connected ecosystem. 

We are building the operating system for modern hospitality - simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafés and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software - we become long-term partners in growth. 

As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we're shaping the future of hospitality technology. 

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale. 

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Oolio, Senior QA Engineers are quality owners and hands-on problem solvers who ensure our SaaS platforms meet high standards of reliability, performance, and stability. 

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to validate features, identify risks early, and strengthen quality practices across your assigned modules or POD. While remaining deeply hands-on in both manual and automation testing, you will also contribute to improving test coverage, processes, and release confidence. 

This role is ideal for someone with strong execution depth, growing leadership maturity, and the ability to independently own quality for complex feature areas. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Own quality validation for assigned modules or features within a POD. 
 - Develop strong product understanding across workflows, especially within SaaS and POS environments. 
 - Design, maintain, and enhance automation frameworks for web, mobile, and API-based applications. 
 - Actively contribute to manual and automated testing across functional, regression, integration, and release cycles. 
 - Identify risks prior to release and collaborate with developers and product managers to mitigate them. 
 - Increase automation coverage to improve release velocity and reduce regression cycles. 
 - Contribute to integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing. 
 - Ensure test cases, scenarios, and validation strategies are well-documented and maintained. 
 - Support release validation, defect triaging, root cause analysis, and production issue verification. 
 - Collaborate closely with QA Leads to align with broader quality strategy and standards. 
 - Guide and support junior QA engineers where required, promoting consistency in testing practices. 
 - Promote accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement within the team. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Role: Senior QA Engineer - final role depends on the individual performance and other credentials during the interview process

Experience: 5 - 13 Years

Education: Preferred - B. Tech/B. E/M. Tech/M. E/MCA/M. S

Technology Stack: 

- Automation: Playwright / Appium / Selenium / Cypress, API Automation - REST Assured / Postman Collections, BDD - Cucumber
 - Manual & Exploratory Testing: Test case design, scenario-based validation, UAT support, regression planning, release sign-off ownership
 - API Testing: Postman / Swagger / Contract Testing
 - Performance Testing: JMeter / k6
 - Mobile Testing: iOS & Android validation (real devices + emulators)
 - CI/CD Integration: Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI
 - Database Validation: SQL (MySQL / PostgreSQL)
 - Cloud & Infra Awareness: AWS environments, Docker, Kubernetes exposure
 - Web Fundamentals (Good to Have): HTML, CSS, JavaScript understanding

OTHER REQUIREMENT: 

Quality & Execution Focus: 

- Ensure thorough functional and regression coverage for assigned modules. 
 - Actively participate in exploratory testing, integration testing, performance validation, and release sign-off support. 
 - Contribute to improving test processes, automation stability, and defect prevention practices. Metrics & Reporting: 

- Track and communicate test execution status, defect trends, and release readiness within your scope. 
 - Provide structured insights to QA Leads and stakeholders during sprint and release cycles. Collaboration & Communication: 

- Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering teams, and DevOps to ensure quality across the SDLC. 
 - Communicate defects, risks, and technical findings clearly and constructively. Professional Attributes: 

- Strong ownership mindset for assigned features and modules. 
 - Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive in identifying quality gaps. 
 - Self-driven, inquisitive, and continuously learning. 
 - Ability to balance speed and quality in a fast-paced delivery environment.

Freight Tiger is looking for an Integration Lead to own end-to-end customer integration delivery between the Freight Tiger platform and customer ERP, SAP and Third party systems. The person will work with customer IT/SAP teams, Integration Solution Engineers, Product, Engineering and DevOps to take integrations from requirements to production. - Own customer integration requirements and act as the primary technical integration contact.

Delivery & Production

Team Contribution

- Mentor and provide technical direction to Integration Solution Engineers.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer to work on Qualys' next-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys' next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open source technologies, and work on challenging and business-impacting projects. 

Responsibilities

As a data platform engineer you will be responsible for the team running data stored with millions of transactions per second, scaling 100s of terrabytes of data. Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys. 

You will be reviewing the application architecture and identify the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting edge technologies and do POC and then responsible for rolling out in production. Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open source community if any enhancement needed to fit in Qualys ecosystem. 

You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate, burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero or least amount of downtime. 

You will be responsible for delivering resilient client SDKs to the applications to communicate with the data source you are responsible for. 

You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current scaling, availability and cost effective alternative solutions. 

Co-develop with a strong sense of ownership Qualys' big-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first-rate experience to our customers. 

Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys' business objectives. 

Produce high quality software following good architecture and design principles that you and your team will find easy to work with in the future. 

A day in the life. . . 

- Apply advanced concepts, theories and principles to create multi-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations 
 - Contribute to development of new data platform principles and concepts 
 - Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys 
 - Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys 
 - Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams 
 - Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams

Who You Are. . . 

- A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies. 
 - A teacher. You're able to mentor your peers and help our team grow. 
 - A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding. 
 - A pragmatist. Your goal is to create useful products, not build technology for technology's sake. 
 - An empath. You understand what the customer needs and use that perspective to create the best user experience. 

How We Work. . . 

- With others. We have remote pairing tools where engineers often work together, as well as virtual collaboration tools for building out architecture solutions. 
 - With transparency. We encourage open dialog and discourse. We don't encourage silos. 
 - With agility. We don't believe in following a process for process's sake. We ship frequently and focus on delivering incremental value. 
 - With open minds. We are committed to building a diverse team of people with unique perspectives. This encourages a healthy and inclusive environment that builds a more sustainable, successful company. 
 - With pride. We value our people most of all. We invest in ourselves by applying our own strengths and interests to company needs. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience . 
 - 6+ years hands-on experience with developing SaaS based software products and solutions for service-oriented deployments in public (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, etc. ) or private clouds. 
 - Prior experience with RDBMS systems and NoSQL databases. 
 - Proven expertise in data-driven critical thinking problem-solving

 - Demonstrated ability to write high-quality, production-ready code (readable, well-tested, with well-designed APIs) 
 - Demonstrated passion for innovation with an ability to work within agile software development methodologies 
 - Experience with infrastructure orchestration and automation tools (Terraform) 
 - Hands-on experience using CI/CD pipelines

data.title: Leadership - System Engineering
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced systems engineering leader to head our Systems Engineering function for UAV/UAS platform development. In this senior leadership role, you will build and lead a high-performing team of systems engineers, owning end-to-end system architecture, requirements management, and verification & validation across our unmanned aerial platforms - including hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing systems. You will be the technical authority bridging mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload sub-disciplines, ensuring the platform is engineered as a coherent, certifiable, and mission-ready system, while partnering closely with program management, manufacturing, quality, and customers to deliver robust, field-proven products. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Establish, lead, and continuously mature the Systems Engineering function - defining processes, tools, and governance for requirements management, system architecture, interface control, and verification & validation (V&V) across the UAV product portfolio. 2
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of systems engineers across requirements, architecture, integration, and test disciplines, fostering technical depth, accountability, and career growth. 
 - Own system-level architecture and trade studies for hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing UAV platforms - balancing payload, endurance, propulsion, structural, and mission performance requirements. 
 - Drive requirements engineering and traceability from customer/stakeholder needs (GSQR/SRS) through system, subsystem, and component-level specifications, ensuring full bidirectional traceability. 
 - Lead integration and verification & validation planning across propulsion, avionics, GNC/flight controls, EMI/EMC, structures, and payload subsystems, ensuring compliance to applicable standards (MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, ARP4754A, STANAG, DO-160 where applicable). 
 - Own technical risk management at the system level - identifying, assessing, and tracking design and integration risks, and driving mitigation through design reviews and test campaigns. 
 - Chair and govern technical design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) and serve as the senior technical interface with program management, quality, certification bodies (CEMILAC/DGQA), and customers. 
 - Partner with PMO, manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement to ensure system designs are manufacturable, testable, and aligned with program schedules and cost targets. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and design improvements from flight test, field deployment, and reliability/endurance data, closing the loop into the engineering baseline. 
 - Lead make-vs-buy and vendor technical evaluations for critical subsystems (propulsion, avionics, payload, navigation) and manage technical relationships with external partners and consultants. 
 - Drive systems engineering tooling and infrastructure investments (requirements management, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), configuration management, simulation platforms).

data.title: Salesforce Architect
data.description:
Salesforce Architect

Enterprise Architecture  |  Technical Leadership  |  Salesforce Platform  |  Multi-Cloud

Company- Kohler

Role Summary

The Salesforce Architect owns the end-to-end architecture, technical leadership, and governance of the Salesforce ecosystem - spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Experience Cloud partner portals, Data cloud, Agentforce, MuleSoft integrations, SAP ERP connectivity, and digital platforms. Acting as platform custodian, this role drives scalability, security, performance, and adherence to enterprise architecture standards while remaining hands-on to guide and elevate development teams. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Platform Architecture

•            Define Salesforce architecture and roadmap across Sales, Service, Field Service, Partner Portal, data cloud and Agentforce. 

•            Design scalable, secure solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and Salesforce best practices. 

•            Guide teams on declarative vs. programmatic solution trade-offs. 

  

2. Hands-On Development & Technical Leadership

•            Develop and maintain Apex, LWC, and integrations as needed. 

•            Conduct code reviews; enforce coding standards, design patterns, and governor limit compliance. 

•            Guide teams on efficient Apex, SOQL, and reusable component design. 

  

3. Code Quality & Coverage Governance

•            Define and enforce unit testing standards, code coverage thresholds, and test automation practices. 

•            Review and approve critical code changes and architectural components. 

•            Implement static code analysis and automated quality tools. 

  

4. Platform Health & Optimization

•            Monitor API usage, governor limits, integration failures, batch jobs, and Apex errors. 

•            Establish performance monitoring dashboards and proactively resolve bottlenecks. 

•            Drive platform optimization and long-term sustainability initiatives. 

  

5. Integration Architecture

•            Design and govern API-led integrations with resilient error handling and retry mechanisms. 

•            Establish API standards, versioning strategies, and event-driven architecture patterns. 

  

6. Data Architecture & Governance

•            Design enterprise Salesforce data models with Salesforce-SAP alignment. 

•            Address large data volume (LDV) considerations and define strategies for data sync, quality, and lifecycle. 

  

7. DevOps & Release Governance

•            Architect CI/CD pipelines, release management, environment strategies, and automated testing. 

•            Experience with Copado or equivalent DevOps platforms preferred. 

  

8. Security & Compliance

•            Implement role hierarchy, permission models, field-level security, and data encryption. 

•            Ensure compliance with enterprise cybersecurity policies. 

  

Required Technical Skills

Salesforce Platform

Sales Cloud  |  Service Cloud  |  Field Service  |  Experience Cloud   |  Data Cloud |  Agentforce

  

Development

Apex  |  LWC  |  SOQL / SOSL  |  Platform Events  |  Batch Apex  |  Async Processing  |  Salesforce APIs

  

Integration

MuleSoft Anypoint  |  REST / SOAP APIs  |  Event-Driven Architecture  |  Enterprise Integration Patterns

  

Preferred Certifications

•            Salesforce Application Architect

•            Salesforce System Architect

•            Salesforce Integration Architecture Designer

•            Salesforce Data Architecture Designer

•            Salesforce Technical Architect (CTA) - highly desirable

  

Experience

•            10-15+ years of overall IT experience; 8-10+ years on the Salesforce platform. 

•            Proven delivery of large-scale, enterprise Salesforce implementations. 

•            Hands-on experience leading multi-cloud Salesforce environments and complex integrations. 

  

Key Competencies

✦  Hands-on technical leadership

✦  Enterprise architecture thinking

✦  Code quality governance

✦  Platform performance optimization

✦  Balancing vision with pragmatism

✦  Strong stakeholder communication

 - Strong expertise in Google BigQuery, cloud data warehousing, data access control, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte), batch and streaming processing, and DataOps (pipeline monitoring, job orchestration, incident resolution). 
 - Proficiency in BI and reporting (Looker, LookML, Power BI, SQL, dashboard design) and data quality engineering (data validation, automated data testing, anomaly detection).

Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

 - Knowledge of mass storage interfaces such as SATA, SAS, NVMe (optional but strong plus). 
 - Knowledge of configuring and debugging issues from the usage of register settings of ASICs in an SoC and embedded firmware dev environment
 - High level of skill in problem recreation and trapping, and in identifying performance critical algorithms for optimization. 
 - Strong skill in ARM development tools and IDE such as Eclipse
 - Ability to scope and estimate development effort. 
 - Ability to work and communicate effectively in a team, able to multitask effectively in fast-paced environment.
