Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

In this position, the individual will be responsible for Designing, implementing, debugging firmware for the next generation storage devices. Typical activities involve the design and implementation of data structures, software algorithms, data path, and implementation of storage interface protocols via PCIe. You will develop firmware using multiple environments that include SW simulations, FPGA boards, and of course the final product HW. You will work in an Agile environment with advanced CI tools and capabilities that help develop clean code fast. 

Responsibilities

- Design & Develop firmware module for front end, back end and infrastructure modules of storage device. 
 - Debug the FW issues found in various validation stages on different platforms and update on tracking tools as required. 
 - Develop / run unit tests, write scripts for testing for firmware modules. 
 - Optimize the code for memory, power and performance, and resolve the deficiencies. 
 - Steer key performance indicators for system performance and quality matrix. 
 - Collaboration with system, Validation, ASIC, program management and cross functional technology teams, to establish priorities and ensure effective implementation

Qualifications

- B. Tech. in Computer Science or Software / Computer / Electrical / Electronics Engineering
 - Previous RTOS experience - advantage (e. g. ThreadX / MQX / Nucleus / VxWorks / Embedded Linux) (desirable)
 - NAND flash fundamentals / Storage protocols / Power Management (desirable)
 - Capable of developing wide system view for complex embedded systems
 - Excellent interpersonal skills and team player
 - Fast learner and implementer

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. 

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs. accommodations@sandisk. com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Actimize
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

So, what's the role all about?

Within Actimize, the Platform Solutions Team is building the next-generation advanced entity resolution and quality assurance solution, designed to empower our clients' Financial Crime programs by providing richer data and added value to Alert Investigator. As part of our development group, you will be responsible for developing Actimize cloud-based solutions and working with cutting-edge cloud technologies. 

How will you make an impact?

Serve as a top-performing engineer by leading the redesign and optimization of our products, which were originally tailored for on-premises environments, to make them truly cloud-ready, effective, and maintainable. You'll play a key role in evolving these solutions on our AWS-based internal cloud platform, with a strong focus on resiliency, operability, and supportability as core principles during all stages of design and development. 

Have you got what it takes?

- Actively collaborate with architects and senior engineers to drive the re-architecture and modernization of products and services, ensuring they are aligned with best practices for cloud-native development and operational excellence on AWS. 
 - Identify and resolve architectural bottlenecks and design limitations, proactively recommending and implementing concrete solutions that boost scalability, maintainability, and cloud compatibility. 
 - Lead communication and documentation of all design shifts and modernization initiatives by producing clear code, comprehensive technical documentation, and facilitating in-depth discussions with both internal and cross-functional partners. 
 - Champion high standards by setting the example in code quality, automated testing, and reliability, especially as software is migrated and enhanced for the cloud; ensure that robust cloud-oriented practices are embedded throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Mentor and support teammates, promoting openness in knowledge sharing and making "thinking out loud" brainstorming sessions a regular part of team culture. 
 - Guide agile teams to deliver cloud-optimized solutions, encouraging continuous improvement and collaboration on every release. 

Qualifications: 

- Degree in Computer Science or a related field from a reputed institute. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience in Java, with deep knowledge of data structures, multithreading, OOP, design patterns, functional programming, and memory optimization. 
 - Proven experience developing with Spring and Spring Boot for web applications or web services. 
 - Required expertise with Kubernetes and Docker for container orchestration and deployment. 
 - Must have hands-on experience with Kafka for distributed messaging. 
 - Experience building, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins. 
 - Demonstrated ability working with infrastructure as code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Helm. 
 - Experience developing RESTful APIs and working within a microservices architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience with Vue 3 (required) for building complex, modern front-end applications, including state management and authentication/authorization flows. 
 - Experience with databases such as MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, including schema design, ORM integration, and query performance tuning. 
 - Experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure. 
 - Practical experience working in Agile development environments and using tools like JIRA. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Excellent communication skills and collaborative teamwork mindset. 

What's in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams - comprised of the best of the best - work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. 

Requisition ID: 11923

Reporting into: Tech Manager

Role Type: Senior Software Engineer

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25, 000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries.

data.title: Senior Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
data.description:
Role Summary

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you'll provide deep reliability and operational expertise for business-critical cloud services. You'll help set the reliability strategy (for example, defining SLOs and error budgets), design the observability and automation that keep services balanced, and lead improvements that reduce operational risk and customer impact. This role suits people who enjoy solving complex production problems and raising the standard for engineering excellence-regardless of whether your background is SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering with strong operations experience. 

On-call: You'll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. As a senior specialist, you'll help improve how we run on-call by reducing noisy alerts, automating repetitive tasks, and strengthening operational readiness so incidents become less frequent and easier to resolve. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly and continuously improve the on-call experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own reliability outcomes for critical user journeys and cloud components by defining SLIs/SLOs, setting error budgets, and using data to prioritise resilience work. 
 - Design observability standards (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting) using tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly. 
 - Lead major incident response as incident commander when needed, drive blameless post-incident reviews, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and measured. 
 - Improve platform resilience and scalability through reliability architecture reviews, capacity and performance engineering, and proactive risk assessments. 
 - Reduce toil by automating repetitive operational work (for example with Terraform, CI/CD, and scripting), and track improvements through clear operational metrics. 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Security, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, compliance obligations, and customer impact. 
 - Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and change procedures, and raise standards through reviews, templates, and shared practices. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers, helping teams adopt SRE ways of working and strengthening operational ownership. 

What You'll Bring

- Significant experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) supporting production services and making reliability improvements that stick. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of reliability practices such as SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident actions, and operational readiness. 
 - Strong AWS knowledge and hands-on experience operating cloud services (for example: EKS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and CloudWatch/CloudWatch Insights). 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (for example, Terraform) and with CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitLab CI/CD). 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, including production operations on managed platforms such as Amazon EKS. 
 - Ability to script to automate and solve (for example, Python and/or JavaScript), with an engineering approach to testing, review, and maintainability. 
 - Experience building actionable monitoring and alerting that balances sensitivity and noise (for example, Datadog and CloudWatch). 
 - Confidence presenting, staying calm during incidents, and influencing teams through data, clear writing, and pragmatic recommendations. 

Good to have Skills: 

Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, networking, security, policy, and multi-tenant considerations). 

Experience with performance testing, load testing, and capacity modelling for cloud-native services. 

Software engineering experience in Python and/or JavaScript beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews). 

Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric develop, alert tuning, incident analytics). 

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Senior Associate

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

data.description:
Why UKG

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That's what we do. 

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you'll get flexibility that's real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters-and so do you. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer III- Eng to help build and operate scalable, enterprise-grade software systems used by organizations around the world. You will work across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and implementation to deployment and operations - delivering reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions in high-scale, compliance-sensitive environments. 

This role is ideal for engineers who combine strong technical fundamentals with practical experience building distributed systems, modern cloud-native applications, and AI-augmented engineering workflows. You will leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering velocity and quality while applying sound engineering judgment, rigorous testing, and operational discipline. 

You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to design systems that are scalable, resilient, observable, and built for long-term maintainability. 

Responsibilities

- Software Engineering: 

Design, build, test, and maintain high-quality software systems and services. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code with a strong focus on correctness, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence. 

- Technical Ownership & Architecture: 

Lead the technical design and delivery of distributed, enterprise-scale systems and services. Contribute to architecture reviews, service decomposition strategies, API design, event-driven integrations, and data modeling decisions that support scalability, maintainability, and resilience. Own services end-to-end, including implementation, CI/CD automation, deployment, observability, operational health, and ongoing production support.

Maintain a high bar for code quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and strong engineering practices. Build deterministic and scalable test suites covering unit, integration, contract, and edge-case scenarios across distributed systems. 

- Reliability & Operations: 

Monitor and improve the reliability, availability, and performance of production services. Use telemetry, logging, metrics, and operational insights to proactively identify and resolve issues in high-scale environments. 

- Collaboration: 

Work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, security, and business stakeholders to deliver complex features and systems iteratively with high quality and operational excellence.

 - Experience implementing automated testing strategies across unit, integration, and contract testing layers. 
 - Experience building systems in compliance-sensitive or business-critical domains.

We are hiring a Staff DFT Engineer to lead DFT strategy, architecture, and implementation for complex, high-performance SoCs. You will define methodologies, and drive DFT from RTL to silicon bring-up, ensuring optimal quality, cost, and time-to-market. 

What You'll Do

- Define DFT architecture and test strategy for SoCs, including scan, compression, MBIST, LBIST, and IO test. 
 - Lead ATPG pattern generation, optimization, and diagnosis flows across multiple fault models. 
 - Architect and oversee MBIST, BISR, and memory repair solutions for large memory arrays. 
 - Design and implement advanced test access mechanisms using JTAG, Boundary Scan (BSCAN), and IJTAG (IEEE 1687). 
 - Drive DFT timing closure, power-aware DFT, and hierarchical/multi-core test strategies. 
 - Own pre-silicon DFT verification (ATPG simulation, GLS) and coverage closure. 
 - Lead silicon bring-up, ATE test program development, post-silicon validation, debug, and yield improvement. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate DFT into the overall design flow and resolve complex issues. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers; contribute to methodology development and tool evaluation. 
 - Optimize test time, data volume, and manufacturing test costs. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's/master's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering. 
 - 8+ years of strong hands-on experience in DFT for complex SoC/ASIC projects. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, IJTAG, BSCAN, scan compression, and related areas. 
 - Proven track record in silicon bring-up, ATE support, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Deep understanding of full ASIC flow (RTL to Silicon) and DFT impact on PPA. 
 - Proficiency with leading EDA tools (Synopsys TetraMAX/DFTMAX, Siemens/Tessent SSN, TestKompress etc. ). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills. 

Good To Have

- Knowledge of advanced topics like 2. 5D/3D packaging test, analog/mixed-signal DFT. 

Job Location

Hybrid/ On-site - Bangalore / Remote - India

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

data.title: Software Validation Lead
data.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient's mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. 

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised. 

What You Can Expect

Software Validation Lead provides technical leadership and strategic oversight for the validation lifecycle of regulated computerized systems supporting business operations within a Medical Device environment. The role is responsible for ensuring computerized systems are developed, implemented, enhanced, and maintained in a validated state through the application of risk-based validation methodologies, regulatory compliance, and industry best practices. This position partners with cross-functional teams to develop validation strategies, guide testing and data migration/transformation activities, support system lifecycle changes, drive process improvements, support supplier/3rd Party vendors oversight validation activities, and ensure solutions meet business, quality, cybersecurity, and GxP requirements and keep the system audit-ready. 

Work Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)

Shift Timing - 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM

How You'll Create Impact

- Leads multiple concurrent high-complexity software validation projects, enhancements, and changes which align to defined procedures
 - Leads gap and risk analysis of IT system changes to ensure appropriate testing levels/strategies are identified as per CSV/CSA principles across projects and platforms. 
 - Works with project teams to develop, review, and approve comprehensive risk-based validation lifecycle documentation, including Validation Plans, Risk Assessments, Requirements, Traceability Matrices, IQ/OQ/UAT Test cases, Validation Summary Reports, and Change Control documentation aligned with CSV, CSA, GAMP 5, and regulatory expectations
 - Guides testing to ensure the quality of software meets the approved intended use prior to production release
 - Define risk-based verification strategies, advising project teams on functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, infrastructure, and automated testing approaches based on system complexity, intended use, and regulatory risk. 
 - Develop validation strategy for data migration/transformation activities by defining migration verification methodologies, reconciliation processes, sampling strategies, traceability requirements, data integrity controls, and acceptance criteria to ensure complete and accurate migration of regulated data
 - Provides change management support for regulated applications by performing change impact assessments, reviewing change requests, defining regression testing requirements, and evaluating implementation risks
 - Develop and deliver structured training and mentoring programs on Computer Software Assurance (CSA), Computer System Validation (CSV), validation lifecycle processes, ALM, and risk-based testing methodologies to improve process consistency
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating existing validation processes, identifying operational inefficiencies, recommending standardized methodologies, and implementing best practices that improve compliance, consistency, quality, and delivery efficiency
 - Acts as a cross-functional resource by partnering with Business, Quality, and Technical teams and ensures compliance with regulatory and corporate policies and standards. 
 - Provide validation guidance for cloud-based, SaaS, and hybrid-hosted applications. 
 - Meet defined deadlines for assigned tasks and scheduled deliverables
 - Support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits by providing Computer System Validation expertise and required validation evidence, and inspection-ready documentation. 
 - Provides mentoring and coaching to junior team members
 - Apply concepts of appropriate standard methodologies and best practices
 - Leads the adoption of validation practices for AI-enabled systems by developing risk-based validation approaches

Preferred Validation Experience

- Partner with Information Security and Infrastructure teams to assess cybersecurity-related system changes and determine validation impact, testing requirements, and compliance considerations. 
 - Provide validation guidance for assessment of supplier controls, infrastructure qualification reliance, and shared responsibility considerations

What Makes You Stand Out

- Experience with Medical Device or Pharmaceutical industries desired. 
 - Advanced knowledge of applicable global regulations and industry guidance, including 21 CFR Part 11, 21 CFR Part 820, GAMP 5 (2nd Edition), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and risk-based validation methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to interpret regulatory expectations and translate them into practical validation strategies for enterprise software implementations and system changes. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, system integrations, APIs, interfaces, data flows, middleware, cloud technologies, authentication mechanisms, and database concepts sufficient to assess validation impact and testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile, V-model, Waterfall, Hybrid SDLC methodologies. 
 - Highly motivated self-starter with strong attention to detail and proven ability to prioritize and scope work. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Flexibility to handle demands of a rapidly growing and changing workplace. 
 - General wide breadth of knowledge of the different Microsoft Office applications. 
 - Advanced experience with test management tools (ALM)
 - Working knowledge of validation considerations for AI-enabled software solutions. 
 - Ability to assess validation implications of emerging technologies while ensuring continued compliance with regulatory expectations. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, Engineering, Science, or related field. 
 - A minimum of 10plus years in an FDA/ISO regulated industry working on Computerized System Validation (CSV) activities. 
 - Demonstrated experience supporting GxP regulated computerized systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA). 
 - Experience leading validation activities for enterprise software implementations, upgrades, migrations, and integrations.

Up to 15%

data.title: Lead – AI Automation & Digital Transformation
data.description:
Lead - AI Automation & Digital Transformation

Global Trading | Minerals & Metals | Manufacturing | Supply Chain | Trade Finance

Location: Hyderabad, India

Experience: 6-10 years

Employment: Full-time

Reporting: Group President / Senior Management

About the Group

We are a diversified international business group with operations and commercial interests across multiple countries, specializing in minerals and metals trading, manufacturing, sourcing, imports, exports, logistics, and trade finance. 

As part of our digital transformation initiative, we intend to develop an integrated, AI-enabled business operating platform that connects our commercial, operational, financial, and management functions. 

We are seeking a hands-on AI Automation Lead capable of independently designing, developing, deploying, and scaling intelligent automation solutions across the group. 

Position Objective

To lead the development of a centralized AI-powered business automation and intelligence ecosystem covering the complete commercial lifecycle-from global market research, customer acquisition, supplier sourcing, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, international logistics, and trade finance through collections, financial realization, and management reporting. 

The successful candidate must combine strong software engineering capabilities with an understanding of business processes, data architecture, enterprise integrations, and AI-powered research systems. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. AI Agents, Bots & Intelligent Workflow Automation

* Design and deploy AI-powered agents and bots for business process automation. 

* Build intelligent workflows using Python, n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or equivalent technologies. 

* Automate data collection, document processing, email classification, task allocation, approvals, reminders, and management reporting. 

* Develop AI systems capable of extracting, analyzing, validating, and organizing structured and unstructured business information. 

* Implement reliable workflow orchestration, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval mechanisms. 

B. End-to-End Trade & Manufacturing Automation

* Map and automate the full purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes. 

* Digitize RFQs, quotations, purchase orders, sales contracts, supplier management, and customer order tracking. 

* Develop manufacturing and inventory monitoring systems covering raw materials, production status, quality checks, warehouse movements, and dispatches. 

* Automate export/import documentation workflows including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, inspection certificates, and customs-related documents. 

* Integrate shipping, freight forwarding, logistics milestones, delivery confirmations, and transaction-level profitability. 

* Establish transaction-level visibility across all participating group entities. 

C. Global Market Research & Commercial Intelligence

* Develop AI-enabled research systems for international minerals and metals markets. 

* Build searchable, structured databases of global importers, exporters, buyers, manufacturers, suppliers, commodity traders, and logistics providers. 

* Automate market mapping by commodity, country, trade route, demand, supply, and potential business opportunity. 

* Collect and analyze information from licensed trade databases, public registries, market intelligence platforms, and authorized data sources. 

* Build data enrichment, duplicate detection, company classification, contact verification, and research update workflows. 

* Generate actionable business intelligence reports for commercial and business development teams. 

D. Trade Finance, Banking & Investment Intelligence

* Build and maintain structured databases of international banks, NBFCs, trade finance institutions, private credit funds, alternative lenders, and investment institutions. 

* Develop tools to identify potential financing institutions based on geography, transaction type, commodity, collateral, and funding requirements. 

* Automate lender prospect research, eligibility screening, outreach tracking, follow-ups, and financing pipeline management. 

* Develop systems to organize financing documentation, transaction information, KYC requirements, and due diligence checklists. 

* Automate monitoring of letters of credit, bank guarantees, receivables financing, invoice discounting, trade loans, and other working capital arrangements. 

* Build dashboards for funding proposals, lender engagement, sanctions, disbursements, repayment schedules, and outstanding obligations. 

E. Group Management Information Systems

* Develop centralized management dashboards covering multiple group companies and international operations. 

* Consolidate data from ERP, accounting, spreadsheets, databases, emails, and operational applications. 

* Automate daily, weekly, and monthly reporting. 

* Develop dashboards for procurement, production, sales, shipments, inventory, profitability, working capital, cash flow, receivables, and financing. 

* Create exception-based alerts for management intervention. 

* Establish consistent reporting definitions, data quality controls, and entity-wise access permissions. 

F. Systems Integration & Technology Architecture

* Design scalable databases, APIs, data pipelines, workflow engines, and internal applications. 

* Integrate existing ERP, CRM, accounting, document management, and communication platforms. 

* Develop secure cloud-based or hybrid technology infrastructure. 

* Implement role-based access control, encryption, logging, monitoring, backup, and recovery processes. 

* Ensure compliance with applicable data protection, cross-border data transfer, and commercial data licensing requirements. 

* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, testing procedures, and deployment standards. 

Mandatory Technical Qualifications

* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, REST APIs, and backend development. 

* Practical experience integrating LLMs and developing AI agents, tool-calling systems, and retrieval-augmented generation solutions. 

* Hands-on experience with n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or equivalent workflow automation platforms. 

* Experience in database architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, data extraction, validation, and integration. 

* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or comparable relational databases. 

* Working knowledge of Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools. 

* Experience integrating ERP, CRM, finance, and third-party business applications. 

* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Docker, Git, CI/CD, testing, and production monitoring. 

* Ability to independently take solutions from business requirements through deployment and maintenance. 

Preferred Experience

* International trade and commodity trading operations. 

* Manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, and logistics technology. 

* Trade finance, banking, lending, or fintech automation. 

* Multi-company, multi-currency, and cross-border operations. 

* Enterprise automation projects with measurable business outcomes. 

Key Performance Indicators

* Number of production-ready automations deployed and adopted. 

* Reduction in manual processing time and repetitive work. 

* Improvement in transaction visibility and operational turnaround time. 

* Accuracy, completeness, and freshness of business intelligence databases. 

* Reliability of integrations and management dashboards. 

* Reduction in reporting delays and operational exceptions. 

* Measurable commercial value generated through improved research, workflow efficiency, and financial visibility. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a builder, not merely a technology coordinator. 

The ideal candidate should be technically independent, commercially aware, analytical, and capable of working closely with senior leadership. 

They must be able to understand business operations, translate requirements into technical solutions, write and review code, integrate systems, troubleshoot production issues, and progressively establish a scalable technology ecosystem. 

- This is a high-ownership role with the opportunity to architect and build the digital intelligence and automation infrastructure of an international business group

data.description:
Position Title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 45078

Role Overview

The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes. 

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline. 

Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Reliability: Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services. 

CI/CD & Release Engineering: Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability. 

DevSecOps Adoption: Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance. 

Security by Design: Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. 

Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling. 

GitOps & Kubernetes: Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman. 

Toolchain Availability: Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows. 

Automated Governance: Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines. 

Observability & Self-Healing: Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience. 

Performance & Operations: Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure. 

Cross-Functional Architecture: Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards. 

AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability. 

Documentation & Enablement: Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices. 

Automation Culture: Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation. 

Required Skills And Experience

Core Experience

10+ years of relevant experience in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps. 

Hands-on engineering experience designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks. 

Strong programming and scripting capability using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages. 

Proven operational discipline across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation. 

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams. 

Technical Capabilities Required

Capability Area

Expected Experience

Cloud Platforms

Microsoft Azure (Must); Google Cloud Platform (Nice to have). 

Source Control & CI/CD

GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms. 

Infrastructure as Code & Configuration

Terraform, Terratest, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt, or equivalent tools. 

Containers & Orchestration

Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, kubectl, Helm, Docker, Podman, or comparable technologies. 

GitOps & Continuous Delivery

Argo CD, Flux CD, or equivalent GitOps tooling. 

Application & Supply-Chain Security

SonarQube, Snyk, Akido, Chaingaurd, SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, dependency scanning, secrets scanning, and quality gates. 

Artifact & Package Management

JFrog Artifactory or equivalent artifact repositories. 

Observability

Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or equivalent monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms. 

ITSM & Work Management

ServiceNow, Jira, automated change integration, and auditable delivery workflows. Handson Experience of integrating DevOps tools chain and ServiceNow and Jira Integration

Testing & Service Virtualization

Selenium, Tosca, automated functional/performance/security testing, and service virtualization tools. 

Linux & Networking

Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine, RHEL; TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, SMTP, FTP, and cloud networking fundamentals. 

AI-Enabled Engineering

GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding and engineering assistants, used within defined governance and security controls. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 

Relevant public cloud certification in Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is required. 

DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, or CNCF certification is preferred. 

Experience with Agile and DevOps delivery methods and with planning, estimation, and delivery in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 

Demonstrated learning agility with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies responsibly. 

Preferred Attributes

- Systems thinker who balances developer experience, security, reliability, governance, and cost. 
 - Self-starter who can operate with appropriate autonomy while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment. 
 - Pragmatic engineer who favors standards, reusable products, automation, and measurable outcomes over one-off solutions. 
 - Curious and adaptable, with a commitment to continuous learning and responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices. 

Key Outcomes

So, what's the role all about?

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions that ensure the delivery of high-quality software products. You will work closely with developers, QA engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders to build robust automation frameworks, define and execute test strategies, and embed quality best practices throughout the software development lifecycle. This role requires strong expertise in Java, API test automation, and backend quality engineering, with experience using Playwright and related automation technologies. You will play a key role in improving product quality, reliability, and release confidence. 

How will you make an impact?

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. 
 - Build, enhance, and maintain automation frameworks using Java, Playwright, and related testing technologies. 
 - Create automated test cases and test scenarios based on business requirements, technical specifications, and user stories.

data.description:
Job Summary

The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations. 

Responsibilities

- Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases. 
 - Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders. 
 - Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality. 
 - Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes. 
 - Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions. 
 - Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines. 
 - Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services. 
 - Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms. 
 - Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations. 
 - Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems. 
 - Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel. 

Qualifications

- Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases. 
 - Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort. 
 - Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances. 
 - Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models. 
 - Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability. 
 - Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

data.title: Technical Lead - OpenBlue CUPO Systems Specialist
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Johnson Controls is shaping a future that is more productive, secure, and sustainable by applying cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and Design Thinking to intelligent buildings. 

In this role, you will help deliver OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions that support reliable, efficient central utilities for critical environments such as universities, hospitals, airports, office towers, and data centers. 

Role Overview

- Based in Pune, this position leads the engineering, integration, commissioning, and optimization of OpenBlue CUP solutions for district energy and chiller plants globally. You will serve as the technical lead for project execution, aligning delivery with customer objectives, schedules, and performance goals while helping drive energy savings, reduced water use, and lower carbon impact. 
 - Key Responsibilities
 - Lead the engineering and project execution of OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions from design through closeout. 
 - Analyze site and operational data to build accurate energy models using CUPO software and identify optimization opportunities. 
 - Prepare drawings, scopes of work, and recommissioning requirements for sensors, meters, and controls needed to make a plant CUP-ready. 
 - Oversee system design, programming, installation coordination, commissioning, performance validation, and project closeout activities. 
 - Create and execute integration test plans with controls service contractors to verify bidirectional data and command flow between CPO and the plant automation system. 
 - Oversee point mapping and local plant automation programming to support smooth transitions between operating modes. 
 - Validate system functionality, analyze command dispatch results, and resolve issues throughout commissioning and startup. 
 - Collaborate with customers, plant operators, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance outcomes. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentor engineering team members, and train operators and end users on OpenBlue CUP solutions. 
 - Maintain strong ethics, quality, safety, and compliance with Johnson Controls policies and applicable regulations. 
 - How You Will Do It
 - Own project outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping delivery aligned to scope, schedule, and customer expectations. 
 - Stay close to the work by reviewing plant data, point maps, and field results to identify practical optimization actions and remove obstacles quickly. 
 - Improve every day through structured test plans, candid troubleshooting, and continuous refinement of engineering standards and methods. 
 - Win as one team by working closely with controls contractors, project managers, operators, and other engineering disciplines. 
 - Lead regular progress meetings, document decisions clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of risks, changes, and commissioning status. 
 - Use Microsoft Project or similar tools to support planning, coordination, and milestone tracking. 
 - Translate technical findings into clear training and support so plant teams can confidently operate the CUP solution. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in building automation controls engineering, programming, and commissioning. 
 - Strong expertise in integrating building systems using industry-standard protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks. 
 - Proven experience designing, implementing, and commissioning central utility plant control systems, including automation startup and commissioning for at least five live critical facility projects. 
 - Hands-on experience in energy modeling, chiller plant optimization, data analytics, and performance assessment using software tools. 
 - Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards and provide technical leadership to engineering teams. 
 - Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills, with experience using Microsoft Project or similar tools. 
 - Prior experience supervising and mentoring technical or engineering staff. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail. 
 - Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international assignments. 

Nice to Have

- Master's degree or Professional Engineer registration. 
 - Strong understanding of energy modeling and data analytics. 
 - Strong background in the Metasys suite of tools. 
 - Programming capability for multiple makes and models of building automation systems and PLC systems. 

Why Join Us

You will contribute to meaningful work that helps customers reduce operating costs, lower energy consumption, and improve the performance of critical central plants. This is an opportunity to apply your technical leadership in a collaborative environment focused on intelligent buildings, sustainability, and reliable outcomes. 

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we invite you to apply and help shape the future of OpenBlue CUP solutions.

data.title: Lead Robotics Engineer
data.description:
Company Description MultiplexEV is an agritech organization focused on building electric tractors, and construction equipments from the ground up. The company leverages advanced technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), to power smart farming solutions. These innovations support farm health monitoring and precision agriculture, helping farmers make data-driven decisions and improve productivity. MultiplexEV operates at the intersection of electric vehicles and agriculture, offering a dynamic environment for professionals interested in sustainable, tech-driven farming. 

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership

- Define the system architecture for perception, planning, controls and hardware interfaces
 - Make build-vs-buy and technology-stack decisions (ROS 2, simulation tools, compute platforms)
 - Set engineering standards for code quality, testing, safety and documentation
 - Review designs and code; be the final technical escalation point

Hands-on engineering

- Develop and optimise core modules in motion planning, controls, localisation or manipulation
 - Lead sensor integration and calibration (LiDAR, cameras, IMU, encoders, force/torque)
 - Build simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test pipelines to cut field debugging time
 - Diagnose complex failures across software, electronics and mechanics

Team and delivery

- Hire, mentor and grow a team of robotics engineers
 - Plan roadmaps and sprints with product, hardware and operations teams
 - Own delivery from prototype to production and field deployment
 - Drive compliance with relevant safety standards: ISO 3691-4 (indoor AMRs), ISO 18497 (agricultural machines), ISO 17757 (construction and mining machines) and ISO 13849 (safety-related control systems)

Required qualifications

- B. Tech/B. E. , M. S. or Ph. D. in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science or a related field
 - 6-8 years building robotic systems, with at least one product shipped to real users or customers
 - 2+ years leading engineers, formally or as tech lead
 - Strong C++ (modern C++14/17) and Python, with deep experience in ROS 2, Linux and real-time systems
 - Hands-on autonomous navigation for wheeled or tracked vehicles: localisation, path planning and path following for skid-steer and Ackermann platforms
 - Multi-sensor fusion across LiDAR, radar, cameras, IMU, wheel odometry and RTK-GNSS
 - Robust localisation where GNSS is weak or missing: warehouses, vineyard rows under canopy, underground or open-pit mines
 - Navigation on uneven terrain: traversability mapping, slope handling, and obstacle and person detection in cluttered outdoor scenes
 - Experience with ROS 2 navigation stacks (Nav2, Autoware or similar) and simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
 - Track record of debugging integrated hardware-software systems in the field

Preferred qualifications

- Converting existing machines to autonomy: drive-by-wire integration and vehicle buses such as CAN, J1939 or ISOBUS
 - Ruggedising sensors and compute against dust, mud, rain, vibration and heat (enclosures, sensor cleaning, IP ratings)
 - Vineyard or orchard row-following, or autonomy for haul and earth-moving machines at construction and mining sites
 - Fleet management, teleoperation fallback and connectivity over 4G/5G or private LTE
 - Perception and ML for outdoor autonomy, with edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson or similar
 - Running field-test programmes at real customer sites

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

Role Overview

The DevOps Architect - Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams - across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks - to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level - defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck - that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model - governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: S

- CI/CD Pipeline Architecture - Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado - defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release. 
 - Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology - defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements. 
 - Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy - including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging - ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled. 
 - Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model - defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale. 
 - Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments - defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves. 
 - Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite - including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests - integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage. 
 - Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline - enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT. 
 - Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4-5 active migration tracks - designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components. 
 - Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework - ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments. 
 - Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments - including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management. 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework - including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership. 
 - DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track - setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams. 
 - Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling - including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows. 
 - Continuous Improvement - Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave - pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps 
 - Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks - maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice. 

Core Technical Skills - Must Have

- Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX - scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments - using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows. 
 - Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform - Gearset or Copado - including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration. 
 - Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency - branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories. 
 - Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery - including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning. 
 - Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills - Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management - required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components. 
 - Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform. 
 - Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce - Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates - defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams. 
 - Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments. 
 - Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration - capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments. 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting - using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar - for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments. 
 - Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control. 

PREFERRED SKILLS - GOOD TO HAVE: E

- Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
 - Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
 - Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
 - Familiarity with Salesforce Shield - Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail - as part of production environment governance
 - Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling - SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework 
 - Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
 - Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
 - Familiarity with DataOps practices - data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
 - Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance - managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

Experience Requirements

- 10-16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
 - 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience - owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
 - 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes - managing 4+ concurrent release streams
 - Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
 - Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
 - Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows - ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines

Salesforce & Platform Certifications

Job Description

Do you have a passion for network automation?

Be part of Akamai's Core IP Networking team!

Our team supports Akamai's global backbone and networking technologies by solving operational challenges through code. This position focuses on reducing toil through code, improving our ability to build and scale. As SRE, you will be a crucial part of our ability to deliver global infrastructure connectivity for the next generation of Akamai's services. 

Partner with the best

Our SRE team sits directly next to Architecture, Engineering and Ops. We are tasked with identifying the biggest areas for improvement and are responsible for designing and building solutions. With a focus on software, you will be directly responsible for continuously improving Akamai's ability to monitor and operate our backbone. 

As a Site Reliability Engineer II, you will be responsible for: 

- Designing and building systems that support automated operational workflows and provide deep insights into our global network data
 - Identifying and eliminate bottlenecks in operational workflows caused by process inefficiencies, manual toil, and technical debt
 - Generating telemetry data and deep observability for network infrastructure
 - Architecting our code to be self-sustainable, robust and easily maintainable, focusing on CI/CD, test-driven development, and iterative design

Do What You Love

- Have 2 and more years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, 
 - Have programming experience with Python/JavaScript, ability to design and develop scalable full-stack systems using appropriate frameworks and SDLC best practices. 
 - Have experience with containers, Kubernetes, service orchestration, microservices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and modern DevOps practices.

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We're doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here. 

Learn more

data.description:
. NET Application Reliability

· Read, debug, and contribute to production C#/. NET code to diagnose and fix app-level reliability issues. 

· Identify and resolve memory leaks, thread pool exhaustion, and GC pressure before they manifest as incidents. 

· Partner with application engineers to embed reliability into new feature design and deployment practices. 

· Instrument . NET services with distributed tracing and structured logging to surface runtime anomalies early. 

AWS Compute & Infrastructure

· Operate and optimize EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate, and Lambda workloads - with clear judgment on when each is the right fit. 

· Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using CloudFormation or CDK for consistent, reproducible environments. 

· Automate operational tasks, deployment pipelines, and disaster recovery procedures. 

· Continuously reduce toil through tooling and automation, freeing the team for higher-impact engineering work. 

RDS SQL Server Operations

· Manage RDS SQL Server deployments including Multi-AZ failover configuration and read replica setup. 

· Operate backup and point-in-time recovery (PITR) processes and validate restore procedures regularly. 

· Diagnose and resolve performance issues: slow queries, missing indexes, and blocking chains. 

· Capacity plan and scale database infrastructure to support transaction volume growth. 

Observability & Monitoring

· Build and maintain observability stacks using CloudWatch metrics, log insights, and alarms; AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing. 

· Own service health dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, and drive data-driven reliability improvements. 

· Design alerts that surface signal - not noise - and ensure on-call responders have the context to act quickly. 

· Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on incidents and lead blameless post-mortems to capture lessons and prevent recurrence. 

Networking & Security

· Design and maintain secure AWS network topologies: VPCs, subnets, security groups, and NACLs. 

· Configure and manage ALB/NLB routing, Route 53 DNS, and TLS certificate lifecycle via ACM. 

· Author and review least-privilege IAM policies; audit roles and resource-based policies for over-permissioning. 

· Support compliance and security controls relevant to a PCI-regulated payments environment. 

Incident Response & On-Call

· Participate in on-call rotation to respond to production incidents and drive swift resolution. 

· Define and track error budgets; use them to balance velocity and reliability investment. 

· Communicate status updates clearly during incidents and coordinate cross-functional response. 

· Maintain and improve runbooks, escalation paths, and on-call health over time. 

Cross-Functional Partnership

· Collaborate with platform engineering teams on architecture decisions and scalability requirements. 

· Share observability and reliability best practices with application teams. 

· Mentor engineers on SRE principles and operational excellence. 

· 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, or a systems-focused software engineering role. 

· C#/. NET engineering ability - can read, debug, and contribute to production code; experience diagnosing memory leaks, thread exhaustion, and GC pressure. 

· AWS compute fluency: hands-on depth across EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate, and Lambda, with informed opinions on when to use each. 

· RDS SQL Server operational experience: Multi-AZ failover, read replicas, backup/PITR, slow query analysis, and blocking chain resolution. 

· Native AWS observability proficiency: CloudWatch (metrics, logs, alarms), X-Ray, and infrastructure-as-code via CloudFormation or CDK. 

· AWS networking and security competence: VPCs, security groups, ALB/NLB, Route 53, TLS/ACM, and least-privilege IAM. 

· SLO discipline: experience defining SLIs/SLOs against real metrics, running blameless postmortems, and carrying an on-call pager. 

· Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and operational tooling. 

· Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, blameless engineering mindset. 

· Genuine openness to adopting AI tools and a willingness to experiment with new technology to work smarter and faster.

About the role

We are looking for an AI-native Senior Forward Development Engineer with strong expertise in Flutter and good hands-on experience with React and Java (Spring Boot), who can design and build scalable services and web applications for large-scale public health and governance platforms. 

By AI-native, we mean an engineer who treats AI as a core part of how software is designed, built, tested, and shipped. Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily to multiply their output, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything they deliver. 

The role involves understanding user problems, shaping simple and effective solutions, designing user-centric mobile experiences, building reusable UI components, integrating applications with backend APIs, and owning features from problem definition through development, testing, and release.
