data.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

As a Lead Manufacturing Engineer, you will collaborate closely with global operating units, suppliers, sourcing, quality, regulatory, and engineering teams to ensure timely and successful completion of assigned programs. This role will focus on medium- to high-complexity manufacturing transfers, supplier transfer programs, vertical integration, cost optimization, process qualification, PPAP execution, and manufacturing readiness. You will help strengthen supply reliability, improve cost competitiveness, and support the delivery of high-quality medical technology for patients around the world. You will be expected to lead technical discussions, resolve manufacturing challenges, apply data-driven engineering judgment, and model the Medtronic Mindset by acting boldly, moving with speed and decisiveness, fostering belonging, and delivering results the right way. 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: 

- Lead end-to-end execution of manufacturing transfer, qualification, and optimization projects from scoping through implementation. 
 - Plan, schedule, track, and report project progress against quality, cost, and timeline commitments. 
 - Collaborate with global operating units, suppliers, sourcing, quality, regulatory, and engineering stakeholders to ensure timely project execution. 
 - Identify risks, challenges, and constraints early and drive mitigation plans with cross-functional teams. 
 - Facilitate supplier and cross-functional reviews to support alignment, decision-making, and project governance. 
 - Manufacturing Engineering and Supplier Support
 - Provide technical support to suppliers by interpreting product drawings, reviewing manufacturing drawings, and resolving production-related technical issues. 
 - Review and validate engineering drawings for manufacturability, accuracy, completeness, and alignment with applicable engineering standards. 
 - Support manufacturing process development for injection molding, stamping, pressure die casting, cleanroom manufacturing, and related regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Drive the process improvement opportunities to strengthen manufacturing robustness, accelerate milestones, and improve decision-making. 
 - Review and validate PPAP deliverables to confirm compliance with technical specifications and quality expectations. 
 - Process Qualification and Validation
 - Lead or support process qualification activities, including Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ). 
 - Develop, review, and approve Master Validation Plans, process flows, validation protocols, and related qualification documentation. 
 - Apply medical device manufacturing standards, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), 21 CFR Part 11 expectations, and quality management requirements. 
 - Ensure validation documentation and supporting artifacts are complete, compliant, and ready for stage-gate approvals. 
 - Statistical Analysis and Measurement Systems
 - Use Minitab and statistical tools to perform process capability studies, including Cpk and related process performance analysis. 
 - Conduct ANOVA, regression, criticality analysis, and data-driven studies to improve process reliability and quality. 
 - Perform Measurement System Analysis, including GR&R studies, and identify appropriate MSA methods for process and inspection needs. 
 - Use statistical evidence to support validation conclusions, supplier readiness, and manufacturing decision-making. 
 - Risk Management and Compliance
 - Engineering Change Management
 - Partner with Quality during risk management activities and actively participate in design and process reviews, including DFMEA and PFMEA. 
 - Identify risks impacting cost, quality, manufacturability, compliance, and schedule, and drive mitigation actions with suppliers and cross-functional teams. 
 - Support engineering change management activities using PLM/PDM systems such as Agile and Windchill. 
 - Maintain required compliance documentation and ensure technical artifacts support stage-gate reviews, change approvals, and quality requirements. 

Required Knowledge and Experience: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, or a related engineering discipline with 10 to 14 years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, supplier transfers, process validation, product sustenance, or regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Strong understanding of medical device manufacturing standards, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11 expectations, validation practices, and quality management systems. 
 - Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as injection molding, stamping, pressure die casting, and cleanroom manufacturing setups. 
 - Strong knowledge of DFMEA, PFMEA, risk management, root cause analysis, and corrective action practices. 
 - Working knowledge of CAD tools such as SolidWorks or Creo and PLM/PDM systems such as Agile or Windchill. 
 - DMAIC Or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification or demonstrated experience applying Lean Six Sigma methods. 
 - Strong project planning, organization, communication, presentation, stakeholder management, influence management, and conflict resolution skills. 
 - Experience in supplier transfer, vertical integration, localization, cost optimization, or value engineering programs. 
 - Exposure should-costing, DFMA, aPriori, VAVE, SAVE/INVEST, or similar cost excellence methodologies. 
 - Exposure to GD&T, tolerance stack-up and reverse engineering methods. 
 - PMP training or certification or demonstrated experience managing cross-functional engineering projects. 
 - Knowledge of Power BI, data analytics, Python, or automation tools for reporting, process tracking, and decision support. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage. 



This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

data.title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
data.description:
Role: Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

Function: Quality Engineering / Software Testing

Location: Gurugram or Kolkata

Type: Full-time

Industry: AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

About Company

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U. S. dental market. 

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily. 

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented - quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end. 

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place. 

Position Overview

This role leads a team of 6-10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows - through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms. 
 - Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation - personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure. 
 - Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability. 
 - Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows - build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed. 
 - Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6-10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth - raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount. 

Must Have Criteria

- 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months. 
 - Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework. 
 - Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability. 
 - Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents - able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught. 
 - Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount. 

Nice to Have

- Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows. 
 - Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms. 
 - Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing. 
 - Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization. 

What We Offer

- Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company. 
 - Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team. 
 - Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture. 
 - Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact. 
 - Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner - not a process gatekeeper.

We are looking for an experienced Non-Functional Tester to help define and establish the non-functional testing strategy for our Digital & Integration platform, with a primary focus on Nexus v4. The platform is continuing to grow, with new components and APIs being delivered to integrate both existing and new applications. Recent work demonstrates the breadth of Nexus integrations and the importance of end-to-end API behaviour, environment configuration, resilience and release validation. Key responsibilities: Define the overall NFT/performance testing strategy and approach for Nexus v4 and its APIs/components. Lead the adoption, governance of NFT tools and frameworks and drive optimization initiatives/improvements. Identify appropriate performance, load, stress, scalability, resilience and capacity testing requirements. Establish suitable tooling, environments, test data, monitoring, baselines and measurable NFRs. Design representative end-to-end workloads covering Nexus APIs and upstream/downstream integrations. Define workload models, test scenarios, test data requirements, and success criteria. Work closely with engineering, QA and platform teams to embed NFT into the delivery lifecycle and provide a repeatable approach for future components. Identify performance risks and bottlenecks and provide clear recommendations for remediation and optimisation. Skills & ExperienceProven experience leading non-functional testing activities within Agile and DevOps environments. Strong expertise in performance testing tools (JMeter)Strong understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, and distributed systems. Experience with observability and monitoring tools -

NewRelic ( Optional if we are going to visit the area) Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and communication skills. We are looking for someone who can lead and shape the approach rather than simply execute existing performance tests, with strong experience of API/integration platforms.

data.title: Senior Test Engineer
data.description:
Senior Test Engineer, IMS & AI Communication Products

Role Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Test Engineer with 5-6 years of experience in testing IMS-based telecom products and next-generation AI-powered communication applications, including Voice Translation, Speech Processing, Conversational AI, and Real-Time Media platforms

Key Responsibilities

IMS & Telecom Testing

- Perform functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing of IMS-based products. 
 - Validate end-to-end call flows across IMS network elements. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot telecom signaling and media issues. 
 - Execute interoperability testing with various IMS components and network elements. 
 - Perform capacity, load, scalability, failover, resiliency, and soak testing. AI Product Testing

- Test AI-powered communication products such as: 
 - Voice Translation
 - Speech-to-Text (STT)
 - Text-to-Speech (TTS)
 - Conversational AI / Voice Bots
 - Real-time Media Processing
 - Validate AI inference accuracy, latency, scalability, and multilingual capabilities. 
 - Develop test scenarios for AI model validation and user experience verification. Automation & Cloud-Native Testing

- Design and implement automation frameworks using Python. 
 - Develop test scripts for validating APIs, SIP call flows, and media scenarios. 
 - Execute testing in Kubernetes/OpenShift environments. 
 - Validate deployment, upgrade, rollback, and high-availability scenarios. Protocol & Media Validation

- Analyze SIP traces using Wireshark, HOMER, or equivalent tools. 
 - Validate RTP, SRTP, RTCP media flows. 
 - Debug signaling and media issues across distributed systems. Review logs, packet captures, and KPIs to identify product defects

Job Requirements

- Telecom / IMS: IMS Architecture, SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, Diameter, HTTP/REST APIs, WebRTC
 - IMS Network Elements: SBC, TAS/Application Server, MRF, IMS Core Components
 - Cloud & Containerization: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Helm, Microservices, Cloud-Native Deployments, OpenShift (Plus)
 - Automation: Python (Mandatory), API Automation, PyTest/Robot Framework, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions)
 - Testing & Monitoring Tools: Spirent Landslide, Spirent Abacus, Ixia, Wireshark, HOMER, SIPp, Prometheus/Grafana (Preferred)
 - Experience: 5 - 8 years of relevant experience
 - Candidates available to join immediate and currently working in Bangalore are preferred

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
About Foundry

Foundry is GreyOrange's platform for designing and validating automated warehouses. It lets teams go from an early concept to a fully validated solution before anything is built: they model flows, size equipment and robot fleets, lay out the warehouse, and simulate how it will perform. Discrete event simulation (DES) is at the heart of the platform. It lets engineers and customers test thousands of what-if scenarios in minutes instead of days. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the technical direction of our discrete event simulation engine. You will set the architecture and lead the engineering of a high-performance simulator for multi-agent warehouse robotics, and grow it into a fast, accurate, extensible product that customers and partners can build on. 

This is a hands-on role. You will write core engine code, make the key architecture calls, and work closely with product, platform, and robotics teams. The aim is for simulation to be the trusted basis for high-stakes design and sizing decisions. 

What You'll Do

Own the simulation architecture and roadmap

- Define the multi-year technical vision for the simulation engine and how it evolves to meet growing product needs. 
 - Make the core engine decisions: event scheduling, time management, deterministic replay, state representation, and scaling to large fleets and long simulated horizons. 
 - Serve as the final technical authority on simulation design, and represent it in platform-wide architecture reviews. 

Build a world-class simulation core

- Lead development of a high-performance engine, with a focus on throughput, latency, and memory efficiency so that large parameter sweeps run quickly and cheaply. 
 - Model warehouse operations faithfully, including robot navigation and traffic, congestion and resource contention, charging, workstation behavior, and a range of picking and putaway workflows. 
 - Set fidelity standards and calibrate simulation results against higher-fidelity testing and real-world operational data, so customers can trust the output. 

Make simulation an extensible, API-first product

- Design versioned, public schemas and APIs for simulation inputs, job control, real-time streaming, and results, so customers can integrate their own data sources and tools or run simulations headless. 
 - Build a secure plugin architecture so customers and partners can bring their own algorithms and strategies. 
 - Define validation rules that decide when a warehouse design has enough detail to simulate. 

Integrate across the platform

- Work with platform teams on asynchronous job execution, cancellation, and multi-tenant scaling. 
 - Build the real-time and analytics data paths that power live visualization, sizing recommendations, and data-driven insights. 
 - Work with adjacent teams to decide when fast simulation is enough and when a scenario needs deeper, higher-fidelity validation. 

Lead and raise the bar

- Mentor senior and staff engineers. Set standards for performance engineering, testing (determinism, regression, and golden-run suites), observability, and code quality. 
 - Write the design docs, specs, and RFCs that align multiple teams, and turn open architecture questions into decisions. 
 - Engage directly with solutions engineers and customers to understand how simulation drives their decisions, and feed that back into the roadmap. 

What You Bring

Requirement

- 14+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading the architecture of complex, performance-critical systems. 
 - Deep expertise in discrete event simulation: event-queue design, simulation clocks, stochastic modeling, determinism and reproducibility, and validating models against reality. 
 - Strong systems programming skills in Rust, with comfort in async runtimes and high-performance data structures. Working proficiency in Java or a similar JVM language. 
 - Experience modeling multi-agent systems such as robot fleets, vehicles, logistics networks, or manufacturing lines, including path planning, traffic and congestion, and resource contention. 
 - A track record of designing public, versioned APIs and schemas that external developers built on. 
 - Solid distributed-systems fundamentals: job queues, real-time streaming, service-to-service communication, and time-series and analytical data stores. 
 - The ability to drive alignment across several teams through clear writing and sound technical judgment. 

Nice to have

- Experience with WebAssembly runtimes or other plugin and sandboxing architectures. 
 - Background in warehouse automation, AMRs/AGVs, goods-to-person systems, or material-handling simulation tools (e. g. , AnyLogic, FlexSim, Simio, Demo3D). 
 - Experience with simulation frameworks such as DesmoJ or SimPy, or with custom simulation engines at scale. 
 - Experience running large simulation or optimization workloads on cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products. 
 - Familiarity with operations research, queueing theory, or ML-assisted optimization. 
 - An advanced degree in Computer Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: You understand the current simulation platform, its fidelity gaps, and its performance limits. You have published a technical strategy and delivered early wins on performance or correctness. 
 - First 6-12 months: Public simulation schemas and extension interfaces are defined and versioned. Simulation runs as a scalable multi-tenant service. Results are calibrated against real-world data with published accuracy bounds. 
 - Long term: Simulation is the fast, trusted backbone of every design and sizing decision, and customers and partners extend it with their own algorithms and tools. 

Why Join

- Shape a core product from the architecture up, at a point where the big decisions are still open. 
 - Work on hard problems where simulation science, systems performance, and robotics meet. 
 - See your work directly affect how some of the world's largest retailers and 3PLs design and run their warehouses.

Overview

As the QA Engineer on the Smart Water pod, you will own quality for a product being scaled into RealPage's standard meter-operations offering, and you will do it by writing test automation rather than clicking through manual passes. You will build automated coverage for the customer-facing Smart Water experience in the Smart Building Portal, the C#/. NET services behind it, and - critically - the accuracy of the meter and usage data flowing through the ingestion pipeline. 

Smart Water's history of data-integrity and onboarding defects makes this a high-impact role: you will stand up the automated regression and data-validation suites that keep calculations correct (cost, usage, loss, occupancy), run in CI on every change, and prevent the kinds of issues that have delayed customer go-lives. A core goal of the pod is to move Smart Water off manual, PME-driven QA and onto repeatable automated tests. 

This role suits a QA engineer who thinks like a developer - someone who reaches for a script before a manual test case and wants to build the automation foundation for a small, fast-moving pod. 

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

- Build and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, API, data-validation) as the primary way Smart Water is tested - integrated into the Azure DevOps CI pipeline to run on every change. 
 - Write automated UI and API tests across the Angular front end and C#/. NET services, replacing manual, repetitive test passes with scripted coverage. 
 - Automate data-integrity checks across the ingestion pipeline - meter reads, usage, cost, loss, and occupancy calculations - so regressions are caught in CI rather than by hand. 
 - Encode water-usage anomaly detection scenarios (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) as automated test cases against known data. 
 - Automate verification of onboarding and self-service workflows to prevent the data and configuration defects that have historically required PMEs. 
 - Partner closely with the pod's developers on quality - reproducing issues, adding regression tests, and confirming fixes. 
 - Reserve exploratory/manual testing for genuinely new features, and convert what you learn there into automated coverage. 

Qualifications

This is an automation-first QA role on a C#/. NET and Angular product - the goal is scripted, CI-integrated tests, not manual QA. 

- 2+ years in software QA with a strong emphasis on test automation. 
 - Proven experience writing and maintaining automated tests (e. g. , Selenium/Playwright/Cypress for UI, plus REST API test frameworks) - this is the core of the role. 
 - Comfortable writing code/scripts to test software, not just executing manual test cases. 
 - Strong SQL skills for automating data validation in MSSQL. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps or similar). 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required). 
 - Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows - using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required). 

Preferred Required

Preferred Skills but not required

- Experience testing data pipelines / ETL or analytics products where data accuracy is critical. 
 - Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains. 
 - Experience with ElasticSearch or performance testing. 
 - Familiarity with C#/. NET test tooling ( xUnit / NUnit ).

Introduction

Job title: Senior Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

Location: Bangalore

The opportunity

You will work on world-class retail supply chain solutions, deploying and running enterprise applications, including GPU-powered AI/ML products, on Azure and Oracle Cloud. These applications run 24/7 and are business-critical: warehouses and stores depend on them for daily operations. In this cloud and SRE role, you will own their reliability: defining and meeting SLOs, responding fast to incidents, troubleshooting end to end, and engineering out recurring problems through automation. 

Job Description

Key responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing team. In this role, you will: 

- Own the reliability of business-critical retail supply chain applications on Azure and Oracle Cloud, used 24/7 by warehouses and stores. 
 - Define and track SLIs and SLOs with product and application teams, using error budgets to balance reliability and release speed. 
 - Build observability (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts) using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Zabbix. 
 - Provide 24/7 L2/L3 support, act as incident commander on major incidents, and lead root cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Troubleshoot end to end across Cloudflare, HAProxy, network, Linux, Docker, Apache TomEE/Java, APIs, and Oracle Database, and quickly isolate the failing layer. 
 - Diagnose Java application issues using thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs, and APM traces. 
 - Perform first-level Oracle Database triage and escalate to the DBA team with clear diagnostics. 
 - Build and deploy cloud infrastructure (networks, VMs, containers, VPN, ExpressRoute, FastConnect) using Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Automate away toil, such as deployments, health checks, failover, and routine maintenance, with Python and Bash. 
 - Plan capacity, tune performance, and test high availability and disaster recovery through regular failover drills. 
 - Plan and execute production changes with minimal downtime and tested rollback, and maintain runbooks. 

Key criteria

Must-have

- 5-10 years in SRE, cloud infrastructure, or production operations, including at least 3 years running production workloads on Azure or OCI. 
 - Strong cloud expertise (Azure or OCI) across networking (VNet/VCN, VPN, ExpressRoute/FastConnect), compute, storage, and IAM. 
 - Strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu) and hands-on Docker experience. 
 - Hands-on Terraform, Ansible, and Python/Bash automation in production environments. 
 - Practical SRE experience: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, 24/7 incident management, and blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Experience with observability and APM tools (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, ELK, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or New Relic). 
 - End-to-end troubleshooting across networking (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS), HAProxy or similar load balancers, Java on TomEE/Tomcat, REST APIs, and Oracle Database at triage level.

Good-to-have

 - Opportunity for cross-skilling (retail products, multi-cloud, DevOps, orchestration tools, scripting, and company AI trainings) and enhancing skills to stay competitive in the future. 

About Us

Our values

Our values guide how we work with our customers and with each other. 

- Customer focus
 - Innovation at speed
 - Targeted focus
 - Team unity

Join us

SymphonyAI is a global leader in Vertical AI platforms. Our Eureka AI platform helps enterprises solve their most complex, high-value challenges across retail and consumer goods, financial services, industrial, and enterprise IT. 

Our retail division helps retailers and CPG manufacturers drive profitable growth with AI-powered solutions for demand forecasting, merchandising, supply chain, and store operations. Learn more at www. symphonyai. com.

From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission. 

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U. S. 

We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. 

Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management. 

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company. 

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. 

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: 

- Go Bold
 - All for One
 - Be a Pro
 - Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations: 

- Sustainability
 - Diversity & Inclusion
 - Trust & Openness
 - Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization. 

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc, " which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Lead Golang Platform Engineer

Domain: Fintech / Trading & Capital Markets

Experience: 6-8+ Years

Work Mode: To be confirmed

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Golang Platform Engineer to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues. 
 - Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency. 
 - Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis. 
 - Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling. 
 - Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads. 
 - Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services. 
 - Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards. 
 - Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Golang, including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling. 
 - Strong production experience with Apache Kafka, including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics. 
 - Proven expertise in PostgreSQL performance tuning and database optimization. 
 - Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability. 

Good to Have

- Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems. 
 - Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization. 
 - Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana. 
 - Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases. 
 - Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms. 

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

data.title: Engineering Manager
Test Automation Engineer II
data.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. 

  

By "Connecting Convenience" across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.   We're a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. 

  

Role Overview

  

Do you love building software that thrills your customers? Do you obsess over the quality of your software? Do you insist on the highest standards for the software your team develops? Are you an advocate of measurable quality? Can you dive deep and still maintain the big picture of your solution's components and the customer experience? Well, if this is you, then come join an energetic team of engineers building future of PDI software solutions.   

As a Test Automation Engineer (a. k. a. Software Engineer in Test) you will be part of an Agile team and involved in all aspects of our projects' lifecycle from inception through release working closely with the team's product owner, architects and engineers. Your mandate on the team will be to: (a) maximize the quality, measurability and supportability of the production features being developed, (b) maximize the testability of the software by finding and closing gaps in test coverage (c) minimize the team's overall internal defect escapes by shifting the balance of how we manage quality from end-of-cycle defect detection & containment (bug-finding & fix cycles) to up-front defect prevention (automation backed coverage of all our application features).   

You will not be writing production code. You will however be writing a lot of code in the form of tools, emulators, mocks, fakes, stubs, unit, component and integration tests. You will also be working closely with the Engineering DevOps teams helping enhance our integration with our continuous integration (CI) systems, our virtual labs and helping build out fully automated reporting of all the various project quality metrics with a vision of achieving "push-button" reporting of a project's software quality and trending (code coverage, static analysis, test surface coverage).   

Key Responsibilities

- Setting up test environments as required including client and web applications, services and databases.   

- Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, smoke, and regression tests

- Build and enhance scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks

- Review user stories and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios, risks, edge cases, and quality gaps

- Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines

- Perform functional, integration, end-to-end, and performance testing as required

- Test APIs, microservices, web applications, databases, and distributed system integrations

- Collaborate closely with developers to improve testability, automation coverage, and overall product quality

- Troubleshoot automation, application, environment, and test-data-related failures

- Participate in Agile ceremonies, release planning, and continuous improvement activities

- Leverage AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, automation development, code reviews, debugging, test-data generation, and failure analysis while applying appropriate engineering review and validation

- Mentor and support junior Test Automation Engineers and contribute to engineering best practices

Qualifications

- 4-7 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or software development

- Experience working with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python

- Experience with automation technologies such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, SpecFlow, Cucumber, or similar frameworks

- Strong experience testing REST APIs using Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, or equivalent technologies

- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL

- Build mocks, emulators, fakes, stubs and test case libraries driving towards 100% acceptance test coverage of stories  

- Experience with Git and CI/CD technologies such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins

- Understanding of modern quality practices including Shift Left Testing, Test Pyramid, risk-based testing, and continuous testing

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and container technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes is an advantage

- Experience with or willingness to adopt AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies for test automation and quality engineering

- Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills

- Ability to independently contribute while collaborating effectively within distributed engineering teams

- Experience in Convenience Retail, Fuel, Payments, Wholesale, Loyalty, or Logistics domains is preferred

Behavioral Competencies

- Ensures Accountability

- Manages Complexity

- Communicates Effectively

- Balances Stakeholders

- Collaborates Effectively

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.   This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.   Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description:
About ValGenesis
ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle. 

Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https: //www. valgenesis. com/about

About the Role: 

Responsibilities

- Architect, Design, develop, and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines (batch and real-time)
 - Build and optimize data Lakehouse architectures using Azure Synapse, Delta Lake, or similar frameworks
 - Integrate and manage structured and unstructured data sources (SQL/NoSQL, files, documents, IoT streams)
 - Develop and operationalize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, or Apache Spark
 - Collaborate with Data Scientists to prepare and serve ML-ready datasets for model training and inference
 - Implement data quality, lineage, and governance frameworks across pipelines and storage layers
 - Work with BI tools (Power BI, Superset, Tableau) to enable self-service analytics for business teams
 - Deploy and maintain data APIs and ML models in production using Azure ML, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Ensure scalability, performance, and observability of data workflows through effective monitoring and automation
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to translate insights into action
 - Mentor junior team members and review their work

Requirements

- Experience: 6 to 12 years in Data Engineering or equivalent roles
 - Programming: Strong in Python, SQL, and at least one compiled language (C#, Java, or Scala)
 - Databases: Experience with relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB) systems
 - Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Azure Data Lake, Databricks
 - ETL/ELT Tools: Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow, or dbt
 - Messaging & Streaming: Kafka, Event Hubs, or Service Bus for real-time data processing
 - AI/ML Exposure: Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and MLOps concepts
 - Visualization & Analytics: Power BI, Apache Superset, or Tableau
 - Cloud & DevOps: Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps
 - Best Practices: Solid understanding of data modeling, version control, and CI/CD for data systems

Preferred Skills

- Preferred Skills (Nice to Have): 
 - Experience in knowledge graph or semantic search solutions
 - Understanding of LLM-based data retrieval (RAG) patterns
 - Exposure to data mesh, data fabric, or domain-oriented data architecture
 - Familiarity with MLflow, Delta Live Tables, or Data Bricks Unity Catalog

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills
 - Attention to detail and ability to work with large, complex datasets
 - Creativity and ability to automate repetitive workflows
 - Passion for continuous learning and innovation in data and AI technologies

We're on a Mission
In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world's first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard. 

Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose-built systems with world-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations. 

The Team You'll Join
Our customers' success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity's quality of life, and we honor that mission. 

We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done. 

We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward. 

We're in it to win it. We're on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won't settle for anything less than being a market leader. 

How We Work
Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company. 

ValGenesis is an equal-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description:
Department: Development

Location: Hyderabad

Description

Infor's AI Studio represents an agentic platform that enables teams to author, configure, and deploy Infor OS and ERP solutions utilizing natural language processing capabilities. We are seeking an Lead Quality Assurance Engineer to join the AI Studio team and lead the QA team to thoroughly validate the agent architecture of AI Studio. The testing will spread across components like ION, Data Fabric, Birst, EPM, RPA/IDP, CSD, and Portal. This initiative constitutes a strategic priority for Infor, designed to accelerate velocity suite sales, enhance customer experience, and facilitate more effective collaboration between Cutomers and Sevices, FDEs, Partners and SCs

We are seeking a Team Lead for Quality Assurance to lead the testing efforts to deliver high quality software solutions across our cloud product portfolio. 

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

A Day in the Life Typically Includes: 

- Define and own the overall QA strategy for AI Studio - covering search relevance, multi-agent coordination, schema validation, tenant isolation, and LLM output quality. 
 - Lead a team of QA engineers, assign test coverage areas, review test plans, and ensure quality gates are met before each release. 
 - Collaborate with the AI Studio architecture team, component teams, and FDEs to understand new features, contribution model changes, and agent updates - translating these into test requirements. 
 - Drive the design of evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic Orchestrator outputs - defining what "correct" means for gap maps, dependency graphs, and blueprint quality across varying user inputs. 
 - Oversee search relevance regression testing - ensuring that as the knowledge corpus grows, existing query-result quality does not degrade. 
 - Define and enforce tenant isolation testing standards, ensuring no cross-tenant data leakage across sessions, project history, or search results. 
 - Report quality metrics to engineering leadership - solution generation success rates, clarification round counts, agent failure rates, and corpus coverage gaps. 

Basic Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 8-10 years of experience in software quality assurance with at least 3 years in a lead or principal QA role. 
 - Proven experience leading QA for an AI or data-intensive product in production - not just familiarity with concepts but hands-on ownership of quality outcomes. 
 - Deep understanding of RAG system testing - search relevance validation, embedding quality assessment, hybrid search behaviour, and corpus quality measurement. 
 - Strong experience with multi-agent or distributed system testing - tracing failures across service boundaries, validating inter-agent contracts, and verifying execution ordering. 
 - Experience building and maintaining automated test suites in Python, with the ability to define quality frameworks from scratch rather than inheriting them. 
 - Solid understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies and tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent - with the ability to select and adapt them to non-standard evaluation problems. 
 - Experience with REST API contract testing and integration testing across multi-service architectures. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS (Preferred), Azure, or GCP. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills - ability to translate quality findings into clear risk assessments for engineering leadership and product teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience leading QA for agentic AI systems or LLM orchestration pipelines where output correctness is semantic rather than deterministic. 
 - Familiarity with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other vector and hybrid search platforms - ideally with hands-on experience designing relevance test suites. 
 - Knowledge of prompt adversarial testing - designing inputs that expose reasoning failures, hallucinations, incorrect component selection, or silent gap map errors. 
 - Experience with MLOps or LLMOps observability tooling - defining monitoring standards, alert thresholds, and trace inspection processes for AI pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS security testing, particularly tenant isolation and session boundary enforcement. 
 - Exposure to Infor OS, ERP systems, or enterprise workflow automation products - understanding the domain context that AI Studio operates in. 
 - Experience establishing QA contribution processes for knowledge-driven systems where test data quality directly determines test coverage effectiveness. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices - ability to integrate quality gates into automated deployment workflows.

data.title: Director / Vice President – SaaS Production Operations, SRE & Security
data.description:
Director / Vice President - SaaS Production Operations, SRE & Security

Location: Chennai, India (relocation support available)

Experience: 15+ years

Leadership Scope: Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, Security Engineering and ISMS

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior technology leader to own end-to-end production operations, reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure and security engineering for a business-critical, customer-facing SaaS platform. 

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring proven experience running live SaaS production environments, managing 24×7 operations, meeting customer SLAs, leading major incidents and building proactive security engineering capabilities. 

The successful candidate will lead an established Cloud Operations and Information Security Management System (ISMS) organization, strengthen its technical capabilities and drive measurable improvements in reliability, security, automation and operational efficiency. 

We are looking for a proven production operations leader-not someone whose experience is limited to enterprise IT infrastructure, architecture, product development or compliance management. 

Key Responsibilities

1. SaaS Production Operations & Reliability

- Own end-to-end operational reliability, availability, performance and support for customer-facing SaaS platforms. 
 - Lead 24×7 application monitoring, production support, on-call operations, escalation management and customer SLA adherence. 
 - Establish and manage SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, observability and reliability improvement programs. 
 - Personally lead critical production incidents, coordinate technical response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventive actions. 
 - Improve incident frequency, Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), change success rates and production stability. 
 - Establish effective capacity planning, performance optimization, release safety and operational readiness practices. 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

- Own cloud architecture, provisioning, infrastructure operations and platform resilience. 
 - Manage cloud environments across OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP, with OCI experience preferred. 
 - Oversee Kubernetes, virtual machines, microservices infrastructure, cloud networking and databases. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC), policy as code, configuration automation and standardized provisioning. 
 - Own disaster recovery, backup and restoration testing, business continuity and infrastructure cost optimization through FinOps. 3. Security Engineering & Proactive Risk Prevention

- Lead hands-on security engineering across IAM, privileged access, secrets management, API authorization and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Establish continuous vulnerability identification, risk prioritization, remediation SLAs and security verification. 
 - Drive cloud security posture management, security monitoring, threat detection and security incident response. 
 - Own penetration-testing programs and ensure identified vulnerabilities are remediated within defined timelines. 
 - Embed security controls into production operations and software delivery rather than relying solely on periodic audits. 4. DevSecOps & Secure Delivery

- Partner with software Engineering to integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Implement SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container security and Infrastructure as Code scanning. 
 - Establish security gates, remediation SLAs, exception management and measurable security engineering outcomes. 
 - Enable secure and efficient releases without introducing unnecessary manual bottlenecks. 5. ISMS, Compliance & Customer Assurance

- Lead operational implementation of ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 controls. 
 - Ensure controls are continuously enforced and validated across production systems. 
 - Manage customer security assessments, audit readiness, risk registers and corrective actions. 
 - Build an integrated operating model where security engineering and compliance work together, with technical risk reduction as the priority. 6. Automation & AI-Driven Operations

- Drive AIOps adoption for anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring and incident response automation. 
 - Reduce manual operational effort through scripting, workflow automation and intelligent monitoring. 
 - Establish production security controls for AI agents, including identity, tool authorization, execution isolation, audit trails and human approval for high-risk actions. 7. Organization Leadership & Transformation

- Lead and develop the existing Cloud Operations, SRE and ISMS organization, including managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Establish clear ownership, operational KPIs, escalation structures and accountability across teams. 
 - Identify capability gaps, recruit critical talent and develop a technically strong leadership pipeline. 
 - Drive operational transformation through automation, engineering discipline, measurable service improvements and continuous learning. 
 - Report production reliability, security exposure, major incidents, remediation progress and infrastructure efficiency to executive leadership. Mandatory Requirements

- 15+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial experience in production operations, SRE, cloud infrastructure or security engineering leadership. 
 - Proven leadership of a customer-facing SaaS product or platform in a live production environment. 
 - Direct accountability for 24×7 application monitoring, customer SLAs, production reliability and major incident management. 
 - Demonstrated experience personally leading critical production incidents and implementing corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Strong technical leadership experience managing managers, senior engineers and multi-disciplinary teams. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, infrastructure automation and disaster recovery. 
 - Practical security engineering experience covering IAM, secrets management, API authorization, vulnerability management and security incident response. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps controls and automated security testing within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Demonstrated success in improving an existing organization's processes, reliability, security posture and operational performance. Preferred Experience

- Multi-tenant SaaS products in insurance, fintech, financial services or other regulated industries. 
 - OCI architecture and operations. 
 - ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 control implementation in production environments. 
 - AIOps implementation and AI-agent security in production. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations and driving operational transformation. First-Year Success Measures

First 90 days

- Establish baseline reliability, incident, security and cloud cost metrics. 
 - Identify operational and security risks, with clear owners and remediation timelines. 
 - Deliver a prioritized 12-month transformation roadmap. Within 12 months

- Demonstrate measurable improvements in production incident frequency, MTTR, vulnerability exposure time and cloud cost efficiency. 
 - Establish automated security gates and tenant-isolation testing. 
 - Complete a successful disaster recovery test. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership, incident prevention, security automation and team effectiveness. Candidate Application Requirements

Please provide specific examples demonstrating: 

- A major production incident you personally led on a customer-facing SaaS platform, including business impact, your role and corrective actions. 
 - A security engineering initiative or security incident you led, including tools used, vulnerabilities addressed and remediation timelines. 
 - Your current leadership structure, including direct reports, managers reporting to you, total team size and budget responsibility. 
 - Whether your production platform was a product sold to customers or a service delivered to a client. Candidates should be prepared to discuss measurable outcomes and their personal accountability for production reliability and security. 

Ideal candidate: A senior production operator who combines strong technical depth, executive leadership, customer-facing SaaS operations ownership, SRE, proactive security engineering and organizational transformation experience.

data.title: Lead Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
Your role

Atlas Copco is a leading global Industrial Group having vision of "First in Mind, First in Choice". Our culture is founded on three core values of commitment, interaction and innovation. They guide us in everything we do and reflect how we behave internally and in our relationships with our stakeholders. 

Digital Technology Practice at GECIA (Global Engineering Centre, India), part of Atlas Copco, is contributing significantly to vision of the Group by focusing on developing global talent, expanding portfolio and competence on futuristic competencies, driving Innovation and achieving operational excellence to drive customer success. 

You will be expected to demonstrate a methodical and detailed approach towards end-to-end System Integration Testing, verification methodologies, quality assurance, and technical leadership. As a Lead Engineer, you will guide the testing team, define test strategies, ensure integration readiness across subsystems, and drive quality throughout the product validation lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- End-to-End System Integration Testing
 - Define and drive system integration test strategy covering hardware, firmware, software, communication interfaces, devices, APIs, and connected subsystems. 
 - Plan and execute integration test scenarios across complete product workflows, including system bring-up, subsystem interaction, regression, failure handling, and release validation. 
 - Validate end-to-end behavior across embedded controllers, sensors, communication protocols, HMIs/tools, and cloud or backend integrations wherever applicable. 
 - Lead Engineer Responsibilities
 - Take technical ownership of test planning, estimation, execution approach, defect triage, test reporting, and release quality inputs. 
 - Guide and mentor the testing team on test design, automation practices, integration testing approach, debugging methods, and quality standards. 
 - Coordinate with embedded, software, hardware, DevOps, and product teams to ensure clear test scope, readiness, dependencies, and timely closure of issues. 
 - Test Planning, Automation, and Execution
 - Develop comprehensive test plans, integration test cases, test data, and acceptance criteria based on system requirements and product specifications. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain automated test scripts, reusable test frameworks, and validation tools using Python and suitable automation technologies. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, identify defects, support root-cause analysis, and ensure effective defect tracking and closure. 
 - Embedded Systems and Interface Validation
 - Perform embedded system, firmware, HIL/SIL, controller, sensor, and communication interface testing to ensure compliance with functional and system specifications. 
 - Validate communication protocols and interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, Modbus, MQTT, or other product-specific protocols. 
 - Support debugging using appropriate tools, logs, traces, simulators, test benches, measurement instruments, and hardware/software diagnostic methods. 
 - Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement
 - Ensure adherence to test processes, software development standards, quality practices, documentation discipline, and release readiness expectations. 
 - Improve test coverage, automation maturity, regression efficiency, CI/CD integration, defect prevention, and overall quality engineering practices. 
 - Communicate test progress, risks, findings, quality metrics, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and project teams. 
To succeed, you will need

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics / Software. 

Experience

- Minimum 8+ years of experience Embedded Systems testing, quality assurance, and end-to-end System Integration Testing. 
 - Proven experience with Python, with Automation Frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems testing, integration testing, subsystem validation, defect analysis, and release quality assurance. 

Technical Skills

- Proficiency in developing automated test scripts using Python. 
 - Experience with embedded system development/testing tools, integration test benches, simulators, HIL/SIL environments, and debugging instruments. 
 - Familiarity with communication protocols (e. g. , UART, SPI, I2C, CAN). 
 - Knowledge of version control systems (e. g. , Git, BitBucket). 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools (e. g. , Jenkins). 

Soft Skills

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to guide a testing team, work independently, collaborate across functions, and take ownership of technical quality deliverables. 

In return, we offer

- An opportunity to work with 150 years old, leading global product company
 - An opportunity where you are empowered to drive your own professional journey through research and development. 
 - A challenging role focused on developing new systems with the help of advanced embedded technology. 
 - Global exposure and opportunities through internal mobility
 - Freedom and authority to act
 - A culture where we care about each other and world around us
 - Best in class total reward program covering Insurances, Higher Education, flexible work timing

Job location

Hybrid

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA in Pune, India. 

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

data.title: Director, MTS (DevOps)
data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers. 

The Director of DevOps & Platform Engineering Gracenote India will be central to the success of our infrastructure, cloud platform, and engineering enablement teams across geographies. This role is fundamental to the growth and technical excellence of the Gracenote engineering organization as a whole. Key goals of this role are to establish technical rigor, operational efficiency, and a robust platform engineering culture. You will be responsible for managing compute infrastructure, cloud native and managed services, observability stacks, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps), while collaborating closely with local and global stakeholders to ensure high availability, scalability, and security for Gracenote's products. 

Responsibilities

- Manage and scale multiple teams of DevOps, and Cloud Infrastructure engineers in India, with direct and indirect managerial responsibilities. 
 - Work with local and global management across all relevant organizational partners to ensure the success, productivity, and operational alignment of assigned teams. 
 - Create a culture based on Nielsen values, fostering collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence across platform operations. 
 - Establish operating rhythm and cadence within areas of responsibility to ensure transparent communication, inclusive leadership, and a positive, high-retention environment for engineers. 
 - Track and drive key performance indicators (KPIs) including system availability/SLA performance, incident resolution times, infrastructure productivity, cloud spend efficiency, and employee retention. 
 - Oversee and manage Gracenote's AWS footprint, including large-scale compute resources and AWS-managed services such as AWS Glue, Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka), EKS, EMR, RDS, and S3. 
 - Drive Kubernetes platform operations (Amazon EKS), focusing on automated scaling, cluster management, workload security, and operational reliability. 
 - Own and evolve the in-house observability stack based on Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and related telemetry tools to ensure end-to-end visibility across microservices and data pipelines. 
 - Lead FinOps and cloud cost management initiatives, establishing robust cost tracking, forecasting, efficiency benchmarks, and continuous resource optimization strategies without compromising performance. 
 - Apply an automation-first mindset to Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and self-healing systems. 
 - Coordinate and maintain a strong talent pipeline. 
 - Continuously assess, streamline, and improve DevOps processes, incident management workflows, and infrastructure reliability standards. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to toolings, governance, and security best practices within the Product Development Lifecycle. 
 - Represent the India DevOps and Platform Engineering organization in cross-functional engagements (e. g. , Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science). 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience working in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record in people management, team building, and leading multi-disciplinary DevOps teams in a global environment. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD tools, Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, CloudFormation), and scripting (Python, Shell, Go, etc. ). 
 - 5+ years of dedicated experience managing production AWS environments at scale, specifically focusing on Amazon EKS and AWS native managed services (AWS Glue, MSK, EMR, S3, RDS, DynamoDB). 
 - Deep expertise in open-source and custom observability tools, particularly Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or ELK stack. 
 - Proven track record in FinOps-managing cloud budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, implementing auto-scaling/spot instances, and tracking cloud spend metrics. 
 - Strong foundation in Kubernetes architecture, containerization, microservices deployment, and networking/security policies. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise workflow and business tools such as JIRA, Confluence, OpsGenie, Gitlab, and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Strong critical thinking, incident response leadership, and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Sense of curiosity, operational discipline, and high attention to detail. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

About The Role
