data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Business / Organization Overview

We are looking for a high-caliber Senior Java Technical Lead / Architect (C13) to spearhead the architecture, engineering strategy, and technical delivery of enterprise-scale distributed platforms. In this strategic technical leadership position, you will govern large-scale engineering initiatives, drive cloud-native modernization, set foundational architecture patterns, and mentor multiple agile engineering squads across globally distributed teams. 

Role Summary

At the C13 grade, you will operate as a subject matter expert and technical authority combining deep architectural mastery with strategic delivery oversight. You will lead end-to-end design, technology evaluation, security governance, and multi-system integration across distributed microservices, high-throughput event streaming, enterprise databases, and container platforms. You will partner with Directors, Enterprise Architects, Product Managers, and Business Leaders to ensure technology roadmaps align with business transformation objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Architecture & System Design

- Own end-to-end technical architecture, system decomposition, and integration strategy for complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems. 
 - Define architectural blueprints, domain models, and technical design standards for high-throughput, low-latency, and highly available microservices. 
 - Lead technology evaluation, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and modernization roadmaps (e. g. , legacy monolith/WebSphere decomposition to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures). 
 - Formally represent the application in Enterprise Architecture Governance, Security Reviews, and Technology Risk committees. 

Technical Governance & Engineering Leadership

- Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight across multiple development teams and technical leads (C11/C12). 
 - Enforce rigorous engineering standards, Clean Code practices, comprehensive automated testing (TDD/BDD), and robust CI/CD DevOps pipelines. 
 - Establish standards for non-functional requirements (NFRs) including system resilience, fault tolerance, high availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), low latency, and horizontal scalability. 
 - Drive modernization of messaging pipelines, event stream topologies, and polyglot persistence layers. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Executive Stakeholders to translate multi-year business strategies into actionable, phased technical roadmaps. 
 - Manage architectural risks, technical debt remediation, and capacity planning. 
 - Act as the senior escalation authority for critical production incidents, driving root cause analysis (RCA) and long-term architectural stability solutions. 

Mentorship & Talent Development

- Foster an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture emphasizing continuous learning, innovation, and technical rigor. 
 - Mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, building leadership pipelines and engineering talent across the organization. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
 - 15+ years of overall software engineering experience in enterprise-grade applications, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical lead, software architect or engineering leadership capacity. 
 - Proven track record of architecting, delivering, and supporting high-throughput, mission-critical systems in financial services, banking, or large enterprise domains. 

Primary Skills & Technical Mastery

- Core Java & Advanced JVM Engineering: Deep mastery of Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), high-concurrency programming, multithreading, memory management, garbage collection tuning (ZGC/G1), and low-latency optimization. 
 - Spring Ecosystem & Microservices Architecture: Extensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). 
 - Event-Driven Architecture & Distributed Messaging: 
 - Expert-level design and production operations with Apache Kafka (cluster architecture, partitions, consumer groups, Kafka Streams/Connect, schema registry, idempotent producers). 
 - Enterprise messaging and integration via IBM MQ / JMS and transaction management across distributed systems (Saga pattern, two-phase commit alternatives). 
 - API Strategy & Integration Patterns: Advanced RESTful API design, OpenAPI standards, API Gateways, gRPC, OAuth2/OIDC, and mutual TLS (mTLS). 
 - Polyglot Database Architecture: 
 - Relational: Oracle (advanced PL/SQL, partitioning, index optimization, query execution plan analysis, Active Data Guard). 
 - NoSQL / Document: MongoDB (sharding, replica sets, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning at scale). 
 - Resilience & Fault Tolerance Patterns: Proven experience implementing Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j), Rate Limiting, Bulkheads, and Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger). 

Secondary Skills & Modernization Competencies

- Containerization & Cloud Native Platforms: Architectural expertise in container platforms, specifically Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes and AWS ECS, including Pod autoscaling, ingress controllers, and Helm chart lifecycle management. 
 - Legacy Modernization & Middleware: Experience migrating workloads from legacy application servers (IBM WebSphere WAS/ND) and workflow orchestrators (IBM BAW / BPM) to modern microservices and cloud runtimes. 
 - Frontend Architecture Exposure: Solid understanding of modern SPA architecture, frontend integration, and frameworks like Angular (TypeScript, state management). 
 - DevOps & Automation: In-depth knowledge of modern CI/CD automation (Harness, Tekton, Jenkins), infrastructure-as-code, and automated security scanning tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, Prisma). 

Leadership & Executive Competencies

- Strategic Vision: Ability to conceptualize multi-year technical strategies and execute them incrementally within agile frameworks. 
 - Executive Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing both technical teams and senior executive leadership. 
 - Problem Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical acumen with proven ability to make pragmatic architectural trade-offs under constraints. 
 - Delivery Ownership: High accountability for end-to-end software delivery, operational excellence, and production resilience.

 - Experience with ServiceNow scripting and JavaScript.

 - Knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, and MFA.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on ServiceNow automation experience and understands IAM processes well enough to automate identity and access workflows. The role is primarily focused on automation and development rather than routine IAM ticket operations.

ServiceNow Automation | Flow Designer | ServiceNow Workflow | JavaScript | REST APIs | IAM | JML | Provisioning | Access Management

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

Keep GSK's standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section. 

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK's Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment. 

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner's backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Reliability: achieve 99. 9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred. 
 - Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards. 
 - Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team's time. 
 - AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails. 
 - Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline. 
 - Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting. 
 - Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours. 
 - Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect's reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 - Area of Specialisation
 - Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
 - Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts. undefined
 - Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
 - Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
 - Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert). 
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

Skills

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Company Description

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth. com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook. 

About The Role

Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through data-driven innovation? The Enterprise Data Platform team is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, evolution, and scaling of our AWS-based enterprise data platform that powers analytics, operational intelligence, AI-enabled solutions, and business-critical decision-making. This role is ideal for a technical leader who combines strong data engineering expertise with architectural vision, product thinking, and a passion for solving business problems through data. As a player-coach, you will contribute to architecture, technical design, and key implementations while mentoring engineers and shaping the future of our data platform. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business stakeholders to build scalable data products and platform capabilities that transform data into actionable insights, intelligent automation, and measurable business outcomes. Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Architect and evolve scalable, secure, and AI-ready data platforms across ingestion, storage, transformation, analytics, and data product layers. 
 - Define technical vision, architecture standards, and engineering best practices that balance business needs, scalability, governance, and innovation. Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business teams to define and execute the architectural vision for a modern data platform, influencing long-term technical direction while balancing current priorities with future growth. 
 - Lead the evolution of our AWS-centric data platform by continuously evaluating modern data architecture patterns, cloud-native services, and emerging AI technologies to ensure the platform scales efficiently with growing business needs and data volumes. 
 - Assess build-versus-buy opportunities and make pragmatic technology decisions that balance business value, scalability, maintainability, operational complexity, and cost. 
 - Champion modern data architecture patterns including data products, data contracts, observability, self-service capabilities, metadata-driven architectures, and AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Data Products & Business Impact

- 
 - Lead the design and delivery of data products that generate measurable business value through analytics, automation, AI/ML, and operational insights. 
 - Partner with stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities and translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Apply a product mindset to data solutions, ensuring investments align with business priorities and user needs. 
 - Define success metrics and drive adoption, reliability, and business outcomes for data products. 

Engineering Leadership

- Lead the design and evolution of scalable data platforms and engineering practices that enable reliable delivery of data products across analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases. 
 - Guide technology, architecture, and engineering decisions across the data ecosystem to ensure scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Establish engineering standards for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data platforms across batch, streaming, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads. 
 - Contribute to architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and critical implementations. 
 - Promote engineering excellence through automation, testing, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as Code, and operational best practices. 

Team & Culture

- Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers. 
 - Coach engineers in system design, architectural thinking, engineering craftsmanship, and operational excellence. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical curiosity. 
 -

Governance & Reliability

- Ensure strong foundations in data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, security, and compliance. 
 - Drive platform reliability, monitoring, observability, and operational excellence. Partner with security and governance teams to implement best practices for handling sensitive and regulated data. 
 -

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 2+ years of experience leading and growing engineering teams. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling enterprise data platforms and data products. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering measurable business value through data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, automation, or a combination of these capabilities. 
 - Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, distributed data processing, and modern data platform technologies. 
 - Experience with technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Airflow, cloud-native services, and modern data engineering frameworks. 
 - Experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms on AWS, including data lake, data warehouse, orchestration, streaming, and analytics services. 
 - Experience with AWS technologies such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, IAM, Lake Formation, and related platform services. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, and drive platform modernization initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions and data products. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences. 
 - Ability to balance strategic thinking, architectural leadership, and hands-on execution. 
 -

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building AI-enabled data products and intelligent automation solutions. 
 - Experience applying machine learning, predictive analytics, Generative AI, or LLM-enabled capabilities to solve business problems. 
 - Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt. Experience with streaming and real-time data architectures. 
 - Experience leading modernization of AWS-based data platforms and evaluating emerging technologies to improve scalability, reliability, governance, and developer productivity. 
 - Experience with modern data stack technologies such as dbt, DataZone, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or similar ecosystem tools. 
 - Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries. Experience working with HIPAA, GDPR, PII, or other regulated datasets. Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. 

AI & Digital Fluency

- Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager - Java Full Stack - Open Banking
data.description:
At U. S. Bancorp India, we're on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U. S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Global Engineering Leadership & India Expansion
 - Lead and scale a high-performing global engineering organization, including building and expanding the India team supporting Acquisition and Open Banking platforms. 
 - Establish a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive talent strategy across hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Foster an inclusive, accountable environment that promotes collaboration, technical excellence, and leadership growth. 
 - Platform Engineering & Architecture (Acquisition & Underwriting)
 - Own the design and evolution of API-first, event-driven platforms enabling digital acquisition and real-time underwriting. 
 - Architect decoupled systems separating customer journeys, decisioning, and core banking platforms to improve scalability and agility. 
 - Establish reusable platform capabilities (decisioning, identity, fraud, KYC, and data integration) consumable across products, channels, and partners. 
 - Drive engineering excellence in distributed systems, scalability, and secure Open Banking integrations. 
 - Execution, Delivery & Operational Performance
 - Lead delivery of the product and platform roadmap with clear accountability for business outcomes, quality, and operational stability. 
 - Ensure predictable, on-time, and within-budget execution while meeting security, compliance, and reliability standards. 
 - Promote strong engineering practices, including high-quality code, sound design decisions, and production stability. 
 - Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and strategic goals. 
 - Technical Leadership & Architectural Governance
 - Provide strategic architectural direction, aligning solutions to business needs, enterprise standards, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Ensure designs are scalable, resilient, maintainable, and testable, with clear handling of dependencies and failure scenarios. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and design forums, driving consistency and simplification across platforms. 
 - Continuously simplify systems to improve speed, reliability, and supportability. 
 - Cross-Functional Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement
 - Partner with product, business, risk, and architecture leaders to define and deliver acquisition and underwriting capabilities. 
 - Influence roadmap decisions by balancing engineering strategy, customer experience, risk, and delivery constraints. 
 - Drive alignment across teams to enable efficient, end-to-end value delivery across the ecosystem. 
 - Communicate architecture, strategy, and delivery risks clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders. 
 - Resiliency, Risk & Operational Excellence
 - Define and enforce resiliency standards (tiering, SLOs, failover strategies) for mission-critical acquisition and underwriting flows. 
 - Ensure high availability and low-latency performance for real-time decisioning systems. 
 - Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements across the platform. 

Technical Scope

The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong hands-on technical leadership and credibility in designing and delivering modern, distributed, and scalable platforms. This role leads engineering teams building API-first acquisition and Open Banking solutions, with a focus on real-time decisioning, resiliency, performance, and regulatory compliance. 

Core Technical Expectations

- Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems, with a strong emphasis on modularity, extensibility, and testability. 
 - Lead development of microservices, APIs, SDKs, and front-end components (MFE) using Java, Spring Boot, and modern UI frameworks aligned to API-driven architectures. 
 - Architect low-latency, high-throughput platforms to support real-time acquisition flows and credit decisioning workloads. 
 - Enable seamless integration across channels and partners through well-defined RESTful APIs and event-driven communication patterns. 
 - Apply event-driven architecture principles using Kafka and related streaming technologies to support asynchronous processing and real-time data flows. 
 - Leverage cloud-native and container-based platforms, including Kubernetes, Istio, Rancher, and API gateways (Apigee), to enable scalability, observability, and secure service communication 
 - Establish modern DevOps and CI/CD practices using tools such as Jenkins/CloudBees and GitLab, ensuring automated testing, deployment, and release management. 
 - Enforce best practices in source control, code quality, and agile delivery, driving consistency, speed, and reliability across engineering teams. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues, ensuring rapid recovery, root cause analysis, and continuous system improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience designing and delivering modern, distributed software systems. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams, including globally distributed/offshore teams. 
 - Proven expertise building and scaling platform-based solutions with measurable business impact. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams in delivering complex, multi-stakeholder products in fast-paced, enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering practices, architecture patterns, and enterprise development tools. 
 - Ability to translate business strategy into technology and engineering outcomes, driving alignment across product, risk, and engineering. 
 - Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, scrum teams, business stakeholders, and external partners. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong domain expertise in customer acquisition, credit underwriting, and Open Banking ecosystems. 
 - Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries, with an understanding of risk, compliance, and security requirements. 
 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, API platforms, and event-driven integration patterns. 
 - Experience leading modernization initiatives, including integrating new platforms with legacy systems in enterprise environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance feature delivery, technical debt, and operational reliability at scale. 
 - Experience with cloud-native platforms and engineering ecosystems (Azure, containers, CI/CD, API management). 
 - Relevant certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, or Cloud technologies are a plus. 

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks and operates at a platform and ecosystem level, considering impacts across domains, customer journeys, and partner integrations. 
 - Demonstrates deep understanding of end-to-end acquisition and underwriting flows, including users, systems, and business outcomes. 
 - Proactively addresses ambiguity, risks, and dependencies, guiding teams toward sound, data-driven decisions. 
 - Builds a culture of strong engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountability. 
 - Combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and disciplined execution to deliver consistent results. 
 - Effectively represents and scales global engineering teams, especially across India and U. S. -based stakeholders. 

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants. 

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. 

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.title: Solution Architect
data.description:
WirelessCar's Journey

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands-like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover-innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

As a Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience, you will help shape and evolve the architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle - from business needs and early design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution. You will work closely with our development teams and other architects to turn business needs into secure, scalable and sustainable technical solutions. 

Our environment is primarily built around AWS, but also Azure, using modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to technology while helping teams make good architectural decisions. You won't be working in isolation. Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort, and an important part of your role will be creating alignment and helping teams make sound technical decisions. 

Your Impact: 

- Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services. 
 - Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 - Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs. 
 - Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions and their implications clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software. 
 - Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects. 

What We're Looking For

- You are a technically experienced and pragmatic person who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details. 
 - You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping a team reach a good solution. 
 - You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation. 

We believe you bring: 

- Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure. 
 - A strong background in software engineering and modern agile development practices. 
 - Experience designing distributed systems and working with areas such as APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures. 
 - An understanding of non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance and cost. 
 - Programming experience in Java, Python or similar languages, allowing you to engage meaningfully with development teams and implementation decisions. 
 - Experience communicating technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to different audiences. 
 - Experience working collaboratively across teams and disciplines in complex development environments. It would be a plus if you have
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms or similar cloud-native technologies. 
 - Experience with system or data migration initiatives. 
 - Interest in or experience with AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning platforms or applying AI to improve engineering and product capabilities. 
 - Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures. 
 - Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements. 
 - Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed development teams. 
 - Knowledge of the automotive industry, connected vehicles or large-scale IoT solutions.

data.description:
Principal AI Architect - Generative AI & Enterprise Delivery

India (Hybrid) | Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time | Hands-on Architecture & Senior Engineering

About Us

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20, 000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6, 000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance. 

The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM's 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT-a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world's leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025-Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale. 

About the Role

Straive is seeking a hands-on Principal AI Architect & Senior Developer to serve as the technical authority for our enterprise Generative AI delivery practice. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end architectural design, backend engineering, and production deployment of enterprise Generative AI platforms, multi-agent systems, document intelligence pipelines, and real-time streaming LLM applications. 

This is an intensely hands-on role requiring expert backend proficiency in Python and SQL alongside deep expertise in Generative AI architectures. You will move beyond simple API orchestration to fine-tune open-weight models, build custom agentic workflows, engineer advanced multimodal RAG pipelines, write high-concurrency streaming backend microservices (FastAPI/AsyncIO), enforce AI security/PII guardrails, and optimize LLM unit economics (inference cost, latency, accuracy) for production deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

• Hands-on Gen AI Architecture & System Design: Architect scalable enterprise Gen AI solutions-including multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph or AutoGen or CrewAI), advanced RAG retrieval pipelines, real-time streaming interfaces (SSE, WebSockets), prompt security, guardrails, and automated evaluation suites. 

• High-Concurrency Backend Engineering & SQL: Write clean, async, high-performance Python backend code (FastAPI or AsyncIO or PyDantic) and write complex, optimized SQL queries to build robust microservices, caching layers (Redis), queueing systems (RabbitMQ/Celery), and vector search integrations. 

• Open-Weight Fine-Tuning & AI Economics: Own open-weight model fine-tuning (Llama or Mistral or Qwen or Phi) using LoRA, QLoRA, and full tuning. Drive inference optimization via quantization (AWQ, GPTQ), model distillation, prompt caching, and high-throughput GPU serving (vLLM/Triton). 

• Agentic Workflows & Tool Integration (MCP): Architect autonomous multi-agent workflows, planner-worker execution patterns, and custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connecting LLMs securely to enterprise databases, APIs, and legacy systems of record. 

• Multimodal RAG & Document Intelligence: Build complex document intelligence and multimodal ingestion pipelines to parse, OCR, chunk, and embed structured/unstructured documents (PDFs, tables, images) using Textract, Unstructured, and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). 

• LLMOps, Telemetry, Guardrails & Governance: Establish end-to-end LLMOps infrastructure-automated CI/CD eval gates (Ragas, TruLens), hallucination detection, telemetry/tracing (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Arize), and AI safety controls (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, PII redaction). 

• Technical Leadership, RFPs & Client Advisory: Lead and mentor 30+ AI engineers and developers through architecture reviews and hands-on code reviews. Partner with client CTOs, CDOs, and commercial teams on RFPs, technical proposals, discovery workshops, and effort estimations. 

Required Experience and Qualifications

• 12+ years of professional software engineering experience across system design, distributed backend development, and AI/ML, with a minimum of 4+ years dedicated to hands-on Generative AI and LLM application architecture. 

• Expert-level hands-on proficiency in Python (FastAPI or AsyncIO or PyDantic or Celery) and SQL (PostgreSQL/pgvector, MySQL, complex joins, CTEs, query optimization) for building production microservices. 

• Proven track record architecting and shipping production Gen AI systems using multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph or AutoGen or CrewAI or LangChain) and advanced RAG architectures (hybrid semantic + BM25 retrieval/re-ranking models). 

• Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight LLMs/SLMs (Llama/Mistral/Qwen/Phi), dataset curation, LoRA/QLoRA execution, and serving models under production load using vLLM, Triton, or Ollama. 

• Strong practical depth with Vector Databases (OpenSearch Vector Search/ Qdrant/ Milvus/ FAISS/ Pinecone) and document parsing/multimodal pipelines (AWS Textract, OCR, Vision-Language Models). 

• Demonstrated ability to optimize LLM inference cost and latency via quantization (AWQ/GPTQ, GGUF), prompt engineering/caching, model routing, and batching. 

• Hands-on expertise in LLMOps telemetry and AI security: evaluation frameworks (Ragas/TruLens), tracing (LangSmith/OpenTelemetry), prompt injection protection, PII masking, and guardrails (NeMo Guardrails/Llama Guard). 

• Solid command of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), streaming APIs (SSE, WebSockets), GPU serving, and cloud AI platforms across either AWS (Bedrock/SageMaker), Azure (Azure OpenAI), or GCP (Vertex AI). 

Preferred Experience & Education

• Hands-on exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Claude Skills, and agentic tool-use protocols. 

• Working command of enterprise AI risk and compliance frameworks. 

• Familiarity with enterprise data platforms (Databricks MLflow/Snowflake) or classical ML (XGBoost, scikit-learn). 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field from Tier 1/Tier 2 colleges)

Recognition & Achievements

• We have been recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest's North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM's PeMa Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025. 

• In Nov 2023, Straive acquired Gramener, an award-winning, design-led data science company, enhancing our data, analytics, and AI capabilities. In June 2025, we acquired SG Analytics, a leading provider of AI-powered insights and contextual analytics services. 

For more information, please visit our Website: https: //www. straive. com/

Equal Opportunity Employer

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. data.title: Staff Quality Engineer — Qira AI Platform
data.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. 

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world's largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo's continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). 

This transformation together with Lenovo's world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www. lenovo. com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. 

About The Role

As a Staff AI Quality Engineer for the Qira AI Platform, you will lead the technical test strategy and architectural validation for Lenovo's cross-device agentic AI ecosystem. You will serve as the technical authority on evaluating non-deterministic systems, designing automated quality platforms that operate across personal computing form factors (PCs, tablets, and smartphones). You will drive non-functional quality standards-ensuring that privacy, security, accessibility, internationalization, and device thermals/battery efficiency are safeguarded-while acting as a crucial release partner alongside Product Management and PMO leads. 

What Will You Do

- Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness. 
 - Agentic AI Quality Frameworks: Design automated evaluation methodologies to validate multi-step agent reasoning, tool-calling graphs, autonomous error recovery, and transactional rollback mechanisms; establish statistical release gates for non-deterministic model behaviors. 
 - Hardware Runtime Resource Profiling: Formulate automated performance and endurance soak suites to benchmark on-device SLM execution against cloud fallback paths, monitoring thermal throttling, memory leaks, and battery draw across hardware device tiers. 
 - Non-Functional Quality Standards: Lead automated verification across non-functional pillars: red-teaming indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities, securing inter-process data barriers, standardizing automated accessibility (screen-reader verbosity, dynamic token streaming), and validating semantic fidelity across international locales. 
 - CI/CD Quality Pipelines Gating: Drive the technical implementation of shift-left gating in continuous integration pipelines, establishing automated failure analytics, regression detection, and flakiness isolation frameworks. 
 - Cross-Functional Peer Leadership: Serve as a core technical gatekeeper alongside Product Management and PMO; establish release acceptance criteria, lead data-informed risk assessments during schedule compressions, and influence platform design for enhanced testability. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of progressive software quality engineering, test architecture, and automation experience covering multi-device hardware ecosystems (Windows and Android). 
 - 3+ years of experience leading quality strategy and automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic AI workflows, or conversational platforms. 
 - Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons. 
 - Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation. 
 - Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on expertise implementing and tuning non-deterministic evaluation platforms (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, TruLens) in production pipelines. 
 - Direct experience testing local NPU runtimes and quantized models (INT4/INT8 vs. FP16) on client silicon (Qualcomm, Intel, AMD). 
 - Background designing automated testing for multimodal inputs (synchronized voice injection, screen-capture parsing, synthetic system events). 
 - Demonstrated ability to resolve complex release-gating disputes with Product Management and PMO using objective risk metrics and clear mitigation trade-offs. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

Produce high-quality design artifacts (architecture diagrams, sequence flows, APIs, data models) and maintain clear, traceable documentation. 

Knowledgeable of emerging technologies and associated services. 

Implement reference implementations, prototypes, and proof-of-concepts to de-risk assumptions and accelerate decision-making. 

Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code where appropriate; set engineering quality bars for reliability, observability, and performance. 

Establish and enforce non-functional requirements (availability, latency, throughput, recoverability), and define SLOs/SLIs with robust monitoring and alerting

Champion security-by-design and privacy-by-default principles-threat modeling, secure coding, data protection, encryption, and compliance alignment. 

Drive integration strategies for legacy and modern systems (APIs, event streaming, messaging, microservices), ensuring interoperability and data integrity. 

Guide CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to streamline delivery, reduce risk, and improve release velocity. 

Lead technical reviews (design, code, readiness) and provide constructive feedback to elevate engineering standards across teams. 

Identify and remediate technical debt strategically-prioritize modernization efforts and build migration paths that minimize disruption. 

Mentor and influence engineers without formal line management-uplift skills in architecture, design, testing, and operational excellence. 

Expertise in architecting large-scale, distributed systems and producing high-fidelity design artifacts (diagrams, APIs, data models, migration plans). Proficiency in cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD with strong testing, observability, and SRE practices. Strong integration and data skills across APIs, event streaming (e. g. , Kafka), and governance, with security-by-design, privacy-by-default, and alignment to regulatory/compliance requirements. 

Subject matter expert in at least one of the tools/technologies used in the space. 

Executive-ready communication and influence without line management-driving technical strategy, risk management, vendor due diligence, and cross-functional alignment to measurable outcomes

Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required

9-11 years of experience in software development or technology infrastructure engineering required; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus. Job holder must have understanding interdependencies and business impact of future IT plans. S/he must have prior lead experience selecting and implementing vendor-specific methodologies and prior consulting experience with structured methodologies. Extensive experience with developing and supporting mainframe applications required. Job holder must have broad experience with multi-platform development tools and toolkits.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer- Fullstack
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

We're looking for a Staff Full Stack Developer to help build and scale our AI-powered tools for application development. You'll work at the intersection of UI, backend, and AI-driven engineering - architecting solutions that improve developer experience, expand platform capabilities, and drive engineering excellence across the team. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement AI-powered tools for application development, using cutting-edge technical approaches to deliver business value
 - Architect and build core web technology stacks - authentication, event tracking, application platform, and design systems
 - Drive architecture and engineering standards at the team and division level, promoting best practices for building modular, scalable web apps and APIs
 - Design, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications on Kubernetes, improving scalability, reliability, and deployment speed
 - Work closely with product, ML, and engineering teams to enhance developer experience, close technology gaps with creative solutions, and increase customer adoption
 - Expand the product's reach to more customers, domains, and global markets while maintaining high engineering quality
 - Integrate AI into engineering workflows and decision-making - using AI-powered tools, automating processes, and applying AI-driven insights to improve how the team builds and ships software
 - Operate at a startup pace with a high degree of total ownership, even within a larger organization

Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience building scalable, high-quality applications
 - Expertise in Java, JavaScript and modern UI frameworks - React, Angular, or Lit (required)
 - Hands-on proficiency using AI tools (e. g. , Copilot, Claude, or similar) in day-to-day development work is a must
 - Strong command of UI design principles, usability, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards
 - Experience with REST, JSON, AJAX, and relational databases
 - Experience with event-driven and stateless architectures, functional programming, and abstract data types (ADTs)
 - Demonstrated experience driving architecture and engineering standards at a team or division level
 - Strong critical thinking and a track record of integrating AI into engineering processes, workflows, or decision-making
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and strong product sense
 - BS or higher in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - A constant thirst for learning and willingness to work outside your comfort zone
 - Backend development experience with Java is an added advantage
 - ServiceNow platform certification and/or development experience is a strong added advantage

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

data.title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

- Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting. 
 - Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work-arounds and resolution of reported issues. 
 - Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run. 
 - Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds. 
 - Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work. 
 - Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right-size servers and services. 
 - Migrate on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure). 
 - Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions. 

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential: 

- BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
 - At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell. 
 - Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible. 
 - Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server. 
 - Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL. 
 - Proven ability to work in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas. 
 - Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems. 
 - Ability to work independently. 

Desirable: 

- 5+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices. 
 - Experience migrating on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure). 
 - Hands-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere. 
 - Availability to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and shift work to support production environments. 
 - Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis. 

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment. 

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

- B. E. /B. Tech. in a related technical field, or equivalent experience, education, or training.

 - Effective verbal and written communication skills with a strong team-player mindset.

 - Familiarity with software engineering best practices that drive enterprise-wide improvement, including DevOps and Observability. 
 - Experience working with Git/GitHub code repositories

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Join us in unlocking infinite opportunity in Mastercard's Commercial Solutions organization. 

In Commercial Solutions, we empower businesses with innovative, trusted payment solutions that deliver seamless, digital-first experiences globally. We are transforming the industry by building world-class travel and B2B platforms for corporate clients. 

As a key leader in our digital transformation journey, you will shape next-generation financial platforms-driving architecture, scalability, and engineering excellence to deliver secure, cloud, enterprise-scale solutions. 

________________________________________

Overview

Mastercard is seeking a Lead Software Engineer with strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and platform architecture. You will lead the design and delivery of scalable, resilient applications powering transaction processing, analytics, APIs, and modern user experiences. 

This role combines technical, architecture ownership, and hands-on execution, with a focus on mentoring teams and driving engineering standards across the stack. 

________________________________________

Role & Responsibilities

Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Lead architecture and system design for large-scale distributed cloud platforms with focus on scalability, resiliency, and security
 - Design and evolve microservices, APIs, and event-driven architectures
 - Translate business requirements into robust platform solutions and technical strategy
 - Own non-functional requirements including performance, reliability, fault tolerance, and observability
 - Drive adoption of cloud-native patterns, 12-factor principles, and domain-driven design

Full-Stack & Engineering Excellence

- Build and evolve high-performance full-stack applications using Java, Angular, and cloud platforms (PCF/Kubernetes)
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards for code quality, security, and performance
 - Lead design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance
 - Drive CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation practices

UI / Front-End Leadership

- Lead development of modern Angular-based architectures using component-driven and micro-frontend patterns
 - Define and Build reusable UI components and scalable design systems
 - Optimize applications for performance, latency, and cross-platform compatibility

AI & Intelligent Systems

- Architect and integrate AI-powered capabilities (e. g. , recommendations, anomaly detection, predictive insights)
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity
 - Ensure responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and compliance

Collaboration

- Provide technical mentorship, elevating engineering capabilities across teams
 - Influence technology strategy, frameworks, and platform evolution
 - Collaborate with product, architecture, and BizOps teams to align on roadmap and delivery
 - Ensure compliance with Mastercard engineering, security, and enterprise standards

________________________________________

All About You

Technical Expertise

- Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and system design
 - Proven experience building large-scale distributed systems and microservices architectures
 - Deep expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and backend engineering
 - Strong understanding of API design, event-driven systems, and messaging frameworks
 - Experience with cloud platforms (PCF, Kubernetes)
 - Solid knowledge of relational databases (Oracle) and data modeling at scale
 - Expertise in performance engineering, resiliency, and scalability patterns
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Git, automated testing, and release pipelines
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, and production support

UI / Angular Expertise

- Deep expertise in Angular, TypeScript, and state management (NgRx)
 - Experience with micro-frontends and component-driven architectures
 - Strong understanding of performance optimization, lazy loading, and rendering strategies
 - Familiarity with UI testing frameworks (Cypress)
 - Strong focus on usability, accessibility, and intuitive design

AI & Modern Engineering

- Experience integrating AI/ML models via APIs or enterprise workflows
 - Familiarity with GenAI/LLMs and AI-driven product capabilities
 - Understanding of data pipelines and model deployment patterns
 - Ability to apply AI to enhance user experience and operational efficiency

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 - DPP
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

QA Engineer - DPP

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Engineer to support the quality, reliability, and integrity of DPP deliverables across data ingestion, transformation, APIs, and downstream reporting. The successful candidate will review requirements and acceptance criteria, design and execute manual and automated tests, validate end-to-end data flows and business rules, and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify defects early, reduce delivery risk, and support high-quality releases. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Design

Review requirements, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation to create clear, traceable test scenarios and test cases for each User Story. 

Review test coverage with relevant stakeholders and maintain the regression suite to ensure ongoing support for business-critical DPP functionality. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

Execute manual and automated tests to validate new features, regression scenarios, and data transformations across the DPP platform. 

Record defects and data issues with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and impact assessment to enable efficient triage and resolution. 

Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to support root-cause analysis, validate fixes, and confirm production readiness. 

Validation & Closure

Retest resolved defects and confirm that acceptance criteria, business rules, and quality expectations have been met before closure. 

Maintain accurate defect reporting, status tracking, and quality documentation to support transparent delivery decisions. 

Data Integrity & ETL Validation

Validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of extracted, transformed, and loaded data across the DPP platform. 

Confirm that processed data aligns with business rules, acceptance criteria, and reporting expectations. 

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, tooling, and automation to increase efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the wider QA and delivery teams. 

Technical Skills & Tools

Mandatory Tools: 

Azure DevOps (Test Management & Release Support): Plan and execute DPP test cycles, manage test evidence and defects, support release readiness, and contribute to quality sign-off across delivery pipelines. 

Azure DevOps (Defect Tracking & Traceability): Log, triage, and track defects and data issues, maintain traceability to User Stories, data changes, and releases, and work with Engineering and Data teams on root-cause analysis and fix validation. 

SQL (Data Validation): Write and execute queries to validate data transformations, reconciliations, referential integrity, and data quality rules across staging and curated layers. 

Postman & Swagger (API Testing): Validate API contracts, schemas, authentication and authorization, error handling, and payload accuracy using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications; create and maintain collections for smoke and regression testing. 

Databricks & Azure Data Factory: Support validation of transformation logic, pipeline outcomes, and orchestration processes. Databricks is the primary platform used in DPP, while Azure Data Factory knowledge remains valuable as an additional skill aligned to broader ETL requirements. 

Programming & Frameworks: 

Python or Java: Experience using one or both languages for test automation, API checks, and data validation scripting. 

PyTest / Robot Framework / Contract Testing / Automated Data Checks: Familiarity with test frameworks and data-quality tooling to support DPP regression coverage and ongoing monitoring. 

KPIs & Success Metrics

Test Execution Delivery: Complete planned DPP test execution within agreed sprint timelines, with clear evidence and status visibility. 

Defect Detection Rate: Identify and log at least 90% of critical defects (data quality issues, pipeline failures, and API contract breaks) before release. 

Defect Turnaround Time: All defects are triaged, prioritized, and assigned within 24 hours of discovery. 

Coverage & Traceability: Maintain end-to-end coverage of User Stories, acceptance criteria, core business rules, and key data scenarios, with clear traceability across testing and release activity. 

Data Quality & Integrity: Ensure validated datasets meet transformation rules, reconciliation checks, and agreed quality tolerances for the DPP platform. 

Status Reporting: Provide weekly QA status updates covering test progress, defect trends, data quality outcomes, pipeline/API risks, and release readiness. 

Continuous Improvement: Propose at least one process or tooling improvement per quarter (e. g. , automation, data-quality checks, or pipeline monitoring) to strengthen DPP quality. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Candidate Profile

- Proven experience in QA or software testing within data-driven platforms, ideally involving ETL processes, APIs, and reporting or analytics solutions. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across data, APIs, and application behavior. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge is essential, including the ability to write and execute queries for data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work effectively across Product, Engineering, and Data teams. 
 - High attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes. 

Nice-to-have Skills

- Experience testing modern data platforms, data pipelines, or cloud-based analytics solutions. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, or quality gates within engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of API standards, data contracts, and integration testing practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional product and engineering teams.

Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

Introduction to the team

You will be joining Travels Foundation, Expedia Group's core platform powering pre and post-booking journeys at global scale. At its heart, the Ordering Services team owns the end-to-end lifecycle of every trip-from checkout to post-booking-across all major travel products. 

We're looking for an experienced backend engineer and strong technologist to build and evolve highly scalable, low-latency systems that power millions of bookings every day. 

Operating at the core of Expedia's transaction platform, our systems process millions of orders and updates daily, ensuring reliability, consistency, and auditability across brands and channels through domain-driven APIs. 

Join us to shape and scale the ordering platform that underpins Expedia Group's global travel marketplace. 

As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate key components of Expedia Group's Ordering Services platform, powering critical booking, reservation, and order management experiences across the travel ecosystem. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality, scalable, and reliable services that support order creation, modification, fulfilment, and lifecycle management while ensuring a seamless experience for travelers and partner teams. 

You will be a hands-on engineer, contributing code, driving technical design discussions, improving system reliability, and collaborating closely with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to solve complex distributed systems challenges.
