data.description:
Job Description

You will work closely with frontend, backend and Sitecore development teams as well as DevOps, UX, QA, and product teams, and you will be responsible for the quality, performance, security, accessibility, and operational health of the frontend. 

Responsibilities

- Technical leadership: Ability to make and document architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, conduct design/code reviews, mentor developers, and establish engineering best practices across the team. 
 - Project Setup & Configuration: 
 - Lead the initial setup and configuration of a Sitecore JSS and Next. js TypeScript project. 
 - Integrate Next. js frameworks like SSR (Server-Side Rendering), SSG (Static Site Generation), and ISG (Incremental Static Regeneration) for optimal performance and scalability. 
 - Set up and configure build tools, CI/CD pipelines, and development environments. 
 - Frontend Development: 
 - Develop dynamic and responsive user interfaces using React, TypeScript, SCSS, and Sitecore JSS. 
 - Ensure seamless integration with the Sitecore Experience Editor for editing content in real-time. 
 - Implement reusable components, hooks, and React state management libraries. 
 - Testing & Quality Assurance: 
 - Write and maintain unit tests using the Jest framework to ensure code quality. 
 - Implement end-to-end testing to cover UI and API integration. 
 - Collaborate with QA to ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Performance Optimization & Security: 
 - Optimize frontend performance by leveraging Next. js best practices, including code-splitting and lazy-loading. 
 - Implement a robust Content Security Policy (CSP) and maintain high security standards for client-side rendering. 
 - Optimize the project for SEO using best practices in SSR and SSG. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: 
 - Work closely with backend developers to ensure seamless API integration and data flow. 
 - Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate design mockups into high-quality code. 
 - Participate in code reviews and collaborate in an Agile development environment. 

Qualifications

- Core Technologies: 
 - Proficient in React, Next. js, TypeScript, SCSS and HTML5. 
 - Strong understanding of Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISG). 
 - Proven experience designing frontend architecture from scratch, defining project structure, component architecture, coding standards, state-management strategy, API/data-access patterns, error handling, logging, and observability. 
 - Strong Next. js architecture knowledge: Beyond SSR/SSG/ISR, experience with routing, caching/revalidation, server/client component boundaries where applicable, middleware, authentication, error handling, image/font optimization, and production deployment considerations. 
 - 6-8 years of practical experience using above technologies
 - 2+ years in a technical lead or architect role with ownership of frontend architecture decisions. 
 - Sitecore JSS: 
 - Experience with Sitecore JSS for creating seamless, editable components. 
 - Understanding of integrating Sitecore Experience Editor. 
 - Testing: 
 - Proficient with Jest for unit testing and ensuring code quality. 
 - Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) practices. 
 - Performance Optimization: 
 - Experience optimizing web performance, particularly in SSR/SSG environments. 
 - Other: 
 - Experience working with Git and CI/CD tools. 
 - Familiarity with setting up projects from scratch, including project structure, build configurations, and deployment pipelines. 

Nice To Have

- Familiarity with other testing frameworks like Cypress or Enzyme. 
 - Knowledge of accessibility standards and SEO optimization techniques. 
 - Experience with GraphQL and REST API integrations.

About The Company

About Us

Meesho is India's e-commerce marketplace, on a mission to democratise internet commerce. 

Our multi-sided technology platform connects four key stakeholders - consumers, sellers, logistics partners, and content creators - to power inclusive growth at scale. 

We enable individuals and small businesses to sell online with ease, offering access to a wide customer base, integrated logistics, payment solutions, and platform support. 

For customers, Meesho offers a broad and affordable selection, tailored for diverse needs across Bharat. We also empower creators to build commerce-driven content that drives discovery and engagement. 

Our logistics operations are powered by Valmo, Meesho's asset-light logistics platform that works entirely through partner-led infrastructure to ensure cost-efficient and scalable deliveries. 

Follow Meesho

LinkedIn Instagram YouTube Facebook Twitter Website

Benefits & perks

Health & Insurance

Medical Insurance: Base cover of ₹6 lakhs for employees and their families, including coverage for LGBTIQ+ and live-in partners, with day-1 coverage for pre-existing conditions. 

Accident & Life Insurance: Personal accident insurance up to 3x CTC and term life insurance up to 2x CTC. 

Wellbeing Support: Free doctor consultations, telehealth services, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

Leave & Time Off

Parental & Childcare Support: Gender-neutral parental leave, including 30 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers, 30 days for secondary caregivers, adoption assistance (up to ₹1 lakh), and pet adoption leave. 

Wellness & Special Leaves: Company-wide "Reset & Recharge" leaves (approx. 11 days), infinite wellness leaves (up to 365 days), and bereavement/paid time off (around 20 days/year). 

Financial Benefits & Equity

Stock Options (ESOPs): Direct ownership via MeeSOPs with employee-friendly vesting schedules and periodic buyback opportunities. 

Retirement & Planning: Provident Fund (PF), Gratuity, National Pension System (NPS) contribution options, and flexible benefit plan (FBP) tax benefits. 

Perks & Aids: Salary advance program (up to 3 months CTC), car lease policy, gym/wellness benefits, and relocation support. 

Work Culture & Learning

Work Arrangement: Remote-first and flexible work policies, with certain roles operating on hybrid or office models. 

Development & Training: Access to learning platforms, courses, and continuous development initiatives via MYAcademy and specialized programs. 

Why explore a career with us

The Key Reasons to Join Meesho

- Accelerated Career Growth & "Extreme Ownership"

Meesho operates on a culture of high autonomy. Teams utilize a "problem-first" approach rather than a feature-first approach. Employees are encouraged to take extreme ownership of projects early in their careers, giving them opportunities to ship ideas quickly and see their direct impact on millions of users. 

- Immense Impact (Building for the Next Billion)

Unlike platforms targeting Tier 1 demographics, Meesho is dedicated to democratizing internet commerce for Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. To foster deep user empathy, the company implements unique rituals like "Listen or Die" (LOD)-mandating that team members gather direct user insights before beginning any project-and sponsors user-safari trips into smaller towns to study consumer habits firsthand. 

- Top-Tier Compensation & Financial Perks

Meesho rates highly for its Compensation & Total Rewards (4. 1/5 stars on Glassdoor). The company offers: 

Competitive base cash salaries. 

Direct equity ownership with employee-friendly vesting schedules and frequent ESOP buybacks. 

Substantial lifestyle perks, such as gym benefits, car lease policies, and salary advance programs. 

- People-First Benefits & Well-Being

Through its MeeCare Program, Meesho focuses on holistic wellness. Notable initiatives include comprehensive health insurance, mental health support, flexible leave policies, and a distinct 9-day post-festive "rest and recharge" shutdown to prevent burnout after major sales campaigns. 

Interview process

Overview of Interview Rounds

- Application & Resume Screening: 
 - Candidates apply via official job portals, campus drives, or recruiter networks. 
 - AI-backed review tools on platforms like Lever may analyze resume metrics, experience, and baseline competencies. 
 - Online Assessment (OA): 
 - Typically lasts 90 to 105 minutes and features 3 to 5 coding and debugging questions (ranging from arrays and greedy approaches to graph/tree and dynamic programming problems) alongside computer science MCQs on OS, DBMS, and Networks. 
 - Technical Interviews (1-2 Rounds): 
 - Round 1 (DSA / Problem-Solving): Focuses on core data structures, algorithms, and logical problem-solving (such as greedy algorithms, array manipulations, or DFS/trees). 
 - Round 2 (Machine Coding / Low-Level Design): A practical coding or LLD session (e. g. , implementing a carpooling system or ticket booking system in 60-75 minutes) to test code structure, scalability, and clean design under constraints. 
 - Hiring Manager / System Design Round: 
 - In-depth discussion on past projects, internships, concurrency, multi-threading, and CS fundamentals like CAP theorem. 
 - Evaluates system architecture and trade-offs. 
 - HR / Cultural Fit Round: 
 - Focuses on alignment with Meesho's core values, such as "extreme ownership, " a "user-first" mindset, and structured communication.

data.title: Engineering Manager — Advanced Manufacturing Systems (Mechanical)
data.description:
Company Overview - Leumas

Leumas is a venture-funded deep-tech company based in Bengaluru, building modular robotic factories and software-defined manufacturing systems for healthcare products. 

Our R&D ambition is to build the future of drug manufacturing across emerging therapeutic modalities. We are developing new manufacturing modules and technologies for peptide synthesis, oncology applications and other advanced drug-production processes, while exploring Physical AI to make manufacturing systems more capable, adaptive and autonomous. 

This work brings together mechanical engineering, chemistry, process development, electronics, firmware, AI and quality systems. Our engineers translate scientific and process requirements into machines, test them through experiments and develop them toward scalable manufacturing platforms. 

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who wants to tackle unfamiliar engineering problems, build a strong multidisciplinary team and help define how future medicines will be manufactured. 

Industry Context

Our equipment must combine process performance, flexible configurations, hygienic design and practical manufacturing economics. Development succeeds when new mechanisms work repeatedly across realistic operating conditions. 

The Role

You will lead mechanical and manufacturing-system R&D for Leumas' next generation of technology modules, spanning peptides, oncology applications, Physical AI and emerging drug-manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with scientific, process, electrical, firmware and AI teams, you will translate new process requirements into equipment architectures, experimental systems and deployable manufacturing modules. You will guide development from early feasibility through prototypes, performance verification and transfer toward production. 

This role requires strong mechanical engineering depth, systems thinking and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You will build and mentor the engineering team while remaining personally involved in critical designs, experiments and technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

1. Technology roadmap - Translate manufacturing needs into development requirements, technical priorities and measurable acceptance criteria. Plan projects, resources and design milestones with leadership. 

2. Architecture & design - Lead mechanisms, motion systems, product-contact assemblies and modular interfaces. Review materials, tolerances, cleanability, maintainability and cost before releasing designs. 

3. Prototype learning - Plan experiments and instrumented trials; quantify dosing accuracy, throughput, repeatability or other relevant performance. Resolve failure modes through evidence and controlled design iterations. 

4. Cross-functional integration - Agree mechanical, electrical and software interfaces early. Coordinate process constraints, sensors, actuation, guarding and service access through complete-machine trials. 

5. Industrialisation - Own drawing and BOM quality, design-for-manufacture reviews and engineering change discipline. Transfer designs to build teams with assembly, test and operating documentation. 

6. Team & knowledge - Coach engineers, run technical reviews and maintain reusable design knowledge. Support invention documentation and protect confidential engineering information. 

7. New Manufacturing Technologies & Module Architecture - Work with scientists and process experts to understand the manufacturing requirements of new therapeutic modalities. Translate these into equipment concepts, module architectures and development plans. Evaluate technical feasibility, identify critical unknowns and build experiments that establish whether an approach can work. 

8. Physical AI & Adaptive Manufacturing - Collaborate with AI, robotics and controls teams to develop machines that can sense, interpret and respond to physical process conditions. Own the mechanical systems, actuation, sensing provisions and interfaces needed to test these capabilities. Establish measurable performance targets and appropriate safeguards with the responsible teams. 

You're a Fit If

·            BE/BTech, ME/Mtech, PHD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; typically 8-12 years in machine design and product development, including technical team leadership. A strong academic foundation from a leading engineering institution such as IITs, IISc, BITS or leading NITs is preferred. 

·            Track record delivering machines from requirements through prototypes, testing and manufacturing release. 

·            Strong fundamentals in mechanisms, machine elements, tolerances, materials and engineering analysis, with practical CAD proficiency. 

·            Ability to balance experimentation with schedules and lead cross-functional decisions using test evidence. 

·            You have developed novel machines or complex hardware where the solution was not fully defined at the outset. 

·            You can translate scientific or process requirements into engineering problems and work effectively with experts outside your discipline. 

·            You understand how mechanical design, sensing, actuation and software interact in a complete system. 

·            You can distinguish early technical feasibility from equipment ready for reliable manufacturing. 

Preferred: Candidates with a leading engineering-institution background and/or substantial R&D experience in a leading technology company / deep tech startups. Demonstrated engineering depth, delivery and startup adaptability will determine selection. 

How You Will Operate

You are a working technical leader who reviews details, invites critique and makes decisions explicit. You distinguish an interesting prototype from a design ready for deployment. 

What Success Looks Like

·            Priority development programs have clear requirements, test plans and accountable milestones. 

·            At least one agreed development milestone reaches documented performance verification and build handover. 

Why Join

·            Help build manufacturing technologies for emerging medicines and therapeutic modalities. 

·            Shape new modules spanning peptide processes, oncology applications and Physical AI. 

·            Work across engineering, science and AI to turn new manufacturing concepts into functioning machines. 

·            Build a capable R&D team and influence Leumas' technology roadmap. 

·            Take substantial ownership in a demanding startup where your work can define future manufacturing platforms.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Software Dev, OpenSearch
data.description:
Description

Amazon OpenSearch is a fully managed and Serverless service that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch clusters for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, and more. As part of AWS, we serve hundreds of thousands of customers who rely on OpenSearch to power mission-critical search and observability workloads at scale. 

The Amazon OpenSearch Core Foundation team owns the foundational indexing and search systems powering both OpenSearch Managed Service and Serverless offerings. We are building next-generation systems that support multiple data formats, diverse execution engines, and federated queries across heterogeneous data sources. As a Sr SDM, you will lead the team responsible for developing OpenSearch's next-generation indexing, storage, and metadata - delivering best-in-class price-performance for search and analytics workloads. You will drive the technical vision and execution for systems that serve both managed and Serverless customers at scale, shaping how millions of users index, store, and query their data. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and grow a multi-team organization of senior engineers and engineering managers focused on OpenSearch Core Foundation systems, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and customer obsession. 
 - Define and execute technical roadmaps for OpenSearch Core Foundation systems, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term architectural investments. 
 - Drive architectural decisions for large-scale distributed iCore Foundation systems, including index and storage build pipelines, consistency models, and cross-region index replication. 
 - Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate customer requirements into engineering priorities, ensuring the team delivers features that have measurable customer impact. 
 - Establish operational excellence standards for the OpenSearch Core Foundation systems, including availability, latency, and durability targets, and lead the team in meeting and exceeding those targets. 
 - Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent; build a diverse, high-performing organization with a strong pipeline of future leaders. 
 - Collaborate across OpenSearch and AWS with peer SDMs and Directors to align on shared infrastructure, resolve cross-team dependencies, and contribute to org-wide engineering strategy. 
 - Communicate complex technical strategies clearly to senior leadership. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
 - 5+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
 - Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
 - Experience in developing data infrastructure, search or similar large-scale data management systems

data.description:
Job Description

Ciklum is looking for a Senior JavaScript Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4, 000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 

About The Role

As a Senior JavaScript Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Together, we will work on the project Phase 2 Customer Expansion: Design, build, and deploy the next-generation, customer-facing RemitIntel Application. 

Responsibilities

- Architecture & Design: Collaborate with cross-functional US and vendor teams to define software requirements and translate them into scalable frontend architectures
 - Core Development: Engineer high-quality, reusable components and services using Angular (11+), TypeScript, and RxJS, ensuring strict adherence to clean code principles
 - Code Quality & Governance: Lead the pull-request process and code reviews to maintain low bug rates and ensure production-grade reliability
 - System Lifecycle Management: Manage the full application lifecycle, from initial requirements analysis and debugging to deployment and continuous refactoring
 - Agile Integration: Drive delivery within an Agile/SCRUM framework, providing transparent task updates and ensuring alignment between onshore and offshore teams
 - Cross-Border Collaboration: Maintain high-touch communication with US counterparts, including staggered shift availability (2pm-11pm) during critical design and delivery phases

Requirements

- Frontend Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, with a minimum of 2 years dedicated to TypeScript
 - Angular Mastery: 2+ years of experience with Angular 11+ component architecture, including directives, pipes, and migration strategies to newer versions
 - Advanced State & Logic: Proficiency in RxJS operators and state management libraries such as NgXs
 - Monorepo & Tooling: Proven experience with Nx (Nrwl) for monorepo management and proficiency in Git/Git hooks via terminal/PowerShell
 - UI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with Kendo UI, Angular Material, or SpreadJS libraries
 - Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with a proven ability to interface effectively with international (US) technical teams

What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
 - Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
 - Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
 - Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
 - Care: We've got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. 

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level. 

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can't wait to see you at Ciklum.

data.title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer, AI & Search
data.description:
Who We Are

Yieldmo is an advertising platform that helps brands invent creative experiences through tech and AI, using custom ad formats, proprietary attention signals, predictive format selection, and privacy-safe premium inventory curation. We believe all ads should be human-centered, tailored, and provoke emotion and action. Yieldmo helps brands deliver the best ad for every impression opportunity, merging creative and media for proven results. 

The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (5-10 years of experience) to help build Yieldmo's AI-powered search engine, which will change how users discover and engage with content across major publishers. This is a full-stack role with a strong ML component. You'll build backend services and ML-powered features, and ship the user-facing interfaces that bring them to life. We care most about builders: engineers who write production code, iterate quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and own their work end to end. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that power AI-driven search, including retrieval, ranking, and indexing components. 
 - Build and deploy ML features into production: embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and model evaluation. 
 - Develop responsive, performant front-end experiences that surface search results and AI features to users and internal teams. 
 - Build and maintain data and content ingestion pipelines that feed the search system. 
 - Own features end to end, from prototype through production, monitoring, and iteration. 
 - Partner with Product, ML, and Engineering teams to turn requirements into shipped features. 
 - Drive quality, performance, and reliability for the services you own, including testing, code reviews, and observability. 
 - Share knowledge and support teammates; senior engineers will mentor others and contribute to technical design decisions. 

Requirements

- Must be based in India. 
 - 5-10 years of professional software engineering experience, building and operating production systems. 
 - Strong backend skills in Python, with solid SQL and experience designing APIs and microservices. 
 - Hands-on front-end experience with a modern framework (React preferred) plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Practical ML experience in production: working with embeddings, vector databases, LLMs, RAG, or ranking/recommendation models. 
 - Experience with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and CI/CD. 
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, system design, and testing. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-moving, remote team. 
 - An ownership mindset: you ship, measure, and improve. 

Nice to Haves

- Deeper ML/AI backend experience: model serving, fine-tuning, training pipelines, or online/offline evaluation. 
 - Experience building search or retrieval systems (inverted indexes, BM25, hybrid search, rerankers). 
 - Familiarity with data tools such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or a modern data warehouse. 
 - Experience with publisher-scale content, recommendation systems, or adtech. 

Hiring Process

Selected candidates will be invited to a 30-minute screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll share full process details. The process typically includes: 

- A 30-minute video interview with the Hiring Manager. 
 - A remote round of video interviews with team members and leadership. 
 - An offer for successful candidates. 

Our Values

- Innovation: We encourage curiosity, embrace new ideas, and believe no idea is too bold. 
 - Agility: We embrace change, act quickly, and adapt with a focus on getting things done. 
 - Intelligence: We make decisions guided by data, aiming to deliver maximum value to our customers. 
 - Autonomy: We empower individuals to create their own paths with flexibility and independence. 
 - Togetherness: We foster teamwork, mutual support, and an environment where every voice matters. 

What We Offer

- Remote work: A fully distributed team, with annual offsites, holiday parties, and more. 
 - Company-paid health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. 
 - Equity: Share in Yieldmo's success through our employee stock option program. 
 - Flexible time off: Plus company slowdowns and Summer Fridays. 
 - Home office setup and stipend: Premium technology packages and a stipend for extra needs. 
 - Professional development: An annual stipend to grow your hard and soft skills.

data.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer - AI
data.description:
Are you passionate about building AI-driven software that transforms how professionals work? Join a dynamic and highly skilled team at Thomson Reuters, where we invest deeply in AI technologies and explore emerging fields with the backing of a global leader. As a Senior Software Engineer - AI, you will play a key role in developing intelligent systems that power the next generation of expert solutions across legal, tax, risk, and compliance domains. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - AI II, you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of product managers, UX designers, and engineers to design, build, and deliver AI-powered solutions. 

- Architect and implement advanced AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom AI agents with multi-step reasoning. 
 - Integrate AI models into production software through robust APIs and scalable data pipelines. 
 - Adapt AI models and techniques to specialized domains, tailoring solutions for expert systems in areas such as legal, tax, and compliance. 
 - Evaluate and prototype cutting-edge AI techniques to solve business challenges. 
 - Conduct proof-of-concept projects for new AI-driven features. 
 - Stay current with AI research and emerging technologies. 
 - Break down functional requirements into scalable technical specifications. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and facilitate technical discussions 
 - Contribute to MLOps and LLMOps practices, both in design and implementation. 
 - Act as a thought leader, sharing expertise in company-wide forums and representing the organization in emerging technology areas. 
 - Implement comprehensive testing frameworks and monitoring systems for AI model performance 
 - Ensure compliance with ethical AI principles and security standards. 
 - Conduct systems analysis and recommend operational improvements. 
 - Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, designers and product teams to translate AI capabilities into real-world applications. 
 - Optimize AI system performance considering factors like latency and resource usage. 
 - Support application feature enhancements through AI capabilities. 

About You

You are a fit for the position of Senior Software Engineer- AI if your background includes: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in software engineering; at least 2 years focused on AI/ML. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks (e. g. , PyTorch, TensorFlow). 
 - Strong understanding of machine learning principles, evaluation, and system design. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps and the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-powered software applications. 
 - Experience integrating AI models into production systems using APIs and data pipelines. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience with AI-driven systems, agent-based architectures, or AI APIs from providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. 
 - Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or search-based AI. 
 - Domain knowledge in legal, tax, or accounting. 
 - A portfolio of projects demonstrating creativity and skill building solutions with LLMs. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. 

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. 

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters. com.

Description

Interested in building Amazon Alexa, Machine Learning, and Generative Artificial Intelligence? We're building products and services that power state of the art for Amazon customers. Come join us!

The Alexa AI org is looking for a Principal Engineer to join Aurora (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) - Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization. Aurora is a science and engineering organization that advances research while delivering robust, scalable runtime solutions. We revolutionize conversational AI through three core pillars: architecting mission-critical AI runtime systems, advancing science solutions that connect key conversational capabilities, and transforming how builders create at scale. 

This role sits at the intersection of latest AI research and large-scale production systems, where you will architect and deliver Pragmatic AI capabilities - AI that is not just technically impressive, but reliably useful, trustworthy, and accessible to real customers in their everyday lives. 

What makes this role unique

You will be building AI experiences that work across the full spectrum of human interaction - multi-modal (speech, text, image, video), multi-lingual (global locales with distinct linguistic and cultural requirements), and multi-model (orchestrating and routing across frontier and specialized AI models to optimize for accuracy, latency, and cost). Your systems will serve customers across a diverse range of endpoints and form factors, from voice-first devices to screen-based and mobile experiences. 

AURORA influences the full Alexa+ agent execution path - from reasoning to evaluation to runtime - enabling you to operate in a structure designed to simplify interactions between components and the people who build them, accelerate feature development, and raise the bar on both operations and innovation velocity. 

Infrastructure & Systems Complexity

- Design and own the architecture for AI capability routing and orchestration at massive scale, including intelligent query classification, model selection, and fallback strategies across heterogeneous AI back-ends
 - Drive latency optimization across globally distributed inference pipelines, including model serving infrastructure, caching strategies, and real-time performance monitoring to meet strict customer-facing SLAs
 - Build evaluation and quality assurance infrastructure - including offline test sets, live traffic sampling, model and prompt release gating, and automated regression frameworks - to maintain high accuracy and reliability as models and locales evolve
 - Architect systems that support rapid iteration and safe deployment of new AI capabilities across global regions, with robust rollback, experimentation, and observability tooling
 - Lead the design of core AI runtime platforms that power conversational experiences end-to-end, including speech processing, intent orchestration, and unconstrained interaction models that move beyond rigid turn-taking structures

Technology Vision

- Define the long-term technical strategy for how Alexa+ delivers high-quality, low-latency AI experiences to a global customer base, including the evolution of model integration patterns as the AI landscape rapidly changes
 - Shape AURORA's platform vision to empower internal and external engineers and scientists worldwide with modular, reusable platforms that accelerate innovation - while delivering accurate, responsive, and reliable conversational experiences to millions of end-users through operational excellence at scale
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for responsible AI deployment - ensuring accuracy, safety, and fairness are first-class properties of every capability shipped
 - Influence the broader Alexa AI platform roadmap by identifying capability gaps, proposing architectural investments, and partnering with applied science, product, and platform teams to close them
 - Drive science-to-production integration for specialized conversational AI capabilities, including reasoning, classification, and language understanding models

What we're looking for

- Deep expertise in distributed systems, ML inference infrastructure, or large-scale AI platform engineering
 - Demonstrated ability to define technical direction in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces with significant customer and business impact
 - Experience driving cross-functional alignment across science, engineering, and product organizations - particularly in environments where unified ownership across research, runtime, and evaluation accelerates delivery
 - A track record of delivering production AI systems that serve diverse, global customer populations
 - Passion for building AI that is genuinely useful and trustworthy for real people

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

- Lead the org's technical direction, making critical decisions on architecture, infrastructure, and systems design for optimal performance, scalability, resilience and access patterns. 
 - Drive innovation in architectures with GenAI models
 - Design and implement scalable solutions to org's technical initiatives
 - Architect and build large-scale, distributed systems that integrate complex datasets and support different access patterns. 
 - Mentor and inspire a team of skilled engineers and scientists, fostering technical and professional growth
 - Collaborate across Amazon to align technical vision and priorities, influencing decisions at senior levels. 
 - Define best practices for system architecture and engineering processes, maintaining high standards for software quality and operational excellence
 - Lead engineering efforts that directly enhance customer experiences and business outcomes through Alexa+ and GenAI powered services. 

About The Team

The AURORA (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) org is part of Alexa AI VP and Devices and Services SVP organization. AURORA is Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization - a science and engineering organization that advances research while delivering robust, scalable runtime solutions. Our vision is to revolutionize conversational AI through three core pillars: architecting mission-critical AI runtime systems, advancing science solutions that connect key conversational capabilities, and transforming how builders create at scale. We are the horizontal Science and Engineering team that empowers Domains and Horizontal CX owners with transformative solutions that enable rapid, efficient scaling. AURORA represents a sophisticated global organization that spans multiple international locations including the US (Boston, Seattle), Canada, Poland, and India. The team's core mission is to deliver Pragmatic AI capabilities - AI that is not just technically impressive, but reliably useful, trustworthy, and accessible to real customers in their everyday lives - by developing and maintaining AI runtime systems and services that enhance the performance of core LLM models across various endpoints, modalities, and locales. 

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes. 
 - Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing, building & operating large scale, highly available, secure cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with AI software systems including Agents. 
 - 15+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to manage, optimize, and scale our cloud infrastructure supporting high-traffic digital news platforms, APIs, internal applications, and video delivery systems. 

The role involves managing AWS infrastructure, improving production reliability, automating operational tasks, strengthening security, troubleshooting performance issues, and optimizing cloud costs. The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of infrastructure and working closely with development teams. 

Key Responsibilities

• AWS Infrastructure Management: Manage and optimize EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, CloudFront, Application Load Balancers, Route 53, VPC, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, and related AWS services. 

• Production Operations: Monitor infrastructure health, troubleshoot application and server issues, investigate outages, and improve system availability and recovery. 

• Linux & Web Servers: Administer Ubuntu/Linux environments, Apache, Nginx, PHP-FPM, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and server-level performance configurations. 

• CI/CD & Automation: Build and maintain deployment pipelines, automate repetitive operational tasks, and improve release reliability using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools. 

• Infrastructure as Code: Work with Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent tools to make infrastructure deployments consistent and repeatable. 

• Cloud Security: Implement least-privilege IAM, security group policies, WAF rules, secure origin access, certificate management, logging, and vulnerability mitigation. 

• Performance & Scalability: Troubleshoot traffic spikes, database and application bottlenecks, CDN behavior, caching issues, and network-related performance problems. 

• Cost Optimization: Analyze AWS usage and billing, identify unnecessary expenditure, optimize compute and database resources, evaluate commitment plans, and implement cost-saving measures. 

• Monitoring & Incident Response: Set up actionable alerts, dashboards, centralized logs, health checks, and incident documentation using CloudWatch and other relevant tools. 

• Collaboration: Work with developers to improve application deployments, environment management, secrets handling, reliability, and production readiness. 

Required Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and production workloads. 

• Good understanding of Linux administration, shell scripting, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancing, and networking. 

• Experience with EC2, S3, CloudFront, ALB, Route 53, VPC, IAM, RDS, and CloudWatch. 

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. 

• Proficiency in Bash or Python scripting for automation and troubleshooting. 

• Practical knowledge of Terraform, CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code tools. 

• Experience troubleshooting production incidents, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes. 

• Understanding of cloud security, backups, disaster recovery, and high availability. 

• Ability to independently investigate issues, document solutions, and take ownership of assigned systems. 

Good to Have

• Docker and containerization; Kubernetes experience is a plus, but not mandatory. 

• Experience with AWS WAF, DDoS mitigation, CDN optimization, and high-traffic web applications. 

• Experience optimizing AWS costs and analyzing billing reports. 

• Knowledge of Redis/Valkey, MySQL/Aurora, PostgreSQL, and database connectivity issues. 

• Experience with media streaming, video delivery, caching, or large-scale content platforms. 

What We Expect

A practical engineer who can independently manage infrastructure, solve production problems, automate routine work, and continuously improve reliability, security, and cost efficiency. We value troubleshooting ability and real-world AWS experience over certifications alone.

data.title: Applied Science Manager ,  Catalog Quality
data.description:
Description

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines. 

As an Applied Science Manager on the team, you will lead a team of scientists to define and execute a transformative vision for holistic catalog quality measurement, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. Your team will own the science solutions for foundational quality detection frameworks, metadata validation and correction technologies, state-of-the-art algorithms to identify and resolve catalog anomalies (violative content, duplicative/low value content, misattributed tracks, incorrect metadata), and/or agentic AI solutions that help internal teams quickly surface and fix quality issues to ensure customers receive accurate, complete catalog experiences. 

Key job responsibilities

You independently manage a team of scientists. You identify the needs of your team and effectively grow, hire, and promote scientists to maintain a high-performing team. 

You have a broad understanding of scientific techniques, several of which may fall out of your specific job function. 

You define the strategic vision for your team. You establish a roadmap and successfully deliver scientific solutions that innovate on catalog quality detection, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. 

You define clear goals for your team and effectively prioritize, balancing short-term quality improvements and long-term innovation in catalog intelligence. 

You establish clear and effective metrics and scientific process to enforce consistent, high-quality artifact delivery and measurable catalog quality improvements. 

You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks. You know when to escalate. 

You communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. You author strategic documentation for your team. You communicate issues and options with leaders in such a way that facilitates understanding and that leads to a decision. 

You work successfully with customers, leaders, and engineering teams. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues. 

About The Team

We are a team of scientists and MLEs focused on music catalog quality and metadata intelligence. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and data quality systems with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, content operations teams, and other scientists with expertise in music metadata, content classification, and building scalable modeling and software solutions that keep the Amazon Music catalog accurate, complete, and trustworthy. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
 - Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics
 - 6+ years of applied research experience
 - Knowledge of machine learning approaches and algorithms
 - 3+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
 - Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - 5+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
 - PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Role Summary

Lead the development of automation solutions supporting Cybersecurity platforms and processes. Design scalable integrations, workflows, and reporting capabilities using Python, Azure, APIs, GitHub, and ServiceNow to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort. 

Key Responsibilities

Automation & Engineering

- Design and develop automation solutions using Python and Azure. 
 - Build API integrations across cybersecurity and enterprise platforms. 
 - Automate workflows, reporting, data collection, and operational processes. 
 - Develop reusable automation frameworks and cloud-native solutions. 
 - Support CI/CD pipelines and platform integrations. 

Platform Integration & Reporting

- Integrate ServiceNow, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and other enterprise tools. 
 - Automate dashboards, metrics, and operational reporting. 
 - Develop data aggregation and synchronization solutions across platforms. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead automation initiatives and technical projects. 
 - Mentor team members on automation and engineering best practices. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and implement automation opportunities. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- 10+ years of experience in Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, DevOps, or related fields. 
 - Strong Python development and automation expertise. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, Azure, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and ServiceNow. 
 - Experience building integrations, workflows, and automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD practices and cloud-based solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 

Cybersecurity Exposure

- Experience supporting cybersecurity or enterprise technology teams through automation solutions. 
 - Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts and processes. 

Preferred Qualifications

- BE/BTech in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 
 - Experience with Power BI, Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. 
 - Azure or automation-related certifications. 
 - Exposure to cybersecurity tools and platforms is a plus. 

Leadership Competencies

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Proven ability to lead large-scale automation initiatives. 
 - Strong technical leadership and mentoring capabilities. 
 - Results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset. 

Key Technologies: Python, Azure, REST APIs, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI, Terraform, CI/CD, Cloud Automation. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Engineering CSV & QMS Manger

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you "Create your own sunshine"- by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you'll find yourself becoming 'Better every day' through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you 'Take charge' and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we 'Thrive together' and support each other's journeys. "

Key Responsibilities

To lead Computer System Validation (CSV) and Engineering Quality Management Systems (QMS) activities across the site, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, data integrity standards, and lifecycle management of GxP computerized systems. The role is responsible for maintaining inspection readiness and supporting business continuity through robust validation and quality systems. 

Computer System Validation (CSV)

- Lead validation activities for GxP computerized systems, including equipment, automation systems, laboratory instruments, utilities, and software applications. 
 - Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements including 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, Data Integrity, and company procedures. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve CSV documentation including URS, FS, DS, Risk Assessments, IQ, OQ, PQ, Traceability Matrix, and Validation Reports. 
 - Manage validation lifecycle activities including implementation, upgrades, migrations, retirement, and periodic reviews. 
 - Coordinate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, IT, Manufacturing, and external vendors during validation projects. 

Quality Management Systems (QMS)

- Manage engineering-related quality systems including Deviations, CAPA, Change Controls, Risk Assessments, Investigations, and SOP management. 
 - Ensure timely closure and effectiveness monitoring of quality events. 
 - Review and assess engineering changes for compliance and validation impact. 
 - Support trend analysis and continuous improvement initiatives related to engineering quality systems. 

Data Integrity & Compliance

- Drive implementation and sustainability of Data Integrity requirements across engineering systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with ALCOA+ principles and regulatory expectations. 
 - Identify compliance gaps and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions. 

Audits & Inspection Readiness

- Serve as SME during USFDA, MHRA, WHO, TGA, Corporate, and customer audits. 
 - Support regulatory inspections and provide responses to observations related to CSV, automation systems, and engineering quality systems. 
 - Maintain audit-ready documentation and validation records at all times. 

Project Support

- Support qualification and validation activities for new equipment, facilities, utilities, and automation projects. 
 - Participate in technology transfer, commissioning, and engineering projects from a compliance perspective. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely project execution and regulatory compliance. 

Training & Team Development

- Conduct awareness programs on CSV, Data Integrity, and Engineering QMS requirements. 
 - Mentor team members and develop site capability in validation and compliance practices.

- 10-15 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Strong exposure to USFDA, MHRA, and other global regulatory requirements. 
 - Hands-on experience in Computer System Validation, Automation Systems, SCADA, PLC, BMS, EMS, TrackWise, SAP, LIMS, or other GxP systems.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

Lead Verification & Validation Engineer will be responsible for the delivery of the of HVDC Controls & Protection Verification and Validation team's activities on time / as per Project Scheduled through proper coordination between Project and department. The role involves technical leadership on the various work packages within the department ensuring that they meet the requirements, and the relevant processes are followed. 

Job Description

Main duties and responsibilities will include. 

- 
 - Prepare and maintain Validation & Verification team's activity plans as per the Project scheduled. 
 - Design and create FST and FAT test cases against design requirements. 
 - Properly manage Validation team shift plan. 
 - Leading the FAT with client. 
 - Gap analysis between standard / design requirement and customer technical requirements further leading to defining of test requirement. 
 - Understand the key milestones in the project plan, ensure that the plan correctly provisions for the required testing activities. 
 - Clearly communicate details of failures to the respective engineering functions. 
 - Knowledge of control system requirements for the RTDS LAB setup including AC DC interface requirement, Plant Emulator Interface requirement and RSCAD Power system network conversion, modelling and verification. 
 - Problem solving skills to support test issues especially lab setup and debugging skills. 
 - Strong sense of urgency and ability to identify and manage technical risks. 
 - Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and Product care teams to develop existing and new products and tools. 
 - Knowledge of Dynamic performance studies using both offline and online simulation tools (PSCAD/RSCAD). 
 - Assist Validation Engineers to carry out execution of tests and provide clear reporting of results. 
 - Review/analyze the test results thereby reporting the status. 
 - Provide support to Commissioning Engineers during Dynamic commissioning at Site. 
 - Support continual improvement, raising the effectiveness and efficiency of the team through the introduction of tools, methods and process improvements and coordinating with the Continuous Improvement leaders
 - Support a standard product methodology mindset, seek opportunities to re-use solutions, improve quality and reliability whilst reducing the delivery timeline and associated costs. 
Qualifications / Essential Requirements

- 
 - Engineering degree with 12+ years of experience or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business. 
 - Experience in the position of Verification Engineer in High Voltage field, preferably experience as a Control & Protection design Engineer. Good knowledge of overall 400kV substation, HVDC system (LCC/VSC/SVC) including control and protection system is essential. 
 - Knowledge and experience of developing and working with RSCAD models is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of Overall HVDC System Operational behavior. 
 - Strong communication skills with a fluency in English language. 
 - Must be flexible with working hours and willing to travel to support projects globally. 
 - Knowledge of applicable electrical standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 62351, IEC 12207, IEEE 15288, IEC 25010, IEC 27032, NERC/CIP will be an added advantage. 
 - Experienced in technical leadership. 
Desired Requirements

- 
 - Experience on MATCAD, PSCAD, PSS/E and MATLAB SIMULINK, EMTP-RV, Dig silent etc. will add advantage. 
 - Knowledge of Fault Recorder (TFR) systems. 
Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Release & Platform Engineering
data.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

About This Role

Release Engineering is OutSystems' is a Platform Engineering function. The group owns the platform's build and deployment orchestration, empowering product and development teams to focus on delivering business value. 

North Star: to empower teams to focus on delivering business value, by creating a zero-touch, secure, reliable, and cutting-edge technology platform capable of orchestrating full build and production deployment processes. 

The group is organized into small, autonomous squads. Release Engineers work across the full software delivery lifecycle - from CI/CD and containerization to cloud infrastructure and release governance - and act as a trusted point of support for engineering teams across the company via the group's dedicated support channels. 

This is a hybrid role: part software engineer, part cloud/infrastructure engineer, and part release governance owner. Expectations scale with seniority - from being autonomous in your own work, to leveraging your knowledge to help the team hit its goals, to guiding others and balancing technical, business, and operational needs. 

Key Responsibilities

- CI/CD ownership: Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows) that power build, test, and deployment automation across OutSystems services. 
 - Container & image management: Maintain and secure the Docker base-image catalogue (ingestion, versioning, deprecation, scanning) and manage AMI/machine-image pipelines (Packer, EC2 Image Builder) for build and CI infrastructure. 
 - Cloud infrastructure: Manage and provision cloud resources across AWS (ECR, EC2, IAM/OIDC) and Azure (ACR, Azure DevOps), using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform via Spacelift). 
 - Versioning & packaging: Own semantic versioning and package management practices (GitVersion, SemVer, NuGet feeds) to keep releases consistent and traceable. 
 - Release governance: Operate release governance processes, including RFC/CAB change management, deployment gating, and rollback procedures for production changes. 
 - Operational support: Staff the Release Engineering support rotation, triaging and resolving developer requests and incidents raised through dedicated support channels. 
 - Monitoring & metrics: Build and maintain observability into pipelines and deployments using tools such as Grafana, Power BI, and Kibana. 
 - Security & compliance: Uphold security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and FedRAMP controls, vulnerability scanning via Wiz/Snyk) across the release pipeline. 
 - Leadership & enablement: As seniority grows, guide other engineers, mentor teams adopting CI platform/release best practices, and represent Release Engineering's roadmap to stakeholders across the company. 

Skills You Need to Succeed

Skills below are ranked by how central they are to day-to-day Release Engineering work. Must-haves are used constantly and span nearly every squad; good-to-haves add significant value but are more specialized or team-specific and can often be developed on the job. 

Must Haves

- CI/CD pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions - designing, debugging, and maintaining build/release workflows. 
 - OCI Lifecycle: Development and management of the full life cycle of OCI artifacts. 
 - Cloud platform fundamentals: AWS (ECR, IAM/OIDC, EC2, RDS) and Azure (ACR, Azure Machines and DBs, Azure DevOps) core services. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Image Building: Proficiency in Terraform, CloudFormation for cloud provisioning and experience with Packer and EC2 Image Builder are must-have skills. 
 - Ownership under pressure: A strong sense of urgency, customer focus, and reliability as a support point for other engineering teams. 

Good To Haves

- Git workflows & semantic versioning: Branching strategies, tagging, GitVersion/SemVer discipline, and NuGet/npm feed mechanics. 
 - Observability & monitoring: Hands-on experience designing, building, and managing end-to-end monitoring and alerting systems to gain operational insights across pipelines and platform components (e. g. , using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Power BI, or Kibana). 
 - Security & vulnerability scanning: Working knowledge of security practices, vulnerability scanning, and compliance standards such as SOC 2 and FedRAMP. 
 - Release & change governance: RFC/CAB processes and staged (ring-based) promotion models for production changes. 
 - GitOps & Kubernetes: Flux-based GitOps repositories and Helm release troubleshooting across multiple environment rings. 
 - Cross-team mentoring & leadership: Experience mentoring other engineers or representing a team's roadmap to stakeholders

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform. 

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact. 

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration. 

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1, 700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees. 

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries- such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA-who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact. 

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports. 

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems. 

What do we have to offer you?

- A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don't just react to AI innovation-we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse. 
 - Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there. 
 - A global collective of world-class talent, where you'll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries-they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together. 

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

RMM Backend - Staff Software Engineer (Development & Quality)

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to influence not only the architecture and scalability of our platform services, but also how engineering teams leverage AI-assisted development, automation, and quality engineering practices to deliver reliable software faster. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native platform capabilities that power Kaseya products. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building reliable, secure, and maintainable SaaS applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about software architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, engineering excellence, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, scalability, and release confidence. 

What You Will Do
