data.title: Technical Manager
data.description:
Position Overview

The Technical Manager will lead technical and engineering activities for Kaprel India, ensuring accurate and timely project technical submittals, compliance with project specifications, effective coordination with contractors and consultants, and practical technical support through procurement, production and installation. The role will oversee the technical team, support product development and standardization, and act as a central technical resource for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. 

Responsibilities

1. Technical Submittals and Project Approvals

·                Prepare, review and coordinate complete technical submittal packages for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, in line with project-specific requirements and approval procedures. 

·                Compile material submittals, compliance statements, technical data sheets, product specifications, test reports, certificates, method statements and supporting engineering documents as required. 

·                Manage material and finish sample submissions, approval tracking, consultant comments, resubmissions and closure of technical queries. 

·                Coordinate with main contractors, consultants, clients, project teams and Kaprel management to obtain approvals and finalize project-specific materials, system details and designs. 

·                Maintain an up-to-date submittal register, document revision history and approvals record; proactively flag submission risks affecting procurement or site schedules. 

2. Technical Leadership and Engineering Management

·                Lead and coordinate the technical and design team, assign work priorities, review deliverables and monitor workload, quality and submission deadlines. 

·                Oversee the development and checking of shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation details, material take-offs and bills of materials to support accurate procurement and manufacturing. 

·                Conduct technical evaluations and design assessments for compliance with applicable standards, approved specifications, contractual scope and customer requirements. 

·                Establish consistent engineering checklists, drawing review procedures, revision controls and handover requirements between departments. 

·                Identify gaps or discrepancies in tender documents, drawings and specifications; raise technical clarifications and coordinate timely resolution before fabrication. 

3. Procurement, Production and Site Coordination

·                Prepare and maintain procurement schedules and long-lead material requirements in coordination with project programmes and approved technical submittals. 

·                Liaise with Procurement, Stores and Production teams to ensure the correct materials and specifications are available when required, and highlight risks early. 

·                Provide technical support to manufacturing and installation teams, resolving design interfaces, fabrication constraints and site-specific technical problems. 

·                Investigate installation and product performance issues, establish root causes and implement practical corrective measures to prevent recurrence. 

·                Coordinate technical responses and support to customers and project teams on system specifications, installation details and product performance. 

4. Product Engineering, Quality and Improvement

·                Drive value engineering initiatives to improve manufacturability, installation efficiency, product reliability and cost effectiveness without compromising approved performance. 

·                Support new product and system development, component selection, prototyping, testing, certification and performance improvement initiatives. 

·                Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders on suitable alternatives for aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, seals, gaskets and related components. 

·                Maintain controlled records of technical specifications, approved system details, certificates, testing reports and product documentation for use across Kaprel locations. 

·                Analyze recurring technical errors, nonconformities and rework costs; recommend design standardization and preventive improvements. 

5. Reporting and Accountability

·                Provide regular updates to the General Manager on technical submission status, departmental workload, approval delays, unresolved technical risks and improvement initiatives. 

·                Coordinate closely with regional Kaprel teams so requirements and approved technical documentation are consistent, while respecting differences in local project specifications and standards. 

·                Escalate deviations involving unapproved system changes, project cost impact, contractual scope or technical performance before implementation. 

Qualifications and Experience

·                Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline. 

·                Minimum 6 years of relevant construction or subcontracting experience, preferably in the glazing, architectural aluminium, partition or door systems industry. 

·                Prior experience managing technical work and coordinating with main contractors, consultants and clients. 

·                Good knowledge of project specifications, technical documentation, material approvals and subcontract scope management. 

·                Ability to interpret engineering drawings and coordinate fabrication, procurement and installation requirements; proficiency with AutoCAD and relevant technical tools is advantageous. 

·                Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and team management skills; comfortable coordinating technical deliverables across multiple locations. 

For those interested, pls send your CV to recruitment@kaprel. com with subject line: Application_Technical Manager_India

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

Job Description

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place. 

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

- AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. 
 - Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. 

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

- Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm. 
 - Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months. 

Technical Strategy & Authority

- Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration. 
 - Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies. 

Customer & Business Impact

- Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. 
 - Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed. 

You're Our Builder Lead If. . . 

- You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent. 
 - You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments. 
 - You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value. 
 - You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects. 
 - You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails. 
 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines. 
 - Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist). 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to an ever-changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to every interaction, and we continue to improve, grow together, and collaborate as one team. All of these, while having Fun, truly make FlexTrade a wonderful place to work. 

About you: 

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically curious engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges in a fast‐paced trading environment. As part of the FX Development & Client Services team, you will architect high‐performance FX trading components, build low‐latency integrations with leading global market participants, and work directly with traders and technologists to shape next‐generation FX workflows. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys breaking down complexity into well‐defined technical solutions and wants to continuously grow as financial products and markets evolve. 

Responsibilities

As a member of the FlexFX Development & Client Services team, you will: 

- Design, implement, and maintain advanced FX trading components with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability, and reliability.

 - Individually test each component you build-designing comprehensive automated tests that cover edge cases, failure scenarios, performance‐critical boundaries, and real‐world resiliency requirements. 
 - Produce clear technical designs, architecture documents, and workflow specifications. 
 - Continuously learn and adapt to new products, markets, and trading technologies as financial systems evolve. Job requirements

- Minimum of 7+ years of professional software development experience.

 - Proficiency in modern C++ or similar high‐performance languages. 
 - Experience working on large‐scale, low‐latency, and/or distributed systems, with teams spread all across global regions. 
 - Strong problem‐solving and debugging skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into clear, actionable tasks. 
 - Familiarity with testing methodologies and frameworks such as GTest. 
 - Excellent communication skills for working across technical and business teams.

data.title: Process Lead - Personal Independence
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Job Description - GDS Independence | Process Lead

Role title GDS Independence Process Lead

Position Summary

The Process Lead is accountable for the governance, quality, and overall health of an assigned GDS Independence process portfolio. Acting as the process steward and independent quality oversight leader within the operating model, the role provides a consolidated view of process performance, recurring issues, control effectiveness, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities across the portfolio. 

The role establishes process priorities, directs and supports Process SMRs, and drives assurance, remediation, and capability initiatives to strengthen consistency, compliance, and operational effectiveness. Working closely with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Leaders, and other stakeholders, the Process Lead ensures global standards are effectively embedded, risks are proactively managed, and process improvements are implemented in a controlled and sustainable manner. 

Through strong governance, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement, the Process Lead enables consistent execution, strengthens process maturity, and supports the delivery of high-quality Independence services across GDS. 

Key Responsibilities

Process Governance & Portfolio Leadership: 

- Lead the governance agenda for assigned GDS processes. 
 - Maintain an integrated view of process health, quality, risks, capability, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Establish portfolio priorities and determine focus areas for assurance, remediation, and process improvement. 
 - Drive consistent application of Global standards and approved process requirements. 
 - Partner with Global and Regional Process Owners to support effective process governance and decision-making. 

Quality, Assurance & Risk Oversight: 

- Approve and oversee risk-based quality and assurance coverage across the portfolio. 
 - Review significant findings, recurring issues, control weaknesses, and emerging risks. 
 - Determine when additional review, remediation, or escalation is required. 
 - Oversee thematic reviews, trend analysis, and quality assessments to identify systemic risks. 
 - Ensure assurance outcomes lead to meaningful and sustainable improvements. 

Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement: 

- Analyse recurring issues, root causes, assurance findings, and process risks across the portfolio. 
 - Establish remediation priorities and monitor progress to closure. 
 - Hold designated owners accountable for delivering corrective actions. 
 - Confirm remediation activities address underlying causes and reduce future risk. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve process effectiveness. 

Process Change & Knowledge Management: 

- Oversee implementation of approved process improvements and changes across GDS. 
 - Maintain process documentation, SOPs, playbooks, controls, job aids, and knowledge repositories. 
 - Translate approved Global changes into practical guidance and readiness actions. 
 - Ensure process standards remain current, accessible, and consistently applied. 
 - Support successful adoption through effective communication and learning strategies. 

Stakeholder & Process Stewardship: 

- Partner with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Independence Leaders and other stakeholders to strengthen process performance and governance. 
 - Provide clear recommendations on process risks, quality concerns, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Influence decisions through data-driven insights and objective process oversight. 
 - Represent the process portfolio in governance forums and strategic discussions. 
 - Foster strong collaboration between process, service, and delivery teams. 

People Leadership & Capability Development: 

- Lead, coach, and develop assigned Process SMRs. 
 - Establish clear expectations, ownership, and accountability for portfolio outcomes. 
 - Drive calibration and consistency of technical judgment across teams and locations. 
 - Strengthen succession planning, knowledge continuity, and leadership readiness. 
 - Build a sustainable pipeline of process stewardship capability to support future organizational needs. 

Success measures

- Quality: Quality at source, rework, Second-line review themes, business escalations, independent QA themes and sustained remediation
 - Experience: RIL pulse, Voice of Customer, communication quality. 
 - People: Capability, engagement, retention, coaching, succession and primary/secondary coverage
 - Risk & Assurance: Reduced systemic risks and recurring quality issues through effective assurance and independent oversight. 
 - Improvement & Transformation: Measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, standardization, and user experience. 
 - Capability & Succession: A strong pipeline of capable Process SMRs supported by effective coaching, knowledge continuity, and succession planning. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Strengthen stakeholder confidence through effective governance, strategic insights and Global alignment. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong Independence or risk and compliance knowledge, with the ability to link process decisions to regional and business outcomes. 
 - Experience in quality management, assurance, root cause analysis, risk assessment, control effectiveness reviews, and remediation oversight. Able to identify recurring and systemic issues, assess risks, and drive practical, sustainable improvements. 
 - Proven leadership of multi-location teams, with clear accountability for capacity, performance, risk and people outcomes. 
 - Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships. 
 - Sound judgment, using service, quality, demand, people and stakeholder insights to set priorities and improve performance. 
 - Inclusive and culturally aware leadership, with a strong focus on coaching, talent development and succession. 
 - Proven ability to lead change, drive technology adoption and deliver sustained service improvements. 

To qualify for the role

- A university degree (master's or post-graduate degree) or equivalent professional experience in business, accounting, finance, risk, compliance, operations or a related area. 
 - 12-14 years of relevant experience in professional services, global delivery, Independence, risk or another controlled service environment. 
 - Demonstrated people leadership, stakeholder management, Quality and controls and change implementation. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English and confidence operating across time zones and cultures. 
 - Evidence of portfolio leadership, senior stakeholder credibility and cross-process judgment appropriate to Rank 62 or aspiring Rank 62. 

What You Can Look For

- A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment. 
 - A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY's brand name. 
 - A team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills. 
 - A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness. 
 - Opportunities to work with regional teams and stakeholders on strengthening the compliance framework. 
 - A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiency to processes. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland and UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve. 

Who You Are

As a Staff Engineer L6, you lead development across Inovalon products and platforms with a focus on solving resiliency, scale, and security challenges at a higher level of technical sophistication. You serve as a functional lead and subject matter expert, helping guide engineering execution across teams while raising discipline, productivity, and technical quality. In this role, you partner with business stakeholders, architecture leads, and engineers to deliver scalable data solutions, strengthen platform reliability, and drive a collaborative, data-driven engineering culture. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable healthcare data pipelines and data access patterns that support Inovalon products and platforms. 
 - Research, evaluate, and apply new technologies, tools, and frameworks focused on high volume data processing in AWS and cloud based environments. 
 - Design and implement distributed data processing pipelines using tools and languages common in the big data ecosystem. 
 - Document technical designs, estimate scope, and help define implementation approaches for complex engineering initiatives. 
 - Drive a culture of collaborative reviews across designs, code, and test plans to improve quality, consistency, and engineering discipline. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders and architecture engineering leads to ensure high quality solutions are delivered and engineering standard methodologies are followed. 
 - Advance DevOps practices by utilizing and improving continuous integration and deployment frameworks, including automated pipelines with multi stage validation. 
 - Solve complex data and platform issues through root cause analysis, and work across teams to resolve operational and performance problems. 
 - Provide strong technical leadership by raising the technical bar, fostering a data and results driven culture, and building trust and collaboration across teams. 
 - Influence and coach junior engineers within and outside your team, communicate effectively across disciplines, and support on call responsibilities for critical issue resolution. 

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of industrial experience with cloud and serverless technologies. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience required. 
 - Hands on experience with AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, test orchestration, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling. 
 - Experience implementing fully automated pipelines with multi stage validation. 
 - Familiarity with SQL Server, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL, especially test data creation, schema validation, and data quality automation. 
 - Proven ability to drive test automation maturity, reduce manual testing, eliminate flakiness, and improve reliability through automation, monitoring, proactive stability improvements, and automated alerting. 
 - Proficiency in test automation for microservices, containerized environments, and orchestrated systems including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by evaluating emerging tools and frameworks, expanding expertise across cloud, data, and automation domains, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes. 
 - Demonstrate leadership by setting technical direction, aligning teams on goals and timelines, coaching engineers, and influencing high quality execution across functions and teams. 
 - Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to changing technologies, priorities, and operational demands while maintaining focus on delivery, resiliency, and quality. 
 - Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying innovative ways to solve scale, security, reliability, and automation challenges across products and platforms. 
 - Demonstrate analytical skills by performing root cause analysis, assessing data and system issues, and using evidence to improve performance, quality, and operational stability. 
 - Nice to have: Experience with service meshes and asynchronous or event streaming systems such as Kafka, SQS, and SNS; advanced performance testing and benchmarking experience with k6, JMeter, or Gatling; security automation experience including vulnerability scanning, static analysis, and secrets validation; experience leading organization wide automation transformations, platform migrations, or quality initiatives.

Work Environment

The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth. 

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are expanding our AI Engineering organization at ZF and are hiring Senior Solution Architects.

This area owns the technology portfolio that connects demand intelligence, inventory positioning, and product flow across Walmart International. Through SMART Forecasting, GeoDemand, Placements, IO2, and O3, the organization enables the capabilities that determine what customers are likely to need, where inventory should be positioned, and how product should flow efficiently through the supply chain. 

The team's purpose is to build an intelligent, scalable, and connected replenishment ecosystem that turns demand signals into better inventory and flow decisions. By bringing together software engineering, data, machine learning, forecasting, and optimization, the team seeks to improve product availability and inventory productivity while reducing variability and creating greater efficiency across suppliers, distribution centers, stores, clubs, and fulfillment networks.

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Site Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our systems and services. You will work closely with development and operations teams to build and maintain robust infrastructure, automate processes, and drive engineering best practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor, maintain, and improve the reliability and availability of production systems 
 - Respond to and resolve incidents, conducting thorough post-mortems to prevent recurrence 
 - Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) 
 - Collaborate with development teams to build reliability into services from the ground up 
 - Design and implement automation to reduce toil and improve operational efficiency 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical systems 
 - Contribute to capacity planning and performance optimization efforts 
 - Document systems, processes, and runbooks to support the wider team

Required Technical Skills

Kubernetes (Required)

- Hands-on experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting workloads in Kubernetes 
 - Strong understanding of core Kubernetes concepts including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Ingress 
 - Experience with Kubernetes cluster management and administration 
 - Familiarity with Helm for application packaging and deployment 
 - Understanding of Kubernetes networking, storage, and security best practices

Additional Technical Skills

- Cloud Platforms: (e. g. AWS, GCP, Azure) 
 - CI/CD Tooling: (e. g. GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Harness) 
 - Monitoring & Observability: (e. g. Prometheus, Grafana, Coralogix, OpenTelemetry) 
 - Infrastructure as Code: (e. g. Terraform, Pulumi) 
 - Config Management: (e. g. Ansible, Puppet, Chef) 
 - Programming/Scripting: (e. g. Python, Go, Bash)

Soft Skills & General Requirements

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams 
 - A proactive mindset with a focus on automation and continuous improvement 
 - Ability to work effectively under pressure, particularly during incident response 
 - Commitment to a blameless culture and continuous learning

Nice to Have

- Experience contributing to open-source projects 
 - Familiarity with SRE principles as defined by the Google SRE handbook 
 - Previous experience in a DevOps or Platform Engineering role

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. 

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

data.title: Manager, Manufacturing Process Operations
data.description:
Job Purpose

JOB DESCRIPTION

Lead Peptide Upstream Manufacturing, particularly Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS), along with manufacturing QMS activities to ensure safe, compliant and timely execution in line with cGMP, quality, EHS and business/project requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Peptide Upstream Manufacturing: Lead SPPS operations covering resin charging/swelling, Fmoc deprotection, amino acid coupling, washing, cleavage and filtration. Ensure execution as per approved BMR/BPR, SOPs, process parameters, quality requirements and production schedules; monitor yields, solvent/material consumption and equipment utilization. 
 - QMS Management: Own manufacturing-related deviations, CAPA, change controls, incident investigations, RCA and risk assessments. Review/approve SOPs, BMR/BPR, protocols, forms, checklists and logbooks, ensuring GDP, Data Integrity and timely QMS closure. Maintain readiness for customer, regulatory and internal audits. 
 - Project & Equipment Readiness: Provide manufacturing inputs for URS, equipment/facility design and process requirements. Coordinate equipment procurement, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning and qualification, including DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ as applicable, and ensure equipment readiness for engineering and GMP batches. 
 - Technology Transfer & Scale-Up: Coordinate with R&D/Process Development for technology transfer, manufacturing feasibility and scale-up. Support engineering, demonstration, validation and commercial batches; identify scale-up risks, implement mitigation and transfer process knowledge to shop-floor teams. 
 - Team Management: Lead, allocate and monitor the Upstream Manufacturing & QMS team. Ensure training and qualification in SPPS, GMP, QMS, troubleshooting and documentation, while driving Safety, Quality, Compliance, Productivity and Accountability. 
 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with R&D, QA, QC, Engineering, Projects, Warehouse, Supply Chain, EHS, Validation and Procurement to ensure timely availability of raw materials, equipment, documents, utilities and manpower. 
 - EHS & Compliance: Ensure safe handling of solvents, reagents, amino acids, resins and process materials. Participate in process risk assessments, HAZOP and safety reviews, and ensure timely closure of safety observations and corrective actions. 

Qualifications

Qualification B. Pharm / M. Pharm / B. Sc. / M. Sc. / B. Tech / M. Tech in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field

Experience Preferably 12-15 years in Peptide/Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, with relevant experience in manufacturing operations and QMS.

Bring-Up and Characterization Engineer

Multiple roles across different levels

Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. We are looking for a Characterisation and Bring-Up engineer to work with Architecture, Silicon Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Operations (device manufacture) and Product teams to help create and execute the bring-up and characterisation of our cutting-edge silicon devices and system platforms. Graphcore design and develop leading edge silicon processors and high-power high-speed blade systems at the forefront of AI technology. As such you will need to develop a detailed understanding of our silicon and platform products. Your role will be to create and execute bring-up and characterisation plans of our silicon devices in systems to show that they will operate correctly over all conditions in the final product. You will concentrate on automated and manual testing of systems in the lab and datacentre. The results will be integrated with data from other teams to provide the complete characterisation solution for the product. For example, a large amount of device testing can be performed by the production test team using high-speed production test equipment.

 - Creation of product specific characterisation plans
 - Liasing with engineering teams to understand what are tests are available for characterisation purposes and driving change where appropriate
 - Create and maintain an automated system for running characterisation testing, capturing the results to a central database and performing data analysis
 - Execution of manual characterisation tests where automation is not appropriate
 - Report regularly on progress and issues during the characterisation
 - Produce characterisation reports containing platform test results and feeding them up into the overall product characterisation report

Essential Skills

- A proven track record of delivering technical output, perhaps as an individual contributor, manager, or project manager
 - Solid experience and understanding of silicon digital device design characterization
 - Knowledge of silicon process technology and how that impacts device performance at transistor and system level
 - Knowledge of high-performance processor and system-on-chip systems
 - Experience of high-speed digital interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet or DDR
 - Knowledge of measurement automation and data analysis
 - The ability to code or script automation and data analysis using appropriate coding languages such as Python, JMP for example

Celebal Technologies is seeking experienced Salesforce professionals to contribute to enterprise transformation, application modernization, and next-generation architecture initiatives. data.title: Builder Developer II
data.description:
Job Description

The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile

You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first. 

- Core DNA
 - AI-Native Workflow. You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place. 
 - Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic. 
 - Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else's problem. 
 - Evidence Over Confidence. You don't ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases - and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn't one. 
 - What You Own

Your agent. Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down. 

The evidence it works. Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does - characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs. 

Your blast radius. You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry. 

- Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)
 - The Agentic Architect (Systems) - you don't just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes. 
 - The UX/Interaction Builder (Product) - the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done. 
 - The Data & Context Engineer (Data) - master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry. 
 - The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA) - you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic. 
 - The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps) - you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI. 
 - The Domain Logic Translator (Business) - you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints. 

What You'll Actually Do

- Build execution agents. Move beyond RAG into action - agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix. 
 - Automate the untestable. Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided. 
 - Prove parity. Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches - on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones. 
 - Prompt engineering and evals. Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions. 
 - Rapid prototyping. Turn a "what if" into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months. 
 - Fix your own agents in production. Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again. 

What Good Looks Like

(Illustrative - real targets agreed with the hiring manager. )

- 30 days: Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small. 
 - 90 days: Owning a legacy module end to end - parity evidence, tests, deployment - with minimal supervision. 
 - 6 months: Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You're the person people ask about one thing in particular. 

The Stack

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. 

Who You Are

- You've shipped one. You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work - not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did. 
 - The early adopter. You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn. 
 - Agent-first thinker. You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions. 
 - The manual-task hater. You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you've already started drafting the automation. 
 - Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn't complexity, it's a puzzle about to get solved. You aren't intimidated by spaghetti code - you're the one who brings the sauce. 
 - Rigor over hype. You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data. 

Why Join Us

- The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you've mastered the hardest problem in software. 
 - Agentic autonomy. We don't do tickets. We do missions. You'll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win. 
 - No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee - a "Does It Work?" policy. 
 - The Builder Tribe. You won't be the only AI person in the room. You'll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Software Engineer based in India. 

Lead the development of innovative software products and AI-powered solutions that transform business operations and deliver exceptional digital experiences. In this role, you will define technical direction, guide architecture decisions, and lead projects from early discovery through production delivery. You will help establish an AI-native engineering culture, leveraging advanced coding tools, intelligent agents, and scalable cloud technologies. Working closely with senior engineering and product leaders, you will translate complex business challenges into practical, high-impact solutions. You will also mentor engineers, strengthen development standards, and ensure that technical decisions balance quality, cost, risk, and speed. This opportunity is suited to a hands-on technical leader who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is passionate about turning ambitious AI strategies into reliable products. 

Accountabilities

As Lead Software Engineer, you will own technical execution for a team or product while helping shape the broader engineering strategy. You will combine architectural leadership, hands-on development, cross-functional collaboration, and team mentorship to deliver measurable business outcomes. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Lead AI Initiatives End to End: Define and maintain the architecture roadmap for your team or product, transforming ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans and production-ready software. 
 - Shape AI Architecture: Partner with senior engineering leaders to develop and implement approaches involving AWS Bedrock, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic architectures, evaluation pipelines, and production safeguards. 
 - Establish AI-Native Development Practices: Design and implement agentic coding workflows using tools such as Claude Code, including reusable skills, engineering standards, and review processes that ensure AI-generated code meets production requirements. 
 - Drive Technical Decisions: Evaluate architectural options, make informed trade-offs, retire outdated designs, and establish scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with product and business priorities. 
 - Mentor and Develop Engineers: Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, pairing, code reviews, constructive feedback, and reusable technical guidelines. 
 - Connect Engineering with Business Needs: Collaborate with teams across departments to understand operational challenges and identify opportunities where AI agents and automation can reduce manual work and improve efficiency. 
 - Manage Cost, Risk, and Delivery: Communicate technical trade-offs and risks in terms of timelines, costs, and business impact, helping stakeholders make informed decisions. 
 - Lead Design and Code Reviews: Guide system design, review implementation quality, and evaluate build-versus-buy decisions to support effective technical execution. 
 - Translate Strategy into Results: Work closely with AI, product operations, and product leadership to prioritize initiatives, stay connected to end users, and keep engineering efforts focused on measurable outcomes. 
 - Support Product Innovation: Contribute to software platforms and AI-enabled tools that support complex brand experiences, event operations, guest registration, hospitality, and asset management. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong technical judgment, a track record of delivering products end to end, and the leadership skills to guide teams through complex engineering challenges. They should be comfortable applying AI technologies in production environments and making decisions that balance innovation with reliability. Key qualifications include: 

- Extensive hands-on software engineering experience, including ownership of products or major initiatives from concept through deployment. 
 - Proven technical leadership experience, including setting architectural direction, making design decisions, and guiding engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of AI-powered software development, including AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, and the evaluation of AI-generated code. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-based AI services such as AWS Bedrock and concepts such as RAG, agentic patterns, evaluation pipelines, and production guardrails. 
 - Experience designing scalable software architectures and making informed decisions about system design, technology selection, and build-versus-buy trade-offs. 
 - Ability to establish engineering standards, code review practices, and quality controls that support reliable production delivery. 
 - Strong mentoring skills, with the ability to improve team performance through pairing, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance. 
 - Business-oriented thinking, including the ability to assess engineering decisions in terms of cost, delivery timelines, risk, and operational impact. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with product leaders, project management teams, and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - A proactive, adaptable mindset and the ability to turn loosely defined business needs into well-scoped technical solutions. 
 - A strong commitment to continuous improvement, practical innovation, and delivering measurable outcomes. 

Benefits

- Competitive annual salary: $140, 000-$160, 000, depending on experience. 
 - Health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance. 
 - Employee stock purchase plan: Opportunity to participate in the employee stock purchase program. 
 - Paid time off: Vacation, personal days, and paid holidays. 
 - Additional protection: Eligibility for disability and life insurance plans, subject to plan terms and conditions. 
 - Flexible spending and savings options: Access to FSA and HSA plans, subject to applicable eligibility and plan terms. 
 - Technical ownership: Opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and AI development practices. 
 - Leadership impact: Work closely with senior engineering and product leaders while mentoring and developing other engineers. 
 - Innovative environment: Help deliver AI-powered products, automation workflows, and technology solutions for complex real-world experiences. 
 - Inclusive culture: Contribute to a workplace that values diverse perspectives, belonging, and individual growth. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) - iOS
data.description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message. We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go - staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation. As an iOS engineer at WhatsApp you will use your ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set technical direction across multiple teams, own the architecture for a major area of the product, and shape what WhatsApp Services becomes in India. 

WhatsApp - Software Engineer (Technical Leadership) - iOS Responsibilities: 

- Build and ship client features for WhatsApp on iOS, with a focus on performance, reliability and responsiveness
 - Own iOS client architecture for services surfaces - payments, commerce and the everyday money-centric flows people already come to WhatsApp for
 - Work across Swift and Objective-C with the iOS SDK, and partner with server and platform teams on API design
 - Identify and solve the hardest technical problems across the pillar, including finding where new technology can address previously intractable problems
 - Set technical direction across multiple teams and own the architecture for a major area of the product
 - Lead initiatives of org-wide scope, resolving ambiguity in both product definition and technical approach
 - Drive engineering standards, quality and craft across the pillar, and make teams and systems work better to increase their impact
 - Mentor other engineers, influence cross-functional partners in product, design and data science, and act as a credible co-owner of product outcomes
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences
 - Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 12+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language with a PhD
 - Experience communicating and working across functions to drive solutions
 - Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
 - Experience driving large cross-functional/industry-wide engineering efforts
 - Proven track record of planning multi-year roadmap in which short-term projects ladder to the long-term mission
 - Experience mentoring/influencing executive stakeholders across organizations

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e. g. , efficiency gains, quality improvements)
 - Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
 - Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
 - Experience building complex applications for the iPhone or iPad using Objective-C/C++/Swift with the iOS SDK and other frameworks
 - Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e. g. , risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
 - Experience designing and operating payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
 - Experience as a technical leader across distributed teams in multiple sites
 - Experience setting technical strategy for global, multi-market products, particularly in emerging markets
 - Experience shipping at a high release cadence with strong attention to craft and detail
 - Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e. g. , prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
 - In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale
 - Experience establishing the technical foundations of a 0-to-1 organization or a new product area
 - Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products, including super-app experience or experience building and scaling consumer products from an early stage in a target market
 - Background in monetization, payments, commerce or AI/ML products

About Meta: 

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today-beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. 

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.
