data.title: Staff Software Developer
data.description:
Take your career to new heights with Loopio! 🚀✨

Loopio is on the hunt for a Staff Software Developer who thrives on solving complex challenges and is driven by curiosity. If you're passionate about building scalable, high-impact solutions and love collaborating across disciplines, this is your chance to make your mark. 

You'll join our Contextualized Understanding (CU) Mission Team- a team of Engineers, Applied Scientists, Product Managers, and Designers building the knowledge graph and AI agents that give Loopio a deep understanding of each customer's business, and the evaluation framework that keeps every answer accurate and trustworthy. Our platform is used by some of the world's leading organisations, and we value clean code, measurable quality, and knowledge sharing. From shaping technical direction to mentoring teammates, you'll play a key role in scaling our systems and evolving our product. 

We're deeply collaborative - whether it's pair programming, technical design reviews, or whiteboarding ideas, we believe the best solutions are built together. If you're excited by elegant architecture, thoughtful product development, and leaving things better than you found them - let's build the future together. 

This role requires close collaboration with teams across Canada, the UK, and India. To accommodate the time zone differences, you will be expected to work from 11: 00am - 7: 30pm IST, with occasional evening calls to overlap with North American colleagues and customers. 

💻 What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the design and end-to-end delivery of complex features for Loopio's web platform - from architecture through to production. 
 - Go beyond writing Python or Java: design and ship reusable frameworks and shared libraries that raise the bar for how every team at Loopio builds, so good patterns scale instead of getting reinvented. 
 - Drive architectural decisions and system-level thinking, influencing design and execution across teams. 
 - Proactively build tooling and safeguards that prevent bugs before they reach customers - because you can't stand crappy software. 
 - Contributing to Loopio's AI roadmap by evaluating third-party models, establishing patterns for agentic workflows and knowledge-graph-grounded retrieval, and defining technical and evaluation guidelines for AI-powered features. 
 - Drive the technical design discussions and facilitate technical decision-making, driving consensus in ambiguous situations. 
 - Partner closely with the ML team to design, integrate, and productionise AI agents and knowledge-graph capabilities, turning research prototypes into reliable, well-evaluated features. 
 - Engage directly with customers to gather detailed feedback, and collaborate closely with Product Managers and Product Designers in an agile environment to bring features to life and iterate on them. 
 - Mentor and coach other engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and code reviews, helping build a culture of knowledge-sharing and open feedback. 

✨ What You'll Bring To The Team

- You are still hands-on. You ship production code every week while setting technical direction. Coding and delivery are core to who you are as an engineer. 
 - 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software systems at scale. 
 - Deep experience leading architectural discussions, influencing cross-team technical decisions, and driving consensus in ambiguous situations. 
 - Strong backend/API experience in Python, Java or PHP, with a track record of designing APIs as platform capabilities (versioned, well-documented contracts consumed by multiple teams and services), building for scale and reliability, and integrating with third-party systems. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating cloud infrastructure like AWS or Azure. 
 - Frontend development experience with a solid understanding of React and JavaScript. 
 - Strong understanding of database design and relational databases such as MySQL. 
 - Exposure to AI technologies, particularly LLMs (e. g. OpenAI, Claude), embeddings, or natural language processing. Deep ML expertise is not required, but familiarity with integrating modern AI APIs is highly valuable. 
 - Experience mentoring other engineers through coaching, design reviews, and code reviews; prior experience as a technical lead is an asset. 
 - A growing passion for driving processes and improving software development productivity for your team. 
 - Nice to have: TypeScript or Python, microservices and event-driven architecture, search and retrieval systems (semantic search, RAG), graph databases and knowledge-graph modelling, agent frameworks and tool-calling patterns, and experience evaluating and monitoring LLM-based features. 

⚒️ Loopio Engineering Technology Stack

- React
 - Node. js
 - PHP
 - Python
 - Flask
 - MySQL
 - Elasticsearch
 - Docker
 - Databricks
 - Amazon Web Services
 - Chef
 - Terraform

Where You'll Work 📍

- This is a remote-first opportunity with the advantages of working flexibly across India. 
 - We are HQ'd in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from. Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in 🇨🇦 Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), 🇮🇳 India (HQ in Ahmedabad), and 🇬🇧 England (London). 
 - Our India/UK hub employees work according to the business hours stated in the job description above. This is intentionally designed to enable our global teams to have overlapping hours for collaboration. 
 - You'll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we're just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work 🙇🏾 during the workday
 - We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global #OneTeam!

Why You'll ❤️ Working at Loopio

- Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice for our 1: 1s and performance conversations
 - You will have the opportunity to elevate 🪄 your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact. 
 - We'll set you up to work remotely with a MacBook laptop 🍏, a monthly phone and internet subsidy, and a work-from-home budget to help get your home office all set up. 
 - You'll be joining a supportive culture that has thoughtfully built out opportunities for connections in a remote first environment. 
 - Participate in 🎤 townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and company celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!
 - Our four Employee Resource Groups offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round. 
 - You'll be a part of an award-winning workplace 🏆with an opportunity to make a big impact on the business. 

Questioning your qualifications? Read this !!️ Hi there, we recognize that all too often, potential candidates don't apply for a position simply because they don't hit every single criteria included in the job description-particularly members of underrepresented groups. 

Whether or not your experience ✅ checks off all the boxes on a job posting, we still encourage you to apply to ensure that your application receives a review from our team. We understand that a resume can only showcase so much during the applicant stage, so we've created prompts in the application for you to share more about yourself. If you've made a career transition (or a few!), you're self taught in a new role, or you have skills/experience you'd like to highlight, we want to hear more about what you could bring to the table. 

AI in Recruitment 👩🏻💻 At Loopio, we leverage artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines

AI Usage in Interviews 🤖 The Loopio interview process is designed to help us better understand your professional experiences, as well as your unique perspective and approach to delivery and collaboration. To ensure a fair and accurate assessment, we expect candidates to refrain from using AI-generated content to produce responses to our interview questions during the live interview, as our goal is to evaluate your own knowledge and problem-solving abilities - not those of an AI assistant. If AI-generated responses are identified during the interview, Loopio reserves the right to disqualify candidates from the interview process. 

For specific roles that include a take-home assignment, our AI Interviewee Policy allows the use of AI for initial support; however, the final submission must be a true reflection of your personal insights, skills and decision-making. 

Loopio is an equal opportunity employer that is deeply committed to building equitable workplaces that are diverse and inclusive. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds and lifestyles to consider us as a future employer. Please contact a member of our Talent Experience team (work@loopio. com) should you require accommodations at any point during our virtual interview processes.

data.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Pioneer Autonomous Security Scale as a Lead AI SecOps Engineer

Are you an experienced cloud security and SRE leader ready to own the AI-driven SecOps strategy for a massive global infrastructure? Trimble is seeking a P3 Lead AI SecOps Engineer to oversee the security architecture, resilience, and automated compliance across our enterprise Azure platform. Operating across a large-scale estate of 22, 000+ Windows Virtual Machines and 3, 000+ Microsoft SQL Servers, you will combine Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Zero Trust architecture, and AI-driven automation to ensure our systems remain secure, compliant, and highly available. 

About Us

Dedicated to the world's tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www. trimble. com

Our SecOps Ecosystem: Our Global AI Site Reliability & Security Operations (AI-SecOps) team integrates cutting-edge AI tools, autonomous patch orchestration, and DevSecOps pipelines to safeguard Trimble's enterprise infrastructure, ensuring compliance with global benchmarks while protecting global customer workflows. 

What Makes This Role Great

As a P3 Lead Engineer reporting directly to the Director of Engineering / Head of Cloud Security, you will have end-to-end strategy ownership for multi-year security roadmaps, autonomous patching frameworks, and AI-driven CVE remediation. Supporting a follow-the-sun model across North America and India, you will serve as a primary technical authority in executive forums, shape Zero Trust adoption, and mentor a high-performing global engineering team. This position offers a high-visibility platform to transform enterprise-level SecOps using modern AI and automation capabilities. 

Key Exciting Responsibilities

- Enterprise AI-SecOps Strategy: Own the AI-driven SecOps strategy and multi-year roadmap across our entire Azure infrastructure, setting architecture standards and defining security investment priorities. 
 - Windows & SQL Server Infrastructure Security: Define and govern enterprise security architecture and exception frameworks across 22, 000+ Windows VMs and 3, 000+ SQL Servers. 
 - Third-Party Patch Governance & AI Orchestration: Drive global third-party patch governance (across tools like NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, Ivanti, BigFix), defining autonomous ring-based rollouts and AI-assisted troubleshooting standards to eliminate deployment failures. 
 - Azure Governance, WAF & Zero Trust: Own enterprise Azure landing zone security, Azure Policy frameworks, RBAC models, Web Application Firewall (WAF) threat thresholds, and Zero Trust adoption. 
 - AI-Driven Vulnerability & CVE Remediation: Direct CVE analysis across platforms (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender) and threat-intel feeds (NVD, MSRC), leveraging AI agents for triage and automated fix deployments while presenting posture metrics to executive leadership. 
 - Cloud Resilience & Global Audit Compliance: Direct DR/BCP strategies, RTO/RPO targets, and compliance execution for ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF/800-53, and CIS Benchmarks, serving as the lead technical stakeholder for security audits. 
 - Security Automation & Global Leadership: Champion security automation using PowerShell, Python, Terraform, and AI Copilots within CI/CD pipelines, while mentoring and leading cross-functional engineering teams across North America and India. 

Essential Skills & Experience

- Professional Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security, SRE, or enterprise security operations, with proven success operating at 10, 000+ endpoint scale. 
 - Cloud & Security Mastery: Deep technical proficiency in Azure, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, WAF, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework. 
 - Infrastructure & Patch Tooling Expertise: Hands-on experience securing Windows Server and MS SQL Server ecosystems alongside enterprise patch management platforms (Azure Update Manager, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, Ivanti, or BigFix). 
 - Vulnerability Management & Frameworks: Expert knowledge of CVE scoring, vulnerability scanners (Defender Vulnerability Management, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7), and regulatory standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF/800-53, CIS Benchmarks). 
 - Automation & DevOps: Proficient in PowerShell, Python, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Terraform, and leveraging AI/Copilot tools for DevSecOps automation. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred). 

Bonus Points For

- Certifications: Microsoft AZ-500, CISSP, Security+, or equivalent enterprise security credentials. 
 - Global Team Leadership: Track record of leading, mentoring, and growing global engineering teams across multiple regions and time zones. 
 - Executive Communication: Experience presenting security posture metrics, risk trade-offs, and compliance progress directly to C-suite and executive stakeholders. 

Logistics

- Grade / Level: P3
 - Department: Global AI Site Reliability & Security Operations (AI-SecOps)
 - Location: Chennai
 - Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"-we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow. 

- You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. 
 - Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem. " You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. 
 - Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored, " empowering proactive "doers. "
 - Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us. 

How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting. 

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate. 

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words-they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. 

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn't to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business's system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life's work. 

About The Role

Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC. 

This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff. 

You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks. 

As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability. 

What You'll Achieve

- Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance. 
 - Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff. 
 - Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates. 
 - Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions. 
 - Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation. 
 - Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns. 
 - Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution. 
 - Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions. 
 - Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution. 
 - Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly. 
 - Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work. 
 - Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel. 
 - Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time. 
 - Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements. 

Skills You'll Need to Bring

- 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role. 
 - Strong hands-on Python development experience. 
 - Working experience with Node. js, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation. 
 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations. 
 - Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff. 
 - Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation. 
 - Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems. 
 - Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects. 
 - Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation. 

Nice to Haves

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation. 
 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools. 
 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations. 
 - Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows. 
 - Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms. 
 - Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams. 

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will

- Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model. 
 - Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners. 
 - Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery. 
 - Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook. 

Within your first six months, you will

- Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff. 
 - Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering. 
 - Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team. 
 - Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements. 
 - Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

By clicking "Submit Application", I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion's Global Recruiting Privacy Policy. 

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement - when that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. 

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. 

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. Pay And Benefits

 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location

 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Resiliency Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for resiliency testing. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Deepen understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery Process and proactively identify opportunities for improvement within assigned responsibilities.

About OvalEdge

OvalEdge is an enterprise-grade AI-powered Data Intelligence platform that unifies Data Catalog, Data Governance, Data Quality, and Analytics into a single, AI-native SaaS product. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies globally, OvalEdge enables organizations to discover, govern, and operationalize their data assets at scale - accelerating data-driven decisions while ensuring compliance and trust. 

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect to serve as the primary hands-on technical owner for OvalEdge's AI Product Platform. This is a deeply hands-on role - you will own the end-to-end technical architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform spanning Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Data Governance, Cloud-native infrastructure, and Enterprise Integrations, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the engineering team that builds it. 

You have done this before. You have shipped AI capabilities to production - not just designed them on whiteboards. You are equally comfortable presenting architecture strategy to the C-suite and doing a deep-dive code review with an engineering team. You thrive in a fast-moving product company where architecture decisions have direct customer impact. 

What You'll Do

Technical Architecture & Design Leadership

• Own the technical architecture and drive a rolling 24-month technology roadmap aligned to product and business objectives. 

• Define and drive adoption of architecture standards, design principles, and decision records across engineering - leading by example through hands-on design work, not policy alone. 

• Drive technical design reviews for all major platform initiatives and own the final call on system design trade-offs. 

• Identify and proactively retire technical debt; ensure the platform stays extensible for emerging AI technologies. 

AI & Agentic Platform

• Design and evolve production-grade Agentic AI systems - multi-agent orchestration, hierarchical supervisor-agent frameworks, goal-oriented task decomposition, and long-running autonomous workflows. 

• Define standards for Generative AI integration: multi-LLM routing, model abstraction layers, prompt and context engineering, token management, and cost optimization across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. 

• Architect RAG pipelines end-to-end: vector databases, embedding strategies, retrieval optimization, hallucination mitigation, and evaluation frameworks. 

• Ensure Responsible AI practices - AI security, data privacy, bias controls, and governance compliance - are baked into every AI system design. 

• Drive LLMOps maturity: model versioning, observability, drift detection, and automated evaluation in production. 

SaaS & Cloud Platform

• Own the architecture for OvalEdge's multi-tenant SaaS platform on AWS - ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, OpenSearch, Bedrock, IAM, and CloudWatch. 

• Design for elastic scaling, disaster recovery, cost efficiency, and 99. 9%+ availability SLAs. 

• Establish self-healing, self-monitoring, and auto-remediation capabilities; drive observability and reliability engineering maturity. 

• Define containerization, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code standards across engineering teams. 

Data & Analytics Architecture

• Design scalable data catalog, governance, and analytics architectures - semantic data layers, query optimization, in-memory analytics, and AI-assisted analysis pipelines. 

• Architect MCP-based enterprise integration services: tool discovery, agent interoperability, REST and event-driven APIs, and partner SDK frameworks. 

Engineering Excellence & Technical Mentorship

• Provide hands-on technical mentorship to AI Engineers, Platform Engineers, and fellow Architects - through pairing, code review, and design-review shadowing, not just top-down direction. 

• Drive AI-assisted development, code generation tooling, and developer productivity improvements across the SDLC. 

• Partner with QA leadership on test strategy - including AI-assisted testing, performance, security, and reliability testing. 

• Work closely with Product Management to assess feasibility, define solution approaches, and shape the product roadmap. 

• Communicate technical strategy and trade-offs clearly to executive stakeholders, translating architectural decisions into business impact. 

What You'll Bring

Required

• 15+ years in software engineering and architecture; 8+ years as a senior/staff/principal-level hands-on technical architect at a software product company. 

• Hands-on, demonstrated experience shipping AI/ML capabilities to production. 

• 5+ years building and scaling multi-tenant SaaS products on cloud-native platforms (AWS preferred). 

• 5+ years building and scaling licensed, on-prem products on multiple platforms. 

• Experience in managing architecture for products deployed across SaaS and multiple, on-prem platforms. 

• Deep expertise in Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP) and RAG architectures in production. 

• Strong command of Generative AI ecosystem: LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), model abstraction, prompt engineering, and LLMOps. 

• Expert-level proficiency in Python and Java; solid understanding of microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

• Demonstrated track record driving technical direction and design decisions across cross-functional engineering teams through large-scale platform builds. 

• Strong foundation in software architecture and system design fundamentals - distributed systems, domain-driven design, API design, and scalability patterns. 

Nice to Have

• 3+ years designing and shipping Generative AI or Agentic AI products commercially. 

• Experience with Data Catalog, Data Governance, Data Quality, or Analytics platforms. 

• Exposure to vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch) and semantic search in production. 

• Experience with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or similar managed AI/ML services. 

• Background supporting enterprise-scale, Fortune 500 customers. 

• Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 

Education

• Master's degree or AI/ML specialization (preferred). 

What Success Looks Like

Area: Platform Reliability

Area: Engineering Delivery

Area: Scalability

Target: × headroom

Why OvalEdge?

data.description:

You will develop high-performance, cloud-enabled data pipelines that power Mastercard's enterprise data warehouse and lakehouse environments, enabling advanced analytics, business intelligence, regulatory reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organisation.

 - Build and maintain batch and near real-time data processing frameworks capable of supporting petabyte-scale workloads. 
 - Develop reusable engineering components and frameworks that accelerate data product delivery while maintaining enterprise standards.

- Design and implement a "build once, run anywhere" architecture supporting seamless deployment across on-premises and public cloud environments without code changes. 
 - Implement data lineage, metadata management, data cataloguing, data quality controls, and observability capabilities across the data ecosystem. 
 - Collaborate with architects and platform teams to establish scalable design patterns and engineering best practices. 

Cloud Modernisation

- Contribute to migration initiatives moving legacy ETL and data warehouse workloads from on-premises environments to cloud-native architectures. 
 - Leverage cloud services such as Amazon S3, EMR, Glue, and related data services to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive adoption of modern lakehouse and distributed compute architectures.

 - Mentor and guide junior engineers through code reviews, technical coaching, and engineering best practices.

Operational Excellence

- Troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform root cause analysis to identify and implement long-term remediation strategies. 
 - Ensure compliance with Mastercard's engineering, security, quality assurance, and operational governance standards. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve performance, automation, monitoring, and process efficiency. 

Innovation

- Evaluate emerging data technologies and conduct proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to determine their applicability within Mastercard's data ecosystem. 
 - Contribute to engineering innovation and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation. 

All About You

Required Experience

- 10-12 years of experience delivering enterprise-scale Data Warehouse, Data Lake, or Data Lakehouse solutions. 
 - Proven experience implementing multiple end-to-end data engineering projects within large-scale distributed computing environments. 
 - Hands-on experience migrating ETL and analytics workloads from on-premises platforms to cloud-native environments. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong development experience using: Apache Spark, Scala or Java, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, Object Storage platforms
 - Experience building orchestration and workflow solutions using: Apache Airflow/ Apache NiFi and Similar enterprise scheduling frameworks
 - Strong SQL expertise and experience with Relational and NoSQL database technologies: Oracle/ SQL Server, Cassandra, Dynamo DB etc. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably AWS: Amazon S3, EMR, AWS Glue, Cloud-native data services

Professional Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Experience operating within Agile delivery environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate within geographically distributed and matrix-based teams. 
 - Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus. 
 - Ability to learn emerging technologies quickly and apply them effectively to business challenges. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power the next generation of infrastructure - combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production-ready solutions. 

We have a requirement for a Principal Software Engineer in the Infrastructure Solutions Software team in our CE-SW group. This role combines technical leadership with responsibility for leading and developing a group of engineering teams delivering complex software for our cloud and data center products. 

You will provide technical direction across the teams while leading through team leads, developing engineering capability and ensuring effective delivery across SoC, firmware and system software. 

This is an opportunity to make an impact at scale!

Responsibilities

You will: 

- Provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams, driving strong technical execution across SoC, firmware and system software from pre-silicon through silicon bring-up and production readiness. 
 - Lead and develop team leads, supporting them in building high-performing teams and developing the technical capability and careers of their engineers. 
 - Drive engineering planning and execution, translating product requirements and architecture specifications into technical priorities, deliverables and effective team plans. 
 - Collaborate across hardware, software, architecture and product teams to manage dependencies, resolve complex technical issues and drive engineering decisions. 

Required Skills and Experience : 

- Extensive experience delivering complex system software within the embedded or infrastructure SoC space, with strong technical leadership across engineering teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of low-level systems, including bootloaders, device drivers, OS fundamentals (preferably Linux), and computer architecture. 
 - Strong background in C (or a similar language) programming, with proven skills in optimising software performance. 
 - Excellent technical judgement, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to influence and drive decisions across engineering teams. 

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Knowledge of Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM). 
 - Knowledge of server-class SoCs, including RAS, power management, PCI Express (PCIe), Compute Express Link (CXL), memory and virtualization. 

In Return: 

Join us and help shape world-class infrastructure technology at Arm! This is your chance to grow, develop new skills, and build a successful career at a leading technology company. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to maintain and enhance the operational excellence and reliability of all Control & Instrumentation systems associated with Boiler systems. This role is pivotal for conducting on-field maintenance activities including routine maintenance, timely overhauls, and calibration of equipment to prevent failures and ensure continuous operation. 

Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Boiler)

Operational Excellence And Equipment Reliability

Monitor the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to Boiler area including firing systems, Mill fan, ASLD, CAMS, and MOV. 

Conduct routine maintenance of MOV, Boiler, and Auxiliaries to prevent equipment failures. 

Execute timely overhauls of the Boiler systems to maintain operational integrity. 

Troubleshoot and rectify breakdowns of equipment to ensure continuous operation. 

Coordinate with other departments to minimize maintenance delays and optimize equipment availability. 

Execute calibrations as per schedule and prepare detailed reports on findings and adjustments. 

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Technical And Process Improvement

Perform periodic backups of Boiler PLC and auxiliary systems to secure operational data. 

Provide resources and guidance to contractor technicians for routine maintenance tasks. 

Follow the established checklist for equipment maintenance to ensure thoroughness and accuracy. 

Maintain the FGD (Flue Gas Discharge) systems to ensure environmental compliance. 

Inventory Management And Documentation

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares. 

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring value for money and adherence to financial guidelines. 

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA, CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Maintain a culture of safety by providing proper training and ensuring adherence to safety protocols and ensuring zero accidents. 

Implement field related ZFO Action Items and AWMS initiatives. 

Adhere to BPT processes, technical audits, and compliance requirements. 

Report unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent incidents. 

Follow the guidelines of the work permit system to ensure safe working conditions. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

8+ years of experience in in C&I systems, preferably in power plant boiler operations. 

Preferred Industry

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.

Senior Software Engineer- DevOps for Workflow Innovation in Barco Control Rooms @Barco

BCR (Barco Control Rooms)

The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations. 

Senior Software Engineer - DevOps for Workflow Innovation @ Barco

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services. 
 - Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios. 
 - Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities. 
 - Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices. 
 - Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability. 
 - Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence. 

Qualifications and Experience

Education

We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains: 

B. Tech. /B. E. /M. E. /M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering

Experience

- 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access. 
 - Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows. 
 - Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable. 
 - Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling. 
 - Understanding of DevSecOps practices, automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices. 
 - Ability to collaborate with cloud partners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, product owners, and validation teams across geographies. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, operational discipline, and willingness to explore and adopt new technologies in AI, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

 - Define and own the end-to-end integration-testing strategy across upstream, downstream, internal and third-party systems. 
 - Establish integration-test scope, environments, test data, dependencies, entry and exit criteria, quality gates and release-readiness measures. 
 - Lead testing across APIs, microservices, messaging platforms, event-driven services, data pipelines, databases and reporting interfaces. 
 - Ensure end-to-end business flows are validated across contact center, Product Control, accounting, regulatory and reconciliation processes. 
 - Coordinate integration testing with global teams across the UK, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, India and Canada. 
 - Identify and manage interface, environment, data, sequencing and dependency risks. 
 - Ensure defects are logged, prioritized, root causes are understood and remediation is tracked through to closure. 
 - Provide clear status reporting on integration coverage, risks, defects, dependencies and release readiness. 

NFR strategy and assurance

- Define and maintain the NFR strategy, ensuring requirements are identified, measurable, testable and traceable to business and technical outcomes. 
 - Work with architects, engineers, infrastructure, security, operations and business stakeholders to establish NFR acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of NFR testing, including: 
 - Performance, load, stress and endurance testing 
 - Scalability and capacity testing 
 - Resilience, failover and recovery testing 
 - Availability and service-continuity validation 
 - Data quality, integrity and reconciliation testing 
 - Security, access-control and vulnerability validation 
 - Monitoring, alerting, logging and observability testing 
 - Disaster-recovery and operational-readiness testing 
 - Deployment, rollback and production-verification testing 
 - Define performance baselines, service-level thresholds, capacity assumptions and production-volume scenarios. 
 - Assess NFR risks and ensure that identified gaps have documented remediation plans and accountable owners. 
 - Challenge designs and implementation approaches where they may create unacceptable performance, resilience, security or operational risks. 
 - Produce NFR evidence and sign-off recommendations for governance forums, architecture reviews and release decisions. 
 - Support audit, regulatory and control requirements through complete and traceable test documentation. 
Technical quality engineering

- Provide hands-on technical leadership for test automation and integration-validation solutions using Java and relevant testing frameworks. 
 - Develop and maintain automation for APIs, services, data flows, messaging, database validation and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish appropriate shift-left quality practices. 
 - Partner with software engineers to improve service testability, observability, error handling and operational supportability. 
 - Review test designs, automation code, test results and technical evidence for quality and completeness. 
 - Support deployment and release activities, including pre-production validation and post-deployment verification. 
 - Contribute to technical delivery plans, estimates, timelines and sprint planning. 

Architecture and stakeholder management

- Work with architecture teams to ensure that integration and NFR considerations are embedded in solution designs and aligned with the target-state architecture. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into clear integration scenarios and measurable NFR acceptance criteria. 
 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream system teams to coordinate interfaces, environments, test data and delivery schedules. 
 - Communicate technical risks, quality trends and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders. 
 - Manage expectations and negotiate practical compromises while protecting critical quality, control and risk outcomes. 
 - Support programme governance, release forums, technical design reviews and production-readiness assessments. 

Leadership and people development

- Lead, coach and mentor integration-test and quality-engineering colleagues. 
 - Establish consistent testing standards, reusable approaches and a culture of quality ownership. 
 - Provide functional management and support the development, performance and career progression of direct reports. 
 - Contribute to recruitment, resource planning and capability development for the testing function. 
 - Promote inclusive, collaborative ways of working across geographically distributed teams. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- Typically 10+ years' experience in software testing, quality engineering, integration testing or software engineering, including significant experience in senior technical leadership roles. 
 - Proven experience leading integration testing for complex, enterprise-scale and regulated technology environments. 
 - Strong experience testing distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms and data-intensive applications.

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Renesas is hiring a Software QA Engineer with strong software and hardware testing experience to work with hands-on automated and manual testing of customer-facing software/hardware integrations. Develop and execute detailed manual and automated software/UI test cases in Python or other OO language. Experience in electrical engineering, Hardware debugging, hardware/firmware or embedded testing is strongly desired. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate market-leading digital controller solutions powering AI, client, and server applications. Responsibilities include software test planning, execution, reporting, leading testing projects, automation, documentation, and debugging software connected to hardware to determine the root cause of issues, and driving product quality across the development software/hardware lifecycle. 

Job responsibilities in QA Testing: 

You will work teams across the globe to generate test requirements and define test methodologies. 

- Develop a robust understanding of detailed technical requirements for product software and related hardware and firmware. 
 - Design and execute automated and manual test plans for software, hardware, firmware, and IC solutions. 
 - Debug software and hardware issues, with a focus on IC functionality and root cause analysis. 
 - Analyze test results, report defects, and support issue resolution with development and customer-facing teams. 
 - Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure product quality exceeds expectations. 
 - Drive test automation, validation framework improvements, and QA best practices. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to testing strategy, planning, and process enhancements. 
 - Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while balancing quality, timelines, and feature delivery. 
 - Proactively identify risks, raise issues, and recommend product and process improvements. 

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or similar

Experience: 2-5 years of Software QA experience, including 8+ years testing software integrated with hardware/firmware. 

Technical Proficiency: 

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a keen attention to detail to debug complex HW/SW issues and document detailed test plans and test cases and root cause analysis of software vs hardware/FW bugs through deep analysis of both manual automated test failures. 
 - Experience in electronics, microcontroller programming, and bus communications, ideally in power systems, semiconductors, or ICs. 
 - GUI test automation skills with Python and tools such as Qt Squish, SmartBear Test Complete, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with lab test equipment and measurement tools. 
 - Solid understanding of JIRA, version control, QA best practices, and software/hardware development lifecycles. 
 - Proven ability to mentor teams, hardware/software test development and lab management, improve test coverage, and drive quality initiatives. 
 - Willingness to speak up, raise issues and risks, ask lots of questions, and provide improvement recommendations for products, test cases, test automation, and team processes. 
 - Background in both Software QA and IC/Power Engineering preferred. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead, coach, and scale a team of high-performing engineers building distributed backend systems and cloud applications. In this role, you will balance people management, system architecture oversight, and cross-functional execution to deliver scalable, resilient software. 

Key Responsibilities

- People & Team Leadership: Hire, mentor, and retain a team of software engineers. Conduct performance evaluations, establish clear career development paths, and build an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture. 
 - Technical Direction & Architecture: Oversee system design and architectural trade-offs for large-scale distributed applications, balancing delivery speed, system resilience, and scalability. 
 - Delivery & Process: Partner with Product, Design, and QA leadership to align on roadmaps, manage project execution, and refine agile development workflows. 
 - Quality & Engineering Standards: Drive best practices across API design, automated testing, continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD), and operational monitoring. 

Requirements

- Management: 2+ years of formal people management experience leading software engineers (including performance appraisals, career mentoring, and hiring). 
 - Technical Foundation: 8+ years of software engineering background designing and building applications using Java and modern frameworks (Spring Boot / Spring MVC). 
 - Distributed Systems: Hands-on experience designing and scaling distributed systems, microservices, and asynchronous architecture patterns. 
 - Cloud & Data Systems: Experience with cloud technologies (AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS) and database systems (MySQL, MongoDB).

data.title: Associate Manager- C&I Maintenance Turbine/Shift Engineer
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the operational integrity and reliability of control and instrumentation systems of a Turbine. This role involves on-field execution of maintenance activities, scheduling and executing precise calibrations, providing technical support and ensuring that all equipment is meticulously monitored and maintained according to established checklists. The lead is pivotal in maintaining the continuous, efficient operation of turbine systems through proactive management and hands-on technical expertise. 

Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Operational Excellence And Equipment Reliability

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries. 

Conduct routine maintenance tasks for SWAS, Motor Operated Valves (MOV), Turbine, and Auxiliaries to prevent operational disruptions. 

Execute timely overhauls of units to maintain optimal performance and reduce downtime. 

Troubleshoot and resolve equipment breakdowns promptly to ensure continuous operations. 

Conduct scheduled calibrations of instrumentation and generate detailed reports on findings and adjustments. 

Allocate necessary resources and guidance to contractor technicians for the execution of routine maintenance tasks. 

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Technical And Process Improvement

Perform periodic backups of DCS, PLC, PSI, and other turbine and auxiliary systems to safeguard operational data. 

Provide technical expertise and resources to contractor technicians for routine maintenance and system upgrades. 

Follow equipment checklists meticulously to maintain high standards of operation and maintenance. 

Inventory Management And Documentation

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares. 

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring adherence to financial guidelines. 

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department to maintain business continuity. 

Implement field related of ZFO Action Items and AWMS to promote continuous improvement. 

Adhere to the BPT process, technical audits, and compliance with safety regulations to ensure zero accidents and a safe working environment. 

Report any unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent potential hazards. 

Follow the CHETNA process and ensure all departmental compliances are met. 

Ensure compliance with safety audit observations and implement corrective actions as needed. 

Utilize the work permit system guidelines to manage and control work-related risks effectively. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency across the department. 

Implement process and system improvements by adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Ensure the integration of advanced technology and digitization in daily operations to improve system performance. 

Drive the adoption of digital tools and platforms to streamline workflows and enhance data-driven decision-making.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

8+ years of experience in control and instrumentation within the power generation or related industry. 

Preferred Industry

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.
