data.description:
Job Description

About The Core Engineering

The Core Engineering is a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm. 

Our engineers have access to the latest technology and massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, leveraging modern frameworks to build responsive, intuitive front-end and Big Data applications. The firm is making a significant investment to uplift and rebuild the Compliance application portfolio. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Vice President (VP), Full-Stack Engineer to join our Surveillance & Models technology team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications. 

As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence-actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions. 

Experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations is expected for this role to help build intelligent, AI-enabled engineering solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture
 - System Design: Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure full-stack applications, microservices, and APIs that align with enterprise standards. 
 - Technology Strategy: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends (including AI-assisted development) to continuously modernize our compliance surveillance technical stack. 
 - Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices across frontend and backend systems. 
 - Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Hands-on Engineering
 - Full-Stack Development: Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code across both frontend user interfaces and backend services using Java, Python, PySpark, SQL, Hadoop, Snowflake, Iceberg, Kafka, Kubernetes. 
 - Backend Development: Design and implement scalable microservices. 
 - Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across both on-prem relational (e. g. , DB2, Sybase) and cloud-based (e. g. Snowflake) database platforms. 
 - API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability. 
 - AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes. 
 - Partnering with Stakeholders: Apply knowledge of the financial industry and compliance or risk functions to design and improve compliance surveillance models. 
 - Team Mentorship & Collaboration
 - Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline. 
 - Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field. 

Technical Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with Java or Python, including with Apache Spark and/or Hadoop 
 - API design and micro-services architecture, such as to create interconnected services 
 - Experience with Cloud-based data platforms, such as Snowflake 
 - Exposure to Data Lake or Lakehouse solutions 
 - Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns 
 - Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features 
 - Knowledge of the financial industry and compliance or risk functions

Interpersonal Skills

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction. 
 - Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery. 

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit to our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

7-8 years of hands-on experience in Linux systems, virtualization/hypervisors, automation, and/or cloud platform operations.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer with 3-4 years of experience to help design, build, automate, and continuously improve our HPE VM Essentials (VME) private cloud platform and HPE CloudOps Suite environment. This is an engineering-focused role - you'll spend your time building automation, hardening infrastructure, improving platform reliability, and engineering solutions to recurring problems. 

What You Need To Bring

Key Responsibilities

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Build and maintain automation for VM lifecycle management, provisioning workflows, patching, and configuration using Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent IaC tooling. 
 - Develop scripts and tools (Python/Bash) to automate health checks, capacity reporting, drift detection, and routine operational tasks. 
 - Own and improve CI/CD-style pipelines for infrastructure changes (version-controlled playbooks/templates, peer-reviewed changes, staged rollouts). 
 - Build self-healing automation and proactive alerting to reduce manual intervention

Linux Systems Administration

- Administer and troubleshoot RHEL/Ubuntu (or similar) Linux servers - services, storage, networking, and log analysis. 
 - Analyze system and kernel logs to support incident diagnosis (storage errors, service failures, resource exhaustion). 

Cloud Platform & CloudOps Suite Engineering

- Support integration tasks between orchestration tooling and underlying infrastructure. 

Documentation & Knowledge Engineering

- Write and maintain infrastructure-as-code documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks as living engineering artifacts . 
 - Contribute to design reviews and engineering retrospectives, driving permanent fixes into automation and standards. 

________________________________________

Required Technical Skills And Good To Have

- Hypervisors: Hands-on experience with KVM/QEMU, VMware, or similar virtualization platforms - VM lifecycle management, snapshots, basic performance troubleshooting. 
 - Linux: Skills on RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu - services, storage (LVM, filesystems), networking basics, log analysis. 
 - Automation: Working knowledge of scripting (Bash and/or Python) and at least one automation/config management tool (Ansible preferred). 
 - Cloud Platforms: Practical exposure to at least one public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) or private cloud orchestration platform (Morpheus, OpenStack, or similar).

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in Linux, hypervisor technologies, automation/scripting, and cloud platforms who wants to grow into private-cloud and clustered-infrastructure specialization. We are looking for a candidate with 7-8 years of experience to work on HPE VM Essentials (VME) clusters and the HPE CloudOps Suite.

7-8 years of hands-on experience in Linux systems, virtualization/hypervisors, automation, and/or cloud platform operations.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer with 3-4 years of experience to help design, build, automate, and continuously improve our HPE VM Essentials (VME) private cloud platform and HPE CloudOps Suite environment. Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Build and maintain automation for VM lifecycle management, provisioning workflows, patching, and configuration using Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent IaC tooling. 
 - Develop scripts and tools (Python/Bash) to automate health checks, capacity reporting, drift detection, and routine operational tasks. 
 - Own and improve CI/CD-style pipelines for infrastructure changes (version-controlled playbooks/templates, peer-reviewed changes, staged rollouts).

Linux Systems Administration

Cloud Platform & CloudOps Suite Engineering

- Support integration tasks between orchestration tooling and underlying infrastructure. 

Documentation & Knowledge Engineering

- Write and maintain infrastructure-as-code documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks as living engineering artifacts .

- Hypervisors: Hands-on experience with KVM/QEMU, VMware, or similar virtualization platforms - VM lifecycle management, snapshots, basic performance troubleshooting.

 - Automation: Working knowledge of scripting (Bash and/or Python) and at least one automation/config management tool (Ansible preferred).

data.title: CMS-Senior-Sentinel SOAR
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Cyber Managed Service -Threat Detection & Response - Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (Sentinel SOAR) - Senior

KEY Capabilities: 

- Excellent teamwork skills, passion and drive to succeed and combat Cyber threats
 - Working with the customer to identify security automation strategies and provide creative integrations and playbooks. 
 - Work collaboratively with other team members to find creative and practical solutions to customers' challenges and needs. 
 - Responsible for execution and maintenance of Sentinel SOAR related analytical processes and tasks
 - Management and administration of Sentinel SOAR platform
 - Developing custom scripts and playbooks to automate repetitive tasks and response actions. 
 - Experienced developer with at least 2 + yrs of experience using Python programming language, REST API and JSON. Must have basic SQL knowledge. 
 - Knowledge on Incident Response and Threat Intelligence tools. 
 - Creation of reusable and efficient Python-based Playbooks. 
 - Use Splunk SOAR platform to enable automation and orchestration on various tools and technologies by making use of existing or custom integration
 - Partner with security operations teams, threat intelligence groups and incident responders. 
 - Should have worked in a security operations center and gained understanding of SIEM solutions like Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel and other log management platforms. Having experience in Splunk content development will be an added advantage
 - Willing to learn new technologies and take up new challenges. Assist in developing high-quality technical content such as automation scripts/tools, reference architectures, and white papers. 
 - Good grasp in conceptualizing and/or implementing automation for business process workflows
 - Knowledge in Network monitoring technology platforms such as Fidelis XPS or others
 - Knowledge in endpoint protection tools, techniques and platforms such as Carbon Black, Tanium, Microsoft Defender ATP, Symantec, McAfee or others
 - Should be able to assist, support and mitigate production issues. 
 - Should have the capability to work with partners and client stack holders to full fill their asks
 - Ability to Coordinate with Vendor to incident closure on according to the severity
 - Review, assess, benchmark and develop issue remediation action plans for all aspects of an engagement. 

Qualification & experience: 

- Minimum of 3+ years' experience in cyber security with a depth of network architecture knowledge that will translate over to deploying and integrating Sentinel SOAR solution in global enterprise environments. 
 - Experience working in ServiceNow SOAR is also an added advantage
 - Strong oral, written and listening skills are an essential component to effective consulting. 
 - Strong background in network administration. Ability to work at all layers of the OSI models, including being able to explain communication at any level is necessary. 
 - Should have strong hands-on experience with scripting technologies like Python, REST, JSON, SOAP, ODBC, XML etc. 
 - Must have honours degree in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field
 - Minimum 2 years of working in SOAR (Sentinel)
 - Experience in Process Development, Process Improvement, Process Architecture, and Training
 - Quick to apprehend and adapt new applications. 
 - Knowledgeable in Cybersecurity and Incident Response Management
 - Certification in any one of the SIEM Solution such as Splunk or SC-200 will be an added advantage
 - Certifications in a core security related discipline will be an added advantage. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE)
data.description:
Job Title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - MySQL, PostgreSQL & Oracle

Location: Remote

Work Mode: Fully Remote

Experience: 5+ years

Start Date: Immediate

Job Summary: 

Owision is seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to own the reliability, performance, scalability, and automation of our MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle database fleet across on-premises and multi-cloud platforms (AWS, OCI, Azure). Operating at the intersection of DBA, SRE, and Platform Engineering, you will treat databases as code, eliminate operational toil, and build self-healing, highly available, and observable data platforms that power mission-critical services. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define, monitor, and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs for database availability, latency, durability, and error budgets across all production tiers. 
 - Architect, maintain, and continuously validate High Availability (HA) configurations, clustering, replication topologies, and automated failover mechanisms. 
 - Lead database incident management, participate in on-call rotations, and conduct blameless Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to implement permanent preventive engineering solutions. 
 - Design, automate, and regularly test Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity plans to guarantee strict RPO and RTO targets. 
 - Treat databases as code by automating provisioning, scaling, patching, backups, and zero-downtime schema migrations using Python, Bash, Terraform, and Ansible. 
 - Build and maintain internal Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) self-service tools and CI/CD automation pipelines for engineering teams. 
 - Conduct deep query optimization, indexing strategies, capacity planning, and engine-level tuning (InnoDB, PostgreSQL autovacuum, Oracle AWR/ASH). 
 - Build end-to-end monitoring, alerting, and telemetry dashboards using PMM, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, and Zabbix. 
 - Enforce database security by design, including encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, auditing, compliance, and data governance policies. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 4-6+ years of hands-on experience as a DBRE, SRE, or Systems DBA managing large-scale, production database environments. 
 - Strong SRE mindset with practical experience managing SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, incident response workflows, and post-mortem practices. 
 - Deep production expertise in MySQL and PostgreSQL internals, alongside solid working knowledge of Oracle Core (RMAN, Data Guard, OEM, RAC basics). 
 - Proven hands-on experience with cloud-native database services across AWS (RDS/Aurora), OCI, or Azure Database. 
 - Strong scripting proficiency in Python and Bash, combined with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Extensive experience with enterprise backup and recovery tools (Percona XtraBackup, pgBackRest, RMAN) and replication mechanisms (async, semi-sync, logical). 
 - Advanced Linux/Unix systems administration skills, OS-level performance tuning, and deep SQL execution plan diagnosis. 
 - Proven track record of self-directed technical ownership and disciplined incident handling in a fully remote environment. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience deploying and orchestrating stateful database workloads using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS R12. x) database administration, patching, cloning, and upgrades. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server (Always On Availability Groups) or NoSQL data platforms (MongoDB, Redis).

data.title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
data.description:
Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Engineer - Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity. 

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree. 

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1-4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation. 

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation. 

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications. 

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times. 

• Run demos, application trials and customer training. 

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running. 

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation. 

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team. 

Must Have

• Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation. 

• 1-4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering. 

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge. 

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills. 

• Willingness to travel to customer sites. 

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus. 

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus. 

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming. 

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment. 

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity. 

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership. 

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles. 

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics. 

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications. 

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. , headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. 

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna. co. in and recruitment1@luna. co. in with the subject "FAE - Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi). 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.title: Tech Lead, Vice President -
data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to support and drive technology initiatives within the Transition Management function of our Investment Management division. 

The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and support enterprise-scale applications. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and global technology teams to deliver high-quality solutions that support key investment management processes. 

The Tech Lead will be responsible for technical design, development oversight, code quality, solution delivery and managing & mentoring team members. A strong understanding of financial services and investment management workflows is highly desirable. 

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

As the Tech Lead, you will

- Lead the design, development, and delivery of applications supporting Investment Management and Transition Management functions. 
 - Provide technical leadership to development teams and drive best practices across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and product owners to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Design and develop enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and relational database technologies. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to solution design decisions. 
 - Review code, enforce development standards, and ensure high-quality deliverables. 
 - Work closely with global teams to prioritize and deliver business-critical initiatives. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex production and performance issues. 
 - Drive automation, process improvements, and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor and guide developers and contribute to team capability building. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity and quality. 
 - Support application upgrades, releases, and ongoing maintenance activities. 

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

- Experience within Investment Management, Asset Management, Transition Management, Trading, Portfolio Management, or Capital Markets domains. 
 - Knowledge of investment workflows, portfolio data, securities, and financial instruments. 
 - Front-end/UI development experience using technologies such as Angular, React, or modern JavaScript frameworks. 
 - Experience with messaging systems, distributed processing, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms. 
 - Experience using AI-enabled development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Microsoft Copilot. 

Education & Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of software development experience, with substantial experience in enterprise application development. 
 - Prior experience in Financial Services, Asset Management, Investment Management, or Capital Markets is highly preferred. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Strong experience with SQL, database design, performance tuning, and data modeling. 
 - Experience building and supporting distributed enterprise applications. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles and design patterns. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and integration frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native development and modern application architectures. 
 - Strong debugging, performance analysis, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions. 

What Makes This Role Unique

- Opportunity to work on strategic technology platforms supporting a leading Investment Management organization. 
 - Exposure to global business and technology stakeholders. 
 - Opportunity to influence architecture, engineering standards, and platform modernization initiatives. 
 - Ability to combine deep technical expertise with investment management business knowledge.

data.title: QA Engg - Backend Automation
data.description:
Corporate Overview

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online  marketplaces that match searchers and "research and compare" consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation's largest media networks. 

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven  matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.   They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results. 

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience. 

We believe in: 

- The direct measurability of digital media. 
 - Performance marketing. (We pioneered it. )
 - The advantages of technology. We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world's biggest channel. 

  

Quality Engineer - Backend Automation  

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
Experience: 4-7 Years |  

About the Role

We are seeking hands-on Quality Engineers to support the modernization of Quest, a high-volume event and workflow-processing platform. This role focuses on backend quality engineering, including API, event-driven, database, integration, performance, and migration testing to ensure reliability and correctness throughout the Quest v2 migration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test strategies for backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and database interactions. 
 - Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate Kafka-based event processing, retries, ordering, duplicate handling, replay, and idempotency scenarios. 
 - Perform migration validation between Quest v1 and Quest v2, including reconciliation and data consistency checks. 
 - Develop SQL-based data validation, integration, regression, performance, and resilience tests. 
 - Investigate defects using logs, metrics, traces, databases, and event streams. 
 - Support production deployments, release validation, and incident investigations. Required Skills

- 4-7 years of Quality Engineering, SDET, or software testing experience. 
 - Strong Java programming and test automation skills. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Strong SQL and database validation experience (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, etc. ). 
 - Experience testing backend services, integrations, and distributed systems. 
 - Good understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, Git, and Linux/Unix environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Preferred Skills

- Experience with Kafka, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures. 
 - Knowledge of Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing. 
 - Experience with JMeter, Gatling, k6, or similar performance testing tools. 
 - Exposure to resilience, concurrency, recovery, and high-volume transaction systems. What We're Looking For

- Engineers who treat automation as production-quality software. 
 - Strong focus on backend, data, event-processing, and system reliability testing. 
 - Ability to independently own test coverage, defect investigation, and quality validation. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with developers, architects, and QA teams. Levels: Candidates may be hired as Quality Engineer (4-6 years) or Senior Quality Engineer (5-7 years) based on experience and capability in automation design, test strategy, performance testing, and technical leadership. 

  

QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law. 

Please see QuinStreet's Employee Privacy Notice here.

Job Title: Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst (Java Full Stack)

Role Overview

The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst (Java Full Stack) is a senior-level technical leadership role responsible for establishing, designing, and delivering high-quality, scalable application systems and software solutions in coordination with cross-functional technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to drive end-to-end applications systems analysis, architectural alignment, full-stack software engineering, and implementation activities across distributed enterprise environments. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Solution Delivery

- System Integration & Product Delivery: Partner with engineering managers, product owners, and multi-disciplinary teams to establish architectural roadmaps, integrate enterprise services, and deliver core system enhancements and new digital capabilities. 
 - Architecture & Engineering Standards: Ensure software and application designs strictly adhere to enterprise architecture blueprints, security baselines, and industry best practices. 
 - Complex Problem Resolution: Resolve high-impact, critical engineering and architectural challenges through in-depth evaluation of complex business flows, technical bottlenecks, system dependencies, and industry standards. 
 - Coding & Quality Governance: Define, champion, and enforce engineering standards for clean code, design patterns, automated unit/integration testing, debugging, code reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Cross-Functional Domain Alignment: Maintain a comprehensive understanding of how application architecture, infrastructure, data management, and business capabilities integrate to achieve business objectives. 

Innovation, AI-Augmented Engineering & Coaching

- Innovative Problem-Solving: Apply interpretive thinking and structured analysis to identify complex technical problems, proposing modern, scalable, and resilient technical solutions. 
 - AI-First Software Delivery: Actively leverage generative AI and modern developer-productivity tools to accelerate software delivery cycles, streamline automated test creation, refactor legacy code, and elevate code quality. 
 - Mentorship & Team Guidance: Serve as a technical advisor and mentor to mid-level software engineers and analysts, leading technical discussions and delegating engineering tasks effectively. 

Risk, Compliance & Governance

- Risk & Controls Assessment: Appropriately assess risk when business and technical decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding client assets. 
 - Regulatory & Policy Compliance: Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and enterprise standards; apply sound ethical judgment; and escalate, manage, and report control issues with full transparency. 

Qualifications & Technical Competencies

- Core Backend Software Engineering (Java)
 - Java Mastery: Advanced, hands-on expertise with Java (Java 17 / 21) and the modern enterprise Java ecosystem. 
 - Frameworks: Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, and Hibernate / JPA. 
 - Microservices Architecture: Proven track record of architecting, implementing, and deploying high-throughput, low-latency, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed processing systems. 
 - Messaging & Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience with asynchronous messaging and event streaming technologies (Apache Kafka, Solace, or JMS). 
 - API Standards: Expertise designing and developing enterprise-grade RESTful APIs and gRPC services with strong authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS). 
 - Modern Frontend Engineering (React / Angular)
 - Frontend Frameworks: Deep practical experience building modern, responsive web applications using React and/or Angular with TypeScript and modern ECMAScript (ES6+). 
 - State Management & Reactive Programming: Proficiency in state management patterns (Redux / NgRx) and reactive streams using RxJS. 
 - Modern UI & Micro-Frontends: Hands-on experience with Micro-Frontend architectures, standalone components, dynamic routing, and complex enterprise data grids (e. g. , AG Grid Enterprise, Elemental UI / Design System components). 
 - Web Fundamentals & Real-Time Data: Strong mastery of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, DOM manipulation, responsive layouts, and bidirectional communication protocols (WebSockets / Server-Sent Events). 
 - Database & Data Engineering
 - Relational Databases (RDBMS): Deep experience with relational data modeling, schema design, advanced SQL tuning, and query optimization on enterprise databases (Oracle, ). 
 - NoSQL Data Stores: Practical experience designing, indexing, and maintaining document/key-value NoSQL databases (MongoDB/Couchbase). 
 - High Availability & Scalability: Solid understanding of database clustering, indexing strategies, replica sets, connection pooling, and caching strategies . 
 - CI/CD, Containerization & Cloud Operations
 - Containers & Orchestration: Proven experience containerizing applications using Docker and deploying onto container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift). 
 - Enterprise CI/CD Pipelines: Hands-on proficiency configuring automated build, test, and release pipelines using modern enterprise platforms (Harness, Jenkins, Tekton, or GitHub Actions) in Linux environments. 
 - Job Scheduling & Batch Systems: Familiarity with enterprise workload automation and job schedulers (Autosys or equivalent). 
 - Quality & Security Tooling: Experience integrating automated code quality, dependency management, and vulnerability scanning tools (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

Education & Experience

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent; Master's degree preferred.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal AI Engineer

AI Solutions, part of Mastercard's AI & Data organization, scales AI across the enterprise, moving use cases beyond pilots into trusted, production-grade capabilities embedded in Mastercard's platforms and products. Centralizing this capability drives speed to scale, operational resilience, consistent delivery standards, and responsible AI by design, in close partnership with the AI Center of Excellence. 

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. 

You will be joining a team of AI and data engineers working on innovative AI and ML fraud solutions. Our innovative cross-channel AI solutions are applied in Fortune 500 companies in industries such as fin-tech and payments processing. We are pursuing a highly motivated individual with strong problem-solving skills to take on the challenge of structuring and engineering data and cutting-edge AI model evaluation and reporting processes. 

NOTE: This role will be reporting to the VP of AI Engineering for AI Solutions. 

As a Principal AI Engineer, You Will

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise AI and agentic systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. 

Build and manage AI-ready data products, retrieval pipelines, vector data stores, and knowledge systems that power AI solutions. 

Develop and standardize agent engineering capabilities, including orchestration, tool integration, memory management, and multi-agent workflows. 

Establish AI observability, evaluation, and AgenticOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, and performance measurement of AI systems. 

Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Product teams to accelerate the delivery and operationalization of AI solutions across the enterprise. 

All About You

Deep expertise in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, or Machine Learning platforms, with a proven track record of delivering production-grade AI solutions at scale. 

Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, agent frameworks, orchestration patterns, and LLM-powered applications. 

Experienced in designing and building scalable data pipelines, data products, APIs, and distributed systems that support AI and analytics workloads. 

Demonstrated technical leadership with the ability to influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and drive the adoption of engineering best practices across teams. 

Passionate about solving complex business problems through innovation, with a pragmatic approach to balancing speed, quality, security, and operational

Proven ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into enterprise-scale platforms, reusable services, and measurable business outcomes. 

At least an undergraduate degree in CS, or a STEM related field

Prior experience in payment fraud detection modeling

Nice To Have

PhD/Master's in CS, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related STEM field

Experience in with data engineering and model building in PySpark using Spark ML on petabyte scale data

Understands and implements methods to evaluate own work and others for bias, inaccuracy, and error

Loves working with error-prone, messy, disparate, unstructured data

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;

 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Principal R&D Engineer (3DIC)
data.description:
You Are

You have 15+ years of experience and are already drawn to hard technical problems: algorithms, data structures, and software that has to be correct, fast, and maintainable. You may not yet have shipped a full EDA product, but you write solid C/C++, you debug with discipline, and you want to learn how production design tools actually get built. 

You are curious about how chips are designed and packaged - and you want to grow into that domain by working on real software, not only on theory. At Synopsys, you will contribute to package substrate design automation within 3DIC Compiler, helping enable advanced multi-die systems for AI, high-performance computing, and heterogeneous integration. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Implement and extend package substrate design automation capabilities within the 3DIC Compiler platform. 
 - Write production C/C++ code for features such as HDI substrate auto-routing, design rule checking, power delivery network analysis, and design for manufacturability. 
 - Build, test, and debug software that runs on large, real-world packaging designs, including multi-die chiplets and heterogeneous integration. 
 - Work with senior engineers, product teams, and customers to understand design bottlenecks and turn them into well-scoped software changes. 
 - Participate in design and code reviews; learn how architecture decisions are made across the 3DIC product. 
 - Grow your skills in algorithms, performance, and software quality under the mentorship of experienced R&D engineers. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Contribute features that help customers design next-generation advanced packaging for AI, high-performance computing, and other complex systems. 
 - Help reduce design cycle time for teams working on HDI substrates, chiplets, and multi-die architectures. 
 - Own well-defined pieces of auto-routing, power delivery, checking, and manufacturability software - and see them used by leading semiconductor companies. 
 - Build a foundation in a strategic Synopsys product line at the center of the industry shift toward chiplet-based systems. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of relevant software or R&D experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ skills and a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity. 
 - Ability to write, debug, and test production-quality code; coursework, internships, or projects that show this clearly. 
 - Interest in physical design, EDA, semiconductors, or advanced packaging - prior domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. 
 - Coursework or project experience in at least one related area is helpful: graph algorithms, computational geometry, CAD/EDA tools, VLSI/physical design, or large-scale C++ software. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to learn from design reviews and feedback. 

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the advanced packaging design automation team for 3DIC Compiler. The team focuses on package substrate design and the industry shift toward chiplet architectures and heterogeneous integration. You will be mentored by senior and distinguished engineers, contribute to a strategic Synopsys growth area, and see a clear path to greater ownership as you grow.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python + AI) - Remote
data.description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. 

We're Most Proud Of: 

- Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. 
 - Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world's greatest companies. 
 - Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. 
 - Our 4. 1-star rating on GlassDoor. 
 - Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. 

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client's problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production. 

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. 

On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right. 

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don't hold up. 

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: 

- Reframes the request. Treats "we need an agent for X" as a hypothesis, not a spec. 
 - Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints - before choosing technology. 
 - Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent - and defends why. 
 - Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won't deliver value. 

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE's first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. 

- Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it's worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. 
 - Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they're worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. 
 - Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines - the things that kill projects in month two. 
 - Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. 
 - Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with "why, " "how do you know, " and "what happens today when. . . " - without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. 
 - Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. 

What You'll Do

- Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. 
 - Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. 
 - Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture - data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted - plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Build. Ship working systems - agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. 
 - Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases. 
 - Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch - eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client's team run it without you. 
 - Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of professional software development experience with core proficiency in Python (or TypeScript/Node. js). 
 - Has shipped at least one agentic AI solution, LLM workflow, or RAG architecture to a production environment.

data.description:
Job Description

Senior Application Development Lead

SCM Technical & Integration

Location Pune, India Employment Type Full-Time

Experience 10+ years preferred Leadership Scope Lead a team of 3 developers

Role Summary

We are seeking a senior-level Application Development Lead to join our Supply Chain Management (SCM) technology team in India. This role combines hands-on development, solution design, application support, integration delivery, and people leadership. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a team of three developers while remaining actively involved in the design, development, review, deployment, and support of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), APIs, and related SCM solutions. 

The ideal candidate has strong experience across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C), along with advanced Oracle PL/SQL, Oracle APIs, OIC integrations, REST/SOAP services, reporting, DevOps, and production support capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and guide a team of three developers, including work allocation, technical direction, code reviews, quality oversight, and delivery tracking. 
 - Act as the technical lead for SCM application enhancements, integrations, incident resolution, and production support. 
 - Partner with solution architects, functional teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs. 
 - Prepare and review technical solution documents, design specifications, interface mappings, deployment plans, test evidence, support documentation, and operational runbooks. 
 - Design, develop, and customize Oracle EBS concurrent programs using PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and Oracle APIs. 
 - Build and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, including orchestrations, scheduled integrations, file-based interfaces, error handling, monitoring, and reprocessing. 
 - Design, develop, secure, test, and document REST and SOAP APIs for internal and external application integrations. 
 - Develop and maintain custom interfaces, data conversions, and migration scripts using PL/SQL, SQL*Loader, Oracle APIs, and other approved integration methods. 
 - Develop operational and analytical reports using Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, Discoverer, and related reporting tools. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Drop Ship Orders, supplier transactions, interfaces, and other P2P/O2C process flows. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis, implement defect fixes and performance improvements, and drive preventive actions for recurring production issues. 
 - Ensure code quality through development standards, peer reviews, unit testing, debugging, security controls, documentation, and release-readiness checks. 
 - Support DevOps and release-management activities, including source control, CI/CD pipelines, deployment coordination, rollback planning, and post-deployment validation. 
 - Provide technical estimates, identify delivery risks and dependencies, communicate status, and escalate issues when required. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing, reusable integration patterns, coding standards, and continuous improvement across the development team. 

Required Technical Skills

- 10+ years of relevant experience in Oracle EBS technical development, SCM applications, enterprise integrations, or a comparable application-development environment. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle EBS SCM modules, with working knowledge of P2P and O2C business processes. 
 - Advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, performance tuning, and debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including adapters, connections, mappings, orchestrations, schedules, fault handling, monitoring, and integration troubleshooting. 
 - Strong API-development experience using REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, error handling, versioning, and API documentation. 
 - Experience with Oracle APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, SQL*Loader, and data migration/conversion techniques. 
 - Experience with Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, and Discoverer or equivalent reporting technologies. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release-management processes. 
 - Ability to develop high-quality technical designs and conduct structured code and design reviews. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining process flows, system integration diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and technical architecture visuals using Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or comparable diagramming tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, production-support, and root-cause-analysis skills. 

Leadership & Professional Skills

- Prior experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a small technical team. 
 - Ability to balance team leadership responsibilities with hands-on technical delivery. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage priorities, deadlines, risks, and dependencies. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience collaborating across global, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Ability to work effectively within Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid delivery models. 
 - Commitment to documentation, knowledge transfer, operational stability, and continuous improvement. 

Tools & Technologies

Category Technologies

Core Applications Oracle E-Business Suite, SCM, P2P, O2C

Development Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, SQL Developer, Oracle APIs, SQL*Loader

Integration & APIs Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, authentication and API documentation tools

Reporting Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, Discoverer

DevOps & Deployment CI/CD pipelines, source control, WinSCP, SBM, Dimensions CM or comparable tools

Monitoring & Analytics Power BI, DAX, Snowflake, Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics or similar tools

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle EBS, API, cloud, or DevOps certifications are preferred. 
 - Experience working in an IT consulting, shared-services, or global enterprise delivery organization. 
 - Experience supporting supply chain integrations with third-party platforms, suppliers, logistics providers, or enterprise applications. 
 - Exposure to Power BI, DAX, Snowflake, Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics, or comparable analytics and monitoring platforms. 

Success Measures

- Consistent, high-quality delivery by the lead and the three-person development team. 
 - Reliable and supportable OIC integrations and APIs with effective monitoring, error handling, and documentation. 
 - Improved code quality, review discipline, deployment readiness, and production stability. 
 - Timely resolution of SCM incidents and successful delivery of enhancements across P2P and O2C processes. 
 - Effective stakeholder communication, team development, knowledge transfer, and reduction of single points of failure. 

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv's Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. 

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion. 

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

- High-Performance Culture
 - Customer Focus
 - Operational Excellence
 - Innovation
 - Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

- Own it
 - Act with urgency
 - Foster a customer-first mindset
 - Think big and execute
 - Lead by example
 - Drive continuous improvement
 - Learn and seek out development
 - Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers' vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today's data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34, 000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv. com to learn more.

Drives the delivery of transformational change by providing leadership and direction to complex technology-related programs focused on overarching improvements to technology and processes, operations, or organizational structures. Ensures that all programs under management meet expected delivery dates, budget allocations, and regulatory requirements. Leads and direct the activities of several managers and specialists. 

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

This role leads the development and adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities across the product development lifecycle. It combines hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for guiding a small team of highly technical professionals. The role partners with product managers, engineering leaders, architects, and global technology teams to build, experiment with, and deploy AI tools and practices that help teams deliver products faster and with greater quality. The successful candidate will bring strong architecture and engineering experience, remain actively involved in technical work, and operate as a player-coach rather than as a traditional program manager. 

Responsibilities

- Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance, coaching, and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures. 
 - Provides hands-on technical leadership for the design, development, prototyping, and implementation of AI-enabled engineering tools, components, plugins, interfaces, reusable skills, and development harnesses. 
 - Drives the application of AI across the full product development lifecycle, from idea and discovery through architecture, engineering, testing, implementation, production deployment, and continuous improvement. 
 - Leads as a player-coach by directing a small team of highly technical professionals toward the highest-value opportunities while remaining actively involved in solution design and building. 
 - Partners with product managers, engineering leaders, architects, and technology teams in India and the United States to co-build solutions and deploy AI-enabled tools and practices. 
 - Explores emerging developments in AI and software engineering, evaluates their relevance, and converts promising ideas into controlled experiments, working solutions, and reusable capabilities. 
 - Coaches product and engineering teams on the effective adoption of AI tools, practices, and reusable components to improve development speed, quality, and outcomes. 
 - Provides technical oversight and promotes sound architecture, engineering standards, risk awareness, controls, and responsible implementation of AI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Builds and maintains strategic relationships across sites, departments, divisions, and internal and external partners to support enterprise adoption and delivery. 
 - Communicates technical direction, progress, decisions, risks, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product partners, and senior leadership. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 10 years of experience in information technology, software engineering, architecture, or product development, with experience across the full product development lifecycle. 
 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Proven experience as a hands-on technical lead, solution architect, engineering architect, principal engineer, senior engineer, or equivalent technical leader. 
 - Practical proficiency with AI-native engineering tools and approaches. Experience with Claude Code or comparable AI coding assistants, including plugins, integrations, interfaces, reusable skills, or related development ecosystems, is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated ability to contribute directly to technical design, system architecture, prototypes, code, integrations, or production-oriented solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software architecture, system design, engineering practices, product delivery, implementation, and production operations. 
 - Experience leading or guiding a small, highly technical team while remaining actively involved in technical work. 
 - Ability to identify and apply emerging AI capabilities to build faster, better, and more effective products. 
 - Strong learning agility and curiosity, with a consistent focus on staying current in a rapidly evolving AI environment. 
 - Self-driven and execution-oriented approach, with the ability to take ideas from exploration through experimentation, implementation, and adoption.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Our commitment to you

Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

Physical wellness

data.title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
