data.title: Chief Technology Officer
data.description:
About the Company

Wastefull Insights is a robotics and AI company focused on developing intelligent automation solutions for waste segregation and material identification. The company integrates robotics, computer vision, AI, mechanical systems, and industrial automation to build technology solutions for real-world operational environments. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the company's overall technology strategy, engineering teams, product development, and technology deployment. 

The CTO will be responsible for converting business requirements into scalable, reliable, and commercially viable technology solutions. This role requires strong technical expertise across robotics, AI/ML, computer vision, embedded systems, mechanical engineering, and industrial automation, along with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver projects from concept to deployment. 

The ideal candidate should be capable of making critical technology decisions, building robust engineering processes, improving product performance, and aligning technology development with the company's business objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Leadership

- Define and execute the company's long-term technology roadmap in alignment with business goals. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, platforms, and architectures relevant to robotics and industrial automation. 
 - Make key technical decisions related to system architecture, technology selection, scalability, and product reliability. 
 - Establish engineering standards, development practices, documentation requirements, and technology governance. 
 - Identify opportunities for innovation, automation, cost reduction, and product differentiation. 2. Robotics & Product Development

- Lead the design, development, integration, and improvement of robotics-based products and systems. 
 - Oversee the integration of mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, actuators, sensors, controllers, and robotic mechanisms. 
 - Guide the development of robot control software, motion planning, perception systems, and hardware-software interfaces. 
 - Ensure products meet performance, reliability, safety, maintainability, and operational requirements. 
 - Drive product development from proof of concept and prototyping through testing, production readiness, and field deployment. 3. AI, Machine Learning & Computer Vision

- Lead the development and integration of AI/ML and computer vision capabilities into robotics products. 
 - Oversee image acquisition, data collection, annotation, dataset quality, model training, validation, and deployment. 
 - Define processes for model monitoring, performance evaluation, retraining, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure AI models perform reliably under real-world conditions, including changing lighting, materials, speeds, and operating environments. 
 - Guide the deployment of vision systems and AI inference solutions on cloud, edge, and on-site infrastructure. 4. Engineering Team Management

- Lead and mentor robotics, software, computer vision, AI/ML, mechanical, electrical, and automation engineering teams. 
 - Define team structures, technical ownership, responsibilities, and reporting mechanisms. 
 - Set engineering priorities, project milestones, technical deliverables, and quality expectations. 
 - Conduct technical reviews, architecture reviews, design reviews, and performance assessments. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 5. System Integration & Deployment

- Ensure seamless integration of robotics hardware, software, AI models, sensors, controllers, and industrial systems. 
 - Oversee factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and performance validation. 
 - Lead technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for failures occurring during development or deployment. 
 - Establish processes for field monitoring, preventive maintenance, upgrades, and technical support. 
 - Ensure deployed systems meet agreed performance and operational requirements. 6. Project & Product Delivery

- Translate business requirements and customer needs into technical specifications and executable development plans. 
 - Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and delivery priorities. 
 - Coordinate with project management, operations, procurement, vendors, and client-facing teams on technical dependencies. 
 - Monitor development progress, resolve technical bottlenecks, and manage delivery risks. 
 - Ensure timely delivery without compromising product quality, safety, or reliability. 7. Infrastructure, Quality & Reliability

- Oversee engineering infrastructure, source-code management, CI/CD, testing automation, and release management. 
 - Establish standards for software quality, hardware validation, cybersecurity, data security, and system reliability. 
 - Guide cloud and edge infrastructure for AI workloads, data pipelines, model deployment, and system monitoring. 
 - Define product performance metrics, uptime targets, failure analysis processes, and reliability improvement plans. 
 - Ensure technical documentation, design records, version control, and deployment procedures are maintained. 8. Cost Optimisation & Vendor Management

- Evaluate technology costs, component selection, vendor capabilities, and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Improve product design for manufacturability, serviceability, and cost-effective scaling. 
 - Work with procurement and operations teams to identify alternative components and reduce recurring costs. 
 - Evaluate and manage technical partnerships, external development partners, and equipment suppliers. 
 - Support budgeting and resource planning for R&D, engineering, and product deployment. 9. Business & Customer Collaboration

- Work closely with founders and leadership to align technology investments with business priorities. 
 - Participate in customer discussions to understand technical requirements and deployment constraints. 
 - Support technical proposals, feasibility assessments, product demonstrations, and solution design. 
 - Identify opportunities to convert customer feedback and field data into product improvements. 
 - Support business growth by building technology that can be replicated across multiple client locations. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related field. 
 - Typically 10+ years of relevant engineering or technology experience, with substantial experience leading multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Demonstrated experience in robotics, industrial automation, AI/ML, computer vision, or integrated hardware-software products. 
 - Proven experience taking complex technology products from development through real-world deployment. 
 - Strong understanding of system architecture, product engineering, testing, debugging, and reliability. 
 - Experience managing engineering teams, technology roadmaps, budgets, and project delivery. 
 - Strong decision-making, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

data.title: Quality Improvement Specialist
data.description:
Main Responsibilities And Tasks

We are seeking an experienced 8D Moderator to lead and facilitate structured problem-solving activities across the organization. The successful candidate will coordinate cross-functional teams, drive effective root cause analysis, ensure robust definition of containment, corrective and preventive actions and strengthen the organization's problem-solving culture. 

This role requires a strong background in Quality and/or Continues Improvement within an industrial environment, exceptional facilitation and training capabilities and the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels. 

8D Problem-Solving Leadership

data.title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
data.description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast - and Brings You With It. 

At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn't a slogan - it's how we work. For over 140 years, we've improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions - but how we operate as a company. 

When you join Fuller, you're joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You'll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that's actively expanding - a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. 

If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it - Fuller is where that happens. 

About The Role

For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations: 

engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers. 

As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms - it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts. 

You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle - from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support. 

Your Responsibilities: 

- Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities. 
 - Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies. 
 - Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals. 
 - Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions. 
 - Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability. 
 - Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians. 
 - Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification. 
 - Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform. 
 - Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications. 
 - Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required. 

You bring

- Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes. 
 - Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation. 
 - Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage. 
 - Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis. 
 - Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
 - Willingness to travel (50-70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training. 

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. 

Application and contact

Please apply by clicking "apply" on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible. 

No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please. 

Build a better world

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success. 

For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https: //www. fuller-technologies. com/

data.description:
Company Description DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide. 

Role Description

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation. The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained. 

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose. 

Key responsibilities

1. Data quality monitoring

- Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data. 
 - Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards. 
 - Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions. 
 - Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records. 
 - Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes. 
 - Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement. 

2. Data Cleansing and Remediation

- Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets. 
 - Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies. 
 - Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information. 
 - Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures. 
 - Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status. 
 - Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner. 

3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding

- Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data. 
 - Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment. 
 - Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data. 
 - Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements. 
 - Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions. 
 - Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information. 

4. Data governance and standardization

- Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data. 
 - Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained. 
 - Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality. 
 - Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures. 
 - Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams. 
 - Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation. 

5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support

- Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information. 
 - Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues. 
 - Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records. 
 - Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices. 

6. Reporting and continuous improvement

- Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress. 
 - Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action. 
 - Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes. 
 - Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation. 

Qualifications

- Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline. 
 - Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment. 
 - Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented. 
 - Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records. 
 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically. 
 - Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues. 
 - Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. 
 - Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions. 
 - A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products. 
 - Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases. 
 - Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms. 
 - Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting. 
 - Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes. 
 - Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

Job Description

This is a senior technical lead role that pairs deep platform engineering expertise with the thought leadership needed to bring AI into production operations. The person owns the build, hardening, patching, and lifecycle of the operating system and platform estate, and serves as the top escalation point for complex incidents - while simultaneously identifying where AI and automation can replace manual toil, reduce incident volume, and shorten recovery times. Success depends as much on change leadership as on engineering: shaping standards, winning stakeholder buy-in, and guiding 1st line operations through new AI-enabled ways of working without disrupting service levels. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform engineering depth - packaging and hardening approved OS builds, management agent stacks, patch currency, and configuration standards across the estate
 - AI-driven operations innovation - identifying, piloting, and scaling AI/automation use cases for incident triage, root cause analysis, runbook execution, and predictive monitoring
 - Thought leadership and evangelism - articulating an AI-for-operations vision, authoring white papers and R&D positions, staying ahead of emerging tooling
 - Change management and adoption - driving organizational uptake of new practices, coaching 1st line teams, managing risk and resistance while protecting SLAs
 - Incident, problem, and change discipline - major incident leadership, RCA, and rigorous change control in a regulated production environment
 - Service improvement measurement - instrumenting and evidencing reductions in incident volume and MTTR from process redesign and automation
 - Solution design and implementation planning - translating requirements into physical builds, costed designs, and multi-workstream delivery plans
 - Automation and infrastructure-as-code fluency - scripting, configuration management, and pipeline-driven platform delivery
 - Standards, compliance, and documentation - run books, technical policies, and AI governance/guardrails to document-control standards
 - Cross-functional influence - partnering with architecture, security, development, vendors, and the business to land change. 

Required Qualifications

- Provides a high level of technical and subject matter expertise in one or more technologies and serves as a point of escalation for technical issues related to specialty. 
 - Produces, delivers, and maintains appropriate documentation for systems in accordance document control standards and procedures. 
 - Provide input to records, quality systems and management reports as required
 - Contributes to the definition and implementation of improved operability on new and current systems. 
 - Uses innovative methods including the redesign of process and providing technical solutions to reduce the volume and mean time to recover incidents in assigned business unit. 
 - Identifies risks & issues and takes ownership to deliver appropriate resolutions. 
 - Provides technical expertise for root cause analysis and problem management. 
 - Provides detailed implementation/project plans across multiple, complex work streams according to agreed standards and ensures project processes and timelines are understood and followed.

 - May be asked to assist with production of white papers on technical R&D projects

 - Stays abreast of recent developments in related technical community, including new technology and business news that may impact vendors' ability to provide service. 
 - Responsible to seek out all information and to fully understand all aspects of each device's technology configuration and uses all approved engineering tools available to implement conforming change. 
 - Leads the analysis and design of complex solutions and requirements definition, including translating technical and business requirements into physical installations, costing design elements, and obtaining agreement to proposed solutions. 
 - Reviews and coordinates the implementation of proposed modifications, and changes to the production environment. 
 - Provides direction into standards and procedures for monitoring, capacity planning, tuning, maintenance, performance optimization, backups and recovery; ensures infrastructure will meet capacity requirements to deliver projects on time. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Provides direction for: proactive health and performance monitoring of databases, indexes and logs, and troubleshooting of reported issues. 
 - Reviews implemented scripts, stored procedures, and reports generated by automated database maintenance scripts. 
 - Participates in the technical design process as it relates to database implementations, reviews technical documents, and communicates any risks or issues using the appropriate escalation procedures. 
 - Provides directions to Technical Recovery plans (Database Standby and Replication, Backup and Recovery). 
 - Platform Engineer: 
 - Packages company approved hardened versions of targeted operating systems. 
 - Ensures stack of agents for management systems are properly installed and connected. 
 - Maintains patch levels in accordance with change management and security standards. 
 - Storage Engineer: 
 - Provides leadership for storage-related projects, including switch installations, disk consolidations, disk assignments, replication, and more. 
 - Works closely with architecture teams to set, communicate, and maintain storage standards. 
 - Network Engineer: 
 - Reviews the network infrastructure documentation/ run book for standards adherence. 
 - Complies with all routing and rules sets, sequences, defaults, and standards. 
 - Documents and maintains all applicable configuration standards. 
 - Assures all NIC and port speeds are appropriately locked down. 
 - Application Engineer: 
 - Fully familiarizes self with all aspects of the developed code. 
 - Recognizes design problems and errors and takes corrective action from a design perspective on the object code Environment. Interfaces with development teams on system design enhancements and the elimination of intermittent hardware/software problems. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

data.description:
Role Description

Information Security Engineer Role

Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Python and security automation to join our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be adept at developing and implementing automated security solutions to protect our systems and data, as well as reviewing, validating, and hardening code and workflows produced by AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic systems. This role requires a proactive individual who can work independently and collaboratively to enhance our security posture in an environment where both humans and AI agents write and operate code. In addition, proficiency and experience using a SOAR for automation and security incident response is required. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain security automation scripts and tools using Python to a high standard of reliability and efficiency, including reviewing and hardening code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Integrate security tools and solutions, including developing and managing APIs, to automate security processes and workflows. 

Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential threats. 

Monitor security systems and respond to incidents with automated solutions, implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Tines, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect) to streamline response activities. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement security controls, and write clear technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for tools and processes. 

Govern enterprise use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including tenant restrictions, access scoping, and compliance/audit logging. 

Design and enforce security controls for agentic AI systems, including tool-permission boundaries, prompt injection defenses, and agent identity/access governance. 

Utilise Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for threat detection and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to analyse security data. 

Implement CI/CD pipeline automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) to ensure secure code deployment and infrastructure provisioning. 

Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field. 

Proven experience as a Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on Python and security automation. 

Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing automation scripts and tools, as well as reviewing and validating code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners. 

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes). 

Experience with API development and integration, including RESTful APIs. 

Proficiency in implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect). 

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint security. 

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication, including writing technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience securing AI/LLM-based agentic systems, including prompt injection defense, tool-permission boundaries, and agent identity governance. 

Experience governing enterprise AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), including compliance/audit logging, tenant restrictions, and CI/CD supply-chain hardening against AI-related risks. 

Desirable

Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) for querying and analysing security data. 

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or GIAC. 

Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). 

Understanding of network protocols and security architecture. 

Familiarity with the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e. g. , tool misuse, agentic supply-chain risk, unexpected code execution, human-agent trust exploitation). 

Experience with AI red-teaming and evaluation methodologies for agentic and LLM-based systems. 

Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and other agent-tool integration risks. 

Skills

AI Security, Python, Cloud Security, IDS/IPS, LLMs, Vulnerability Assessment, SOAR, Container Security, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

The Role: Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you'll own the top of this funnel - building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month. 

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you'll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you. 

What You'll Own

Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management

- Lead management framework: Design and own the end-to-end framework - sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads. 
 - Ideal customer profile: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data. 
 - Outreach playbooks: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events. 
 - Renewal-cycle planning: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates. 

Target Account List Building

- Target list: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership. 
 - Research & data tools: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data. 
 - Data hygiene & prioritisation: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert. 

Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team

- Qualified pipeline: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month. 
 - Monthly targets: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals. 
 - Feedback loop: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly. 

Team Leadership & Motivation

- Hiring & training: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e. g. , Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life). 
 - Targets & reviews: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards. 
 - Coaching & culture: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture. 

Individual Contribution

- Personal target: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - CXO outreach: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team. 
 - Lead from the front: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate. 

Tools, Reporting & Analytics

- Lead management stack: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team. 
 - Dashboards & MIS: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement. 
 - Data-led allocation: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaboration: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering. 

How Success Is Measured

- Qualified leads delivered: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target. 
 - Meetings held: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker. 
 - Funnel conversion: Lead → meeting → proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel. 
 - Team productivity: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week. 
 - Self-outreach target: The Manager's personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - Data quality: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records. 

Who You Are

- 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets. 
 - Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover. 
 - Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools - CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms. 
 - Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly. 
 - Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team. 
 - Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS. 
 - Excellent communication skills. 
 - Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru. 

Good to have

- Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e. g. , HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS). 
 - Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment. 
 - Graduate degree; MBA preferred. 

Why This Role Rocks

- You'll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms. 
 - You'll have high ownership and visibility - your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business. 
 - You'll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs. 
 - You'll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product. 
 - Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families. 

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice. 

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

data.title: Manager Account Analytics
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive. 

How You'll Make An Impact

The Manager, Account Analytics Development is a hands-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team - today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you. 

We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists. 

What You'll Build

Interpretation. Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business-relevant interpretation - what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization. 

Client knowledge. A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilon's relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki. 

Media investment planning. Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning - putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Systems Design

- Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning. 
 - Design evaluation before you design the solution. Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop. 
 - Establish the engineering standards - source control, testing, documentation, deployment - that let a three-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Write production code. 
 - Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded. 
 - Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them. 

Team Leadership

- Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level. 
 - Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review. 
 - Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to. 
 - Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team. 

Business Partnership

- Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage - and where they do not. 
 - Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non-technical partners. 
 - Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client-facing workflows and have to keep working. 
 - Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights

Qualifications

- 8+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects. 
 - Strong Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM-based systems in production - agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs - not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone. 
 - Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as "interpret this analysis" and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did. 
 - A considered point of view on evaluating non-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it. 
 - Working familiarity with marketing measurement - attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance - sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. 

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Preferred Technical Experience

- Agentic development environments - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar - used as a daily working tool rather than tried once. 
 - Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms. 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice. 
 - Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow. 
 - Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background. 
 - Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints. 

How You Work

- You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to. 
 - You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it. 
 - You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands. 

Additional Information

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. 

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9, 000 employees around the world. 

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. 

- People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. 
 - Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. 
 - Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. 
 - Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. 
 - Flexibility: We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. 

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. 

- Act with integrity
 - Work together to win together
 - Innovate with purpose
 - Respect all voices
 - Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. 

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond. 

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career. 

Join us, and together, we'll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. 

Job Summary

More about the role

Designs and implements digital services to meet Business requirements. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless digital solutions. Monitors and optimizes digital solutions for performance and scalability. 

Key Areas of Responsibility

Good To Have

- Collaborates with stakeholders to gather and analyze technical requirements. 
 - Documents technical processes and provides training to support teams
 - Owns the overall technical quality, performance, security, continuity and availability of the products in scope. 
 - Translates business requirements into technical solutions to optimize business experience. 
 - Analyze problems and provide problem solving expertise to ensure complex issues are resolved efficiently within the stipulated timeframe while also meeting the satisfaction of the user. 
 - Proactively share knowledge and experiences in focus groups, with colleagues from own and other teams with a similar technical focus. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners/ Service Owners/ Business Process Owners/ Business Process Experts to craft clear business requirements and deliver prototypes and products within timelines/ sprints. 
 - Be the trusted advisor for Product Owner/ Service Owners/ Business Process Owners/ Business Process Experts for the product area. 
 - Integrates digital services with existing platforms and third-party applications. 
 - Required Skills & Qualifications: 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - Minimum of 8 years of experience in Robotic Process Automation (RPA), including at least 6 years of hands-on experience with UiPath. 
 - Strong proficiency in UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, REFramework, and familiarity with UiPath Apps and AI Center or Willingness to learn and adapt to evolving RPA technologies is essential. 
 - Have delivered Agentic Automation use cases. 
 - Solid programming skills in VB. NET, C#, Python, and SAP scripting. 
 - Experience working with SQL databases, REST/SOAP APIs, and version control systems such as Git. 
 - UiPath certifications (e. g. , UiPath Developer, Advanced RPA Developer) are highly desirable. 
 - Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and effective communication skills. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, document understanding, or process mining. 
 - Exposure to cloud automation (UiPath Cloud, Azure, AWS). 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and CI/CD practices. 
 - Domain experience in Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Consumer, or Customer Service. 

Everything we'll do for you

You can grow a lasting career here. We'll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We'll help you learn and progress in a way that's right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We'll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27, 000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together. 

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

data.description:
Position Title: Dam Safety Specialist (International Expert)

Key Qualifications/ Requirements: He/ She should have a degree in civil engineering and have at least experience of 15 years' experience in dealing with construction supervision and quality assurance, safety evaluation, preparation of guidelines/manuals, design experience, past member of any safety inspections and remedial measures etc. He/ She should have worked in at least 5 large dam projects. 

Job Descriptions

- Serve as the Nodal Expert for reviewing all dam safety aspects across project activities. 
 - Conduct CS&QA visits and prepare official transmittals for onward submission. 
 - Perform dam safety inspections and provide expert opinions to address safety concerns. 
 - Review overall rehabilitation plans of DRIP dams. 
 - Assess construction quality, quality control systems, and quality assurance. 
 - Design customized training modules/lectures to train IAs. 
 - Contribute to the updating or development of dam safety guidelines/manuals. 
 - Participate as a domain expert in the DHARMA updating team. 
 - Provide necessary input for the development of MIS and the official project website. 
 - Conduct Training of Trainers (TOT) programs for officials. 
 - Assist in developing the annual training program calendar and act as faculty. 
 - Expedite and ensure compliance with urgent dam safety matters as assigned by the Project Director. 
 - Participate in relevant dam safety activities as required. 

At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!

Role Description

Job Title

Senior QA Engineer - Test Automation (Java/Kotlin, Selenium, RESTAssured)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer with a strong background in test automation using Java/Kotlin, API testing with RESTAssured, and UI automation using Selenium. The role involves designing and maintaining automation frameworks, ensuring high test coverage for APIs and applications, and actively contributing to quality engineering practices across the SDLC in an Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

- Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks using Java/Kotlin
 - Develop and execute API automation tests using RESTAssured
 - Automate web application testing using Selenium WebDriver
 - Ensure comprehensive validation of REST APIs (request/response, schema, status codes, edge cases)
 - Implement data-driven, reusable, and scalable test automation solutions
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, and end‐to‐end testing

CI/CD & DevOps Collaboration

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
 - Support continuous testing and provide automation feedback for builds and deployments
 - Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to improve test execution reliability

Quality Ownership

- Participate in requirements analysis, test planning, and test strategy discussions
 - Identify quality risks early and propose automation-based solutions
 - Analyze test failures and perform root cause analysis
 - Log, track, and validate defects using defect tracking tools such as JIRA

Leadership & Collaboration

- Review automation code and ensure adherence to best practices
 - Mentor junior and mid-level QA engineers on automation and testing practices
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of QA standards, tools, and processes

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong programming experience in Java and/or Kotlin
 - Hands-on expertise with Selenium WebDriver
 - Strong experience in API testing using RESTAssured
 - Experience with TestNG or JUnit
 - Proficiency with build tools such as Maven or Gradle
 - Experience using Git or other version control systems
 - Solid understanding of RESTful services, HTTP methods, and JSON
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

Testing Expertise

- Strong knowledge of test automation principles and best practices
 - Experience with functional, regression, and integration testing
 - Familiarity with BDD frameworks (Cucumber) is a plus
 - Experience testing microservices-based applications is an advantage

Experience

- 6-9 years of experience in software testing
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience in test automation using Java/Kotlin
 - Proven experience in API and UI automation in enterprise or product-based environments

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Docker / containerized test execution
 - Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
 - Performance or security testing exposure
 - Knowledge of Kotlin-based automation frameworks

Skills

api testing, java, rest assured, selenium,

data.title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud QA Engineer
data.description:
About ETS

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide. 

Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide. 

Position Summary

The Salesforce Quality Assurance Engineer - India is a varied business-facing role that will help continuously improve and grow ETS and subsidiaries Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform globally. This position will create Scenarios and Test Scripts to perform testing during the multiple steps of Salesforce Commerce Cloud development (functional testing, integration and UAT). The Salesforce Commerce Cloud QA Engineer is responsible for executing quality checks and ensuring that the application is developed as per business requirements. This role provides knowledge and support for application testing, testing automation, performance testing and continuous improvements. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Identify test requirements from user stories and design testing to ensure coverage of features. 
 - Develop, document, and maintain test cases, data, and scripts used. 
 - Develop end-to-end test scenarios for Salesforce Commerce Cloud Integrations. 
 - Isolate, replicate, report, and verify bug fixes. 
 - Log, track, and manage issues, bugs, and enhancements. 
 - Evaluate existing test artifacts and design test cases and scripts for new releases. 
 - Identify any potential quality issues immediately and report them to the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Development Lead. 
 - Be an integral part of the development team through the establishment of testing processes and control gates. 
 - Work with development teams to understand root causes and implement fixes. 
 - Assist in Defining metrics to track completion, defect reports and prevention, and test coverage. 
 - Adhere to ethical standards and comply with the laws and regulations applicable to your job function. 
 - Ability to Develop solutions using best practices with customer success in mind. 
 - Ability to Interpret technical specifications and create technical documentation. 
 - Strong understanding of key components of QA principles. 
 - Excellent tracking, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to influence, Relationship building and collaboration skills. 
 - Excellent communication and attention to detail in fast paced cross-group development. 
 - Ability to Coordinate with multiple teams during test definition and execution. 

Education And Experience

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 - Minimum 3 years of Salesforce Commerce Cloud experience. 
 - Minimum 3 years of software testing experience. 
 - Experience documenting for test development, execution, and defect management with JIRA or similar. 
 - Experience implementing and developing in JSON, CSS, XML, Apex, LWC/JavaScript, and SQL. 
 - Salesforce Commerce Cloud Certification is a plus. 
 - Agile (Scrum) experience is desirable. 
 - Selenium automation experience is desirable. 
 - Knowledge of Retail and Ecommerce in general is a must. 
 - Experience with end-to-end, integration, and API testing is desirable. 
 - Active participation in the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Community and Trailhead is preferred. 

ETS is mission driven and action oriented

- We are passionate about hiring innovative thinkers who believe in the promise of education and lifelong learning. 
 - We are energized by cultivating growth, innovation, and continuous transformation for the next generation of rising professionals as leaders. Â In support of this ETS offers multiple Business Resource Groups (BRG) for you to learn and advance your career growth! 
 - As a not-for-profit organization we will encourage you to lean in to your passion for volunteering. Â At ETS you may qualify for up to an additional 8 hours of PTO for volunteer work on causes that are important to you! 
 - The base salary range advertised represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base pay is only one aspect of the Total Rewards Package that will be offered to the successful candidate. 

ETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe in creating a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.

data.title: Sales Manager
data.description:
Company Description Bajaj Finserv, founded in April 2007, is the financial services arm of the Bajaj Group and one of India's fastest-growing, most diversified non-banking financial companies (NBFCs). The organization focuses on delivering high-performance solutions across lending, insurance, and wealth advisory services. With 24 products spanning 12 product lines, Bajaj Finserv offers extensive opportunities for innovation and career growth. Its presence extends across the length and breadth of India, creating a dynamic environment for professionals who aim to build impactful careers in financial services. 

Role Description The Sales Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Coimbatore. This role involves leading and managing a sales team to achieve revenue and growth targets for Bajaj Finserv's lending, insurance, and wealth advisory products. Responsibilities include planning and executing sales strategies, overseeing daily sales operations, tracking performance metrics, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. The Sales Manager will build and maintain strong customer and partner relationships, conduct market analysis, and identify new business opportunities. The role also requires collaboration with cross-functional teams, coaching and developing team members, and preparing regular reports and forecasts for leadership. 

Qualifications

- Strong sales, business development, and relationship management skills, with the ability to drive revenue growth and meet targets. 
 - Experience in financial services, NBFCs, banking, or insurance, with a solid understanding of lending, insurance, or wealth advisory products. 
 - Leadership and team management capabilities, including coaching, performance monitoring, and motivating diverse sales teams. 
 - Analytical and problem-solving skills for market analysis, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Effective communication, negotiation, and presentation skills for engaging customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. 
 - Proficiency in using CRM tools and basic office software for reporting, planning, and tracking sales activities. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage. 
 - Ability to work on-site in Coimbatore, with flexibility to travel within the region as required. 
 - Demonstrated integrity, customer-centric mindset, and commitment to inclusive and respectful workplace practices.

data.title: AI/ML Technical Architect (  exp is a must)
data.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

The Experience

The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution - acting as both a Strategist, shaping the long-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an Orchestrator, coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value. 
 - Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures. 
 - Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams. 
 - Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives. 
 - Coordinate cross-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively. 
 - Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution - ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects. 
 - Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints. 
 - Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts. 
 - Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI-first design principles. 
 - Ship working AI solutions hands-on - prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper. 
 - Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast. 
 - Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents. 
 - Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs-of-concept back to the team. 
 - Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage. 
 - Own end-to-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness. 
 - Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost-efficiency, security posture). 
 - Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations. 
 - Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- 10+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture. 
 - Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions (e. g. , LLM-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent). 
 - Strong grasp of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices. 
 - Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high

Even Better If. . . 

- Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification. 
 - Experience leading AI governance, responsible AI, or AI risk frameworks. 
 - Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers. 
 - Exposure to multi-org, multi-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments. 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents (e. g. , Agentforce, custom agent frameworks) in real-world settings. 
 - Practical experience with AI tools such as Gemini, Cursor, and Claude for coding, prototyping, or workflow automation. 
 - Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool-use patterns. 
 - Comfortable working directly in code/config to build and ship - not purely a design-and-document architect. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

data.title: Technical Architect
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Generative AI / Agentic AI Architect with 15+ years of overall IT experience and strong expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Knowledge Graphs, context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, and LLM evaluation, along with expertise in frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and architect scalable GenAI and agentic AI solutions for enterprise applications. 
 - Build advanced RAG pipelines integrating document retrieval, embeddings, vector databases, and reranking techniques. 
 - Design and implement Knowledge Graphs to enhance contextual retrieval, reasoning, and knowledge representation. 
 - Apply context engineering techniques to optimize LLM inputs, memory, context windows, and response quality. 
 - Develop and orchestrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI and AutoGen. 
 - Establish LLM evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, roundedness, reliability, and performance. 
 - Implement spec-driven development practices to translate business requirements into structured specifications, workflows, and testable implementations. 
 - Define AI architecture standards, reusable components, security controls, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and enterprise architects to deliver production-ready AI solutions. 
 - Mentor engineering teams and provide technical leadership across GenAI and agentic AI initiatives. Required Skills

- 15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, or enterprise solution architecture. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and context engineering. 
 - Experience designing and implementing agentic AI systems and multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Hands-on experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. 
 - Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, benchmarking, observability, and continuous quality improvement. 
 - Experience with spec-driven development, structured requirements, and automated validation. 
 - Strong understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and retrieval optimization. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, API design, scalability, data security, and deployment best practices. 
 - Excellent architecture, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience deploying GenAI solutions in production environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-based AI platforms, model serving, and MLOps/LLMOps. 
 - Experience with Python, REST APIs, vector search technologies, and graph databases. 
 - Experience leading technical teams and driving enterprise AI adoption.
