data.description:
Job Description

Title: Senior Developer - Azure Full Stack / Custom Business Applications - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)

Id: 21372

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Job Title: Salesforce Accessibility Tester

Experience: 5+ Years

Location: Remote (PAN India)

Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract

Job Summary: 

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Accessibility Tester with 5+ years of experience in accessibility testing, including hands-on experience testing Salesforce applications for accessibility compliance. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of WCAG guidelines, accessibility testing tools, and assistive technologies to ensure Salesforce applications are accessible and user-friendly for people with disabilities. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Perform accessibility testing of Salesforce applications, including Lightning Experience, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Visualforce pages. 
 - Validate compliance with WCAG 2. 1/2. 2 AA, Section 508, and ADA accessibility standards. 
 - Conduct manual and automated accessibility testing to identify accessibility issues. 
 - Use accessibility testing tools such as Axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, Accessibility Insights, and screen readers. 
 - Test keyboard navigation, focus management, screen reader compatibility, color contrast, labels, and ARIA attributes. 
 - Validate accessibility across Salesforce components, forms, tables, modals, dashboards, and dynamic content. 
 - Test applications using assistive technologies such as NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track accessibility defects with clear reproduction steps and remediation recommendations. 
 - Collaborate with Salesforce developers, QA teams, business analysts, and UX designers to resolve accessibility issues. 
 - Perform regression testing to ensure accessibility fixes do not introduce new defects. 
 - Integrate accessibility checks into test automation and CI/CD pipelines wherever applicable. 
 - Prepare accessibility test reports, compliance documentation, and audit findings. 

Required Skills

- 5+ years of experience in software testing, with strong hands-on experience in accessibility testing. 
 - Experience testing Salesforce applications, preferably Salesforce Lightning Experience, LWC, and Visualforce. 
 - Strong knowledge of WCAG 2. 1/2. 2, Section 508, and accessibility best practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with accessibility testing tools such as Axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, or similar tools. 
 - Experience with screen readers such as NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver. 
 - Strong understanding of keyboard accessibility, semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, focus order, and color contrast. 
 - Experience in manual testing, defect management, and accessibility reporting. 
 - Familiarity with Jira or similar defect-tracking tools. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. 

If interested, kindly share your resume at hr@runmapglobal. com

data.title: QA/QC ENGINEER LECTRONICS
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

We are looking for a passionate QA/QC Engineer - Electronics to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware. 

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Quality Assurance Leadership: Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices. 
 - Design Phase Integration: Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design. 
 - Reliability & Circuit Analysis: Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities. 
 - AIT & Environmental Compliance: Review and validate environmental qualification test results-including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing-and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP). 
 - Audit & Configuration Control: Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control. 
 - Non-Conformance Management: Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems. 
 - Standards & Compliance: Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles. 
 - Technical Expertise: Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills. 
 - Methodologies: Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks. 
 - Core Competencies: Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes. 
 - Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices. 
 - Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads. 
 - Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt). 

WHY JOIN US?

- Pioneering Impact: Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit. 
 - End-to-End Exposure: Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness. 
 - Innovation Culture: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment. 
 - Career Growth: Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

*Contract extension possible based on performance, with additional benefits including a performance bonus and medical insurance*

Are you passionate about engineering automation solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control at scale? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment? This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an SMTS (Backend Engineer) based in India.

You will work on innovative technologies that help enterprises simplify IT operations and transform existing hardware into scalable, reliable, and future-ready cloud environments. Collaborating with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams, you will help shape product roadmaps, develop robust backend services, and solve complex infrastructure challenges. You will play an important role in improving system performance, scalability, and reliability while supporting deployments and troubleshooting production issues. This position offers the opportunity to work with cloud-native architectures, virtualization technologies, and modern infrastructure platforms in a dynamic, data-driven environment. If you enjoy solving challenging engineering problems, taking ownership of your work, and continuously learning new technologies, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful technical impact.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world's largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo's automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700, 000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. 
 - Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering. 
 - Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions. 
 - Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners. 
 - Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: 

- This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week. 
 - This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence. 
 - The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55, 00, 000 LPA and INR 75, 00, 000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e. g. , ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended. Experience: 

- Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required. 
 - Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team. 
 - Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required. 
 - Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them. 
 - Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams. 
 - AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction. 
 - ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation. 
 - Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e. g. , SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain. 
 - Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction. 
 - Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e. g. , available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs). 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: 

- An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting. 
 - Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture. 
 - PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business. 
 - Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India. 
 - Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market. 
 - Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure. 

Additional Information

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate. 

Our "One Sectigo" culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo: 

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage. 

Global team. Global reach. Global impact. 

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work - and our team members - reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

data.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
data.description:
Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)

About The Role

What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress-test AI-powered applications and infrastructure - identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Conduct penetration tests against AI-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
 - Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
 - Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry-standard tools and methodologies
 - Simulate real-world attack scenarios - from reconnaissance through exploitation and post-exploitation
 - Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
 - Evaluate AI-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
 - Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
 - Work independently on task-based engagements on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK)
 - Proficient with industry-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
 - Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
 - Able to think like an attacker - creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
 - Strong written communication skills - you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
 - Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments

Nice to Have

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
 - Experience with AI/ML security testing - adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red-teaming
 - Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
 - Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
 - Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
 - Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
 - Experience conducting security assessments in compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc. )

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - work when and where it suits you
 - Freelance autonomy with access to high-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
 - Be at the forefront of AI security - a rapidly growing field with massive demand
 - Sharpen your skills against novel AI-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
 - Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

data.title: Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems) based in India. 

We are seeking a technically minded specialist to support, test, and improve a radio communications application used in a professional telecommunications environment. In this role, you will combine application support, system and integration testing, JavaScript scripting, and defect management to ensure reliable application performance. You will help users resolve technical issues, maintain system rules and models, and contribute to continuous product improvement. Working within a small, established Agile team, you will collaborate with colleagues to identify issues, enhance functionality, and strengthen software quality. This remote contract opportunity is well suited to someone who enjoys troubleshooting, communicating with users, and developing their technical skills in radio systems and cloud-based testing. 

Accountabilities

- Application Support: Provide timely technical assistance to users, investigate application issues, guide users through troubleshooting steps, and deliver application training when needed. 
 - Integration and System Testing: Plan and execute comprehensive integration and system tests in cloud environments to validate application functionality, reliability, and performance. 
 - Defect Tracking and Resolution: Identify, document, track, and manage software defects using Jira, collaborating with the team to investigate issues and verify fixes. 
 - JavaScript Scripting and System Configuration: Develop and maintain Radio Online (ROL) system rules and models using JavaScript, including variables, loops, functions, and related scripting techniques. 
 - Agile Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members in an established Agile environment to refine application functionality, prioritize issues, and support iterative improvements. 
 - Application Quality and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to testing practices, troubleshoot recurring issues, and recommend improvements to application stability, usability, and support processes. 
 - Technical Learning and Development: Participate in advanced JavaScript training and specialized workshops covering ROL testing methods, continuous integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - User Communication: Explain technical concepts and troubleshooting procedures clearly, helping users understand solutions and use the application effectively. 

Requirements

- Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in engineering or a technical discipline, together with at least three years of engineering, IT, or technical experience; alternatively, five or more years of relevant engineering, IT, or technical experience. 
 - Application Support: Experience or demonstrated capability in technical troubleshooting, application support, and helping users resolve software-related issues. 
 - Testing and Quality Assurance: Understanding of integration testing and system testing, ideally with experience validating applications in cloud-based environments. 
 - JavaScript Fundamentals: Familiarity with JavaScript or the ability to develop scripting skills involving variables, loops, functions, and system logic. 
 - Defect Management Tools: Ability to document and track defects systematically; experience with Jira is valuable. 
 - Agile Collaboration: Willingness to work within an Agile team, collaborate on application improvements, and contribute to structured development and testing workflows. 
 - Communication Skills: Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical steps in straightforward language and support users with patience, empathy, and professionalism. 
 - Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: A methodical approach to investigating issues, identifying root causes, validating fixes, and improving application reliability. 
 - Preferred Radio Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with digital or analog radio technologies, radio communications systems, or dispatch consoles is an advantage. 
 - Learning Mindset: Motivation to develop expertise in JavaScript, specialized radio application testing, and CI/CD practices. 

Benefits

- Health Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance coverage. 
 - Employee Wellbeing: A wellness program with a focus on mental health. 
 - Recognition and Rewards: Employee recognition initiatives and company incentive programs. 
 - Paid Leave and Time Off: A range of leave options, including holiday, maternity, paternity, birthday, bereavement, and paid personal leave. 
 - Remote Work: Remote working opportunities for greater flexibility. 
 - Work-Life Balance: A focus on supporting a healthy balance between professional and personal commitments. 
 - Learning and Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development, technical training, and continued learning. 
 - Immigration Support: An immigration program that may support relocation to Canada for eligible employees. 
 - Contract Opportunity: A remote contract position based in India. Specific compensation details and contract duration were not provided in the original job description.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

data.title: T24 Senior Test Analyst (Perm)
data.description:
As a T24 Senior Test Analyst, you will manage testing deliverables for Temenos Core Banking systems. You will lead test planning, create functional and non‐functional test cases, define automation strategies, and ensure quality delivery across SIT, UAT, and BAU support. 

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Test Planning & Execution

- Manage T24 testing team deliverables and track schedules to meet project timelines. 
 - Create functional and non‐functional test cases based on designs from analysts and developers. 
 - Prepare test data, execute test cases, and report progress with recovery planning if delays occur. 
 - Identify, log, track, and report defects, clarifying issues with analysts and developers. 
 - Define automation and performance test strategies. 
 - Support user acceptance testing (UAT). 
 - Provide BAU support for branches including troubleshooting and QA. 

Collaboration & Governance

- Liaise with IT and business partners to ensure test coverage. 
 - Collaborate across teams to align testing with project objectives. 
 - Ensure timely communication of progress, risks, and issues. 

We'd Love to Hear From You If. . . 

Experience

- You have 4-6+ years of experience testing Temenos Core Banking (T24). 
 - You have knowledge of T24 retail/corporate banking modules including Accounts, Funds Transfer, Teller, FX, Money Market, Loans and Deposits, SWIFT, reporting, Letters of Credit, General Ledger, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Miscellaneous Deals, and Non‐Stop modules. 
 - You have team management experience. 
 - You have experience in full SDLC (advantageous). 
 - You have experience testing in MUFG or other financial institutions (advantageous). 

Technical Expertise

- You have a bachelor's degree in Computing or a relevant field (e. g. , B. Tech, B. E, MCA). 
 - You have proven skills in developing automation strategies, frameworks, and scripts using Selenium or Playwright. 
 - You have experience with DevOps and defect management tools such as JIRA and Azure DevOps. 
 - You have experience using AI technologies (e. g. , Copilot). 
 - You have Unix/Linux knowledge. 

Ways of Working

- You are proactive, motivated, and results‐driven with strong accountability. 
 - You work effectively under pressure and meet challenging deadlines. 
 - You have strong logic, math, algorithmic, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - You demonstrate independence, teamwork, and urgency in prioritising work. 
 - You have excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. 
 - You have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and accuracy. 
 - You understand controls in a banking environment. 

---

Who We Are

Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan-Asian presence. We focus primarily around technology-driven consulting, adoption of value-added bespoke solutions, enabling enhanced decision support through data analytics, and embracing possibilities in the cloud. We are heavily inclined towards building capabilities collaboratively with clients and believe strongly in improving grounded and practical outcomes. 

This approach is possible through our partnership with leading global technology providers and internal R&D teams. Our clients come from Financial Services, Banking, Telco, Government, Healthcare, and Consumer-oriented organisations.

data.title: Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer based in India. 

Join an innovative cloud security engineering environment where you will help validate and strengthen the security of modern cloud infrastructure and runtime environments. In this role, you will design automated testing frameworks and ensure that advanced security features perform reliably across major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will work with Python, eBPF, Linux kernel technologies, containers, and Kubernetes to test security capabilities and identify complex technical issues. Collaborating closely with software and kernel engineers, you will investigate runtime behaviour, reproduce challenging issues, and improve the quality and reliability of security solutions. You will also contribute to continuous integration pipelines that enable faster, more consistent validation of new features. This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious engineer who enjoys automation, cloud-native technologies, and solving complex security challenges in a fast-evolving engineering environment. 

Accountabilities

- Cloud security validation: Design, implement, and maintain automated validation strategies for cloud security features and runtime protection capabilities. Ensure that security functionality performs as expected across different cloud environments and deployment configurations. 
 - Python test automation: Develop and maintain Python-based testing frameworks using tools such as pytest. Create reusable test cases, validate REST APIs, process JSON and YAML configurations, and automate repetitive validation tasks to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - eBPF and runtime observability testing: Build and maintain test hooks and validation frameworks for eBPF-based capabilities. Work with kernel-level observability mechanisms to verify runtime security functionality and help ensure accurate detection of relevant system and application behaviour. 
 - Multi-cloud environment management: Configure, deploy, and test security sensors and agents across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Validate feature behaviour under different infrastructure configurations and investigate platform-specific issues. 
 - Linux kernel investigation: Collaborate with kernel engineers to reproduce, investigate, and debug runtime security issues. Analyse relevant Linux kernel behaviour, system calls, namespaces, and control groups to identify root causes and support effective fixes. 
 - Continuous integration and automated pipelines: Integrate automated security validation into CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Improve test execution reliability, provide timely feedback on code changes, and help detect regressions early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Container and Kubernetes testing: Validate security functionality across Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, pods, and related cloud-native environments. Investigate issues involving container isolation, runtime behaviour, and infrastructure configuration. 
 - Infrastructure automation and observability: Use tools such as Terraform to provision and manage test environments. Leverage monitoring and visualisation tools such as Grafana to support troubleshooting, test analysis, and performance investigation. 
 - Serverless container validation: Test security capabilities in serverless container environments, including AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run, ensuring consistent behaviour across different deployment models. 
 - Cross-functional engineering collaboration: Work closely with security, platform, and kernel engineering teams to understand technical requirements, improve test coverage, investigate defects, and strengthen the quality and reliability of cloud security features. 
 - Continuous improvement: Identify gaps in existing validation processes, improve test frameworks and automation practices, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of cloud security testing methodologies and engineering standards. 

Requirements

- Cloud engineering experience: Hands-on experience configuring and working with at least one major cloud platform, with practical familiarity across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The ability to deploy infrastructure, configure cloud services, and troubleshoot cloud-based environments is important. 
 - Python automation expertise: Strong Python programming and test automation skills, including experience with pytest, REST API testing, and structured data formats such as JSON and YAML. You should be able to develop maintainable automation frameworks and reusable validation components. 
 - Linux internals: Familiarity with Linux kernel concepts, including system calls, namespaces, control groups (cgroups), and kernel modules. The ability to investigate low-level system behaviour and troubleshoot runtime issues is highly valuable. 
 - eBPF knowledge: Experience with eBPF technologies and kernel-level observability is highly desirable. An understanding of how eBPF-based instrumentation operates and how to validate its behaviour will be a strong advantage. 
 - Containerisation and orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, and pods. You should understand containerised application environments and be comfortable testing security functionality across cloud-native deployments. 
 - Infrastructure as code and monitoring: Practical familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and Grafana for monitoring and visualisation. Experience creating repeatable test environments and analysing system behaviour is beneficial. 
 - CI/CD and test integration: Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable tools. Understanding test automation, regression detection, and pipeline reliability is important. 
 - Serverless technologies: Exposure to serverless container platforms such as AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run is an advantage, particularly when validating security behaviour across different execution environments. 
 - Analytical and debugging skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a structured approach to investigating complex technical issues. You should be able to reproduce failures, identify potential root causes, and collaborate with engineers to validate fixes. 
 - Communication and teamwork: Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams, explain technical findings clearly, document test results, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Engineering mindset: A proactive, quality-focused approach to software validation, with an interest in cloud security, runtime protection, automation, and emerging infrastructure technologies. 

Benefits

- Full-time employment opportunity based in India. 
 - Opportunity to work on advanced cloud security and runtime protection technologies. 
 - Exposure to major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern technologies such as Python, eBPF, Linux kernel internals, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Opportunity to collaborate with experienced security, platform, and kernel engineers on complex technical challenges. 
 - Scope to influence automated testing frameworks, validation strategies, and the reliability of security products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native, containerised, and serverless infrastructure environments. 
 - Opportunities to deepen technical expertise in cloud security engineering, runtime observability, and test automation. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). data.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Operator
data.description:
HiveWatch is a tech-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we're solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we're building. 

HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less "noise", we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe. 

The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our App Experience team. You'll design, build, and ship AI-powered features in the intelligence layer of our platform: the agents that triage alarms, assess incidents, and recommend or take action the way an experienced security operator would. That means composing frontier models (language, vision, audio) with our own data, tooling, and retrieval into production-grade agent workflows, and working across the full stack to do it, from model orchestration in our Kotlin / Spring Boot / Python services to the React/TypeScript surfaces where operators see and act on the results. 

You'll own the evaluation loop for what you build. You'll define what "correct" means for an agent decision, build the eval sets and harnesses to measure it, and use those results to drive changes to prompts, tools, and architecture. To get there, you'll dig into real customer data, including alarm streams, video, access control events, and operator actions, to form and test hypotheses about where agents get things right, where they drift from human judgment, and why. You'll build the guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and observability that let us trust agents with higher-stakes decisions over time, and that let customers understand why an agent did what it did. 

You'll prototype quickly to learn what works, then harden the winners into reliable, cost-aware features. You'll partner closely with our product team and in-house security operations experts to turn operator intuition into something an agent can act on and to find the next problem worth automating. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build agentic product features that assess security scenarios and make decisions human security operators make today, such as whether to triage, escalate, dismiss, or dispatch. 
 - Form hypotheses about our data, then validate them: query production datasets, analyze results, and turn findings into product and model decisions
 - Orchestrate calls to both self-hosted inference models and frontier models, including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, routing across models, and cost/latency tradeoffs
 - Ship end-to-end features: Python for LLM/inference orchestration and analysis, and our Kotlin / Spring Boot / GraphQL backend to integrate agent capabilities into the platform
 - Work with product, customers, and security operations experts to encode operator judgment into agent behavior
 - Reliably deliver features and services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and modern service delivery practices
 - Mentor junior engineers and drive technical decisions that influence the team's architecture and development practices
 - Support production systems through incident response, troubleshooting, and break-fix activities to maintain service reliability and customer trust
 - Participate in a 24/7 on call rotation approximately 1 week per month as needed. 

Our Tech Stack

- Languages: Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, and Rust

Description

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon. com. 

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to 'making zero happen' to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill "the 3 Zeros". We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. 

Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus. 

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements. 

We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. data.title: Technical Delivery Director – Salesforce
data.description:
Technical Delivery Director - Salesforce

About MirketaMirketa is a U. S. -headquartered digital transformation, technology consulting, and product engineering company with a delivery center in Noida, India. We specialize in Salesforce consulting and implementation, AI/GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, enterprise integration, and custom applications. We also build enterprise products for healthcare, AI-powered case resolution, revenue management, and nonprofit organizations. 

Position OverviewWe seek a technically accomplished Technical Delivery Director - Salesforce to own end-to-end Salesforce solutioning and technical execution across an assigned portfolio of enterprise engagements. The Director will lead Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams; own pre-sales technical proposals and estimates; and ensure solution quality, predictable delivery, and strong talent development. This is an engineering-led role, not merely project coordination. 

1. End-to-End Technical Solutioning, RFPs & Estimation·            Lead end-to-end technical solutioning from discovery through technical approval and project initiation, including requirements analysis, architecture, technology selection, integration design, build-versus-buy decisions, sizing, and implementation planning. 

·            Own technical responses to RFPs/RFIs, proposal architecture, solution diagrams, assumptions, resource and staffing plans, effort estimates, and implementation timelines. 

·            Lead business and technical discovery with clients, U. S. sales teams, Business Analysts, and solution architects; translate requirements into feasible Salesforce solution designs. 

·            Validate platform constraints, data architecture, security, integration complexity, nonfunctional requirements, risks, and delivery feasibility before commitments are made. 

·            Act as technical solution owner through pre-sales handover; ensure proposed solutions are scalable, commercially viable, and executable by the engineering team. 

·            Participate in technical workshops, client solution presentations, and proposal defenses; refine estimates using actual delivery benchmarks. 

2. End-to-End Salesforce Technical Delivery·            Own Salesforce technical execution across concurrent implementation, modernization, integration, and enhancement projects, from design and build through testing, deployment, and stabilization. 

·            Manage Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams, ensuring delivery against approved scope, effort budgets, timelines, and quality standards. 

·            Identify technical blockers and delivery risks early; lead recovery of troubled projects, complex integrations, and critical platform issues. 

·            Coordinate with Program Delivery, PM/BA, QA, DevOps, and U. S. client stakeholders on dependencies, releases, and acceptance. 

3. Portfolio Governance & Project Reviews·            Run weekly technical portfolio reviews covering milestone status, estimate-to-actual variance, remaining effort, staffing, defects, dependencies, and risks. 

·            Own technical forecasts and corrective actions; ensure Technology Managers maintain credible engineering plans and proactively escalate threats to delivery. 

·            Provide clear portfolio reporting to the VP Engineering & Technical Delivery and collaborate with Program Delivery on project controls and change management. 

4. Salesforce Architecture & Quality·            Own architecture quality and standards, reviewing data models, security/sharing, scalability, governor limits, integrations, platform performance, and design tradeoffs. 

·            Guide appropriate choices between configuration and customization; ensure Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, event-driven and asynchronous patterns are fit for purpose. 

·            Enforce peer reviews, unit and regression testing, CI/CD, source control, environment management, and release quality gates. 

·            Lead defect root-cause reviews, reduce rework and technical debt, and promote reusable architecture patterns and engineering accelerators. 

·            Provide technical judgment on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and, where relevant, Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce. 

5. Delivery Economics & Resource Planning·            Own engineering effort budgets, estimates, delivery efficiency, utilization, capacity plans, and staffing for assigned projects. 

·            Work with Finance and Program Delivery to monitor margin performance, effort variance, productivity, and corrective measures. 

·            Forecast demand for Salesforce skills and align technical staffing to pipeline and delivery commitments. 

6. Hiring, Leadership & Culture·            Own technical hiring requirements and assessments across junior, mid-level, senior, and leadership positions; personally interview Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and senior Salesforce engineers. 

·            Partner with HR on sourcing, competency models, technical assessments, onboarding, career paths, development plans, and employee retention. 

·            Mentor technical managers and leads; establish regular coaching, meaningful 1: 1s, performance feedback, succession plans, and collaborative engineering practices. 

·            Build a high-performing, accountable culture with strong technical ownership, merit-based recognition, continuous learning, and innovation. 

7. Salesforce Capability Development & Innovation·            Establish domain-specific architecture patterns, reference solutions, internal training, certification priorities, and reusable implementation assets. 

·            Develop capabilities in Agentforce and Salesforce AI, AI-assisted development and testing, and integrations with Python, AI services, cloud, and data platforms. 

·            Collaborate with AI/Data and Cloud Technical Delivery Directors on cross-technology solutions. 

8. Client Engagement & Escalations·            Serve as senior technical counterpart for Salesforce clients, clearly presenting architecture tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recovery plans. 

·            Own critical technical escalations and contribute to client trust, delivery acceptance, and account growth. 

Required Qualifications·            12-16+ years in enterprise software engineering and technical delivery, including significant hands-on Salesforce development and solution architecture.

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

data.title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
data.description:
Description

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions - interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that. 

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights. 

This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
 - You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
 - You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
 - Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
 - Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
 - Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
 - Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
 - Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
 - Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
 - Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
 - Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

A day in the life

You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries. 

About The Team

DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely. 

We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.title: Senior/Staff Deep Learning Compiler Engineer
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

Quadric is building the world's first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a Deep Learning Compiler Engineer, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads. 

What You'll Do

Deep Learning Compiler Infrastructure & Optimization

- Design, implement, and maintain compiler optimization passes targeting Quadric's processor architecture using frameworks like MLIR, Apache TVM, or LLVM. 
 - Develop lowering pathways from high-level machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) down to optimized low-level kernel code. 
 - Optimize neural network performance for memory throughput, latency, compute unit utilization, and power consumption. 

Neural Network Model Parsing & Graph Transformation

- Implement graph-level optimizations, including operator fusion, layout transformation, quantization (INT8/FP16), and memory allocation strategies. 
 - Analyze novel deep learning model topologies (Transformers, CNNs, Vision-Language Models) and extend compiler support for new operators and primitives. 
 - Benchmark and profile end-to-end model performance to identify and resolve compiler bottlenecks. 

Hardware-Software Co-Design

- Collaborate closely with hardware and micro-architecture teams to define instruction set extensions, hardware acceleration features, and compiler requirements. 
 - Develop software simulators, functional models, and test benches to validate compiler correctness and generated binary performance. 
 - Participate in hardware bring-up and validation efforts on FPGA and ASIC platforms. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll:

data.title: Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

Quadric is building a revolutionary new processor-based SoC architecture. As a Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer, you will join the ground floor of our chip design team, taking technical leadership in architecting and building our SoC-level verification environment from scratch. You will collaborate closely with architects, hardware engineers, and software teams to ensure high quality and complete verification coverage for our next-generation GPNPU-based SoCs. 

What You'll Do

Testbench Architecture & Test Plan Development

- Architect and build novel, scratch-built testbenches for SoC-level verification of our GPNPU-based SoCs. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architects, HW designers, and SW teams to document comprehensive verification test plans. 
 - Implement scalable testbenches using commercial Verification IP (VIP) and/or internal software utilities. 

Test Execution & Verification Coverage

- Develop directed and random drivers, as well as assembly or C++ programs, to efficiently stress-test SoC subsystems and integration. 
 - Verify complex SoC subsystems, including 3rd-party IP (e. g. , NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR). 
 - Leverage VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation environments alongside assembly programming and Python scripting to execute test suites. 
 - Track, analyze, and communicate verification progress across teams using functional and code coverage metrics. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll: 

- Build out and deploy a fully functional, scratch-built SoC-level UVM verification environment. 
 - Achieve target coverage metrics across all critical SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP blocks. 
 - Establish robust co-simulation pipelines that validate HW/SW execution before tapeout. 

Required

What We're Looking For

- Minimum 5+ years of dedicated design verification experience on complex SoC/ASIC designs. 
 - Deep expertise in UVM methodology and leading SoC-level verification practices. 
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog or Verilog, assembly programming, and scripting languages like Python. 
 - Hands-on experience verifying SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP (e. g. , NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR). 
 - Strong computer architecture background with experience in VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation.
