data.title: Lead Engineer - Process & Operability Engineering
data.description:
Overall target of the position : The Process & Controls Engineer has the responsibility of the on-time delivery of the Project Process engineering documentation according to the valid Work Instructions and Technical Rules, with respect to the Project and contractual requirements, and Company Plant EHS Policy, with technical support from the Process Lead Engineer and Experts. 

Delivering Steam Turbine & Generator Auxiliaries systems in compliance with the Company Rules and Policy, Project, Regulations, Codes and Standards, Contract and Country requirements. 

Tasks & Responsibilities

- Reviews the technical contractual requirements and analyze the rules, codes and standards applicable to Process & Controls engineering. 
 - Identifies the contractual Risks and Opportunities and propose technical deviations and clarifications. 
 - Determines applicability of the project contractual requirements on process & controls engineering scope and ensures the allocation of requirements to document for his/her scope of work in the documents management tool, 
 - Executes (with the other Process & Control engineers of his/her project team and supported by the Lead Engineer Process & controls and by experts) the following Process & Controls engineering activities: 
 - 
 - The Process (mechanical) systems design including: 
 - Process Flow Diagrams, 
 - The P&IDs, 
 - The System Design Manuals including the controls logic diagrams, Electrical and I&C interfaces, 
 - The process electrical load list (list of electrical consumers with process engineering data only), 
 - 
 - The piping interfaces list, 
 - The functional safety studies: HAZOP, safety functions (SIL) requirements, excluding Safety Requirements Specification, SIL verification reports, 
 - Identification of Nuclear Safety Classified Items/Components and Activities in line with Equipment qualification team and supported by the Nuclear Safety Process Engineer, 
 - Input data for fatigue analysis, per system, 
 - The Reliability Availability and Maintainability (RAM) studies. 
 - Provides input for the preparation of the MTS and EDM, 
 - Is responsible for Design control and Design freeze process for his/her scope, complying with applicable configuration management procedures, 
 - Analyses Customer comments and Technical Queries and prepare related answers, 
 - Ensures technical check for process engineering deliverables done by other process engineer(s) to maximize the quality level, 
 - Contributes to the Plant Operation and Control Concept, 
 - Prepares and manage mechanical and functional interfaces with internal participants (product lines, mechanical packages) and external parties (customer, general designer, partner, supplier) and take actions if necessary (MCL), 
 - Supplies and reviews of Process Operating and Design Data for circuits in EDB, 
 - Participates in design and/or technical reviews (internal/external) and prepares the associated reports, 
 - Participates in various coordination meetings (liaison, conciliation, workshops, etc. . . ) with customer/general designer/partner. 
 - Ensures that the arrangement and the piping routing correspond to the process requirements, 
 - Coordinates and provides the Process & Controls documentations "as built" revisions and collect the REX from site. 
 - Participates in control system FAT (test preparation, tests and subsequent actions after tests). 
 - Ensures timely responses on Process & Controls issues raised internally by other engineering disciplines. 
 - Supports the site Construction and Commissioning staff through troubleshooting, claim management supporting, Close-Out punch lists to obtain PAC and FAC with the Customers, review major software and mechanical modifications (eg FSI preparation). 
 - Contributes Operating Instructions, 
 - Prepares reply of Non Conformance Reports (NCR) and take the necessary actions, 
 - Ensures the feedback of experience from the project via the Lead Engineer, 
 - Provides information to prepare the engineering progress upon request by Lead Engineer, 
 - Reports to the Lead Engineer Process the status of the assigned tasks. 

Qualification Profile

Education and Experience: 

- Bachelor degree in Mechanical or Instrumentation and control engineering or equivalent degree, 
 - At least 10 years professional experience in Process & Control Engineering within Power Plant Engineering, 
 - Site experience (3 months preferable), 

Specific Knowledge And Skills

- Engineering in his/her technical field and with interface clarification beyond his/her field, 
 - Good knowledge in other disciplines (i. e. products specifications, layout & arrangement, electrical design) involved in Power Plant engineering, 
 - Detailed knowledge of power plant water/steam cycles and/or ST auxiliary systems and/or generator auxiliary systems and, 
 - Basic knowledge of Company's products: Steam Turbine, Generator, Heat exchangers and Pumps, 
 - Computer familiarity (Word, Excel, Outlook, Pdf editor, . . . . . ), 
 - Knowledge about CAD tools: Autocad, Visio, Naviswork, etc. . . 
 - Fluent in English (good standard in reading, written and spoken is mandatory), 
 - Strong technical and scientific know-how and willingness to continuously extend and develop it, 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills, enjoys personal contact

The Power Platform & Copilot Developer leads the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise AI chatbot and low‐code solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft Power Platform to support LCS strategic business use cases. This role serves as a technical and functional lead, providing architectural guidance, governance oversight, and mentorship while ensuring measurable business outcomes from AI investments. 

The role partners closely with business leaders, AI governance teams, and platform stakeholders to establish a scalable, governed low‐code AI operating model, build Copilot Studio subject‐matter expertise (SME), and drive adoption across LCS.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end‐to‐end architecture, design, and delivery of Copilot Studio solutions and AI chatbots
 - Define conversational AI patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption
 - Review and approve solution designs to ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability
 - Drive continuous improvement of AI agents based on usage analytics, feedback, and business outcomes

Power Platform Solution Architecture

- Lead development of complex Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse solutions supporting Copilot use cases
 - Establish best practices for low‐code / pro‐code extensibility, integrations, and APIs

 - Experience with governance, security, and compliance in regulated enterprise environments
 - Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder‐management skills

- Microsoft certifications (Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI)

 - Experience defining and tracking KPIs, ROI, and adoption metrics for AI solutions

data.title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
As a Principal Data Platform Engineer at RWS, you will be the most senior technical authority on our data platform. You will architect and implement a scalable Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data platform, setting the engineering standards, patterns and guardrails that the wider Data Engineering team builds on. This is a hands-on role: you will write the Terraform, the pipelines and the automation that make the platform repeatable, secure and cost-effective at scale. 

You'll own the platform end to end - from infrastructure as code and CI/CD through to the data pipelines running on top of it - and you'll push the boundaries of how we deliver, including leveraging AI agents to scale up pipeline delivery. Your work will directly enable our Analytics and AI teams to build the future of global language services. If you enjoy designing systems that other engineers depend on, you'll find a home here. 

About Product & Technology

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. Additionally, we oversee the development and maintenance of core applications essential for the seamless operation of various functions across the organization. We are committed to driving and executing future roadmaps that are in line with the overall strategic direction of RWS. 

With a global reach, Product & Technology provides support services to over 7500 end users worldwide. We take pride in managing the information security operation and safeguarding all our assets. Our core functions encompass Enterprise & Technical Architecture, Network & Voice, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Service Operations, Data & Analytics, Security & Quality Compliance, Transformation, Application Development, Enterprise Platforms, With a dedicated team of over 500 staff, Product & Technology ensures a strong presence across all regions, enabling efficient and effective support to our global operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Job Overview

- Architect the GCP Data Platform: You'll design and implement a scalable, secure GCP data platform that serves as the foundation for analytics and AI across RWS. 
 - Build Infrastructure as Code: You'll create a reusable, modular Terraform codebase so that provisioning new environments and data products is fast and repeatable. 
 - Automate Delivery: You'll implement CI/CD pipelines that give us automated, controlled and auditable deployments of both infrastructure and data code. 
 - Engineer Data Pipelines: You'll design and build pipelines using native GCP services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Cloud Composer and Knowledge Catalog. 
 - Scale Delivery with AI: You'll leverage AI agents and automation to accelerate pipeline delivery and raise the throughput of the wider engineering team. 

Skills & Experience

- Infrastructure Automation: Expert-level Terraform, with GitHub Actions or similar for automated build and deployment. 
 - Expert Cloud Architecture: Deep, predominantly GCP experience - BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Cloud Composer and Pub/Sub. 
 - Cloud Security and Networking: Strong working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, VPC design and firewall configuration. 
 - Software Engineering: Strong programming skills in Python, and experience with Java or Scala. 
 - Data Engineering at Scale: Solid ELT/ETL design experience and hands-on work with Apache Spark. 

Bonus points if you have: 

- Multi-Cloud Exposure: Experience with Azure alongside GCP. 
 - Container Orchestration: Experience packaging and deploying workloads with Helm and Kubernetes. 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering: Practical experience using AI agents or copilots to accelerate engineering delivery. 
 - Data Products: Knowledge or experience of implementing data products and data mesh principles. 

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood , then you'll love life at RWS. 

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

We are seeking an experienced and technically influential  Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Cloud Tooling and Pipelines team. This pivotal team is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our core Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (leveraging Spinnaker and custom tooling), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) execution engines (primarily Terraform), and a suite of supporting microservices. These systems are critical for enabling and managing our extensive resource footprint across AWS ECS and EKS. 

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a key contributor, driving the implementation of scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. Your deep expertise in software engineering principles and cloud-native development will be essential in building and enhancing our critical tooling for infrastructure provisioning, vulnerability management, and IaC deployments. You will also play a vital role in mentoring other engineers and influencing the team's technical roadmap. If you have a strong passion for building robust software systems that empower operational efficiency at scale, we encourage you to apply. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Design and Develop Core Platform Components: Lead the design and development of scalable and reliable microservices and tools that form the backbone of Okta's Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (including components for Spinnaker, Terraform, and custom tooling). 
 - Build Infrastructure as Code Automation: Develop sophisticated software solutions and APIs that empower engineering teams to provision and manage infrastructure, execute production changes, and deploy code with high reliability and efficiency. 
 - Architect and Implement Deployment Workflows: Contribute to the architectural design and hands-on implementation of robust CD pipelines and Terraform-based IaC workflows, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security for application deployments. 
 - Develop High-Quality Automation Software: Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code (primarily in Java, Python, or Go) for microservices with a strong focus on automation, operational excellence, and self-service capabilities.

 - Champion Software Engineering Best Practices: Advocate for and implement industry best practices in software design, development, testing, and deployment to ensure the highest quality and maintainability of our tooling. 
 - Integrate Security by Design: Apply and promote security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle of our tooling and infrastructure automation to ensure a secure and compliant operational environment. 
 - Enable Self-Service Capabilities: Proactively identify opportunities to build self-service automation for infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, and other operational tasks, reducing manual effort and improving developer velocity and onboarding.

 - 4+ years of professional experience in Software Development, with a strong focus on developing and maintaining automation tools, platforms, or microservices for cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or similar). 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience in Java, Go, Python, or similar backend languages, specifically building scalable and reliable platform components, tooling or automation. 
 - Experience working on backend microservices stack and distributed services is a nice-to-have. Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and practical experience with tools such as Terraform. 
 - Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) platform development, including familiarity with tools like Spinnaker or similar. 
 - Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and ECS, from a software development perspective. 
 - Proficient in using Docker and experienced with building applications that interact with underlying Linux and networking fundamentals. 
 - Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, etc. ) in the context of application development and operational management. 
 - A strong passion for solving complex operational challenges through innovative software solutions and automation. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills within a software development context. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

data.description:
What you'll do

- Own the cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform that hosts services end-to-end - provision, upgrade, and operate multi-cloud (AWS + Azure) clusters. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code - Helm charts, ARM/CloudFormation templates, cloud-init, and Python automation for cluster creation, CNI, node scaling, machine health checks, and workload identity. 
 - Bake and harden machine images using Packer + Ansible for Linux and Windows, validate them with automated image tests (goss), and manage the container image supply chain. 
 - Run observability and alerting - Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk (OTel collectors, saved searches/alerts)
 - Lead production support and on-call - triage incidents, perform RCA, remediate issues and manage node/pod health, capacity, and autoscaling. 
 - Design and operate CI/CD and release pipelines using Jenkins and deployment pipelines. 
 - Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot platform services - Spring Boot services, node agents, and containerised engine workloads - across Kubernetes and clouds. 
 - Optimize scalability, cost, and security - right-size clusters, tune autoscaling/workload placement, enforce network policies and admission control. 
 - Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code. 
 - Participate in code/infra reviews, cross-functional collaboration, and mentor junior engineers.

- 6-8 years in software/platform engineering with strong DevOps / SRE / infrastructure focus and end-to-end production ownership. 
 - Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience - Cluster API / kubeadm, Helm, networking/CNI (Calico), autoscaling, and Linux/Windows node/container workloads. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS and/or Azure experience across compute, storage, networking, identity/IAM, and managed services; multi-cloud is a strong plus. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code and automation proficiency - Helm, ARM/CloudFormation/Terraform, Packer + Ansible + Python
 - Proven production-operations experience - monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk/OTel, with on-call ownership. 
 - CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions, including staged releases, rollbacks, and change management. 
 - Database operations experience across relational/NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL/SQL Server, Cosmos DB/DynamoDB/MongoDB, and Redis. 
 - Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code. 
 - Application and platform security fundamentals - OWASP, Vault/CyberArk, IAM/least-privilege, network policy, OAuth2/OIDC/SAML. 
 - Messaging/micro-services familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/Service Bus, and event-driven operations. 
 - Git proficiency, Agile/Scrum experience, excellent communication, and cross-functional/cross-time-zone collaboration.

Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role. 

Responsibilities

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues. 
 - Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards. 
 - Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc. 
 - Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed. 
 - Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L. 
 - Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy. 
 - Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted. 
 - Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
 - The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. 
 - The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage. 
 - The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite. 
 - The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working. 
 - Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice. 
 - Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution. 

Establishment and growth of GCC

- Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC
 - Contribute to the design of operational processes, systems and measures
 - Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
 - Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity. 
 - Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
 - Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe. 
 - Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below. 
 - Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

Technical and Project Management

- Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
 - Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
 - Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
 - Promote technical excellence in all our projects
 - Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
 - Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

Commercial

- Implement the project delivery systems and structures
 - Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
 - Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
 - Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

Qualifications

- The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record. 
 - The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services. 
 - Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration. 
 - Maintain product quality and cultural integrity. 
 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today.

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

data.title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
data.description:
Job Description

Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations

Summary/Objective

The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U. S. -based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization. 

Core Job Duties

- Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines. 
 - Conduct 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team. 
 - Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization. 
 - Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively. 
 - Partner with U. S. -based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones. 
 - Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U. S. data and integrations teams. 
 - Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems. 
 - Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards. 
 - Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution. 
 - Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch. 
 - Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect. 
 - Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e. g. , Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards. 
 - Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e. g. , Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers. 
 - Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns. 
 - Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions. 
 - Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work. 
 - Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U. S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones. 
 - Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U. S. counterparts as needed. 
 - Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U. S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity. 

Job Complexity

Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities. 

Interaction

Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U. S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U. S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones. 

Supervision

Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently. 

Experience

Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work. 
 - 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U. S. -based counterparts across time zones. 
 - Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e. g. , Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato). 
 - Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work. 
 - Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e. g. , Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e. g. , Great Expectations, dbt tests). 
 - Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration. 
 - Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e. g. , Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require. 
 - Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization. 
 - Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution. 
 - Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations. 
 - Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic. 
 - Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: 
 - Direct hands-on experience with Workato
 - Experience with Parabola. io or comparable low-code automation tools
 - Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e. g. , Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
 - Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
 - Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
 - Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model
Position Details

Physical Demands: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 

Travel Required: Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U. S. for team and stakeholder alignment. 

Work Authorization: Employee must be legally authorized to work in India. 

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Location: India (Hybrid/Remote)

data.description:
We're Hiring | Technical Lead - UPI & NPCI Integrations

Location: Gurugram | Hybrid
 Experience: 8-12+ years

Build. Integrate. Launch. Lead the next phase of digital payments. 

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead - UPI & NPCI Integrations to anchor the end-to-end technology development of a UPI-enabled fintech application, including sponsor bank integration, NPCI onboarding, testing, certification and production launch. 

This is an ownership-driven role for someone who understands the UPI ecosystem and can translate business requirements into a secure, scalable and production-ready platform. 

Key Responsibilities

- UPI Application Development: Lead the architecture and development of the mobile application, backend services and supporting payment infrastructure. 
- NPCI & Sponsor Bank Integration: Drive technical integration with the sponsor PSP bank and relevant ecosystem partners, including onboarding, certification, testing and go-live readiness. 
- Solution Architecture: Design APIs, transaction workflows, payment processing, reconciliation, transaction-status handling, reversals and exception management. 
- Security & Reliability: Ensure robust application security, encryption, access controls, audit trails, monitoring, scalability and high availability. 
- Technology Delivery: Lead internal developers and external technology partners, manage delivery milestones, resolve technical dependencies and drive execution through launch. 
- Production Readiness: Oversee integration, performance and security testing, operational readiness, deployment and post-launch stabilisation. 
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with business, product, compliance, operations, banks and technology partners. 

What We're Looking For

- 8-12+ years of experience in software engineering, fintech, digital payments or banking technology. 
- Demonstrated hands-on experience in UPI integration, preferably taking a solution from sponsor bank engagement and technical integration through certification and production launch. 
- Strong understanding of UPI transaction flows, payment APIs, reconciliation, reversals, transaction failures and exception handling. 
- Experience building secure, scalable backend systems and integrating mobile applications with payment infrastructure. 
- Proficiency in relevant backend technologies, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, DevOps and application security. 
- Proven ability to work with banks, payment partners, technology vendors and cross-functional teams. 
- Strong ownership mindset, technical judgement and execution capabilities. 

Priority will be given to candidates who have personally led a UPI integration or launch. Experience limited to general app development, without hands-on payment ecosystem integration, may not be sufficient. 

Why This Opportunity?

- Own a strategic fintech technology initiative from architecture to production. 
- Work directly with business leadership and ecosystem partners. 
- Shape a secure, scalable UPI-enabled customer-facing platform. 
- Take meaningful technical ownership in a high-impact digital payments initiative.

data.description:
Overview

Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) is seeking a senior Engineering Manager to lead the development of intelligent automation solutions for Payments Operations and Client Servicing. The successful candidate will combine proven engineering management experience with hands-on technical expertise and a track record of building and deploying enterprise-scale automation solutions into production. This individual will lead engineers, influence technical direction, and actively participate in architecture and implementation decisions while delivering scalable solutions leveraging Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, document intelligence, workflow orchestration, and cloud-native technologies. 

This role requires a leader who can operate effectively at both strategic and technical levels, partnering closely with Payments Operations, Product, and Technology teams to identify automation opportunities and translate business needs into scalable software solutions. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated history of leading high-performing engineering teams, delivering distributed systems using modern Java technologies, and applying AI capabilities to solve complex operational challenges in large-scale enterprise environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for delivering intelligent automation solutions for Payments Operations and Client Servicing. 
 - Own end-to-end engineering delivery, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and operational excellence. 
 - Define and execute the engineering roadmap for AI-enabled workflow automation solutions aligned with Payments Technology objectives and business priorities. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership by actively participating in architecture reviews, solution design, technology selection, engineering reviews, and key technical decisions. 
 - Design, build, and deliver scalable software solutions leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, document intelligence, workflow orchestration, and automation technologies. 
 - Partner closely with Payments Operations, Product, Architecture, and Technology teams to identify high-value automation opportunities and translate business requirements into scalable engineering solutions. 
 - Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including cloud-native architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and platform engineering principles. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards for quality, scalability, resiliency, observability, security, maintainability, and operational excellence. 
 - Ensure all solutions comply with enterprise technology standards, AI governance requirements, regulatory expectations, cybersecurity controls, and risk management policies. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and technical excellence through mentoring, talent development, performance management, and hiring. 

Required Qualifications

- 15+ years of software engineering experience delivering large-scale enterprise applications, platforms, and distributed systems. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams, including management of globally distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, intelligent automation, workflow automation, or document intelligence solutions into production environments with measurable business impact. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams while remaining actively engaged in architecture, technical design, software delivery, and engineering execution. 
 - Deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, API development, and distributed systems design. 
 - Strong experience with event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and streaming technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native applications utilizing Kubernetes, OpenShift, containers, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Strong understanding of AI architecture patterns including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, AI agents, tool integration, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive engineering execution while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, security, compliance, and operational excellence. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with experience collaborating with senior business and technology leaders in highly regulated environments. 

Why Join Citi

Join a team shaping the future of global money movement and real-time payments. You'll have the opportunity to build cloud-native payment infrastructure at global scale, solve complex low-latency distributed systems challenges, influence the evolution of instant payments worldwide, and leverage AI-powered engineering capabilities to deliver the next generation of payment innovation.

data.title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished Application Dev Lead to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL), have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions. 

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Leadership & People Management

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms. 
 - Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization. 
 - Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs). 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals. 
 - SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery. 

Technical & Domain Responsibilities

- Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern). 
 - Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments. 
 - High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption. 
 - Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices. 
 - Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers. 
 - Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards. 
 - High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing. 

Recommended Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

- Java & Microservices: 
 - Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC). 
 - Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch). 
 - Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing). 
 - Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Database & Data Persistence: 
 - Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering. 
 - Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE). 
 - Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks). 
 - Enterprise Middleware & Messaging:

data.title: Principal Enterprise Architect
data.description:
Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI

Role Overview

Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren't a traditional gatekeeper-you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale. 

This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity. 

As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly. 

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization

- Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems. 
 - Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling. 
 - Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance. 
 - Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e. g. , self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting). 
 - Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources. 
 - Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities. 

Data & AI Infrastructure

- Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads. 
 - Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost. 
 - Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases. 
 - Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems. 

Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture

- Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution. 
 - Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns. 
 - Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions. 

GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy

- You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle. 
 - You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization. 
 - Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability. 

Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership

- Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape. 
 - Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams. 
 - Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence. 
 - Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health. 
 - Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes. 

Who You Are

- Strategic Visionary-you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps. 
 - Ultra-technical-you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach. 
 - System-First Thinker-you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision. 
 - Cloud-Native Expert-you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance. 
 - Pragmatic Decision Maker-your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed. 
 - Builder's Mentality-you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption. 
 - Growth-Oriented Mentor-you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy. 

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms. 
 - Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e. g. , EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus. 
 - Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution-understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies. 
 - Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems. 
 - Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker). 
 - Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin). 
 - Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards. 
 - Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures. 
 - Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms. 
 - Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies. 

Why Join Us?

- Impact at scale-we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges. 
 - Modern technical foundation with room to innovate-leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges. 
 - Hands-on architecture leadership-you won't be stuck in meetings; you'll drive execution. 
 - Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts, pushing the limits of what's possible. 
 - Competitive compensation and high ownership-your work will define how Jumio scales. 

Jumio Values: 

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

Equal Opportunities: 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. 

About Jumio: 

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we're expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others. 

Applicant Data Privacy

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio's application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio's Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio. com.

Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) is seeking a highly experienced and hands-on engineering leader to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of our next-generation Global Instant Payments Platform. 

This role is ideal for an accomplished software engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, remains actively involved in architecture and technical design, and wants to build the future of real-time payment infrastructure at global scale. The successful candidate will combine deep payments expertise, low-latency Java engineering, cloud-native architecture, and strong delivery leadership to build resilient, high-performance payment solutions supporting Citi's global clients. The role requires close collaboration with Product, Operations, Infrastructure, Risk, and Engineering teams globally to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure instant payment capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Citi's next-generation Instant Payments platform, providing hands-on technical leadership across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Design and develop high-performance payment services using Java, distributed systems principles, and event-driven architectures to support low-latency, real-time transaction processing at global scale. 
 - Drive the modernization of payment platforms on AWS through cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, containerization, and automated infrastructure practices. 
 - Build and evolve payment capabilities supporting RTP, FedNow, UPI, SEPA Instant, and emerging real-time payment networks across multiple markets and regulatory jurisdictions. 
 - Architect highly resilient and scalable systems capable of processing millions of transactions daily with demanding requirements for latency, availability, security, and operational resilience. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers while remaining actively engaged in technical design reviews, architecture decisions, code quality, and resolution of complex engineering challenges. 
 - Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, and business stakeholders to translate client and market requirements into innovative payment capabilities and platform enhancements. 
 - Build and enhance core payment platform services including payment orchestration, liquidity management, reconciliation, settlement processing, transaction monitoring, exception management, and recovery capabilities.

 - Leverage AI-enabled software engineering tools throughout the SDLC to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing effectiveness, platform reliability, and delivery velocity. 

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience building large-scale payment processing, transaction processing, or financial technology platforms. 
 - Expert-level Java development experience with deep understanding of concurrency, JVM performance tuning, asynchronous processing, low-latency application design, and distributed systems engineering. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering high-throughput, mission-critical systems operating at enterprise scale.

You'll have the opportunity to build cloud-native payment infrastructure at global scale, solve complex low-latency distributed systems challenges, influence the evolution of instant payments worldwide, and leverage AI-powered engineering capabilities to deliver the next generation of payment innovation.

data.description:
Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs. 

Qualifications

- Should be a Graduate from a recognized University
