data.title: Software Development Manager, Alexa Shopping - Core
data.description:
Description

The Alexa Shopping team in Bangalore is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead engineering efforts in building AI-powered shopping experiences that help millions of customers save time and money every day. 

You will lead a team that leverages Generative AI to build features that anticipate what customers need before they ask, help them evaluate products with confidence, and unify Alexa Shopping and Rufus customer communication across Echo devices, Alexa App, and Alexa. com. Your work will directly impact executive-level goals and shape how hundreds of millions of customers shop worldwide. 

We operate in a high-performance, co-located agile ecosystem where SDEs, SDMs, and Product Managers frequently connect with end customers. Our engineering team significantly influences the product roadmap, contributes to PRFAQs, and creates disproportionate impact through innovative technology. We operate like a start-up within the Amazon ecosystem, pioneering products and services that are new to Amazon with opportunities to scale globally. 

Our roadmap through 2027 is well defined, and the problems ahead are real: new device endpoints, additional channels, and higher customer expectations. If you want to lead a team whose work customers rely on every single day, this is the role. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and grow a software development team, setting technical direction and establishing team structure to deliver on a multi-year roadmap for the Post-Purchase experience across Alexa endpoints and channels. 
 - Define and drive the architecture for distributed, low-latency services at massive scale that power real-time tracking, proactive notifications, and post-delivery experiences for millions of customers. 
 - Partner with product management, applied science, and peer engineering teams to prioritize features, resolve cross-team dependencies, and ship cohesive solutions that reduce friction in the post-purchase journey. 
 - Establish operational metrics and quality mechanisms to measure customer experience, system health, and team delivery velocity, using data to inform roadmap tradeoffs and continuous improvement. 
 - Coach and develop engineers across multiple levels, creating growth plans, providing actionable feedback, and building an inclusive team culture where people do their best work. 

About The Team

Our team is building the unified proactive communication layer for Alexa Shopping, ensuring every customer experiences one coordinated, trusted conversation with Alexa across Echo devices, mobile, email, and emerging endpoints. We own the orchestration that determines what reaches the customer, when, and on which surface. Our team values deep customer empathy, technical ambition, and cross-org collaboration. We are looking for builders who want to define the future of proactive, agentic commerce at Amazon. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
 - 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
 - Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science
 - 3+ years of distributed system management experience
 - Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
 - Experience in developing and executing an analytic vision to solve business-relevant problems
 - Deep hands-on technical expertise

data.title: Sr Network DevOps Engineer - Operations
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics. 
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design. 
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale. 
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments. 
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers. 
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues. 

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure. 
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash. 
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico. 
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia). 
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes. 
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment. 
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization. 

Qualifications & Skills

- 5+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC). 
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM). 
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico. 
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale. 
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet). 
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS). 
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing. 
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays. 
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes. 
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics. 
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives. 
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous. 
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture. 

Diversity & Inclusion

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

data.description:
Role Title : AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering. 

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

For Internal Applicants

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
 - Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
 - Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
 - Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal )
 - L09+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible. 
 - L09+ Employees can apply

Role Title : AVP, Principal Software Engineer (L11)

Company Overview : Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry's most complete digitally enabled product suites. We were among the Top 50 India's Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW.  - We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles. 

Organizational Overview

This role sits within Synchrony's Front-End Engineering organization, which builds and maintains the web applications that power digital experiences for over 60 million customers and hundreds of brand partners. Our teams are focused on delivering seamless, accessible, and high-performance user experiences at scale - from consumer-facing product interfaces to partner integration portals. As AI dissolves the traditional boundaries between front-end, back-end, and platform engineering, this organization is evolving beyond its front-end anchor. Engineers increasingly work fluidly across the full stack, leveraging AI-assisted development and agentic workflows to deliver end-to-end solutions. This Tech Lead will help drive that evolution within their team while keeping user experience excellence at the center of everything we build. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Billions of transactions-and you'll touch all of them if you join our IT team as a Principal Front-End Engineer. Imagine the sheer scale of what we impact every second of every day. Now imagine what you can do with that influence-this is where you can shape the future of payments. 

Responsibilities

You'll work within multi-disciplinary teams to deliver on business goals. This person will be responsible for both the development of new features and the overall success of deliveries including analysis and design, development, deployment, optimization, and day to day operations. The role can be broken down into the following key aspects: 

- Communicator: You act as a translator between business stakeholders and your engineering team, ensuring no miscommunications. 
 - Coach: You are a mentor to your engineering team, taking every opportunity to up-skill our developers-including on AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Quality control: You have battle-tested JavaScript knowledge and can dive deep into the code-whether human-written or AI-generated-to provide thoughtful feedback and ensure the highest quality. 

It's the ideal time to come aboard-we're focused on the future as we continue to evolve as a company. With so many opportunities available, this is where you can make your mark and help define the FinTech industry. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead development teams through all phases of the Agile development life cycle. 
 - Coach and mentor junior talent, including pair-programming and reviewing AI-generated code with engineering judgment. 
 - Influence and collaborate with software developers, UX designers, product managers, application architects, and customer application experts to create amazing apps. 
 - Champion responsible adoption of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) on the team-setting prompt patterns, distinguishing AI Skills (deterministic capabilities) from Agents (autonomous, multi-step workflows), and following Synchrony's guidance for data handling, PII protection, IP compliance, and code provenance in regulated financial services contexts. 
 - Ensure compliance with architecture, security, and technology standards set by Synchrony. 
 - Participate in addressing root cause analyses, incident reports, and provide direction in problem resolution. 
 - Ability to analyze production defects, troubleshoot systems, identify root cause, and implement fixes. 
 - Provide 24x7 on-call support periodically throughout the year. 
 - Identify ways to increase efficiency and improve system performance, including by piloting AI tools and agentic workflows for repetitive engineering tasks. 
 - Work with third party vendors to develop software and/or integrate their software into Synchrony's products. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years in full stack development with a strong focus on JavaScript (React JS in particular) OR, in lieu of degree, with 7 years of experience in the same. 
 - Hands-on experience using at least one AI coding assistant (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as part of regular development workflow. 
 - Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, Styled-Components, and RTL or Cypress. 
 - Familiarity with AI-native concepts-RAG patterns, vector databases, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and agent orchestration-and how they differ from traditional architecture. 
 - Awareness of the open-source AI tooling ecosystem (Continue. dev, Aider, Cline, Ollama). 
 - Exposure to building or customizing AI agents/skills using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI) for engineering automation such as code review, documentation, or migration assistants. 
 - Live and breathe testing. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Knowledge of industry-wide technology trends and best practices. 
 - Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals. 
 - Advanced knowledge of application, data, and infrastructure architecture disciplines. 
 - Extremely self-driven and can work autonomously. 
 - A desire to be in the FinTech space. 
 - Start-up or consulting experience. 

Eligibility Criteria

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, plus 5+ years of experience in software development, design, and architecture. Proven track record as a tech lead or senior individual contributor. 

WORK TIMINGS: 2: 00 PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. 

For Internal Applicants

data.title: On-Site Installation Lead
data.description:
About the role

You will own how Wakefit Home Interiors gets installed in customers' homes: on time, right the first time, at a sustainable cost. 

This is a 0 to 1 role. There is no inherited playbook to run. You will build the systems for on-site quality and timely execution, then lead a team of carpenters and work with external agencies to deliver against them. 

Expect unknowns. The right person treats each new problem as a reason to build a repeatable, cost-effective solution rather than a one-time fix. 

Key responsibilities

Build the on-site quality system

- Define installation quality standards and site checklists for each stage of installation. 
 - Create SOPs that carpenters can follow consistently, with minimal dependence on any one person. 
 - Set up snag capture, root-cause tracking and closure, so repeat issues are fixed at the source. 
 - Own the handover standard: what "complete" means before the customer signs off. Build the timely execution system

- Plan and schedule installations so sites are ready, material is on site and crews are assigned before work starts. 
 - Track every installation against its committed timeline and flag delays early. 
 - Work with production and dispatch so what reaches the site matches what was designed. Lead the carpenter team

- Hire, onboard and train carpenters on Wakefit standards and SOPs. 
 - Allocate crews across sites to balance quality, timelines and productivity. 
 - Build skill development and accountability into how the team works. Manage external stakeholders

- Be the on-site point of coordination for customers and other external parties involved in installation. 
 - Resolve escalations at site and feed recurring issues back into the system. Keep it sustainable and cost-effective

- Track installation cost and find ways to reduce it without lowering quality. 
 - Choose solutions that scale with volume rather than adding headcount for every problem. KPIs Targets are to be set once baselines are established.

data.title: Engineering Manager - System Design
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst Ansätze, Projekte und Programme im Funktionsbereich oder der betroffenen Unternehmensorganisation und die Arbeitsweise. Beeinflusst die Qualität, Effizienz und Effektivität des eigenen Teams. Hat wesentlichen Einfluss auf die Prioritäten. Geleitet von professionellen Praktiken und Richtlinien, die von der Rolle selbst geprägt sind. Die Rolle verfügt über eine moderate Autonomie und erfordert ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem. 
 - Entwicklung von Fachwissen in der eigenen Disziplin. Dient als Ressource für bewährte Verfahren/Qualität. Hat Kenntnis der neuesten technischen Entwicklungen im eigenen Bereich. Trägt zur Strategie- und Richtlinienentwicklung bei und gewährleistet die Umsetzung im Verantwortungsbereich. 
 - Verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse zu Best Practices und über die Integration des eigenen Bereichs in andere Bereiche; verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
 - Verwendet Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen oder moderat komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb/Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen. Betrachtet bestehende Lösungen aus einer neuen Perspektive. Verwendet technische Erfahrung und Fachwissen für die Datenanalyse, um Empfehlungen zu unterstützen. Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung. Kann kleine Projekte mit moderaten Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten. Erklärt schwierige oder vertrauliche Informationen; arbeitet, um einen Konsens zu schaffen. Entwicklung von Überzeugungsfähigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um andere bei Themen innerhalb des Fachgebiets zu beeinflussen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule. 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Lead Data Engineer to lead data migration, data engineering, and data governance initiatives supporting our next-generation Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. 

This role is responsible for defining migration strategies, designing scalable data architectures, establishing governance frameworks, and leading teams responsible for migrating and integrating data from legacy platforms into Salesforce and Enterprise Service Management ecosystems. 

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in data engineering, data migration, cloud platforms, and enterprise data architecture with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities. You will work closely with Salesforce Leads, Architects, Integration Teams, Business Analysts, and customer stakeholders to enable accurate, secure, and reliable data foundations that support AI-powered service experiences, enterprise automation, and business transformation initiatives. 

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy solving large-scale data challenges while shaping the future of Enterprise Service Management, Agentforce, and Salesforce-driven innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Migration Leadership

- Lead end-to-end data migration initiatives supporting Salesforce and Enterprise Service Management transformation programs. 
 - Define migration strategies, migration roadmaps, cutover plans, reconciliation frameworks, and migration governance processes. 
 - Assess legacy source systems and determine migration approaches aligned with business and technical objectives. 
 - Establish migration success criteria, validation processes, and quality checkpoints. 
 - Drive data cleansing, standardization, enrichment, and remediation activities to improve overall data quality. 
 - Act as the primary data migration lead across implementation and transformation programs. 

Data Architecture & Engineering

- Design scalable, secure, and high-performing data architectures supporting Salesforce and enterprise platforms. 
 - Define data transformation, mapping, validation, and cleansing strategies. 
 - Develop reusable migration frameworks, ETL/ELT pipelines, and automation utilities. 
 - Establish Master Data Management (MDM) principles and enterprise data governance standards. 
 - Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, regulatory, and organizational governance requirements. 
 - Drive adoption of data engineering best practices across projects. 

Salesforce & ITSM Data Enablement

- Lead migration and transformation of: 
 - Incident Records
 - Service Requests
 - Change Records
 - Problem Records
 - Knowledge Articles
 - CMDB Data
 - IT Asset Management Data
 - User and Organizational Hierarchies
 - Support Team Structures
 - Service Catalog Data
 - Partner closely with Salesforce Architects and Leads to ensure alignment with Salesforce data models and platform design. 
 - Support data readiness activities for Agentforce, AI-powered workflows, reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives. 
Team Leadership & Governance

- Lead and mentor Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers across multiple workstreams. 
 - Establish data quality KPIs, migration success metrics, and governance frameworks. 
 - Conduct stakeholder reviews, executive reporting, and risk assessments. 
 - Drive issue resolution, dependency management, and mitigation planning. 
 - Foster a culture of continuous improvement, automation, and engineering excellence. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Collaborate with Architects, Integration Developers, Salesforce Developers, Business Analysts, and Quality Analysts. 
 - Support effort estimation, sprint planning, release planning, and project governance activities. 
 - Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of data migration and engineering workstreams. 
 - Participate in solution reviews and enterprise architecture discussions. 

AI & Innovation

- Support data foundations for Agentforce, Data Cloud, AI-driven automation, and conversational service experiences. 
 - Contribute to enterprise data strategy and modernization initiatives. 
 - Evaluate emerging data technologies and recommend innovative approaches to improve scalability, quality, and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive automation opportunities across migration, validation, and governance processes. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 7-10 years of overall IT experience. 
 - Minimum 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Migration, or Data Architecture roles. 
 - Experience leading enterprise-scale data migration initiatives. 
 - Experience supporting Salesforce implementations and transformation programs. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce data models and platform architecture. 
 - Deep expertise in: 
 - Data Engineering

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Team

Rippling's Tax Platform is one of only ~5 companies globally that owns the full tax calculation and filing stack. We process over $30 billion in annual payroll for 1 million+ employees-growing 50% year-over-year. Our systems handle millions of payroll transactions across multiple countries, ensuring tax correctness across 4, 000+ jurisdictions while staying compliant with constantly changing tax regulations. 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who takes ownership of complex problems, designs robust systems, and delivers high-quality solutions that directly impact millions of tax calculations. 

What You Will Do

- System Design: Architect scalable, reliable systems that handle billions of dollars in tax calculations with zero tolerance for error

 - Reliability & Correctness: Build systems where accuracy is non-negotiable; a single bug can mean compliance failures across thousands of companies
 - Global Scale: Solve challenges unique to processing millions of payroll transactions across multiple countries with 4, 000+ jurisdictions and evolving regulations
 - Collaboration: Partner with compliance, product, and platform teams to translate complex tax requirements into elegant technical solutions

What You Will Have

- 5+ years of software engineering experience
 - Strong system design skills with experience building distributed, high-reliability systems
 - Proficiency in Python; experience with Django or similar frameworks that follow the MVC pattern (layered architecture). 
 - Track record of owning and delivering impactful projects autonomously
 - Rigorous approach to correctness-you write tests, handle edge cases, and think about failure modes
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex problem spaces

Nice to Have

- Experience in fintech, payroll, or tax domains

 - Experience with domain-specific languages or rule engines
 - Familiarity with MongoDB, Temporal, or event-driven architectures

data.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description Summary

The Sr Engineer - Systems Architecture and Design is a senior technical role within PCS Hardware Platforms, providing shared systems-design leadership for Common OS and Common UI platform releases. The role ensures that both platforms meet system and product needs, comply with applicable medical-device standards and internal quality-system requirements, and are released with appropriate quality, traceability, risk controls, and technical evidence. 

The role aligns subsystem requirements, architecture, interfaces, design controls, verification strategies, technical reviews, release evidence, and lifecycle decisions across Common OS and Common UI. The Sr Engineer works with System Architects, Product Owners, platform and component architects, verification leaders, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, program teams, and consuming product teams. 

The position coordinates cross-platform dependencies, compatible baselines, integration milestones, product adoption, and consolidated release readiness. The role requires strong systems thinking, embedded software and Linux platform knowledge, reusable UI platform understanding, medical-device development rigor, and the ability to lead complex technical work through influence. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own subsystem requirement definitions derived from system requirements, user needs, intended use, and platform strategy; ensure flow-down to design outputs, component requirements, interfaces, and verification evidence. 
 - Provide shared systems-design leadership for coordinated Common OS and Common UI releases, including joint planning, dependency management, integration milestones, readiness reviews, and release decisions. 
 - Lead system decomposition, interface definition, architecture-to-requirement traceability, critical-to-quality attributes, non-functional requirements, and documented technical trade-offs. 
 - Balance safety, security, privacy, usability, performance, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, cost, reuse, and lifecycle sustainability. 
 - Own the subsystem Design History File strategy and ensure completeness, consistency, traceability, and audit readiness of engineering evidence. 
 - Define subsystem verification strategies and ensure bidirectional traceability among requirements, risks, verification methods, results, anomalies, and release decisions. 
 - Ensure subsystem and component Technical Design Review strategies align with system plans and the needs of Common OS and Common UI. 
 - Lead product and subsystem risk profiling based on intended use, safety, privacy, and cybersecurity; drive FMEA, FTA, risk-benefit analysis, and risk-control traceability. 
 - Define and monitor platform-health metrics covering quality, reliability, cybersecurity, defect trends, performance, technical debt, obsolescence, and adoption. 
 - Review product-to-platform and Common OS-to-Common UI interface requirements; maintain clear interface ownership, compatibility expectations, and supported version combinations. 
 - Drive integrated validation with product teams, including interface, compatibility, performance, upgrade, failure-recovery, cybersecurity, and regression considerations. 
 - Establish integrated Common OS and Common UI release-readiness reviews covering dependencies, risks, verification evidence, deviations, known limitations, and product-consumption readiness. 
 - Coordinate defect triage and technical decisions for issues crossing operating system, UI framework, middleware, application, hardware, or product boundaries. 
 - Conceptualize and drive proofs of concept for new platform capabilities and influence Common OS, Common UI, process, and engineering-tool roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and emerging system designers in systems engineering, design controls, risk management, technical reviews, and evidence-based decision making. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related STEM discipline. 
 - Typically 10+ years of engineering experience, including substantial experience in systems architecture and design, embedded software, platform engineering, or medical-device development. 
 - Demonstrated experience translating system and product needs into subsystem requirements, interfaces, design outputs, verification strategies, and traceable release evidence. 
 - Experience with regulated product development, design controls, risk management, quality systems, and cross-functional technical reviews. 
 - Technical depth in embedded Linux architecture and development, middleware or application architecture, cybersecurity, reusable platform technologies, and Qt/QML application development. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as C or C++, with scripting experience using Python and/or shell. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, products, sites, or business stakeholders through influence. 

Desired Characteristics

- Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience developing and sustaining reusable platforms consumed by multiple medical-device products. 
 - Experience coordinating releases across interdependent operating-system and user-interface platform areas. 
 - Experience with Yocto Project or Buildroot, Linux BSPs, bootloaders, device drivers, NXP or TI application processors, and hands-on Qt/QML development for embedded user interfaces. 
 - Working knowledge of INCOSE-aligned systems-engineering practices, requirements modelling, interface management, CTQs, FMEA, FTA, and risk-benefit analysis. 
 - Experience with Agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, automated verification, configuration management, SBOM practices, lifecycle vulnerability management, and defect management. 
 - Experience across concept, new product introduction, sustaining engineering, installed-base support, obsolescence, and end-of-life phases. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams, quality and regulatory partners, product stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
 - Demonstrated commitment to acting with humility, leading with transparency, delivering with focus, driving ownership, and operating with unyielding integrity. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

data.description:
About Albertsons: 

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub in India: 

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & responsibilities: 

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required: 

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason 
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions 
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally 
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work 
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens 
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required: 

- Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems: design review and governance 
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability 
 - MCP, Memory and State Management, Context Engineering, RAG 
 - Python / Java / TypeScript (hands-on) 
 - Cloud Platform Experience (Azure and/or Google Cloud) 
 - Engineering Leadership, Hiring and Change Management 
 - AI Governance, Guardrails, Token and Compute Cost Management

At Arctic Wolf, you will not just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you will help lead the change. Our global team is made up of people who thrive on solving complex problems, moving quickly, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and International Data Corporation MarketScape. What matters most is the work behind these recognitions: delivering real outcomes for customers through award-winning innovation such as our Aurora Platform. 

If you are looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth company that is redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you. 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. 

We are looking for a Manager - Detection Engineering, XDR to lead detection development activities and help achieve our mission of End Cyber Risk. 

The Manager - Detection Engineering, XDR plans and directs all aspects of detection development activities within their team. This includes ensuring that engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are aligned with the organization's established policies and objectives. 

The Manager reports to a Senior Manager of Research and Development and works closely with Research and Development Leadership, Product Management, and Security Services (S2) to ensure the team is building what our customers and users need in a timely manner. 

This is a detection development team responsible for building generalized detections across multiple telemetry sources, including endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email, to provide broad Extended Detection and Response (XDR) coverage for customers. Managers may also have specialized subject matter expertise within the technical areas their teams support. 

SCOPE OF ROLE

- Generate and manage the day-to-day work for the team. 
 - Work with the Product Team to define and deliver the six-month roadmap. 
 - Contribute to longer-term planning and strategy in partnership with the Director. 
 - Provide direction, clarity, and support to the team to ensure detection development activities remain focused on organizational and customer needs. 

In This Role, You Will

Team Leadership and Detection Development

- Manage teams responsible for delivering high-quality, innovative detection content spanning multiple telemetry sources. 
 - Work collaboratively with architects, developers, Product Managers, data engineers, and security analysts. 
 - Support the team by providing direction, clarity, and removing obstacles. 
 - Instill the Foundations of Research and Development within the team by living them on a daily basis. 
 - Set and maintain a high technical bar for detection quality, coverage, and false-positive rates across the team's output. 
 - Ensure teams are highly motivated, performing well, and delivering work on time. 
 - Ensure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve. 
 - Work with team members to deliver key features. 
 - Build collaborative relationships with other teams and stakeholders within the organization. 

Product Roadmap and Detection Strategy

- Execute the Product roadmap. 
 - Work with the Product Team to define and deliver the six-month roadmap. 
 - Work with Architects to define and execute on the company's technical roadmap. 
 - Drive detection coverage expansion across telemetry sources, ensuring breadth and depth of XDR detection capabilities. 
 - Champion cross-telemetry detection strategies that maximize coverage while minimizing false positives across diverse customer environments. 
 - Own detection quality metrics and continuously raise the bar on precision, recall, and mean-time-to-detect. 
 - Represent the team's work to senior leadership with data-driven reporting on detection coverage, efficacy, and operational impact. 

Detection Development Lifecycle

- Oversee the full detection development lifecycle, from research and hypothesis through implementation, testing, tuning, and retirement. 
 - Establish and enforce rigorous peer review processes for all detection content before production deployment. 
 - Ensure the team delivers high-quality detection content across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email telemetry. 
 - Ensure detection development processes and engineering initiatives remain aligned with organizational policies and objectives. 

Team Execution and Delivery

- Remove blockers preventing teams from getting their work done. 
 - Make sure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve. 
 - Support the team in delivering key features and detection capabilities. 
 - Drive continuous development process improvements. 
 - Continuously improve team velocity and delivery predictability. 
 - Lead Agile development practices across the team. 

Research and Development Responsibilities

- Implement the Research and Development Department and Team Responsibilities. 
 - Ensure teams are following Information Security Management System (ISMS) regulations, including: Secure Coding Practices Acceptable Use
 - Establish and maintain processes that support technical excellence and secure detection development. 

People Development and Mentoring

- Develop the careers of team members. 
 - Mentor each team member and help them grow their technical and leadership skills. 
 - Establish career development plans and achievable goals for direct reports. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-ones. 
 - Provide career and personal development coaching. 
 - Build a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence. 
 - Maintain a clear history of learning and skills development across the team. 
 - Regularly help detection developers develop their skills in a variety of ways. 
 - Support and mentor individuals toward senior and lead roles. 

Administrative and Financial Responsibilities

- Manage employee compensation and vacation time. 
 - Manage and approve conference and training budgets. 
 - Participate in helping set and manage the Directorate-level budget. 
 - Apply strong financial management skills to team and organizational responsibilities. 

Recruitment

- Lead recruitment efforts for the team for both full-time and co-op employees. 
 - Be a key contributor to planning, hiring, and recruitment strategy for the team. 
 - Maintain a high hiring bar by assessing candidates for both depth of security knowledge and breadth of cross-domain thinking. 

We're Looking For Someone With Experience In

- 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on detection engineering, threat detection, or security analytics at scale. 
 - 3+ years of management or team lead experience in a cybersecurity or detection engineering role, with demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing teams. 
 - Deep understanding of diverse telemetry sources, including: Endpoint and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) Network and Network Detection and Response (NDR) Cloud, including Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP) Identity Provider (IdP) telemetry Email security
 - Hands-on experience normalizing and correlating signals across diverse telemetry sources. 
 - Proven track record of developing detection content using correlation rules, behavioral analytics, and machine learning-based approaches across heterogeneous data sources in production environments. 
 - Expert-level familiarity with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) platforms and query languages such as Splunk Processing Language (SPL), Kusto Query Language (KQL), SQL, Sigma, or equivalent. 
 - Ability to evaluate detection efficacy through metrics-driven approaches. 
 - Strong knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and demonstrated experience applying it to detection coverage mapping, gap analysis, and prioritization. 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell, with the ability to build tooling and automation for detection development workflows. 
 - Experience leading Agile development teams, preferably with formal Agile training. 
 - Track record of continuously improving team velocity and delivery predictability. 
 - A clear history of technical influence, such as public conference talks, published research, open-source contributions, patents, or similar contributions. 
 - A clear history of learning and skills development. 
 - Experience regularly helping detection developers develop their skills and mentoring individuals into senior or lead roles. 
 - Professional security certifications are required, such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCED, GREM, or OSCP. 
 - Permanently located in Bengaluru, India. 

Nice To Have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 
 - Formal Agile training. 
 - Experience with machine learning-based detection approaches. 
 - Experience building and managing generalized detection capabilities across multiple telemetry sources. 
 - Experience with cross-telemetry detection strategies and XDR coverage. 
 - Experience with detection quality metrics, including precision, recall, and mean-time-to-detect. 
 - Experience with technical research, public speaking, published research, open-source contributions, or patents. 

Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good. 

We celebrate diverse perspectives through our Pack Unity program and encourage employees to participate in or create new alliances. 

We also believe in corporate responsibility and have joined the Pledge One Percent movement to give back to our communities. 

All Employees Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

- Equity for all employees
 - Flexible annual leave, paid holidays, and volunteer days
 - Training and career development programs
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance equal to three times compensation, and personal accident insurance
 - Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under applicable law. We are committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, and inclusive environment. 

Security Requirements

- Conduct duties in accordance with Arctic Wolf information security policies, standards, processes, and controls
 - Background checks are required for this position
 - This role may require access to information protected under United States export control laws and regulations

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.
