data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Job Summary

This role is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of full‐stack applications and shared platform services deployed on AWS. The position operates as a senior contributor within the team, combining hands‐on development with strong engineering practices, test automation awareness, and operational excellence. 

The Senior Full Stack Developer will work closely with product, platform, QE, and operations teams to deliver scalable, secure, and observable solutions. While the primary focus is full‐stack development, the role requires practical exposure to automation testing, dashboards, analytics, and cloud‐native DevOps patterns to support data‐driven decision making and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

- Demonstrated experience using AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and AgentCore. 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, while exercising sound judgment to validate and take ownership of AI-generated output. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, and/or model integration patterns. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain cloud‐native full‐stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies, with a focus on clean, maintainable, secure, and well‐documented code. 
 - Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices deployed on AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Participate across the entire application lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Collaborate with architects, product owners, QE, and other developers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 - Contribute to automation testing efforts, including development and maintenance of unit, API, integration, and contract tests to ensure high code quality and regression coverage. 
 - Support the development and integration of dashboards and analytics to provide visibility into application health, operational metrics, and system usage. 
 - Participate in CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance, enabling automated builds, tests, deployments, and quality gates. 
 - Apply DevSecOps best practices, including secure coding standards, dependency management, and proactive risk identification. 
 - Assist with steady‐state operations, troubleshooting production issues, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Ensure applications are optimized for performance, scalability, and mobile‐friendly UI/UX where applicable. 
 - Participate in code reviews, promoting best practices, coding standards, and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Analyze problems effectively, provide accurate effort estimates, and deliver milestones within committed timelines. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation covering design, deployment, operational procedures, and troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with global teams across time zones to support delivery, integration, and operational objectives. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of IT experience with strong hands‐on full‐stack software development experience. 
 - Solid understanding of modern application architectures, including microservices and API‐driven systems. 
 - Experience with frontend development using Angular, React, or similar frameworks. 
 - Backend development experience using Java, TypeScript or Python. 
 - Hands‐on experience with AWS cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, and monitoring. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git‐based source control platforms (GitHub, GitLab, or similar). 
 - Working knowledge of automated testing frameworks and practices (unit, API, integration testing). 
 - Familiarity with dashboards and analytics concepts, including application metrics and operational reporting. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models. 
 - Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross‐functional teams. 
 - Consistent commitment to safety, security, and protection of customer and organizational data. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience in designing, building, and deploying multi‐layered application architectures across on‐premises and AWS cloud environments using services such as EC2, ECS, S3, VPC, RDS, SQS, ELB, Auto Scaling, CloudFront, CloudFormation, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and SNS. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud computing models (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) and hands‐on implementation experience using AWS and container platforms such as OpenShift. 
 - Experience implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeCommit, CodePipeline, or equivalent Git‐based CI/CD platforms. Proficiency across multiple frontend and backend technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular or React, Java, Python, and Node. js. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining test automation tools and frameworks for unit, contract, API, integration, and web/UI testing. 
 - Hands‐on experience working in Agile delivery environments, supporting multiple applications and releases. 
 - Proven ability to set up and maintain CI pipelines for new branches and releases while ensuring stability, dependency management, and seamless integration with existing pipelines. 
 - Exposure to resolving build, deployment, and dependency issues in complex, enterprise‐scale systems. 
 - Curiosity to learn new technologies and continuously improve engineering practices. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. 

For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme

Area(s) of responsibility

BIRLASOFT

Job Description

Developer / Engineer - Agentic AI (Aisera & Allied Platforms)

Experience

8-12 years

Location

Noida / Pune / Bengaluru / Hyderabad (Hybrid)

Practice

Service Integration Practice

Employment Type

Full-time

Role Summary

We are hiring hands-on Developers and Engineers to design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI solutions on Aisera and similar platforms (ServiceNow AI and open agent frameworks) across client engagements. You will develop autonomous and multi-agent systems that reason, plan, and execute - integrating LLMs with enterprise systems to automate ITSM, operations, and business workflows, and remaining hands-on through to delivery.

- Develop, configure, and deploy AI agents using Aisera's platform and comparable agentic AI toolsets to solve real-world client workflows. 
 - Build autonomous and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool selection, and task execution.

 - Integrate agents with external systems - APIs, webhooks, databases, CRMs, ITSM platforms, and data pipelines - for seamless workflow execution.

 - Implement AI governance, security, and compliance controls (auth flows, responsible-AI safeguards, observability of agent behavior).

- 8-12 years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or systems integration, with recent hands-on Agentic AI / LLM delivery.

 - Strong programming in Python (primary), plus Java and/or JavaScript; clean, efficient, production-quality code. 
 - Proven experience building agents with LLM frameworks - LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or PydanticAI. 
 - Solid understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, function calling, and agent evaluation. 
 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent architectures (preferred). 
 - Integration experience: REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines; OAuth/OIDC/JWT authorization flows. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and monitoring. 
 - Familiarity with AI/LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, ELK) is highly desirable. 
 - Strong problem-solving, customer-facing communication, and the ability to work independently.

data.title: Principal Engineer - Open Source Data Platform (ODP)
data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Engineer with at least 14 years of experience to serve as a technical visionary and thought leader for Acceldata's Open Data Platform (ODP). In this role, you will define the long-term technical strategy, lead the most complex architectural initiatives, and represent Acceldata in the global open-source and distributed systems community. You will work directly with engineering leadership and executives to shape product direction while driving innovation across the organization. 

WHY JOIN US?

As a Principal Engineer at Acceldata, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of enterprise data platforms, defining the technical vision for systems that power mission-critical workloads across the world's largest organizations. Your decisions will directly influence not only our platform but also the broader data ecosystem through open-source contributions and industry leadership. 

You'll work alongside Apache members, committers, and industry veterans who are passionate about solving the hardest problems in distributed computing. This is a rare opportunity to combine deep technical impact with strategic influence, building technology that matters while shaping the direction of a growing data observability company. 

Responsibilities

- Define and drive the long-term technical strategy and architecture for the Open Data Platform, aligning with business objectives and industry trends. 
 - Own the design of the most complex, high-impact systems and establish architectural principles and patterns that scale across the organization. 
 - Identify emerging technologies and industry trends; lead research and development initiatives that position Acceldata at the cutting edge of data platform innovation. 
 - Serve as a recognized leader in the open-source community; drive Apache project contributions, represent Acceldata at conferences, and influence project roadmaps. 
 - Collaborate with CTO, VP of Engineering, and Product leadership to translate business strategy into technical execution; provide technical due diligence for strategic initiatives. 
 - Influence engineering practices, tools, and culture across multiple teams; establish best practices that elevate the entire engineering organization. 
 - Mentor Staff Engineers and Senior Engineers; develop technical leadership capabilities across the organization. 
 - Lead resolution of the most challenging technical problems spanning architecture, performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Engage with strategic customers and partners on complex technical discussions; translate customer needs into platform capabilities. 
 - Drive alignment across engineering, product, and operations on technical decisions with broad organizational impact. 
 - Work across diverse environments: Bare Metals, VM, Kubernetes, multi-cloud, and hybrid architectures at enterprise scale. 

Requirements

- 15+ years of hands-on software development experience with at least 8 years focused on distributed systems, big data platforms, or data infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record of leading large-scale technical initiatives from conception to production across multiple teams. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Java or Scala; strong skills in Python and systems languages. 
 - Deep expertise in distributed computing, including consensus protocols, distributed transactions, data replication, partitioning strategies, and optimization with modern table formats. 
 - Extensive experience in architecting and scaling systems using Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Trino, Kafka, Flink, and related technologies at production scale (100s to 1000s of nodes).

 - Expert knowledge of cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes orchestration, and multi-cloud deployment patterns. 
 - Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex distributed system issues, including performance optimization, resource management, and failure mode analysis. 
 - Significant contributions to major open-source projects; experience working with distributed global teams and open-source governance models. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to influence technical direction across organizations and with external stakeholders. 
 - Ability to balance long-term technical vision with near-term delivery requirements; experience making build vs. buy decisions. 

DESIRED BACKGROUND

- PMC member or committer status in Apache projects (e. g. , Spark, Kafka, Hive, Hadoop, Iceberg, Flink, Trino). 
 - Speaker at major conferences (ApacheCon, Spark Summit, Kafka Summit, QCon, etc. ); published papers or widely-read technical content. 
 - Experience building or contributing to query engines, optimizers, or execution frameworks. 
 - Deep experience with modern lakehouse architectures, table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), and data mesh patterns. 
 - Experience with ML infrastructure, feature stores, or MLOps platforms. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organisations in high-growth environments. 
 - Master's or PhD in Computer Science, with a focus on distributed systems, databases, or related fields.

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

A Full Stack Developer with . NET and React expertise specializes in building complete enterprise web applications using Microsoft's . NET ecosystem for the backend and React for the frontend. Also, you're expected to architect solutions, mentor junior developers, and own entire features from design through production. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Frontend Development: Building responsive, performant user interfaces with React, managing state, and implementing complex UI interactions
 - Backend Development: Designing and implementing APIs using . NET (C# with ASP. NET Core or Framework), managing business logic, and ensuring system reliability
 - Database Design: Creating efficient SQL Server schemas, optimizing queries, and ensuring data integrity
 - System Architecture: Contributing to decisions about application structure, scalability, and integration patterns
 - API Development: Building RESTful APIs endpoints with proper authentication, validation, and error handling
 - Code Quality: Writing clean, maintainable code following SOLID principles and conducting code reviews
 - Testing: Implementing unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests across both layers
 - Deployment & DevOps: Managing CI/CD pipelines, deploying to Azure or on-premises servers, and monitoring applications
 - Problem-Solving: Debugging issues that span React frontend, . NET backend, and SQL Server database
 - Collaboration: Working with designers, product managers, QA, and other developers
 - Performance Optimization: Ensuring fast load times, efficient database queries, and optimized React rendering
 - Documentation: Maintaining API documentation and architectural decision records

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Full-Stack Microsoft Expertise: You need strong knowledge across the entire Microsoft stack-React for frontend, . NET/C# for backend, and SQL Server for data. You should understand how these technologies integrate and optimize across all layers. 
 - Enterprise-Level Thinking: Enterprise applications require scalability, security, maintainability, and reliability. You should think about long-term implications of technical decisions, not just short-term solutions. 
 - Database Optimization: SQL Server expertise with understanding of query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design patterns that support high-performance applications. 
 - Communication: Explaining technical decisions about architecture, technology choices, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Problem-Solving Across Layers: Ability to diagnose whether a performance issue is in the React UI, . NET API, the database, or network layer-and fix it systematically. 

Ideally, you'll also

- 5+ Years in . NET and React Development should have spent substantial time building production applications with both technologies. This typically means multiple projects where you've seen different architectural patterns, scaling challenges, and business requirements. 
 - C# Expertise: Deep knowledge of C# including LINQ, async/await, delegates, events, generics, and modern language features (nullable types, records, tuples, etc)
 - API Design: Building RESTful APIs following best practices, versioning strategies, and proper HTTP status codes
 - Authentication & Authorization: Implementing authentication (JWT, OAuth, Windows Auth) and role-based access control
 - React Proficiency: Modern component-based UI development with hooks, state management, and performance optimization. React is the standard for building dynamic user interfaces in this stack. 
 - . NET Mastery: Deep knowledge of C# and the . NET ecosystem, including async/await patterns, dependency injection, middleware, and entity framework. Understanding both . NET Framework and . NET Core is valuable. 
 - Database Optimization: SQL Server expertise with understanding of query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design patterns that support high-performance applications. 
 - Advanced React Knowledge: Deep proficiency with React hooks (useState, useContext, useReducer, custom hooks), functional components, and lifecycle methods
 - JSX & Component Architecture: Building reusable, well-structured components with proper prop management and composition patterns
 - State Management: Experience with major state management solutions
 - CSS & Styling: Proficiency with CSS-in-JS solutions (styled-components, Emotion) or CSS modules, responsive design, and styling best practices
 - Performance Optimization: Understanding React performance (memorization, lazy loading, code splitting, virtualization)
 - Testing: Writing unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, integration tests, and snapshot testing
 - Debugging: Using React Developer Tools and browser Dev Tools effectively
 - Version Control: Expert-level Git proficiency including branching strategies and workflows
 - CI/CD Pipelines: Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools for automated testing and deployment
 - Azure: Proficiency with Azure services commonly used with . NET. 
 - Monitoring & Logging: Setting up logging (Serilog, NLog), monitoring, and alerting
 - Design Patterns: Understanding and implementing common patterns (Repository, Factory, Observer, Strategy, etc)
 - SOLID Principles: Writing code that follows Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion principles
 - Clean Architecture: Building applications with clear separation of concerns across layers

What We Look For

EY People Consulting is likely seeking someone who: 

- Enterprise-Ready Developer: Someone who writes production-quality code that scales and is secure
 - Full-Stack Independence: Can own features end-to-end without being blocked by frontend or backend specialists
 - Modern Tech Stack Expertise: Deep knowledge of current best practices in both React and . NET ecosystems
 - Technical Leadership: Can make architectural decisions, guide junior developers, and establish coding standards

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. 

- Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 
 - Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 
 - People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 
 - Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 
 - How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Position Summary

The Senior Staff Software Engineer will provide technical leadership in designing and evolving large-scale, distributed systems and platform architectures across multiple teams and organizational domains. This role will drive long-term technical strategy, architectural modernization, AI-enabled engineering practices, and platform capabilities while improving system reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and business outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and evolution of large-scale, distributed systems and platform architectures to ensure long-term scalability, reliability, and extensibility. 
 - Define and guide technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams, aligning engineering priorities with business objectives and product goals. 
 - Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development practices and AI-enabled capabilities to improve engineering effectiveness, product innovation, and measurable business outcomes. 
 - Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple systems and domains while driving technical alignment and successful execution. 
 - Identify, communicate, and mitigate systemic technical risks while advancing system reliability, observability, performance, and operational maturity. 
 - Define and drive strategies for reducing technical debt, modernizing legacy systems, and improving platform architecture across the organization. 
 - Develop and promote shared platform capabilities, services, tooling, and engineering practices that improve developer productivity and system consistency. 
 - Mentor senior and staff engineers, influence technical direction, and promote a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and high-quality system design. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience driving technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams or organizational domains. 
 - Deep experience designing, building, and evolving large-scale distributed systems, platform architectures, and cloud-based production environments. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud-native architecture, scalability, reliability, security, and cost optimization. 
 - Proven ability to navigate complex and ambiguous environments, influence technical stakeholders, and drive alignment and execution across teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with . NET full-stack and API development across frontend and backend technologies, with proficiency in Rust, C#, and/or JavaScript. 
 - Extensive experience with distributed systems, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep. 
 - Deep expertise in observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, incident response, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience with modern authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, and SAML, as well as secure coding and security architecture practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, progressive deployment strategies, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience with relational and non-relational databases and the architectural considerations involved in designing systems at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience driving engineering productivity, platform improvements, technical modernization, and AI adoption across multiple teams or organizational domains. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Assistant Vice President–Lead QA & Proofing Unit
data.description:
Mashreq Bank
JOB DESCRIPTION
1
Job Title
AVP - Lead, QA & Proofing Unit

Department
Operations GRC

Direct Supervisor
Head - Internal Controls, Operations GRC
Job Number

2
Job Purpose

To lead the Quality Assurance and Proofing Unit under the Enterprise Reconciliation Framework (ERF), ensuring robust control oversight and assurance over reconciliation lifecycle activities across Operations and Business units. This role will provide independent validation, exception monitoring, and follow-up closure of outstanding reconciliation items. It will serve as the 1. 5 Line of Defense, with an enterprise-wide mandate covering all reconciliation types (manual, semi-automated, automated) and platforms including TLM. The role ensures that reconciliation quality and closure processes are consistently applied and monitored, with clear escalation mechanisms. 3
Dimensions

Scope of work
- Oversight of enterprise-wide reconciliation proofing, covering: 

- Nostro/Vostro

- Inter-branch accounts

- Sundry & suspense GLs

- Internal accounts

- VAT reconciliation

- Independent review of reconciliation breaks across all platforms (automated/manual

- Escalation and closure follow-up of breaks beyond T+3 days (auto) / agreed timelines (manual)

- Thematic reviews, exception trend reporting, and root cause analysis

Service Level Management - Track adherence to reconciliation closure timelines (T+3, etc. )

- Maintain performance dashboards with metrics across divisions and platforms

- Set up QA KPIs aligned with ERF and Group Operations KRIs

- Establish early warning triggers for high-risk or aging items

Quality Review
- Monthly quality assurance sampling of reconciled items

- Tracking accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of proofing controls

- Raising exceptions to the CRU head and relevant BU operations for resolution

- Conducting periodic health-checks aligned with audit and GRC guidelines
Key Interfaces
- Internal: CRU head, Ops unit heads, Finance (CAD), Technology, Risk, Compliance

- External: Audit (Internal & External), Regulators (for proofing expectations), IBG Ops Heads

- Represent in Operations GRC Risk Councils, FROC and other governance forums

4
Key Result Areas

- % of reconciliations reviewed as part of QA plan per quarter across all account categories
- Reduction in aged unreconciled items (>180 and >360 days). 
- Reduction in outstanding >T+3 items across platforms
- % adherence to reconciliation policy and internal controls. 
- No. of thematic issues identified and resolved via QA testing
- Timely and accurate reconciliation attestation and proofing validations. 
- Platform enhancements delivered and automated rules adoption. 
- SLA adherence across business units and international/overseas branches. 
- Successful internal audit and risk reviews with minimal or no observations. 
- Quality of audit feedback for proofing-related controls
- No overdue proofing validations. 
5
Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

- Operates independently from the CRU but in close coordination
- Enterprise-wide scope across Group Operations and Business Units
- Covers both UAE and international operations including Egypt, Pakistan, India, and IBG branches
- Maintains reporting line into GRC - not embedded within the CRU to preserve independent assurance role
- Aligned with ERF governance manual, APPM, ORM Guidelines and reporting templates. 
- Works within a cross-functional, multi-country environment. 
- Expected to define and enforce centralized standards and controls while balancing local branch needs. 
- Works with constrained resources in a transformation phase and must effectively build team capacity. 
Working Relationships
Directly interfaces with: 
- Head of CRU and his leadership team
- Matrix relationships with - Audit, Risk, Compliance, CAD & Tax teams
- Operations GRC leads in Egypt, India, Pakistan

6
Problem Solving

- Recommend remediation plans for recurring proofing issues. 

- Diagnose systemic control weaknesses across reconciliation processes and recommend design enhancements. 

- Address recurring break trends and implement data-driven remediation plans across business and product lines. 

- Resolve conflicts or accountability gaps between Operations, Finance, and Technology teams on account ownership and reconciliation execution. 

- Mitigate regulatory and audit risks related to unreconciled balances by ensuring preventive and detective controls are in place. 

- Identify pattern-based failures or non-adherence to reconciliation SLAs

- Drive cross-functional resolution forums for persistent items

- Challenge ownership decisions or business rationales where reconciliation breaks are not justified

7
Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

- Escalate aging/unjustified open items directly to Head of OpEx & GRC or Head of Central Accounts. 

- Recommend suspension of automated recon processes if persistent QA failures occur

- Approve monthly QA plans and thematic review scope

- Raise and track Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) jointly with Operations heads. 

- Approve or Reject proofing certifications. 

8
Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Knowledge: 
- Reconciliation platforms: Smart Stream / TLM, and other tools. 
- Operations risk, controls, and audit methodology
- Regulatory reporting and reconciliation governance

Skills: 
- Strong analytical and root cause analysis capabilities
- Excellent stakeholder communication and escalation skills
- Proficiency in dashboarding tools (Power BI/Tableau/Excel)
- Team leadership and QA framework design

Experience: 
- 10+ years in operations/internal controls/reconciliation/assurance roles within banking

data.title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Are you a customer-obsessed software engineer and technical architect who is passionate about applying AI to complex, real-world problems? The Engineering Operations (EngOps) team's mission is to transform Microsoft Cloud customers into fans. Through our deep engineering engagements with customers and teams across Microsoft, we analyze and amplify customer needs and drive the vision to improve cloud quality, security, and reliability. Our culture of growth mindset and empowerment is central to who we are and how we work. 

Our ACES CODE engineering team is building domain-specific agents and services that are fundamentally transforming Azure customer support, moving from reactive, human-only workflows to AI-first systems that resolve customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking a Principal Applied AI Engineer to serve as a hands-on technical architect and developer for production agentic AI services. 

You will define and implement the architecture for next-generation AI agents, including LLM orchestration, multi-agent coordination, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool integration, and evaluation systems. You will write production code, lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, and guide engineers across organizational boundaries through technical influence rather than people management. 

This is a deeply technical individual contributor role with broad architectural scope and direct accountability for production outcomes. You will turn ambiguous customer and business problems into scalable systems, make critical design decisions, build foundational components, and help teams ship secure and reliable AI services that handle thousands of customer cases per month. 

Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help EngOps ACES provide our customers with the world-class cloud services they need to succeed. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Architect and build production agentic AI systems: Design and implement scalable AI agents and services, including LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool integrations, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop experiences. 

Lead through hands-on engineering: Write, review, and maintain production-quality C# and Python code. Build critical components, reference implementations, prototypes, and reusable platform capabilities that accelerate delivery across the engineering organization. 

- Own end-to-end technical delivery: Translate ambiguous customer support scenarios into clear technical requirements and take solutions from architecture and experimentation through implementation, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define technical architecture and engineering standards: Establish architecture patterns, API and data contracts, code quality expectations, evaluation practices, deployment strategies, and observability standards for AI services. Drive technical consistency while allowing teams to evolve their solutions. 
 - Advance evaluation-driven AI development: Design and implement evaluation frameworks using rubrics, golden datasets, simulation, judge models, and offline and online evaluation. Define quality thresholds and graduation criteria for moving agents from experimentation through shadow mode and into autonomous operation. 
 - Own production quality and reliability: Ensure AI services meet demanding standards for correctness, availability, latency, scalability, cost, and safety. Diagnose complex production issues, lead technical incident response and root cause analysis, and engineer systemic improvements. 
 - Design for responsible and secure AI: Embed responsible AI principles, privacy protections, prompt-injection defenses, tool authorization, data boundaries, action controls, auditability, and fail-safe behavior into system architecture and implementation.

Job Description

Job Title - Lead Systems Engineer

The Infrastructure Reliability Engineer position will use automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability, operational data, and engineering practices to improve the availability and resiliency of infrastructure services. 

The Purpose of This Role

Fidelity's Enterprise Infrastructure & Operations Distributed Compute and Storage organization is looking for an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer to help engineer, automate, and improve the reliability of our enterprise infrastructure platforms. 

We are a dynamic team of engineers focused on making infrastructure highly available, resilient, observable, automated, and easy to consume. We partner closely with infrastructure engineering, operations, application, cloud, and technology teams to improve platform reliability while reducing operational complexity through automation. 

The Value You Deliver

This role will help us move from traditional infrastructure operations toward engineering-led operations, where repetitive activities are automated, infrastructure health is measurable, failures are anticipated, recovery is engineered and tested, and operational insights drive continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

- Engineer and operate resilient enterprise infrastructure services across on-premises and cloud environments. 
 - Develop automation that improves infrastructure reliability, scalability, supportability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Automate common operational activities and eliminate repetitive manual processes. 
 - Build observability capabilities that provide meaningful insight into infrastructure health and service reliability. 
 - Partner with Compute, Storage, Cloud, Network, Security, and Application Engineering teams to resolve complex infrastructure problems. 
 - Participate in major incident response and provide engineering expertise during infrastructure service disruptions. 
 - Conduct post-incident analysis and convert lessons learned into automation, monitoring, resiliency, or platform improvements. 
 - Improve infrastructure patching, maintenance, provisioning, lifecycle management, and recovery through automation. 
 - Participate in capacity planning and proactively identify scalability or performance constraints. 
 - Engineer and test backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities. 
 - Develop reusable automation and self-service capabilities for infrastructure consumers. 
 - Contribute to technical standards, engineering best practices, documentation, and operational procedures. 
 - Challenge existing operational processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and engineer away operational toil. 

How Your Work Impacts The Organization

Improve stability, increase availability, and enhance customer and stakeholder satisfaction

The Skill that are Key to this role

Technical/Behavioral

Reliability Engineering

- Apply reliability engineering principles to improve the availability, resiliency, performance, recoverability, and operational readiness of infrastructure platforms. 
 - Identify reliability risks and engineer solutions that eliminate or reduce recurring infrastructure failures. 
 - Establish meaningful health indicators, operational metrics, dashboards, alerts, and reliability measures for infrastructure services. 
 - Use operational data and production insights to identify patterns and proactively address potential reliability issues. 
 - Participate in reliability reviews, failure analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Promote blameless root cause analysis and translate incident learnings into engineering improvements. 

Infrastructure Automation

- Engineer automation that reduces repetitive manual activities and operational toil. 
 - Develop reusable automation utilizing technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Shell, Golang, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, maintenance, recovery, and operational workflows. 
 - Integrate infrastructure platforms through REST APIs and automation frameworks. 
 - Apply software engineering disciplines including source control, code reviews, automated testing, reusable components, and CI/CD to infrastructure automation. 
 - Identify opportunities to transition infrastructure activities from ticket-driven operations to automated and self-service capabilities. 

Observability & Operational Intelligence

- Build and maintain dashboards, monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities for infrastructure platforms. 
 - Develop actionable infrastructure health signals rather than relying solely on threshold-based monitoring. 
 - Correlate telemetry across infrastructure components to accelerate issue identification and resolution. 
 - Analyze operational and infrastructure data to identify: 
 - recurring failures, 
 - performance bottlenecks, 
 - capacity risks, 
 - availability trends, 
 - automation opportunities, 
 - reliability improvement opportunities. 
 - Develop data-driven insights and visualizations using platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Resiliency, Backup & Recovery

- Engineer infrastructure platforms with recoverability as a core design principle. 
 - Support enterprise backup and recovery capabilities across compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, and application infrastructure. 
 - Automate backup validation and recovery workflows to improve consistency and reduce recovery time. 
 - Participate in disaster recovery and resiliency exercises, including recovery into alternate or newly established infrastructure environments. 
 - Validate that infrastructure recovery processes meet defined recovery objectives. 
 - Identify opportunities to continuously improve Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) capabilities. 
 - Use automation and testing to demonstrate that recovery capabilities work when required rather than relying solely on documented procedures. 

Soft skills required: Organizational agility, communications, influencing, time management, contextual awareness and ability to work under pressure. 

The Expertise We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with several of the following: 

Infrastructure

- Linux / Unix
 - Windows Server
 - VMware / Virtualization
 - Enterprise Compute
 - Enterprise Storage
 - Kubernetes / Container Platforms
 - Backup & Recovery technologies

Cloud

- AWS
 - Azure
 - Private / Hybrid Cloud

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Python

 - Go Lang
 - Shell scripting
 - Ansible
 - Terraform
 - REST APIs

Observability

- Datadog
 - Splunk
 - Prometheus
 - Grafana
 - ELK / OpenSearch
 - OpenTelemetry

DevOps / Engineering

- Git
 - Jenkins
 - CI/CD
 - Agile engineering practices

Behaviours

- Systems-thinking and engineering mindset when approaching complex infrastructure and reliability challenges.

 - Automation-first mindset, continuously identifying opportunities to eliminate repetitive operational work and reduce manual effort. 
 - Strong problem-solving capabilities across complex, interconnected infrastructure technologies and services. 
 - Data-driven decision making, using telemetry, operational insights, and trends to identify and prioritize reliability improvements.

Job Description: E-Commerce QA Engineer (SAP Commerce Cloud - B2B)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced E-Commerce QA Engineer to join our B2B digital commerce team. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our SAP Commerce Cloud (CCV2) platform, which integrates with an ECC backend via SAP Datahub and is configured through Backoffice. The ideal candidate will thrive in an agile environment, balancing hands-on functional testing with test automation to support continuous delivery, while maintaining rigorous quality gates and providing visibility into deployment health through dashboards and metrics. 

Key Responsibilities

Sprint-Based Testing & Agile Collaboration Work closely with Business Analysts and Tech Leads to review and clarify sprint stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs. Translate business and technical requirements into comprehensive test cases covering both positive and negative scenarios. Participate in sprint ceremonies (planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint review, retrospectives) to represent QA perspective and raise risks early. 

Functional & Platform Testing Perform functional, integration, and end-to-end testing across SAP Commerce Cloud (CCV2) storefronts, ECC backend transactions, Datahub integration flows, and Backoffice configuration changes. Validate B2B-specific workflows such as account hierarchies, contract pricing, approval workflows, punchout, quoting, and order management. Test data flow integrity between Commerce Cloud, Datahub, and ECC (e. g. , pricing, inventory, order sync, customer master data). 

Regression Management & Test Automation Build and maintain a robust regression suite covering core storefront and integration scenarios to support continuous delivery. Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for ongoing development, prioritizing high-risk and high-frequency regression areas. Continuously expand automation coverage as new features are delivered, reducing manual regression effort over time. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast feedback on builds and deployments. 

Quality Gatekeeping & Documentation Document test plans, test cases, execution results, and defects in a structured, traceable manner. Own quality gate decisions for sprint deliverables and releases, ensuring no critical defects or unresolved risks pass into production without sign-off. Maintain clear defect logs with root cause classification (e. g. , requirement miss, development miss, QA miss) to support continuous process improvement. 

Reporting & Metrics Prepare and maintain dashboards tracking release/deployment quality, test coverage, automation progress, and defect trends. Track and report failure metrics by category (requirement gaps, development defects, QA escapes) to identify systemic improvement areas. Present quality summaries to stakeholders (BA, Tech Leads, Product Owners, Management) at sprint and release milestones. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of QA experience in e-commerce, with at least 2+ years working on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) or similar platforms
 - Solid understanding of B2B e-commerce workflows (account management, contract pricing, quotes, approvals, punchout)
 - Experience testing integrations involving SAP ECC and middleware/integration layers (SAP Datahub or similar, e. g. , MuleSoft, Boomi)
 - Familiarity with SAP Commerce Backoffice for configuration validation
 - Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar; SAP Commerce-specific test frameworks a plus)
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum sprint cycles and CI/CD-driven delivery
 - Strong test case design skills covering positive, negative, edge, and boundary scenarios
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e. g. , JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, ALM)
 - Ability to build reporting dashboards (e. g. , JIRA dashboards, Power BI, Excel, or similar) for tracking quality metrics
 - Strong analytical skills to classify and root-cause defects (requirement, development, or QA origin)
 - Excellent communication skills to collaborate with BAs, Tech Leads, Developers, and Product OwnersPreferred Qualifications

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. You will provide architectural leadership for ClaimCenter implementations, claims transformation programs, and digital experience solutions built using Jutro, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions that accelerate customer value. 

This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers' path to value while contributing to Professional Services' mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation. 

Job Description

What you'll do

Required

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - IPv6 Networking exp is a must**
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

About the Role

SonicWall is seeking a Senior Software Engineer  with deep IPv6 expertise to lead the design, implementation, and hardening of IPv6 capabilities across the Sonicwall firewall firmware stack. As a Principal Engineer, you will be the technical authority for IPv6 feature parity, protocol correctness, and interoperability across SonicWall Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms. This role is ideal for engineers with hands-on experience delivering IPv6 in high-performance router, switch, or carrier-grade networking products who are looking to apply that expertise in the embedded network security domain. 

Responsibilities

- Lead IPv6 Architecture & Feature Delivery - Own end-to-end design and implementation of IPv6 features across the Sonicwall frewall networking stack, including IPv6 routing, interface addressing, DHCPv6, NDP, MLDv2, and IPv6 Policy-Based Routing (PBR). 
 - Drive IPv6 Feature Parity - Identify and close gaps between IPv4 and IPv6 feature sets across subsystems - including VPN Tunnel Interfaces, IPsec/IKEv2, SSL-VPN, Syslog, SNMP, and NAT64 - ensuring consistent dual-stack and IPv6-only operation. 
 - Design High-Performance IPv6 Packet Processing Paths - Architect and optimize the IPv6 dataplane for packet forwarding, classification, ACL matching, and session lookup within the sonicwall high-performance packet-processing pipeline. 
 - Resolve Complex IPv6 Protocol Issues - Diagnose and resolve deep-rooted interoperability, conformance, and performance issues involving IPv6 neighbor discovery, prefix delegation, ICMPv6 error handling, and fragmentation edge cases. 
 - Establish IPv6 Protocol Conformance Standards - Define and drive compliance with IETF IPv6 RFCs (RFC 2460, RFC 4291, RFC 4861, RFC 4862, RFC 6724, RFC 8200, and related extensions) within the Sonicwall frewall codebase. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Platform, Security, Data Platform, and QA teams to integrate IPv6 changes safely across subsystems and validate correctness at scale. 
 - Prototype and Evaluate IPv6 Technologies - Evaluate emerging IPv6 transition mechanisms (464XLAT, MAP-T, CLAT, SRv6) and contribute to next-generation NGFW networking capabilities. 
 - Influence Technical Direction - Drive architectural decisions, IPv6 scalability strategies, and long-term technical roadmap for protocol parity and government/federal compliance (USGv6, IPv6-ready certification, DoD IPv6 mandates). 
 - Mentorship & Technical Leadership - Serve as the IPv6 subject-matter expert (SME) for the Sonicwall frewall engineering org; mentor senior and mid-level engineers and lead cross-team IPv6 technical design reviews. Requirements

- 7- 9+ years of hands-on C/C++ systems-level development for networking platforms - with a strong emphasis on routers, Layer-3 switches, carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) devices, or network security appliances. 
 - Deep IPv6 Protocol Expertise - Proven, production-level implementation experience with: 
 - IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and prefix delegation (DHCPv6-PD)
 - Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP), Router Advertisements (RA), and MLDv2
 - IPv6 routing protocols (OSPFv3, BGP with IPv6 AFI/SAFI, RIPng)
 - IPsec/IKEv2 over IPv6 transport
 - IPv6 ACLs, PBR, and traffic classification at line rate
 - IPv6 transition and coexistence mechanisms (Dual-Stack, 6in4, 6rd, NAT64/DNS64, 464XLAT)
 - L2/L3/L4 Networking Depth - Solid understanding of Ethernet, VLANs, 802. 1Q, bridging, routing (static and dynamic), NAT, firewall state tables, and VPN tunneling in the context of both IPv4 and IPv6. 
 - High-Performance Packet Processing - Experience with DPDK, ODP, OFP, XDP/eBPF, or comparable frameworks for low-latency, high-throughput packet forwarding is a strong advantage. 
 - Protocol Conformance & Testing - Experience validating IPv6 implementations against IETF RFC requirements and government IPv6-ready test suites (USGv6, IPv6-Ready Logo Phase-2) is highly desirable. 
 - Strong Debugging & Diagnostic Skills - Proficient with tcpdump, Wireshark (IPv6 dissectors), GDB, kernel trace tools, and network emulation environments (GNS3, EVE-NG, or equivalent) for root-cause analysis of IPv6 issues. 
 - Communication & Leadership - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to lead cross-functional IPv6 design discussions, write technical specifications, and represent engineering in product and architecture reviews. Nice to Have

- Experience with government / federal IPv6 compliance requirements (DoD IPv6 mandate, NIST SP 500-267, USGv6 Profile). 
 - Exposure to SRv6 (Segment Routing over IPv6) or MPLS over IPv6 architectures. 
 - Familiarity with Sonicwall frewall, SonicWall NGFWs, or similar embedded network security firmware. 
 - Working knowledge of WireGuard over IPv6 transport. 
 - Experience with automated IPv6 test frameworks (RFC 2544, IXIA, Spirent, or similar).

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran's test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques. 

As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran's testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results. 

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. 

Technologies You'll Use

- Java11, JUnit5, 
 - Docker and Kubernetes
 - AWS, GCP
 - Terraform, WireMock, RestAssured
 - Bazel, BuildKite

What You'll Do

- Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback. 
 - Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness. 
 - Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments. 
 - Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions. 
 - Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to: 
 - Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
 - Generate high-quality test scenarios
 - Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
 - Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
 - Enhance developer and QA productivity
 - Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines. 
 - Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes. 
 - Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking. 

Skills We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence. 
 - Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, Buildkite. 
 - Experience working with backend automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of database testing and ETL/data pipeline validation is a strong plus. 

AI & Productivity Engineering

- Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities. 
 - Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines. 
 - Ability to design prompt strategies, validate LLM outputs rigorously and implement safeguards to prevent hallucinations or unsafe automation. 
 - Experience streamlining workflows using AI to improve measurable engineering productivity. 
 - Comfortable feeding, tuning and orchestrating AI agents to solve real engineering problems. 
 - Strong outcome orientation, measures success through impact, reliability gains and velocity improvements rather than output volume. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*
 - Professional development and training opportunities
 - Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
 - Monthly cell phone stipend
 - Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities.

 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Lead initiatives with high accountability, create a collaborative environment with a solution-based approach. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor and mentor for the team offering technical advice. 
 - Ability to communicate with precision, engaging team and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships across cross-functional teams and geographies enabling organizational alignment. 
 - Ability to set priorities with the team by understanding interdependence, inspiring team members with consistent focus, quality output, and timelines. 
 - Constantly keep oneself updated on current technology & trends to drive innovative decisions through piloting forward-thinking approaches to complex problems in one's own area of work. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer priorities and business challenges while creating value for technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to break down complex problems into concise impact statements. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Experience with a modern front-end framework is a plus
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. Why join?

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platforms
data.description:
We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer for Arm's AI Platforms team in Bangalore. You will help shape technical direction, build production software, and establish the engineering practices of a growing team. Working with the Director of Engineering and technical leaders across Arm, you will take responsibility for significant platform capabilities and remain closely involved in their implementation. 

We are looking for an exemplary practitioner whose code, technical decisions, and approach to difficult problems set the standard for the team. You will combine systems engineering depth with hands-on expertise in agentic AI across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), helping engineers embrace new methods and assess their effect on delivery and quality. 

Responsibilities

- Define technical direction with engineering leadership. Assess platform needs, explore design options, and turn decisions into software the team can deliver and operate. 
 - Design and implement distributed platform services. Write critical code, review implementations, and rapid prototyping to test uncertain assumptions before committing to a design. 
 - Shape the engineering culture through daily practice. Help the team deliver frequent changes with clear ownership, useful design and code reviews, and verification appropriate to the software being built. 
 - Build and use agentic AI workflows across the SDLC. Give agents useful project context, connect them to development tools, and establish feedback through tests and code review. Measure their effect on delivery speed and software quality. 
 - Keep current with developments in software engineering, AI development tools, and cloud systems. Evaluate promising approaches through hands-on experiments and adopt them when the results justify the change. 
 - Resolve difficult design and production problems involving concurrency, data consistency, performance, and failure recovery. Use what you learn to improve the architecture and the team's engineering practices. 
 - Help recruit staff and senior engineers, and develop their judgment through shared technical work. Support engineers in taking ownership of complete capabilities and working through unfamiliar problems. 
 - Partner with Arm teams in the US and UK on architecture and shared interfaces. Make technical decisions understandable and establish clear ownership across teams. 

Required skills and experience

- 12+ years building distributed software, cloud platforms, or production infrastructure, or equivalent experience demonstrated through the scope and impact of your work. 
 - Strong programming skills in Go, C++, Rust, Python, or a comparable language. Experience designing service interfaces, working with concurrency and persistent data, and debugging complex failures. 
 - Experience building and operating software on Kubernetes and Linux, with an understanding of workload lifecycle, networking, resource management, and failure recovery. 
 - Hands-on expertise with agentic AI tools and harnesses for the SDLC. Experience configuring and extending workflows, assessing generated code, and verifying changes through automated checks and engineering review. 
 - A record of technical leadership grounded in your own engineering work, including mentoring experienced engineers, explaining design choices, and improving how a team develops software. 

Preferred skills and experience

- Experience with AI inference infrastructure or model serving, including how workload and hardware choices affect latency, throughput, and resource use. Knowledge of inference performance and resource-efficiency considerations. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, Ray, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or Dynamo or experience qualifying accelerators and tuning distributed workloads. 
 - Kubernetes controllers or operators, deployment systems, or software that manages releases across different compute environments. 
 - Developer productivity tools, build and test infrastructure for large scale distributed systems. 
 - Distributed tracing, observability, diagnostics, or data processing systems used to understand production behavior. 

In Return: 

We provide an opportunity to learn about the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with a highly skilled engineering team on ground-breaking technology!

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
