data.title: Web Developer - Webflow, Marketo
data.description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions-creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels. 

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth-turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection. 

Job Summary

Role Purpose

Candescent is seeking a skilled Web Developer to build, maintain, and continuously improve our website from one of our India office locations. You will work closely with marketing, design, and strategy stakeholders to bring pages and campaigns to life quickly and cleanly, with a strong focus on hands-on Webflow development and integrating web experiences with Marketo for lead capture and marketing automation. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys turning designs into polished, performant, well-structured pages and is comfortable owning the technical execution of a marketing website. You will work under the direction of the senior web developer in India, who will set priorities, review your work, and provide technical coaching. 

Key Responsibilities And Deliverables

What you will be responsible for and what you will do

Build & Maintain

- Build, update, and maintain website pages, templates, and components in Webflow, following design specifications and brand guidelines. 
 - Maintain clean, scalable Webflow CMS structures including collections, fields, and dynamic content that non-technical teammates can manage. 
 - Implement responsive, accessible, cross-browser designs from Figma or similar design files. 
 - Perform regular site maintenance including fixing broken links, resolving bugs, managing redirects, and monitoring uptime. 

Marketing Systems & Tracking

- Integrate and troubleshoot Marketo forms, tracking scripts, and landing pages within the website, ensuring accurate lead capture and data flow into marketing automation. 
 - Implement and maintain tracking and analytics tags such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin in coordination with marketing stakeholders. 
 - Support A/B testing initiatives by implementing test variants and experiment code on landing pages. 

Performance & Quality

- Optimise pages for site speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance. 
 - Ensure SEO best practices are followed in markup, including meta tags, structured data, semantic HTML, URL structure, and redirects. 
 - Translate designs accurately, with strong attention to spacing, typography, and visual detail. 

Collaboration & Ways of Working

- Collaborate with designers, marketers, and project managers to scope, estimate, and deliver web requests on time. 
 - Work closely with the senior web developer in India, who will set priorities, review work, and provide technical direction and coaching. 
 - Maintain basic documentation of site structure, components, and workflows. 
 - Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs. 

Experience

Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience

- 3-5 years of experience building and maintaining websites, including hands-on Webflow development across Designer and CMS. 
 - Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
 - Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform for forms and tracking on a website. 
 - Familiarity with responsive design principles and cross-browser and device testing. 
 - Basic understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup and structure. 
 - Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate designs accurately. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and projects at once. 
 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced marketing environment with shifting priorities. 

Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions

Additional accomplishments

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a portfolio of live sites will be considered. 
 - Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager is preferred. 
 - Experience with other no-code or low-code website platforms and content management systems is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with version control such as Git for custom code embeds is a plus. 
 - Basic experience with A/B testing tools is a plus. 
 - Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred. 
 - Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful. 

What Success Looks Like

- Web pages and campaigns are built accurately, on time, and match design intent. 
 - Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors. 
 - The site stays fast, functional, and free of recurring bugs. 
 - Webflow CMS is organised and maintainable by both developers and marketers. 
 - Requests are delivered predictably, with clear communication on status and blockers. 

What Will Make You Successful

- Care for the small details that separate a good build from a sloppy one. 
 - Willingness to ask questions early rather than guessing at requirements. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum. 
 - Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones. 
 - A collaborative, low-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback. 
 - Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment. 

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve Walmart's next-generation International Pricing platforms. 

The International Pricing team enables Walmart's mission of Every Day Low Price (EDLP). At its core, the team is responsible for the systems that help set, manage, approve, and execute prices for first-party items across Walmart's international markets. 

The platforms you build will support multiple countries, each representing a multi-billion-dollar business. You will solve complex engineering and business problems involving large-scale data processing, pricing recommendations, rules and workflows, downstream price execution, resiliency, auditability, and market-specific requirements. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write production-quality code, lead architecture and design, review critical technical decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. 

About The Team

Walmart International Technology enables our stores, eCommerce operations, associates, and customers across markets outside the United States. 

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets. 

What You'll Do

Remain hands-on and contribute production-quality code for critical platform capabilities, complex integrations, and technically challenging initiatives. 

Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for International Pricing platforms. 

Write high-quality design documents, including HLDs, LLDs, Architecture Decision Records, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams, and operational readiness plans. 

Review architecture and technical designs produced by engineering teams and ensure alignment with platform standards, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Design and build scalable, high-throughput, and low-latency Java- or Kotlin-based microservices deployed on cloud infrastructure. 

Build extensible pricing capabilities using domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, Kafka, API-first principles, and well-defined service boundaries. 

Design solutions for pricing recommendations, rule evaluation, approvals, simulations, publishing, execution, auditability, and downstream-system integration. 

Own data-modelling and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data stores, with a strong focus on data accuracy, lineage, consistency, and traceability. 

Design resilient distributed workflows using appropriate patterns such as orchestration, outbox, retries, circuit breaking, idempotency, and dead-letter processing. 

Define REST and gRPC APIs with clear contracts, backward-compatibility guarantees, versioning strategies, and consumer-driven contract testing. 

Design for multi-market and multi-tenant use cases while balancing global platform consistency with market-specific business requirements. 

Identify and proactively address systemic risks, including scaling bottlenecks, single points of failure, data-integrity gaps, operational dependencies, and technical-debt accumulation. 

Drive architecture and integration alignment with shared platforms and downstream systems responsible for price calculation, price publishing, execution, catalogue, analytics, and store operations. 

Represent International Pricing in cross-organizational architecture and engineering forums. 

Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security validation, canary deployment, rollback, and production verification. 

Drive observability-first engineering through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, actionable alerts, and business-flow monitoring. 

Ensure that services comply with enterprise security, privacy, infrastructure, and software-development standards. 

Lead production-readiness reviews, incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reliability-improvement initiatives. 

Mentor junior, mid-level, and senior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, pairing, and structured feedback. 

Establish engineering standards for design quality, code quality, automated testing, performance, security, release readiness, and operational excellence. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Business, Program, Quality Engineering, and other platform teams to translate complex pricing requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Promote a platform-first mindset by creating reusable and configurable capabilities that enable multiple markets and engineering teams without duplicating solutions. 

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value. 

Make sound technical decisions and solve complex problems efficiently in a high-impact, fast-moving environment. 

What You'll Bring

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed-system fundamentals, design patterns, and software-engineering principles. 

Strong experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms and asynchronous processing patterns. 

Experience designing and operating systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 

Advanced experience with cloud infrastructure such as Azure, GCP, or AWS. 

Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, service-to-service communication, autoscaling, resource management, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

Experience designing systems that process large data volumes while maintaining strong consistency, traceability, performance, and availability. 

Demonstrated ability to author clear technical designs and influence architecture across multiple teams. 

Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, messaging, and data layers. 

Experience driving engineering excellence through automated testing, performance optimization, reliability improvements, operational readiness, and incident prevention. 

Experience integrating machine-learning inference APIs or model endpoints into production services. 

Familiarity with GenAI-assisted engineering tools and their responsible use across software-development workflows. 

Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus-building skills. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical capabilities of the broader team. 

Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform architecture and sustainability. 

Experience building or operating large-scale retail, eCommerce, pricing, promotion, markdown, or revenue-management platforms. 

Understanding of retail pricing concepts such as EDLP, competitive pricing, price rules, simulations, approvals, price execution, regional pricing, and markdown optimization. 

Experience building multi-tenant or multi-market platforms with shared global capabilities and configurable market-specific behaviour. 

Experience integrating with complex upstream and downstream enterprise systems. 

A continuous drive to simplify, automate, improve, and optimize platforms, tools, development workflows, and operational processes. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

About Us

Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%. Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers. 

At Landmark Digital, we cultivate an agile work culture, empowering you to make impactful decisions from day one within collaborative squads comprising professionals from over 20 nationalities. Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products. Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies, including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development. 

In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits, we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally. Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Staff SDE - IBM OMS Sterling who will serve as a technical leader, driving architectural direction, multi-team initiatives, and the development of highly scalable distributed systems. You will partner with Product, Architecture, DevOps and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful technology solutions across a complex digital ecosystem. 

You will independently define and deliver large-scale, multi-phase projects, mentor engineers, and shape technical strategy. The role also includes leveraging LLMs and GenAI-driven tools to enhance engineering productivity, reduce cycle time, and build the next generation of internal developer experience tools. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Drive technical strategy and architecture for complex distributed systems and core platform components. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact, multi-team engineering initiatives. 
 - Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, pragmatic technical solutions. 
 - Define technical roadmaps, sequence projects into phases, and ensure timely execution across teams. Software Engineering & System Design

- Architect, develop, and optimize microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud. 
 - Design scalable, resilient, secure cloud-native applications. 
 - Lead system design reviews, architecture discussions, and technical deep dives. 
 - Solve complex cross-system issues through deep debugging, performance tuning, and root cause analysis. 
 - Build frameworks and shared libraries to accelerate development across squads. AI & Engineering Productivity

- Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices and LLM/GenAI tools across engineering teams to enhance workflows, improve cycle time, and automate routine tasks. 
 - Define clear guidelines, training, and standards for effective and secure use of AI tools, including prompt engineering, code generation, and review expectations. 
 - Integrate AI-driven capabilities such as code generation, unit test creation, log analysis, documentation summarization, and code review assistance into the development workflow. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices for AI-generated code, including human-in-the-loop reviews, coding standards, test automation, secure coding, and design-first development. 
 - Measure and optimize engineering productivity using AI-related metrics (cycle time, PR throughput, AI-code adoption, defect escape rate, developer satisfaction) and continuously identify opportunities to reduce bottlenecks with AI. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact

- Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, QE, DevOps, and peer engineering teams. 
 - Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate across teams to resolve dependencies and align on architectural standards. 
 - Influence technical direction beyond your immediate team. Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Mentor engineers across multiple teams, guiding them in design, coding, debugging, and best practices. 
 - Participate actively in hiring and talent development. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design critiques, and technical leadership. 
 - Help define and uphold engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural principles. Ownership & Operational Excellence

- Take full ownership of systems from development to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
 - Ensure engineering deliverables meet performance, reliability, and security criteria. 
 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and propose scalable, maintainable solutions. 
 - Lead incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Skills and Qualifications

Must-Have - IBM Sterling OMS

- 10+ years of professional experience in IBM OMS Sterling Development. 
 - Hands-on experience with IBM Sterling OMS on-premises - order lifecycle management, distributed order management (DOM), and fulfilment workflows. 
 - Proficiency in Sterling customization: Java extensions via YFS/SMCFS APIs, pipeline configuration (condition trees, transaction pipelines), agent framework, and service framework. 
 - Deep understanding of Sterling Agent Server architecture: master/child agent processes, agent criteria, job thresholds, and concurrency impact on database performance. 
 - Ability to diagnose Sterling on-premises JVM issues: heap sizing, GC tuning (G1/ZGC), root cause analysis, and thread dump/heap dump interpretation. 
 - Experience with IBM Sterling Configuration Deployment Tool (CDT) and environment promotion governance across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Experience with IBM Inventory Visibility (IV): supply, demand class modelling, net availability calculation, and OMS-IV integration. 
 - Understanding of inventory supply and demand mapping: how WMS feeds populate IV supply and how OMS order reservations reduce net availability. 
 - Experience implementing REST-based inventory reservation flows from e-commerce platforms through OMS into IBM IV - including idempotency, retry, rollback, and reservation release on cancellation. 
 - Ability to articulate the end-to-end customer order journey and every OMS/IV touch point - from PDP availability check through order creation, fulfilment, and returns. Assessed in interview. 
 - Delivered at least two IBM Sterling OMS implementations or major platform transformations; able to articulate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and lessons learned from each. 
 - Proven experience shipping scalable, high-availability, high-performance systems, including load handling, horizontal scaling, observability, and fault-tolerant design. 
 - Experience with WAS Application, JMS, distributed system patterns, caching, asynchronous processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of working with databases: Oracle
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, debugging capabilities, and system-level thinking. 
 - Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. 
 - Ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive technical initiatives. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience applying LLMs/GenAI to improve engineering productivity and developer workflows. 
 - Prompt engineering experience and familiarity with integrating models into applications. 
 - Experience with Domain-Driven Design, event-driven systems, CQRS, or enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Familiarity with Linux systems and container-based deployment architectures. 
 - Experience with application servers such as Tomcat. 
 - Contributions to internal platforms or open-source projects. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong leadership qualities with the ability to influence without authority. 
 - High levels of self-motivation, ownership, and drive. 
 - Critical thinking abilities and a strong problem-solving mindset. 
 - Excellent team collaboration skills and a positive, proactive attitude. 
 - Adaptability, willingness to learn, and continuous improvement mindset. 
 - Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple competing priorities effectively.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform Engineering)
data.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world's leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit  www. saviynt. com. 

This is a Principal position within the  Platform Engineering organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated Platform Engineering hat, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience. 

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering-working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams-while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- 
12+ Years of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure. 

- 
Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production. 

- 
Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane. 

- 
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies. 

- 
Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends. 

- 
GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience-building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams. 

- 
Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale-module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases. 

- 
Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems. 

- 
Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures. 

- 
Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters. 

- 
Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs. 

- 
Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability. 

- 
Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs. 

- 
Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP). 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOINGInternal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal

- Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning. 

- Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles. 

- Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails. 

- Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach. 

Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations

- Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses. 

- Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments. 

Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes

- Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users. 

- Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams. 

- Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level. 

- Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations. 

GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure

- Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption. 

- Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows. 

- Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure. 

API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure

- Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives. 

- Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths. 

Infrastructure Automation & IaC

- Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default. 

- Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane). 

- Engineer custom Go-based CLI tools and operators to automate critical platform tasks, including cost tracking and credential rotation. 

Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience

- Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics. 

- Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths. 

- Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants. 

- Integrate chaos testing and automated disaster recovery (DR) failover verification to meet strict enterprise SaaS uptime requirements. 

Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default

- Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies. 

- Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity. 

- Streamline secrets management by providing a secure, automated, self-service platform capability. 

- Build compliance-as-code into CI/CD pipelines to automatically generate audit trails and SBOM documentation required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP certifications. 

Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure

- Manage shared messaging infrastructure systems like Kafka and AWS MSK, delivering topic provisioning and schema management as a robust platform service. 

- Construct reusable patterns and scaffold templates that allow product teams to easily implement event-driven architectures from within the IDP. 

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

Security & Compliance
This role requires adherence to Saviynt's information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training. 

Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Full Stack Engineer based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced Principal Full Stack Engineer to shape the technical direction of a global SaaS platform serving millions of volunteers across multiple countries. In this senior individual contributor role, you will combine hands-on software development with architectural leadership to build scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems. You will work across multiple product teams, solving complex engineering challenges and driving critical initiatives from technical discovery through delivery. With a strong focus on Laravel, Next. js, and cloud infrastructure, you will help evolve a modern platform toward event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, and AI-augmented capabilities. You will influence engineering standards, strengthen software quality, and mentor developers through collaboration and technical excellence. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to make a lasting impact on product strategy, platform architecture, and engineering practices within a collaborative, product-focused environment. 

Accountabilities

- Technical Architecture and Direction: Own the architecture and technical direction of core platform domains, establishing scalable modular boundaries, event-driven workflows, and foundations for AI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Hands-on Engineering: Dedicate approximately 60-80% of your time to designing, coding, reviewing, debugging, and pairing on complex technical challenges across Laravel, PHP, Next. js, and cloud environments. 
 - Cross-Team Technical Leadership: Work across multiple product squads to resolve complex engineering problems, lead technical discovery, and deliver high-impact initiatives that span teams and systems. 
 - Engineering Standards: Define, document, and promote architectural principles, coding standards, and development patterns that improve system reliability, maintainability, security, and observability. 
 - Quality Engineering and Delivery: Champion shift-left testing, robust test strategies, CI/CD improvements, regression control, and production monitoring to ensure consistent software quality and reliable releases. 
 - Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Guide senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing sessions, and constructive feedback, empowering them to take ownership of systems and technical decisions. 
 - Innovation and AI Integration: Evaluate and prototype emerging technologies, including generative AI workflows, AI agents, data pipelines, and tools such as Vertex AI, helping teams adopt practical solutions that enhance product capabilities. 
 - Strategic Collaboration: Partner with engineering leadership and technical leads on long-term architecture, roadmap planning, estimation, prioritization, and technical trade-offs while ensuring engineering health remains aligned with business objectives. 
 - Platform Evolution: Support architectural improvements involving event-driven systems, distributed workflows, cloud infrastructure, and future platform capabilities, including AI readiness and multi-cloud development. 

Requirements

- Professional Experience: At least 8 years of software engineering experience, including experience in a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Software Architect role within a SaaS environment. 
 - Backend Development: Deep expertise in Laravel 10+, PHP 8+, or comparable backend technologies, with strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, relational databases, SQL, caching, and backend system design. 
 - Frontend Engineering: Strong experience with React and modern frontend architecture, ideally including Next. js and the ability to design maintainable, scalable user-facing applications. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Proven experience building and operating secure, scalable cloud-native systems, with AWS required and exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) highly desirable. 
 - Architecture and Distributed Systems: Familiarity with event-driven architectures, modular system design, containerized environments, Kubernetes/EKS, asynchronous workflows, and distributed system principles. 
 - Software Quality and Delivery: Deep understanding of testing strategies, automated validation, CI/CD pipelines, production observability, performance optimization, and regression prevention. 
 - AI-Driven Development: Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Gemini, automating development workflows, and improving feature delivery through test generation, scaffolding, and code assistance. 
 - AI-Augmented Products: Familiarity with integrating large language model APIs, prompt design, generative AI workflows, or AI agent architectures. Experience coaching other engineers in AI-assisted development is an advantage. 
 - Additional Technical Strengths: Knowledge of analytics platforms such as Looker or BigQuery, data pipelines, machine learning workflows, message queues such as AWS SQS or Kafka, and distributed-system performance tuning is beneficial. 
 - Leadership and Communication: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence technical decisions without relying on formal management authority. 
 - Product and Business Mindset: A proactive, adaptable, and customer-focused approach, with the ability to translate product goals into sound technical decisions, manage ambiguity, document decisions clearly, and collaborate across disciplines. 

Benefits

- Fully Remote Work: Flexibility to work remotely, with an emphasis on sustainable productivity and managing energy rather than fixed hours. 
 - Flexible Working Arrangements: Greater autonomy in organizing your schedule and balancing professional responsibilities. 
 - Professional Development: Access to online learning platforms and a dedicated budget for training and career growth. 
 - Collaborative Culture: A supportive, low-silo environment that encourages knowledge sharing, technical experimentation, and cross-team collaboration. 
 - Team Engagement: Opportunities to participate in team lunches, social events, and activities that encourage creativity and connection.

Role Description A Senior Embedded Software Manager -PMSM Motor Control leads the design, development, and team execution of firmware, control algorithms, and software architectures for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) & it's related peripherals, communications etc. This role spans automotive traction/Motor drives, industrial automation systems, and high-volume consumer appliances.

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end embedded software and system architectures for 3-phase PMSM motor control Electronic Control Units (ECUs), industrial drives, and appliance control boards.

 - Application Scope Strategy: Drive software engineering for diverse applications including EV traction drives, automotive thermal management (electronic water pumps, cooling fans), industrial servo drives, and consumer motor control applications like air conditioning compressor controls. 
 - People & Program Management: Lead, mentor, and scale cross-functional embedded software and motor-control engineering teams. Handle sprint planning, milestone tracking, and cross-department collaboration. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to industry safety and quality standards, managing software lifecycles compliant as per industry needs e. g. ISO 26262 (Automotive ASIL), IEC 61508 (Industrial), IEC 60730 (Consumer Safety), ASPICE, and MISRA C guidelines. 
 - Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with power electronics, inverter hardware, and systems engineering for debugging, HIL/SIL/MIL validation, and motor dynamometer testing.

data.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we're on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We're looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. 

What You'll Do

As an experienced software engineer utilizing test instrumentation with a broad scope for implementing Viasat's test and measurement strategies, you will provide technical insights and skill to the product test engineering organization. You will drive long-term improvement of the organization's testing processes and growth in a multi-customer/multi-vendor/multi-configuration environment. 

You will need to think long-term and lay out scalable and maintainable solutions solving issues impacting customer test systems, with effective test measurement tools. You will need a clear understanding of the Test Development Life Cycle and consistently look beyond the current solutions and may have several deliverables not tied to a particular test process and platform. You will deal with broad issues and will be expected to provide solutions along with support. You will use your knowledge of software engineering processes, measurement methodologies, and instrumentation to continually improve all aspects of Viasat's test software solutions. 

You will work together with test engineers of different groups to improve their teams test strategies and make sure test coverage is complete among different teams and areas. In short, you will assist in defining the high-level testing strategies, while implementing the low-level frameworks and tools which make those strategies possible. This includes implementing and leveraging drivers, abstractions, libraries, and frameworks. 

In addition, you will have wide-reaching scope, impact and influence that extend beyond the confines of the Test organization and span the entire organization. Ultimately, you will be responsible for ensuring a quality test platform, delivered across all parameters, both functional and non-functional including performance, security, usability, etc. Sound interesting? Keep reading. . . 

The day-to-day

Viasat's Instrumentation test and driver development. 

Develop measurement strategies. 

Unit test, integration and automation test for testing. 

What You'll Need

- Minimum 6 years of professional experience working with RF and digital test instrumentation (e. g. , Spectrum and Network Analyzers, Oscilloscopes) and measurement techniques and methodologies (e. g. , Noise Figure, Spurious Emissions, IP3)
 - Strong understanding of instrument communication, capabilities, file formats, and calibration types. 
 - Experience in designing, documenting, developing, and debugging instrument driver APIs (e. g. , IVI), services, measurements, and tests.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in India. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute your technical expertise to the training and evaluation of next-generation artificial intelligence systems. You will design realistic software engineering challenges that assess AI models' ability to write reliable code, implement features, resolve bugs, refactor complex codebases, and optimize performance. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical capabilities of AI-generated software through rigorous testing and deterministic verification. You will draw on your experience in backend development, algorithms, system design, debugging, and software quality assurance to create meaningful technical assessments. Working independently in a fully remote, flexible contract role, you will have the opportunity to apply your engineering judgment to cutting-edge AI development.  - Excellent analytical thinking, technical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex engineering challenges independently. 
 - Strong written communication skills and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear, reproducible coding tasks and verification criteria. 
 - Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and consistently deliver high-quality results in a remote, contract-based environment. 

Additional Skills That Would Be Advantageous

 - Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), distributed systems, microservices, and architectural design patterns.

Position Summary

HealthEdge is seeking a Manager, DevOps to lead the offshore DevOps engineering team supporting HealthRules® Payer (HRP) and related platforms. This role owns day-to-day delivery, technical direction, and people leadership for the India-based DevOps organization, reporting to the Director, DevOps (India). The Manager will partner closely with onshore DevOps leadership, HRP Engineering, Release Management, InfoSec, and Infrastructure Platform teams to execute the CI/CD modernization, AWS migration, and security remediation roadmap while building a resilient, well-coached team. 

This is a hands-on people-management role: the Manager is expected to run day-to-day operations, remove blockers, coach engineers, and represent the offshore team's work and capacity accurately to onshore leadership - not simply relay status upward. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery Management

- Manage and coach a team of offshore DevOps engineers, including 1: 1s, performance feedback, and career development plans. 
 - Own sprint and quarterly planning for the offshore DevOps workstreams, ensuring realistic capacity allocation across CI/CD, security remediation, and AWS migration initiatives. 
 - Identify and remediate single-point-of-failure (SPOF) risk within the team by building cross-training plans and documented ownership for critical systems (CI/CD infrastructure, release tooling, environment automation). 
 - Provide regular, accurate status reporting to the Director, DevOps and onshore leadership using a decision-focused format (hot topics, upcoming milestones, blockers, risks). 
 - Escalate ownership, scope, or resourcing conflicts early, with clear recommendations rather than status updates alone. 

CI/CD & Platform Engineering Oversight

- Guide execution of the Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions migration, including EKS-based runner architecture, GitHub Apps authentication, and CI/CD pipeline modernization. 
 - Oversee Infrastructure-as-Code (CDK/Ansible) provisioning for internal environments (Dev, QA, Perf, Shared, Preprod), maintaining the boundary that DevOps owns internal environments while Release Management owns customer-facing environments. 
 - Drive the Azure-to-AWS migration workstream for internally owned environments, coordinating with Infrastructure Platform and networking teams to resolve cutover blockers. 
 - Ensure code release, build, and deployment tooling (Nexus, Sonar, Jenkins) is kept current, secure, and migrated per the platform roadmap. 

Security & Compliance Execution

- Lead the offshore team's execution of Q4 security initiatives originating from InfoSec, including dependency-tree generation, secrets detection/rotation, vulnerable-commit blocking, and Wiz runtime integration. 
 - Own DevOps' portion of the secrets remediation program: guardrail tooling, Secrets Manager/Vault integration, and coordination with repo owners and Release Management on rotation. 
 - Maintain clear RACI boundaries when scoping security work - DevOps owns pipeline-level guardrails; repo and environment owners drive remediation; Release Management owns customer-environment actions. 
 - Support FedRAMP 20x and CMS POC evidence requirements as they relate to DevOps-owned controls (STIG AMIs, TLS, Secrets Manager, GitHub Apps, IaC). 

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Partner with the Director, DevOps, onshore senior ICs, and HRP Engineering leadership to align on architecture, release cadence, and upcoming platform changes before they reach the team mid-quarter. 
 - Represent the offshore team in the monthly DevOps/Engineering cadence and biweekly senior IC forums, surfacing toil, risk, and proactive architectural concerns. 
 - Coordinate with Infrastructure Platform, InfoSec, and Release Management to resolve cross-team ownership gaps before they become production issues. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Platform Engineering roles, with at least 2-3 years in a people-management or team-lead capacity. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing distributed or offshore engineering teams, including performance management and coaching plans. 
 - Strong hands-on background in CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK, Ansible, Terraform), and cloud platforms (AWS required; Azure a plus). 
 - Working knowledge of GitHub administration, including GitHub Apps, PAT-to-App migrations, and repository governance at scale (400+ repositories). 
 - Experience with artifact and dependency management tooling (Nexus, Sonar) and secrets management platforms (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager). 
 - Familiarity with security remediation workflows: vulnerability scanning, dependency-tree analysis, secrets rotation, and runtime security tooling (e. g. , Wiz). 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to produce concise, decision-focused updates for senior leadership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve single-point-of-failure risk and to build redundancy into critical operational functions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting healthcare technology, claims processing, or other regulated/compliance-heavy platforms. 
 - Familiarity with FedRAMP, HITRUST, or similar compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) for CI/CD runner infrastructure or application workloads. 
 - Exposure to DORA metrics and engineering-productivity measurement programs. 
 - Prior experience operating in a matrixed organization with distinct onshore/offshore reporting lines. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 6 Months

- Offshore team capacity, ownership, and SPOF risks are documented and actively being mitigated through cross-training. 
 - Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions and AWS migration workstreams are progressing against a jointly owned, realistic timeline with clear blockers surfaced early. 
 - Security remediation items owned by DevOps show measurable burn-down, with clean ownership boundaries agreed upon with InfoSec and Release Management. 
 - The Director, DevOps and onshore leadership have consistent visibility into offshore delivery through structured, decision-focused reporting.

Date: Oct 19, 2026

Job Requisition Id: 66764

Location: 

Pune, IN

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation. 

At YASH, we're a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth - bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future. 

We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas : 

Experience Level 8+ Years

Job Title: Lead Quality Engineer / MDM Test Engineer

Role Overview

We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our Reltio MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match & merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes - ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness. 
 - Test match & merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations. 
 - Validate integration pipelines (batch and real-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. 
 - Perform data quality testing - profiling, validation, and reconciliation - across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub. 
 - Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium. 
 - Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar. 
 - Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations. 
 - Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria. 
 - Validate data migration activities - pre-migration, mid-migration, and post-migration - ensuring data integrity and completeness. 
 - Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles. 
 - Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports. 
 - Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 3+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1-2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar). 
 - Hands-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts - entities, relationships, match & merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows - sufficient to design meaningful test cases. 
 - Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools. 
 - Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy). 
 - Experience with data quality testing concepts - completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness. 
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy. 
 - Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines. 
 - Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus. 
 - Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. ) for automated testing workflows. 
 - Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects. 
 - Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements. 
 - Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services. 

Key Competencies

- Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset. 
 - Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams. 
 - Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks. 
 - Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions. 

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale. 

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles

- Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
 - Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
 - All Support needed for the realization of business goals, 
 - Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Company: Codewinglet Pvt Ltd

Location: Surat, Gujarat (Must be based in Surat or willing to relocate)

Experience: 1-6 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO)

About Codewinglet

Codewinglet Pvt. Ltd. is an AI-first engineering company building modern software products and solutions across AI, web, backend, and cloud technologies. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to build, automate, secure, and maintain reliable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. You will work with cloud, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, and monitoring tools to improve deployment efficiency and production reliability. 

You will take ownership of infrastructure and delivery tasks from implementation through troubleshooting and continuous improvement, collaborating closely with development and engineering teams. You will also contribute to technical design decisions, infrastructure reviews, incident resolution, and knowledge sharing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and application deployments across environments. 
 - Provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices. 
 - Manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. 
 - Monitor systems, investigate incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventive improvements. 
 - Apply cloud security best practices, manage secrets, and support vulnerability remediation. 
 - Optimize cloud costs, performance, availability, and resource utilization. 
 - Follow change-management practices and maintain technical documentation. 
 - Collaborate with development teams on automation, infrastructure design, and release reliability. 

Required Technical Skills

- Linux & Networking: Linux administration, troubleshooting, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls, load balancers, and AWS networking (VPC, subnets, routing, security groups). 
 - Git & Scripting: Git workflows, branching strategies, and Bash or Python scripting. 
 - Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, and hands-on Helm chart development, configuration, releases, and troubleshooting. 
 - CI/CD: Practical experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or an equivalent platform; automated builds, testing, deployments, and rollbacks. 
 - AWS: Hands-on experience with services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and EKS or ECS. 
 - Terraform: Infrastructure provisioning, reusable modules, remote state, state locking, environment separation, and plan/apply workflows. 
 - Monitoring & Security: Metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, incident troubleshooting, least-privilege IAM, secret management, and vulnerability scanning. 

Good To Have (Preferred Skills)

- Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux. 
 - DevSecOps tools such as Trivy, Gitleaks, SonarQube, or Snyk. 
 - OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SRE practices, or FinOps. 
 - Relevant certifications such as AWS SAA / DOP, CKA, CKAD, or Terraform Associate. 

Eligibility Criteria

- Experience: 1-6 years in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering. 
 - Education: Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Certifications: Cloud, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications are preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Willingness to work onsite in Surat and participate in operational support as required. 

What You Will Gain

- Hands-on ownership of real-world cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows. 
 - Opportunities to work on infrastructure design, automation, security, and cloud optimization. 
 - Structured learning paths, learning materials, and support for professional development. 
 - Growth opportunities toward Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or SRE roles. 

Soft Skills We Value

- Ownership, systematic problem-solving, curiosity, clear communication, collaboration, proactiveness, composure, and continuous improvement. 

Why Join Codewinglet?

- Modern products and technologies in an AI-first engineering environment. 
 - Real-time AI projects, including AI Agents and GenAI systems. 
 - High-growth, fast-paced learning environment. 
 - Exposure to the latest technologies and live projects. 
 - Supportive and transparent leadership. 
 - Clear career growth and performance-based appraisals. 
 - Competitive & industry-aligned salary. 
 - Stable team culture with regular engagement activities. 
 - Flexible working hours and 5-day work week. 
 - On-time salary disbursement.

 - Experience working in Linux environments, including familiarity with basic command-line operations. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD tools and continuous testing practices; experience with Jenkins is preferred. 
 - Basic to intermediate understanding of SQL for backend data validation and testing. 
 - Experience testing web applications, including functional, integration, regression, and cross-browser testing. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to software quality. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical and business teams.

 - Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams.

data.title: SWQA Test Developer Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has advanced computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. We are developing the next era of computing through AI, supported by dedicated people and a diverse, collaborative environment. 

We are seeking a SWQA Test Developer Engineer to join the Mobile QA Group and help deliver high-quality products built on NVIDIA Tegra systems on a chip (SoCs). You will be validating Nvidia Shield TV supporting AI-enhanced upscaling, 4K HDR, GeForce NOW cloud gaming, built in Google Assistant, which also supports Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, etc. You will work on AI platforms running Linux, Android, and proprietary operating systems, collaborating with engineers, workstream leads, and release managers. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Apply AI-powered tools and agents throughout the test development lifecycle to accelerate test generation, code development, test analysis, coverage improvement, log analysis, regression triage, root-cause analysis, and code reviews. 
 - Build and use an E2E AI Agentic Workflow with existing and custom agents and skills for every SDLC phase. This will expedite key objectives and important metrics of test and quality engineering. 
 - Develop AI framework for test strategies, plans, and detailed test cases from customer requirements; regularly implement tests for software features on Tegra-based platforms using AI-powered tools. 
 - Review product requirements, specifications, and technical designs, and provide feedback to improve testability and coverage. 
 - Develop applications, test tools, and automated tests using NVIDIA test frameworks for Tegra platforms. 
 - File clear bug reports, investigate failures, and work with engineers to triage issues and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with project management, hardware, and software teams; analyze priority bugs and share periodic quality metrics and reports with collaborators. Improve testing processes and product quality. 
 - Partner with development, architecture, product, and release teams to identify quality risks, analyze sophisticated system-level issues, drive defects to resolution, and communicate release readiness and quality metrics. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. 
 - 3-5 years of professional experience in software validation, preferably with ARM SoC-based Linux or Android products and end-to-end validation of game console devices. 
 - Strong Python programming skills with experience building test frameworks, automation infrastructure, utilities, and validation tools from the ground up. 
 - Hands-on experience bringing to bear AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered workflows for test development, code generation, test analysis, debugging, coverage improvement, or test development workflow optimization. 
 - Strong proficiency in Linux, including shell scripting, system-level debugging, process/resource analysis, and command-line fixing. 
 - Ability to implement end-to-end AI agentic testing workflows across all software development lifecycle (SDLC) phases, from requirements analysis and test planning through development, integration, release validation, and post-release monitoring. 
 - Experience using AI agents to assess streaming quality of service (QoS) and end-user experience, including playback startup time, buffering, latency, audio-video synchronization, visual quality, and playback stability; automate visual validation to minimize manual checks and surface issues for review. 
 - Ability to validate Android Streaming Devices for multimedia playback, including 4K HDR video, hardware decoding, audio passthrough, format switching, and audio-video synchronization across supported display and audio configurations. 
 - Experience validating local and cloud gaming on Android Streaming Devices, including controller compatibility, input latency, frame pacing, network sensitivity, and stability during extended gaming sessions. 
 - Ability to manage work independently, demonstrate leadership, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively, with a passion for emerging technologies. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with Android streaming products, graphics rendering techniques, display parameters, graphics processing, shaders, clusters, streaming apps/games, competitive analysis & benchmarking analysis of different streaming devices. 
 - Experience working on the development or validation of AI agents, Agentic AI workflows, multimodal AI, or Physical AI applications, including tool calling, orchestration, perception, or spatial understanding. 
 - Proven track record of applying AI tools or AI-powered test development agents to measurably improve test automation efficiency, coverage, quality, debugging, and regression efficiency.

data.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Local AI
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself for over two decades. The invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of PC gaming, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning has ignited modern AI, positioning NVIDIA as a leading AI computing company. 

Artificial intelligence is shifting from passive assistance to autonomous, always-on workflows. Our mission is to make this transition seamless, efficient, and secure for millions globally. The Local AI Inference team is seeking a Senior System Software Engineer to lead the development of robust system-level software and infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying high-quality AI applications and models across Linux and Windows systems powered by RTX and DGX-class GPUs. You will partner with inference engineers, model developers, and AI application teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure that enables reproducible evaluation and improves local AI performance. Using AI tools and developing autonomous agents, you will accelerate infrastructure development, automate operations, and help engineers diagnose complex system issues. If you enjoy tackling systems challenges and shaping how AI infrastructure is built and operated, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner across organizations with benchmarking teams, inference teams, and AI application developers to define requirements, design, and maintain shared infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying AI workloads across infernece backends such as llama. cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, and WinML. 
 - Build Git-based CI infrastructure for automated builds, integration testing, and regression detection across hardware platforms, operating systems, and runtime configurations. 
 - Develop model management services to download, version, cache, and synchronize checkpoints and dependencies for reproducible execution. 
 - Design databases, backend services, and data pipelines to store and query model metadata, benchmark results, system telemetry, and execution artifacts. 
 - Create dashboards and reports that help engineers compare inference configurations, identify regressions, and investigate performance bottlenecks. 
 - Develop and operate server infrastructure, including environment provisioning, workload scheduling, resource management, and failure recovery. 
 - Develop autonomous AI agents for infrastructure management, workload orchestration, monitoring, and diagnostics, with appropriate access controls and execution safeguards. 
 - Maintain Git repositories and companion websites, keeping code, documentation, model recommendations, and evaluation results current. 
 - Collaborate with inference developers to implement instrumentation and debugging capabilities, resolve system issues, and improve infrastructure efficiency and scalability. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 5+ years of relevant software development, with strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, C#, or another systems programming language. 
 - Experience developing system software, backend services, or infrastructure supporting engineering development. 
 - Understanding of system APIs, multithreading, process and resource management, and systems debugging. 
 - Hands-on with Git-based CI, databases, SQL, and data modeling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently own projects and manage competing priorities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaboration across engineering teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Track record of integrating or debugging AI inference frameworks and building model evaluation or benchmarking platforms
 - Proficiency working with AI agents, including tool integration and evaluation of autonomous infrastructure workflows. 
 - Hands-on expertise in developing telemetry and observability systems using tools such as Grafana or Kibana. 
 - Demonstrated ability to publish technical documentation, model recommendations, or benchmark results through companion websites.
