data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

You will lead the architecture and development of scalable, elastic distributed systems, driving performance, reliability, security, and operational excellence. You will define scalability requirements and SLOs, design fault-tolerant services that support upgrades without downtime, and establish telemetry and rigorous resilience testing. You will also resolve complex production issues, mentor engineers, and build infrastructure automation for safe deployments, patching, and rollbacks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Basic Qualification

7+ years of industry experience working on commercial or open-source software. 

Strong fluency in C++ or Java or similar modern languages

Excellent problem-solving skills and a deep understanding of Computer Science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems. 

Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and build control plane systems for cloud scale

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compiler (LLVM)
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

As a senior member of our Compiler team, you will be tasked with optimizing the performance of code running on the Quadric processor. You will be responsible for implementing required support of new processor architectural features. Additionally, you will be supporting internal/external customers. 

What You'll Do

- Enhance the development of Quadric's LLVM compiler
 - Collaborate on developing the programming model for Quadric's high-performance computing platform
 - Collaborate with the hardware design team to co-optimize compiler strategy with hardware architecture
 - Build custom front-end and back-end LLVM passes

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll: 

- Successfully support the development process across the Engineering team
 - Optimize code generation to increase the performance of code running on the Quadric processor

Required

What We're Looking For

- MS or PhD in Computer Science with a minimum of five years of compiler experience
 - Proficiency in C++ > 11
 - Experience with LLVM or GCC codebase
 - Strong background in graphs and related algorithms
 - Knowledge of front-end and back-end compiler techniques

Preferred

- Experience in compiler strategies for data parallel processors such as GPUs, DSPs
 - Knowledge of end-to-end toolchain, including compilers, linkers & debuggers

Benefits

Quadric also offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: 

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 - Equity with the business
 - Paid Parental Leave
 - PF Retirement Plan
 - Flexible PTO
 - Winter holiday shutdown
 - Catered lunch each day in our office
 - Downtown Pune office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities
 - Collaborative, low-ego culture with significant ownership and impact
 - A work culture focused on innovative disruption

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law

 - Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.

There's nothing more exciting than being at the center of a rapidly growing field in technology and applying your skillsets to drive innovation and modernize the world's most complex and mission-critical systems.

 - Learn the architecture of all applications to effectively troubleshoot issues and Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability and reliability

 - Excellent communication skills for interacting with end users and team members and Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and cloud services. 
 - Advanced knowledge of application, data, and infrastructure architecture disciplines, and understanding of architecture and design across all systems. 
 - Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals and Passionate about building an innovative culture and understanding industry-wide technology trends and best practices.

ParentPay Group is the largest EdTech company in Europe with over 1000 employees and more than £130m turnover. The group has a portfolio of software solutions for educational establishments which serve their management, payments, catering and library service needs. 

PPG is also the largest provider of school management software in the UK and touches the lives of over one million people every day, streamlining school administration and management to free up time for teaching and learning, with its market-leading SIMS software solution

A new team will be forming and will be working under a DevSecOps culture using eXtreme Programming techniques, ensuring the highest standards of quality, security and delivery are met. 

The product will pass through a formal Service Transition process into live support, but the team should also have a firm focus on live service operations and where they fit into 3rd line support.

You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.

The product will deliver a new Auth Solution for all group products, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. Desired Skills

data.description:
Job Description

Basic Job Functions: 

- Directs and manages 24/7 Site Plant's Semiconductor Operations activities with overall responsibilities for Operational Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Quality, Production (Throughput), Equipment Maintenance, Process Engineering, Cost, and meeting customer demand. 
 - Leads a team of Area Managers responsible for Semiconductor Manufacturing operations in a thin-film photovoltaic manufacturing flow. 
 - This position owns the integrated Manufacturing, Engineering, Maintenance, and key functions in Semiconductor Manufacturing Areas. 
 - Ensures that products and processes are introduced, and the designs are capable of being manufactured to meet the organization's objectives. 
 - Acts as an advisor and coach concerning manufacturing-related issues to facilitate teamwork and continuous improvement to management and the workforce. 
 - Controls the AOP spending within the approved budget and other operation-related activities. 
 - Deploys and provides leadership in continuous improvements, including leading/participating in global alignment activities. 
 - Establishes and invests in training and development of people/upskills associates, technical competencies, and standardized training programs for all plants. 
 - This position also serves as the key backup to the Head - Semiconductor Operations when not available. 

Education/Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in an engineering, business administration, or management discipline (MBA or Master of Engineering a plus). 
 - 5+ years of manufacturing experience w/ 2+ years of Supervisory experience. 
 - In lieu of a degree: 
 - 8+ years in managerial roles experience in a high-tech manufacturing environment. 
 - 10+ years of Manufacturing experience in a technical field or manufacturing environment. 
 - Direct experience in at least one of the areas preferred - PV semiconductor, Vacuum Systems, Sputtering, Vision metrologies, Thermal/Oven processes, Wet chemistry and film coating, Scribe Laser related. 

Required Skills/Competencies: 

- Safety First Mentality. 
 - Must be self-motivated and able to provide strong leadership in a highly matrixed organization structure. 
 - Provides leadership and strategy to accomplish First Solar's goals and objectives. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as experience with cross-functional coordination required. 
 - Proven Employee Relations Skills and Knowledge of Human Resources Practices.

data.title: Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer
data.description:
HRS As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay. 

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations. 

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers. 

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers. 

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

You'll join HRS's Product & IT organization, in the team that builds the AI agent layer for our global sales organization. Our goal: give Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Learning & Development, and leadership teams trusted AI agents that work directly inside the tools they use every day, such as our CRM, Microsoft 365, and our data platforms. The foundation is already in place. A central AI gateway on AWS gives every agent secure, audited access to approved AI models, and a dedicated platform engineer builds and maintains the secure connections into our core business systems. That lets you concentrate on building agents that solve real business problems for our teams worldwide. We are deliberately not a single-vendor shop: we build on Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, and other cloud-native agentic workflow engines, with the platform for each use case selected based on the agent capabilities it requires. 

POSITION

As Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer (all genders), you are the lead architect and builder of HRS's growing portfolio of AI agents and agentic workflows. You define the multi-agent architecture and the development standards the team follows across platforms, and personally drive the delivery of production-grade agents that account executives, sales operations managers, and customer success teams use every day - in Microsoft Teams and beyond. 

Our central AI gateway connects agents to approved AI models, and our platform engineer (a separate role) owns the detailed technical integrations into Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, and our other data systems. That leaves your focus on what makes agents valuable: design, orchestration, quality, and scale. You will mentor the mid-level engineer, set the technical bar, and make sure every agent ships as a reliable, well-governed product, whichever platform it runs on. 

CHALLENGE

- Architecture and delivery standards: Define the platform-agnostic multi-agent topology, conversation and workflow design principles, naming conventions, guardrail patterns, and release standards the team follows across all engines. 
 - Multi-agent framework: Design the orchestrator and sub-agent structure, handoff protocols, context passing, and fallback behaviors, including cross-platform communication via open standards like MCP and A2A. 
 - New use cases: Lead design and delivery of agents for pipeline queries, opportunity stage updates, forecasts, opportunity creation, approval workflows, and AI-generated content across a growing sales and customer-facing backlog. 
 - Enterprise data access: Partner with the platform engineer to define tool, API, and connector contracts for Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, SAP, Clay, AWS data products, and internal APIs. Enforce governed interfaces only: no direct database access, no free-form SQL, no plaintext credentials. 
 - Guardrail framework: Define and implement RBAC, DLP controls, prompt-injection defenses, output validation, and audit logging standards for every agent on every platform. 
 - Release management: Own versioning, regression testing, and staged rollout to production, including human approval gates for write-back actions, and sign off on every production promotion. 
 - Mentoring: Guide the mid-level engineer through architecture advice, reviews, and structured onboarding, building a team that delivers independently. 
 - Stakeholder translation: Work with sales and sales operations to scope use cases, define acceptance criteria, and manage delivery expectations. 

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH

- Experience: Typically 7+ years in software, automation, or integration engineering, with a track record of shipping AI agents or agentic workflows that real users rely on in production. 
 - Agent platforms: Proven experience deploying production agents, including multi-agent orchestrator/sub-agent architectures, on at least one agentic engine (e. g. Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock Agents, LangGraph). Production experience on multiple platforms is a strong plus. 
 - M-shaped profile: Deep agentic engineering expertise plus broad knowledge of enterprise systems such as CRM (e. g. Dynamics 365), ERP (e. g. SAP), Microsoft 365, and cloud data platforms. 
 - Agentic AI patterns: Deep understanding of orchestrator/sub-agent design, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, MCP, agent memory, and evaluation. 
 - Platform judgment: Clear view of each platform's strengths and limits, designing every agent to make the most of where it runs. 
 - API fluency: Confident with REST, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2. 0 / service principals; consumes APIs, connectors, and MCP servers and specifies precisely what agents need from the platform team. 
 - Governance: Solid knowledge of identity and RBAC (e. g. Entra ID), DLP, secrets management, environment and solution lifecycle, and CI/CD for agents. 
 - Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency for agent data handling. 
 - Mentoring: Proven ability to coach engineers and uphold quality standards across a team. 
 - Design and documentation: Strong skills in architecture decision records, conversation and workflow specs, and runbooks. 
 - Certifications (a plus): Microsoft PL-400 or AI-102, AWS, or platform-specific equivalents. 
 - Communication: Fluent English, verbal and written, able to lead discussions with technical and business stakeholders.

Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

As a Senior Engineer, your responsibilities will include developing and maintaining Software defined Storage solutions. You will focus on solving complex problems, developing, testing, automating and collaborating with the Software Engineering team to deploy features in a production environment. Additionally, you will be responsible for designing and implementing managed Cloud Services based on given requirements. We expect you to have excellent coding skills and take a lead role in designing and implementing managed Cloud Services. 

Prior experience in Filesystems would be an added advantage, and you should also have the ability to quickly learn existing code and architecture.

- Lead to deliver features, including participating in the full software development lifecycle.

 - Proficient with any of the languages C, C++, and good to have Python. 
 - Strong in Data Structure and algorithms. 
 - System/Kernel programming, Experience with Filesystems or Networking or file/cloud protocols is a must. 
 - Experience with ONTAP or similar storage operating systems 
 - Familiarity with agile software development practices 
 - Continuously monitor, analyse, and measure system health, availability, and latency using native tooling. Develop and implement steps to improve system and application performance, availability, and reliability.

 - Strong oral and written communication skills.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

data.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
data.description:
HRS As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay. 

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations. 

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers. 

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers. 

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

Revenue Operations (Rev Ops) is building HRS's AI-powered Go-to-Market platform - a single, governed access layer that gives Sales, Rev Ops, Marketing, Learning & Development, and Management teams trusted AI capabilities across our revenue systems. The foundation is already in place: HRS operates a centrally managed AI Gateway running on AWS, providing a shared, auditable AI infrastructure that all agents connect to. Your role is to build on top of this foundation - designing, developing, and scaling Microsoft Copilot Studio agents that solve real business problems for our global revenue teams. 

POSITION

As AI Platform Engineer (all genders) in our Revenue Operations team, you are the technical backbone of HRS's Copilot Studio agent delivery operation. You own the Microsoft Power Platform environments, CI/CD pipelines, security configuration, and Azure services that enable the development team to build, test, and ship Copilot Studio agents reliably and at scale. 

The HRS AI Gateway is already live and managed centrally - your job is not to build infrastructure from scratch, but to ensure the Copilot Studio platform is production-ready: well-governed environments, automated deployment pipelines, clean security controls, and solid observability so the team can focus on delivering agents rather than fighting platform issues. 

CHALLENGE

- Environment strategy and ALM: Design and maintain the dev, test, and production environment topology; manage solution exports, imports, and environment variables; and own the connection references and service accounts agents rely on. 
 - CI/CD pipelines: Build and run Azure DevOps or Power Platform ALM pipelines that promote Copilot Studio solutions across environments, with regression checks, versioning, and rollback procedures. 
 - Azure services: Own Azure Key Vault (secrets), Entra ID (identity and service principals), and Azure Monitor / Application Insights (telemetry and alerting). 
 - HRS AI Gateway connectivity: Configure and maintain the custom HTTP connectors that link Copilot Studio agents to the HRS AI Gateway on AWS, keeping them secure, authenticated, and resilient. 
 - Security and compliance: Implement DLP policies, manage Entra ID RBAC across environments, ensure EU data residency at the connector and environment level, and maintain audit logs of all agent interactions. 
 - Platform monitoring: Track telemetry, connector latency, error rates, and token usage, and build dashboards that surface production issues before they affect users. 
 - Developer support: Unblock developers on environment, connector, and deployment issues, and turn platform requirements into clear standards and guardrails. 

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH

- Power Platform administration: Hands-on experience with environment management, DLP policies, solution ALM, connection references, and Dataverse security roles. 
 - CI/CD: Experience designing pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, using Power Platform Build Tools or the Power Platform CLI. 
 - Identity and secrets: Working knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Entra ID, and service principals, including securing credentials and managing identities for automated deployments. 
 - Custom connectors: Experience building custom HTTP connectors to external REST APIs secured with OAuth 2. 0 or API keys. 
 - Monitoring: Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics for telemetry, alerting, and dashboards. 
 - Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency as they apply to Power Platform environments and connectors. 
 - Collaboration: Able to work closely with developers and turn platform constraints into clear guidelines without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Certifications (required): PL-400 (Power Platform Developer) or AZ-104 (Azure Administrator); holding both is a strong differentiator. 
 - Language: Fluent English, verbal and written.

data.title: Salesforce Application Architect
data.description:
Salesforce Application Architect - Sovos SOVOS Salesforce Application Architect

Accounting/Finance· Full-Time

- India

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. 

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence - and helping communities thrive. 

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. 

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. 

The Role

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here. 

More Specifically, You Will

- Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity. 
 - Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales. 
 - Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access. 
 - Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware. 
 - Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder. 
 - Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy. 
 - Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration. 

What You Bring to Sovos

- You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career. 
 - Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design. 
 - Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios. 
 - Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer. 
 - Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale. 
 - Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance. 
 - Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement. 
 - Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. 

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. 

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

- Global Mentoring Programs
 - AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
 - Continuous Learning and Development
 - Language Learning Support
 - Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
 - Global Parental Leave Policy
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
 - Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
 - Hybrid Work Arrangement
 - Annual Health Check-up

Corporate Title: AVP (Internal: AVP)

Job Profile

Position details

The AVP, Lead Software Engineer will apply hands-on technical knowledge across data integration, database engineering, scripting, cloud-based data services, and AI-enabled solutions. The role is to help design secure, scalable Generative AI capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge bases, semantic search, and document intelligence solutions.

The individual will translate business and technical requirements into reliable solutions, guide development teams, and deliver against milestones in a regulated financial-services environment. - Design, develop, enhance, and maintain complex ETL mappings, workflows, data pipelines, and UNIX/Linux shell scripts in enterprise data warehouse and data lake environments
 - Build and optimize batch, real-time, and near-real-time integrations using IDMC or comparable integration technologies
 - Develop advanced SQL and database solutions across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable relational platforms, including performance tuning and data-quality controls

 - Partner with architecture, security, data governance, model risk, legal/compliance, and business teams to move AI proofs of concept into supportable production services

 - Build resilient, observable, and cost-conscious architectures using infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, metrics, and alerting
 - Apply secure cloud engineering patterns for network connectivity, encryption, secrets, least-privilege access, service integration, and operational recovery
 - Provide technical knowledge and understandings across design, development, testing, implementation, release, and production-support activities
 - Create and review functional designs, detailed technical designs, data mappings, interface specifications, runbooks, and operational documentation

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience working as a Data Engineer, designing, developing, and supporting scalable data pipelines and data-processing solutions using AWS services
 - 8+ years of experience with IDMC or a comparable enterprise ETL/data-integration platform, including batch and real-time or near-real-time patterns.

Description

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500, 000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale. 

We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules - integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments. 

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses. 

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and leading teams of software engineers, front-end engineers, and technical program managers, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level systems at scale. They will be a strategic thinker who hires and develops exceptional talent, sets clear goals tied to organizational impact, and independently manages both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities - fostering a high-performance, team-oriented culture.

data.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
data.description:
About the TeamThe team builds and operates technology that helps Walmart understand and improve its physical environments, modernize manufacturing, and support the assets that keep stores running. Its work spans digital representations and simulations of stores and supply chain facilities, IoT and automation in meat and dairy plants, and GNFR systems connecting stores, service technicians, and distribution centers. 

What You Will DoOwn Business Outcomes and Engineering Strategy· Start with operational problems: Work directly with store, energy, real estate, manufacturing, and GNFR partners to understand user workflows, operational constraints, and business priorities. Translate these into product requirements and engineering commitments. 

- Set direction and prioritize investment: Define a multi-year technology roadmap with product and business leaders. Balance new capabilities, modernization, technical debt, operational resilience, and cost; make investment tradeoffs explicit. 
 - Measure value after launch: Establish business, functional, and engineering baselines before delivery. Review adoption and realized benefits with operating teams, and use evidence to adjust priorities and solution design. 

Business and Domain ResponsibilitiesDigital Twins and Energy and Asset Intelligence· Connect Walmart's digital twins: Deliver a federated ecosystem connecting 13+ digital twins through a unified connective layer for shared simulation, standardized data, and cross-domain intelligence. Preserve domain ownership while enabling information to work across business boundaries. 

- Create a consistent operational model: Standardize the enterprise ontology for associates, products, spaces, and equipment. Define shared identifiers, relationships, and data contracts that reduce silos and shorten use-case onboarding from months to weeks. 
 - Turn simulation into operating decisions: Scale simulation for HVAC, lighting, and refrigeration energy efficiency; emergency routing; predictive equipment maintenance; and hazard detection across stores and the supply chain. Partner with business owners to validate results and incorporate them into operational workflows. 
 - Lead the technical design: Own architecture decisions for 3D engine integration, core service databases, spatial and equipment data, alarms, and event processing. Establish data freshness, interoperability, and simulation validation practices so users can trust the results. 
 - Scale efficiently: Set baselines for simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity. Improve compute and storage efficiency while maintaining the performance required by each business use case. 

Modern Manufacturing Engineering· Modernize meat and dairy operations: Direct the engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Walmart's proprietary processing and manufacturing plants. Partner with plant leaders to prioritize operational needs and sequence delivery around production requirements. 

- Connect operational data and workflows: Lead IoT and automation solutions that bring equipment and production information into usable engineering and business applications. Define integrations, data ownership, and exception handling across connected systems. 
 - Improve plant visibility and execution: Enable timely insight into equipment condition and operational exceptions. Work with manufacturing teams to reduce manual intervention and improve the reliability and efficiency of technology-supported production processes. 
 - Deliver safely into live operations: Coordinate testing, site readiness, deployment windows, training, and support with plant and operations partners. Validate changes against operational requirements and establish clear recovery and escalation procedures. 

GNFR Supply Chain and Store Asset Support· Own GNFR warehouse technology: Lead engineering and technical operations for Warehouse Management Systems across the GNFR network, with accountability for dependable inventory and fulfillment workflows. 

- Deliver OneAtlas facility rollouts: Lead technical rollout and integration across upcoming GNFR facilities. Own integration readiness, data migration validation, end-to-end testing, cutover, stabilization, and handoff to operational support. 
 - Support store asset maintenance: Enhance ordering, inventory tracking, and fulfillment of maintenance and replacement parts for commercial HVAC, refrigeration systems, fixtures, and other store assets. Improve visibility for stores and service technicians from request through fulfillment. 
 - Connect procurement and fulfillment: Modernize asset procurement, catalog management, inventory visibility, and order routing between stores, service technicians, and GNFR distribution centers. Address inconsistent data and workflow gaps that delay fulfillment or require manual coordination. 

Technical and Operational LeadershipArchitecture and Technical Depth· Own application and integration design: Guide domain modeling, service boundaries, APIs, event contracts, workflow orchestration, and data architecture across the portfolio. Make deliberate choices on scale, decoupling, extensibility, and maintainability. 

- Engage in the hardest engineering decisions: Work directly with architects and engineers on complex design and production problems. Challenge assumptions, review alternatives, and explain tradeoffs in business and technical terms. 
 - Modernize with continuity: Define incremental migration and integration strategies for existing business systems. Protect data integrity and operational continuity through compatibility planning, reconciliation, controlled rollout, and tested rollback or recovery paths. 
 - Govern data quality and access: Establish clear ownership, validation, lineage, and access controls for equipment, location, catalog, inventory, and operational event data. Partner with security and relevant business teams on privacy, security, and compliance requirements. 

Engineering Excellence and Production Ownership· Own the full development lifecycle: Set expectations for design reviews, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness. Cover integration, performance, resilience, and critical business workflows in validation. 

- Run reliable business services: Define service-level objectives and agreements that reflect operational criticality. Establish end-to-end observability across applications, integrations, and business flows, including detection of stalled or incomplete processing. 
 - Lead incident prevention and recovery: Build clear on-call ownership, runbooks, escalation paths, and recovery procedures. Review incidents with business partners, address recurring causes, and test continuity and disaster recovery plans. 
 - Improve performance and unit economics: Use telemetry, profiling, and capacity analysis to improve latency, throughput, and resource utilization. Manage cloud, storage, and software costs against the business value and workload served. 
 - Eliminate operational toil: Automate repetitive support, data validation, deployment, and recovery tasks. Measure reductions in manual effort and failure rates while retaining appropriate controls for actions affecting live operations. 

Organizational Leadership and Execution· Build and develop the organization: Design teams with clear ownership and appropriate spans and layers. Hire and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors across software, data, IoT, and systems engineering. 

- Set a high performance standard: Run consistent goal setting, coaching, calibration, promotion, and performance management. Build succession plans and strengthen both technical and people leadership. 
 - Establish execution mechanisms: Translate strategy into OKRs, milestones, dependency plans, and regular business reviews. Surface risks early, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain clear accountability for commitments and benefits. 
 - Influence across functions: Align executive stakeholders in Supply Chain, Real Estate, Store Operations, Manufacturing, Product, and Global Technology. Communicate decisions, investment needs, progress, and risks clearly to technical and business audiences. 
 - Model Walmart values: Respect the Individual, Act with Integrity, Serve our Customers and Members, and Strive for Excellence. Create an inclusive environment where associates can challenge assumptions, learn, and take ownership. 

What You Will BringMinimum Qualifications· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

- 15+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, including at least 5 years leading large-scale, multi-team engineering organizations at Director level or above. 
 - A proven record of delivering enterprise business applications and distributed systems, with experience in data integration or federation and complex cross-system workflows. 
 - Demonstrated experience in supply chain technologies, specifically Warehouse Management Systems and enterprise asset management. 
 - Experience leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors, including hiring, organization design, talent development, and performance management. 
 - Evidence of translating business problems into technical requirements and delivering measurable improvements in operational outcomes, service reliability, performance, or cost. 
 - Strong architecture and engineering judgment across APIs, event-driven systems, databases, integration patterns, and the full software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience owning production services and major modernization programs, managing cross-functional dependencies, and communicating with senior business and technology leaders. 

Preferred Qualifications· Experience architecting or operationalizing virtual stores/DC/FCs, simulation engines, enterprise ontologies, or 3D and spatial data solutions. 

- Experience with IoT, equipment telemetry, automation, or technology delivery in manufacturing or industrial environments, especially meat or dairy processing. 
 - Experience with energy management, predictive maintenance, refrigeration or HVAC systems, or technology supporting physical asset operations. 
 - Experience rolling out WMS, asset management, procurement, or related business applications across large distribution, manufacturing, or retail networks. 
 - Experience connecting enterprise applications with operational technology and managing site readiness, cutover, stabilization, and business adoption. 
 - Strong financial and technical governance acumen, including cloud infrastructure budgets, vendor decisions, performance contracts, and total cost of ownership. 

How Success Will Be MeasuredAgree baselines and targets with business owners for the scope of each initiative. Evaluate both business impact and engineering health rather than delivery volume alone. 

- Business results: Energy efficiency and asset reliability; manufacturing operational efficiency and manual effort; GNFR inventory accuracy, ordering and fulfillment cycle times, and facility rollout readiness. 
 - Digital Twin effectiveness: Use-case onboarding time, simulation adoption and validated usefulness, data freshness and quality, simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity. 
 - Engineering and organizational health: Availability, incident impact and recovery time, change quality, delivery predictability, cost efficiency, operational toil, and development of engineering talent.

Description

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems. 

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. 

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands - customer obsession is part of our company DNA. 

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business. 

We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. 

If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc. ). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team's software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Principal Engineer, Design Verification Engineering
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Analog Devices is seeking Digital Design Principal Verification Engineer, who will be responsible for design verification of highly integrated solutions and products in a multifunctional team. You will be working on driving real revenue growth on the next generation of Intelligence at the Edge products across multiple products and business units. 

About ADI: 

Analog Devices, Inc. is a leading global high-performance analog technology company dedicated to solving our customers' most complex engineering challenges. We play a critical role at the intersection of the physical and digital world by providing the building blocks to sense, measure, interpret, connect, and power devices and systems. We design, manufacture, test, and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including integrated circuits (ICs), software and subsystems that leverage high-performance analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing technologies. We embrace a culture of innovation and collaboration to push the state of the art. 

About The Role

Lead design verification team for SOC or subsystem design pre silicon verification. The candidate will be responsible for formulating verification strategies, Define verification architecture, Flow, Methodology and leading, driving and completing verification of large integrated products. As a senior team member, it is expected that he/she will lead and influence verification methodologies within both DBU and ADI. The candidate is also encouraged to participate in cross company technical initiatives as well as patent and publish work where possible. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end SoC verification for complex digital SoCs, driving execution from planning to signoff. 
 - Verify complex microprocessor-based designs, AI/ML accelerators, and high-speed peripherals using advanced verification methodologies. 
 - Define and drive team execution by planning tasks, tracking progress, and providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to define requirements and align on verification deliverables and dependencies. 
 - Drive pre-silicon readiness by aligning with emulation, FPGA, and software teams to cover post-silicon validation scenarios early. 
 - Develop and execute end-to-end system-level use cases for comprehensive functional validation. 
 - Architect and implement scalable UVM-based testbenches, DV flows, and methodologies. 
 - Define and review test plans; ensure closure of functional and code coverage across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Work cross-functionally with emulation, FPGA, firmware, and system teams to ensure full-system correctness. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques for IP and subsystem-level validation. 
 - Lead NoC/interconnect verification and ensure robust data flow across the SoC. 
 - Perform performance verification and system-level analysis across real-world use cases. 
 - Drive innovation in verification strategies to meet aggressive schedules and quality goals. 
 - Define overall verification strategy based on product requirements and design specifications, leveraging modern techniques such as formal, emulation, portable stimulus, and virtual platforms. 

Requirements

- B. Tech/M. Tech with 12+ years of experience in digital pre-silicon verification, including leadership across IP, subsystem, or SoC-level DV. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC/Subsystem architectures with hands-on expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbench development, debugging, and methodology implementation. 
 - Proven track record in verification closure using functional and code coverage metrics across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Expertise in NoC, bus, and interconnect verification, along with coverage analysis and optimization. 
 - Experience in architecting scalable testbench environments and defining robust DV flows and methodologies. 
 - Strong background in power-aware verification (UPF), including power analysis and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with formal verification, including flow definition, connectivity, and functional property checking. 
 - Solid protocol knowledge and verification experience across high-speed and low-speed interfaces such as I2C, SPI, Ethernet, UART, AXI/AHB, DMA, and SVI3. 
 - Experience in security and safety verification, ensuring compliance with secure design and functional safety requirements. 
 - Familiarity with gate-level simulations with timing annotation (GLS). 
 - Strong expertise in test planning, constrained-random verification, assertions, and transaction-level modeling. 
 - Good understanding of processor-based systems (ARM, RISC-V, Tensilica), AI/ML accelerators, and proficiency in C/C++, SystemC, and scripting (Python/TCL/Shell). 
 - Exposure to mixed-signal/analog verification (ADC/DAC/PLL/PHY) is a plus. 
 - Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams and drive verification innovation. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies

Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process.

data.title: Principle DFT Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

As a part of the Connectivity BU DFT team the suitable candidate will work on all aspects of DFT in products catering to the networking domain: DFT architecture and Testability strategy, Flow, Implementation, Verification and post-Si bring up. 

Marvell's Connectivity Business Unit is the industry-leading provider of high-speed connectivity solutions powering the full range of network infrastructure - from the optics of AI GPU boards to top-of-rack optical fibers and active copper cables in data centers and their fabrics. The BU spans multiple cutting-edge product lines, including Optical Digital Signal Processing (ODSP), Active Electrical Cable (AEC), and Coherent Digital Signal Processing (CDSP), delivering solutions to enterprise, data center, service providers, and cloud customers worldwide. 

You'll work closely and mentor other DFT team members for DFT features Implementation, Integration and Verification in SoC. You will also have close interaction with Logic Design/Physical design/STA/ATE teams as needed. 

What You Can Expect

- Define and drive the DFT architecture and test strategy for complex IPs and SoCs, ensuring robust testability and alignment with product quality, coverage, and manufacturability goals. 
 - Lead the implementation and integration of Scan, ATPG, JTAG, MBIST, and Boundary Scan (BSCAN) solutions, ensuring compliance with IEEE 1149. 1/1149. 6 standards. 
 - Develop and deploy DFT features including test structures, IP-level DFT integration, ATPG fault models, test point insertion, coverage optimization, scan insertion, and MBIST implementation at both block and chip levels. 
 - Own and execute hierarchical DFT flows across the design hierarchy, from individual IPs through full-chip integration. 
 - Implement, validate, and debug DFT/DFX features, ensuring seamless integration with the overall SoC architecture. 
 - Generate and validate production test patterns, perform RTL and netlist verification, execute gate-level simulations (zero-delay and SDF-based), and ensure comprehensive test-mode validation. 
 - Develop and maintain test timing constraints, including SDC creation, test-mode timing analysis, and support for block- and chip-level STA signoff activities. 
 - Utilize industry-standard EDA tools for Scan, ATPG, MBIST, and JTAG implementation, verification, and debug. 
 - Collaborate closely with Design, Synthesis, Physical Design, STA, Validation, and Silicon Bring-up teams to resolve DFT-related issues and ensure successful project execution. 
 - Drive Post-Silicon bring-up, ATE debug, silicon characterization, and production ramp-up activities, enabling efficient silicon validation and productization. 
 - Own DFT deliverables throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring successful execution from architecture definition through tape out, silicon validation, and manufacturing release. 
 - Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, and technical leadership to ensure successful tape out and post-silicon ramp-up of the project.

- Master's degree and/or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields with 12+ years of experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering or related fields and 14+ years of related professional experience. 
 - Hands on working experience in various stages of DFT-Execution, SCAN-Insertion/MBIST/ATPG/Validation/STA/IP-DFX/Post-Silicon Bring up/Debug

 - Understanding of DFT Flows and Methodologies and Experience with Cadence/Mentor/Synopsys Tool set (Genus, Modus, NCSim/DC, Tessent, Spyglass/Tmax) 
 - Proven experience leading DFT activities, including technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding DFT engineers, driving successful execution across multiple projects and enabling team scalability. 
 - Experience owning complete DFT responsibility for one or more successful chip tapeouts, ensuring delivery of high-quality test solutions meeting coverage, quality, and schedule targets.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer (GoLang, Kubernetes Operators, CRD)
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

To be successful in this role you have: 

- You will own the design and delivery of significant components and core subsystems of our Kubernetes platform-for example secrets and certificate management, workload identity, storage, or cluster networking-from design through production operation. 
 - You will take a loosely defined platform problem and turn it into a design, a plan, and shipped software, with limited scaffolding from others. 
 - You will contribute to the architecture of distributed workloads running on the platform, working with the teams who depend on it to get the runtime and isolation model right. 
 - You will spend most of your time hands-on in code-operators and controllers, infrastructure automation, and platform services-and in the reviews that keep their quality high. 
 - You will own the operability of what you build: SLOs, failure modes, upgrade and migration paths, and on-call for your own systems. 
 - You will partner with senior staff and principal engineers to keep your work aligned with the wider platform architecture, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers. 
 - You will help us run a platform that serves regulated markets, where compliance constraints including FedRAMP shape design choices. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

- Built and operated Kubernetes platform infrastructure in production before, at meaningful scale-not just consumed it. You can point to specific subsystems you designed, shipped, and then supported through real incidents and upgrade cycles. 
 - 8+ years building production software, including solid experience operating distributed systems. 
 - Strong programming skills in Go, with production Kubernetes controller or operator work behind you. 
 - Hands-on depth with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP)-its compute, networking, and IAM primitives, and where they leak into cluster design. 
 - A track record of owning complex components end to end, from ambiguous problem to production, whether or not you carried a lead title. 
 - Strong working knowledge of containers, CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work-AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI's impact on how infrastructure is built and run. 

It Also Helps If You Have

- Experience with managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) alongside self-managed clusters. 
 - Experience with container networking (CNI) and/or service mesh. 
 - Experience with mTLS, workload identity, and secrets management at fleet scale. 
 - Experience with observability-metrics, tracing, and SLOs. 
 - Experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar declarative infrastructure tooling. 
 - Experience designing or tuning distributed data or compute workloads on Kubernetes. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

data.title: Lead Verification Engineer
data.description:
Job Title : Lead Verification Engineer

Location : Bangalore/Chennai/Nashik

Job Description: 

We are seeking a technically strong and quality-driven Lead Verification Engineer to lead the test strategy and execution for embedded automation platforms in Surface Drilling systems. You will be responsible for designing and implementing automated test frameworks, validating real-time control systems, and ensuring seamless integration across hardware-software interfaces. 

This role is central to Epiroc's automation roadmap, supporting the development of brand-agnostic, interoperable platforms that enable autonomous operations across global mining fleets. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead verification strategy for embedded control systems in Surface Drilling projects. 
 - Develop automated test frameworks using Python, Robot Framework, and Pytest. 
 - Drive system-level validation for real-time, safety-critical applications. 
 - Collaborate across teams to ensure testability, RTM traceability, and product quality. 
 - Lead defect management, continuous improvement, and own key verification artifacts. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote best practices in test automation and quality. 
 - Drive AI-assisted verification to validate autonomous and intelligent control functions. 
 - Define and report verification metrics such as pass rate, test coverage, and defect trends. 

Required Skills and Qualifications: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or Computer Science. 

Technical Skills: 

- 8-12 years of experience in software verification and automation for embedded systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in HiL, FAT, and SAT across lab, factory, and site environments. 
 - Proficient in Python, Robot Framework, Selenium, and test automation libraries. 
 - Experience in system validation for real-time or industrial control systems. 
 - Strong understanding of communication protocols: CAN, UDS, J1939, LIN, Ethernet. 
 - Excellent analytical, debugging, and communication skills. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, ALM traceability. 
 - Strong system knowledge with the ability to derive and interpret system requirements. 
 - Knowledge of machine electrification and autonomous machine systems. 
 - Good programming skills in Python and CAPL, with basic knowledge of C and C++. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience in mining, construction, or automotive control systems. 
 - ISTQB Test Certifications & Agile certifications (Scrum Master, Product Owner). 
 - Knowledge of AUTOSAR, ADAS, sensor fusion, computer vision, OTA, and SDV. 
 - Exposure to functional safety and cybersecurity (e. g. , ISO 26262, CRA). 
 - International work experience with the ability to collaborate across global teams. 
 - Exposure to Agentic AI-based test automation and traceability. 
 - Familiarity with simulation-driven validation, virtual test environments, and digital twins. 

Soft Skills: 

- Self-driven with a strong curiosity to learn and explore new ideas. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. 
 - Attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality results. 

What We Offer: 

- Competitive Salary and Benefits: Enjoy a rewarding compensation package tailored to your expertise. 
 - Global career opportunities across Epiroc's worldwide network. 
 - Epiroc University for continuous learning and competence development. 
 - Innovative projects that shape the future of automation and sustainability. 
 - Hybrid work culture supporting flexibility, collaboration, and well-being. 
 - Inclusive environment built on trust, innovation, and teamwork. 

Why You Should Apply: 

- This role places you at the heart of automation programs, where your verification expertise will shape safe, reliable next-generation machine solutions. 
 - Work at the intersection of AI, autonomy, and validation engineering to help build safer, smarter, and more sustainable mining solutions for Surface Drilling. 
 - Collaborate globally to align verification, integration, and delivery across teams and sites. 
 - Support team growth by strengthening verification practices and promoting structured technical problem-solving. 

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support. 

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www. epiroc. com
