data.title: Senior Oracle Functional Consultant / Test Lead
data.description:
Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services. 

We're an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do: 

- UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner 
 - 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business 
 - 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK 
 - Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW 
 - Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We're a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it's deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we'll invest in you!. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle Functional Consultant / Test Lead to provide functional consultancy and testing leadership across Oracle E-Business Suite implementations, enhancements and international rollout programmes. 

The successful candidate will have strong hands-on Oracle EBS R12 Financials expertise and experience across the full implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support. 

This is a dual functional and testing role. The consultant will design and configure Oracle solutions while using their functional expertise to develop test scenarios, validate end-to-end business processes, support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), manage defects and provide assurance that solutions meet agreed business and statutory requirements. 

Experience of international rollouts and new-market implementations is particularly important, including the establishment of new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units and integration with third-party systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Oracle Functional Consultancy

- Lead requirements gathering and analysis with business, Finance and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into effective Oracle EBS solutions. 
 - Design and configure Oracle Financials solutions, particularly General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, E-Business Tax, Fixed Assets, AGIS and related financial processes. 
 - Configure and support new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units for international and new-market implementations. 
 - Ensure solutions meet country-specific business and statutory requirements while remaining aligned with the organisation's wider Oracle template and financial architecture. 
 - Produce and maintain functional design and configuration documentation, including MC050 configuration documents and implementation artefacts. 
 - Develop configuration migration plans and support controlled promotion through development, SIT, UAT and production environments, using tools such as ConfigSnapshot where appropriate. 
 - Provide functional input into integrations with third-party applications, including procurement, payroll, foreign exchange/rate providers and retail systems. 
 - Work closely with technical consultants, developers and integration teams to define and validate integrations and customisations. 
 - Provide functional support throughout deployment, cutover, go-live and hypercare. 

Testing and Quality Assurance

- Translate business and functional requirements into structured test scenarios, test cases and expected results. 
 - Define and execute functional test coverage for Oracle configurations, customisations, integrations and end-to-end business processes. 
 - Lead or provide senior functional support for SIT, UAT and regression testing, including country-specific and statutory requirements. 
 - Test both standard business processing and exception/error scenarios across Oracle and connected applications. 
 - Analyse defects to identify root causes across configuration, application functionality, customisation, integration, test data and business processes. 
 - Work with business and technical teams to reproduce, resolve and retest defects. 
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, functional designs, configuration and test coverage. 
 - Support business users during UAT, resolving functional queries and distinguishing genuine application defects from process or data issues. 
 - Provide functional assurance to support implementation readiness and go-live decisions. 
 - Validate critical configuration and business processes following deployment and continue defect investigation during hypercare. 

Qualifications

Functional and Technical Skills

Essential

- Significant experience as a Senior Oracle E-Business Suite Functional Consultant, with strong Oracle EBS R12 Financials knowledge. 
 - Detailed functional experience across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Advanced Global Intercompany System (AGIS) and E-Business Tax. 
 - Experience configuring ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units. 
 - Proven delivery experience across multi-country, new-market or legal-entity implementations. 
 - Strong requirements gathering, functional solution design, configuration and documentation skills. 
 - Strong understanding of the relationship between Oracle configuration, business processes and downstream testing. 
 - Hands-on experience of SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management and resolution. 
 - Ability to create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases from business requirements and functional designs. 
 - Experience testing interfaces between Oracle EBS and third-party applications. 
 - Experience supporting deployment, cutover, go-live and post-production hypercare. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Finance, business, functional, technical, integration and programme teams. 

Highly Desirable

- Experience using ConfigSnapshot for configuration definition, comparison, migration or assurance. 
 - Experience producing and maintaining MC050 configuration documentation. 
 - Experience implementing statutory ledgers. 
 - Experience within a large international retail environment. 
 - Experience supporting multiple concurrent country implementations. 

Testing Competencies

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong quality and testing mindset, with the ability to understand how Oracle configuration decisions translate into testing requirements. 

They should be capable of assessing how a business process will operate in Oracle, what configuration and integrations support it, how the solution will be validated, how exceptions and failures should be handled, and what regression testing is required when the solution changes. 

The ability to combine deep Oracle functional expertise with structured end-to-end testing is a core requirement of the role. 

Seniority and Leadership

As a senior member of the delivery team, the consultant will take ownership of assigned functional areas and provide guidance to business users, consultants and testers. Responsibilities may include coordinating functional workstreams, reviewing functional and testing deliverables, supporting planning and issue resolution, providing input into implementation readiness and go-live decisions, and supporting junior team members through knowledge transfer and solution guidance. 

Personal Attributes

The Ideal Candidate Will Be

- Analytical, methodical and detail-oriented. 
 - Comfortable owning delivery from initial requirement through to production. 
 - Able to challenge requirements constructively and identify gaps and risks. 
 - Strong at troubleshooting complex functional, configuration and integration issues. 
 - Confident communicating with both business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Comfortable operating within high-profile, business-critical programmes. 
 - Able to balance delivery deadlines with appropriate testing and quality controls. 
 - Capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a wider programme team. 

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability. 

- Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits 
 - Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme 
 - Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people's individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance 
 - Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme 
 - Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies 
 - Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat 
 - Reward schemes including Version 1's Annual Excellence Awards & 'Call-Out' platform. 
 - Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes. 

And many more exciting benefits. . . drop us a note to find out more. 

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

AI Compiler Engineer

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5. 6 billion. 

Job Description

The world is how we shape it. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications leveraging LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and modern AI engineering tools. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based solutions that solve real business problems and create measurable value. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop AI agents, copilots, and autonomous workflows. 
 - Build solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Google ADK. 
 - Develop RAG solutions, semantic search capabilities, and enterprise knowledge assistants. 
 - Integrate AI solutions with business applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. 
 - Package, deploy, and monitor AI applications in cloud environments. 
 - Contribute reusable frameworks, accelerators, and AI engineering best practices. 

Required Technical Skills

Programming & Engineering

- Strong proficiency in Python. 
 - Experience with REST APIs and integrations. 
 - FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals. 

Agentic AI & LLMs

- Hands-on experience with one or more: 
 - LangChain
 - LangGraph
 - CrewAI
 - AutoGen
 - Google ADK
 - Prompt Engineering
 - Function/Tool Calling
 - Agent Workflows and Memory Concepts
 - Building LLM-powered applications

RAG & Knowledge Systems

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, Milvus, etc. )
 - Semantic Search and Embeddings

Cloud & Deployment

- Docker
 - Azure, AWS, or GCP
 - CI/CD fundamentals

Preferred Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
 - Multi-Agent Systems
 - GraphRAG
 - Semantic Kernel
 - OpenAI Agents SDK
 - PydanticAI
 - AI Evaluation Frameworks (Promptfoo, RAGAS)
 - Knowledge Graphs
 - React or Streamlit-based AI applications

Professional Attributes (Mandatory)

- Strong collaborator capable of working effectively across engineering, product, business, and leadership teams. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Confident, proactive, and self-driven individual who takes ownership and delivers results. 
 - Strong networking and relationship-building abilities, with the capability to engage stakeholders across teams and geographies. 
 - Comfortable conducting demos, presentations, workshops, and technical discussions. 
 - Passionate about continuous learning and staying current with emerging AI technologies. 

Experience Requirements

- 3-8 years of overall software engineering experience. 
 - Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based application development. 
 - Experience building and delivering AI-powered applications, agents, copilots, or automation solutions in enterprise or production environments. 

Qualifications

Bachelor of Technology

Additional Information

Ideal Candidate Summary

A hands-on AI Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals and at least 2 years of experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI. The ideal candidate has experience building AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based solutions using modern agent frameworks and LLM technologies. Beyond technical expertise, they are a confident communicator, strong collaborator, and relationship builder who can effectively influence stakeholders, drive cross-functional collaboration, and help accelerate AI innovation across the organization.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Golang/Python
data.description:
About The Job

The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a talented and versatile Senior Software Engineer. 

Our mission is to deliver a next generation platform for building, testing and releasing artifacts to deliver Red Hat products and services using open hybrid cloud technologies while focusing on innovation and security. 

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing the next-gen productization pipeline, optimizing our systems, and ensuring a seamless user experience in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 

This position requires a proactive problem solver who is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions and continuously improving our systems. 

You will work with Red Hat's latest open source technologies, such as Kubernetes, Tekton, ArgoCD, Terraform and OpenShift. You will also work closely with Red Hat's leading product development teams, QE, SRE, product management, and other stakeholders worldwide, working with a stable team in an agile environment to deliver services for Red Hat teams and customers. 

What you will do?

- Design, develop, and implement new features based on evolving business requirements. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software defects. 
 - Ensure that all code changes maintain or improve system stability and performance. 
 - Assist users by troubleshooting issues and providing technical support when needed. 
 - Gather user feedback and suggest improvements to enhance user experience. 
 - Monitor system performance and implement optimizations to improve efficiency and scalability. 
 - Conduct code reviews and refactor existing code to maintain code quality and performance. 
 - Deploy changes to staging and production environments following established processes and best practices. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth and reliable operation of software in production. 
 - Stay updated with industry trends and technologies to bring innovative ideas to the team. 
 - Contribute to the improvement of internal processes, tools, and standards. 
 - Work with open source communities such as Tekton and Kubernetes and submitting code in these upstream communities for review
 - Work in a global team, including teams in EMEA, NA, and APAC
 - Work with developers, quality engineers, PMs, SRE and customers
 - Learn about the latest AI tools and how to apply them to solve existing problems

What you will bring?

- Ability to work with new and fast-changing technologies with a high level of uncertainty, reacting to changes in requirements quickly
 - Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for learning and adapting to new challenges. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent working experience
 - At least 5 years of experience writing code in Golang, JAVA, or Python
 - Experience working on shared codebases using source control management (SCM) systems like GitHub or GitLab
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. 
 - Experience working with Linux as a developer
 - Experience with building & debugging applications on Kubernetes clusters
 - Experience building and running containerized applications and controllers
 - Experience with cloud-based infrastructure (e. g. , AWS) and microservices architecture

The Following Is Considered a Plus

- Experience with IBM cloud
 - Experience in Terraform
 - Experience in Tekton or ArgoCD
 - Experience building CICD pipelines
 - Experience in Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk
 - Experience in Open Source development
 - Experience defining requirements between application components
 - Experience in DevSecOps or Product Security 
 - Experience with Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM)

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world's leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. 

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat's culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. 

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. 

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. 

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat. com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

Department: LAPS Development, Enterprise IT & Quality

Location: Bangalore

Your impact begins here

As PEMS (Production Environment Monitoring System) developer you will design, develop and support solutions on the LabVantage LIMS platform for QC laboratory operations and the PEMS system. You will build features and interfaces, resolve complex application issues and contribute to reliable releases in a regulated GxP environment. By combining strong technical delivery with close business collaboration, you will help improve system functionality, data integrity and the day-to-day experience of laboratory users. 

What You'll Bring

You are a hands-on developer who takes ownership, learns independently and works effectively across technical and business teams. You will bring: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or an equivalent discipline. 
 - 4-6 years of software development experience using Java and database technologies, including application development, configuration and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong development skills in Core Java, JavaScript, JSP, REST APIs, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL. 
 - Experience debugging application issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes. 
 - Experience authoring and reviewing FDS, TDS, API documents, risk assessments and test documentation. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, verbal and written communication, analytical and decision-making skills. 
 - A proactive, self-driven approach with ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing and the ability to work within defined processes and deadlines. 

Useful, But Not Essential

- Experience with hands on PEMS development in the Lab Vantage ecosystem is a plus
 - Experience operating and maintaining a GxP or business-critical IT system is a plus

What You'll Do

- Design and development: Develop LabVantage LIMS features, interfaces, configurations and proofs of concept for the PEMS system. 
 - Technical troubleshooting: Perform root cause analysis, resolve application issues, deliver bug fixes and patch sets, and address support tickets requiring technical analysis. 
 - Specifications and quality: Create, update and review FDS, TDS and API documentation; perform code reviews and maintain relevant CIL updates. 
 - Release and upgrade delivery: Contribute to PEMS upgrades and releases by developing changes, assessing risk, designing and executing tests, and deploying to validation and production environments. 
 - Testing and validation: Prepare and execute SIT and OQ test cases and support compliant delivery across the end-to-end release cycle. 
 - Business collaboration: Work with users, system owners, system managers, product and project stakeholders, IT SMEs, service providers, consultants and vendors to deliver high-quality solutions. 
 - Continuous improvement: Understand system functionality, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, propose new ideas and adapt methods based on operational experience and feedback. 
 - Agile delivery: Contribute actively in daily stand-ups, PI Planning, team channels and other Agile delivery activities. 

Who You'll Work With

You will join the LAPS Development and work globally with colleagues supporting QC laboratory operations and the PEMS system. Your partners will include line-of-business users, system owners and managers, product and project stakeholders, department managers, IT subject-matter experts, service providers, external consultants, vendors and the Release Train Engineer. 

You will collaborate with these groups throughout development, support, release and improvement activities, presenting solutions and coordinating vendor contributions to keep delivery aligned with business needs and quality expectations. 

What You Can Expect Here

You will work in an international, regulated environment where technical quality, compliance and dependable laboratory systems matter. The role offers broad ownership across development, problem solving, validation, stakeholder collaboration and release delivery, with opportunities to deepen your LabVantage expertise and influence future improvements. 

You will be encouraged to bring forward ideas, share knowledge, mentor colleagues and take initiative on complex challenges while helping the team deliver trusted systems and services. 

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build and improve LabVantage LIMS solutions that support QC laboratory operations, apply for the PEMS application developer role.

data.title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
data.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world. 

SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations. 

What You Will Do

- Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems. 
 - Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers. 
 - Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data. 
 - Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues. 
 - Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions. 
 - Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes. 
 - Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas. 
 - Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses. 
 - Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations. 
 - Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes. 
 - Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks. 
 - Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas. 
 - Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior. 
 - Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions. 
 - Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems. 
 - Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared. 
 - Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions. 
 - Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation. 
 - Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis. 

Must-have Qualifications

- Technical
 - 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company. 
 - Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc. 
 - Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code. 
 - Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems. 
 - Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
 - Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
 - Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components. 
 - Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products. 
 - Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues. 
 - Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes. 
 - Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence. 
 - Behavioral
 - Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work. 
 - Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information. 
 - Willingness to challenge assumptions. 
 - Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them. 
 - Strong ownership of difficult investigations

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

This position is part of the R&D Validation and Verification (V&V) team. The R&D team is responsible for designing, implementing, and testing embedded software for protection and control applications, primarily in the electrical distribution and transmission industry. 

The role also includes the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, and Agentic AI to enhance R&D V&V activities, including intelligent test automation, automated test-case generation, test-result analysis, anomaly detection, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of verification and validation processes. 

Job Description

- Define and implement comprehensive Verification & Validation (V&V) strategies, test plans, and frameworks for power-system, protection, control, embedded software, and industrial communication products. 
 - Review system requirements, communication specifications, use cases, interfaces, and architecture to establish complete test coverage, traceability, and validation criteria. 
 - Design and execute system-level, integration, communication, functional, regression, interoperability, performance, robustness, and negative testing. 
 - Develop and maintain Python-based automated test frameworks, communication simulators, protocol test tools, and test infrastructure. 
 - Plan and execute validation of industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104 (T104), T103, T101, TCP/IP, Ethernet, and Serial communication. 
 - Perform communication interoperability and integration testing between IEDs, protection relays, RTUs, SCADA systems, gateways, PLCs, control systems, and substation automation systems. 
 - Validate communication functions including data exchange, command/control, time synchronization, event reporting, configuration, fault handling, timeout, recovery, redundancy, and performance. 
 - Develop Python-based tools for protocol message generation, packet analysis, device simulation, communication monitoring, automated validation, and fault injection. 
 - Analyze communication traces, network packets, relay event records, system logs, and test results to identify communication and system-level issues. 
 - Troubleshoot complex communication, embedded software, firmware, and system-integration issues and perform structured root-cause analysis. 
 - Work closely with Power Systems, Protection, Hardware, Firmware, Software, Systems Engineering, and Continuous Engineering teams to resolve defects and improve product reliability. 
 - Validate Protection & Control systems for generators, transmission lines, transformers, motors, busbars, substations, and digital control applications. 
 - Test protection schemes including Overcurrent/Earth Fault, Differential, Distance, Generator, Motor, Transformer, and Busbar protection. 
 - Validate protection relays, IEDs, RTUs, SCADA interfaces, digital control systems, gateways, and embedded software/firmware. 
 - Apply AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI to communication and V&V activities. 
 - Develop AI Agents that can analyze communication requirements, generate test scenarios, orchestrate approved test workflows, analyze protocol logs, detect anomalies, classify failures, and assist with root-cause analysis. 
 - Develop Agentic AI-based communication testing solutions capable of interacting with approved testing tools, simulators, protocol analyzers, and V&V infrastructure. 
 - Apply AI-assisted analysis to IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, T104, TCP/IP, Ethernet, and serial communication logs and traces to accelerate troubleshooting and defect identification. 
 - Implement intelligent workflows for automated test-case generation, regression-test optimization, communication anomaly detection, test-result analysis, and automated V&V reporting. 
 - Ensure AI/Agentic AI-based testing remains traceable, explainable, repeatable, deterministic where required, and subject to engineering validation and human approval. 
 - Establish and maintain CI/CT-based automated V&V pipelines for continuous communication and system testing. 
 - Use JIRA, Xray, Confluence, Git, and other engineering tools for requirements traceability, test management, defect tracking, documentation, and configuration management. 
 - Continuously improve communication testing methodologies, automation frameworks, AI-assisted V&V capabilities, test coverage, and product reliability. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Communication Engineering, Instrumentation, or Power Systems Engineering. 
 - Minimum 3+ years of experience in communication testing, system V&V, embedded software/firmware testing, automation, or R&D engineering. 
 - Strong Python programming skills for automation, scripting, protocol testing, data analysis, and tool integration. 
 - Strong understanding of industrial communication, power-system automation, protection, control, and embedded systems. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of: 
 - IEC 61850
 - DNP3
 - Modbus
 - IEC 60870-5-104 (T104)
 - T103
 - T101
 - TCP/IP
 - Ethernet
 - Serial communication
 - Experience with communication troubleshooting, protocol analysis, packet capture, message decoding, interoperability testing, and network diagnostics. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI applied to testing, automation, communication analysis, or engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of AI Agent architecture, tool/function calling, RAG, APIs, Python-based AI automation, and intelligent workflow orchestration is desirable. 
Power System & Protection Knowledge

- Understanding of electrical distribution and transmission systems. 
 - Knowledge of Protection & Control systems for generators, transmission lines, transformers, motors, busbars, and substations. 
 - Knowledge of IEC and ANSI standards related to protection, control, automation, and communication. 
 - Understanding of CT/VT calculations and protection relay settings is advantageous. 
 - Experience with ABB, Siemens, SEL, and other major relay manufacturers is an advantage. 

AI & Agentic Communication Engineering

- Develop intelligent communication-testing agents capable of: 
 - Analyzing communication requirements
 - Generating protocol test scenarios
 - Creating test data
 - Executing approved test workflows
 - Monitoring communication traffic
 - Analyzing protocol logs
 - Detecting communication anomalies
 - Identifying failure patterns
 - Supporting root-cause analysis
 - Generating automated test reports
 - Combine Agentic AI + Python + industrial protocols + power-system domain knowledge to create next-generation automated communication V&V solutions. 
 - Apply human-in-the-loop controls and engineering validation for AI-driven decisions in safety- and reliability-critical power-system applications. 
Tools & Processes

- Python, Git, JIRA, Xray, Confluence
 - Protocol analyzers and network diagnostic tools
 - Automated test frameworks and simulators
 - CI/CD and Continuous Testing
 - SDLC, STLC, V-Model, Agile/SAFe
 - White-box, black-box, system, integration, regression, interoperability, and performance testing

Desired Characteristics

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills in industrial communication and embedded systems. 
 - Ability to bridge communication engineering, power systems, protection & control, software automation, and Agentic AI. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills across multidisciplinary R&D teams. 
 - Strong interest in applying AI Agents and intelligent automation to next-generation power-system communication and V&V. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

We design and develop our back end systems and REST APIs that serve hundreds of millions of searches a day, collecting and parsing data across thousands of partners to get the best deals for our customers

In This Role You Will Get To

 - Innovate with a cross-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates and delivers on new product objectives. 
 - Showcase fluency and development skills of Java

 - Apply your programming skills towards building low latency and high throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing. 
 - Implement SQL composition skills that collects and queries data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications. 
 - The ability to quickly apply your experience to understand our codebase, systems and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications. 
 - Influencer and communicator on team development efforts. Influence what the best solutions are and communicate your findings to key business stakeholders. 

Who You Are

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in software engineering and development. 
 - Exceptional coding experience with Java. 
 - An interest in being a mentor and influencing best practices with less experienced developers. 
 - Strong grasp of SQL compositions skills for composing queries and analysis. 
 - Confident with the utilization of Spring Frameworks, Web Services and APIs. 
 - Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP. 
 - Experience in Microservices, Kubernetes (GKE preferable), and Dockers. 
 - Proven ability in Design and Architecture of complex, highly scalable and performance driven applications. 
 - Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust. 
 - The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it's a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential. 

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE. 

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Our culture is unique and inspiring (that's what our employees tell us). We're a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn't stabilized. 

We're on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, and scale cloud-native applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS technologies, and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate is a well-rounded full-stack engineer who works independently across backend services, modern web application development, and cloud-native architectures, applying sound engineering judgment across a range of situations with only occasional guidance. The role requires familiarity with AI-assisted development practices and the ability to incorporate AI-powered capabilities into business solutions where they add measurable value. This individual demonstrates strong ownership, delivers quality outcomes with minimal oversight, contributes to design and architecture based on approved patterns, and supports and mentors less-experienced engineers while contributing hands-on to the design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications using AWS services and modern engineering practices. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and contemporary frontend development practices. 
 - Build responsive, performant, and user-friendly experiences in partnership with product owners and business stakeholders. 
 - Develop scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices-based architectures, ensuring optimal use of frameworks for efficient, maintainable code. 
 - Contribute across the full technology stack, from user interfaces through APIs, business services, cloud infrastructure, and production support. 
 - Draft designs and architecture based on approved patterns, and apply best practices for cloud architecture, security, observability, performance, and resiliency. 
 - Design AWS serverless components (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) and containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and proactively identify cost-optimization opportunities. 
 - Optimize database design and queries across relational (Postgres, Aurora, MySQL, Oracle) and non-relational (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis) stores, and contribute to data modeling activities. 
 - Automate deployment, monitoring, and management of cloud applications, and create and maintain operational dashboards in CloudWatch, Sumo Logic, and Dynatracz. 
 - Lead RFCs and support deployments; create effective root-cause analyses for incidents to prevent recurrence. 
 - Resolve security defects raised by AMU, Veracode, SCA, and Wiz scans independently, embracing a security-first mindset. 
 - Utilize Delta-approved AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Copilot, Kiro) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, while critically validating AI-generated output. 
 - Evaluate and incorporate AI-powered capabilities into applications when they provide measurable business value. 
 - Demonstrate end-to-end ownership of technical solutions from design through production support, delivering with minimal supervision. 
 - Proactively identify risks and dependencies, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and mentor developers through code reviews and pair programming. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 4+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and modern frontend development patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and building distributed systems, including the ability to draft architecture based on approved patterns. 
 - Experience deploying and managing applications using ROSA, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Solid working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e. g. , GitLab CI, ROSA pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, Nexus, SonarQube, Veracode). 
 - Strong programming skills in Java; working knowledge of Python is a plus. 
 - Experience optimizing SQL/NoSQL databases, writing efficient queries, and contributing to data modeling. 
 - Demonstrated experience using Delta-approved AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt design, and common AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical solutions independently with occasional guidance. 
 - Experience mentoring or guiding junior developers and reviewing peers' pull requests. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification. 
 - Experience with microservices architecture and serverless computing. 
 - Understanding of networking and security principles in cloud environments. 
 - Exposure to modern AI technologies and frameworks, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP, is a plus. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

data.title: Security Validation Lead
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

In this context, you will be responsible for Camera Image Sensor SoC validation, focusing on Security, Secure Streaming, Cryptographic Validation, and System-Level Functional validation. 

The candidate will be responsible for validating security features across the Camera Image Sensor SoC, ensuring robust implementation of security architectures including Secure Boot, Root of Trust, Authentication, Encryption, Hashing, Secure Firmware Update, Secure Streaming, and Anti-Tamper mechanisms. The role requires deep understanding of imaging pipelines, embedded systems, security protocols, and automation using Python. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate end-to-end security architecture of Camera Image Sensor SoCs. 
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans for hybrid cryptographic schemes combining classical and PQC algorithms: 
 - Secure Boot
 - Chain of Trust
 - Secure Firmware Loading
 - Secure Debug Access
 - Secure Key Provisioning
 - Anti-Tamper Mechanisms
 - Secure Manufacturing Flows
 - Secure video streaming
 - Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms. 
 - Validate OTP -based security configurations. 
 - Perform negative testing and security robustness testing. 
Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. 
 - Knowledge: 
 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM (Quality Assurance/SailPoint Testing)
data.description:
FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc. , a top 20 U. S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company's over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients' greatest ambitions. 

Job Description

Value Proposition

As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at First Citizens Bank, the Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM (Quality Assurance) will serve as the technical leader responsible for defining and driving the quality engineering strategy for enterprise IAM platforms and services. 

This role requires deep expertise in IAM technologies, quality engineering, test automation, and cybersecurity practices. The successful candidate will provide leadership across multiple IAM initiatives, establish testing standards and frameworks, drive automation maturity, and ensure the security, scalability, reliability, and compliance of IAM solutions. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to engineering, architecture, product, and cyber security teams while influencing strategic technology decisions across the IAM ecosystem. 

Job Details

Job Title : Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM

Career Level: P4

Job Category: Assistant Vice President

Role Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bangalore

About The Team

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program supports end-to-end identity governance, access lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, and privileged access management capabilities for employees, contractors, partners, and enterprise applications across the organization. 

Impact

This position resides within the Cyber Security organization and is responsible for establishing the quality engineering vision and testing strategy across IAM platforms. The role will drive test automation, security validation, performance engineering, and quality governance for critical IAM capabilities. 

The Principal Engineer will lead complex testing initiatives, influence architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and ensure enterprise IAM solutions meet security, operational, regulatory, and business requirements. This individual contributor role partners closely with IAM Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and Information Security leadership teams. 

Key Deliverables (Duties And Responsibilities)

- Define and drive the enterprise IAM Quality Engineering and Test Automation strategy. 
 - Hands-on experience on Selenium, building test strategy for large scale platforms like SailPoint, Automation using Python or other scripting languages. 
 - Establish testing standards, frameworks, tools, governance models, and best practices across IAM programs. 
 - Lead quality assurance efforts for Identity Governance, Access Management, SSO, Federation, MFA, PAM, and Directory Services initiatives. 
 - Design and build scalable automated test frameworks leveraging modern programming languages and enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Drive continuous testing practices integrated with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps methodologies. 
 - Define quality gates, release readiness criteria, risk assessments, and production validation processes. 
 - Provide technical leadership for end-to-end testing across IAM platforms, APIs, workflows, integrations, and cloud services. 
 - Partner with architecture teams to review solution designs and ensure testability, scalability, resilience, and security requirements are met. 
 - Lead security testing initiatives including authentication, authorization, privilege escalation, API security, and identity lifecycle validation. 
 - Establish performance, load, stress, and resilience testing strategies for IAM platforms. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers on quality engineering, automation practices, and testing methodologies. 
 - Drive adoption of shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles across IAM delivery teams. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, cyber security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards. 
 - Evaluate emerging testing technologies, AI-driven automation capabilities, and industry best practices to improve effectiveness and efficiency. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and strategic technology planning. 
 - Develop and report quality metrics, automation coverage, defect trends, and risk indicators to senior leadership. 
 - Serve as the escalation point for complex testing, integration, and production quality challenges. 

Functional Skills

Skills and Qualifications (Functional and Technical Skills)

- Strong leadership and influencing skills with the ability to drive enterprise-wide quality initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to define testing strategies and quality engineering roadmaps for large-scale IAM programs. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, security, architecture, and operations. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
 - Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution when required. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and developing technical talent. 

Technical / Business Skills

- 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or information security engineering. 
 - 7+ years of experience supporting IAM technologies and identity lifecycle processes. 
 - Deep understanding of IAM concepts including: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)Single Sign-On (SSO)Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)FederationSAMLOAuth 2. 0OpenID Connect (OIDC)LDAPRole-Based Access Control (RBAC)Privileged Access Management (PAM)
 - Strong experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud. 
 - Expertise in building enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium, Rest Assured, Postman, Cucumber, JUnit, TestNG, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience implementing automated testing within CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab. 
 - Experience testing APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong understanding of security testing methodologies and cybersecurity controls. 
 - Experience building performance and scalability testing frameworks using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or LoadRunner. 
 - Experience working in Agile, DevSecOps, and cloud environments. 
 - Strong understanding of data validation, test data management, and synthetic data generation. 
 - Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to financial services environments is preferred. 
 - Relevant certifications are highly desirable: CISSPCISMCIAMSailPoint CertificationsCertified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE)Agile Testing Certifications

Accessibility Needs

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage (application, interviews, or onboarding), we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.

data.title: Quality Assurance Principal
data.description:
The Quality Assurance Principal is responsible for supporting DeepHealth products and product development, and for Quality Management System effectiveness across the organization. This individual contributor role leads design-quality and product lifecycle quality work, owns assigned QMS processes such as CAPA and complaint management, guides junior Quality Assurance team members, and partners with Engineering, Clinical, Marketing, and QRC colleagues to maintain compliance with applicable US and outside-US standards and regulations. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Engage cross-functionally with Engineering, Clinical, Marketing, and other partners to support new product development through Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and New Product Introduction (NPI) processes. 
 - Act as the Quality lead for design changes to existing DeepHealth products, including non-medical devices, so changes remain compliant with applicable standards and guidance. 
 - Guide junior Quality Assurance team members on consistent implementation of quality processes, including design control and risk management. 
 - Own assigned product-related Quality Management System processes, such as CAPA and complaint management, to maintain compliance and improve efficiency. 
 - Work cross-functionally to integrate products following corporate and/or product acquisitions. 
 - Partner with the Quality Assurance team to maintain compliance with applicable US and outside-US standards and regulations. 
 - Support preparation for and participation in regulatory audits related to design quality and QMS processes as assigned. 
 - Collect and monitor quality metrics in support of Management Review. 
 - Identify quality and compliance risks, escalate issues that may affect patient safety or market compliance, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of design quality and QMS processes, and support development of junior staff as requested. 

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. 

Minimum Qualifications, Education And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience (for example, an Associate's degree with 5 years of related experience) (required). 
 - 8 to 10 years of experience in a regulated industry (required); FDA-regulated and Software as a Medical Device experience preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of FDA Quality System Regulations, including 21 CFR Part 11 and 21 CFR Part 820 (required). 
 - Demonstrated experience leading design quality, design control, and/or QMS process ownership in a medical device or SaMD environment (required). 
 - Experience guiding or mentoring junior Quality Assurance colleagues without formal people management (required). 
 - Excellent written and oral communication skills (required). 
 - Preferred: Knowledge of EU MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 62304. 
 - Preferred: Knowledge of pre- and post-market clinical study requirements (for example, 21 CFR Parts 812, 50, and 56). 
 - Preferred: Participation in regulatory audits. 
 - Preferred: Experience supporting product or quality integration following acquisitions. 

Quality Standards

 - Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. 
 - Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment. 
 - Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures. 
 - Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. 
 - Practices universal safety precautions. 
 - Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. 
 - Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. 
 - Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. 
 - Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. 

Travel

This position may require occasional travel for audits, acquisitions support, or cross-site collaboration. 

Working Environment

Remote / Hybrid. India (per requisition). Flexible schedule may be required to support international teams. 

Physical Demands

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Based on experience: 

₹30-50 LPA (INR, annual)

Experience

Job Location

Role Overview

The Engineer / Sr. Engineer - QA/QC will be responsible for monitoring and implementing quality control procedures for assigned tower(s) at the construction site. The role involves ensuring that all construction activities are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. 

The candidate will work closely with civil execution teams, subcontractors, and consultants to ensure proper quality control across structural works, reinforcement, formwork systems, finishing works, and MEP installations. 

Key ResponsibilitiesSite Quality Inspections

- Conduct regular quality inspections at various stages of construction for assigned tower(s). 
 - Ensure works are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and method statements. 
 - Monitor quality compliance for structural works, reinforcement, formwork, finishing, and MEP activities. 

Inspection & Testing Implementation

- Ensure implementation of Inspection and Testing Plans (ITP) for construction activities. 
 - Verify reinforcement checks, formwork alignment, concrete works, finishing works, and MEP installations before approvals. 
 - Monitor material testing and field test procedures. 

Material Quality Verification

- Ensure materials used at site meet approved specifications and standards. 
 - Verify material test reports, inspection records, and certifications including concrete cube tests and steel test reports. 

Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions

- Identify quality deviations and non-conformance issues during site inspections. 
 - Assist in raising Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and follow up for corrective actions. 
 - Ensure timely rectification of quality issues at work fronts. 

Coordination with Site Teams

- Coordinate with civil engineers, tower incharges, and subcontractors to maintain quality standards. 
 - Ensure proper sequencing of activities to maintain construction quality and workmanship. 
 - Support execution teams in resolving quality-related issues. 

Consultant Inspections

- Assist in coordinating consultant and client inspections for assigned work fronts. 
 - Ensure readiness of work areas for quality approvals and inspections. 
 - Address consultant observations and ensure closure. 

Documentation & Reporting

- Maintain records of inspection checklists, quality reports, material approvals, and test results. 
 - Prepare daily inspection reports and quality monitoring reports for assigned towers. 
 - Maintain proper documentation for quality audits and compliance. 

Technical Skills Required

- Strong knowledge of construction quality standards and inspection procedures
 - Experience in quality control for high-rise building construction
 - Ability to read and interpret structural and architectural drawings
 - Familiarity with inspection and testing procedures for construction materials
 - Proficiency in MS Excel and quality documentation

Preferred Skills

- Strong attention to detail and inspection capability
 - Good coordination with execution teams and subcontractors
 - Strong documentation and reporting skills
 - Ability to enforce quality standards at work fronts
