data.title: Technology Delivery Lead (Markets Technology) (Prime Services, Equity Swaps & Secured Financing) - Managing Director
data.description:
State Street is seeking an accomplished senior technology leader to lead technology delivery for the Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing businesses within State Street Markets Technology. This will provide strategic leadership, delivery oversight, and engineering excellence across globally distributed teams, with a significant delivery footprint in India. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving execution across complex technology portfolios, enabling business growth, modernizing platforms, strengthening operational resilience, and building high-performing engineering organizations. As the India-based senior technology leader, will oversee both employee and vendor delivery teams, partnering closely with business, operations, risk, and technology leaders globally to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions. The role requires a strong blend of business acumen, engineering leadership, transformation experience, and execution rigor within highly regulated financial services environments. 

Role Overview

The Managing Director will serve as the senior technology delivery leader for Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing Technology. The role owns end-to-end technology execution across the software delivery lifecycle and is accountable for delivery predictability, platform stability, modernization, workforce strategy, and engineering excellence. 

This leader will play a critical role in supporting State Street Markets' strategic growth objectives, including scaling newly launched business capabilities, expanding product offerings, modernizing technology platforms, and advancing automation across front-to-back operational processes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Delivery Leadership & Business Execution-
 - Own end-to-end technology delivery across Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing, including architecture, engineering, testing, release management, and production support. 
 - Deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes aligned with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and client commitments. 
 - Scale technology capabilities supporting the growth of the Equity Swaps business across global markets. 
 - Lead strategic modernization initiatives, including platform transformation, application rationalization, and legacy technology retirement. 
 - Drive front-to-back automation across Prime Services workflows, including corporate actions, claims, recalls, and billing processes. 
 - Enhance platform resilience, security, and operational stability through cloud adoption, application modernization, technology controls, and remediation programs. 
 - Expand technology capabilities supporting Secured Financing products, including intraday repo, agency repo, and unsecured bond borrow offerings. 
 - Global Delivery & India Leadership-
 - Serve as the senior delivery executive for India-based engineering teams supporting Prime Services, Equity Swaps, and Secured Financing. 
 - Drive organizational scale, productivity, and delivery excellence across globally distributed teams. 
 - Establish and evolve a high-performance operating model with clear accountability, governance, execution discipline, and workforce optimization. 
 - Lead effective collaboration across global technology, business, and operations organizations to ensure successful delivery outcomes. 
 - Engineering Modernization & Transformation-
 - Define and execute the technology modernization roadmap aligned to business growth and strategic priorities. 
 - Accelerate adoption of cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, event-driven platforms, and engineering best practices. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through automation, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, and site reliability practices. 
 - Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities to improve productivity, quality, and delivery velocity. 
 - Risk, Controls & Operational Excellence-
 - Establish robust governance frameworks covering delivery health, operational performance, risk management, and service quality. 
 - Ensure proactive identification and mitigation of execution, technology, cyber, and operational risks. 
 - Strengthen controls and resiliency aligned with enterprise risk management and regulatory expectations. 
 - Drive operational excellence through disciplined metrics, transparency, and continuous improvement. 
 - Executive Stakeholder Management-
 - Act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior leaders across business, operations, technology, and risk functions. 
 - Lead executive governance forums and delivery reviews. 
 - Provide transparent, data-driven reporting on portfolio performance, investment priorities, risks, and strategic outcomes. 
 - Influence key technology and business decisions through strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement. 
 - Talent & Organizational Leadership-
 - Build and develop high-performing engineering teams capable of delivering strategic business outcomes. 
 - Lead workforce planning, succession management, leadership development, and capability-building initiatives. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 - Optimize the workforce model across employees and strategic vendor partners to support long-term business growth. 
 - Enterprise Leadership-
 - Contribute to broader State Street technology priorities, including engineering excellence, talent strategy, AI adoption, delivery governance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Collaborate across technology organizations to drive consistency in standards, practices, and execution methodologies. 
 - Support enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that enhance scalability, resiliency, and business agility. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 20+ years of progressive experience leading technology delivery and large-scale engineering organizations within financial services or complex global enterprises. 
 - Proven track record of delivering large transformation programs and managing complex technology portfolios. 
 - Deep knowledge of Capital Markets, Prime Brokerage, Securities Finance, or related Markets businesses. 
 - Strong engineering background with experience in modern technology architectures, including cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Demonstrated success leading global teams across multiple locations, including employee and vendor organizations. 
 - Strong execution discipline with expertise in delivery management, software engineering, production stability, and operational excellence. 
 - Deep understanding of risk management, technology controls, cyber security, resilience, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Exceptional communication, collaboration, and executive leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders globally. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading technology organizations supporting Prime Brokerage, Securities Finance, Secured Financing, Equity Swaps, or broader Markets businesses. 
 - Experience driving cloud transformation, platform modernization, and enterprise-scale engineering transformations. 
 - Knowledge of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation, and emerging productivity technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Agile, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and engineering maturity models. 
 - Architecture-level understanding of enterprise data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and front-to-back financial services technology architectures. 

Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don't necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit. 

Why This Role Is Important To Us

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We're driving the company's digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation. 

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We're looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company. 

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. data.title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain. 

Job Description

We are seeking a visionary and highly technical AI Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success. 

Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend. 

Responsibilities

- AI Architecture & Custom Integration
 - Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components. 
 - Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects. 
 - Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e. g. , CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization. 
 - Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
 - Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors. 
 - Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations. 
 - Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting. 
 - Cross-Functional Efficiency
 - Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers. 
 - Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC). 
 - Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems. 
 - Ability to write and maintain production integrations - Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent - connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools. 
 - Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack - specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
 - Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance. 
 - Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD, " you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel. 
 - Experience with AI agent orchestration - managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce). 
 - Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents - treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup. 
 - Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it - and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD And QAD Redzone

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. 

QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD's vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

data.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

Chalhoub Group's Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail. 

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

Lead delivery of the group's digital commerce applications, owning sprint and Program Increment execution from planning through release. Keep commitments realistic against available capacity, and manage risks, dependencies, and release readiness across the digital release cycle. 

- Lead delivery for digital commerce capability within the Omnichannel domain, managing the squad that delivers these capabilities for the group's brands. 
 - Deliver the committed sprint and PI scope for the capability to agreed quality, with predictable velocity and no unplanned slippage against committed dates. 
 - Improve release readiness and stability for the capability, reducing defects reaching production and the time taken to resolve them. 
 - Produce the sprint and PI plan in Confluence, documenting objectives, scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, and committed deliverables, and maintain it through the increment. 
 - Provide objectives, status updates, and exact man-days per item for consolidation into PI billing to the business. 
 - Manage delivery demand against squad capacity, ensuring commitments are realistic, and dependencies across squads are understood before work is planned. 
 - Facilitate agile ceremonies, track RAID items through to closure, and coordinate release readiness, cutover, and handover with engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Remove impediments for the squad, and escalate risks, dependencies, and scope changes that threaten committed outcomes to the Head of Digital. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 6 to 9 years in digital commerce platforms, including leading an agile delivery squad. 
 - Experience delivering on SFCC, Shopify or Shopify Plus within a digital commerce environment. 
 - Experience running sprint and PI planning, managing squad capacity, and tracking risks, issues, and dependencies to closure. 
 - Experience coordinating release readiness, cutover, and handover with engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Usage proficiency in Jira and Confluence or related project management tools for planning, documentation, and reporting. 
 - Experience providing delivery inputs for billing or cost recovery to the business. 
 - Certification in agile delivery, such as Scrum Master or SAFe, is nice to have. 
 - Preferred Profile: Retail or e-commerce domain experience. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor. Profiles such as Digital Capability Lead, Delivery Lead, Delivery Manager, or Agile Delivery Lead in digital commerce. 

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. 

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. 

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.title: Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
Join our India Tech Hub - Be among the first hires!

Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world's most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty. 

About The Team And What We Will Build Together

The Manager of Software Engineering leads one or more Agile development squads within the Software Engineering group at Kobie. As part of our strategic roadmap and client implementations, this role focuses on delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions while supporting the growth and development of the engineering team. 

As a key leader within the team, you will work closely with Product Owners, QA, Architects, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-designed technical solutions. You will guide a team of skilled engineers in building and delivering reliable software, while fostering strong engineering practices and a collaborative team environment. 

You will play an active role in day-to-day delivery, sprint execution, and team enablement ensuring predictable outcomes, high-quality releases, and continuous improvement. This includes supporting resource planning, mentoring engineers, and helping the team grow both technically and professionally. 

In this role, you will build strong partnerships with product and cross-functional teams, gaining a deep understanding of business needs and contributing to solutions that leverage modern technologies within a scalable platform ecosystem. 

The Manager of Software Engineering is responsible for driving team momentum, maintaining high standards of execution, and ensuring alignment between engineering efforts and product goals. You will also help communicate technical approaches and decisions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, building strong working relationships across the organization. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Lead one or more Agile development squads within the Software Engineering group, delivering scalable and high-quality platform capabilities and client solutions
 - Partner closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects and the teams to translate business requirements into well-designed technical solutions
 - Drive end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and alignment with product and client implementation goals
 - Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, coaching, and performance feedback, helping them grow their skills and careers
 - Contribute to the design and development of modern distributed systems and microservices architectures
 - Champion strong engineering practices, including code quality, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness
 - Work with QA and SDET teams to improve test automation coverage and quality engineering practices across Agile squads
 - Demonstrated ability to define and evolve CI/CD strategies and infrastructure, enabling automated, secure, and efficient deployments
 - Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment that drives team momentum, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement

What You Need To Be Successful

- 8-10 years of software development experience, with 2+ years of engineering leadership or team management
 - Proven experience leading Agile development teams delivering production-grade software systems
 - Hands-on expertise in modern backend and frontend technologies (e. g. , Java, Spring, Angular) and testing methodologies
 - Strong understanding of modern Java architecture including event-driven design, Kafka, pub/sub messaging patterns, and scalable microservices
 - Familiarity with event-driven design and messaging platforms such as Kafka or similar pub/sub systems
 - Experience running production workloads in cloud-based, containerized environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
 - Demonstrated ability to define and evolve CI/CD strategies and infrastructure, enabling automated, secure, and efficient deployments
 - Knowledge of test automation strategy and frameworks, including test coverage analysis, parallel test execution, and integration into CI pipelines
 - Experience with testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Rest Assured, Postman, SoapUI, or similar frameworks and test-first development approaches, preferably BDD
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization
 - Ability to mentor engineers, drive team accountability, and maintain focus on delivering high-quality outcomes

About Kobie

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We're always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. 

As a trusted partner to some of the world's most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special. 

We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard. 

Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie, through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities. 

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays, offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance. 

As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U. S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection. 

Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Own the hardest engineering outcomes in X3 and turn architecture direction into working, supportable product capabilities. Set the technical bar across squads while remaining close enough to the code, evidence and customer impact to make sound decisions. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Expert understanding of distributed systems architecture, including domain-driven design, service decomposition, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, scalability, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, consistency models, disaster recovery, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Extensive experience defining and governing API-first and event-driven platforms, including REST, GraphQL, messaging architectures, service contracts, versioning strategies, backward compatibility, integration governance, and ecosystem extensibility. 
 - Strong engineering and architecture expertise across relational databases and document databases, including platform-scale data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, replication, migration strategies, data lifecycle management, and operational resilience. 
 - Deep experience leading cloud-native engineering initiatives encompassing containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, secure software supply chains, observability, reliability engineering, security architecture, upgrade strategies, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex modernization initiatives, balancing legacy constraints, customer continuity, platform evolution, technical debt reduction, and long-term architectural sustainability. 
 - Proven ability to evaluate and govern AI-assisted engineering practices, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, security controls, testing strategies, and operational safeguards. 
 - Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, architects, product leaders, operational teams, and executives around complex technical decisions, risks, investments, and trade-offs. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Shape platform capabilities as strategic products that enable engineering velocity, operational excellence, ecosystem extensibility, and long-term scalability across multiple squads and domains. 
 - Define and govern service boundaries, domain ownership models, API contracts, event architectures, distributed systems patterns, and platform standards that remain sustainable as the organization scales. 
 - Establish organization-wide engineering expectations for secure software delivery, supply-chain security, identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, infrastructure automation, observability, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Drive adoption of OpenTelemetry-compatible observability, reliability engineering practices, SLOs, performance management, capacity planning, resilience testing, incident learning, and recovery strategies across engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical leadership for platform engineering capabilities, including containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, developer experience improvements, automation, self-service engineering capabilities, and FinOps optimization where appropriate. 
 - Define and govern compatibility, upgrade, migration, deprecation, recovery, and rollback strategies that protect customer continuity, partner investments, operational stability, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders, establish engineering standards, review architectural direction, and influence cross-functional technical decision-making across the portfolio. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing large-scale ERP, enterprise business applications, batch-processing platforms, reporting platforms, or complex legacy systems. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are valuable context but are not required. 
 - Deep understanding of ERP, manufacturing, distribution, finance, supply-chain, commerce, or operational workflow domains, including platform modernization, migration, reconciliation, and business continuity. 
 - Experience leading platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, cloud platform transformations, developer-experience initiatives, or internal platform product development. 
 - Experience designing extensible ecosystems, marketplace architectures, partner enablement platforms, metadata-driven platforms, migration factories, or highly configurable enterprise applications. 
 - Experience delivering regulated, highly available, enterprise-scale SaaS platforms with strong requirements for reliability, security, compliance, privacy, auditability, and operational governance. 
 - Experience influencing engineering organizations through architecture governance, technical strategy, technology roadmap definition, engineering excellence programs, and senior technical mentorship. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture, platform strategy, distributed systems design, and cross-team technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native products. 
 - Demonstrated success leading major modernization, transformation, platform, or SaaS initiatives that span multiple teams, business domains, and technology stacks. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability. 

Provide your feedback on BizChat

Expected outcomes / success measures

- A small number of agreed architecture decisions and transition states guide delivery without blocking squads. 
 - Modern components and contracts reduce coupling, runtime dependency and support effort while preserving customer behaviour. 
 - Critical releases and migration waves have repeatable quality, observability and rollback evidence. 
 - Engineers make more decisions locally because standards, examples and mentoring are clear. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Managers, Principal and Senior Engineers, Automation, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services, partners and Europe/North America domain experts. India delivery is a first-class ownership centre with planned Europe/North America overlap and clear hand-offs across time zones. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Acts as a calm technical role model, makes uncertainty visible, develops talent and chooses the simplest safe path that improves customer and business outcomes. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Own cross-squad technical strategy for a significant modernisation outcome, from current-state discovery through a viable transition state and measurable exit criteria. 
 - Make and record decisions on domain boundaries, GraphQL contracts, componentisation, data-path simplification and legacy-runtime reduction. 
 - Lead difficult implementation, incident, performance and migration problems; decide when to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire a capability. 
 - Set engineering standards for secure coding, testing, observability, deployment, upgrades and rollback, and ensure they are adopted rather than merely documented. 
 - Coach senior and developing engineers, grow technical leadership in India and across the distributed squad network, and challenge designs constructively. 

Decision ownership: 

Technical direction within the assigned portfolio, cross-squad trade-offs, exception escalation, transition-state design and acceptance of engineering evidence. Escalates product, legal, security or commercial policy decisions with a clear recommendation. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Lead substantial engineering work within a X3 squad, delivering maintainable modern capabilities while protecting X3 behaviour, upgradeability and operational continuity. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong software engineering experience delivering cloud-native SaaS platforms and distributed systems using modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/Node. js, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a track record of building secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including service decomposition, synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, event-driven architectures, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, scalability, observability, eventual consistency, and failure-recovery strategies. 
 - Deep experience designing, developing, and evolving API-first platforms, including REST, GraphQL, event-driven integrations, service contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, security controls, and integration governance. 
 - Experience designing and operating solutions using relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, migration strategies, and operational support. 
 - Strong cloud-native engineering experience across containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, telemetry, secure software supply chains, reliability engineering, release management, upgrade strategies, disaster recovery, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience defining domain boundaries, service ownership models, integration contracts, extensibility frameworks, and modernization patterns that improve maintainability, scalability, and customer continuity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern web application architecture, including React, TypeScript, component-based design, state management, accessibility, responsive design, browser performance optimization, and browser-to-service integration patterns where relevant to the domain. 
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering responsibly with appropriate human review, traceability, automated testing, security validation, and regression evidence. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, participate in architecture reviews, and collaborate effectively across globally distributed engineering teams. 

Modern Platform Skills for this Role

- Own service and API contracts, event-driven integrations, and domain boundaries within the assigned area, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Design and operate distributed services using modern SaaS engineering principles, including observability, performance management, fault isolation, resiliency patterns, capacity planning, and reliability engineering. 
 - Drive secure software delivery through CI/CD, supply-chain security controls, identity and secrets management, policy enforcement, automated quality gates, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Establish and maintain OpenTelemetry-compatible observability practices, including logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, operational dashboards, alerting strategies, and production diagnostics. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering capabilities through containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, self-service delivery patterns, and automation that improves developer productivity and operational excellence. 
 - Own compatibility, upgrade, migration, recovery, and rollback strategies for services under management, ensuring customer continuity and operational resilience. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing legacy business applications, ERP platforms, batch-processing systems, data migration solutions, reporting platforms, or other enterprise software environments. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are beneficial but not required. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React, Next. js, TypeScript, design systems, micro-frontends, accessibility frameworks, and advanced user experience patterns. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, messaging platforms, distributed data architectures, performance engineering, platform engineering, and production operations at SaaS scale. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted software development practices, including code generation, automated testing, code review workflows, security validation, traceability, and regression management. 
 - Experience operating global-scale SaaS platforms with strong reliability, observability, security, compliance, and operational governance requirements. 

Senior Software Engineer Hiring Signal

- Senior Software Engineers are expected to design, build, and operate distributed SaaS platforms, own domain-level architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, mentor engineers, and deliver reliable cloud-native services using technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, while leveraging X3 domain knowledge to accelerate transformation rather than as a prerequisite for hiring. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering commercial products. Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering or a related field. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Substantial slices reach production predictably with tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback plans. 
 - Technical debt and coupling are reduced in the owned area without breaking supported customer behaviour. 
 - Code reviews, estimates and incident learning improve squad flow and engineering quality. 
 - Less experienced engineers deliver safely with useful coaching and examples. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Collaborates with Product, Principal/Staff Engineers, Software and Automation Engineers, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and domain specialists in Europe/North America. Owns outcomes from India with deliberate overlap for design and production conversations. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Takes ownership, raises risks early, gives kind and precise feedback, and keeps learning visible. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Break outcomes into sound designs, vertical slices and estimates; deliver production-quality code across services, APIs, UI or data paths. 
 - Make day-to-day technical decisions on component boundaries, GraphQL contracts, PostgreSQL access, observability, test strategy and safe rollout. 
 - Analyse legacy dependencies and contribute to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire decisions with evidence. 
 - Review code and designs, support incident resolution and improve the squad's automation, documentation and delivery flow. 
 - Pair with and mentor Software Engineers while learning from Principal Engineers and Architects. 

Decision ownership: 

Implementation design and sequencing inside the squad, technical risk escalation, test and observability approach, and readiness of owned work for review and release. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS

Location: Mumbai

Role: Full time, Founding Team

Joining: November

Looking for an engineer who is also an Entrepreneur, Builder and Mr. Figureoutable at heart to join our founding team. 

About Us: 

We are a D2C brand led by IITR alum. We are pre-launch and have raised pre-seed funding backed by founders of Souled Store, TIGC, partners from Investment banking, and strong startup operators. 

We aim to become a 5000 Crore brand by 2030 and tech would be at the core of how we achieve this goal. 

But why hire in tech for a D2C brand?

We're building what we hope will be one of India's first truly AI-native, tech-first D2C brands. 

- Not a D2C company that occasionally uses ChatGPT. 
 - A company where AI and technology are at the core of how we operate, make decisions, serve customers, and scaleThus we are looking for a Founding Engineer cum AI builder to make this happen. 

Who are we looking for?

- A strong full-stack engineer, AI enthusiast, problem solver, and someone with serious entrepreneurial energy. 
 - Has a high bias for action. You'd rather ship something in 3 days than discuss it for 3 weeks. 
 - Someone who can independently take products from idea to deployment. 
 - Can build for web and mobile (or is confident in figuring out what they don't know). 
 - Is genuinely excited about, stays highly updated and has built products using AI, LLMs, agents, and automation. 
 - Thinks like a founder, not just an engineer. 
 - Loves ownership, ambiguity, and figuring things out. 
 - Bachelors from tier-1 colleges - IIT/BITS/IIIT
 - Bonus: Experience building AI agents, agentic AI systems which are being used on production and at scale would be a big plus
 - Bonus: ex-founders, ex-founding engineer at funded startups

What will you actually do?

Pretty much everything tech. 

- Build our website, mobile app, and customer-facing experiences. 
 - Build AI agents and automate workflows across marketing, operations, customer experience, and more. 
 - Experiment with new AI tools, ship quickly, break things, fix things. 
 - Own the entire tech stack, from writing code to deploying products. 
 - Eventually help build the tech team as we scale. 

Why this should be exciting?

- Because you will one of the first few engineers in India who will build a real-life case study on building brands in the age of AI. 
 - You'll get to experiment with technology across the entire business, not just a product; and you get to see the impact your work is bringing. 
 - If you have that entrepreneurial itch, this could be one of the most interesting ways to scratch it. 
 - It's the perfect opportunity if you are looking for a role that could be a stepping stone before building your own startup

Important Disclaimer

- This might come with a pay cut. If maximizing your salary over the next 12 months is your top priority, this probably isn't the right opportunity. 
 - We're looking for someone optimizing for ownership, learning, building incredible things, and long-term upside. 
 - There will be meaningful ESOPs, real decision-making power, and a chance to build something that becomes a case study talked about globally. 

Interested?

 - Your gitbhub
 - Latest resume (not fully updated also works)
 - Link to something you've built that you're ridiculously proud of at palakjajoo10@gmail. com,

Job Description

Role purpose

Implement, test and support well-defined slices of X3 modernisation while developing strong X3 domain knowledge and safe engineering habits. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong software engineering experience in modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a proven ability to build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade services. 
 - Solid foundation in software design, object-oriented and distributed systems principles, API-first development, automated testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery practices. 
 - Required understanding of distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency patterns, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, observability, and data consistency trade-offs. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST, GraphQL, and event-based integrations, with strong understanding of API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and secure service interactions. 
 - Experience working with relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, migration, and operational considerations. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, including containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, secure software supply chains, and operational readiness. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Practical experience with modern web application development using React and TypeScript or equivalent modern dynamic UX frameworks, including component-based architectures, responsive and accessible user experiences, state management, browser diagnostics, and automated UI testing. 
 - Ability to learn and work effectively within Sage X3 business processes, metadata-driven architectures, extensibility models, modernization initiatives, and SaaS transformation programs. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed global engineering teams and contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Implement and test service/API contracts and integrations in the assigned discipline; follow secure CI/CD, identity/secrets and telemetry patterns, and contribute compatibility, upgrade and rollback checks. Build hands-on container or IaC skills when required by the owned service, using team-supported paths. 

Preferred Skills

- Commercial ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance experience, including L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL. 
 - React, automated API testing, telemetry, batch processing or migration tooling. 
 - Practical use of AI coding assistants with human review and regression checks. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years of professional software development, or equivalent practical experience. Degree, diploma or apprenticeship in computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Owned work is delivered to agreed acceptance criteria with useful tests and no avoidable regression. 
 - The engineer builds confidence in X3 domain knowledge and contributes to safe modernisation decisions. 
 - Defects, risks and support issues are surfaced early with enough evidence to act. 
 - Learning, review feedback and delivery estimates become more accurate over time. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Senior and Principal Engineers, Automation, Product, Architecture, Security, Cloud Support/L3 and Customer Services. India-based delivery is integrated with distributed squads and planned Europe/North America overlap. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Asks good questions, honours commitments, learns from feedback and keeps quality visible. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Implement features, fixes, APIs, components or migration assets from clear designs and acceptance criteria. 
 - Write maintainable code and automated tests, participate in review, and keep technical documentation and operational notes current. 
 - Learn X3 processes, metadata, Xtrem/X3 architecture and the effect of changes on customers, partners and upgrades. 
 - Use CI/CD, observability and local diagnostics to find problems early; escalate uncertainty with evidence. 
 - Contribute to refactoring, automation, accessibility, performance and reliability improvements within the squad. 

Decision ownership: 

Implementation choices within agreed patterns, test coverage for owned changes, and prompt escalation when requirements, customer behaviour, security or rollback are unclear. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

support consistent product quality and process control in a 24×7 pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

 Lead and coordinate QA and QC operations, ensuring adherence to cGMP requirements and the Quality

 Lead and develop the QA/QC team while fostering a strong, sustained commitment to quality.

 8-10 years of relevant experience in a process industry operating on a 24×7 basis. 

 Pharmaceutical industry background, including hands-on exposure to shop-floor operations. 

 Working knowledge of cGMP, QMS, IPQC/IPQA, process controls and pharmaceutical quality documentation. 

 Experience in statutory and customer audits, including WHO-GMP audits, and the ability to prepare supporting documents. 

 Strong team-working skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 

 Computer proficiency and comfort with documentation and quality records.

data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Create and maintain dependable automated checks that protect X3 customer behaviour and give X3 squads fast feedback on every change, release and migration asset. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code. 
 - Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing. 
 - Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control. 
 - Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows. 
 - Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the team's secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices. 

Preferred Skills

- TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle. 
 - Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports. 
 - Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence. 
 - Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change. 
 - Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact. 
 - The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building a finance, accounting, payroll and expense management** solution****s** that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring. 
 - Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Develop automated UI, API, GraphQL, integration and regression tests from clear risks and acceptance criteria. 
 - Maintain test data, environments, diagnostics and documentation so failures can be reproduced and fixed efficiently. 
 - Contribute tests to CI/CD quality gates and help identify flaky, missing or redundant coverage. 
 - Learn X3 processes, metadata and customisation patterns so automation reflects real customer outcomes. 
 - Participate in defect analysis, release verification, upgrade checks and rollback rehearsals. 

Decision ownership: 

Test implementation for assigned stories, defect evidence, coverage recommendations and escalation of quality or environment risks. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Design Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Design Quality Assurance Engineer_(Immediate Joiners)

Experience: 5-8 Years

Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Biomedical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline

Job Summary

We are seeking a Design Assurance Engineer to ensure that product design, risk management, verification and validation, and design-control activities comply with applicable regulatory and quality requirements throughout the product lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support design control activities, including design inputs, design outputs, traceability, and maintenance of the Design History File (DHF). 
 - Lead or support product risk-management activities, including hazard analysis, FMEA, and Risk Management File preparation. 
 - Ensure compliance with ISO 14971 and applicable medical-device quality and regulatory requirements. 
 - Review and approve verification and validation (V&V) protocols and reports for hardware and software. 
 - Assess design and process changes and support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs). 
 - Support CAPA, nonconformance, complaint, and investigation activities. 
 - Participate in internal, customer, and regulatory audits. 
 - Work closely with R&D, systems, software, hardware, quality, and regulatory teams. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation, traceability, and objective evidence are maintained throughout product development. Required Skills

- Strong knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR Part 820. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and IEC 62366. 
 - Experience with design controls, risk management, and V&V processes. 
 - Strong technical documentation and review skills. 
 - Ability to interpret engineering and regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable quality processes. 
 - Experience in audit preparation and supporting regulatory compliance activities. Preferred

- CQE, CQA, or equivalent quality certification. 
 - Experience in medical devices or other regulated/safety-critical products.
