 - Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes. 
 - Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment. 

Why Chubb?

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results. 

- Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence

Employee Benefits

data.description:
Requisition Id: 1753732

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and 'It's yours to build' which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self. 

The opportunity : Manager-National-Business Consulting Risk-CBS - RM - Proj & Operations - Mumbai

National : 

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience. 

CBS - RM - Proj & Operations : 

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. 

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are : 

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses. 

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management. 

Your Key Responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Work profile: Compliance and Risk management We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive team member to join Consulting SL Quality team. The candidate will be required to work as part of the Consulting SL Quality team on a range of programs and initiatives for compliance and risk management on EY's various sector related consulting engagements for clients. Assist with Quality operations: 
 - Review and monitoring - Review the engagement set-ups under India Consulting practice and assist in evaluating the compliance for them, from firm's policies and guidance perspective - Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to ensure smooth review and compliance processes. - Provide timely updates and reports to management on review statuses and other quality initiatives. - Tracking the consolidated status of the same for the allocated partners/SMUs (prior experience of Contract reading is a must) - Connect with the assigned EPs on the monthly basis to discuss and track their progress on Quality KPI - Monitor the team-members on assigned segment and ensure completion of Quality KPis
 - Consultation and specific support - Assisting with timely consultations, as required, by client-serving professionals - Action on the responses received for the set-up related queries raised by the candidate Other activities / support - Maintaining and providing consolidated updates for each of the above activities - assistance on ad-hoc job activities as required from time to time - Timely escalation, as and when required, to ensure adherence to defined timelines and to highlight any other critical issues as and when identified Desired Skills: - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. - Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. - Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities. - Proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong sense of perseverance. - Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance. - Previous experience in a quality assurance or onboarding role is a plus. - Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. - Time management skills with a focus on fast turnaround times. - Work Planning and Management - Experienced in related function will be an added advantage. Education: - Master's/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. ________________________________________

Skills And Attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification

- Master's/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. 

Experience

- - Master's/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. 

What We Look For

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach. 

What We Offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities. 

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people-enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing. 

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. 

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement

Tower

Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Location

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

Reports to

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

Role type

People manager

Scope

Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

Grade

About The Hub

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

Key Responsibilities

- Transition and shared services set-up
 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 
 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls
 - Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 
 - Continuous improvement and digital
 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 
 - People leadership, performance and culture
 - Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. 
 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. 
 - Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. 
 - By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. 
 - Within 12-18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

KPI

Indicative target

Hub-wide SLA adherence

≥ 95% across towers

Validated CI Benefits

Annual savings and hours released against target

Automation hours released

Increased year on year

Reporting timeliness and accuracy

100% on schedule

Hub CSAT / NPS

At or above target

Audit and quality findings

Closed within agreed timelines

CI participation

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 

Technical Skills

- Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. 
 - Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. 
 - Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. 
 - Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). 
 - ITIL service level management and quality management systems. 
 - Benefits realisation and business case development. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

Customer-centric leadership

- Builds teams from zero
 - Drives change and adoption
 - Sound judgement under pressure
 - Influences without authority across countries
 - Data-led decision making
 - Coaches and develops talent
 - Holds a high bar on control

Essential

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. 
 - Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. 
 - Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

Preferred

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO. 

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter. 

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can. 

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria. 

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails. 

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls). 

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one. 

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents. 

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers. 

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework. 

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud. 

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal. 

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders. 

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails. 

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services. 

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling. 

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications. 

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents. 

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed. 

About Moring

Moring helps enterprises put AI agents into production safely.

Organizational Overview

Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony's risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony's Second Line of Defense. 

Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges. 

Role Summary/ Purpose

The eGRC Solution Architect is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that automate, standardize, and integrate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.

 - Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony's risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony's Second Line of Defense. 

Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges. 

Role Summary/ Purpose

The eGRC Solution Architect is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that automate, standardize, and integrate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver GRC solutions: Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions. 
 - Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions . 
 - Lead technical implementations : Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms. 
 - Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation. 
 - Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
 - Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives . 
 - GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 . 
 - Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Architectural and technical skills: Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines. 
 - Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

Work Timings: 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.

data.title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
data.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a motivated and detail oriented Software Product Assurance Engineer for Space Systems to join our growing team. 

As our new Software Product Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of software throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle. You will define and evolve software product assurance requirements, adapted to lean and agile development practices, while applying a criticality-based approach where the level of rigour is aligned with the safety and mission impact of each software item. 

You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, AIT, Product Assurance and supplier teams to ensure that software development, verification, configuration management and change control activities meet the required quality and product assurance standards. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve software product assurance requirements across the development lifecycle, adapted to lean and agile development practices. 
 - Apply a criticality-based approach to software product assurance, scaling the level of rigour according to the safety and mission impact of the software item. 
 - Develop, implement, monitor and review Software Product Assurance (SW PA) plans. 
 - Oversee and participate in verification and validation (V&V) activities according to defined V&V plans. 
 - Support Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) activities, working with IV&V personnel to mitigate software risks and enhance safety and quality. 
 - Help drive internal and external reviews of development plans and software designs to ensure seamless integration with the satellite system. 
 - Participate in the analysis and evaluation of software designs, including change impact analysis and regression testing, particularly for COTS software. 
 - Support Product Assurance activities across engineering and flight models and associated infrastructure, ensuring documentation and objective evidence are captured consistently. 
 - Contribute to estimating and tracking the expected reliability and availability of the satellite platform as part of Product Assurance reporting. 
 - Support Product Assurance follow-up on supplier discrepancies and defects, ensuring corrective actions are documented and tracked. 
 - Support engineering change control, including understanding the Class I / Class II concept and ensuring the required approvals are obtained. 
 - Be willing to travel to supplier facilities for audits when required. 

Skills And Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace, electronics, information technology, systems engineering and minimum 8 years of work experience in a similar relevant field. 
 - Knowledge of software development processes and lifecycles. 
 - Knowledge of software verification techniques, including testing and inspections. 
 - Knowledge of software configuration management fundamentals and related tools. 
 - Clear conceptual understanding of the difference between proactive Product Assurance and retrospective Quality Control. 
 - Familiarity with non-conformances, deviations, waivers, and corrective/preventive actions, including RCA and CAPA, at a basic level. 
 - Awareness of SW Product Assurance principles and the ECSS/Q Product Assurance philosophy. 
 - Ability to constructively challenge engineering decisions and ask, "What is the risk?"
 - Comfortable working cross-functionally with systems, hardware, software, AIT and suppliers. 
 - Clear and effective technical writing and communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 - Previous exposure to satellite technologies through an internship, thesis, or student satellite project (e. g. CubeSat, nanosat or payloads), with an understanding of software Product Assurance concepts such as verification matrices, test coverage and configuration management. 
 - Introductory knowledge of risk management and single-point failure identification, with proficiency in C/C++ and Python and familiarity with NASA software assurance standards such as NASA-STD-8739. 8 and NASA-GB-8719. 13. 

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment - you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. 
 - Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space . 
 - Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. 
 - We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking - runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion. 

Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications

and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era. 

The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies

For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.

data.title: FFR - Lead Software Engineer – Backend & AI/ML & Cloud
data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

The team comprises highly motivated engineers and stakeholders who are passionate about extracting targeted insights from diverse document sources and transforming them into high-value data products. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, the team focuses on building scalable pipelines that efficiently collect, structure, and process large volumes of data. 

Over time, the team has developed a robust and high-performing data pipeline capable of generating best-in-class structured datasets that power FactSet's products. Currently, the team is advancing this ecosystem by driving end-to-end automation across multiple stages of the pipeline. This includes the development of an event-driven, GenAI-centric, agent-based infrastructure aimed at enhancing efficiency, scalability, and innovation in data processing workflows. 

SUB-PROCESS BRIEF

Leads development strategies, architecture designs, data management, and code flow analysis necessary for the software development life cycle. Works closely with different groups/teams to ensure engineering team delivers on precision/correctness, performance, and scalability across our distributed computational framework. 

What You'll Do: -

- AI/ML & LLM Expertise: 
 - Design, fine-tune, and deploy small and open-source large language models (LLMs) such as Llama, Mistral, OpenAI GPT, etc. 
 - Hands-on leadership in prompt engineering, few-shot prompting, and building advanced NLP/NLU workflows. 
 - Guide adoption of modern AI/ML frameworks (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, etc. ) and architect reusable pipelines in Python. 
 - Python & API Development: 
 - Drive critical systems architecture in Python, using best practices in API and microservices design (FastAPI, Flask, Django, etc. ). 
 - Cloud Deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP): 
 - Architect, deploy, and scale robust, production-grade ML/AI solutions on cloud (AWS strongly preferred), leveraging cloud-native tools (Lambda, S3, ECS/ECR/Fargate, etc. ), serverless, and IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform). 
 - Champion DevOps best practices, automation, containerization (Docker/K8s), CI/CD, and operational monitoring. 
 - Technical Leadership: 
 - Mentor engineers, lead by example, drive system architecture reviews and code standards, and ensure high-quality technical delivery across teams. 
 - Act as the technical point of contact for escalation, incident resolution, and production troubleshooting. 
What We're Looking For: -

- Experience: 
 - 8-12 years in software development, including 3+ in senior or lead roles delivering ML/AI solutions in a cloud environment. 
 - LLM & Prompt Engineering: 
 - Strong real-world experience in LLM prompt engineering, few-shot prompting, and fine-tuning (using frameworks like Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, etc. ). 
 - Python Expertise: 
 - Mastery of Python for API/microservice development, object-oriented patterns, code optimization, automated testing, and packaging. 
 - Cloud (AWS Preferred): 
 - Hands-on deployment and scaling of AI/ML services on AWS, Azure, or GCP; proficient in containers, serverless, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Technical Leadership: 
 - Proven experience mentoring software engineers, shaping system design, and driving cross-team initiatives. 
 - Communication: 
 - Exceptional ability to explain complex technical subjects and influence technical direction with diverse audiences. 
Nice to Have: -

- Databricks: 
 - Experience building, deploying, or orchestrating ML/AI or data pipelines on Databricks (Data Engineering, MLflow, collaborative workflows, jobs). 
 - (Note: Knowledge of Databricks is highly valued but not required; candidates without PySpark but with Databricks experience are welcome. )
 - PySpark: 
 - Experience using PySpark for big data ETL/processing, but not a must-have. 
 - Data Engineering: 
 - Familiarity with Spark, Airflow, advanced data analytics stacks, and modern data lakes (e. g. , Delta Lake). 
 - ML Productionization & MLOps: 
 - Experience with ML lifecycle tools, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and model governance. 
 - Visualization: 
 - Python-based dashboarding/analytics (Streamlit, Dash, Plotly). 
 - Security & Compliance: 
 - Secure cloud design, IAM, encryption, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Published Work / Open Source: 
 - Contributions to AI/ML communities, conference presentations, or technical publications. 
Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent. 
 - Experience working in product engineering organizations preferred. 

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: 

- The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. 
 - Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days. 
 - Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives. 
 - A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions. 
 - Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development. 
 - Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging. 

Learn More About Our Benefits Here. 

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications. 

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

data.description:
Responsibilities

Architect, implement, and validate innovative DFT techniques on ARM SoCs. Insert DFT logic into SoC style designs at the RTL level and at the Synthesis gate level, validate all features, and generate ATE targeted test patterns to be run on silicon. Work closely with front-end design and verification teams on DFT RTL level insertion, back-end synthesis, place-and-route, and static-timing-analysis teams on gate level insertion and timing closure, and Test and Debug teams on silicon characterization and validation. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Core DFT skills considered for this position should include some of the following: Scan compression and insertion, Memory BIST and repair scheme implementation, Logic BIST, JTAG/IJTAG, at-speed test, ATPG, fault simulation, back-annotated gate level verification, silicon debug, memory and scan diagnostics
 - Experience ranges from 3- 20 Years. 
 - Experience coding Verilog RTL, TCL and/or Perl
 - Proficient in Unix/Linux environments
 - Bachelors or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Familiarity with IEEE 1149, 1500, 1687, 1838
 - Synthesis & Static Timing Analysis
 - Familiarity with SoC style architectures including multi-clock domain and low power design practices. 
 - Validated understanding of Siemens DFT tools
 - Familiarity with Arm IP like the following: Cortex CPUs, Mali GPUs, AMBA protocols, CoreLink interconnects, CoreSight debug
 - Experience with 2. 5D and 3D test
 - Ability to work both collaboratively on a team and independently
 - Hard-working and excellent time management skills with an ability to multi-task

Managing and developing teams of high quality Data Center Technicians, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager - AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions. . 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks. 
 - Drive enterprise-wide adoption of intelligent agents built using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#). 
 - Define architecture standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Mentor team members and ensure high-quality delivery across AI initiatives. 
 - Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. 
 - Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#). 
 - Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem. 
 - Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows. 
 - Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components. 
 - Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards. 
 - Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore-offshore delivery models. 

Ideally, you'll also

The following skills are preferred and add value to the role: 

- Experience with Power Platform. 
 - Experience with Azure Integration Services. 
 - Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
 - Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
 - Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

What We Look For

- Total Experience: [12+ Years]
 - Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
 - Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements. 
 - Degree in BE / B. Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience. 
 - Microsoft AI certification is preferred. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you. 

, , JR2024865

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Real Time Index Engineering(Java)
data.description:
FTSE Russell is a leading global provider of financial services, specialising in the creation and management of indexes, data, and analytic solutions. As part of the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we support investors worldwide in making informed decisions across asset classes, investment strategies, and market segments. Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk. 

Job Summary

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Reliability, security, and data quality are non-negotiable as we modernise the platform that underpins our entire real-time franchise. 

The ideal candidate is a self-sufficient, technically excellent engineer who can lead through architectural clarity, thorough code review, and hands-on delivery. You combine strong expertise in low-latency, event-driven system design, data modelling, and debugging with genuine passion for how AI tooling is redefining software engineering. This is an individual contributor role where you will lead through the quality of your thinking and your engineering standards. 

AI-First Engineering This team operates with an AI-first approach. We expect hands-on experience with AI development tooling: terminal-based agents, AI-augmented IDEs, and automated workflows. You are ultimately accountable for production quality, security, and correctness. This means owning infrastructure review, security validation, system observability, and operational guardrails. 

What You'll Do

- Build low-latency, event-driven calculation engines that price indices accurately through market events. 
 - Operate a cloud-native, horizontally scalable, always-on platform, built as resilient and managed through infrastructure as code. 
 - Own data foundations for real-time market and reference data, with strong modelling, quality and auditability. 
 - Deliver secure APIs and streaming, event-driven distribution that make real-time index data easy to consume. 
 - Help bring advanced and multi-asset methodologies to market (e. g. volatility-controlled, options/futures-based, long-short). 
 - Modernise the operations experience: replace manual workflows with intuitive tooling and observability. 
 - Lead through architecture, code review and test strategy, partnering across product, operations and client-facing teams. 

Tech Stack

- Development: Java, C#, , Python, SQL, OpenAPI
 - Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required)
 - Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres
 - IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab
 - AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

Experience We Value

- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong expertise in system design, distributed and event-driven systems, and relational data modelling. 
 - Solid experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS. 
 - Ability to write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent). 
 - Experience designing test strategies at multiple levels of the testing pyramid. 
 - Proficiency with AI development tooling and a clear understanding of how to use AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality. 
 - Strong debugging skills across distributed systems. 
 - Basic understanding of financial services or capital markets. 
 - Effective collaboration and the ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical audiences. 

How We Work

The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools. 

- Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution.

 - Act as owners. Operate as though it is your business. Make thoughtful trade-offs and deliver long-term value. 
 - Lead with data. Validate assumptions, stay close to the details, act decisively. 
 - Build responsibly, deliver incrementally. Look for the small opportunities and milestones to build ambitious solutions. 
 - AI-native by default. Use AI tooling as a force multiplier, frame problems clearly, validate continually, and own the output.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with 6+ years of relevant industry experience and demonstrated technical leadership at lead or head of engineering level. 

• Experience working with international teams and coordinating quality across multiple projects and external partners. 

• Strong foundations in design, engineering and manufacturing, supported by experience solving real industrial engineering problems. 

• Hands-on expertise in CAD and FEA, with sufficient breadth to evaluate CFD work alongside specialists and recognise the limits of an analysis. 

• Experience reviewing and approving other engineers' work, challenging assumptions, and making defensible technical decisions. 

• Proficiency in relevant CAD and simulation tools, such as SolidWorks, Ansys, Abaqus, Fluent, or Simcenter.

data.title: Senior CPU Verification Engineer
data.description:
CPU Random Tools Engineer - Grade 4

Introduction to Arm

You know us. With 125 Arm-powered products shipped every second, we'll be in over a trillion smart devices by 2035. Your smartphone, award-winning VR gaming, the world's fastest supercomputer - our engineers are crafting the sophisticated core processors leading the race towards a connected, autonomous, hyper-performance future. 

ARM designs the technology that is at the heart of sophisticated digital products, from wireless, networking and consumer entertainment solutions to imaging, automotive, security and storage devices. ARM improves people's lives by enabling the intelligence in affordable, easy-to-use electronic products that transform the way we live and work. We work in partnership with a global network of leading technology companies which are using our smart low-power technology. Together we are enabling the future of a better world. 

ARM is well recognized as the market leader in the CPU and System IP industry and this has been achieved by consistently delivering reliable and high quality IP products. The cost of design and manufacturing is high and that warrants "right first time" approach for all IP and System products. Time-to-market is essential for our partners to take care of steadfast competition in the marketplace, being first would enable them to get premium value from the end products. In this context, Design Verification of CPU IPs is an exciting challenge requiring an engineering abilities that is both broad and deep. 

So, we promise you endless exciting opportunities to experiment and go even further in CPU IP design!

Job Description: Role and Responsibilities

As an Engineer responsible for CPU Random Tools for stress verification, you will work on a sophisticated Random Instruction Sequences (RIS) tool. With a combination of techniques, the tool verifies the functionality of our CPU cores, being designed in Austin (US), Cambridge (UK) or Sophia Antipolis (FR). The existing team ensures addition of new architecture features, its customization to specific CPU cores, and provides support. 

You will be based in Arm's Bangalore design centre in India. 

As Senior Verification Engineer, your role will cover the development of the tool from development to deployment, and accountable for: 

- Understanding the intricacies of the CPU micro-architecture and defining how to push the test boundaries; 
 - Architect and develop solutions to improve the generation of stimuli to produce programs to stress our next generation CPUs; 
 - Implementing and supporting the tool, from the early stages of CPU development to product maturity. 

Job Requirements

- Problem Ownership and ability to work from abstract requirements 
 - Good communication and presentation skills 
 - Self-motivated and willing to take up additional responsibilities 
 - Quick learner with a strong desire to learn and develop new skills

Qualification And Experience

- B. Tech/B. S. or MTech/M. S. in Computer/Electronics Engineering or Computer Science from a reputed institute 
 - 5-10 years of stable proven experience with significant project contributions

Crucial Skills

- You hold experience in software design, and should be comfortable working with low-level hardware 
 - You have good solid understanding of programming languages, such as C and Python 
 - You are knowledgeable about CPU architecture and micro-architecture concepts 
 - You are able to understand assembly language (ASM) 
 - You have strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well as part of a team with the willingness to tackle varied technical challenges. 

Desirable Skills

- Fundamentals of Processor Architecture. 
 - Basics of ARM Architecture. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and Hardware Design Verification. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Equal Opportunities

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic UK Highways Design Leaders to lead the delivery of complex highway infrastructure projects for our UK business. This role combines strong technical expertise, project leadership, stakeholder management, and people leadership to drive successful project outcomes while contributing to the strategic growth and capability development of the Highways discipline. 

Responsibilities

Project & Technical Leadership

Lead the end-to-end delivery of UK highway design projects, ensuring compliance with programme, budget, quality, and client expectations. 

Serve as a technical authority for highway engineering, applying advanced engineering principles to solve complex design challenges. 

Drive technical excellence, innovation, and the adoption of industry best practices, digital delivery solutions, and emerging technologies. 

Review and approve technical designs, reports, specifications, and engineering documentation. 

Ensure designs comply with relevant UK standards, regulations, and client requirements.

Identify and manage technical, commercial, and delivery risks, implementing mitigation strategies where required. 

Ensure adherence to Quality Assurance (QA), CDM Regulations, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), and Sustainability requirements.

Drive capability development and career progression for early-career professionals and emerging leaders. 

Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture focused on excellence and continuous improvement.

Support discipline leadership with workforce planning, utilisation forecasting, and performance management. 

Contribute to strategic growth initiatives and the expansion of UK Highways capabilities within the GCC. 

Drive Lean and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, productivity, and operational excellence. 

Support the implementation of innovative tools, processes, and delivery methodologies.

Highway Geometry Design

Traffic Signs and Road Markings

Site Clearance and Highway Infrastructure Design

Civil 3D

OpenRoads Designer

MX

PDS / Keyline

AutoCAD

Proven experience in: 

Leading and developing technical teams

Stakeholder and client management

Project and resource management

Delivering projects to programme and budget requirements

Technical report writing, specifications, and design documentation

UK Highways design standards and regulations

Industry trends, innovation, and digital engineering practices

 - Drive performance optimization, scalability planning, and production reliability across multiple web apps serving internal and external users
 - Lead technical discovery and solutioning for new features, integrations, AI tooling, and platform migrations
 - Own CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in collaboration with the DevOps team - GitLab CI, conventional commits, and deployment automation
 - Conduct deep-dive code reviews and architectural walkthroughs ensuring correctness, maintainability, and TypeScript-first quality
 - Champion automated testing strategy - unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage using Jest, Vitest, and Playwright
 - Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Antigravity) to accelerate development and model best practices for the team. 

People & Delivery Management (30%)

- Lead and grow a team of 6-12 engineers - manage hiring, onboarding, and career development
 - Set clear goals, expectations, and performance benchmarks - conduct regular 1: 1s and structured performance reviews
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers toward technical leadership; build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into engineering roadmaps and delivery plans
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (QA, DevOps, Design, Product) to ensure smooth delivery and consistent quality
 - Manage project timelines, dependencies, and technical risk - communicate status and blockers to leadership proactively
 - Stay current with emerging technologies - AI agents, edge computing, WebSockets, MCP - and drive continuous adoption of better engineering practices. 

Technology Skills In Order Of Priority

- TypeScript - 10+ years; deep expertise in strong typing, generics, and TypeScript-first

architecture on both frontend and backend. TypeScript is the primary language - not Python. 

- AI Agents - hands-on experience with Cloudflare Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Flue, or similar; prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and AI-powered feature integration
 - Cloud Providers - AWS (S3, Athena, k8s/EKS) and/or Azure; hands-on infrastructure and deployment experience
 - REST APIs, WebSockets & MCP Servers - designing, governing, and consuming APIs; real-time services and Model Context Protocol server integration
 - Node. js / NestJS - backend service development, TypeScript-based REST and WebSocket APIs
 - SQL / PostgreSQL & Prisma ORM - query optimization, data modeling, schema design, and ORM-based data access
 - Git & CI/CD - GitLab CI pipelines, conventional commits, branching strategies, and release automation
 - Python - working familiarity for scripting and data tasks (deprioritized; TypeScript preferred for all APIs and services)
 - UX Engineering mindset - deep appreciation for design systems, accessibility, and UI quality; UX engineering background is a strong plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 10 - 20 years of hands-on experience in full stack development (TypeScript+Node).

 - Proven track record of delivering large-scale, distributed, cloud-hosted applications
 - Demonstrated ability to grow and retain high-performing engineering teams
 - Strong problem-solving, system design, and architectural decision-making skills

data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Switching Software Engineer to lead innovation and development of cutting-edge managed switching solutions for small and medium enterprise (SME) markets. This role requires deep technical expertise in switching software architecture and product-level understanding to drive breakthrough innovations in cost-effective, feature-rich managed switches from 10GB to 400GB targeting SME deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Product Innovation Leadership: Drive breakthrough innovations in SME-focused switching features including zero-touch provisioning, cloud-based management integration, and AI-powered network optimization
 - SME Feature Development: Lead development of enterprise-grade features optimized for SME deployments: simplified network segmentation, automated VLAN provisioning, intelligent traffic prioritization, and plug-and-play enterprise security
 - Cost-Performance Optimization: Innovate cost-effective solutions that deliver enterprise functionality at SME price points while maintaining performance
 - Customer-Driven Innovation: Lead research into SME networking pain points and develop innovative software solutions for simplified network management
 - Platform Differentiation: Drive technical differentiation through innovative features like ML-based network anomaly detection, automated capacity planning, and predictive maintenance for SME environments
 - Market-Focused Architecture: Design switching architectures that balance advanced enterprise features with SME deployment simplicity and cost constraints
 - Innovation Partnerships: Collaborate with product management and field teams to identify market opportunities and drive product innovation
 - Competitive Analysis: Lead technical competitive analysis and drive innovation to maintain market leadership in SME managed switching

SME Market Product Knowledge

- SME Network Challenges: Deep understanding of SME networking constraints including limited IT staff, budget sensitivity, and simplified management requirements
 - Market Positioning: Knowledge of SME switching market dynamics, competitive landscape, and differentiation opportunities
 - Enterprise Feature Adaptation: Expertise in adapting complex enterprise features for simplified SME deployment and management
 - TCO Optimization: Understanding of total cost of ownership considerations for SME customers including deployment, management, and maintenance costs

Advanced Switching Features for SME Market

- Intelligent Auto-Configuration: Zero-touch VLAN setup, automated QoS policies, and self-configuring network segmentation
